Job.JobDescription:
Job Description:

Job Title: Territory Sales Manager

Job Summary: Our Territory Sales Managers are responsible for driving profitable growth in their assigned territory. We are looking for motivated team players who can influence independent agents to sell Hallmark Auto and Renters products, develop existing and new agency relationships, generate production growth and execute business plans to meet the companies’ sales expectations.  A successful Territory Sales Manager will be able to accomplish this through communication with sales and product leadership, prospecting new opportunities, agency appointments, visits to existing agencies and through other field sales activities.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for managing and developing a territory of independent agents, including finding new agency partners and maintaining strong relationships with agents at all levels within the agencies.
  • Implement and execute sales strategies to achieve sales goals.
  • Drives new business policy and premium growth.
  • Assess agency mix of business, retention and profitability results.
  • Responsible for agency onboarding and training regarding Hallmark products and best practices such as company underwriting guidelines, programs, websites and rating tools.
  • Must be able to effectively present and communicate to large groups and influence behavior through consultive selling.
  • Required to evaluate agency relationships for profitability.
  • Attend and participate in industry conventions, events or groups associations.
  • Communicate industry trends, competitor changes and observations and feedback on existing products and market opportunities.
  • Maintain up to date records of field activity, contact information, sales strategy and new agency appointment paperwork and other critical reports and documentation.
  • This position is a field sales role and requires regular travel throughout the assigned territory with an expectation of 30% overnight travel

Qualifications for the Territory Sales Manager:

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree preferred or Experience of 3-5 years insurance sales experience
  • Experience: A working knowledge of non-standard auto insurance operations: claims, coverage, products and underwriting are preferable to effectively communicate with agency and company personnel
  • Skills:
    • Bi-Lingual (English and Spanish) is preferred
    • Proficient in Microsoft Office Applications
    • Excellent Communication and Interpersonal Skills
    • Organization and Time Management
    • Ability to analyze and interpret report data through spreadsheets. Must be able to interpret statistical data from company records and build action plans around insights
    • Problem Solving Skills
    • Must be flexible in nature and highly motivated self-starter

Hallmark Financial Services is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Description:

Job Summary
The Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and Information Technology to support system enhancements, business initiatives, and process improvements within Commercial Insurance operations. This role combines business analysis, ticket administration, requirements documentation, testing, and defect management throughout the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has strong Commercial Insurance knowledge and experience participating in projects, system implementations, testing efforts, or process improvement initiatives.

Commercial Insurance experience is a core requirement for this position. This role supports multiple concurrent initiatives and requires the ability to effectively manage competing priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and maintain progress in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, highly organized, a quick learner, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with business and technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

·         Gather, analyze, and document business requirements.

·         Partner with business stakeholders and IT teams to support solution design and implementation.

·         Manage requests, enhancements, and defects through the development lifecycle.

·         Create and maintain requirements, project documentation, and process flows.

·         Develop and execute test scenarios and test cases to validate system functionality.

·         Perform manual testing of enhancements, defect fixes, and system changes.

·         Assist with regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

·         Research reported issues, document findings, and coordinate defect resolution.

·         Apply Commercial Insurance knowledge to evaluate business requirements and system functionality.

·         Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

·         Commercial Insurance experience.

·         Experience supporting business projects, system implementations, process improvements, testing efforts, or technology initiatives.

·         Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

·         Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

·         Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

·         Self-motivated with strong time management and organizational skills.

·         Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.

·         Ability to quickly learn new systems, processes, and business concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

·         Business Analyst experience.

·         Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.

·         Experience with software testing, quality assurance, or User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

·         Experience working with policy administration systems.

·         Experience with Diamond, Cover-All, or comparable insurance systems.

·         Experience working directly with business and IT teams.

Education & Experience

·         Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience preferred.

·         Commercial Insurance experience required.

·         Experience supporting business analysis, system implementations, process improvement initiatives, testing efforts, or technology-related projects preferred.

·         Experience in underwriting, policy administration, operations, product support, or related Commercial Insurance functions strongly preferred.

·         Experience with policy administration systems such as Diamond, Cover-All, or comparable insurance platforms preferred.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Merrillville, IN.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling

#LI-Hybrid

The Workers’ Compensation Claims Specialist manages within company best practices lower-level, non-complex and non-problematic workers’ compensation claims within delegated limited authority to best possible outcome, under the direct supervision of a senior claims professional, supporting the goals of claims department and of CorVel.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers’ Compensation claims, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgment of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Manages non-complex lost-time workers’ compensation claims under close supervision
  • Communicates claim status with the customer, claimant and client
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Assists other claims professionals with more complex or problematic claims as necessary
  • Additional projects and duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to learn rapidly to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to meet or exceed performance competencies
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 1 year of industry experience and claims management preferred
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE: 

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time. 

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process. 

Pay Range:  $52,999 – $85,473 

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management 

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

The Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

This role is available for both remote and hybrid work arrangements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers’ Compensation claim, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgement of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim by investigating and gathering information regarding the claim and files necessary documentation with state agencies
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Develops and manages well documented action plans with the case manager and outcomes manager to reduce overall cost of the claim
  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties
  • Manages subrogation and litigation of claim as it applies
  • Manages potential claim recoveries of all types
  • Reports claims to the excess carrier when applicable
  • Communicates claim status with the customer and claimant
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Develops and maintains professional customer relationships
  • Complies with rules and regulations of applicable state
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

Pay Range:  $61,053 – $98,334

The Provider Network Manager is responsible for National provider network management including, development and implementation of corporate network initiatives within CorVel’s proprietary networks, specifically the CareIQ Ancillary Care Networks. This individual should have a background in vendor management, PPO or Specialty/Ancillary network contracting and developing, with strong negotiation skills and management experience. 

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensures ancillary vendor and provider contracted provider and vendor rates meet corporate requirements and goals; holds account for national contracts’ impact on direct expenses and subsequent product profitability, while maintaining strong relationships with vendor/provider representatives
  • Collaborates with local stakeholders to improve nationwide and state-by-state networking strategy, contracted rates and outcomes as needed
  • Manages operational and business requirements language utilized in ancillary provider and vendor contracts
  • Reviews and evaluates facility contract language and rates on an annual basis; makes necessary changes in collaboration with all impacted stakeholders, internal and external
  • Identifies National contract opportunities, potential participants and client nominations
  • Builds familiarity with Workers’ Compensation, Auto insurance and Group Health rules and regulations relating to the ability to channel patients, reimbursement schedules, PPO reduction limitations, etc.
  • Works with CorVel Provider Relations staff in educating providers on CareIQ program rules and regulations, contract terminology, and service expectations from participating provider and vendor groups
  • Conducts group training calls and individual training meetings as needed
  • Identifies provider network coverage and service deficiencies; owns the resolution strategy and implementation
  • Manages national provider/network issues and projects to resolution and completion
  • Manages network contracts through legal review and approval process; assists with arbitration unto resolution as applicable
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: 

  • Strong interpersonal skills and adaptive communication style
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • In-depth problem solving skills, drive for results and innovation
  • Proven track record of delivering concrete results in strategic projects/programs
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to deliver results in a fast paced and dynamic environment
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications and able to quickly learn corporate proprietary systems

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Health Care Management or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience of PPO network development and/or network management with proven success required
  • Experience managing national ancillary healthcare provider network relationships preferred
  • Experience managing provider/vendor contracts and relationships in the worker’s compensation industry preferred

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

The WC Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards.   • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Boise, ID.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

This is a remote position but candidates must reside in Idaho.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $63,739 – $95,264

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in California.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager, you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

This is a remote position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position for KY, preferably in the Georgetown/ Lexington, KY area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Preferred to have national certification – CCM, COHN, CRRN, CDMS
  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients.  We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities.  Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

#LI-Remote

The Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

This is a remote role.

New York state independent adjuster license required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers’ Compensation claim, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgement of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim by investigating and gathering information regarding the claim and files necessary documentation with state agencies
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Develops and manages well documented action plans with the case manager and outcomes manager to reduce overall cost of the claim
  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties
  • Manages subrogation and litigation of claim as it applies
  • Manages potential claim recoveries of all types
  • Reports claims to the excess carrier when applicable
  • Communicates claim status with the customer and claimant
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Develops and maintains professional customer relationships
  • Complies with rules and regulations of applicable state
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • New York state independent adjuster license required.
  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $61,053 – $98,334

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

The Bill Review Analyst is responsible for reviewing, auditing and data-entry of medical bills for multiple states and lines of business.

This role is available for remote, hybrid, and onsite work arrangements.

The Business Analyst is an individual with current expertise in CorVel’s Care Management or claims management system and related product lines. As a member of the Business Operations Team the candidate will be asked to utilize expertise in a particular product line, but not be limited to projects in that particular area, and frequently collaborate with various subject-matter experts.

The position requires excellent listening and problem-solving attributes in addition to effective communication skills. The ability to evaluate alternative options and make decisions is a necessary attribute.

The position requires the individual to work in conjunction with CorVel management and field operations to develop consistent enterprise-wide workflow processes. The candidate will translate the consistent workflow processes into business requirements that can be developed into software applications through daily collaboration with the CorVel development team.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work with team members, software engineers, and business stakeholders to gain expertise with claims and care management applications and how these function in our production environments
  • Interacts with business users, software engineers, technical staff and state experts to help identify, analyze, and implement enhancements as they are requested
  • Work with business stakeholders to determine new opportunities for automation and increased quality controls in our core products
  • Follow team protocol for updating, recording and organizing documentation
  • Apply  process and system knowledge to diagnose and resolve complex business problems
  • Follow established escalation protocol when issues arise that may cause backlog of release expectations
  • Acquire extensive business and system knowledge
  • Apply system knowledge to diagnose and resolve complex business problems
  • Work with business stakeholders to determine new opportunities for automation and increased quality controls in our core products
  • Follow team protocol for updating, recording and organizing documentation

The Quality Assurance Nurse is responsible for case management quality assurance and mentorship of operations staff, providing tools and calibrating processes, while ensuring consistent delivery of CorVel’s case management services.

  • Develop, implement, and provide ongoing quality assurance calibration of processes as well as a case management mentoring, both managed and delivered at the operational level

Job.JobDescription:
The Telephonic Case Manager coordinates resources and develops cost-effective, personalized care plans for ill or injured individuals. The goal is to support quality treatment and, when appropriate, a timely return to work. This role uses clinical expertise to assess the appropriateness of current treatment plans based on the patient’s medical and physical condition. The Case Manager communicates directly with treating physicians to evaluate and recommend alternative care options when needed. They also explain medical conditions and treatment plans to patients, family members, and adjusters, while supporting the objectives of the Case Management department and of CorVel.

This is a remote role.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide medical case management to individuals through coordination with the patient, the physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Provide assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluate patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Utilize medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan/alternate treatment plans with the physician
  • Make medical recommendations of available treatment plans to the payer
  • Implement care such as negotiating and coordinating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • Devise cost-effective strategies for medical care
  • Required to prepare organized reports within a specified timeframe
  • Minimum Productivity Standard is 95% per month

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field (Medical) Case Manager position in the Tampa, FL area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field (Medical) Case Manager position in the Fairfax, VA area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

    KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

    • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
    • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
    • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
    • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
    • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
    • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

    • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
    • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
    • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
    • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
    • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

      PAY RANGE:

      CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

      For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

      Pay Range:  $66,941 - $101,258

      A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

      In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. The ideal candidate has a sharp eye for visual storytelling and excels at building polished, on-brand PowerPoint presentations and engaging social media, digital ads and print assets. This role is for a creative self-starter who can manage multiple projects at once, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and ensure brand consistency across all marketing collateral. The majority of this role will be spent designing presentation decks for sales, leadership, and marketing, along with graphics for LinkedIn and other social channels, with additional support on broader marketing design needs as they arise. Strong design fundamentals, organizational skills, and an eagerness to grow with the company are essential.

This is a fully remote role.

Responsibilities:

•      Design, build, and refine PowerPoint presentations for sales, account management, leadership, and marketing, including pitch decks, internal updates, and client-facing materials (primary focus of the role).

•      Develop and maintain a library of branded, reusable PowerPoint templates, slide layouts, and master slides to improve consistency and speed across the organization.

•      Create engaging graphics and visual content for CorVel's LinkedIn account and other social channels, in partnership with the content marketing team (primary focus of the role).

•      Translate complex concepts and data into clear, polished slide visuals, including charts, diagrams, and infographics.

•      Collaborate cross-functionally with content, digital, product, and sales teams to gather requirements and turn them into compelling presentation and social content.

•      Maintain and evolve CorVel's brand identity, ensuring visual consistency across presentations, social assets, and all marketing collateral.

•      Support additional marketing design needs as they arise, including email templates, one-pagers, case studies, whitepapers and trade show assets.

•      Manage multiple design requests simultaneously, prioritizing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

•      Coordinate with external designers, agencies, and other vendors as needed.

•      Stay current on presentation design and social content trends, bringing fresh ideas to the marketing team.

Qualifications:

•      Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Fine Arts, or a related field.

•      2-4 years of experience in graphic design, with significant hands-on experience building presentations in PowerPoint.

•      Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design and social media graphics, ideally alongside broader marketing design work.

•      Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint (including custom templates, master slides, and animations); strong working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator).

•      Solid understanding of typography, layout, color theory, and brand systems, with the ability to apply them consistently across slides and social content.

•      Experience designing for social platforms (LinkedIn in particular), with an understanding of platform-specific formats and best practices.

•      Excellent communication and time management skills, with the ability to take and incorporate feedback gracefully, often under tight turnaround times.

•      Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•      Experience in the healthcare or risk management industry (preferred).

•      Basic video editing or motion graphics skills (preferred).

•      Familiarity with marketing platforms/tools, including Canva, WordPress, Seismic, and Pardot/Salesforce (preferred).

The RTW coordinator facilitates safe, timely and appropriate return to work outcomes for injured employees. Through working partnerships with CorVel’s clients, the coordinator will identify RTW potential and will coordinate activities to achieve return to work outcomes that are successful for our clients and the employee.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    • Direct contact with the client, injured employees and healthcare providers to determine RTW potential and coordinate RTW efforts
    • Active participation in RTW efforts with examiner and nurse case managers
    • Actively works with physicians to clarify medical restrictions, limitations and their impact on work functionality
    • Works with client locations to identify job functions that can be modified and creates a bank of potential RTW job descriptions for future use
    • Monitors injured workers' RTW status to increase functional ability before RTW period expires
    • Sets follow-ups to review claims where function is expected to increase and/or where release to RTW is anticipated
    • Accurate RTW screen coding and documentation of RTW efforts and outcomes
    • Identify trends and barriers to RTW with internal partners (Customer Delivery) to develop proactive solutions
    • Assist in internal and external audits and presentations, and participates in external customer meetings
    • Additional duties as assigned

    KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

    • Considerable exposure to medical conditions and terminology; knowledge of impact of medical conditions on work functions, job task analysis and worksite accommodations
    • Considerable experience with presenting in front of external customers regarding trend analyses and consultative services on RTW
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills
    • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and customer service skills
    • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
    • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
    • Ability to prioritize, effectively manage multiple tasks, work in a fast-paced environment and meet multiple deadlines, while maintaining accuracy
    • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

    • Bachelor’s degree in vocational Rehabilitation or related field
    • Minimum of 3 years' providing vocational rehabilitation services or 3 years as an occupational health nurse

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field (Medical) Case Manager position in Knoxville, TN.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

    KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

    • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
    • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
    • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
    • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
    • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
    • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

    • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
    • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
    • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
    • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
    • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in the Northern New Jersey area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing servicesThis role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

      KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

      • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
      • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
      • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
      • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
      • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
      • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

      EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

      • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
      • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
      • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
      • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
      • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

        PAY RANGE:

        CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

        For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

        Pay Range: $66,941 - $101,258

        A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Training & Development Specialist, Human Resources & Training
Job.JobDescription:
The Nurse Trainer is responsible for developing, assessing, administering, and revising training material for all positions in a clinical setting. This role reviews all existing training material, identifies areas in which it is lacking, and creates new supplemental material and training content to complement existing material. The goal of this process is to ensure that the triage program has adequate substance to determine whether existing nurses are adequately meeting job requirements and to equip all potential new nurses with the information and experience necessary to fulfill their new roles.

Strong verbal and written communication skills are important in this position, as these trainers not only create and edit written training material, but also interface with existing nurses at all levels to ascertain their training. As such, strong memory skills, close attention to detail, and high adaptability are all beneficial for the position.

 This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop Training curriculum with full agenda
  • Coordinate training for all nurses and stakeholders, ensuring appropriate training assignments are assigned and the scoring is provided to the supervisor
  • Monitor for QA trends regarding new hires to improve training material
  • Participate in monthly QA calibrations
  • Communicate with new hires weekly up until orientation start date – to ensure nurse has internet set up and getting applications submitted
  • Train users on equipment, software and/or technology
  • Maintain a document of important things to remember when documenting/working with medical records
  • Follow up with newly hired nurses after 90 days to review the training and answer any questions
  • Develop Lessonly content and track nurses' progress
  • Identify and find solutions for performance issues both technically and in user behavior
  • Work with existing nurses that are struggling and need remedial training and communicate progress with the supervisor/manager
  • Provide summary updates to each supervisor following individual nurse assistance
  • Attend monthly staff meeting to stay apprised of updates/issues/team conversations
  • Occasionally answer calls when asked by supervisor due to additional help being needed to clear out the customer service queue
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong knowledge and experience in quality assurance and training programs
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to skillfully manage multiple, complex projects and competing priorities, while meeting deadlines and maintaining strong customer service
  • Effective quantitative and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment while functioning as an educator rather than an auditor
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 

  • BSN, unencumbered RN license required
  • 2+ years of training experience

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market-based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range, and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $35.26 - $54.45 per hour

Job.JobDescription:
The Telephonic Case Manager coordinates resources and develops cost-effective, personalized care plans for ill or injured individuals. The goal is to support quality treatment and, when appropriate, a timely return to work. This role uses clinical expertise to assess the appropriateness of current treatment plans based on the patient’s medical and physical condition. The Case Manager communicates directly with treating physicians to evaluate and recommend alternative care options when needed. They also explain medical conditions and treatment plans to patients, family members, and adjusters, while supporting the objectives of the Case Management department and of CorVel.

This is a remote role.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide medical case management to individuals through coordination with the patient, the physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Provide assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluate patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Utilize medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan/alternate treatment plans with the physician
  • Make medical recommendations of available treatment plans to the payer
  • Implement care such as negotiating and coordinating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • Devise cost-effective strategies for medical care
  • Required to prepare organized reports within a specified timeframe
  • Minimum Productivity Standard is 95% per month
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Ability to make independent medical decisions and recommendations to all parties
  • Effective multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to interface with claims staff, attorneys, physicians and their representatives, and advisors/clients and coworkers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

    • Bachelor’s degree required, BSN preferred
    • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
    • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
    • 3 or more years of recent clinical experience, preferably in rehabilitation
    • URAC recognized Case Management certification (ACM, CCM, CDMS, CMAC, CMC, CRC, CRRN, COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC) required to be obtained within 3 years of hire if no nationally recognized certification is present at time of hire
    • Strong clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation preferred
    • Strong cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care helpful

Job.JobDescription:
The Telephonic Case Manager coordinates resources and develops cost-effective, personalized care plans for ill or injured individuals. The goal is to support quality treatment and, when appropriate, a timely return to work. This role uses clinical expertise to assess the appropriateness of current treatment plans based on the patient’s medical and physical condition. The Case Manager communicates directly with treating physicians to evaluate and recommend alternative care options when needed. They also explain medical conditions and treatment plans to patients, family members, and adjusters, while supporting the objectives of the Case Management department and of CorVel.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide medical case management to individuals through coordination with the patient, the physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Provide assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluate patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Utilize medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan/alternate treatment plans with the physician
  • Make medical recommendations of available treatment plans to the payer
  • Implement care such as negotiating and coordinating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • Devise cost-effective strategies for medical care
  • Required to prepare organized reports within a specified timeframe
  • Minimum Productivity Standard is 95% per month
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Ability to make independent medical decisions and recommendations to all parties
  • Effective multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to interface with claims staff, attorneys, physicians and their representatives, and advisors/clients and coworkers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, BSN preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • 3 or more years of recent clinical experience, preferably in rehabilitation
  • URAC recognized Case Management certification (ACM, CCM, CDMS, CMAC, CMC, CRC, CRRN, COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC) required to be obtained within 3 years of hire if no nationally recognized certification is present at time of hire
  • Strong clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation preferred
  • Strong cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care helpful
  • Certification as a CIRS or CCM preferred

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $30.64 - $45.80 per hour

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

Job.JobDescription:
The CareIQ Scheduling Coordinator provides administrative customer service assistance to claimants, providers, and claims management by scheduling ancillary healthcare appointments.   • Schedules medical appointments for claimants and owns the results of assigned cases, to ensure product service level expectations are met

  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to maintain a professional and courteous demeanor that sets tone for complex telephonic conversations
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in California.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager, you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers

This is a remote role.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in the Greater Portland, OR area.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 
  • Possess an unrestricted Oregon RN license

In addition, Medical Case Managers are eligible for bonus and will be provided state-of-the-art technological devices to ensure ready access to CorVel’s proprietary Case Management application, enabling staff to retrieve documents on the go and log activities as they occur.
