The WC Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

This is a remote position and must reside in California.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers’ Compensation claim, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgement of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim by investigating and gathering information regarding the claim and files necessary documentation with state agencies
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Develops and manages well documented action plans with the case manager and outcomes manager to reduce overall cost of the claim
  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties
  • Manages subrogation and litigation of claim as it applies
  • Manages potential claim recoveries of all types
  • Reports claims to the excess carrier when applicable
  • Communicates claim status with the customer and claimant
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Develops and maintains professional customer relationships
  • Complies with rules and regulations of applicable state
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

The WC Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties

  • Manages potential claim recoveries of all types
  • Reports claims to the excess carrier when applicable
  • Communicates claim status with the customer and claimant

  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)

  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Orlando, FL and surrounding area.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager, you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Little Rock, AR.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Spanish Speaking

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $63,739 – $95,264

The Financial Analyst has a strong background in financial analysis, strategic planning, and data-driven decision-making. This role is responsible for providing advanced financial insights, conducting complex financial modeling, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive informed business strategies. The Financial Analyst's contributions will directly impact the organization's financial performance and strategic direction.

This role focuses on both customer and service profit analysis, pricing relating to RFPs and internal and external customer reporting requests.

 This is an onsite position located in Irvine, CA

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive financial analysis to assess performance, identify trends, and provide insights to support key business decisions
  • Perform variance analysis and recommend corrective actions to ensure financial goals are met. Including ERP and FP&A
  • Lead the development and consolidation of budgets and forecasts for the organization
  • Collaborate with various departments to gather inputs, analyze data, and provide accurate financial projections 
  • Create and maintain intricate financial models that simulate different scenarios to aid strategic planning, risk assessment, and investment decisions
  • Translate complex data into actionable recommendations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their financial needs, provide financial guidance, and assist in developing strategies that align with overall corporate objectives
  • Prepare and present regular and ad hoc financial reports to senior management, highlighting key performance indicators, financial trends, and actionable insights
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency of financial data by conducting rigorous data validation and reconciliation processes. Identify and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance financial processes, reporting methodologies, and tools to streamline operations and improve the quality and timeliness of financial information
  • Assess financial risks and opportunities, providing recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities
  • Assist in developing strategies to optimize capital allocation
  • Stay updated on financial regulations, accounting standards, and reporting requirements
  • Ensure all financial activities are conducted in accordance with relevant laws and regulations

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Rogers, AR.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field Nurse Case Manager position in Phoenix AZ.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Field Nurse Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Bilingual Preferred

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Folsom, CA.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

The Claims Training Specialist is responsible for developing curricula to ensure adherence to CorVel’s best practice guidelines, special customer handling requirements, improve quality of audit metrics and overall claims outcomes. This includes ensuring that a designated geographical claims area of CorVel is equipped with an Operations workforce that can optimize its current and future goals and objectives, and deliver quality services that can meet our clients’ requirements and service expectations.  In order to efficiently execute daily responsibilities, the Claims Training Specialist must first obtain a deep understanding of the business to articulate what our claims model does and to clearly demonstrate all aspects of the Operations roles in order to be able to successfully conduct and oversee the department training.

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in <>.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits. 
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, et cetera for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy. Initial home visit for initial evaluation.

  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel.

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Experience as a RN, Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred.
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, and advisors/clients and coworkers.
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful.
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Bilingual

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing.
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation.
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications are preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required.

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Boise, ID.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides Medical Case Management to individuals through in person and telephonic communications with the patient, physician, other health care providers, employer and others.
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans.
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation of patient’s progress. 
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits. 
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, et cetera for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy. Initial home visit for initial evaluation.
  • Implements care such as negotiation the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services. 
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Experience as a RN, Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred.
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, and advisors/clients and coworkers.
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful.
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing.
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation.
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications are preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required. 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $62,306 – $93,123

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

About CorVel – Medical Case Managers

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries.   CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients.  We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities.  Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!). 

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off. In addition, Medical Case Managers are eligible for bonus and will be provided state-of-the-art technological devices to ensure ready access to CorVel’s proprietary Case Management application, enabling staff to retrieve documents on the go and log activities as they occur.

CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

Claims Coverage Attorney

Hybrid Work Schedule

Buffalo, NY

Merchants Insurance Group is a leading Property and Casualty Insurer in the Northeast and is looking for an experienced Claims Coverage Attorney for our Corporate Claim Legal Team located in Buffalo, NY.

We are seeking individuals with at least 5 years of previous experience in insurance coverage analysis/determination/disposition.  

This position will be responsible for preparing coverage opinions and coverage position letters for claims involving complex coverage issues or disputes.  This role will also assist claims professionals in the evaluation of risk transfer opportunities, priority of coverage, and tender strategies.  The Claims Coverage Attorney is responsible for assessing and directing coverage litigation strategy in conjunction with outside counsel and the claims professional, including developing and executing a plan to manage the coverage litigation through final resolution. This individual may also provide legal support to underwriting, product development and regulatory compliance programs.

This position is responsible for both first- and third-party coverage review, analysis and decisions for all levels of claims, including those involved in litigation. In addition, the individual will provide claim, policy, regulatory and legal expertise, if or as appropriate, to all levels of management up to and including senior management.   The role will also review all policy forms for updates and revisions, ensuring compliance with state regulations, as well as applicable statutes and case law.  The position will also require training for all levels of claims staff in matters of policy interpretation, investigatory processes, regulatory compliance and good faith claims practices across multiple venues.

Hybrid Work Schedule

Buffalo, NY 

At Merchants Insurance Group, we're looking for a strategic and results-oriented professional to help shape the future of our insurance product portfolio. As a Product Manager for commercial package and middle market, you will lead the performance, strategy, and growth of assigned product lines, driving initiatives that enhance profitability, improve loss outcomes, and strengthen our competitive position in the marketplace.

In this highly visible role, you'll collaborate across Underwriting, Actuarial, Claims, Distribution, and other key business areas to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful business results. Success requires a strong blend of analytical thinking, business acumen, and influence—leveraging data, expertise, and relationships to align stakeholders and execute winning strategies.

The ideal candidate brings product management experience within the insurance industry, a passion for data-driven decision-making, and the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Candidates with underwriting and/or actuarial experience will be especially well-positioned to thrive in this role.

If you're looking for an opportunity to make a measurable impact, collaborate with talented professionals, and help drive the continued success of Merchants Insurance Group, we encourage you to apply.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Product Strategy, Portfolio Management & Performance

  • Drive production goals for assigned product lines by monitoring performance, partnering with regional teams to identify opportunities and challenges, and implementing targeted actions to improve results.

Product Development & Innovation

  • Partner with technology and operational teams to improve product capabilities, streamline processes, and enhance customer and agent experience.
  • Analyzes performance across key dimensions and leverages insights to recommend and implement actions that improve results.
  • Identifies and develops new product opportunities, coverage enhancements, and endorsements to strengthen profitability and expand market presence.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Production Management 

  • Lead cross-functional product initiatives, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely execution across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Influence decision-making and drive outcomes without direct authority in a matrixed environment.
  • Partner with regional leadership and distribution teams to achieve production goals and optimize growth.

SUMMARY 

Responsible for conducting analysis, pricing and risk assessment to estimate financial outcomes.  Applies knowledge of mathematics, probability, statistics, and principles of finance and business to calculations in life, health, social and casualty insurance, annuities, and pensions.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

•    Provides business leadership, analytical expertise, and process oversight for significant strategic initiatives;

•    Prepares and analyzes various reports to identify trends and deviations;

•    Conducts analysis by qualitatively and/or quantitatively analyzing data and information, including exploratory data analysis, graphing, forecasting and modeling;

•    Analyzes and documents complex data and business problems and provides recommendations based on research of performance analysis and business products for optimal business solutions;

•    Develops reports, presentations and proposals for action and/or implementation plans and presents to management to assist in decision making;

•    Infrequent travel required 10% - 20% of the time;

•    Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor's Degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related quantitative field

Fifteen (15) or more years related work experience

Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS)

Fellowship in the Society of Actuaries (FSA)

SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Proven ability to apply actuarial techniques and standards to complex business problems

Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills

Excellent analytical, problem solving and time management skills

Possess high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Ability to work independently and within a team and to foster teamwork

Advanced knowledge of insurance or financial principles and concepts

Proficient in Microsoft Office products; expert level in Excel

Job.JobDescription:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for the design, development and implementation of Comprehensive Technical Risk Assessment Services and loss control training programs in order to service existing clients and to assist in securing new clients.  Functions as part of an overall Account Management Team and provides support on both a regional and/or national basis for practice programs, Subguard Programs and Wrap-Up Programs as necessary. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

Generates risk engineering and loss control solutions to a wide range of customers;

Identifies and analyzes critical issues and implements or recommends solutions, operating on a holistic, multi-disciplinary Risk Management Platform philosophy;

Designs and drafts complex loss control and site specific safety plans for large complex construction projects;

Designs, develops and implements Comprehensive Technical Risk Assessment Services and loss control training programs;

Assists in the marketing, coordination and delivery of risk control services to clients and prospects;  

Conducts field visits with Carrier Reps on behalf of existing and prospective clients;

Consults and advises others regarding all Federal & State Safety Compliance regulations including OSHA, NFPA, JCAHO, enforcement, data & statistics and training;

Utilizes interdisciplinary knowledge of coverage, claims and safety to articulate, consult and recommend solutions and plans to top level management in order to influence positive results;

Coordinates cross functional relationships with Account Executives & Producers (Regional and National), Claims Managers (Regional & National), Wrap Up Teams, and External – Insurance Carrier Loss Control representatives and industry or other trade association representatives;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Eight (8) or more years related work experience

Extensive Industry knowledge – particularly of Construction trade, management or other related industry work

OSHA 500 Authorized Trainer

Certified Safety Professional (CSP)

SKILLS

Superior written, verbal, interpersonal and presentation capabilities

Ability to coordinate efforts involving individuals from different geographic areas as well as external partners

Excellent leadership, problem solving, planning, and organizational skills-and can translate technical /tactical plans into strategic plans for customer use

Must be able to work effectively as part of a team, highly collaborative and to steer team dynamics for risk engineering facets

Strong qualitative and quantitative skills

Proficient in MS Outlook, MS Office, Excel and other critical safety related software is essential

SUMMARY

Performs a variety of analysis including provider network analysis and carrier utilization analysis. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Initiates recurring analyst renewal projects on assigned accounts (pre-renewal spreads, carrier renewal process initiation, information requests, etc.); Gathers, reviews and validates all information related to assigned clients for renewal analysis and marketing purposes, gaining comprehensive familiarity with client’s current details and history;

Reviews all marketing and plan option responses, evaluates for accuracy and completeness, and requests clarifications and revisions as needed;


Handles ongoing (monthly/quarterly) client maintenance projects as determined by account team;


Reviews team members work for accuracy and completeness as needed;

Other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Degree in Business or Mathematics preferred. 


One (1) or more years related work experience


Valid insurance license (or must be obtained within ninety (90) days of employment)


Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal


Basic knowledge of compliance topics (HIPAA, COBRA, ACA, Medicare).


Basic knowledge of programs (know of existence and how to get a quote).  


Salesforce experience preferred


Knowledge of all major fully-insured and self-funded lines of benefits insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability, EAP);

Excellent problem solving and time management skills

Excellent planning, organizational and prioritization skills

Job.JobDescription:
SUMMARY

Partners with operational leaders and staff to provide high level consultative advice to optimize employee relations. Fields inquiries from employees, serving as an employee advocate; and objectively investigates employee relations matters. Maintains strong knowledge of employment law, legislative changes, and legal trends as they impact Human Resources and the organization. Monitors and shares HR metrics related to organizational development, performance management, exit surveys, etc. to make recommendations for improvement. Supports recruitment efforts as needed.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serves as an HR specific business partner to senior and executive level leaders.

Provides the lead on employee relations support for operations group needs such as organizational development, performance management, change management, succession planning, coaching/counseling, and separations.

Meets regularly with operations leaders to review support needs.

Investigates reported incidents, makes recommendations and conclusions.

Drafts responses to external third parties when necessary and collaborates with legal counsel.

Manages decisions regarding background checks and oversees timely review for pre-hire purposes.

Provides HR support during acquisition integration. responsible for leading offer letter efforts during the pre-acquisition phase and supports the transition of seller management to established HR best practices post-close.

Tracks and manages employee relations data for presentation; monitors trend analysis for operations group.

Provides oversight of ethics system reports for operations groups including investigations, recommendations, and closure of individual reports.

Reviews offer of employment for accuracy and to ensure pay equity across the company.

Provides consultation and support to other human resource team members administering leaves of absences.

Engages in the interactive process on potential disability accommodations, as appropriate.

Manages secondary stage of workers’ compensation which includes return to work program, report analysis, claims research, and partnering with internal workers compensation representatives, leave of absence administrators, employees, claims adjusters, and outside counsel on escalated matters.

Audits and reviews HR files. Completes a review of employment contracts and partners with management and internal/external counsel as necessary prior to advising on any employment action.

Provides high level benefits administration support as it relates to separations, retirements, and leave of

absences.

Responds to inquiries for outsourced unemployment administrator and attends hearings.

Partners with leaders on involuntary separations including risk assessments, appropriate approvals, and

employment action execution.

Assesses HR related training needs of the business, collaborates with internal HR team and Professional

Development to develop and deliver as needed.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Eight (8) or more years related HR work experience

Six (6) or more years HR Generalist or Business Partner experience

Experience with HR systems


SKILLS

Strong knowledge of employment law, legislative changes, and legal trends as they impact Human Resources and the organization

Advanced knowledge of interactive process, ADA, FMLA and state specific laws regarding leaves of absences and workplace accommodations;

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Ability to easily communicate with members of senior management

Strong presentation skills

Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork

Good problem solving and time management skills

Good planning, organizational and prioritization skills

Ability to successfully mediate and resolve conflict

Proficient in Microsoft Office products

Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and use discretion with sensitive information.

Ability to work remotely in a self-directed manner.

Ability to handle high volume and adapt to change

SUMMARY

Provide support for the management, development, analysis, design, evaluation, implementation and administration of the company's compensation programs and initiatives. Responsible for the documentation and evaluation of jobs, capturing critical information needed for FLSA classification, completion of compensation surveys, and associated analysis.  Ensure requests for job title, pay and classification changes comply with applicable regulations and current compensation policy.  Partner closely with business leaders and cross-functional HR partners to facilitate compensation solutions. 


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide a high-level of support for the annual merit and incentive process, and officer slate; including project planning, communication, and execution.

Work on a variety of complex projects involving analysis, job mapping, project planning, and testing.

Work with managers to develop and update job descriptions, ensuring job content is appropriately captured.

Perform evaluation of job responsibilities to determine appropriate FLSA classification.

Perform regular research and audit of incentive plan eligibility for new hires and job changes, report findings and recommend corrections.

Perform compensation analyses, market pricing, and audit of internal pay and job data to ensure compliance with state and federal laws.

Maintain job description tracking, ensure each job has an updated job description and job descriptions are documented in the company’s standardized format.

Review job and pay change requests, identify potential discrepancies, seek clarification, process approved changes, and prepare corresponding promotion or employment change letters.

Review and audit compensation reports such as ‘Employment Conditions Audit’ and ‘Upcoming Agreement  Dates’ report, ensuring future compensation commitments are documented and processed in a timely manner.

Perform regular research and audit of incentive plan eligibility for new hires and job changes, report findings and recommend corrections.

Provide analytical and administrative support for various compensation projects, including responsibilities related to documenting, monitoring, tracking, auditing and coordinating payments from the annual incentive bonus, merit, promotion.

Develop, maintain and audit job titles, job codes, and other job related attributes in the HRIS.

Provide overall project support with the compensation administration application; audit internal data, perform testing of configuration and data interface files to ensure data integrity and accuracy.

Provide training and cross-training in support of Compensation Function procedures and team support model.

Maintain job family and career path information by Operations group.

Stay abreast of and may report on compensation compliance updates, such as state minimum wage increases, and FLSA exemption regulations.

Compile data for compensation survey submissions.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience  


Two (2) or more years’ experience with administration of compensation programs

Four (4) or more years overall experience in Human Resources, Finance, or related area within a mid to large size organization

Experience working with leaders and recruiters to prepare and maintain job descriptions

Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or completion of some CCP course work



SKILLS

Knowledge of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

Knowledge of federal, state and local laws relating to Compensation and HR practices

Knowledge of salary planning tools and methods, job evaluation techniques, and market salary trends

Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.; with emphasis on Excel

Skill in writing and editing job descriptions

Strong time-management, problem-solving, and organizational skills

Skill in analyzing and organizing technical data

Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail

Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with frequent interruptions, distractions, and a fluctuating workload

Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision

Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion

Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form

Ability to understand and express opposing points of view while maintaining positive working relationships

Ability to maintain effective interpersonal relationships with employees at all levels of the organization

SUMMARY

Responsible for leading the design and delivery of transformational platform implementations. This role will partner directly with IT leadership, ServiceNow developer teams, and business stakeholders to translate organizational imperatives into scalable, value-driven ServiceNow solutions. This is a leadership-focused role that bridges technical excellence with strategic business outcomes and platform health/performance. You will also engage with implementation partners, participate in internal governance boards, and work across IT and business functions to drive platform adoption and sustainable value realization.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead end-to-end ServiceNow architecture, solution design, and implementation strategy; own the platform roadmap from discovery through go-live and optimization.

Direct delivery teams (developers, functional analysts, administrators, testers) on complex, multi-module implementations (ITSM, CSM, HRSD, GRC, FSO, etc.); ensure adherence to ServiceNow best practices and platform governance.

Engage C-suite (CIO, CTO, CFO, business unit leaders), IT leadership (Senior Directors, Directors, Release Train Engineers), and cross-functional business stakeholders to define strategic platform vision, business outcomes, and change management; serve as the trusted technical advisor on ServiceNow strategy and organizational impact.

Define scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions for ServiceNow modules, integrations, and custom applications.

Design platform architecture, data models, integration patterns, and data governance frameworks aligned with client regulatory and operational requirements in partnership with other IT teams.

Collaborate with IT project managers and business analysts to translate business requirements into ServiceNow solution designs and detailed user stories.

Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture, business needs, and platform best practices.

Review technical design documents, data models, and integration patterns for quality and compliance.

Lead scope management, risk mitigation, and escalation resolution on complex implementations; drive accountability for schedule, technical quality, and business outcomes.

Partner with IT project managers, implementation partners, developers, and systems integrators; coordinate delivery across internal and external teams to ensure alignment, knowledge transfer, and sustainable handoffs.

Assess existing ServiceNow instances (e.g., CMDB/CSDM health, configuration debt, data model governance, upgrade readiness); recommend remediation and optimization strategies.

Participate in and/or lead governance boards, steering committees, and strategy forums; serve as the primary escalation point for technical strategy, business alignment, and change management decisions.

Develop proof-of-concept demonstrations, technical specifications, and detailed business cases quantifying platform value and organizational outcomes

Coach and mentor junior architects, functional leads, and delivery teams on ServiceNow best practices, design patterns, and implementation methodology


QUALIFICATIONS

SUMMARY

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for serving as the primary operational liaison between company, independent insurance producers, employer groups, and carrier partners. Provides consultative support throughout the customer lifecycle including new business development, implementation, enrollment, ongoing service, renewals, and carrier administration. Acts as an extension of the General Agency and carrier service teams by delivering operational support, resolving service issues, coordinating implementations, educating producers, employers and employees, and supporting the growth and retention of General Agency business.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Builds and maintains trusted relationships with assigned brokers, agencies, carrier partners, and employer groups to promote retention, growth, and exceptional service.

Serves as the primary day-to-day General Agency contact for assigned producers and carrier partners.

Supports producer-led new business efforts including quoting, plan recommendations, proposal preparation, RFP responses, and quote-to-card coordination.

Reviews and scrubs new business submissions for completeness and accuracy prior to carrier submission.

Coordinates new group implementations, installation activities, enrollment timelines, and carrier onboarding requirements.

Conducts or participates in employer implementation meetings, employee education meetings, benefit presentations, and open enrollment meetings in partnership with producers and carrier representatives.

Facilitates renewal activities including proposal preparation, alternative plan options, plan design changes, and renewal strategy discussions.

Provides first-line operational support by researching and resolving eligibility, billing, claims, pharmacy, ID card, provider directory, plan change, member add/termination, reinstatement, ancillary product, and other service-related issues using carrier service platforms whenever possible.

Assists producers and employer groups with carrier portals, eServices, Employee Navigator, connectivity, and other enrollment or technology platforms.

Coordinates resolution of complex service issues and appropriately escalates matters that cannot be resolved through established carrier resources.

Maintains working knowledge of carrier products, underwriting guidelines, administrative procedures, technology platforms, and regulatory requirements affecting General Agency operations.

Supports producer education by delivering training on carrier products, processes, enrollment tools, and General Agency resources.

Collaborates with carrier sales and service teams to implement new products, initiatives, and strategic growth opportunities.

Maintains accurate documentation and utilizes agency management systems and other technology platforms to support operational excellence.

Exercises sound judgment in balancing producer advocacy with carrier requirements while ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years related work experience  

Valid Insurance License

Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal


SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Ability to conduct producer, employer and employee meetings

Excellent customer service skills

Good analytical, problem solving and time management skills

Ability to be organized and to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, agency management systems, carrier portals and enrollment technology

Job.JobDescription:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for evaluating and underwriting submissions for all pricing requests, including advanced underwriting and analysis projects.  Leads and/or assists in the management and execution of all assigned client projects. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Competent in all major areas of general underwriting including, but not limited to, pricing forecasts for medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, life and AD&D, disability and EAP pricing for both rate development as well as option pricing;

Competent in special pricing and marketing projects such as:  medical network changes, claim re-pricing, disruption analysis, migration analysis, insured to self-funded modeling, contribution structure change modeling, as well as others;

Meets with Producers, clients, Underwriters, Account Executives and Benefits Analysts as needed to define and accomplish projects;

Expert in understanding actuarial plan values and how they are used in various pricing and analysis projects.  This includes ability to competently use software available for such types of plan analysis and pricing;

Full understanding of underwriting models and reporting templates, with ability to fully modify and customize to meet customer needs;

Works with internal staff and vendors to establish project timelines, identifies critical deadlines for completion and performs necessary functions to ensure project completion;

Assists or leads all assigned client underwriting projects, including the ability to present analysis to clients directly in a confident and easy-to-understand manner;

Maintains data tracking and reporting for financial management, underwriting models, client reports and other analytical reporting deliverables;

Assists with the development of new reporting tools and models;

Competent in multiple carrier data and reporting systems as needed to obtain claim data for reporting and analysis purposes;

Confidently analyzes and challenges insurance company renewal calculations for fully-insured contracts (Health, Dental and Vision);

Maintains files and historical data on all assigned clients and/or programs;

Actively engages in educational opportunities to further underwriting knowledge, market trends and regulatory environment;

Responsible for accuracy and timeliness of all work performed, including proper management of timelines and meeting deadlines as established;

Addresses incoming correspondence and responds as required in a timely manner;

Assists with development and training of other Underwriters;

Assists with the development of training materials and presentations;

Peer review of other Underwriters’ work for accuracy and completeness;

Serves as mentor to Underwriter I and II;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned


QUALIFICATIONS 

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience


Three (3) or more years related work experience


Valid Insurance License within 90 Days


Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal


  

SKILLS


Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Excellent problem solving and time management skills


Good customer service skills, including telephone and listening skills


Excellent planning, organizational and prioritization skills


Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork


Ability to completely manage small and mid-level projects as well as effectively manage and lead small teams to complete goals


Ability to work productively as an individual to accomplish assigned projects


Ability to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines


Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, advanced MS Excel skills required

SUMMARY 

Responsible for handling high exposure professional liability and litigated claims, as well as commercial injury and non-injury general liability and automobile claims, in accordance with client, carrier and company guidelines, statutory regulations and best practices. Primary duties include investigating, evaluating, reporting to authorities as applicable, and maintaining adequate reserves. Manages claims through well-developed action plans to an appropriate and timely resolution.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

Maintains diary system to ensure claim files are up to date, and that required follow-up is taking place;

Investigates and evaluates claims to determine liability and compensability;

Communicates with vendors, producers, policy holders, clients and insurance companies to communicate claim status;

Negotiates settlements with claimants and insureds;

Reports to authorities as applicable, providing updates on litigated claims, serious injuries, and claims over the adjuster’s authorization limits;

Sets and manages reserve accounts, and ensures that adequate levels are maintained;

Analyzes and reviews invoices for payment;

Provides producer inquiry assistance;

Provides set-up of rental vehicles for clients as needed;

Creates and maintains reports and worksheets as needed;

Provides training and mentoring to less experienced adjusters;

Travels as necessary to attend appeal hearings, trials, and perform on-site investigations;

May act as backup for Supervisor on an as needed basis;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS 

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

High School Diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

Responsible for attending continuing education as

Seven (7) or more years experience in liability claims processing

SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including telephone and listening skills

Excellent customer service skills

Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

Strong analytical skills and problem solving skills

Strong organizational and time management skills

Discretion and independent judgment required

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite - Excel, Word, Outlook

*****NO RECRUITERS PLEASE*****

Assistant Controller (CPA Required) | Hybrid

Experienced Senior Accountants and Accounting Managers with an active CPA license are encouraged to apply. We are seeking professionals with expertise in budget preparation, leadership of month-end close processes, team management, and driving process improvement initiatives.

POSITION SUMMARY

Windward Risk Managers is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Controller (CPA Required) to support the Controller in leading the organization's accounting and financial reporting functions. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for overseeing month-end close. financial reporting, budgeting, cost allocation, financial analysis, and accounting operations while providing guidance and mentorship to the accounting team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in financial reporting, budgeting, and process improvement, along with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Hybrid Schedule: This position offers a hybrid schedule of four days in the office and one day remote following the initial training period. During training (up to six months), the position is fully onsite five days per week.
 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

General Ledger and Financial Reporting

  • Lead month-end closing and preparation of monthly internal financial statements and reporting packages.
  • Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and reports.
  • Work closely with the Commissions team to develop, analyze, and reconcile reports and statements.
  • Support Accounts Payable and Claims Billing functions as needed.
  • Train and mentor junior staff.
  • Assist with annual audit preparations.
  • Assist with system reviews and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Budgeting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead the annual operating budget process in coordination with department heads.
  • Maintain department-level budgets and support models.
  • Prepare monthly budget-to-actual variance analyses.
  • Partner with department leaders to review variances and support corrective actions.
  • Ensure budgets align with organizational objectives and cost structures.

Cost Allocation & Expense Management

  • Develop, document, and maintain cost allocation methodologies across departments, entities, and cost centers.
  • Ensure cost allocations are applied consistently, accurately, and in accordance with internal policies.
  • Collaborate with Accounting to reconcile allocated costs to the general ledger and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assesses allocation methodologies periodically to ensure continued appropriateness and transparency.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune’s Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with solid expertise in personal and/or commercial residential property insurance to support and enhance our Policy and/or Claims Administration systems. This role will partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze workflows, define requirements, support system enhancements, and resolve production issues that impact critical insurance operations.

This position may be filled at the BA I, BA II, or BA III level, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to work independently, lead initiatives, and influence outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, regulated environment with evolving priorities.

Essential Functions:

Business & Systems Analysis

  • Partner directly with Underwriting, Product, Operations, Compliance, Claims, and Technology teams to gather and document business requirements
  • Translate underwriting and/or claims guidelines, eligibility rules, rates, forms, endorsements, and workflows into functional system requirements
  • Support enhancements and configuration of online quote/bind applications and policy/claims administration systems
  • Create user stories, business process flows, requirement documentation, acceptance criteria, and traceability artifacts
  • Analyze impacts of product or regulatory changes to system functionality and business processes
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned to support business objectives.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in or lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and backlog refinement meetings.
  • Manage changing priorities and scope while ensuring requirements remain clear, documented, and approved.
  • Participate in testing validation, defect triage, and production implementation activities
  • Provide clear, timely communication and status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Create and maintain documentation while ensuring Confluence is consistently updated and serves as the single source of truth for requirements including workflows, business rules, system behaviors, and configuration details.
  • Develop and execute test plans, track defects and coordinate fixes.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and compliance expectations.

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot system issues, identify root cause, and coordinate resolution with IT and development teams.
  • Support production incidents and escalated help desk tickets related to our systems.
  • Communicate issue status, risks, and resolution progress effectively to business partners.
  • Review escalated Service Desk tickets to identify opportunities for process improvement, knowledge base development, and training, facilitating the transition of repeatable support activities and issue resolution from higher support tiers to Level 1 Service Desk teams.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Professional experience in the Property & Casualty Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial insurance industry functioning in a Business Analyst capacity, including requirements elicitation, documentation, and collaboration with technical teams to implement changes to insurance or policy administration systems.
  • Proven experience analyzing business problems, troubleshooting issues, and applying logical, detail-oriented approaches to develop effective solutions with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritizing work, managing scope, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical resources, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst role within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience supporting Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial lines of business for Florida, Texas, and/or California risks, including familiarity with state-specific products, forms, rating, underwriting, or regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Duck Creek.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as Florida and/or Texas.
  • Insurance carrier or MGA background strongly preferred.
  • Business Analyst certification (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA) a plus.

Essential Skills:

  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate effectively with developers and system vendors.
  • Strong attention to detail especially when working with policy, forms, rating, claims, or billing system changes.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate business needs and translate them into clear, well-defined requirements.

Position Summary: 

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment: 

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.
