Join AI Products and Transformation (APT) | Data Science Solutions and help our team shape how AI transforms underwriting at scale.
 
We’re looking for a Data Science Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and scaling of AI-powered intelligence products changing how underwriters make decisions. This role sits at the intersection of underwriting, product management, data science, and technology, with the opportunity to take successful solutions and expand them across North America underwriting segments, profit centers, and lines of business.
 
You’ll lead high-visibility decision intelligence products leveraging machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI to help underwriters make faster, more informed decisions. You’ll work directly with business leaders, data scientists, engineers, architects, and technology partners to identify high-value opportunities, shape product strategy and roadmaps, and turn emerging intelligence capabilities into scalable solutions with measurable business impact.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building and scaling innovative AI products, solving complex business problems, and influencing how a large underwriting organization works in the future.

Role Summary

The Data Science Product Manager will lead the strategy, development, deployment, and scaling of complex intelligence products that leverage machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI technologies to improve underwriting decision-making and business outcomes. This role is responsible for driving the expansion and adoption of successful intelligence products across underwriting segments, profit centers, and lines of business, maximizing reuse, consistency, and enterprise impact.

Additionally, this role partners across business, data science, and technology teams to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable value.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and drive strategy for advanced analytics products, multi-year roadmaps, and investment priorities for a portfolio of enterprise intelligence products.
  • Identify high-value opportunities where AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and decision intelligence capabilities can create measurable business impact.
  • Establish product vision, success metrics, and adoption strategies aligned to organizational and enterprise objectives.
  • Drive product portfolio decisions through business case development, financial valuation, and outcome-based prioritization.

AI & Data Science Product Leadership

  • Partner with Data Scientists, Engineers, Architects, and Technology teams to deliver scalable AI and machine learning solutions throughout the full product lifecycle.
  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced AI capabilities, including predictive modeling, NLP, LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, recommendation engines, and decision intelligence solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering partners on production deployment strategies, MLOps processes, observability, model monitoring, reliability, and governance.
  • Influence technical direction on AI platform capabilities, reusable services, model orchestration, and enterprise-scale intelligence architecture.

Stakeholder & Customer Leadership

  • Serve as the voice of the customer and trusted advisor to business leaders, translating complex business challenges into scalable product solutions.
  • Build alignment across senior stakeholders while effectively managing competing priorities, trade-offs, dependencies, and resource constraints.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, AI capabilities, and product outcomes to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.
  • Drive organizational readiness, training, adoption, and change management activities to maximize business value realization.

Portfolio Management & Delivery

  • Own product valuation frameworks, prioritization methodologies, and outcome measurement processes.
  • Define, measure, and communicate KPIs related to business outcomes, adoption, operational efficiency, profitability, and product performance.
  • Lead product planning activities, including roadmap development, PI planning, dependency management, and release coordination.
  • Guide identification and prioritization of technical debt, platform modernization, and product scalability initiatives.

Governance, Risk & Responsible AI

  • Ensure intelligence products are designed and operated in accordance with Responsible AI principles, governance standards, model risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with governance and technology teams to implement robust monitoring, auditability, explainability, and feedback mechanisms across AI-powered solutions.
  • Establish frameworks for evaluating, measuring, and continuously improving model and GenAI performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field with 5+ years of experience in insurance, actuarial, data science, analytics, technology, or advanced analytics product management.
  • Prior advanced analytics product management experience supporting data science, machine learning, AI, or intelligence solutions preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data science, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI concepts and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of data science product development, deployment, MLOps, monitoring, and governance practices.
  • Understanding of technology platforms, architectures, APIs, and tools used to support AI/ML solutions.
  • Experience translating business needs into product strategy and prioritizing work based on customer and business value.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across functions.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with analytical and advanced analytics product management tools including PowerPoint, SQL, Python, modern data and AI technologies.
  • Understanding of insurance underwriting practices, risk assessment, pricing, and decision-support workflows preferred.
  • Experience building, deploying, or scaling GenAI, agentic, or advanced analytics solutions preferred.
  • ACAS or equivalent insurance industry credentials helpful.

Preferred Experience

  • Strong foundation in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies.
  • Strong advanced analytics product management experience supporting complex intelligence products.
  • Proven experience scaling successful solutions across multiple business segments, underwriting organizations, or product lines.
  • Experience with MLOps, AI governance, model monitoring, and enterprise deployment practices.
  • Experience building GenAI solutions, RAG applications, and agentic systems.
  • Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies and responsible AI principles.
  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration and leadership within a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience driving adoption and value realization for AI-enabled products at scale.
Qualifications
  • Responsible for the management, technical oversight and development for a team of data science and advanced analytics staff.
  • Collaborates with business partners to develop tools and services such as modeling, dashboard development, and decision aids to drive strategic decision making.
  • Presents findings, shares insights, and makes recommendations that impact profitability, growth and/or customer satisfaction.
  • Provides tactical input on highly technically complex projects that drive change across function, SBU or Corporate Department.
  • Supervises and performs highly complex well-defined work, containing technical and creative predictive analytics projects.
  • Regularly engages with the data science community and leads cross functional working groups.

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. This role is primarily remote in the state of Colorado except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As a Senior Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where you’ll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a highly experienced Senior Attorney to lead the management of complex litigation matters involving substantial legal and financial exposure. This role requires mastery of advanced legal principles, regulatory expertise, strategic litigation management, budget oversight, and client relationship leadership. The Senior Attorney will leverage cutting-edge technology, mentor junior attorneys, and collaborate extensively with Claims Representatives, insured clients, and external partners to deliver favorable outcomes while minimizing risk and cost. This position plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement and upholding the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities: 

  • Legal Strategy Development: Craft, implement, and continuously refine sophisticated legal strategies for complex litigation matters by applying advanced legal principles and comprehensive knowledge of the regulatory environment.
  • Litigation Execution & Management: Independently oversee all phases of complex litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, and settlement negotiations, ensuring meticulous preparation and execution of legal documents and motions. Manage and co-chair trials with exposure typically exceeding $50,000, leading negotiation efforts to achieve optimal resolutions that safeguard client interests.
  • Technology Utilization: Champion the use of state-of-the-art e-discovery tools and case management technologies to enhance legal workflows, operational efficiency, and remote collaboration across teams.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Serve as a trusted legal advisor providing clear, authoritative opinions and strategic counsel to Claims Representatives and insured clients.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate potential legal risks associated with complex cases.
  • Budget and Resource Management: Oversee litigation expenses, trial budgets, and case timelines to balance high-quality legal representation with fiscal responsibility.
  • Training, Mentorship, and Leadership: Design and lead comprehensive training programs for Legal, Claims, and other departments to enhance team competencies and legal knowledge. Provide mentorship, guidance, and support to junior and mid-level attorneys, paralegals, and law clerks, fostering professional development and a collaborative work environment.
  • Continuous Legal Knowledge Enhancement: Stay current on evolving legal developments, industry trends, and relevant medical, scientific, or engineering issues affecting cases.
  • Organizational Improvement & Collaboration: Actively contribute to initiatives that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold and promote the highest standards of legal ethics and professional conduct in all activities. Manage complex ethical issues and guide junior attorneys in compliance with the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Colorado and in good standing; additional licensure for specialized courts or boards may be required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of successful trial attorney experience, with a focus on insurance law and complex civil litigation and as necessary, workers’ compensation and/or No Fault law. Construction Defect and Personal Injury experience preferred.
  • Proven expertise managing high-stakes, complex litigation with substantial exposure (trials exceeding $50,000).
  • In-depth knowledge of insurance law, regulatory frameworks, and client business operations.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency with advanced e-discovery platforms, case management software, and remote collaboration tools.
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentorship experience within a legal team.
  • Superior communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex cases concurrently.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and regulatory compliance.

This role requires mastery of advanced legal principles, regulatory expertise, strategic litigation management, budget oversight, and client relationship leadership. The Senior Attorney will leverage cutting-edge technology, mentor junior attorneys, and collaborate extensively with Claims Representatives, insured clients, and external partners to deliver favorable outcomes while minimizing risk and cost. This position plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement and upholding the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities: 

  • Legal Strategy Development: Craft, implement, and continuously refine sophisticated legal strategies for complex litigation matters by applying advanced legal principles and comprehensive knowledge of the regulatory environment.
  • Litigation Execution & Management: Independently oversee all phases of complex litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, and settlement negotiations, ensuring meticulous preparation and execution of legal documents and motions. Manage and co-chair trials with exposure typically exceeding $50,000, leading negotiation efforts to achieve optimal resolutions that safeguard client interests.
  • Technology Utilization: Champion the use of state-of-the-art e-discovery tools and case management technologies to enhance legal workflows, operational efficiency, and remote collaboration across teams.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Serve as a trusted legal advisor providing clear, authoritative opinions and strategic counsel to Claims Representatives and insured clients.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate potential legal risks associated with complex cases.
  • Budget and Resource Management: Oversee litigation expenses, trial budgets, and case timelines to balance high-quality legal representation with fiscal responsibility.
  • Training, Mentorship, and Leadership: Design and lead comprehensive training programs for Legal, Claims, and other departments to enhance team competencies and legal knowledge. Provide mentorship, guidance, and support to junior and mid-level attorneys, paralegals, and law clerks, fostering professional development and a collaborative work environment.
  • Continuous Legal Knowledge Enhancement: Stay current on evolving legal developments, industry trends, and relevant medical, scientific, or engineering issues affecting cases.
  • Organizational Improvement & Collaboration: Actively contribute to initiatives that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold and promote the highest standards of legal ethics and professional conduct in all activities. Manage complex ethical issues and guide junior attorneys in compliance with the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Colorado and in good standing; additional licensure for specialized courts or boards may be required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of successful trial attorney experience, with a focus on insurance law and complex civil litigation and as necessary, workers’ compensation and/or No Fault law. Construction Defect and Personal Injury experience preferred.
  • Proven expertise managing high-stakes, complex litigation with substantial exposure (trials exceeding $50,000).
  • In-depth knowledge of insurance law, regulatory frameworks, and client business operations.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency with advanced e-discovery platforms, case management software, and remote collaboration tools.
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentorship experience within a legal team.
  • Superior communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex cases concurrently.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and regulatory compliance.

At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where you’ll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in California and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers’ compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where you’ll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowner’s property.  This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive – you’ll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Clinton, MD (20735) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

 

Sign-On Bonus Available!  We’re offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

 

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work: Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support: To set you up for success, you’ll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement: This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where you’ll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowner’s property.  This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive – you’ll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within St. Michael, MN (55376) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

 

Sign-On Bonus Available!  We’re offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

 

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work: Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support: To set you up for success, you’ll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement: This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.
About Us

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As a Supervising Trial Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where you’ll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance is seeking a highly qualified Supervising Trial Attorney with strong litigation expertise, operational management skills, and a deep understanding of insurance defense litigation. The Supervising Trial Attorney will play a critical role in overseeing team performance, developing litigation strategies, and fostering a culture of integrity and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

  • Operational Management and Oversight: Assist the Resident Attorney in managing team operations, contributing positively to overall office metrics, and supporting office-level initiatives.
  • Litigation: Manage litigation activities within the team as well as your own high exposure commercial cases, ensuring quality legal representation that aligns with departmental and organizational goals. 
  • Caseload Management: Oversee distribution of caseloads and file assignments based on case complexity and attorney experience.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct internal quarterly file audits for the team and assist the Resident Attorney with office-wide audits to uphold high-quality legal standards and minimize risk.
  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain trusted relationships with claims leadership and business units to assess and enhance litigation strategies and claims processing efficiencies.
  • Process Improvement: Assist in process improvement initiatives that drive operational efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and innovation within the legal team.
  • Compliance Culture: Foster a culture of integrity by ensuring legal practices adhere to industry regulations, ethical standards, and corporate policies, including mentoring attorneys on adherence to MRPC.
  • Talent Acquisition and Development: Support or lead interviewing and hiring processes for the team. Mentor, coach, and develop attorneys through talent management practices focused on growth, engagement, and collaboration to meet performance benchmarks.  
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) or Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a practicing trial attorney with demonstrated management experience.
  • Strong litigation skills in high exposure insurance defense, including auto, premises liability, and general liability and as necessary, workers’ compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proven leadership abilities with experience managing and developing legal teams.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to persuasively present complex legal and business issues.
  • In-depth knowledge of legal ethics, compliance standards, and risk management.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships with claims and business partners.
  • Competent in leveraging technology and process improvements to enhance legal operations.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage workflows and caseloads effectively.
  • Commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and integrity.

Join the Aerial Analytics and Operations team within Personal Lines Property & Specialty Product and help shape the performance and success of our Aerial ecosystem. In this role, you’ll turn data into actionable insights, strengthen monitoring and operational capabilities, and support vendor performance, flight planning, and compliance. You’ll also collaborate closely with the Aerial Solutions team to inform roadmap priorities and investment decisions—helping ensure Aerial continues to deliver value for our business and customers.

This role will focus on monitoring, diagnosing, and improving the operational health of the Aerial ecosystem, with a particular focus on supporting the state filings and objections workstream. The chosen candidate will be responsible for integrating data analysis, operational judgment, and regulatory awareness to identify issues, assess impact, and drive resolution. The individual in this role will rely on strong analytical skills, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to translate data into clear operational readouts, and will be energized by building deep expertise in how Aerial performs across states, vendors, and regulatory contexts.

** This position may be filled at the Senior Analyst, or Consultant level, depending on the candidate’s experience and qualifications, at the hiring manager’s discretion. This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location. **

Responsibilities and attributes of the ideal candidate:

● Aerial health and monitoring: Builds and maintains Aerial monitoring dashboards and performance readouts; tracks state-level performance; conducts issue detection, root cause analysis, and impact assessment; flags anomalies and emerging trends; maintains the source of truth for Aerial operational health.

● State filings and objections: Supports the process for state filings and objections related to Aerial, partnering with compliance to respond to regulatory requests; maintains awareness of Aerial regulations and state-level implications; helps ensure Aerial practices and vendor behavior stay aligned with filed and approved use.

● Operational support: Partners with compliance to provide Aerial-specific solutions and support in response to regulatory requests; maintains posture on Aerial regulations and influences partner vendors accordingly; maintains and prioritizes the Aerial research backlog.

● Data querying and analysis: Writes and optimizes SQL queries to pull, join, and analyze large datasets; works directly in Snowflake to explore, model, and maintain data supporting Aerial performance and operational reporting.

● Data pipeline and dashboard monitoring: Monitors the performance and reliability of data pipelines supporting Aerial reporting; maintains dashboards that surface pipeline health; identifies and troubleshoots data discrepancies and gaps, escalating to data engineering as needed.

● Analytical rigor: Translates ad hoc business questions into structured analyses; derives hypotheses from data and frames conclusions using sound, evidence-based reasoning; comfortable moving between exploratory analysis and recurring reporting.

● Technical fluency: Strong working knowledge of SQL and Snowflake required; familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and basic scripting (e.g., Python) a plus.

● Dedication to quality: Produces high-quality, thoroughly vetted analysis suitable for a highly visible capability area; maintains a strong personal standard of accuracy, rigor, and polish.

● Excitement on building depth of expertise: Pursues deep, multi-layer understanding of the Aerial ecosystem — technical, operational, and regulatory — to surface unseen implications, anticipate stakeholder questions, and provide thought leadership.

● Project management skills: Manages complex, often ambiguous operational and compliance-adjacent initiatives; coordinates with cross-functional stakeholders, including compliance, vendors, and the Aerial Solutions team, to drive issues to resolution.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, or other quantitative field Minimum 4 year's relevant work experience, typically 6 years.
  • Master's degree beneficial. Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (e.g., SAS, Emblem).
  • Must have strong planning, organizational, analytical, decision making and communication skills.
  • Experience managing projects preferred.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. ● Analytical rigor: Translates ad hoc business questions into structured analyses; derives hypotheses from data and frames conclusions using sound, evidence-based reasoning; comfortable moving between exploratory analysis and recurring reporting.

● Technical fluency: Strong working knowledge of SQL and Snowflake required; familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and basic scripting (e.g., Python) a plus.

● Dedication to quality: Produces high-quality, thoroughly vetted analysis suitable for a highly visible capability area; maintains a strong personal standard of accuracy, rigor, and polish.

● Excitement on building depth of expertise: Pursues deep, multi-layer understanding of the Aerial ecosystem — technical, operational, and regulatory — to surface unseen implications, anticipate stakeholder questions, and provide thought leadership.

● Project management skills: Manages complex, often ambiguous operational and compliance-adjacent initiatives; coordinates with cross-functional stakeholders, including compliance, vendors, and the Aerial Solutions team, to drive issues to resolution.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, or other quantitative field Minimum 4 year's relevant work experience, typically 6 years.
  • Master's degree beneficial. Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (e.g., SAS, Emblem).
  • Must have strong planning, organizational, analytical, decision making and communication skills.
  • Experience managing projects preferred.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where you’ll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowner’s property.  This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive – you’ll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Quincy, MA (02171) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

 

Sign-On Bonus Available!  We’re offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

 

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work: Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support: To set you up for success, you’ll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement: This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Premium Auditor, Accounting / Finance, Internal Auditor
Job.JobDescription:
Our professional auditors are integral to our company's mission by ensuring the financial integrity of premium development. In this role, you will examine policyholders' operations and financial records to ensure exposures (such as payroll, sales, fixed assets) are accurately calculated within strict insurance guidelines and communicate audit findings through detailed formal reports. As a Premium Auditor, you will work out of your home, when not traveling to policyholders' locations.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform examination of policyholders' accounting and financial records to ensure accurate calculation of earned premium for smaller, less complex risks.
  • Ensure that audited exposures (payroll, sales, fixed assets, etc.) are accurately calculated within strict insurance guidelines.
  • Communicate audit findings through detailed formal reports supported by audit workpapers.
Qualifications
  • Review appropriate audit documentation and/or company policy systems, to determine auditable exposures and coverages provided by the policy and plan audit strategy.
  • Investigate policyholder operations to obtain actual exposures, verify classifications as they apply to the policy and ensure conformity to various state laws and insurance regulations for the appropriate audit period.
  • Prepare detailed work papers and written correspondence in support of audit findings.
  • Identify issues to be communicated and socialize the audit information to appropriate stakeholders (i.e., Central Processing, Distribution, Underwriting, Agent/Broker, etc.) to elaborate on current risk conditions or initiate necessary changes to the policy contract. Exhibit effective workload management skills through efficient time utilization. This includes scheduling audit appointments taking into account priority and location of assignments within assigned territory managing work-in-process and documenting progress for appropriate stakeholders/management.
  • Perform routine administrative tasks such as: Time Tracking, Expense Reports, Mileage Reports, etc.
  • As assigned, coordinate assignment of multi-location audits for large risks review location audits to ensure quality and accuracy. Consolidate in proper format for rating purposes. As requested, assist with complex audits, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) related accounts, and/or special projects, including mentoring, presentations, etc.

In this role, you will examine policyholders' operations and financial records to ensure exposures (such as payroll, sales, fixed assets) are accurately calculated within strict insurance guidelines and communicate audit findings through detailed formal reports. As a Premium Auditor, you will work out of your home, when not traveling to policyholders' locations.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform examination of policyholders' accounting and financial records to ensure accurate calculation of earned premium for smaller, less complex risks.
  • Ensure that audited exposures (payroll, sales, fixed assets, etc.) are accurately calculated within strict insurance guidelines.
  • Communicate audit findings through detailed formal reports supported by audit workpapers.
Qualifications
  • Review appropriate audit documentation and/or company policy systems, to determine auditable exposures and coverages provided by the policy and plan audit strategy.
  • Investigate policyholder operations to obtain actual exposures, verify classifications as they apply to the policy and ensure conformity to various state laws and insurance regulations for the appropriate audit period.
  • Prepare detailed work papers and written correspondence in support of audit findings.
  • Identify issues to be communicated and socialize the audit information to appropriate stakeholders (i.e., Central Processing, Distribution, Underwriting, Agent/Broker, etc.) to elaborate on current risk conditions or initiate necessary changes to the policy contract. Exhibit effective workload management skills through efficient time utilization. This includes scheduling audit appointments taking into account priority and location of assignments within assigned territory managing work-in-process and documenting progress for appropriate stakeholders/management.
  • Perform routine administrative tasks such as: Time Tracking, Expense Reports, Mileage Reports, etc.
  • As assigned, coordinate assignment of multi-location audits for large risks review location audits to ensure quality and accuracy. Consolidate in proper format for rating purposes. As requested, assist with complex audits, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) related accounts, and/or special projects, including mentoring, presentations, etc.
About Us

Job.JobTitle: Principal Full Stack Software Engineer, Investments Technology (Public Markets)
Job.JobDescription:
Liberty Mutual Investments manages Liberty Mutual Insurance Group’s global financial assets across public and private domains, to create capital and generate income. With over $100 billion in AUM and staffed with 300+ investment, finance and operations professionals located in Boston, MA., Liberty Mutual Investments offers the best of both worlds; the look and feel of a boutique investment firm, and the reputation and financial strength of a Fortune 100 company.

Note: This role has a preferred hybrid work arrangement (3 days per week in our Boston office).

The Principal Full Stack Software Engineer for the Public Markets Agile Squad will:

- Provide hands-on technical leadership designing and building real-time, high‑throughput trading and market data platforms for Global Liquid Markets.

- Partner closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and Solution Engineers to co‑create solution designs that balance speed, resilience, security, and enterprise quality.

- Serve as the technical authority on the squad, guiding architecture decisions, setting engineering standards, and ensuring alignment with Public Markets and enterprise technology strategy.

- Design clean, evolvable architectures for low‑latency, event‑driven, and API‑first systems supporting institutional trading workflows.

- Embed modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and responsible use of AI across the SDLC to improve developer productivity and system quality.

- Lead design reviews, produce clear architectural artifacts, and articulate technical trade‑offs to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

- Collaborate across squads and enterprise architecture to deliver integrated solutions while avoiding local optimization.

- Mentor and develop engineers through code reviews, pairing, and coaching, setting a high bar for engineering excellence.

Qualifications

Experience

- 8+ years of software engineering experience in an agile environment

- Prior experience building real‑time trading, execution, order management, or market data systems for institutional investors strongly preferred.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems, low‑latency architectures, and resilient, fault‑tolerant design.

- Proven experience working in fast‑paced, regulated financial services environments.

Skills

- Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend development; experience with cloud‑native architectures on AWS (e.g., Lambda, Fargate, Step Functions).

- Experience designing and consuming REST and event‑driven APIs; familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake and ingestion pipelines.

- Practical experience applying AI‑assisted tools in the SDLC (e.g., code generation, test creation, observability, or productivity tooling).

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and influence skills.

Knowledge

- Deep knowledge of software architecture patterns, security and privacy controls, and enterprise engineering practices.

- Strong grasp of agile delivery, backlog management, and incremental value delivery.

Education

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Highly Desirable: CFA or Progress towards CFA

Job.JobTitle: Complex Claims Specialist, Long Term Care Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Complex Claims Specialist to join our Long-Term Care Claims Team. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role for an experienced Professional Liability claims handler with deep Long-Term Care (LTC) facility expertise. With minimal supervision, the Complex Claims Specialist will manage a book of specialty LTC Professional Liability Claims through the entire lifecycle, applying advanced coverage interpretation, clinical issue spotting, complex litigation management and prudent reserving to resolve high-exposure matters economically and defensibly.

Why this role matters

  • Lead ownership of complex facility professional liability claims (nursing homes, assisted living, hospice, home health, ancillary providers).
  • Opportunity to shape claim strategy on high-severity matters, coordinate clinical/expert resources, and act as an internal subject-matter resource for underwriting, reinsurance and senior leadership.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with autonomy to influence outcomes and policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage LTC Professional Liability Claims from first notice through resolution: investigate, analyze coverage, evaluate liability and damages, establish and adjust reserves, negotiate settlements and close files within authority.
  • Perform advanced coverage analysis (duty to defend vs. indemnify, occurrence vs. claims-made, allocation, additional insured issues, contractual liability, tail exposures, endorsements) and prepare clear coverage opinions and reservation of rights/declination communications.
  • Document claims thoroughly using Claims Management System and proactively diary follow-up actions and deadlines.
  • Set indemnity and expense reserves within authority; escalate and recommend reserves for matters outside authority; review reserves regularly and justify reserve positions to management and auditors.
  • Manage litigation: retain and oversee outside defense counsel with LTC expertise, control budgets and billing, direct discovery strategy, and evaluate mediation/arbitration/trial risk to optimize resolution.
  • Coordinate clinical resources and expert consultants (nursing, pharmacy, infection control, medical specialists) for chart review, causation analysis and expert testimony.
  • Interface with regulatory, compliance and risk management teams on CMS/state surveys, licensing investigations and mandatory reporting; incorporate regulatory developments into case strategy.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, reinsurance and subrogation on allocation, ceded reporting and recovery opportunities.
  • Identify and report claim trends, coverage exposures and policy issues to management and underwriting; contribute to playbooks, training and process improvements.
  • Participate in mediations and arbitrations within settlement authority and support major loss response efforts.
  • Maintain required adjuster licenses and adhere to company litigation and billing guidelines.

*This position may have in-office requirements and other travel needs depending on candidate location. You will be required to go into an office twice a month if you reside within 50-miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; or Westborough, MA.  We will consider a remote candidate if you do not live within 50-miles of one of these offices. This policy is subject to change.

We are open to fill this position depending on related professional skills and experience. The salary range reflects the varying pay scale that encompasses each of the Liberty Mutual regions, the salary for both levels, and the overall cost of labor for that region.  Please note your salary range may not fall at the top of the posted range, depending on your location.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree.  J.D. is a plus!
  • 7 + years claims/legal experience, with at least 2 years within a technical specialty preferred.
  • Healthcare Claims experience strongly desired (Long-Term Care Professional Liability, Miscellaneous Medical Facilities and/or Group Practice claims).
  • Advanced knowledge of claims handling concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues, and product line knowledge.
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated advanced verbal and written communications skills.
  • Demonstrated advanced analytical, decision making and negotiation skills.
  • Obtain and maintain Adjuster's license.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

Job.JobTitle: Complex Claims Specialist, Long Term Care Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Complex Claims Specialist to join our Long-Term Care Claims Team. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role for an experienced Professional Liability claims handler with deep Long-Term Care (LTC) facility expertise. With minimal supervision, the Complex Claims Specialist will manage a book of specialty LTC Professional Liability Claims through the entire lifecycle, applying advanced coverage interpretation, clinical issue spotting, complex litigation management and prudent reserving to resolve high-exposure matters economically and defensibly.

Why this role matters

  • Lead ownership of complex facility professional liability claims (nursing homes, assisted living, hospice, home health, ancillary providers).
  • Opportunity to shape claim strategy on high-severity matters, coordinate clinical/expert resources, and act as an internal subject-matter resource for underwriting, reinsurance and senior leadership.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with autonomy to influence outcomes and policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage LTC Professional Liability Claims from first notice through resolution: investigate, analyze coverage, evaluate liability and damages, establish and adjust reserves, negotiate settlements and close files within authority.
  • Perform advanced coverage analysis (duty to defend vs. indemnify, occurrence vs. claims-made, allocation, additional insured issues, contractual liability, tail exposures, endorsements) and prepare clear coverage opinions and reservation of rights/declination communications.
  • Document claims thoroughly using Claims Management System and proactively diary follow-up actions and deadlines.
  • Set indemnity and expense reserves within authority; escalate and recommend reserves for matters outside authority; review reserves regularly and justify reserve positions to management and auditors.
  • Manage litigation: retain and oversee outside defense counsel with LTC expertise, control budgets and billing, direct discovery strategy, and evaluate mediation/arbitration/trial risk to optimize resolution.
  • Coordinate clinical resources and expert consultants (nursing, pharmacy, infection control, medical specialists) for chart review, causation analysis and expert testimony.
  • Interface with regulatory, compliance and risk management teams on CMS/state surveys, licensing investigations and mandatory reporting; incorporate regulatory developments into case strategy.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, reinsurance and subrogation on allocation, ceded reporting and recovery opportunities.
  • Identify and report claim trends, coverage exposures and policy issues to management and underwriting; contribute to playbooks, training and process improvements.
  • Participate in mediations and arbitrations within settlement authority and support major loss response efforts.
  • Maintain required adjuster licenses and adhere to company litigation and billing guidelines.

*This position may have in-office requirements and other travel needs depending on candidate location. You will be required to go into an office twice a month if you reside within 50-miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; or Westborough, MA.  We will consider a remote candidate if you do not live within 50-miles of one of these offices. This policy is subject to change.

We are open to fill this position depending on related professional skills and experience. The salary range reflects the varying pay scale that encompasses each of the Liberty Mutual regions, the salary for both levels, and the overall cost of labor for that region.  Please note your salary range may not fall at the top of the posted range, depending on your location.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree.  J.D. is a plus!
  • 7 + years claims/legal experience, with at least 2 years within a technical specialty preferred.
  • Healthcare Claims experience strongly desired (Long-Term Care Professional Liability, Miscellaneous Medical Facilities and/or Group Practice claims).
  • Advanced knowledge of claims handling concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues, and product line knowledge.
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated advanced verbal and written communications skills.
  • Demonstrated advanced analytical, decision making and negotiation skills.
  • Obtain and maintain Adjuster's license.

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts (including high individual line sizes and unusual exposures in parts of North America), manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your line of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As an Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where you’ll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a skilled and proactive Attorney to independently manage moderately complex civil litigation matters. This role requires a deep understanding of legal principles and insurance law, strategic case management, advanced technology utilization, and strong client relationship skills. The Attorney will develop and execute sophisticated legal strategies, lead settlement negotiations, mentor junior attorneys, and contribute to organizational improvements while maintaining the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Management and Execution: Independently manage all phases of litigation involving claims of moderate to heavy value. Conduct comprehensive legal research, draft precise pleadings, motions, and other legal documents. Lead settlement negotiations and participate in hearings, trials, and mediations to achieve optimal case outcomes.
  • Litigation Support: Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Legal Strategy Development: Develop, implement, and continuously refine advanced legal strategies for discovery, investigation, and trial preparation.
  • Technology Utilization: Employ advanced e-discovery tools, case management systems, and data analysis software to streamline workflows and reduce costs.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear, well-reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to clients and Claims Representatives. Build and sustain trusted relationships by understanding client operations and legal challenges.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with cases in collaboration with clients and senior attorneys.
  • Training, Mentoring, and Leadership: Design and conduct training sessions and workshops for Legal, Claims, and related departments. Mentor junior attorneys and legal support staff, offering guidance and direction to elevate team performance.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies. Adhere strictly to ethical guidelines, licensing requirements, and the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
  • Organizational Improvement and Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities for process automation and workflow enhancements.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Colorado and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful trial attorney experience, preferably within insurance law and related litigation.
  • Proven experience managing moderately complex litigation with demonstrated success in achieving favorable outcomes.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers’ compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficient in advanced e-discovery tools, legal case management software, and remote collaboration technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead junior attorneys and legal staff.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and compliance with all regulatory and professional standards.

Job.JobTitle: Associate Attorney - Special Investigation Unit and Liability
Job.JobDescription:
This role is primarily remote in the state of New York except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team in a role that combines special investigations legal support with liability litigation.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney whose practice will focus on special investigations matters and on liability litigation. Under moderate supervision, you will provide legal support for the investigation and evaluation of potentially fraudulent or materially misrepresented insurance claims, working collaboratively with Special Investigations Unit (SIU) professionals, claims representatives, and senior counsel. You will also represent Liberty Mutual and its policyholders, as appropriate, in moderately complex civil litigation involving claims for monetary damages arising from personal injury or property damage.

You will apply your legal knowledge, investigative judgment, research skills, and client relationship capabilities to develop facts, assess legal risks, and support fair, well-reasoned claim decisions and effective litigation outcomes in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

Special Investigations

Investigative Legal Support: Partner with SIU professionals and claims representatives to develop legally sound investigation strategies for claims involving suspected fraud, material misrepresentation, or other potentially improper activity. Identify relevant legal issues, evidentiary needs, and appropriate next steps while maintaining an objective, fact-based approach.

Examinations and Evidence Development: Prepare for and conduct examinations under oath, where authorized and appropriate, and assist with witness interviews, document requests, and other fact-development activities. Evaluate testimony, claim documentation, and other evidence to identify inconsistencies and determine whether additional investigation is warranted.

Legal Research and Claim Evaluation: Research and analyze applicable law concerning insurance fraud, misrepresentation, policy conditions, and investigative procedures. Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions to support claim evaluation, coordinating with coverage counsel or other designated counsel when appropriate.

Investigation-Related Litigation: Handle or support litigation arising from special investigations within the scope of the assigned practice, including discovery, depositions, motions, hearings, and trial preparation. Collaborate with senior counsel on matters involving moderately complex investigative and evidentiary issues.

SIU Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain effective working relationships with SIU, Claims, and legal partners. Share legal developments and practical guidance that strengthen investigative practices, evidence preservation, and documentation quality.

Liability Litigation

Litigation Execution: Manage assigned personal injury and property damage liability cases from inception through resolution, including pleadings, discovery, depositions, hearings, mediations, and trials. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in case preparation, management, and trial execution.

Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution: Assess liability, damages, and litigation exposure. Develop defense strategies and collaborate with claims representatives, insured clients, and senior counsel to facilitate effective case resolutions.

Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide strategic legal advice and clear, consistent, and timely updates to insured clients and claims professionals. Maintain strong client relationships through transparent communication and alignment with case objectives.

Responsibilities Across Both Practice Areas

Technology Utilization: Use e-discovery, legal research, and case management technologies to improve efficiency and support effective collaboration with remote team members.

Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Prepare accurate, thorough, and timely legal documents, investigative assessments, and case reports in accordance with applicable legal standards and client expectations.

Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance.

Ethical Compliance and Professional Judgment: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics, confidentiality, and professional responsibility. Recognize and appropriately address conflicts of interest, preserve applicable privileges, and ensure investigative and litigation activities comply with governing law and licensing requirements.

Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in NY and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

The Executive Underwriter in Major Accounts Risk Management is responsible for developing, growing, and maintaining a profitable, diversified book of loss sensitive primary casualty business focused on Workers Compensation, General Liability and Commercial Auto through marketing, underwriting decision making, building mutually beneficial agent/brokers relationships and establishing a marker-facing leadership presence, and application of underwriting tools, systems, and expert resources. Guides/mentors less experienced underwriters in their respective area of expertise, including regular employee coaching with feedback to the manager on progress of the employee.

Our opening is considered a range posting for a Senior or Executive Underwriter depending upon experience.

  • Risk Selection: Reviews, rates, underwrites, evaluates, or assesses the business applying for insurance by qualifying accounts, identifying, selecting and assessing risks, determining the program structure, premium, collateral, policy terms and conditions, obtaining approvals, creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker, and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Demonstrates a high level of responsiveness and focus on supporting Agents and Brokers objectives. Establishes, develops, and maintains successful relationships with Agents and Brokers to facilitate marketing of products, through responsive service, site visits, in person renewal meetings or enhanced knowledge of their customers businesses. Develops strong personal brand to build and maintain a long-term quality pipeline with Agents/Brokers.
  • Portfolio Management: Manages a sizable and complex book of business by analyzing the portfolio, identifying areas of opportunity for improved growth, profit and diversification, and executing marketing plans to increase market share by making marketing calls to brokers to market and cross market.
  • Documenting the Deal: Documents files in a way that reflects a solid thought process and decision making through comprehensive account reviews, sign-offs and referrals that comply with state regulations, letter of authority, and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Formally guides, mentors, and coaches underwriters and account analysts in both technical and professional skills. Demonstrates an area of expertise and provides regular updates to other underwriters.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participates in continuous improvement by generating suggestions, participating in problem solving activities and using continuous improvement tools to support the work of the team. Participates in high-profile projects across departments designed to drive underwriting and process excellence (e.g., being on a working team).

  • Must demonstrate comprehension of most complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
