Job.JobTitle: Principal Front Office Engineer - Investment Innovation, Integration & Trading
Job.JobDescription:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Principal Front-Office Engineer to join Liberty Mutual Investments Technology. As a Principal Front-Office Engineer, you will serve as the technical lead embedded within the Investment Innovation, Integration & Trading (I3T) team, driving design and implementation of small-scale proofs of concept and prototypes that support the fixed income portfolio, improve investment analysis, develop AI-enabled workflows, and enhance reporting systems & processes. You will partner closely with analysts and investment teams to enhance their day-to-day use of AI, helping them build artifacts in a more technically sound manner and building robust systems and tools that scale those prototypes into production-ready applications. We’re looking for a hands-on software architect and builder who can design systems, rapidly iterate on them, and deliver quality solutions that power analytics, reporting, and investment decision-making.

This role is ideal for a Lead or Senior Engineer who thrives as an individual contributor and wants to drive technical direction without moving into management.

·       

Note: This Boston-based role has a hybrid work arrangement (3 days per week in office). 

Qualifications

Qualifications: 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically, independently, and act with minimal handholding.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex ideas and analysis to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Full-stack development knowledge with a minimum of 8 years professional experience programming in Python demonstrating the ability to write efficient androbust code able to process and analyze large financial datasets.
  • Experience with key Python Libraries (pandas, NumPy) required
  • Hands-on experience developing within Bloomberg’s BQuant environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience writing and maintaining BQL queries, leveraging PyBQL and working with the Bloomberg data ecosystem is strongly preferred
  • Experience in front-end development and user experience (UX) design required; experience with Pythonic front-end and data visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Dash) preferred.
  • Experience using Version Control (Git) required.
  • Experience using Agentic Programming tools (Github Copilot, Claude) required.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with business teams to convert AI-generated artifacts (e.g., prototypes, proofs of concept) into production-ready applications.
  • Experience bridging the gap between rapid AI-developed prototypes to quality full-stack applications is highly valued.
  • Proven ability to design, build, and scale application systems in data-rich environments including custom AI tools.
  • Experience developing applications for investment management firms or, more broadly, financial services is a strong plus.
  • Strong SQL skills required. Familiarity with financial data platforms (sucas Bloomberg, FactSet, Aladdin, eFront, Moodys), financial databases, and data manipulation techniques strongly preferred.
  • Experience with statistical and time-series data analysis using pythonic libraries (such as Scikit-Learn, SciPy, cvxpy) is preferred.
  • Solid understanding of financial markets, with foundational knowledge across fixed income, private equity, and private credit investment domains.
  • Practical experience in developing and maintaining models, tools, and reports thatshowcase a deep understanding of quantitative techniques, methods, statistics and econometrics

Education 

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience

At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where you’ll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Texas and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum 5 years experience in insurance law, and as necessary, workers’ compensation.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

Job.JobTitle: Product Owner II, Insurance Investment Accounting, Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Product Manager, Technology / Insurtech, Insurance Accountant
Job.JobDescription:
The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Liberty’s strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally, taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY. 

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Liberty’s strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds — the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best. 

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technology—with the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI 

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking a Product Owner II to support its Accounting Product, with responsibility for investment accounting and regulatory and financial reporting capabilities across multiple reporting frameworks, including statutory (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, NAIC), GAAP, and TAX. The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining accounting and reporting capabilities within LMI's investment accounting platform, SimCorp Dimension, and its related data and reporting processes, with an emphasis on the end-to-end processes and upstream data that produce reported figures, including quarterly and annual statutory investment schedules. This position reports to the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner within Financial Products and Global Investment Solutions (GIS).

Operating at the intersection of Investment Accounting, Finance, Technology, Data, Investment Product, and the platform vendor, the Product Owner will translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable product priorities and drive the delivery of technology solutions that enable accurate, timely, and reliable financial and regulatory reporting. The role will own the Accounting Product backlog and proactively partner with Agile delivery teams, other Product Owners, and SimCorp Dimension's Regulatory Center of Excellence (REGCOE) to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and regulatory commitments.

This role requires strong business acumen, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a proactive approach: anticipating regulatory and accounting changes, setting and communicating timelines, and aligning dependencies early. The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Responsibilities:

Product Strategy, Prioritization & Delivery

  • Partner with the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner and stakeholders to shape and execute the Accounting Product roadmap across reporting frameworks (statutory/NAIC, GAAP, and TAX), ensuring alignment with broader product strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the Accounting Product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory deadlines, strategic enhancements, technical improvements, and production support, and serve as the point of coordination for all accounting- and reporting-related changes across product backlogs.
  • Translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.
  • Set clear deadlines and handoff dates for each deliverable and maintain visibility of partner teams' commitments and deadlines so that dependencies, sequencing, and critical-path risks are managed in advance.
  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate business value, feasibility, and regulatory risk to make informed prioritization decisions and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Regulatory & Accounting Change Management

  • Proactively monitor regulatory, statutory accounting, and reporting framework changes (e.g., NAIC updates), as well as SimCorp REGCOE releases and roadmap items, and assess their impact on systems, data flows, and downstream processes ahead of effective dates.
  • Translate upcoming changes into backlog items with defined timelines, owners, and testing and validation plans, and communicate impacts, priorities, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership early.
  • Assess the impact of new investment types and reporting requirements across statutory, GAAP, and TAX bases, including basis differences (such as the statutory-to-GAAP "stat gap") and their effect on reporting content and downstream processes.
  • Apply working knowledge of investment accounting, investment operations, and the upstream data that feeds reporting (trade capture and settlement, security master and reference data, pricing and valuation sources, custodian and counterparty data, and corporate actions) to evaluate how upstream changes affect reporting accuracy and timing.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Internal (LMI): Partner with Investment Reporting, Operations, Investment Product, Data Product, Technology and other Financial Product teams to deliver accurate, complete, and timely financial and regulatory reporting.
  • Liberty Mutual Group (LMG): Coordinate with LMG Corporate Accounting, Finance, TAX, and other group functions that depend on LMI's accounting and reporting outputs, aligning on requirements, calendars, and priorities.
  • Vendors: Work with SimCorp, implementation partners, and other platform and data vendors to manage releases, defects, enhancements, and delivery commitments.
  • Regulators and external parties: Support engagement with regulators, auditors, and advisors as needed, and ensure reporting changes and regulatory requirements are understood and addressed ahead of deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Accounting Product stakeholders, building strong relationships, facilitating decisions, and communicating priorities, progress, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify and resolve reporting issues, data quality concerns, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks as appropriate to protect critical reporting timelines.

Data Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Data Product and Investment Product, alongside Accounting, Finance, and Technology stakeholders, to define data requirements, ownership, and quality standards for the data that feeds accounting and reporting.
  • Strengthen data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance through effective data validation, reconciliation, and operational controls, identifying and addressing data quality gaps at the source.
  • Drive process improvements and leverage automation, including AI-enabled capabilities, to reduce manual effort, improve reporting efficiency, and mitigate operational risk.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with platform stability, ongoing production support, and evolving regulatory and data governance requirements.
  • Define and monitor product-level KPIs to measure reporting timeliness, data quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in business, technology, financial services, or consulting, including 3+ years working with Agile teams in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Working knowledge of investment accounting and financial and regulatory reporting frameworks, including statutory accounting principles (SAP) and NAIC investment reporting, GAAP, and TAX, including basis differences between them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories, and delivering technology or data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate business processes, data dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to proactively plan and independently drive complex initiatives from requirements through implementation, set and meet deadlines, manage dependencies, and deliver business value in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstrates strong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation while maintaining sound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance or asset management, with familiarity with investment instruments and accounting processes.
  • Experience with SimCorp Dimension or comparable investment accounting platforms such as Blackrock Aladdin, Eagle STAR, State Street Alpha, Charles River, Princeton Financial System, Clearwater, FIS, SS&C Advent Geneva
  • Data management and regulatory reporting capabilities, and multi-basis (statutory, GAAP, and TAX) accounting.
  • Experience working with data and investment product teams on data quality, reference data, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), reporting automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Product Manager, Technology / Insurtech, Insurance Accountant
Job.JobDescription:
The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Liberty’s strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally, taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY. 

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Liberty’s strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds — the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best. 

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technology—with the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI 

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking a Product Owner II to support its Accounting Product, with responsibility for investment accounting and regulatory and financial reporting capabilities across multiple reporting frameworks, including statutory (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, NAIC), GAAP, and TAX. The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining accounting and reporting capabilities within LMI's investment accounting platform, SimCorp Dimension, and its related data and reporting processes, with an emphasis on the end-to-end processes and upstream data that produce reported figures, including quarterly and annual statutory investment schedules. This position reports to the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner within Financial Products and Global Investment Solutions (GIS).

Operating at the intersection of Investment Accounting, Finance, Technology, Data, Investment Product, and the platform vendor, the Product Owner will translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable product priorities and drive the delivery of technology solutions that enable accurate, timely, and reliable financial and regulatory reporting. The role will own the Accounting Product backlog and proactively partner with Agile delivery teams, other Product Owners, and SimCorp Dimension's Regulatory Center of Excellence (REGCOE) to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and regulatory commitments.

This role requires strong business acumen, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a proactive approach: anticipating regulatory and accounting changes, setting and communicating timelines, and aligning dependencies early. The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.

  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.

US Retail Market (USRM) Architecture is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead Accelerator, a team of software engineers who build reusable assets (patterns, libraries and tutorials) that put USRM architecture standards into practice. These assets give all USRM engineering squads a faster, more consistent starting point for development. The team also builds the fitness functions and framework that measure how well teams adhere to standards.

You will be directly accountable for team effectiveness, delivery quality and the growth of your engineers. You will create a motivating environment of continuous learning and accountability, leveraging agile practices.

What You Will Do

Reusable assets and standards

  • Define reusable assets (patterns, libraries, templates, tutorials and documentation) that speed adoption of USRM architecture standards.
  • Identify where standardization at scale will deliver the most consistency and value across USRM.
  • Identify new reusable assets to be developed (skills, agents, other) that support agentic engineering best practices.

Engineering practices

  • Promote AI-enabled engineering practices that speed delivery and improve outcomes.
  • Champion modern cloud engineering practices, including cloud-native design, automation, CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) and infrastructure as code.
  • Assist in the evaluate and selection of  new technologies.

Architecture adherence

  • Guide the fitness functions and framework that measure adherence to architecture standards and turn th results into clear next steps for engineering teams.

Partnership and alignment

  • Partner with the Product Owner, Scrum Master and Architect to align the team's work with shared product goals and define the KPIs (key performance indicators) that measure success.
  • Build partnerships with clients, technology and business managers, vendors and technology executives to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Team leadership

  • Monitor team effectiveness, remove roadblocks and manage dependencies on other teams.
  • Mentor and coach team members.
  • Deliver performance reviews, address performance issues promptly and support professional development, including rotations and special assignments.

Why join us

You will lead a team with high visibility and enterprise-wide impact. You will shape how USRM teams build software, work with cutting-edge cloud and AI technologies and develop a team that makes everyone else faster.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience
  • Experience managing teams that use Agile Scrum
  • Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform) and cloud-native architecture
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of how AI is changing engineering practices and solution delivery
  • Experience driving adoption of architecture standards, platforms or shared engineering practices across multiple teams
  • Ability to set a clear vision, mission and strategy for a team and rally others around it
  • Passion for advancing engineering practices and helping teams adopt the approaches that work best
  • Strong communication, influence and stakeholder management skills
  • Track record of coaching engineers and building inclusive, high-trust teams
  • Strong analytical skills and sound judgment, with the ability to build consensus across cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred

  • Background in platform engineering, developer experience or enterprise architecture
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, containerization and infrastructure as code
  • 3+ years leading engineers

Job.JobTitle: Director, Engineering - Property & Specialty (P&S) Delivery - USRM Tech
Job.JobDescription:
USRM Technology is seeking a passionate, transformational Director, Engineering to lead the Property & Specialty (P&S) Delivery portfolio. This organization directly drives the design and build of product capabilities to deliver on aggressive P&S Profit and Growth targets. As Director, you will lead a group of ~150 FTE and contractors, and will bring partners together across domains to launch, roll out, and enhance our products.

You will partner closely with business stakeholders to further accelerate our ambition to grow Property & Specialty while maintaining target profitability. Central to that ambition is to pair lead lines with strong Specialty lines. Your teams will build and deliver the capabilities that make that strategy real for our customers and agents.

You will also play a key role transforming how we deliver. We are re-imagining our product delivery model to materially increase our speed to market for product launches and rollouts. You will be a driving force for AI in our delivery, from spec-driven development to agentic coding, and will build the delivery engine of the future.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business leadership with engineering excellence, influence investment decisions, and deliver lasting business value.

About the role:

  • Lead: Serve as a strategic technology leader, coach, and mentor for a high-performing engineering team. Attract and build talent and create an environment where teams can deliver with clarity, accountability, and urgency.
  • Strategize: Define and advance the technology strategy, build cross-functional partnerships across domains, and drive operational excellence by optimizing processes and delivery practices to accelerate speed-to-market while maintaining the high quality. Translate business priorities, user expectations, and industry trends into technology strategies that enable growth, profitability, both in the short and in the long term.
  • Analyze, Decide, and Execute: Use data-driven insights, business cases, engineering metrics, operational health, and risk indicators to make informed portfolio decisions, prioritization, and drive execution. Ensure teams deliver measurable outcomes, modernize critical platforms, improve resiliency and speed to market.      
  • Collaborate: Build trusted partnerships across USRM Technology, Personal Lines Product, Service, Claims, Billing, Operations, Architecture, and peer portfolio teams to align priorities, remove barriers, manage dependencies, and deliver end-to-end solutions. Balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while ensuring technology decisions remain aligned to business strategy and long-term architectural direction.
  • Transform: Support the core Frontier team in shaping and advancing USRM’s multiyear transformational journey to simplify and modernize our product offering, policy capabilities, technology landscape, and ways of working.
  • External support: Develop and maintain a network of industry contacts and vendor relationships. Uses insights and contacts to strategically augment our teams to deliver on outcomes with flexibility.
  • Present and Influence: Communicate frequently with senior leaders, executives, peers, and cross-functional stakeholders to build alignment around portfolio vision, strategy, investment decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes. Bring clarity to complex topics and influence decisions across a broad and senior stakeholder group.
  • AI Fluency: Actively uses AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scale of work; can point to concrete workflows where AI adds value; critically evaluates and validates AI-generated output; and applies AI responsibly, protecting confidential and customer data.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in technical or business discipline or related experience; Master's Degree preferred.
  • Generally, more than 10 years related experience with 5 years in leadership role.
  • Proven experience leading and running a large-scale software engineering delivery engine of equivalent scale across distributed, multi-domain teams.
  • Property & Casualty (P&C) or Specialty insurance experience highly preferred.
  • In-depth knowledge of IT concepts, strategies and methodologies and their application to business opportunities. In-depth knowledge of business operations, objectives and strategies.
  • In-depth knowledge of project planning methodologies and tools and IT standards and guidelines.
  • Advanced knowledge of management concepts, practices and techniques. Ability to promote a team environment consisting of several teams.
  • Highly developed negotiation, facilitation and consensus building skills.
  • Highly developed oral and written communication skills; strong presentation skills.

About Us

When you join the LII LATAM U.S. Region Planning & Reporting team at Liberty Mutual, you will help shape the financial narrative and strategic direction of a dynamic, multi-country business. You’ll work closely with Regional Executive leaders, the Regional President, Product Line Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide timely, actionable insight into business performance.

About the Role

In this role, you will participate in the planning, reporting, and analysis of the LII LATAM U.S. Region’s financial results. You will analyze topline and bottom-line performance against plan, identify country- and product-line-level trends, and translate complex financial information into clear, compelling stories and recommendations for leadership. You will also serve as a key planning and reporting partner for assigned product lines, building subject-matter expertise and acting as a trusted resource for stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to combine strong financial acumen, analytical rigor, communication skills, and a continuous-improvement mindset (including the use of AI and emerging technologies) to enhance how the region plans, reports, and makes decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Support monthly Management Operating Review (MOR) meetings with the Regional Executive Team and Regional President by preparing clear, accurate, and insightful reporting on financial performance.
  • Analyze topline and bottom-line deviations from plan, forecast, prior year, and other relevant benchmarks; identify material drivers, emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop an understanding of financial performance by country, product line, and key business driver, and communicate findings in a concise, executive-ready format.
  • Serve as the primary planning and reporting contact for assigned product lines, partnering closely with Product Line Managers to support decision-making and build expertise in the business.
  • Help lead and coordinate elements of the annual and multi-year financial planning process, including topline assumptions, expense planning, consolidating outputs, and developing the overall financial story.
  • Partner with stakeholders to validate assumptions, investigate significant variances, resolve data questions, and ensure alignment on reporting results and planning inputs.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses, reports, presentations, and financial models in accordance with established procedures and regional business needs.
  • Maintain clear documentation of recurring reporting processes, data sources, business assumptions, methodologies, and controls; update documentation as processes evolve.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, planning tools, controls, data quality, and stakeholder experience.
  • Help drive innovation across the team by identifying and implementing practical applications of AI, automation, and other technologies to improve the speed, quality, and efficiency of financial planning and reporting.
  • Support regional strategic initiatives and special projects, including analysis, business-case development, implementation planning, and rollout support.
  • Act as a key communication link among Finance, Product Line leadership, Regional leadership, and other internal stakeholders, ensuring financial information is understood, aligned, and actionable.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree (Finance or Accounting) required.
  • CPA or advanced degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of finance experience.
  • Must demonstrate attention to detail in a fast-paced work environment and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously to drive results.
  • Communicates well with own team and across organizational boundaries to ensure the successful completion of shared goals.
  • Comfortable leading meetings and able to communicate issues and trends to senior management and other groups at the appropriate level of detail.
  • Solid understanding of Finance Tools and Analytical Methods.

At Liberty Mutual, we’re committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders’ rights and positively impacting our business. As an Attorney at Liberty Mutual, you’ll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If you’re looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where you’ll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a skilled and proactive Attorney to independently manage moderately complex civil litigation matters. This role requires a deep understanding of legal principles and insurance law, strategic case management, advanced technology utilization, and strong client relationship skills. The Attorney will develop and execute sophisticated legal strategies, lead settlement negotiations, mentor junior attorneys, and contribute to organizational improvements while maintaining the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Management and Execution: Independently manage all phases of litigation involving claims of moderate to heavy value (up to approximately $50,000 exposure). Conduct comprehensive legal research, draft precise pleadings, motions, and other legal documents. Lead settlement negotiations and participate in hearings, trials, and mediations to achieve optimal case outcomes.
  • Litigation Support: Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Legal Strategy Development: Develop, implement, and continuously refine advanced legal strategies for discovery, investigation, and trial preparation.
  • Technology Utilization: Employ advanced e-discovery tools, case management systems, and data analysis software to streamline workflows and reduce costs.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear, well-reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to clients and Claims Representatives. Build and sustain trusted relationships by understanding client operations and legal challenges.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with cases in collaboration with clients and senior attorneys.
  • Training, Mentoring, and Leadership: Design and conduct training sessions and workshops for Legal, Claims, and related departments. Mentor junior attorneys and legal support staff, offering guidance and direction to elevate team performance.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies. Adhere strictly to ethical guidelines, licensing requirements, and the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
  • Organizational Improvement and Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities for process automation and workflow enhancements.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Texas and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful trial attorney experience, preferably within insurance law and related litigation.
  • Proven experience managing moderately complex litigation with demonstrated success in achieving favorable outcomes.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers’ compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficient in advanced e-discovery tools, legal case management software, and remote collaboration technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead junior attorneys and legal staff.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and compliance with all regulatory and professional standards.

The Senior Underwriter is responsible for underwriting energy accounts independently within delegated authority, making data-driven accept/decline and pricing decisions for complex or high line-size risks across oil & gas, pipelines, power generation and renewables in North America.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of brokers/agents and clients; source and underwrite profitable energy business.
  • Assess technical exposures using loss histories, engineering reports, production/operational data and modelling; set terms, limits, deductibles and reinsurance needs.
  • Provide portfolio analytics and insights to inform pricing, appetite and marketing plans.
  • Maintain senior broker relationships and clearly articulate coverage differences and risk appetite.
  • Collaborate with Claims, Actuarial, Engineering, Legal and UW Support; participate in improvement and product development projects.
  • Mentor junior underwriters and represent the company at industry events.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

  • Manage a portfolio of brokers/agents and clients; source and underwrite profitable energy business.
  • Assess technical exposures using loss histories, engineering reports, production/operational data and modelling; set terms, limits, deductibles and reinsurance needs.
  • Provide portfolio analytics and insights to inform pricing, appetite and marketing plans.
  • Maintain senior broker relationships and clearly articulate coverage differences and risk appetite.
  • Collaborate with Claims, Actuarial, Engineering, Legal and UW Support; participate in improvement and product development projects.
  • Mentor junior underwriters and represent the company at industry events.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Job.JobTitle: Senior Casualty Claims Specialist, Attorney Represented - Central or Eastern Time Zone
Job.JobDescription:
Advance Your Career with Liberty Mutual’s

Personal Lines Casualty Team!

 

Our Casualty Attorney Represented team is currently hiring for Senior Claims Specialists to manage attorney represented and litigated auto and homeowner's bodily injury claims. This role will manage, investigate and resolve claims as well as assist in providing prompt and quality service to policyholders for mild to moderate severity and/or complexity claims.

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: Candidates who live within 50 miles of a Liberty Mutual Claims office are expected to work on-site at least two days per month.
Remote: Candidates who live more than 50 miles from a Liberty Mutual Claims office are eligible to work fully remote.

The start date for the role is January 11, 2027.

This position operates on a Central or Eastern time schedule.

                                    

Responsibilities:

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed authority levels.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences and reports to Home Office and local management on status.
  • Confers with trial counsel and prepares trial reports.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims, refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary, and advise as to proper course of action.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Updates files and provides comprehensive reports as required.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years Personal Lines Third-Party Auto Casualty Experience.
  • 1+ years Attorney Represented Experience.
  • Experience handling Litigated Third-Party Auto Casualty Claims.
  • Experience handling Uninsured and Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) Claims.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communications skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated competency of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 12-18 months of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

Applicants residing in Washington state, California, or the District of Columbia are not eligible at this time.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region
Job.JobDescription:
Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowner’s liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowner’s experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

 Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX All‑Lines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 sign‑on bonus.

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote.  Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Eastern Time Zones.

 

Hub Locations:


Chandler, AZ
Clifton Park, NY
Columbus, OH
Indianapolis, IN
Lake Mary, FL
Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ
Plano, TX
Suwanee, GA
Naperville, IL
Westborough, MA

 

Travel: 10% for mediations, arbitrations, trials, or in‑person events.

Your Expertise Opens Doors

The work you do here can be the foundation for what comes next. As you build technical depth, demonstrate leadership, and expand your impact, you will have opportunities to pursue new challenges and advance within the organization.

At Liberty Mutual, growth is not limited to one job title and trust is not limited to one decision. We give you the opportunity to build your career and the authority to make a difference.

Training That Sets You Up for Success:

Your growth begins on day one. Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatory and crucial to your success in this high‑impact role.

Qualifications
  • Must have an expert knowledge of coverage, liability, and complex claims handling procedures.
  • Must be able to effectively handle claims at the highest technical and complexity level.
  • Must be knowledgeable of state and federal laws in the adjuster's jurisdiction.
  • A full working knowledge of claims operations and procedures is required.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills required as well as strong interpersonal, analytical, investigative and negotiation skills.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 7 years of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowner’s liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowner’s experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

 Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX All‑Lines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 sign‑on bonus.

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote.  Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Eastern Time Zones.

Job.JobDescription:
Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowner’s liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowner’s experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment

We are seeking a high-performing Construction Casualty Executive Underwriter to drive profitable growth and strategic portfolio development across the Midwest region. In this role, you will leverage deep construction industry expertise and advanced underwriting acumen to manage complex Middle Market, Large Account, and National Account casualty risks. As part of Liberty Mutual, you will have the authority to make impactful underwriting decisions, build strong broker and client relationships, and contribute to the continued success of our specialized construction practice. If you are a proven commercial insurance underwriting professional with a strong market presence, exceptional risk assessment skills, and a growth-oriented mindset, this is an outstanding opportunity to advance your career while shaping a profitable book of business.
 
This role could be filled at the Senior or Executive level depending upon experience. 

Responsibilities:             

This position would be located in the field near our agency/broker partners:

  • Risk Selection: Reviews, rates, underwrites, evaluates, or assesses the business applying for insurance by qualifying accounts, identifying, selecting and assessing risks, determining the premium, policy terms and conditions, obtaining approvals, creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker, and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Demonstrates a high level of responsiveness and focus on supporting Key Agents and Brokers objectives. Establishes, develops, and maintains successful relationships with Key Agents and Brokers to facilitate marketing of products, through responsive service, site visits, in person renewal meetings or enhanced knowledge of their customers businesses. Develops strong personal brand to build and maintain a long-term quality pipeline with Key Agents/Brokers.
  • Portfolio Management: Manages a sizable and complex book of business by analyzing the portfolio, identifying areas of opportunity for improved growth, profit and diversification, and executing marketing plans to increase market share by making marketing calls to preferred brokers to market and cross market. Provides input to the development of marketing plans, product analysis, services, geographic focus and broker intelligence.
  • Documenting the Deal: Documents files in a way that reflects a solid thought process and decision making through comprehensive account reviews, sign-offs and referrals that comply with state regulations, letter of authority, and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Formally guides, mentors, and coaches underwriters and account analysts in both technical and professional skills. Demonstrates multiple areas of expertise and provides regular updates to other underwriters.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participates in continuous improvement by generating suggestions, participating in problem solving activities and using continuous improvement tools to support the work of the team.
Qualifications
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of insurance products/coverage, underwriting, pricing, risk selection, market segments and marketplace; insurance finance and actuarial concepts; loss control/risk engineering; marketing techniques, regulatory environment and reinsurance; advanced-level knowledge of territory management.
  • Ability to apply underwriting/appetite, tools, systems, and resources to achieve goals, solve complex problems, establish and build healthy working relationships exceeds in mentoring relationships, and negotiate as normally acquired and a related bachelor’s degree, three to ten years of relevant experience preferred; CPCU or professional insurance designation strongly preferred.

Responsibilities:             

This position would be located in the field near our agency/broker partners:

  • Risk Selection: Reviews, rates, underwrites, evaluates, or assesses the business applying for insurance by qualifying accounts, identifying, selecting and assessing risks, determining the premium, policy terms and conditions, obtaining approvals, creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker, and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Demonstrates a high level of responsiveness and focus on supporting Key Agents and Brokers objectives. Establishes, develops, and maintains successful relationships with Key Agents and Brokers to facilitate marketing of products, through responsive service, site visits, in person renewal meetings or enhanced knowledge of their customers businesses.   • Portfolio Management: Manages a sizable and complex book of business by analyzing the portfolio, identifying areas of opportunity for improved growth, profit and diversification, and executing marketing plans to increase market share by making marketing calls to preferred brokers to market and cross market. Job.JobTitle: Executive Underwriting Manager, Shared & Layered, GRS North America Property
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Executive Underwriting Manager, Shared & Layered is responsible for leading underwriting strategy, portfolio performance, and talent development for the Global Risk Solutions (GRS) North America Shared & Layered Property business. This leader drives profitable growth through disciplined underwriting, effective capacity deployment, portfolio management, and strong partnerships with brokers, Risk Engineering, Claims, Actuarial, Product, Distribution, and Finance teams.

As a senior underwriting leader, the Executive Underwriting Manager establishes underwriting direction, manages portfolio performance, and serves as a key authority on complex property risks, ensuring alignment among growth, profitability, and risk appetite objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Underwriting and Portfolio Leadership

  • Develop and execute underwriting strategies to achieve profitable growth across the Shared & Layered Property portfolio.
  • Oversee underwriting performance across large and complex property risks, including but not limited to primary, buffer, and excess layers, quota share, and alternative risk transfer deals.
  • Monitor portfolio composition, rate adequacy, retention, new business production, and profitability metrics.
  • Ensure disciplined deployment of underwriting capacity consistent with enterprise risk appetite.
  • Evaluate market opportunities and emerging property trends to optimize portfolio performance.

Property Risk Expertise

  • Serve as the senior underwriting authority for complex property accounts and large-limit property programs.
  • Provide expertise on property exposures, account structures, coverage design, pricing, capacity deployment, and terms and conditions.
  • Partner with Risk Engineering to evaluate exposures and strengthen underwriting outcomes.
  • Monitor catastrophe aggregation, concentration management, and portfolio exposure trends.
  • Ensure underwriting decisions appropriately balance growth opportunities with risk management objectives.
  • Apply knowledge of reinsurance considerations and capacity constraints when shaping account and portfolio decisions.

Distribution and Market Leadership

  • Build and strengthen relationships with key brokers and strategic distribution partners.
  • Represent the organization in major broker engagements, client meetings, and industry forums.
  • Influence market strategy and broker trading relationships to enhance the organization’s competitive position.
  • Identify growth opportunities within existing and emerging market segments.

Talent Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop underwriting leaders and individual contributors.
  • Build a culture of underwriting excellence, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.
  • Drive talent assessment, succession planning, and organizational capability development.
  • Attract, develop, and retain top underwriting talent.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Product, Actuarial, Risk Engineering, Claims, Distribution, and Finance to drive business performance.
  • Influence underwriting guidelines, product enhancements, operational improvements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Support execution of enterprise and business-segment priorities.
  • Serve as a key contributor to senior underwriting leadership discussions and business planning activities.

Skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills. 

Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent.
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 4 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred.
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred.
  • Significant experience underwriting large, complex commercial property risks, including shared and layered structures.
  • Demonstrated success leading underwriting teams and managing profitable portfolios.
  • Deep understanding of property underwriting, catastrophe exposures, risk evaluation, pricing, capacity deployment, and portfolio management.
  • Strong broker and distribution management experience.
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility.
  • Demonstrated expert-level ability to communicate complex analyses and information.
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Director, Product Owner - Global Surety
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Product Manager, Technology / Insurtech, Surety Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
The Senior Director, Product Owner role is responsible for aligning Global Surety's business objectives to our technology investment portfolio. This includes deeply understanding surety's business objectives, how and where technology can best achieve those goals, and partnering with operations and technology to plan, estimate, deliver and measure results in furtherance of those goals.

You will also be responsible for leveraging strong Agile methodologies and standards to consistently improve performance, communicate with and integrate feedback from stakeholders, and drive delivery of our technology portfolio. In addition to the qualifications below, ideal candidates have successfully worked in a global environment, are confident with AI, and push themselves and others to find creative solutions to business problems.

Responsibilities:

 

  • Responsible for translating portfolio-level business objectives (increase sales to independent agents through improved digital quoting and binding) into technology product strategies
  • Responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction and overall progress of the transformation to Agile development methodology
  • Works closely with business units to take business strategy and translate into product strategies to support overall business objectives
  • Represents the business by communicating the product vision broadly and effectively to key stakeholders and Senior Management.
  • Allocates investment across products and ensures sufficient resources
  • Owns the overall product backlog and provides guidance to product owners on the scrum teams that comprise the complete effort
  • Uses the overall backlog to coordinate the work of product teams, through each team`s product owner
  • Functions as the final arbiter at the product level to order work and accepts the final release plan
  • Manages final escalation on trade-offs across the product portfolio Provides customer-oriented feedback on product and feature demos for scrum sub-teams
  • Provides leadership to agile product teams and has direct managerial responsibilities for Product Owners and other Agile development team roles
  • Defines objectives and development plans in alignment with IT and business objectives
  • Manages team to achieve business results
  • Champions Agile development methodology transformation across the company through contribution to Agile education initiatives and communicating agile principles to executive audiences
  • Monitors the application of Agile principles across product teams
Qualifications
  • Business expertise and knowledge of Agile development methodologies and IT project management as typically acquired through a Bachelors` degree in relevant field (business, computer science, etc
  • Minimum of 10 years` experience in business, engineering, technology and/or consulting
  • Master`s degree preferred
  • At least 5 years` experience managing product management teams
  • Proven business expertise needed to set clear priorities across the product portfolio and drive business value
  • Has in depth knowledge and ability to influence business strategy
  • Possesses strong communication and influence skills within reporting line as well as with IT and business peers
  • Excellent collaboration skills -- leading execution across teams, influencing across organizations, respected, experience of working across levels from developers and designers Demonstrates passion for improving customer outcomes and experiences
  • Embraces change and `outside of the box` ideas-does not feel attachment to the status quo
  • Encourages non-hierarchical culture
