Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, you’ll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

We’re hiring across the Northeast and Southeast:

Northeast: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania

Southeast: Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia and West Virginia

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, you’ll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

We’re hiring across the Northeast and Southeast:

Northeast: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania

Southeast: Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia and West Virginia

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, you’ll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

We’re hiring across the Northeast and Southeast:

Northeast: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania

Southeast: Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia and West Virginia

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, you’ll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

We’re hiring across the Northeast and Southeast:

Northeast: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania

Southeast: Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia and West Virginia

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, you’ll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

We’re hiring across the Northeast and Southeast:

Northeast: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania

Southeast: Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia and West Virginia

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines.  Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers’ compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
As a member of the Comparion Insurance Agency, you will lead a team of Insurance Sales Agents across Northern Ohio. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role, with the goal being to better meet the needs of our customers, help improve the sales process for our reps, and to support growth and profitability of the core business by influencing and mentoring sales representatives.

This position is responsible for providing strategic guidance and coaching support to drive the expansion and optimization of the agency, including the identification and evaluation of emerging opportunities for business growth. You determine how much you earn by how well you motivate and develop your team to sell and service customers.

This is a chance to play a key role in evolving the agency while developing and maintaining effective relationships with business partners and serving as a liaison between your branch and other business areas.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive sales team towards achieving/exceeding sales metrics.
  • Develop and coach the sales team.
  • Establish long-lasting relationships with customers in order to maintain high customer retention and satisfaction.
  • Oversee operational functions of the Branch.
  • Ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and high customer retention.
  • Generate strategic and innovative ideas in order to drive new business development.
  • Facilitate an engaging environment in which agents are inspired and feel supported.
  • Manage acquisition and service cost for Branch assignment.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor `s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of personal lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative

As a member of the Comparion Insurance Agency, you will lead a team of Insurance Sales Agents across Northern Ohio. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role, with the goal being to better meet the needs of our customers, help improve the sales process for our reps, and to support growth and profitability of the core business by influencing and mentoring sales representatives.

This position is responsible for providing strategic guidance and coaching support to drive the expansion and optimization of the agency, including the identification and evaluation of emerging opportunities for business growth. You determine how much you earn by how well you motivate and develop your team to sell and service customers.

This is a chance to play a key role in evolving the agency while developing and maintaining effective relationships with business partners and serving as a liaison between your branch and other business areas.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive sales team towards achieving/exceeding sales metrics.
  • Develop and coach the sales team.
  • Establish long-lasting relationships with customers in order to maintain high customer retention and satisfaction.
  • Oversee operational functions of the Branch.
  • Ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and high customer retention.
  • Generate strategic and innovative ideas in order to drive new business development.
  • Facilitate an engaging environment in which agents are inspired and feel supported.
  • Manage acquisition and service cost for Branch assignment.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor `s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of personal lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

As an Insurance Sales Apprentice, you will develop the skills necessary for a successful sales career at Comparion by working closely with our Sales Managers and Sales Agents.Throughout this apprenticeship, you will build prospecting and product knowledge, as well as build and develop client relationships within local communities to promote Auto, Home, Life, Health, and Commercial Insurance products.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career in Towson, MD and Frederick, MD. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Brentwood, TN office.  This is an in-office position.

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community. 

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company that’s committed to advancing an inclusive environment. We do that through leadership development programs aimed at advancing, engaging, and retaining under-represented talent and our Employee Resource Groups, which strengthen our inclusive workplace, enhance personal development, and provide ways for employees to connect, learn and engage.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutual—a Fortune 100 company that’s committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new hire training class once they begin working for Comparion.  The training includes a licensing training program in which Comparion covers the cost of training materials and exam fees.
Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. Description

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.

We are looking for a part-time Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Burlington, MA office.  This position has in-office requirements.

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community.

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, is seeking motivated and career-driven individuals to join our Insurance Sales Apprenticeship Program. This is a structured, 6-month, hands-on development program designed to prepare participants for a successful career in insurance sales.

As an apprentice, you will build foundational knowledge of insurance products, develop consultative sales skills, and gain real-world experience working alongside Sales Managers and Agents. Successful completion of the program is intended to lead to a full-time, benefits-eligible Sales Agent position featuring a competitive base salary, robust uncapped commission structure, bonus opportunities & revenue-sharing potential!

 

Compensation: $24/hour
Employment Type: Temporary (6 months)
Benefits: Not eligible

What You’ll Do

  • Learn and develop knowledge of auto, home, life, and specialty insurance products
  • Obtain required insurance licenses (company-supported)
  • Shadow and partner with Sales Managers and Sales Agents
  • Conduct customer needs analyses to identify coverage opportunities
  • Assist with prospecting, outreach, and lead generation activities
  • Support quoting, proposal development, and new business processing
  • Build relationships with prospective and existing clients
  • Utilize CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) to manage customer interactions and pipeline activity
  • Participate in community events and networking to promote the Comparion brand
  • Develop and execute prospecting and Centers of Influence (COI) strategies

Program Structure

Throughout the apprenticeship, participants will progress through:

  • Foundation Building: Licensing, product knowledge, systems training
  • Sales Development: Customer conversations, needs-based selling, closing support
  • Business Development: Prospecting, networking, and pipeline management

What We Offer

  • Paid, hands-on training and licensing support
  • Real-world sales experience in a consultative environment
  • Mentorship from experienced sales professionals
  • Exposure to multiple carriers and product offerings
  • Clear pathway to a full-time Sales Agent role upon successful completion
Qualifications

Qualifications

Required Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated with a strong interest in sales and career growth
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Organizational and time management abilities
  • Ability to learn new systems and technology quickly

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles (retail, hospitality, service, banking, or sales)
  • Exposure to sales, account management, or business development
  • Interest in consultative selling and relationship management

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure.
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Description

We are excited to announce the launch of #Comparion Insurance Agency, a new Liberty Mutual company.  As one of the largest personal lines insurance agencies in the US, Comparion connects customers with the best insurance solutions to meet their needs whether from Liberty or from one of a number of top national and regional carriers.

Program Overview:

As an Insurance Sales Apprentice, you will develop the skills necessary for a successful sales career at Comparion by working closely with our Sales Managers and Sales Agents.Throughout this apprenticeship, you will build prospecting and product knowledge, as well as build and develop client relationships within local communities to promote Auto, Home, Life, Health, and Commercial Insurance products.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop complete knowledge of insurance products, systems, business operations, and sales strategy.
  • Assist Sales Agents in daily and weekly activities which include creation of prospecting plans, developing Centers of Influence (COI) relationships.
  • In partnership with Sales Manager and Sales Agents, create marketing and prospecting techniques to meet established targets for new business policies and premium.
  • Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of appropriate protection and coverage by conducting customer needs analysis to determine multiple selling opportunities.
  • Establishes relationships and promotes Comparion brand awareness through community marketing events. Advances the Company's current advertising campaigns and projects a positive corporate image in the community. Leverages community relationships to increase selling opportunities
  • Prospects and initiates new business sales. Assists in the processing of new business. Includes contacting customers to finalize sales transactions.
Qualifications
  • Results oriented with demonstrated organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build rapport with prospective and existing customers.
  • Possess excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven track record of success in current role

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself.

 As one of the largest personal lines insurance agencies in the US, #Comparion Insurance Agents connect members of their local communities with insurance solutions to meet their unique needs, including Auto, Home, and Life products from top national and regional carriers.

Success in this role will require you to build and leverage a strong local network and in-person relationships in the community. This role has in-office requirements.

We encourage you to explore our Insurance Agent role if you are:

Highly self-motivated and driven: You're resilient, have a strong work ethic and don't need oversight once you're trained up. You're a natural born leader who manages and organizes time well.

Gritty and adaptable: You work well under pressure and can successfully adapt when the unexpected happens. You take ownership of your results.

Coachable: You’re a team player who loves to learn from others. You respond to feedback and always seek to continuously improve how you operate.

Results-oriented: Friendly rivalries motivate you, you’re competitive, and you go above and beyond to achieve.

Charismatic: You’re a people person! You enjoy helping people in your communities stay safe and secure. You cultivate new relationships easily, and your influencing skills are second-to-none.

Comparion Insurance Agents enjoy:

  • Uncapped pay including base salary and bonuses, with renewal commissions providing opportunity to increase your earnings each year
  • Recognition including prizes and worldwide travel on top of competitive income
  • Paid training (including licensing training) and mentorships for employees who want to pursue their career goals
  • Sales support, including earning commission for leads even if other team members close the deals
  • Comprehensive benefits from day one, including health and dental insurance, 401(k) with company match, company paid pension, paid time off, 401(k) student loan match, tuition reimbursement, family building support
Qualifications

Preferred Experience

  • Previous employment in a sales role where you have successfully turned prospects into customers.
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life.

Required Skills

  • Effective written and oral communication and presentation skills
  • Well-developed persuasion and negotiation skills
  • Great interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build relationships with prospective and existing customers
  • Effective time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to learn insurance coverage and underwriting guidelines
  • Familiarity with finding, building and growing leads and customer base

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

We are looking for a Sales Agent to join our team in our The Woodlands office. Success in this role will require a strong local network and in-person relationship building in the community. This is an on-site and field sales focused position.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Insurance Sales Agent – Grow Your Career & Impact Your Community

Are you ready to build a rewarding career where you make an impact in your community? Join our team as a Sales Agent in our Memphis, TN location.

We’re looking for motivated individuals with a passion for connecting with others and building meaningful relationships. If you have a strong local network or the drive to build one, we want to meet you!

Licensing Requirement:
Candidates are welcome to apply even if you do not currently hold your Property & Casualty and Life insurance licenses; however, you must obtain both licenses before your scheduled start date. Whether you already hold your licenses or obtain them before your start date, you’ll receive a $1,000 professional start bonus to support your transition into your new role!

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Compensation:
    • $55K–$65K base training salary
    • $1,000 professional start bonus
    • First-year total compensation typically $55K–$75K, with top performers earning over $100K
    • Uncapped commissions and renewal income for sustained earning potential
  • Career Growth & Support:
    • Paid training once onboard
    • Ongoing mentorship and professional development
    • Sales support—you can earn commission for leads, even if another teammate closes the sale
  • Exceptional Benefits (Day One):
    • Health and dental insurance
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Tuition reimbursement and student loan match
    • Paid time off and family-building support
  • Recognition & Rewards:
    • Unlock extraordinary rewards for your hard work!
    • Win exclusive prizes, luxury gifts, and all-expenses-paid travel to premier destinations—celebrating your achievements in style.
    • Earn public recognition at company events and in team communications, spotlighting your success and setting you apart as a top performer.

Who Succeeds Here?

  • Highly self-motivated individuals
  • Networkers and relationship-builders who love face-to-face interaction
  • Adaptable professionals who own their results and rise to challenges
  • Team players eager to learn, grow, and continuously improve
  • Charismatic communicators who enjoy helping others protect what matters most

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.

  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.

  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.

Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

We are looking for a Part Time Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Marlton, NJ office (32 hours per week).  This is not a remote position.

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company that’s committed to advancing an inclusive environment. Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutual—a Fortune 100 company that’s committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.

  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service

  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Please note: While No Insurance Experience is required, you must obtain P&C and Life License prior to employment. 

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • $1,000 Professional Start Bonus
  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.

Compensation Details:

  • The typical training salary is $51k-55k
  • Through a combination of base, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, typical total first year compensation ranges from $65k - $80k
  • Potential for top performers to earn over $100k in their first year
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain P&C and Life licenses prior to being hired. 

 

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.
