In-Person Summer 2027 Internship 

Our Summer 2027 Early Talent internships are a set 11-weeks in length, with 2 options for start/end dates. Limited exceptions to these start/end dates may be considered on a case-by-case basis:

May 17, 2027 - July 30, 2027

June 1, 2027 - August 13, 2027

Were you born to close deals? Do you love networking and connecting with people? Do you possess an unwavering drive to succeed?


If you checked any or all of these boxes, it’s time to put your people skills to work at Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company as a Sales intern. 

Details 

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where you’re encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!


You’ll grow sales through cold calling, observe and assist with sales events, develop sourcing strategies, and utilize CRM tools and systems to support marketing campaigns. You may even be asked to implement a social media strategy for sales reps.


Best of all, at the close of the internship, you may have the opportunity to explore a future career in sales at Comparion Insurance Agency.

Qualifications

What you’ve got

  • You are pursuing an Associate's or Bachelor's degree program, graduating between December 2027 - May 2028.
  • Sales, Marketing, Communications and Business Majors preferred or related fields.
  • You’re organized, know how to manage your time, and know how to get results.
  • You know how to build rapport with prospective and existing customers.
  • You possess excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • You have prior experience in sales or client service environment.
  • You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.
  • Local to office selected

Were you born to close deals? Do you love networking and connecting with people? Do you possess an unwavering drive to succeed?


If you checked any or all of these boxes, it’s time to put your people skills to work at Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company as a Sales intern. 

Details 

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where you’re encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!


You’ll grow sales through cold calling, observe and assist with sales events, develop sourcing strategies, and utilize CRM tools and systems to support marketing campaigns. You may even be asked to implement a social media strategy for sales reps.


Best of all, at the close of the internship, you may have the opportunity to explore a future career in sales at Comparion Insurance Agency.

Qualifications

What you’ve got

  • You are pursuing an Associate's or Bachelor's degree program, graduating between December 2027 - May 2028.
  • Sales, Marketing, Communications and Business Majors preferred or related fields.
  • You’re organized, know how to manage your time, and know how to get results.
  • You know how to build rapport with prospective and existing customers.
  • You possess excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • You have prior experience in sales or client service environment.
  • You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.
  • Local to office selected 
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. 

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

  

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits 
  
Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Were you born to close deals? Do you love networking and connecting with people? Do you possess an unwavering drive to succeed?


If you checked any or all of these boxes, it’s time to put your people skills to work at Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company as a Sales intern. 

Details 

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where you’re encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!


You’ll grow sales through cold calling, observe and assist with sales events, develop sourcing strategies, and utilize CRM tools and systems to support marketing campaigns. You may even be asked to implement a social media strategy for sales reps.


Best of all, at the close of the internship, you may have the opportunity to explore a future career in sales at Comparion Insurance Agency.

Qualifications

What you’ve got

  • You are pursuing an Associate's or Bachelor's degree program, graduating between December 2027 - May 2028.
  • Sales, Marketing, Communications and Business Majors preferred or related fields.
  • You’re organized, know how to manage your time, and know how to get results.
  • You know how to build rapport with prospective and existing customers.
  • You possess excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • You have prior experience in sales or client service environment.
  • You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.
  • Local to office selected

We are looking for a part-time (32 hours+ per week) Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Cranston, RI office.  This position has in-office requirements.

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community. 

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company that’s committed to advancing an inclusive environment. We do that through leadership development programs aimed at advancing, engaging, and retaining under-represented talent and our Employee Resource Groups, which strengthen our inclusive workplace, enhance personal development, and provide ways for employees to connect, learn and engage.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutual—a Fortune 100 company that’s committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new hire training class once they begin working for Comparion.  The training includes a licensing training program in which Comparion covers the cost of training materials and exam fees.
Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

 

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

We are looking for a Part-Time Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Brentwood, TN office. 

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community. 

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company that’s committed to advancing an inclusive environment. We do that through leadership development programs aimed at advancing, engaging, and retaining under-represented talent and our Employee Resource Groups, which strengthen our inclusive workplace, enhance personal development, and provide ways for employees to connect, learn and engage.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutual—a Fortune 100 company that’s committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new hire training class once they begin working for Comparion.  The training includes a licensing training program in which Comparion covers the cost of training materials and exam fees.
Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company that’s committed to advancing an inclusive environment. Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.

  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

 This is an in-office position in  Charleston,  Wheeling , Morgantown, WV 

 

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

In-Person Part-Time Academic Year Sales Internship 

Were you born to close deals? Do you love networking and connecting with people? Do you possess an unwavering drive to succeed? Are you a student graduating between December 2027 - Summer 2028?


If you checked any or all of these boxes, it’s time to put your people skills to work at Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company as a Sales intern. 

Office Location: Openings across the following Comparion office locations:

  • Glastonbury, CT
  • Trumbull, CT
  • Middlebury, CT
  • Reno, NV
  • Elko, NV
  • Chandler, AZ
  • Gilbert, AZ
  • Cottonwood Heights, UT

Details 

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where you’re encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!


You’ll grow sales through cold calling, observe and assist with sales events, develop sourcing strategies, and utilize CRM tools and systems to support marketing campaigns. You may even be asked to implement a social media strategy for sales reps.


Best of all, at the close of the internship, you may have the opportunity to explore a future career in sales at Comparion Insurance Agency.

Qualifications

What you’ve got

  • You're an undergraduate or associate degree student in your junior or senior year, currently pursuing a degree. Candidates majoring in Sales are preferred.
  • You hold a competitive cumulative GPA. Additional requirements might apply. 
  • You’re organized, know how to manage your time, and know how to get results. 
  • You know how to build rapport with prospective and existing customers.
  • You possess excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. 
  • You have prior experience in sales or client service environment.

Insurance Sales Agent – Grow Your Career & Impact Your Community

Are you ready to build a rewarding career where you make an impact in your community? Join our team as a Sales Agent in our Murfreesboro, Downtown Nashville or Hendersonville, TN location.

We’re looking for motivated individuals with a passion for connecting with others and building meaningful relationships. If you have a strong local network or the drive to build one, we want to meet you!

Licensing Requirement:
Candidates are welcome to apply even if you do not currently hold your Property & Casualty and Life insurance licenses; however, you must obtain both licenses before your scheduled start date. Whether you already hold your licenses or obtain them before your start date, you’ll receive a $1,000 professional start bonus to support your transition into your new role!

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Compensation:
    • $55K–$65K base training salary
    • $1,000 professional start bonus
    • First-year total compensation typically $55K–$75K, with top performers earning over $100K
    • Uncapped commissions and renewal income for sustained earning potential
  • Career Growth & Support:
    • Paid training once onboard
    • Ongoing mentorship and professional development
    • Sales support—you can earn commission for leads, even if another teammate closes the sale
  • Exceptional Benefits (Day One):
    • Health and dental insurance
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Tuition reimbursement and student loan match
    • Paid time off and family-building support
  • Recognition & Rewards:
    • Unlock extraordinary rewards for your hard work!
    • Win exclusive prizes, luxury gifts, and all-expenses-paid travel to premier destinations—celebrating your achievements in style.
    • Earn public recognition at company events and in team communications, spotlighting your success and setting you apart as a top performer.

Who Succeeds Here?

  • Highly self-motivated individuals
  • Networkers and relationship-builders who love face-to-face interaction
  • Adaptable professionals who own their results and rise to challenges
  • Team players eager to learn, grow, and continuously improve
  • Charismatic communicators who enjoy helping others protect what matters most

About Us:
As part of Comparion, one of the largest personal lines insurance agencies in the US, you’ll connect your local community with Auto, Home, and Life insurance solutions from top national and regional carriers.

Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

 

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career.

Candidate must live in or close to Kalispell, MT.

This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you’ll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed — no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Plano, TX office.  This is not a remote position.

We’re Hiring Immediately!

 

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community. 

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company that’s committed to advancing an inclusive environment. We do that through leadership development programs aimed at advancing, engaging, and retaining under-represented talent and our Employee Resource Groups, which strengthen our inclusive workplace, enhance personal development, and provide ways for employees to connect, learn and engage.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutual—a Fortune 100 company that’s committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new hire training class once they begin working for Comparion.  The training includes a licensing training program in which Comparion covers the cost of training materials and exam fees.
Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance license—or willingness to earn one with training and support—in Property & Casualty, and Life

Description

What you’ll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.

  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income – potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable – you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive – you follow through and do what you say you’ll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy – you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused – you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing – you’re comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy – you’re able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure – you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Job.JobDescription:
What you'll be doing:
Service and renew customer accounts for Church Mutual within an assigned territory. Conduct on-site visits to inspect, field underwrite, evaluate exposures, and conduct customer renewal and service presentations. Provide risk management advice as appropriate. Evaluate exposures and round out customer accounts with appropriate supplemental coverage. Investigate and respond to customer inquiries. Maintain customer database and process automated insurance transactions.
 
 
Benefits:
Base Salary
Potential New Business Commission
Potential Year End Bonus
Company Car, Gas Card, and Company Credit Card for Business Expenses
Profit Sharing, As Declared by Church Mutual Board
 
 
On any given day, you'll:
  • Develop and implement a service and renewal plan that leads to successful accomplishment of assigned goals and corporate objectives.
  • Develop subline and other sales opportunities to customers of Church Mutual and subsidiaries.
  • Conduct on-site visits to inspect, field underwrite, evaluate exposures, obtain referrals, and conduct customer renewal and service presentations.
  • Obtain referrals for new business.
  • Provide risk management advice. Evaluate exposures and round out customer accounts with appropriate supplemental coverage.
  • Investigate and respond to customer inquiries and respond appropriately. Report activities in appropriate systems.
  • Maintain customer database and process automated insurance transactions.
 
Here's what we expect:
  • Bachelor's degree and industry experience is preferred.
  • Obtain and maintain proper insurance license.
  • Maintain valid driver's license.
  • Ability to understand organizational structure and operation.
  • Able to work independently to specific performance standards and goals.
  • Ability to travel, including overnight stays.
  • Strong written/verbal presentation and listening skills.
  • Demonstrated skills in relationship building, decision-making, negotiation, and communication.
  •  Ability to understand, interpret, and explain various insurance policies.
  • Ability to learn and use job-related software to stay current with changes.
  • Remote.
  • Travel and overnight stays are required.
 
 
 
Church Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 
 

Exact compensation will vary based on consideration of a variety of factors including education, skills, experience, and location.

What you'll do:

The Assistant Vice President of IT & Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a senior IT executive role responsible for enterprise application development, integration, and data platforms across Church Mutual’s Property & Casualty insurance technology ecosystem. This role leads a high‑performance technology delivery organization and partners closely with business leaders to translate strategy into scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions.

The CTO owns working with business unit leaders to translate business needs into technology strategy execution, application portfolio health, and delivery of strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, architectural standards, security requirements, and financial stewardship. The role is accountable for both run‑the‑business stability and transformational modernization initiatives.

Primary Accountabilities:

Technology Leadership & Strategy

  • Partner with business unit leaders to co‑develop and execute business‑aligned technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Translate enterprise and line‑of‑business strategies into actionable technology delivery plans.
  • Serve as a key member of the IT executive leadership team, contributing to enterprise‑wide IT strategy, investment prioritization, and governance.

Application Development & Integration

  • Department head for full‑stack application development across enterprise and customer‑facing platforms, with emphasis on Java‑based architectures.
  • Own data integration, API strategy, and system interoperability across core insurance platforms and vendor ecosystems.
  • Ensure development practices support scalability, reliability, and maintainability in a regulated P&C insurance environment.

Data Platforms & Analytics Enablement

  • Provide technology leadership for:
    • Data acquisition and Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW)
    • OneLake / modern data platforms
    • Data pipelines supporting reporting, analytics, and operational insights
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to ensure data platforms are trusted, secure, and fit for purpose.

Agile Delivery & DevOps Excellence

  • Establish and mature Agile delivery practices across application teams.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling, and automation to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality and security.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery predictability, velocity, and quality.

Application Portfolio Management

  • Maintain accountability for application lifecycle management, including:
    • Currency and technical debt management
    • Rationalization and modernization planning
    • Retirement of obsolete or redundant systems
  • Partner with Architecture, Security, and Portfolio Management to ensure investment discipline and sustainability.

Strategic Initiative Delivery

  • Lead delivery of major strategic initiatives, including:
    • Core system modernization
    • Digital customer experience platforms
    • Enterprise integration and data modernization efforts
  • Ensure initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, disciplined execution, and measurable outcomes.

People Leadership & Culture

  • Build, lead, and inspire a high‑performance technology organization.
  • Attract, develop, and retain top engineering and technology talent.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Key Relationships

  • CIO and Executive Management Team
  • Business Unit Leaders and Executives
  • Infrastructure/Operations, Security CISO, Enterprise Architecture  and Project Management Office Leadership
  • External technology partners and vendors

Key competencies:

  • Technical expertise: In-depth knowledge of enterprise application platforms, cloud computing and immersion technologies. Ability to use strategic planning to translate business goals into technology solutions.
  • Communication and collaboration: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to collaborate with other executives, stakeholders and teams across the organization, and to influence people to achieve common goals.
  • Project management: Strong project management skills, including experience with agile methodologies and change management.
  • Analytical skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities; proficiency in data analysis and performance metrics.
  • Financial acumen: Understanding of financial principles and ability to manage budgets and optimize costs.
  • Leadership and decision making: Readiness to lead, inspire and develop innovative teams. Ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement while demonstrating sound judgment and making timely, effective decisions.
  • Customer focus: Prioritization of the needs of our business and its customers. Ability to drive initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction and business value.

Integrity and trust: High ethical standards and trustworthiness. Ability to act consistently with transparency and accountability

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including enterprise application development and integration.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in P&C insurance or regulated financial services environments.
  • Experience with large scale delivery projects. 
  • Deep experience with:
    • Full‑stack development (Java‑based ecosystems)
    • Enterprise integration and APIs
    • Data platforms (Data Warehouse, modern data lakes)
    • Agile and DevOps / CI‑CD practices
    • Core Insurance applications (Policy, Claims, Billing) and platforms.
    • Artificial Intelligence, robotic process automation (RPA) and workflow technologies.

Preferred

  • Experience leading large‑scale modernization programs.
  • Strong executive communication and business partnership skills.
  • Proven ability to balance run stability with transformational change.

Success Measures

  • Delivery of strategic initiatives on time, on budget, with quality to deliver desired business outcomes.
  • Strong  application portfolio health, with 5-year business technology roadmap and technical debt reduction strategies.
  • Increased delivery predictability and engineering maturity
  • Strong business satisfaction with IT partnership and outcomes

What you'll be doing: 
Provide customer service regarding billing/payment questions to internal and external customers.  Apply payments received from customers via multiple payment channels.  Change payment plans and deposit funds using automated software and conventional methods.  Complete daily balancing to ensure payments are processed accurately and completely.   

  

On any given day, you'll 

  • Provide customer service regarding billing/payment questions to internal and external customers via telephone, email, and letters. Submit payments on behalf of customers using payment processing applications. 
  • Apply payments from customers received via the lockbox, internet, interactive voice response, banking networks, or directly per department procedures. Change payment plans as appropriate and process direct-received payments using automated software and conventional methods.  Escalate payments received on cancelled policies and request policy reinstatement when appropriate. 
  • Reconcile daily receipts to source documentation and bank deposit reports. Research and provide explanations for reconciling items. 
  • Create, review, and resolve special messages within the billing system. 
  • Process address changes, complete billing and payment breakdowns, respond to credit history requests, reprint bills, and send paid receipts, as needed. 
  • Review, prioritize, and resolve billing activities within the billing system. 

  

Here's what we expect: 

  • Accounts receivable and/or billing experience preferred. 
  • Customer service experience is required. 

Education: 

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required. 
  • Associate's degree in a business-related field is preferred. 

  

Necessary Knowledge and Abilities: 

  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to interact with multiple departments and external customers. 
  • Must be detail-oriented and possess strong judgment and decision-making skills. 
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel. 
  • Ability to operate a calculator with speed and accuracy. 
  • Ability to investigate and resolve issues. 
  • Ability to work independently and with others. 
  • Must possess strong teamwork and collaboration skills. 
  • Must be able to multitask and prioritize job responsibilities.

BASIC PURPOSE:  Perform claim related administrative duties throughout the claim’s life cycle for all lines of business in multiple claims systems. Provide quality claim service within state requirements and corporate claim standards.  Duties my include, but are not limited to, intake of claims, claim financial transactions, claim data collection and entry, and various claim compliance tasks.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Triage and assign claims to Adjusters following the Line of Business segmentation guidelines and assignment rules.
  • Enter and confirm payments made are in line with the contracted services. Identify and escalate when invoicing is unusual or off budget.
  • Act as a subject matter expert to develop operational and compliance related procedures, standard work, and processes as requested.
  • Timely and accurately investigate, distribute and process misdirected electronic information and mail received from internal and external sources to the appropriate unit, individual, or company.
  • Monitor electronic queues and shared inboxes to ensure work is being performed within service levels and according to quality guidelines. Electronic queues may include those used with TPA (third-party administrators) integrations and payments.
  • Issue authorized and approved expense and loss payments in the claim system as instructed and document the electronic file as necessary ensuring payments are coded accurately.
  • Assist in the maintenance of multiple applications, systems, and portals to support the Claim Department.
  • Perform compliance related tasks as assigned to support compliance research, initiatives or the development of compliance job aids and guidelines.
  • Complete general administrative tasks and other work duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School diploma or equivalent is required. Office, clerical, computer and/or insurance classes are desirable.
  • Prior work experience in an Insurance, Customer service or office environment is preferred.
  • Proficient data entry skills.
  • Ability to process work using Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Must be self-motivated.
  • Possess a cooperative positive attitude.
  • Ability and willingness to answer phone calls from internal/external customers and deliver the required level of service and support.
  • Must use time management skills to manage work independently following established processes and guidelines.
  • Must be able to collaborate as part of a team.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

NOTE:    This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by this employee.  Employees may be requested to perform job‑related tasks other than those specifically presented in this job description.  The employer reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

The CM Group is made up of Church Mutual Insurance Company, S.I., CM Regent Insurance Company, CM Vantage Specialty Insurance Company and CM Select Insurance Company.

What you'll be doing:
In accordance with application of state and federal laws and company best practices, gather and review claim information, determine coverage, determine duty, and conduct liability investigations. Initiate and maintain contact with claim parties to provide updates and resolve issues timely. Update the claim system to document claim handling activities throughout the life of the claim. Determine, set, and maintain reserves and issue payments in line with a level of authority.  Review contracts and thoroughly investigate risk transfer possibilities.  Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.  Direct vendors and review reports to evaluate exposure.  Manage and direct counsel when litigation is involved.
 
On any given day, you'll:
  • Perform claim tasks timely and document claim files appropriately. Proactively manage claim activities to ensure fair claim resolution. Handle all claims in accordance with state and federal laws.
  • Make complex coverage decisions by gathering information necessary to make an informed decision in a fair, equitable, and ethical manner. Deny losses within authority level, providing detailed explanation, citing facts, and policy language.
  • Perform a thorough investigation based upon the type, complexity, and severity of the claim. Upon completion of the investigation, analyze and evaluate the potential exposure and damages, including potential full or partial liability and compensability denials. Formulate and document an action plan based on the covered damages and injuries.
  • Determine and set reserves based on the most probable outcome of the claim, within authority level. Evaluate and negotiate directly with insured, claimant, or claimant's attorney on all cases within authority level. Review claim facts and exposure with claims management, as appropriate, to guide claim strategy. Make complete, accurate, and timely payments within authority for covered losses. Refer claims above authority to appropriate team member for review and potential reassignment.
  • Maintain a professional, courteous, and helpful approach when communicating in-person, on the phone, or through email and other correspondence with internal and external customers, business partners and brokers.
  • Recognize when vendor partners are required on a claim, including experts, independent adjustors, nurses, defense attorneys, etc. Assign and direct vendors, as needed, to aid in the investigation and evaluation of the claim. Manage claim expense by concluding vendor assignment when vendor is no longer adding value to the claim.
  • Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.
  • Act as a resource to share knowledge and experience with other claim handlers. Assist and support their development with mentoring and auditing functions.
  • Negotiate settlements, attend mediations, attend settlement conferences, engage in various ADR opportunities.
 
Here's what we expect:
  • Minimum of seven years handling General Liability and/or Commercial Auto claims is required.
  • Three years of litigation management experience is preferred.
Education:
  • Bachelor's degree preferred. A combination of equivalent education and/or experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Additional training in insurance, medical, and/or building terminology knowledge is desirable.
  • Completion of INS, AIC, or CPCU is preferred.
Necessary Knowledge and Abilities:
  • Ability to obtain and maintain state adjusting license requirements and complete continuing education requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and manage workload timely.
  • Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of policy terminology and legal principles involving at least one or more of the following: insurance, automobile, medical and property claims.

BASIC PURPOSE:

 

Support the development, configuration, implementation, and maintenance of commercial property and casualty insurance products through a blend of insurance expertise, product analysis, and technology-enabled solutions. Partner with underwriting, actuarial, compliance, product, and technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into configured product solutions that support profitability, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and speed to market.

Conduct research, analysis, product configuration, testing, and implementation activities within Guidewire PolicyCenter and related policy administration systems. Leverage commercial insurance knowledge and technical capabilities to optimize product performance, streamline workflows, improve data quality, and support strategic business initiatives.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Lead insurance product initiatives through research, analysis, no/low-code configuration, testing, implementation, and post-production validation activities.
  • Apply a strong understanding of commercial property and casualty insurance products, underwriting workflows, and policy lifecycle processes to support product development and operational effectiveness.
  • Partner with underwriting, product, actuarial, compliance, and technology teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into configurable product solutions.
  • Configure and maintain commercial insurance products within Guidewire PolicyCenter’s no/low-code Advanced Product Designer application, including coverages, business rules, forms, workflows, and product attributes.
  • Support the development of business requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation that clearly communicate intended product behavior and system functionality.
  • Participate in testing activities, including functional testing, regression testing, product validation, rate verification, forms attachment testing, and integration testing.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve product configuration, workflow, system, and data issues in partnership with business and technology teams.
  • Conduct competitor analysis, market research, rate analysis, and filing analysis to support product recommendations and business strategy.
  • Support development, submission, implementation, and maintenance of state filings in partnership with product, compliance, and actuarial teams.
  • Analyze data relationships, system integrations, workflow impacts, and operational requirements to support product enhancements and business initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline business processes, improve data quality, optimize workflows, and increase operational efficiency across highly configurable systems.
  • Communicate project status, technical issues, timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and business impacts to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain underwriting protocols, product documentation, and no/low-code configuration standards supporting consistent business practices and regulatory compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or comparable industry experience may be considered with a high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • CPCU, ARM, ASLI, or evidence of continuing and progressive insurance education preferred.
  • Five years or more of commercial property and casualty insurance experience in underwriting, product development, product management, configuration, actuarial, underwriting administration, business analysis, or related functions.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance products, underwriting operations, policy administration processes, and policy lifecycle activities.
  • Experience configuring products within Guidewire PolicyCenter or similar no/low-code configurable policy administration systems preferred.
  • Understanding of configurable business rules, product structures, workflows, data relationships, system integrations, and policy administration technology.
  • Working knowledge of XML, JSON, query tools, data structures, integrations, or related technologies preferred.
  • Experience conducting market analysis, competitor analysis, rate analysis, product analysis, or filing analysis to support business recommendations and implementation decisions.
  • Understanding of modern product development methodologies including business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing, defect resolution, and implementation practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills supporting the ability to develop, test, implement, and support solutions for complex business, product, and system issues.
  • Strong listening, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Organized, analytical, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Professional office or home office environment.

Job.JobDescription:
What you'll do:
Identify training needs based on individual performance observations, quality assurance data, and department performance standards. Recommend formal training programs to provide knowledge, improve performance, and provide professional development of new and existing Service agents. Conduct training sessions for model office and any other training needs identified. Complete individual 1:1 mentoring and coaching sessions that address processes, procedures, workflow, and product. Work closely with leadership, Quality Analysts, Operations Analyst, Commercial Operations Specialist, and Learning & Development to identify skill deficiencies. Develop training and coaching plans for addressing the deficiencies in existing staff. Provide support to increase daily knowledge, performance improvement, and professional development.


PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Conduct needs assessments: identify training needs through surveys, on-the-job interactions with employees and from those needs identify training objectives for department processes and procedures.
• Deliver training Sessions: Facilitate training sessions in various formats, such as in person, webinars or virtual learning sessions.
• Collaborate with Commercial Operations leadership and Learning and Development to recommend, develop, and maintain formal training plans.

ROLE:

Lead business user acceptance testing (UAT) activities supporting the implementation of Guidewire PolicyCenter and related systems for commercial property and casualty insurance operations. This role serves as the primary coordinator between business and technology teams to ensure system functionality aligns with approved business requirements and operational needs.

The Guidewire UAT Lead is responsible for establishing the structure, governance, processes, and reporting necessary to successfully execute UAT activities across multiple products and business functions. This position works closely with underwriting, insurance product, technology product, quality assurance, and implementation teams to define requirements, develop testing strategies, manage testing execution, facilitate issue resolution, and ensure business readiness prior to production deployment. The role provides leadership and influence across cross-functional teams without direct supervisory authority.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead UAT strategy, planning, preparation, execution, and completion for Guidewire PolicyCenter and related integrations supporting commercial property and casualty insurance products.
  • Partner with underwriting, insurance product, technology product, business analysis, quality assurance, development, and implementation teams to establish UAT scope, schedules, resource requirements, entry and exit criteria, and business sign-off expectations.
  • Facilitate working sessions with underwriting and product subject matter experts to define and refine business requirements, workflows, referrals, product rules, and expected system behavior.
  • Translate approved business requirements into acceptance criteria, end-to-end business scenarios, test cases, test scripts, expected outcomes, and reusable regression testing assets.
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive UAT framework, including test inventories, traceability documentation, readiness assessments, tester assignments, schedules, execution tracking, and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate and lead business subject matter experts and UAT participants by assigning work, clarifying expectations, monitoring progress, and addressing resource constraints, dependencies, and testing gaps.
  • Coordinate test environments, system access, test data, integrations, documentation, and other prerequisites required to support successful testing execution.
  • Lead testing activities across policy lifecycle functions including submission, quote, underwriting, referral, rating, bind, issue, endorsement, renewal, cancellation, reinstatement, and associated integrated systems.
  • Validate configured workflows, screens, rating logic, product rules, documents, integrations, and migrated data to ensure compliance with approved business and operational requirements.
  • Document, assess, prioritize, track, and communicate defects, requirement gaps, and testing issues while coordinating appropriate resolution activities with business and technology teams.
  • Coordinate corrective actions, retesting, regression testing, and issue closure to ensure successful implementation outcomes.
  • Develop and communicate testing status, defect trends, risk assessments, readiness evaluations, dependencies, and recommendations to project stakeholders and leadership.
  • Facilitate business review and acceptance activities and support final business sign-off decisions based on testing outcomes, acceptance criteria, and residual risk evaluation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of UAT methodologies, testing standards, documentation practices, and governance processes to support future technology implementations.
  • Support organizational readiness by identifying operational impacts, process changes, and training considerations associated with new system functionality.
  • Build collaborative relationships across business and technology teams and provide leadership through influence, coordination, and effective communication.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; degree emphasis in insurance, risk management, information technology, business, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Five or more years of commercial property and casualty insurance experience in policy administration, business analysis, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, or a related discipline. Experience spanning underwriting, insurance product management, and technology product functions is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading business user acceptance testing efforts for complex enterprise system implementations, modernizations, or migrations.
  • Experience defining and documenting business requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, business scenarios, test scripts, expected results, and regression testing materials.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance operations and policy lifecycle processes.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into structured testing methodologies and repeatable test conditions.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and lead work across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and competing business needs in a fast-paced transformation environment.
  • Guidewire PolicyCenter experience strongly preferred. Experience with policy administration platforms, testing tools, defect management systems, agile delivery methodologies, and related insurance industry designations is preferred.
  • Advanced computer skills and the ability to learn and apply new technologies and tools.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Professional office environment.
  • Hybrid work arrangement with in-office days Tuesday through Thursday in Merrill, Madison, or Milwaukee.
  • Fully remote work may be considered for candidates outside commuting distance.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support project planning, testing activities, training, or implementation efforts.

Full-Cycle Recruiting

BASIC PURPOSE:

The Senior Network Engineer provides technical leadership for enterprise network infrastructure, driving architecture standards, design improvements, and alignment with business objectives. This role leads complex network design, implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization across routing, switching, security, cloud, and enterprise connectivity (voice, data, wireless, and collaboration), while ensuring high availability through proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and effective disaster recovery planning. The position also mentors junior engineers and requires deep cross-domain expertise with the ability to lead hands-on technical work and resolve complex incidents. Individuals unable to do so will not meet expectations.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, implement, and support complex enterprise network and communications solutions (voice, data, video, wireless)
  • Lead complex troubleshooting efforts and root cause analysis for network, voice, and collaboration incidents
  • Oversee network operations and lead response to high-impact incidents, ensuring timely resolution and service restoration
  • Guide incident triage and escalation efforts, contributing to improvements in response processes
  • Architect and optimize multi-domain network solutions across routing, switching, security, cloud, and unified communications
  • Analyze network performance data (telemetry, logs, packet captures, VoIP metrics) to identify trends and drive improvements
  • Lead implementation and integration of new technologies across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Support and enhance network architecture standards, configurations, and documentation practices
  • Drive capacity planning, performance tuning, and lifecycle management to ensure scalability and reliability
  • Partner with vendors and stakeholders to design, implement, and improve network and communication solutions
  • Lead infrastructure-related projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and architectural standards
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, supporting skill development and problem resolution
  • Support IT service management processes, disaster recovery planning, and continuous improvement initiatives

 

Level Expectations (Performance and Scope Indicators)

The following outlines how performance is evaluated at this level. These are not additional job responsibilities, but indicators of scope, autonomy, impact, and influence expected of this role.

Scope: Leads major initiatives, projects, and engineering workstreams across multiple domains. Serves as subject-matter expert for technical architecture, and ensures alignment with enterprise standards, investigation methodology, and enterprise tooling.

Autonomy: Operates with high autonomy. Makes technical decisions, designs solutions, and resolves complex issues. Escalates only when strategic trade-offs or cross-team impacts arise.

Impact: Shapes network and telecommunications capabilities across the entire organization. Defines engineering patterns, raises maturity levels, and drives large-scale improvements that reduce risk and improve operational efficiency.

People Influence: Mentors less experienced team members. Leads technical project teams. Provides input into workforce capability development. Influences Architecture, Infrastructure, and Operations as a subject matter expert.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Degree in Computer Science, Networking, Telecommunications, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent work experience;7-10+ years hands-on experience.
  • Proven leadership in Network Engineering and architecture.
  • Ability to design and maintain enterprise systems and automation workflows.
  • Advanced experience with Networking, Voice Technologies and Collaboration systems at engineering depth.
  • Ability to act as escalation point for complex, multi-vector incidents.
  • Expertise across endpoint, cloud, network, and data security domains.

Technical Competencies

  • Capability to evaluate and improve network and voice architecture.
  • Ability to drive technical initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination.
  • Design and Implementation experience in voice, data communications, contact center technologies, and video conferencing.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, H.323, and other VoIP protocols.
  • In-depth understanding of communication protocols and routing protocols.
  • Solid background in network administration and architecture.

Preferred

  • Cisco CCNA or CCNP or CCDP – Voice/Collaboration certification a plus.
  • Experience influencing enterprise architecture and leadership decision-making.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

❖ Office

  • Professional office environment. Regularly uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
  • Regularly required to communicate; sit; stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities – None
  • CM Group Office – Hybrid
