Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating – Northern Virginia
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Opportunities are available for Northern Virginia area.

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.  

  

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   

  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   

  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   

  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  

  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   

  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  

  • Construction Program or Construction or Mitigation Estimating desired.

  • Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  

  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.  

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.  

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.  

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.  

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.  

  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.  

  

Required Qualifications:  

  • Residency within Northern Virginia area is mandatory for this role.   

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof. 

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.  

  

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work. 

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job. 

  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.  

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

  

Sign On Bonus:   

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

  

Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

  

Allstate Benefits:  

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

We are seeking a Managing Engineer to lead high-performing software engineering teams responsible for building and modernizing enterprise applications that support Allstate's Roadside Services critical business operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role that includes active Java coding and technical contribution alongside people leadership. This leader will drive technical strategy, partner with product and business stakeholders, and foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering practices. You will develop engineering talent, contribute directly to the design and development of Java-based solutions, deliver scalable and reliable applications, and help shape the technical direction of key products and platforms.

The internal job title for this is role is Software Engineer-Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop software engineering teams, providing mentorship, career guidance, and ongoing performance feedback.
  • Remain hands-on with Java engineering by contributing production-quality code, reviewing code, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting technical delivery.
  • Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Security, and business leaders to translate strategic goals into technology solutions.
  • Guide teams through product discovery, planning, prioritization, and delivery activities within Agile environments.
  • Establish and evolve application architectures, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards.
  • Drive engineering excellence through modern development practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, and secure coding.
  • Ensure applications are scalable, secure, reliable, and effectively supported in production.
  • Remove technical and organizational obstacles, helping teams effectively execute against priorities and commitments.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen delivery, quality, and team effectiveness.
  • Foster collaboration across engineering teams to improve consistency, reusability, and organizational alignment.
  • Support workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and talent development activities.
  • Define and monitor key engineering metrics related to quality, delivery, reliability, and operational performance.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to technology and business stakeholders on software engineering best practices and emerging technologies.

Essential Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams delivering enterprise applications and services. (Or Equivalent)
  • Experience managing or leading software engineers in Agile development environments. (Or Equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to remain hands-on with coding while leading and developing an engineering team.
  • Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot development experience, including designing, coding, testing, and troubleshooting enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience with relational database technologies.
  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting applications in production with a focus on reliability, monitoring, and operational excellence.
  • Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience leading technical planning, estimation, prioritization, and execution activities.
  • Proven success attracting, developing, mentoring, and retaining engineering talent.

Job.JobTitle: Attack Surface Management Service Lead Consultant - Exposure Intelligence Team
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Role Scope: Attack Surface Management Service Lead Consultant – Exposure Intelligence

Allstate Job Profile & Family: Lead Consultant- Threat & Incident Response


Team and overall work scope

  • The team operates within a newly established Exposure Management function in the broader cybersecurity organization, focused on modernizing how the enterprise identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates security vulnerabilities shifting from traditional patch approaches to a more strategic focus on true business risk and exploitability
  • Individual Contributor/ Lead Consultant roles are designed to bring in deep respective domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, Databases & Data Stores, Applications, API's, Attack Surface Management etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies
  • The Lead Consultant – Attack Surface Management is the SME responsible for discovering, monitoring, and governing the enterprise's internet-facing attack surface, including unknown and unmanaged assets, external exposures, and third-party and subsidiary footprints. As the founding member of the capability, the role establishes ASM practices, applies CTEM principles to tie external findings to real attack paths, and partners with asset owners to drive remediation that measurably reduces exploitable exposure.

Success Measures

  • Expanded and validated coverage of the external attack surface, with fewer unknown or unowned internet-facing assets.
  • Reduced time from discovery of a new external exposure to an assigned owner and completed mitigation.
  • Higher signal quality in external findings, with fewer false positives and more accurate prioritization.

Key Responsibilities (Core + Domain)


Exposure Intelligence (Core)

  • Translate external attack surface findings into exposure intelligence and exploitability-based prioritization.
  • Identify attack paths that start from internet-facing assets, such as exposed services, misconfigurations, expired or weak certificates, and exposed admin interfaces.
  • Produce clear remediation guidance and partner with asset owners to validate closure.


Attack Surface Management (Domain)

  • Own SME coverage for external attack surface discovery and monitoring using EASM and scanning platforms (e.g., Censys, Qualys).
  • Establish asset governance practices, including attribution, ownership assignment, inventory reconciliation, and detection of shadow IT and orphaned assets.
  • Extend visibility to third-party, subsidiary, and cloud-hosted footprints, and partner with Penetration Testing, Product Security, and Exposure Response to operationalize findings.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in attack surface management, vulnerability management, security operations, or exposure management.
  • Strong understanding of internet-facing infrastructure, including DNS, IP space, certificates, cloud hosting, and common external misconfigurations.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into business risk and practical remediation actions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Censys or comparable EASM platforms, and with Qualys or similar vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Familiarity with asset inventory/CMDB processes, cloud provider connectors, and third-party risk practices.
  • Ability to build a new capability from the ground up, including processes, metrics, and stakeholder buy-in, as the first person in the function.

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Atlanta, GA
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Coordinated Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Coordinated Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will be handling escalated claims files involving complex contents damage to ensure our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these claims.

  • Handle escalated claims files involving complex contents damage.
  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.  
  • Use advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.  
  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair, and easy manner.  
  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.  
  • Coordinate with structure and ALE adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file. 
  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.  
  • If offered the role, you will go through virtual training.  You will receive ongoing support, mentoring and coaching as you develop your career.    

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.  
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.  
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.  
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.  
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.   

Schedule:  

  • Monday – Friday; 8 am - 5 pm.
  • This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need. As a result, you must be willing to work some weekend and extended hours if necessary.  

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Reside in Metro Atlanta, GA area.
  • 3+ years of previous experience handling property insurance claims preferred.
  • Have prior experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating.  
  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.  
  • You enjoy the ability to work independently in the field or from your home office.   
  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.   
  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Are known for clear and professional communication – both written and verbal. 

Required Qualifications:

  • Required to have a valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role. 

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.  
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job. 

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

  

  

Sign On Bonus:   

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.  


Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

   

Allstate Benefits:  

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit: www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

Core Engineering & Platforms (CEP) group is seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Lead Product Engineer for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to drive the development and adoption of enterprise-scale infrastructure automation capabilities. This role is responsible for designing, building, and productizing reusable infrastructure solutions that enable engineering teams to provision, manage, and operate infrastructure through code. The ideal candidate may have successfully launched large-scale IaC initiatives and can translate strategic objectives into practical, scalable engineering solutions.

As a technical acumen and practitioner, the candidate will establish engineering standards, build reusable modules and automation frameworks, implement CI/CD pipelines, and drive self-service infrastructure capabilities across the organization. Also, the candidate will collaborate closely with platform, server, security, networking, and application teams to transform infrastructure delivery from manual processes into a resilient, automated, and software-defined operating model.
  • Accountable for the enterprise Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, standards, governance, and adoption roadmap. 
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable infrastructure automation solutions across omni-hosted platforms. 
  • Build reusable modules, templates, blueprints, and self-service automation capabilities for infrastructure teams. 
  • Develop automation using Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, Puppet, Rundeck, Python, or related infrastructure automation technologies. 
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering and Specification-Driven Design practices to improve delivery speed, consistency, and automation quality. 
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, security controls, governance, and risk management within enterprise automation platforms. 
  • Design and develop APIs and integrations that enable infrastructure orchestration, provisioning, and platform services. 
  • Drive CI/CD, security, compliance, testing, and deployment automation for infrastructure delivery. 
  • Partner with platform product teams to accelerate IaC adoption and productize infrastructure capabilities. 
  • Create documentation, reference architectures, training materials, and enablement programs for IaC tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering best practices. 
  • Leverage cross-domain infrastructure knowledge spanning compute, networking, storage, security, identity, cloud, and infra services to deliver curated consumer-facing platform products and improve operational resilience. 

Job Qualifications 

  • Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code principles, patterns, and engineering practices. 
  • Experience with continuous collaborative pair programming to solve technical challenges. 
  • Strong experience building infrastructure automation solutions using tools such as Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, Env0, Puppet, or equivalent platforms. 
  • Demonstrated success establishing and scaling enterprise infrastructure automation initiatives. 
  • Strong software engineering mindset with emphasis on maintainability, testing, version control, and automation. 
  • Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments. 
  • Knowledge of Git-based development workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review practices. 
  • Experience building reusable modules, templates, and shared automation services. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, identity management, and platform services. 
  • Proven ability to influence engineering teams and drive adoption of technical standards. 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution. 

Nice to have Qualifications 

  • Experience integrating LLMs, MCPs, AI agents, Copilot technologies, or workflow automation platforms into infrastructure engineering solutions. 
  • Experience building AI-native infrastructure platforms that incorporate intelligent code generation, automated testing, policy validation, self-healing workflows, and predictive operational insights. 
  • Experience enabling self-service capabilities through platform engineering or developer platforms. 

Supervisory Responsibilities 

  • This role does not require supervisory duties. 

Experience

• 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Ansible (Software), Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering Practices, Infrastructure Automation, IT Infrastrcuture Project Management, Python (Programming Language), Solution Engineering, Strategic Collaborations, Technical Knowledge

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of security-focused products that protect enterprise data assets and deliver security-by-design capabilities that enable data discovery, governance, protection, compliance, and responsible data use across the enterprise. This role will own the lifecycle of critical security tools and platforms, utilized by the enterprise. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with a deep understanding of security principles, DevSecOps practices, and modern engineering workflows. Additionally, the candidate will leverage AI-driven capabilities to optimize workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance efficiency across security operations and product management processes. 

This role requires forward-thinking and strategic planning to anticipate future security needs, define measurable outcomes, and ensure products deliver long-term value. Success will be measured by risk reduction, improved data governance maturity, increased adoption of security controls, enhanced user experience and compliance adherence.

Job Description 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Define Product Strategy & Vision: Establish and communicate the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for security products aligned to enterprise risk posture and compliance requirements.  
  • Set Clear Outcomes: Define what success looks like for each product, including measurable KPIs.  
  • Plan for Scalability & Future Needs: Anticipate evolving security threats and compliance requirements. Design products that scale and adapt to future enterprise needs.  
  • Incorporate AI for Efficiency: Identify opportunities to integrate AI into daily workflows to automate repetitive tasks, improve decision-making, and maximize efficiency.   
  • Data Governance & Stewardship: Partner with business and technology stakeholders to enforce governance standards, data ownership models, stewardship processes, and policies that improve data quality, protection, and accountability across the enterprise. 
  • Manage Product Development: Collaborate with engineering and security teams to design and deliver secure-by-default capabilities integrated into developer workflows and experiences that support data discovery, classification, DLP, access governance and lifecycle management. Maintain backlog, write and groom user stories, and drive iterative releases using Agile methodologies.  
  • Enable Data-Driven Decisions: Define and monitor KPIs to measure adoption, effectiveness, and risk reduction. Leverage analytics and reporting to inform prioritization, validate assumptions, and optimize product outcomes. 
  • Stakeholder Communication: Lead product ceremonies and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to engineering leadership, security teams, and partners.  

 
Essential Skills 

  • Minimum of 5 years' experience conducting product scoping, discovery, framing, owning and managing a backlog (in agility or similar tools) of products for a digital product team.    
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience operating as a ‘coach’ partnering & mentoring early in trade product management peers across a broader technology organization. 
  • Strong understanding of security principles, secure SDLC practices, and the design of applications and platforms that enable data protection, governance, compliance, and risk management. 
  • Demonstrated ability to define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs), make data-driven decisions and plan strategically for long term product impact.  
  • Proven experience in Agile product delivery (backlog management, ceremonies, iterative releases)  
  • Understanding of modern software development practices, automation, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and security controls required to support data protection and governance outcomes. 

 
Desirable Skills 

  • Experience with data discovery, classification, labeling, DLP, DSPM, access governance, privacy, retention, and regulatory compliance initiatives. 
  • Understanding of modern data ecosystems including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure, AWS, GCP, SaaS platforms, data warehouses, and AI/ML environments. 
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CSSLP, CISSP, CCSP, CDMP, CIPM) or equivalent experience.  
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor) and ability to leverage them for productivity gains.

Job.JobTitle: Digital Product Manager Expert - Security Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of security-focused products that protect enterprise assets and enable secure-by-default development practices for the Product Security team. This role will own the lifecycle of critical security tools and platforms, utilized by the enterprise.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with a deep understanding of security principles, DevSecOps practices, and modern engineering workflows. Additionally, the candidate will leverage AI-driven capabilities to optimize workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance efficiency across security operations and product management processes. This role requires forward-thinking and strategic planning to anticipate future security needs, define measurable outcomes, and ensure products deliver long-term value. Success will be measured by risk reduction, improved developer experience, and compliance adherence.

Key responsibilities
 

  • Define Product Strategy & Vision: Establish and communicate the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for security products aligned to enterprise risk posture and compliance requirements. 
  • Set Clear Outcomes: Define what success looks like for each product, including measurable KPIs. 
  • Plan for Scalability & Future Needs: Anticipate evolving security threats and compliance requirements. Design products that scale and adapt to future enterprise needs. 
  • Incorporate AI for Efficiency: Identify opportunities to integrate AI into daily workflows to automate repetitive tasks, improve decision-making, and maximize efficiency.  
  • Manage Product Development: Collaborate with engineering and security teams to design and deliver secure-by-default capabilities integrated into developer workflows (IDE, CI/CD pipelines). Maintain backlog, write and groom user stories, and drive iterative releases using Agile methodologies. 
  • Enable Data-Driven Decisions: Define and monitor KPIs for success. Use analytics and risk reporting to validate assumptions and optimize adoption. 
  • Stakeholder Communication: Lead product ceremonies and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to engineering leadership, security teams, and partners. 

Essential Skills: 

  • A minimum of 5 years' experience conducting product scoping, discovery, framing, owning and managing a backlog (in agility or similar tools) of products for a digital product team. 
  • A minimum of 1 years’ experience operating as a ‘coach’, partnering & mentoring early in trade product management peers across a broader technology organization. 
  • Strong understanding of security principles, secure SDLC, and DevSecOps practices. 
  • Demonstrated ability to define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs), make datadriven decisions and plan strategically for long term product impact. 
  • Proven experience in Agile product delivery (backlog management, ceremonies, iterative releases) 
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, and automation in security workflows. 

 Desirable Skills: 

  • Familiarity with application security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA), secrets management (Vault/KMS), IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and PaaS; tools like Postman, Mural/Figma, Jira/Azure DevOps/VersionOne. 
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CSSLP, CISSP, CCSP) or equivalent experience. 
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor) and ability to leverage them for productivity gains. 

Supervisory Responsibilities: 

This job does not have supervisory duties.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment  while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

Job Description

We are seeking an Endpoint Security Engineer to join our team to help secure and manage enterprise endpoint protection technologies across a global environment. This role will serve as a key technical resource responsible for administering and enhancing endpoint security platforms including CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM).

The Endpoint Security Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, optimization, and support of enterprise endpoint security platforms. This role partners closely with Cyber Operations, Infrastructure, Desktop Engineering, and Identity teams to protect endpoints, improve detection capabilities, automate security processes, and strengthen the organization's overall security posture.


The ideal candidate combines strong operational security experience with modern engineering and automation skills. They have hands-on experience with EDR, firewall management, device control, API management, and endpoint security operations, along with a solid understanding of incident response and threat detection. Comfortable administering CrowdStrike and Microsoft security platforms, they leverage scripting, API integrations, GitHub-based workflows, and emerging AI-driven security technologies to automate processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen security outcomes. Curious, proactive, and innovative, they continuously seek opportunities to enhance the organization's cyber security capabilities through automation and continuous improvement.

The internal job title for this is role is Security Engineer Senior Consultant II.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Design, implement, and optimize endpoint security controls. 
  • Evaluate new endpoint security technologies. 
  • Develop security baselines and endpoint hardening standards. 
  • Provide technical guidance for endpoint-related security projects. 
  • Understand system security vulnerabilities and associated threats, and assess the overall security risks to the system 
  • Provide assistance to engineers to implement new security tools to feed our DevOps/SecOps processes, ensuring the solvency of computing resources 
  • Participate as an active member of Design & Build IT projects, steering configurations and services towards industry-leading security practices within domain expertise 
  • Work alongside Senior Security Engineers/Architects, and assist in Proof of Concepts and implementation of the security solution 
  • Assist with security and compliance-based projects involving cloud, operating systems, applications, and database and security issues and requirements 
  • Understand DevOps ideologies with the ability to drive and communicate change supporting DevOps/SecOps methodology within the organization 
  • Understand software installations, systems monitoring and troubleshooting, account management, and overall efforts to minimize system 

Essential Skills: 

  • 3 years or more of professional experience in cybersecurity, endpoint security, or security engineering. 
  • 1 year or more of professional experience administering Anti-Virus/Endpoint Detection Response solutions. 
  • Experience investigating security events and supporting incident response activities. 
  • 1 year or more of professional experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting languages. (Or Equivalent)
  • Experience working with APIs and automation workflows. 

Desirable Skills: 

  • Experience with privileged access management platforms. 
  • Familiarity with GitHub and version control best practices. 
  • Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) platforms. 
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel or other SIEM platforms. 
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted security operations or security copilots. 

Experience

  • 3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Adjuster, you'll be at the forefront of our claims process—meeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the same—whether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years’ experience in auto collision estimating using CCC One

  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates

  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert – you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 

  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 

  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver – you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 

  • The Recorder – Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track - In this role, you’ll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, you’ll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which we’ll train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role. To be eligible for this role, you must be in the following location: Boston, MA

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Please note, you may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjuster’s license

  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire

  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal

  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings: 

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan

  • Ayco financial coaching 

  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources

  • Paid parental leave

  • Adoption reimbursement 

  • Paid time off

  • Tuition reimbursement 

  • Wellness incentives

  • Learn more by visiting Allstategoodlife.com

Notes

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. May be required to perform other related duties as assigned. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this job. This position is not available for residents of Washington, California, Alaska, and Hawaii.

Job.JobTitle: Specialty Operations Claims (Property & Casualty Reinsurance) Senior Consultant II
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Specialty Operations Senior Consultant plays a critical role in shaping successful outcomes for highly complex reinsurance claims. In this position, you will lead the resolution and settlement of high exposure assumed reinsurance matters—including asbestos, pharmaceutical, toxic tort, environmental, sexual abuse and molestation, and other mass tort claims.
You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable Specialty Operations team where independent judgment, analytical skill, and strategic decision making are valued. This is an opportunity to influence meaningful outcomes, work with challenging and evolving legal issues, and contribute to our continued success within a highly specialized claims environment

Key Responsibilities:


• Independently manage a portfolio of complex reinsurance claims involving asbestos, environmental, and other latent injury exposures—analyzing liability, damages, and contractual obligations to drive informed and strategic claim outcomes.

• Interpret and apply facultative and treaty reinsurance contracts, as well as CGL, umbrella, and excess policies, to determine coverage, using underlying facts and relevant case law.
• Establish accurate case reserves, leveraging cedent reporting, internal assessment, and designated authority levels; seek management approval for exposures exceeding authority.
• Develop and execute action plans for the evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of reported claims.
• Maintain thorough and timely documentation, ensuring claim files reflect clear reasoning, compliance with internal guidelines, and proactive communication with management.
• Stay current on emerging legal trends, industry developments, and significant case law, applying this knowledge to enhance claims strategy and decision‑making.
• Serve as a corporate witness or representative in litigation, arbitration, and other dispute‑resolution settings when required.


Supervisory Responsibilities:


This position does not include supervisory responsibilities.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience:

• 5+ years of relevant experience preferred; 3+ years will be considered for strong candidates with demonstrated capability.


Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of reinsurance contracts, insurance coverage principles, claim processes, and relevant case law. This role focuses on Property & Casualty reinsurance.
• Proven experience evaluating and resolving complex bodily injury and property damage reinsurance claims involving mass‑tort exposures.
• Ability to collaborate effectively in both virtual and in‑person settings with internal teams, management, external cedents, and brokers.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and Copilot; aptitude for learning new technology and claims systems.
• Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well‑reasoned documentation.


Limited travel will be expected (approx. twice per year) to build team connections.


#LI-SP2

Skills

Claims Auditing, Claims Litigation, Claims Resolution, Claims Review, Insurance, Insurance Claims, Litigation, Mass Torts, Problem Resolution, Reinsurance, Reinsurance Administration, Time Management, Tort Claims, Toxic Torts

Compensation

Additional Job Description
Base compensation offered for this role is $80,000 -$125,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

*** Total compensation for this role is comprised of several factors, including the base compensation outlined above, plus incentive pay (i.e. commission, bonus, etc.) as applicable for the role.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Trial Attorney, Remote (Los Angeles, California)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and the Company! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll handle bodily injury, property damage lawsuits, and more, with mediations, arbitrations, and occasional trials. Beyond the courtroom, you'll provide vital counsel to business clients and coordinate between legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our strategies remain sharp. Embrace the excitement of constant challenges and victories in this dynamic role! 

Applicants must be licensed to practice in the state of California

Applicants can reside in the following states: CA, WA, AZ, NV, OR


This position is eligible for a $10,000 sign-on bonus, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Represents insured individuals and the Company in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation, and Allstate Financial cases. 
  • Prepares thoroughly for and conducts hearings, trials, arbitrations, mediations, and depositions. 
  • Prepares and presents pre- and post-trial motions effectively. 
  • Assists colleagues in resolving calendar conflicts in a collaborative manner. 
  • Offers counsel to business clients on day-to-day legal matters. 
  • Manages projects efficiently, fostering coordination and collaboration among legal teams. 
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law; identifies and summarizes relevant issues; collaborates with other areas of the Law and Regulation (L&R) department; provides proactive advice and counsel to business units on the impact of new laws; monitors legal representation. 

Education 

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the California State Bar required.

Minimum Requirements 

  • 4+ years of proven litigation experience or strong litigation-type skills, such as case strategy development, legal research, and advocacy, with the ability to manage complex disputes and work effectively under pressure. 
  • First or second chair jury trial experience
  • Proven experience with insurance defense is preferred. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, LexisNexis, and internet research. 
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants under the guidance of Lead Counsel. 
  • Capacity to manage a substantial case load. 
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and willing to travel throughout California for trials & court appearances on an as needed basis.

 
  

#LI-JA2 

Skills

Arbitration, Case Management, Depositions, Evidence Gathering, Litigation, Trial Experience

Compensation

Compensation for this role ranges from $150,000 to $170,800 annually, based on experience and qualifications, with an additional annual bonus opportunity.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Jackson, MS
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.  

  

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Qualifications:  

  • 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  
  • Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.  
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.  
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.  
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.  
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.  
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.  

  

Required Qualifications:  

  • Residency within 60 miles of Dallas, TX is mandatory for this role.   
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof. 
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.  

  

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work. 
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job. 
  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.  

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply. 

  

Sign On Bonus:   

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  


*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

  

Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

  

Allstate Benefits:  

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobDescription:

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

In this role, candidates must demonstrate a high level of adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment. Success requires the ability to manage multiple, diverse venues simultaneously, each with its own unique operational demands and stakeholder expectations.

As the claim owner, you are the primary point of contact for the customer for their claim. While others—such as field adjusters or repair shops—may assist with the claim, the insured will look to you for guidance throughout the process.

Excellent customer service is essential. For many customers, this may be their first experience filing a claim. It's your responsibility to support them through what can be a stressful situation by providing clear communication and empathetic guidance.

Additionally, the role involves close collaboration with internal partners to assess and drive value across initiatives. This cross-functional engagement is key to aligning strategic goals and delivering impactful outcomes.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific, Mountain or Central time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

The work schedule varies depending on your local time zone:

  • Pacific Time Zone: Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm PST
  • Mountain Time Zones: Monday–Friday, 8:00am –5:00pm MST
  • Central Time Zones: Monday–Friday, 8:00am –5:00pm CST

Job.JobTitle: Senior Trial Attorney, Remote (San Diego, CA)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and the Company! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll handle bodily injury, property damage lawsuits, and more, with mediations, arbitrations, and occasional trials. Beyond the courtroom, you'll provide vital counsel to business clients and coordinate between legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our strategies remain sharp. Embrace the excitement of constant challenges and victories in this dynamic role! 

Applicants must be licensed to practice in the state of California

Applicants must reside in the following states: CA, WA, AZ, NV, OR

This position is eligible for a $10,000 sign-on bonus, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Represents insured individuals and the Company in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation, and Allstate Financial cases. 
  • Prepares thoroughly for and conducts hearings, trials, arbitrations, mediations, and depositions. 
  • Prepares and presents pre- and post-trial motions effectively. 
  • Assists colleagues in resolving calendar conflicts in a collaborative manner. 
  • Offers counsel to business clients on day-to-day legal matters. 
  • Manages projects efficiently, fostering coordination and collaboration among legal teams. 
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law; identifies and summarizes relevant issues; collaborates with other areas of the Law and Regulation (L&R) department; provides proactive advice and counsel to business units on the impact of new laws; monitors legal representation. 

Education 

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the California State Bar required.

Minimum Requirements 

  • 4+ years of proven litigation experience or strong litigation-type skills, such as case strategy development, legal research, and advocacy, with the ability to manage complex disputes and work effectively under pressure. 
  • First or second chair jury trial experience
  • Proven experience with insurance defense is preferred. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, LexisNexis, and internet research. 
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants under the guidance of Lead Counsel. 
  • Capacity to manage a substantial case load. 
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and willing to travel throughout California for trials & court appearances on an as needed basis.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Subrogation Attorney, Remote (Los Angeles, CA)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Join Allstate's legal frontline and play a critical role in recovering losses and advancing strategic litigation outcomes. As a Senior Subrogation Attorney, you will lead complex auto and property subrogation matters from investigation through resolution, while providing legal guidance to claims partners and business stakeholders.   

This role offers the opportunity to independently manage sophisticated litigation, develop recovery strategies, conduct negotiations, and represent Allstate in court, arbitration, mediation, and trial proceedings. You will collaborate closely with legal and claims teams, provide thought leadership on subrogation matters, and contribute to meaningful financial and operational impact through successful recovery efforts. 

Applicants must be licensed to practice in the state of California 

Applicants must reside in the following states: CA, WA, AZ, NV, OR 

 

This position is eligible for a $10,000 sign-on bonus, subject to applicable terms and conditions. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Manage all aspects of complex auto and property subrogation litigation from investigation through resolution, including discovery, depositions, motion practice, negotiations, arbitrations, trials, and post-trial motions.  
  • Investigate and evaluate subrogation opportunities, determine liability and damages, and develop recovery strategies to maximize results.  
  • Lead negotiations with carriers, attorneys, and third parties to achieve favorable recovery outcomes and efficient dispute resolution.  
  • Review new file assignments, develop litigation strategies, and provide legal guidance aligned with business objectives.  
  • Partner with claims professionals and business stakeholders to provide legal counsel on litigation risks, recovery opportunities, and case strategy.  
  • Prepare and present witnesses, conduct depositions, and represent the Company in hearings, mediations, arbitrations, and trials.  
  • Analyze claims files, expert reports, legal authorities, and other case materials to support litigation strategy and recovery recommendations.  
  • Prepare and argue pre-trial and post-trial motions, settlement proceedings, and other complex legal matters.  
  • Monitor developments in applicable laws, regulations, and case law, providing proactive guidance on potential impacts to subrogation recoveries and litigation strategy.  
  • Manage a high-volume caseload and legal projects effectively while collaborating with attorneys, claims teams, and support staff to drive successful outcomes  

Education  


  • Juris Doctorate required.  
  • Active membership in good standing with the California State Bar required.  

Minimum Requirements  


  • 4+ years of litigation experience, including insurance defense, subrogation, personal injury, property damage litigation, or related practice areas.  
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage a substantial litigation caseload from inception through resolution.  
  • Experience conducting depositions, mediations, arbitrations, hearings, and other litigation proceedings.  
  • Strong knowledge of civil litigation procedures, legal strategy development, negotiation, and dispute resolution.  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, LexisNexis (preferred), and legal research platforms.  
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, claims professionals, and support staff.  
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and willing to travel throughout California for trials & court appearances on an as needed basis. 

Skills

Arbitration, Case Management, Court Appearances, Depositions, Litigation, Trial Practice

Compensation for this role ranges from $150,000 to $170,800 annually, based on experience and qualifications, with an additional annual bonus opportunity.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and the Company! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll handle bodily injury, property damage lawsuits, and more, with mediations, arbitrations, and occasional trials. Beyond the courtroom, you'll provide vital counsel to business clients and coordinate between legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our strategies remain sharp. Embrace the excitement of constant challenges and victories in this dynamic role!

Applicants must be licensed to practice in the state of California

Applicants must reside in the following states: CA, WA, AZ, NV, OR

This position is eligible for a $10,000 sign-on bonus, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Represents insured individuals and the Company in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation, and Allstate Financial cases. 
  • Prepares thoroughly for and conducts hearings, trials, arbitrations, mediations, and depositions. 
  • Prepares and presents pre- and post-trial motions effectively. 
  • Assists colleagues in resolving calendar conflicts in a collaborative manner. 
  • Offers counsel to business clients on day-to-day legal matters. 
  • Manages projects efficiently, fostering coordination and collaboration among legal teams. 
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law; identifies and summarizes relevant issues; collaborates with other areas of the Law and Regulation (L&R) department; provides proactive advice and counsel to business units on the impact of new laws; monitors legal representation. 

Education 

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the California State Bar required.

Minimum Requirements 

  • 4+ years of proven litigation experience or strong litigation-type skills, such as case strategy development, legal research, and advocacy, with the ability to manage complex disputes and work effectively under pressure. 
  • First or second chair jury trial experience
  • Proven experience with insurance defense is preferred. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, LexisNexis, and internet research. 
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants under the guidance of Lead Counsel. 
  • Capacity to manage a substantial case load. 
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and willing to travel throughout California for trials & court appearances on an as needed basis.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Dallas (East Metro), TX
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.  


Candidates residing in East Dallas, Mesquite, Garland, Rowlett, Rockwall, Forney, Terrell, and surrounding eastern Dallas metro communities are preferred.


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Qualifications:  

  • 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  
  • Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.  
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.  
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.  
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.  
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.  
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.  

  

Required Qualifications:  

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.   
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof. 
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.  

  

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work. 
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job. 
  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.
