At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Data Expert provides technical leadership in designing and delivering scalable, reliable, and well-governed enterprise data solutions. This role defines data architecture and engineering standards, solves complex data challenges, and drives modernization and engineering excellence across teams.

As a Data Expert, you will provide technical leadership in the design, engineering, governance, and evolution of enterprise data solutions. This role serves as a senior technical authority for complex data initiatives, translating business and analytical needs into scalable, secure, reliable, and well-governed data products.


You will lead the design of modern data architectures and engineering patterns, establish technical standards and best practices, and solve highly complex data problems spanning multiple systems and business domains. You will partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to modernize data platforms and create trusted, reusable data capabilities.


You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and drive continuous improvement in data architecture, engineering, governance, quality, observability, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities:


Data Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the architecture and design of complex, enterprise-scale data solutions across cloud, lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and analytical platforms.
  • Define scalable architectural patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, integration, consumption, and lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical direction for complex initiatives involving multiple applications, data domains, platforms, and engineering teams.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, interoperability, metadata, lineage, security, performance, and platform integration.
  • Lead technical design reviews and evaluate architectural trade-offs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex data architecture, engineering, integration, and production challenges.
  • Guide modernization of legacy data platforms and workloads using modern cloud and distributed data technologies.

Advanced Data Engineering

  • Design and lead implementation of highly scalable batch, streaming, and event-driven data processing solutions.
  • Develop complex data solutions using Python, PySpark, Scala, SQL, or comparable engineering languages.
  • Apply distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, or equivalent modern data frameworks.
  • Design reusable engineering frameworks and patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple data products and teams.
  • Design dimensional, relational, lakehouse, and domain-oriented data models appropriate for operational and analytical use cases.
  • Optimize distributed workloads, SQL queries, storage organization, partitioning strategies, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Establish advanced practices for automated testing, dependency management, orchestration, failure recovery, replay, and operational resilience.

Microsoft Fabric & Cloud Data Platforms

  • Provide technical leadership for modern data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Design scalable processing solutions using Fabric Notebooks, Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.
  • Define patterns for data organization, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and consumption within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Apply appropriate Azure and/or AWS cloud services to enterprise data architectures.
  • Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and determine where they can improve engineering productivity, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Engineering Excellence & DevOps

  • Define and promote software engineering standards for data development, including Git-based version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
  • Establish reusable development patterns, coding standards, testing strategies, and deployment practices.
  • Design observability strategies covering pipeline execution, data quality, dependencies, application health, performance, and failures.
  • Drive proactive monitoring and operational excellence using platforms such as Datadog or equivalent observability technologies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex production issues and drive solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Establish measurable engineering practices that improve reliability, maintainability, performance, and supportability.

Data Quality, Governance & Security

  • Define and implement enterprise-level practices for data quality, metadata management, lineage, retention, classification, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish automated data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and quality monitoring practices.
  • Partner with business owners, data custodians, governance teams, security teams, and architects to establish trusted and governed data products.
  • Ensure solutions align with applicable privacy, security, regulatory, retention, and enterprise data governance requirements.
  • Establish clear ownership and accountability for critical data elements and governed data products.
  • Design and communicate standards for documenting data sources, transformations, lineage, business rules, and downstream dependencies.

Technical Strategy & Innovation

  • Evaluate new data technologies, architectural patterns, and frameworks and recommend adoption where they provide measurable value.
  • Provide technical leadership for modernization initiatives and migration from legacy data ecosystems to modern cloud and lakehouse platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, improve development velocity, and increase reuse.
  • Apply generative AI and agentic AI tools and patterns where appropriate to improve data engineering productivity, metadata management, data quality, and operational processes.
  • Develop prototypes and reference implementations to validate emerging technologies and architecture patterns.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to translate complex business needs into long-term data capabilities.
  • Communicate complex technical topics, architectural decisions, risks, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Facilitate architectural and technical discussions across engineering, product, analytics, governance, and business teams.
  • Influence technical direction across multiple teams without direct supervisory authority.
  • Mentor engineers and help develop advanced engineering and architecture capabilities across the organization.
  • Create technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, and reusable implementation guidance.

Core Skills

  • Expert-level knowledge of data architecture, data engineering, distributed processing, data integration, and data modeling.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, Scala, SQL, or comparable languages used for large-scale data processing.
  • Advanced understanding of Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Strong knowledge of Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, distributed computing, batch processing, and streaming architectures.
  • Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of relational, dimensional, NoSQL, and distributed data modeling techniques.
  • Experience designing reusable frameworks and enterprise-scale data processing patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud architecture and data services within Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Advanced understanding of engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure/deployment automation, and release management.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog and designing operational monitoring for enterprise data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, privacy, and retention principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex distributed data and production problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and influence engineering standards across multiple teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate architecture and technical strategy to engineering teams, business partners, and senior leadership.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing large-scale solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data warehouse, ETL, or enterprise data processing environments into cloud/lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven data processing and orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with event-driven and real-time data architectures.
  • Experience establishing enterprise data engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or reference architectures.
  • Experience with data cataloging, lineage, governance, and observability capabilities.
  • Experience applying generative AI and agentic AI technologies to data engineering and operational use cases.
  • Experience leading architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and complex platform modernization efforts.

Experience

  • 10 or more years of relevant technology, data engineering, data architecture, or data platform experience (Preferred).
  • Significant experience designing and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership across large or cross-functional initiatives.

Job Description

Leads complex data and analytics initiatives that deliver trusted, secure, and scalable enterprise data capabilities. This role combines technical expertise, business knowledge, and cross-functional leadership to advance data strategy, governance, quality, modernization, and analytics across the enterprise.

The Data & Analytics Lead Consultant provides strategic and technical leadership to deliver enterprise data and analytics capabilities that support business goals and enable trusted, data-driven decision making. This role combines strong data and analytics expertise with business knowledge to lead complex initiatives, establish scalable solutions and standards, and foster collaboration across business, technology, analytics, and data governance teams.


The Lead Consultant will contribute to enterprise data strategy across Data Governance & Quality, Analytics Ecosystem, Master Data Management, and Data Information & Security, while helping modernize data platforms and engineering practices.


Key Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics Strategy

  • Lead complex, cross-functional data and analytics initiatives aligned with business and enterprise data strategies.
  • Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data, analytics, and technology solutions.
  • Contribute to functional strategy and define measurable success criteria for enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Develop frameworks, roadmaps, and implementation plans for strategic data initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how enterprise data is collected, integrated, managed, governed, and consumed.
  • Evaluate technical approaches and communicate recommendations, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to stakeholders.

Data Solutions & Modernization

  • Lead the design and delivery of scalable data solutions supporting analytical and business needs.
  • Provide technical guidance for data ingestion, transformation, integration, storage, modeling, and consumption.
  • Apply modern data technologies and frameworks such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Spark, Python/PySpark, SQL, Kafka, dbt, or equivalent technologies.
  • Support modernization of legacy data platforms and processes through cloud, lakehouse, and modern data engineering patterns.
  • Promote reusable patterns and standards that improve consistency, scalability, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
  • Ensure data solutions meet expectations for performance, reliability, security, and operational support.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish and promote practices that improve the reliability, consistency, accessibility, and quality of enterprise data.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to define data ownership, stewardship, metadata, lineage, and quality expectations.
  • Define and monitor data quality controls, validation rules, reconciliation processes, and key data quality metrics.
  • Help establish trusted and governed data sources that can be consistently reused across business and analytical applications.
  • Ensure appropriate data lifecycle, retention, privacy, and governance requirements are incorporated into data solutions.

Analytics Ecosystem

  • Enable the appropriate data, platforms, and capabilities needed to conduct analysis, inform decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with analytics, data engineering, product, and business teams to develop integrated analytical capabilities.
  • Promote consistent and reusable approaches to data modeling, data access, semantic definition, and analytics consumption.
  • Identify gaps in the analytics ecosystem and recommend improvements to platforms, processes, and capabilities.

Master Data Management

  • Support the development and adoption of trusted enterprise sources for key business data.
  • Establish processes and standards that improve the consistency, quality, and usability of shared data across business domains.
  • Partner with data owners, data custodians, technology teams, and business stakeholders to establish authoritative data definitions and ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce duplication and inconsistencies across enterprise data assets.

Data Information & Security

  • Partner with security, governance, and technology teams to protect enterprise data through appropriate security and access controls.
  • Ensure data solutions align with applicable privacy, security, regulatory, and enterprise requirements.
  • Incorporate security considerations into data architecture, integration, storage, and consumption designs.
  • Promote appropriate data classification and access practices throughout the data lifecycle.

Program Leadership & Enterprise Collaboration

  • Lead integrated, multi-track projects and initiatives, ensuring high-quality deliverables, effective risk management, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Develop project plans, establish controls, track performance, manage dependencies, and communicate risks and status.
  • Collaborate across business units and technology teams to resolve complex data and delivery challenges.
  • Foster enterprise-wide collaboration and alignment across data engineering, analytics, architecture, governance, security, and business teams.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business implications, capabilities, risks, and recommendations.
  • Communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Mentor team members and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of data and analytics best practices.

Core Skills

  • Strong knowledge of data and analytics strategy, data governance, data quality, data engineering, and analytics.
  • Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including lakehouse, data warehouse, batch and streaming processing, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Hands-on knowledge of technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Spark, Python/PySpark, SQL, or equivalent modern data technologies.
  • Experience with data modeling, data integration, metadata, lineage, master data management, and data quality practices.
  • Understanding of Microsoft Fabric capabilities including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, and Semantic Models.
  • Experience with modern software and data engineering practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex technical and business problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business capabilities and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration, facilitation, consulting, and written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data platforms and processes into cloud or lakehouse architectures.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, lineage, and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience with Master Data Management and enterprise data standardization.
  • Experience with data security, privacy, classification, and access-control practices.
  • Familiarity with generative and agentic AI capabilities and their application to data, analytics, and engineering productivity.

Experience

  • 7 or more years of relevant experience in data, analytics, technology, consulting, or related disciplines (Preferred).
  • Experience leading complex or cross-functional data and analytics initiatives (Preferred).

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As a Claims Resolution Adjuster, your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving bodily injury. In this role, you will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service. You will communicate with customers through voice calls, email, and text messages, and use innovative platforms and tools to negotiate fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific or Mountain time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


At Allstate, responsibilities may vary from day to day. We are looking for adaptable professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment, bring care and sound judgment to each claim, and are excited to make an impact.


  • The Customer Service Expert – You’ll support customers by caring, empowering, and restoring throughout the claims process. You will do this by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator – You’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator – You’ll use phone, email, and sometimes video chat to help customers through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also tailor your approach to claim handling by honoring the customer’s communication preferences and keeping them updated on claim progress.
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claim settlements with customers, vendors, third-party carriers, and claimants in accordance with legal and business standards. You will incorporate tactics for handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver – You’ll use multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimating tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, while applying strong critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder – You’ll help protect the company financially by following applicable policies and keeping a clear record of your work in the claims system. You’ll ensure timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 2+ years of claims experience, specifically with casualty bodily injury claims.
  • Claims investigation and negotiation experience preferred.
  • Experience with liability investigations, coverage investigations, property damage coverage, method of inspection, rental, and liability resolution preferred.
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

Work Location


This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States within one of the listed time zones above.


When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.


What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Work Schedule 

  • 8-hour shift Mon-Fri | 8:00am - 4:30pm with potential Saturday duty rotation. 

Licensing Requirements 

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment. 
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire. 
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment. 
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team. 
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements. 

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus. 
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits 

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. 
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement. 
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance. 
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role. 
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. 

Please Note: 

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions. 
  • This job description is not intended to include a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned. 
  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role.

The first approximately 8-12 of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Job.JobTitle: Claims Resolution Adjuster II - Remote - MST/PST
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As a Claims Resolution Adjuster II, your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles that result in property damage and/or bodily injury. In this role, you will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service. You will communicate with customers through voice calls, email, and text messages, and use innovative platforms and tools to negotiate fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific or Mountain time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


At Allstate, responsibilities may vary from day to day. We are looking for adaptable professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment, bring care and sound judgment to each claim, and are excited to make an impact. 


  • The Customer Service Expert – You’ll support customers by caring, empowering, and restoring throughout the claims process. You will do this by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – You’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – You’ll use phone, email, and sometimes video chat to help customers through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also tailor your approach to claim handling by honoring the customer’s communication preferences and keeping them updated on claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claim settlements with customers, vendors, third-party carriers, and claimants in accordance with legal and business standards. You will incorporate tactics for handling challenging and complex situations. 
  • The Problem Solver – You’ll use multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimating tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, while applying strong critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – You’ll help protect the company financially by following applicable policies and keeping a clear record of your work in the claims system. You’ll ensure timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim. 

Work Location


This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States within one of the listed time zones above.


When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.


What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Work Schedule 

  • 8-hour shift Mon-Fri | 8:00am - 4:30pm with potential Saturday duty rotation. 

Licensing Requirements

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment.
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire.
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment.
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team.
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements.

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus. 
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of claims adjusting experience determining liability.
  • Claims investigation and negotiation experience preferred.
  • Experience with liability investigations, coverage investigations, property damage coverage, method of inspection, rental, and liability resolution preferred.
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

Allstate Benefits

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement.
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role.
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Please Note

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions.
  • This job description is not intended to include a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role.

The first approximately 8-12 of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Job Description

As a Field Auto Adjuster, you will play a crucial role in our Auto claims handling process by writing estimates directly at customer homes, repair shops, or tow yards. Your job will involve a variety of customer/shop interactions, including face-to-face, virtual, and written communication, as you assess and finalize estimates. With a diverse range of workstreams, including repairable estimates, total loss assessments, and virtual inspections, you will enjoy a dynamic and engaging work environment.

You must live in/near the Greenville, SC area to be eligible for this role.

You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience.

The Customer Service Expert– you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
 
The Investigator– you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
 
The Effective Communicator– you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
 
The Negotiator– you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
 
The Problem Solver– you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
 
The Recorder– you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim. 

Preferred Qualifications:

•    This is not an entry level position. Candidates must have 18+ months of experience writing auto collision estimates using auto estimating programs such as CCC One, Audatex, or Mitchell. 
•   Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers.
•   Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates.
•   Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing.
•   Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively.
•   Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:
•   As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
•   If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:
You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Internal candidates and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.*

Allstate Benefits:
Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

•    Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
•    Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
•    Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
•    Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.


Notes:
The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. May be required to perform other related duties as assigned. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this job. Please note, you may be required to attend a 2-week training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

This position is not available for Puerto Rico, California, Alaska, and Hawaii residents.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:  

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention 
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals 
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth 
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales 
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives 
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition 
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations 

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?  

  • Day 1 Benefits  
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more 
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays 
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone 
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture 
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program 
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive 

Minimum Qualifications:  

  • 0 – 2 years of experience  
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.  
     
     

Skills

Active Learning, Active Listening, Business Rules, Communication, Cooperation, Customer Service, High Reliability, Professional Integrity, Sales, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour  
   
Total Compensation:  
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

Job Description

The Vended Application Senior Consultant II (Zscaler) serves as an experienced contributor for enterprise security platforms, with a primary focus on Zscaler technologies. This role is responsible for supporting, configuring, optimizing, and enhancing cloud-delivered security services that enable secure access to applications, data, and internet resources across the enterprise. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

• Develops and maintains the assigned market’s new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level & coach new TSM’s

• Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software

• Collaborates with Independent Agents to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

• Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages (based on state availability)

• Delivers on the business unit’s annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on SV & HH package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director

• Consults with IA’s by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position NGAAC products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

• Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

• Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan

• Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and UW trends filed and implemented in the market


Candidates must reside in the greater Bay Area (San Jose, San Francisco, Vallejo, Salinas)


Experience

• 3 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Consultative Selling, Insurance Products, Relationship Building, Strategic Collaboration, Territory Sales Management

Compensation

Base Salary: $85,000 - $90,000 plus incentives based on performance

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Louisville, KY
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Large Loss Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Preferred Qualifications:


  • 4-5 years’ previous experience as an outside property adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Reside within 40 miles of Louisville, KY
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

·         

Required Qualifications:


  • Must be able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

** Please note, you will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-DL1

Skills

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Insurance Claims, Multitasking, Organizing, Time Management, Working Independently, Xactimate

Base compensation offered for this role is $72,000-$115,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Critical Facilities Engineer is part of the Facility Operations team, responsible for performing preventative and ongoing maintenance of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments (e.g., data centers, medical facilities, laboratories, or utilities infrastructure). This role regularly inspects and monitors equipment and responds to abnormal operating conditions.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Acts as a consistent individual contributor and team member, providing influence, knowledge sharing, training, mentoring, and direction to other staff engineers and peers.
  • Applies expertise and knowledge to develop concepts, techniques, and process improvements.
  • Identifies and troubleshoots electrical, mechanical, plumbing and building related issues, resolving where able, in order to ensures data center uptime and project success.
  • Reviews major design modifications and upgrades to ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety, and operational standards.
  • Creates and reviews all mission-critical MOPs (Method of Procedures) and SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for accuracy, safety, and business impact assessment.
  • Collaborates with partner data centers.
     

Functional Skills:
Systems Knowledge

  • Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC (Heating, Venting, Air Conditioning, CRACs (Computer Room Air Conditioning), UPS (Uninterruptible Power Systems), ATS (Automatic Transfer Switches)
  • Data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments
  • Familiarity with Building Automation Systems/Building Control Systems (BAS or BCS), or Facility Management Control Systems (FMCS)
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, CAD (Computer-Aided Design), electrical and mechanical schematics
     

Process Knowledge

  • ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Change Management and ServiceNow Change Process
  • Familiarity with safety and risk management principles

Experience

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in critical facilities or related environments preferred
     

General Skills

  • Strong problem-solving abilities
  • Familiar with hand tools and power tools
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and email applications
     

Physical Requirements

  • Regularly required to stoop, kneel, bend, twist, crouch, and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Occasionally walk or work in:  uneven terrain or extreme climates
  • Responsible for safely moving and using ladders and elevated work platforms

Computer Skills

  • Proficient in operating computers and related equipment, troubleshooting technical issues, and using software applications including MS Office and internet-based tools

Location and Work Hours

  • Location: Rochelle, IL (fully on-site role)
  • Work Schedule: Second shift, Wednesday – Wednesday, from 3pm-1:30am, then 6 days off.  Occasional need to work other days or shifts to cover changes, PTO or emergencies.
  • Training Schedule: Position will be 1st shift hours for the first 3 months with the working hours being Mon-Fri from 7am-3:30pm

#LI-SP2


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Building Automation Systems, Critical Environments, Data Center Operations, Data Center Power, Electrical Management, HVAC Systems, Mission Critical Environments, Plumbing

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is $28.03-$39.42 hourly and is based on experience and qualifications.

*** Total compensation for this role is comprised of several factors, including the base compensation outlined above, plus incentive pay (i.e. commission, bonus, etc.) as applicable for the role.

Job.JobTitle: SIU Field Investigator - Oakland, CA - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

Put your investigative skills to work uncovering the facts behind complex insurance claims. As an SIU Field Investigator, you’ll conduct detailed investigations, analyze claim information, identify potential fraud indicators, and gather the information needed to reach well-supported conclusions. You’ll use critical thinking, effective interviewing, research, and analytical skills to connect details and resolve questions that may not have an obvious answer. Whether analyzing information or conducting investigative work in the field, you’ll play an important role in helping ensure claims are handled appropriately while protecting customers and the business from potential fraud.

We're looking for a SIU Field Investigator to join our team in Northern California. This is a field-based role within the SIU (Special Investigations Unit) Fraud Investigation Department, responsible for conducting in-depth fraud investigations related to insurance claims. The preferred candidate should be based in or around San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose, Sacramento, or the surrounding commuting areas, as they will be expected to service the broader region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both investigations and insurance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Enters SIU claim data information into multiple SIU systems
  • Reviews investigations with fraud outcomes to validate whether denial is appropriate
  • Updates files with investigation outcome, and when no fraud or insufficient evidence is found, returns file to market claim office for further handling and settlement
  • Conducts complex online data application searches, research, and evaluation
  • Conducts complex site inspections, including body shops, medical clinics, loss locations etc.
  • Conducts thorough investigations of complex that are potentially fraudulent to determine if payment is warranted, including scene investigations and surveillance as needed
  • Validates that the information provided and obtained through investigation is true and accurate and follows up on all possible leads
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process
  • Utilizes analytic tools or SIU field intelligence to identify complex claims for investigation and/or for support in the evidence of the fraud and damages
  • Researches and responds to complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, Documentations, Evidence Gathering, Fraud Investigations, Insurance Claims Investigations, Interviewing, Investigative Skills, Problem Analysis, Special Investigations, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is:

SIU Consultant I: $60,000 - $87,400
SIU Consultant II: $62,100 - $92,700 

And is based on experience and qualifications. Total compensation for this role is comprised of several factors, including the base compensation outlined above, plus incentive pay (i.e. commission, bonus, etc.) if applicable for the role.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

Put your analytical skills and claims expertise to work as an Auto Field Adjuster with National General, an Allstate Company. In this role, you’ll evaluate first- and third-party material damage claims, develop comprehensive damage estimates, and guide claims toward appropriate resolution. You’ll apply your knowledge of regulatory requirements, fair claims practices, policy coverage, and estimating fundamentals while building trusted relationships with internal and external customers. From negotiating settlements to documenting claim activity and making payments within your authority, you’ll take meaningful ownership of the claims process and help deliver thoughtful, well-supported outcomes.

Where You’ll Work:

This is a field-based position supporting customers throughout Little Rock and surrounding areas in Arkansas. Candidates must live within reasonable proximity to the assigned territory and be comfortable with regular local travel to support customers and complete in-person claim inspections.


We are seeking an Auto Field Adjuster to join our team in the Little Rock, AR region. In this field-based role, you will assess vehicle damage, prepare estimates, and guide customers through the claims process.

About Law & Regulations
The Law & Regulations organization provides strategic legal and compliance services that protect the company and its customers while ensuring adherence to evolving legal, regulatory, privacy, and ethical standards. Position Summary
We are seeking an accomplished and highly motivated Software Engineer (Java/Full Stack) to join the Law & Regulations Technology team. This position is responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of enterprise applications that enable legal operations, matter and document management, compliance initiatives, and business process automation.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong full stack development expertise and hands-on proficiency in React, Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud technologies, APIs, and event-driven architectures. This individual will collaborate with cross-functional partners across Legal, Compliance, Product Management, Architecture, Data Engineering, and other business functions to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions.
This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the modernization of enterprise legal technology while working with contemporary cloud-native platforms and engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise-grade applications across the technology stack.
  • Build modern, responsive, and scalable web applications using React and modern UI frameworks.
  • Develop secure, high-performing backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following software engineering best practices.
  • Participate in application modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

Legal Technology and Matter Management Solutions

  • Develop and support Matter Management, Legal Operations, and Document Management solutions.
  • Build integrations between legal platforms, claims systems, document repositories, and enterprise applications.
  • Implement workflow-driven solutions supporting legal intake, matter lifecycle management, document processing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support litigation, claims management, legal reporting, and operational processes through technology solutions.

Backend and API Development

  • Design and develop cloud-native microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful architectures.
  • Build scalable APIs and enterprise integrations supporting business-critical applications.
  • Develop event-driven solutions utilizing technologies such as Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security controls aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and availability.

Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and microservices.
  • Create reusable UI components and implement modern design patterns.
  • Improve usability, accessibility, and overall user experience.

Database and Data Management

  • Design and support solutions utilizing MongoDB, SQL Server, Oracle, and document-based databases.
  • Develop and maintain relational and NoSQL data models.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, performance, and scalability across applications.

Cloud and DevOps

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and deployment automation.
  • Support cloud-native application deployment and operations.
  • Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Participate in Azure and AWS cloud environments.
  • Support monitoring, alerting, logging, observability, and incident management activities.
  • Perform production support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Engineering teams.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support testing, releases, upgrades, and post-production activities.
  • Contribute to peer code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 3-5 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer.
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise applications and integrations.
  • Experience with distributed messaging platforms such as Kafka or Azure Service Bus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native application development principles.
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and application security.

Cloud and Platform Experience

  • Experience developing and deploying applications in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Experience building and supporting cloud-native, containerized applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, and similar automation platforms.
  • Experience supporting production environments through monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational excellence practices.

Preferred Domain Experience

  • Experience with Matter Management, Legal Operations, Case Management, Claims Systems, or Document Management platforms.

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented, Complex/Severe - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job.

As a Represented Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury on complex/severe claims. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Qualifications:


  • 3+ years of Casualty Represented complex/severe claim handling experience.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: Ohio, Michigan, Indiana.
  • Candidates in the Central and Eastern time zones preferred.

Training:


The first approximately [six-nine weeks] of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

 

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply. 

Sign-On Bonus Information:


  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus. 
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.

Job.JobTitle: Field Property Adjuster - Naperville, IL - National General
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Outside Property Consultant investigates and confirms the facts of loss for advanced homeowner claims. The role determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. The position creates or audits a comprehensive estimate of damages for first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition.

We are seeking an experienced Property Field Adjuster to support the Illinois suburbs, primarily covering Kane and Cook Counties, with coverage extending into DuPage County as needed. This team supports our premier clients and is looking for a seasoned professional who brings strong communication, customer service, and property claims expertise. In this role, you will handle a variety of property claims, including water-related losses, roof claims, and interior losses, many of which may be high-value and complex in nature.

Key Responsibilities

  • Possesses a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company
  • Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on first party homeowner losses with complexity
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers across multiple lines
  • Evaluates settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices and makes decisions on best option
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.


Sign On Bonus:

You’ll manage claims from initial investigation through resolution, conducting field inspections, evaluating damages, reviewing applicable coverage, developing repair estimates, and working with customers and other involved parties to reach timely and accurate claim outcomes. This role combines independent field work, critical thinking, technical expertise, and strong customer service. You’ll manage an assigned territory and workload while documenting claim activity, communicating throughout the claims process, and making sound decisions in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

We're hiring a Field Property Adjuster based near Worcester, Northborough or Natick, Massachusetts. You'll manage property claims from inspection through resolution, including estimating damage, reviewing supplements, handling contents losses, and supporting customers throughout the claims process.

The ideal candidate has property claims experience, strong customer service and organizational skills, proficiency in Xactimate, and an active adjuster license (or the ability to obtain one). Experience handling claims both in the field and virtually is preferred.
