Job.JobTitle: Software Engineer Senior or Lead Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Software Engineer, Sr Consultant II to Lead Consultant, implement applications following 12-factor principles to build out the product and iterative enhancements. They own the full stack of software products; developing and implementing frontends (web or mobile), and backend services. They leverage test driven development and continuous integration to ensure agility and quality of products. They actively participate in the decision-making process of the team ensuring that the simplest appropriate technology and design is chosen to meet user needs.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Engineering (Primary Focus) 

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java backend services using Spring Boot or similar frameworks. 
  • Build APIs and services OAuth backed by SQL-based relational data stores. 
  • Apply modern engineering practices to ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
  • Write clean, testable, and production-ready code using automated testing practices. 
  • Make thoughtful design decisions with a focus on simplicity and long-term supportability. 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across applications, containers, and basic networking layers. 

Platform & Delivery 

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines supporting continuous integration and deployment. 
  • Deploy and operate services in containerized environments, including Kubernetes. 
  • Support applications in lower and production environments. 
  • Participate in improving observability, resiliency, and operational practices. 

Frontend (Supporting Contribution) 

  • Contribute to frontend code when needed, primarily using React. 
  • Read, debug, and make small enhancements to frontend components. 
  • Frontend expertise is considered a supporting skill and is not required. 

Collaboration & Communication 

  • Participate in standups, planning sessions, retrospectives, and design discussions. 
  • Communicate technical concepts, design decisions, and tradeoffs clearly. 
  • Ask clarifying questions when requirements or expectations are unclear. 
  • Collaborate through code reviews, pairing, and technical discussions. 

AI & Emerging Technologies 

  • Demonstrate interest in modern AI system design and emerging technologies. 
  • Exposure to model orchestration, agent-based workflows, or multi-agent patterns is a plus. 
  • Participate in exploration or prototyping of AI-assisted tools where appropriate. 
  • Stay informed about how AI can enhance developer productivity and product capabilities. 

 

Essential Skills


Levels Considered: Senior Consultant II: 3+ years | Lead Consultant: 5+ years


  • 3+ years (Senior Consultant II) or 5+ years (Lead Consultant) of professional experience building backend systems using Java.
  • Proven ability to develop backend services using Spring Boot or similar Java frameworks.
  • Demonstrated proficiency building and integrating APIs, including services using OAuth.
  • Hands-on knowledge of SQL and relational databases supporting backend applications and services.
  • Strong knowledge of automated testing practices and development of clean, testable, production-ready code.
  • Practical understanding of CI/CD pipelines, continuous integration and deployment practices, and version control.
  • Working knowledge of containerized application deployment and support, including Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues across applications, containers, and basic networking layers.
  • Applied knowledge of scalability, reliability, resiliency, maintainability, and observability practices for backend services.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively through code reviews, pairing, technical discussions, planning, and design sessions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, design decisions, and tradeoffs clearly in meetings, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Solid familiarity with modern AI systems and AI-assisted development tools, including exposure to model orchestration, agent-based workflows, or multi-agent patterns.
  • Foundational knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 

Desirable Qualifications


  • Solid development expertise with frontend technologies such as React or Angular, including the ability to read, debug, and enhance frontend components.
  • Broad exposure across multiple cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Demonstrated capability supporting applications in production environments.
  • Familiarity working within product-driven or consulting-style teams.

Supervisory Responsibilities


  • This job does not have supervisory duties

#LI_NJ1

Skills

Angular, Angular, API Integration, Application Deployment, Application Programming Interface (API), Automated Testing, Back-End Development, Backend Systems, Cloud Platform, Code Reviews, Collaboration, Communication, Computer Science, Containerized Application, Continuous Integrations, Debugging, Java (Programming Language), Java Frameworks, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, Problem Resolution, Software Development, Spring Boot, Technical Discussion, Troubleshooting {+ 2 more}

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 90,700.00 - 153,925.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

This position is for a Project and Program Management Expert on the Claims Strategy team.

The Claims Strategy team drives clarity, alignment and execution throughout Claims. We serve as the connective tissue across the organization, translating strategy into action, aligning leaders around priorities and orchestrating complex work to enable stronger decisions and business results. We operate with clarity, discipline, accountability and a commitment to outcomes. Success is measured not only by the value we create for the business, but also by how we foster a positive team culture that develops talent through meaningful experiences, broad exposure, and enterprise-level work, preparing team members for future leadership opportunities across Claims and Allstate.

As an Expert, you will partner across Claims and the enterprise to navigate complex priorities, influence decisions, connect teams, and ensure strategic initiatives deliver measurable value.

Key Responsibilities

• Demonstrates mastery of best practices in project management and communication processes and contributes to the improvement of these processes at Allstate 

  • Drives agenda and facilitates projects/program steering committee meetings; delivers project communication and issues in an easily understood simplified style to any audience 
  • Drives achievement of enterprise level projects/program success factors 
  • Trains project management techniques and leads by example in raising the level of performance 
  • Takes the lead role in highly pressurized situations when there is a need to communicate critical project information while remaining 
  • sensitive to organizational politics 
  • Leverages organizational dynamics to influence outcomes through leadership and communication skills 
  • Demonstrates thought leadership and strong business acumen in solving complex problems, leveraging data and insights to develop recommendations and effectively influence senior leadership. 
  • Drives project execution. Provides direction and oversight throughout project lifecycle to project team to meet applicable business 
  • requirements 
  • Represents the projects/program and its objectives in all governance and gating forums 
  • Customizes solutions for complex issues typically involving enterprise-level considerations 
  • Works autonomously to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem identification through execution, using sound judgment to determine priorities, next steps, and appropriate stakeholder engagement. 
  • Leverages data and analytics to identify trends, develop actionable insights, measure outcomes, and translate complex information into clear recommendations that support business and strategic decisions. 
  • Builds and maintains strong relationships across a broad network of business partners and key stakeholders, effectively navigating competing priorities and driving alignment toward shared outcomes. 
  • Synthesizes information from multiple sources to identify themes, risks, dependencies, and opportunities, translating findings into concise, executive-ready recommendations and action plans. 
  • Proactively identifies risks, barriers, and emerging business needs and develops solutions with limited direction, escalating appropriately when leadership decisions or intervention are required. 

Education

• 4 year Bachelors Degree (Preferred)


Experience

• 7 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


Education & Experience (in lieu)

• In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Skills

Leading Project Teams, Project Communications Management, Project Implementations, Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC), Project Planning

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment  while making a difference, then apply to join our team today! 

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique? 

  • Day 1 Benefits 
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • 0 – 2 years of experience 
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

#LI-RR1

Skills

Active Learning, Adaptability, Business Integrity, Customer Service, Persuasion, Sales, Social Orientation, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour
 
Total Compensation: 
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

National General Holdings Corp., a member of the Allstate family of companies, is headquartered in New York City. National General traces its roots to 1939, has a financial strength rating of A– (excellent) from A.M. Best, and provides personal and commercial automobile, homeowners, umbrella, recreational vehicle, motorcycle, supplemental health, and other niche insurance products. We are a specialty personal lines insurance holding company. Through our subsidiaries, we provide a variety of insurance products, including personal and commercial automobile, homeowners, umbrella, recreational vehicle, supplemental health, lender-placed and other niche insurance products.

Companies & Partners

Direct General Auto & Life, Personal Express Insurance, Century-National Insurance, ABC Insurance Agencies, NatGen Preferred, NatGen Premier, Seattle Specialty, National General Lender Services, ARS, RAC Insurance Partners, Mountain Valley Indemnity, New Jersey Skylands, Adirondack Insurance Exchange, VelaPoint, Quotit, HealthCompare, AHCP, NHIC, Healthcare Solutions Team, North Star Marketing, Euro Accident.

Benefits

National General Holdings Corp. is an Equal Opportunity (EO) employer – Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of any characteristic protected by law. Candidates must possess authorization to work in the United States, as it is not our practice to sponsor individuals for work visas. In the event you need assistance or accommodation in completing your online application, please contact NGIC main office by phone at (336) 435-2000.

Allstate provides a comprehensive technology setup, including a laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse. Employees eligible to work from home also receive a monthly connectivity reimbursement to help offset internet costs.

When working from home, you must have a dedicated, private workspace free from distractions, along with appropriate desk and seating. Reliable internet is required, with minimum speeds of 50 MB download and 5 MB upload.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

This role will focus on setting the strategy and working through initial implementation for how we think of public cloud, private offerings on prem, infrastructure as it relates to GPU farms and AI use cases, mainframe modernization and platform capabilities implemented consistently across infrastructure solutions.  Leveraging open source will be critical to the roll out of our fully realized hybrid infrastructure model which will require this leader to have deep ties into the open-source community such that we are active contributors, leaders and consumers of open-source solutions.  This role will set direction for multiple product teams to ensure Allstate’s scaled delivery in this space is cohesive and driving towards homogeneity in technologies and simplicity in usage.

As a Director you won’t just deliver results – you drive our culture and shared purpose. You can work remotely and will commute to a nearby office and/or travel for meaningful connection opportunities.

Job Summary

The Principal Platform Consultant has accountability for leading the discovery and delivery of innovative technical solutions that enable business outcomes in compliance with enterprise target state architectures. The incumbent has direct leadership over critical groups with significant Allstate technology responsibilities. Directs groups that are more heavily resourced with more senior staff and are responsible for more technically complex or strategically important parts of Allstate’s technology. The Principal Platform Consultant is expected to build relationships throughout the organization to ensure whole-company alignment support Allstate technologies. They apply a systematic application of scientific and technological knowledge, methods, and experience to lead in the design, implementation, testing, and documentation of software. They own and manage the running of Allstate technology applications in production and ultimately are accountable for the success of Allstate technologies that include digital products through achieving KPIs. The Director leads an outcome-based delivery organization, highly matrixed, and globally dispersed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Frequently advise others on complex engineering matters.  
  • Integrate business plans by building foundation to translate strategy into challenging and meaningful goals.
  • Accountable for leading the evolution of scalable strategic visions.
  • Achieving organization financial targets and ensuring viability of decisions are financially grounded.
  • Achieves results through the management of teams that are responsible for strategic and critical pieces of architecture or provide functions that are of key strategic value to the business.
  • Act as an authority in software best practices and be relied upon to propagate these in the broader organization, beyond their individual team.
  • Accountable for leading the solutioning and technology implementations of outcomes driven by enterprise commitments and strategic roadmaps.
  • Determines and establishes and leverages strong/trust-based relationships across technology, product stakeholders, vendors, and other partner organizations.
  • Integrate by leading cross-shore product teams to deliver modern technology solutions that enable business opportunities and/or solve problems. 


Education

  • 4 year Bachelors Degree (Required)


Experience

  • 12 or more years of experience (Preferred).
  • Expertise defining enterprise hybrid infrastructure strategies spanning public cloud, private cloud, on-premises, and mainframe environments.
  • Ability to translate technology strategy into reference architectures, engineering standards, roadmaps, guardrails, and investment priorities.
  • Experience establishing enterprise platform capabilities, reusable services, and developer self-service models.
  • Experience adopting, contributing to, and influencing open-source technologies and communities


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job has supervisory duties.


Education & Experience (in lieu)

  • In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.


Skills and Capabilities

  • People Leadership & Talent Development: Track record of building, developing, and leading high‑performing large organizations; establishes clear decision rights, accountability, and operating cadence while developing future leaders and succession pipelines.
  • Operational Expertise: Brings strong operational expertise, with a proven ability to optimize processes, drive execution against strategic outcomes, and deliver consistent, high-quality results across complex environments.
  • Strategic Thinking & Innovation: Demonstrates strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex business challenges, identify innovative solutions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Applies forward-looking insights and analytical rigor to optimize processes, enhance performance, and support long-term organizational objectives.
  • Business Acumen & Analytical Rigor: Advanced business acumen with strong analytical skills; uses data, insights, and technology fluency to inform decisions and foster a culture of disciplined execution.
  • Innovation & Process Orientation: Natural process innovator with strong learning agility and a continuous‑improvement mindset.
  • Influence: Proven capability to successfully influence decision-makers and collaborators at all levels - upward, downward, and laterally.  Able to build alignment, negotiate effectively, and drive outcomes without relying solely on positional authority.
  • Change Leadership: Proven ability to lead large, multi‑location teams through significant changes, including business transformations, systems implementations, and organizational integrations.

Skills

Change Management, Cloud Architectures, Executive Communications, Infrastructure Modernization, Open Source Development, People Leadership

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 211,000.00 - 290,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As AI explodes in use cases it drives a parabolic increase in the amount of safeguarding required to leverage the technologies with integrity. This role will have to partner closely with the delivery organizations leveraging agentic solutions to ensure the appropriate safeguarding and controls are in place. This organization builds product alongside delivery teams to ensure adoption of controls is organic with the way digital product teams deliver solutions on behalf of our customers. Focal areas in this space navigate around use cases for frontier models like identifying toxic combinations of vulnerabilities that could pose imminent threat, the ability to automatically remediate those vulnerabilities, how we leverage open weight models, the way we want to scrutinize token consumption, building of small language models, and even recommending which models to use in which situations. The role will continue to evolve as agentic solutions evolve, so this role must be focused on emerging trends and have the ability to shape the organization as the industry changes. As a Principal Engineer, this role will have leadership for all engineered solutions for how we think of AI based control implementation across the enterprise.

As a Director, you won’t just deliver results – you drive our culture and shared purpose. You can work remotely and will commute to a nearby office and/or travel for meaningful connection opportunities.

Job.JobTitle: Inside Auto Claims Adjuster - Hybrid (Nashville, TN)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

Work Location & Schedule



During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:45pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Hours: Monday–Friday between 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM, with occasional Saturday 
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid schedule – 3 days in office (Tuesday-Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday) 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjuster’s license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal.
  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state.
  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

What You Need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What Allstate Provides:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, mouse). 
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset a portion of your internet costs.

Allstate Benefits: 

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our benefits:  

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan 
  • Ayco financial coaching 
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources 
  • Paid parental leave 
  • Adoption reimbursement 
  • Paid time off 
  • Tuition reimbursement 
  • Wellness incentives 
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities 

Skills

Auto Insurance Claims, Communication, Liability Analysis, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is $50,000-$60,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.
 

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Director, Detection & Threat Response is the enterprise’s senior leader for intelligence-led detection and response. The role is accountable for how Allstate anticipates, finds, and stops adversaries before they affect customers, data, or operations. This leader sets the strategic direction for three global functions: D&R Engineering & Automation, Threat Intelligence, and Threat Hunting. The goal is to unite them into one system in which intelligence sets priorities, hunting tests those priorities against the environment, detections are engineered and shipped as code, and response runs at machine speed under clear governance.

As a Director, you won’t just deliver results – you drive our culture and shared purpose. You can work remotely and will commute to a nearby office and/or travel for meaningful connection opportunities.

Imagine this.

  • 7:02 a.m. A new intelligence report describes an MFA-bypass technique being used against financial services firms. Within two minutes it is scored against Allstate’s priority intelligence requirements and flagged as relevant, and an automated hunt launches across identity and email telemetry.
  • 7:09 a.m. The hunt gets a hit: one account shows the technique’s pattern. An AI agent opens the investigation immediately, pulls identity and device context, runs the pivots a senior analyst would run, and reaches a high-confidence verdict with a full evidence trail.
  • 7:11 a.m. Contained. The verdict meets the bar for a pre-approved, reversible response, so the system acts on its own: active sessions revoked, credentials reset, account temporarily locked. Nine minutes from first intelligence to containment.
  • 7:16 a.m. An analyst reviews the evidence and the actions taken, confirms the call, and reaches out to the employee. Humans stay accountable for every automated action, without being the bottleneck for it.
  • 8:02 a.m. An AI-drafted detection for the technique is waiting in an engineer’s review queue. It uses the real attack telemetry from the hunt as its test case, and has been backtested against 30 days of history for false positives. It arrives linked to the intelligence that prompted it, the attack path it closes, and its expected alert volume. The engineer approves it and the pipeline promotes it. Next time, nobody has to go hunting. It fires on its own.

Now imagine you lead the teams that made that possible. Your intelligence team set the priority. Your hunters tested it against our environment. Your engineers built the automation that contained it in minutes and the pipeline that turned it into durable coverage within the hour. And you know it worked because you inspected the data, not because someone said so.

That’s the job, and it’s what we’re building at Allstate.

What we’re building

Allstate is building a Cyber Response organization designed for the speed of AI-enabled threats. The work underway is the kind most security teams are still only talking about:

  • An AI-assisted detection-as-code pipeline. Every detection version-controlled, peer-reviewed, tested, tied to the attack paths that matter most to Allstate, and promoted through CI/CD, with AI agents accelerating how detections are created and validated.
  • Agentic investigation and governed response. AI-driven triage and investigation paired with orchestrated response, with human decision gates where the business impact is real.
  • Automated threat intelligence. Pipelines that turn global threat reporting into fast, relevant action for exposure management, incident response, hunting, and leadership.
  • Intelligence-led threat hunting. Hypothesis-driven hunts, AI-assisted scoping, and findings that flow straight into durable detections.
  • Continuous adversarial validation. Breach-and-attack simulation and purple teaming that prove coverage against real attacker behavior.

We need a leader who can bring these together into one system and take it to enterprise scale.

Why this matters

Allstate exists to protect people from life’s uncertainties. In security, that promise now runs into a math problem: adversaries are using automation and AI to scale, and human hours do not. If analyst capacity decides what we detect, risk ends up in the alerts no one had time to look at. Our goal is to predict, detect, and disrupt threats before they reach our customers and our data, with coverage we can prove, detections we can trust, response at machine speed, and automation we can govern.

What Allstate can do for you

  • A charter, not a backlog. You’ll lead three teams, D&R Engineering & Automation, Threat Intelligence, and Threat Hunting, and define how they work as one system. You report to the leader of Cyber Defense & Response and sit on that leadership team.
  • Scale and stakes. A Fortune 100 insurer, a global team across the US, Ireland, and India operating follow-the-sun, and an enterprise attack surface spanning identity, cloud, email, endpoint, and applications.
  • Real backing for the AI-era SOC. Executive sponsorship and active investment in agentic investigation, orchestration, and AI-assisted engineering, with a mandate to scale through intelligence and automation.
  • Room to build the culture. A mandate to build teams where candor is normal, “I don’t know” is a respected answer, quality is inspected rather than assumed, and people improve the system instead of heroically working around it.

What you can do for Allstate

  • Build one loop, not three teams. Create the strategy and operating processes that connect intelligence, hunting, and D&R engineering. Priority intelligence requirements set the agenda, hunts test the hypotheses, and every finding ends in a detection, a control change, a telemetry requirement, or a documented decision.
  • Decouple coverage from analyst capacity. With AI handling first-pass investigation, stop tuning coverage to what humans can staff. Expand behavioral coverage across the attack paths that matter most to Allstate, with identity first in line, and measure coverage of those paths rather than rule counts.
  • Run detections like code, end to end. Git-backed content, unit tests, linting, peer review, staged CI/CD promotion, and a clear definition of done, applied to every detection in the library.
  • Make the queue work for the SOC. Partner with Security Operations so detections land in AI-assisted investigation at creation time. Look past medians to tail wait time and cycle time across every severity, because the risk sits in the tail, not the average.
  • Put humans where judgment changes the outcome. Let machines investigate and take pre-approved, reversible containment actions at machine speed, with every action reviewed by a human. Keep a human decision gate for business-impacting remediation. Earn trust in AI the statistical way, with parallel runs and measured agreement, and expand its autonomy as the data proves it out.
  • Inspect quality, then build it in. Stand up quality control across detections, hunts, and intelligence products: defined rubrics, meaningful sampling, and a feedback loop where every defect becomes training, automation, or a process fix.
  • Scale intelligence for speed and relevance. Lead automated intelligence pipelines that tell exposure management, incident response, hunting, and leadership, in minutes, when a threat actually matters to Allstate.
  • Show your work. Build capacity models, coverage baselines, and a quarterly scorecard that ties detection and response to outcomes and cost lines leaders already track. Ask the right questions and answer them with data.
  • Lead leaders and grow people. Develop the leaders of all three teams, hire for traits like curiosity, empathy, and candor, and teach the skills. Protect the team from burnout by fixing the system that causes it.

What you should bring with you

  • 12+ years across threat detection, incident response, threat intelligence, or security operations, in large enterprise, managed detection and response, incident response consulting, or security product teams.
  • Experience leading leaders, including teams distributed across time zones.
  • A track record of applying software engineering discipline to detection: you have run detections as code and know what it takes to keep a library healthy.
  • Experience taking AI or agentic capabilities in detection and response from pilot into production, and clear opinions about where humans must stay in the loop.
  • A data-driven management style: capacity modeling, queueing, quality control, and the habit of answering hard questions with data.
  • Deep understanding of attack surfaces and attacker behavior, especially identity, cloud, and email, and how to turn that into measurable coverage of the attack paths that matter rather than a color-coded matrix.
  • The ability to explain the math to a CFO and the TTP to an engineer, in the same afternoon.
  • Empathy and candor. You own the problem before you solve it, and you build teams where people can say “I was wrong.”

Skills

Cyber Defense, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, People Leadership, Production Automation

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 187,500.00 - 258,375.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobTitle: Travel Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Remote (Eastern Time Zone)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Travel Estimating Property Adjuster:  

 As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.    

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   

  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   

  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   

  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  

  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   

  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Schedule: 

  • During training, work Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. 

  • After training, work 10 days on 4 days off working 8 - 12 hours/day (up to $175/day for working over 8 hours, $200 weekends and/or holidays). 

  • This field position requires up to 90% travel out of town. 

  • Required to attend 2-week training program in Dallas, TX 

Qualifications:  

  • 2+ years of experience writing water damage estimates preferred. 

  • Previous experience as a property adjuster preferred.  

  • Proficiency in estimating software like Xactimate preferred.  

  • Strong focus on providing exceptional customer service.  

  • Ability to work independently, starting from home, and travel to different locations.  

  • Proactive problem-solving skills and a positive attitude toward challenges. 

  • Excellent organization and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.  

Required Qualifications: 

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof. 

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements. 

  • Must reside within 50 miles of an airport.  

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply. 

  

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work. 

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.  

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

Sign On Bonus:   

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.  

  

Company Car: 

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

  

Allstate Benefits:  

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

The Senior Detection Content Engineer (Identity) is the technical authority for identity detection content in Detection and Response Engineering. You own coverage of credential abuse, account takeover, privilege escalation and directory attacks across industry leading Identity Detection and Response Platforms. Identity sits at the center of most attack chains, so you also lead cross-domain correlation that links identity signals to endpoint, cloud and communications activity. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Detection Engineering Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own identity coverage strategy against Allstate's threat profile, with emphasis on password spray, MFA fatigue and bypass, token theft and replay, impossible travel and privilege escalation.
  • Design detections for on-premises Active Directory attacks seen through MDI (Kerberoasting, DCSync, pass-the-hash, reconnaissance) and for cloud identity abuse in Entra ID and Okta.
  • Lead cross-domain correlation that ties identity to other domains (for example risky sign-in to endpoint execution, or OAuth consent to mailbox access).
  • Maintain identity Knowledge Objects: privileged account and service account watchlists, break-glass account lists, sign-in baselines and identity investigation context files.
  • Work with Automation Engineers on session revoke, account disable and MFA reset workflows with safe guardrails for privileged and VIP accounts.
  • Track and report MFA enforcement gaps and conditional access weaknesses that affect detection coverage.
  • Assist in driving the Detection Standard for the Identity domain: reusable detection patterns, templates and the Definition of Done, consistent with the team-wide standard.
  • Set tuning standards, fidelity thresholds and suppression governance for domain content. Approve tuning and redesign recommendations.
  • Run the lifecycle review for domain content and present retirement recommendations, confirming no coverage gap is created.
  • Own and develop the Identity domain's agentic content development workflow (context files, skills and agents), with human review before anything reaches production.
  • Final technical reviewer for high and critical severity Cloud domain content. Coach and develop junior and mid-level engineers, and act as secondary Subject Matter Expert (SME) cover for at least one other domain.


Key Requirements

  • 7+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, SOC, or incident response with at least 2 years at a senior or lead level.
  • Significant experience using industry standard querying languages, such as Kusto Query Language (KQL) and CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL).
  • Experience using Microsoft Security Suite, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, and E5 Logging Sources.
  • Proven delivery of detection-as-code in Git (branching, pull requests, CI/CD).
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Entra ID SigninLogs and AuditLogs, MDI tables, and at least one third-party IdP (Okta, PingFederate or DUO).
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory and Kerberos attacks, OAuth and token-based attacks, and conditional access.
  • Track record of building identity detections that hold up in a large, complex user population spanning multiple Tenants and directory forests.


Desired Qualifications

  • Entra ID Protection and risk-based conditional access design.
  • Identity security certifications (e.g.; GIAC GCIH, Microsoft SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, Okta Certified Professional) or cloud engineering background.
  • UEBA and anomaly detection approaches for sign-in data.
  • Identity threat hunting across hybrid AD and cloud environments.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar), including writing custom context, skills or prompts.
  • Built agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop controls for security content.
  • Experience writing investigation context for AI SOC agents.
  • Experience in a large, regulated enterprise (financial services or insurance).

Skills

Cloud Identity, Cloud Security, Cybersecurity Strategies, Identity Governance, Information Security Engineering, Information Technology Training, IT Security Architecture, IT Security Operations, Kerberos, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth, Security Engineering, Security Incident Response, Security Operations, Threat Detection

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role ranges from $100,000 – 195,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

You own coverage of attacks against Azure and AWS control planes, containers and Kubernetes, and cloud-hosted AI services, using industry leading Cloud Detection and Response Platforms.   • Design detections across industry standard sources, including but not limited to Azure Activity, AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Kubernetes audit logs.
  • Build detections for emerging cloud and AI risks: LLM abuse via API, shadow AI usage and prompt or key misuse in AI services.
  • Maintain cloud Knowledge Objects that feed downstream detections, enrichments and contextualization: account and subscription inventories, sanctioned service lists, privileged role watchlists and cloud investigation context files.
  • Work with Automation Engineers on key revocation, role removal and workload isolation workflows.
  • Drive cloud logging requirements (for example data events, Kubernetes audit levels) with Pipeline Engineers and cloud platform owners.
  • Assist in driving the Detection Standard for the Cloud domain: reusable detection patterns, templates and the Definition of Done, consistent with the team-wide standard.
  • Set tuning standards, fidelity thresholds and suppression governance for domain content. Approve tuning and redesign recommendations.
  • Run the lifecycle review for domain content and present retirement recommendations, confirming no coverage gap is created.
  • Own and develop the Cloud domain's agentic content development workflow (context files, skills and agents), with human review before anything reaches production.
  • Final technical reviewer for high and critical severity Cloud domain content. Coach and develop Junior and Mid-Level engineers, and act as secondary Subject Matter Expert (SME) cover for at least one other domain.

  • Proven delivery of detection-as-code in Git (branching, pull requests, CI/CD).
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Azure and AWS logging (eg; Azure Activity, Entra workload identities, CloudTrail, GuardDuty) and the IAM models behind them.
  • Strong understanding of cloud attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK cloud matrices) and container / Kubernetes attack paths.
  • Experience turning CNAPP or CSPM findings (eg; Wiz, Prisma Cloud or MDC) into actionable detections.


Desired Qualifications

  • Cloud security certifications (e.g.; GIAC GCTD, Microsoft SC-200, SC-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty) or cloud engineering background.
  • Detection of AI and LLM service abuse.
  • Infrastructure as code awareness (Terraform, Bicep) for spotting risky changes.
  • GCP logging and detection experience.
  • Built agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop controls for security content.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar), including writing custom context, skills or prompts.
  • Experience writing investigation context for AI SOC agents.
  • Experience in a large, regulated enterprise (financial services or insurance).

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As an Unrepresented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles that result in property damage and/or bodily injury. In this role, you will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service. You will communicate with customers through voice calls, email, and text messages, and use innovative platforms and tools to negotiate fair injury settlements with customers.

Candidates must reside in the Central, Mountain or Pacific time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico.

At Allstate, responsibilities may vary from day to day. We are looking for adaptable professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment, bring care and sound judgment to each claim, and are excited to make an impact. 


  • The Customer Service Expert – You’ll support customers by caring, empowering, and restoring throughout the claims process. You will do this by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – You’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – You’ll use phone, email, and sometimes video chat to help customers through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also tailor your approach to claim handling by honoring the customer’s communication preferences and keeping them updated on claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claim settlements with customers, vendors, third-party carriers, and claimants in accordance with legal and business standards. You will incorporate tactics for handling challenging and complex situations. 
  • The Problem Solver – You’ll use multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimating tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, while applying strong critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – You’ll help protect the company financially by following applicable policies and keeping a clear record of your work in the claims system. You’ll ensure timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim. 

Work Location 

  • This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. 
  • Candidates must reside in the Central, Mountain or Pacific time zones.
  • This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, or Hawaii. 

Licensing Requirements 

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment. 
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire. 
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment. 
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team. 
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements. 

Sign-On Bonus Information 

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus. 
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Qualifications 

  • 2+ years of claims adjusting and bodily injury adjusting experience. 
  • Previous experience in bodily injury claims handling or a related field preferred. 
  • Colossus evaluation experience preferred. 
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately. 
  • Ability to work independently and remotely while managing time efficiently. 
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination. 
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully. 
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation. 

Allstate Benefits 

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. 
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement. 
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance. 
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role. 
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. 

Please Note: 

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions. 
  • This job description is not intended to include a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned. 
  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role.

Who is Allstate:
Allstate Insurance Company of Canada is a leading home and auto insurer focused on providing its customers prevention and protection products and services for every stage of life. Serving Canadians since 1953, Allstate strives to reassure both customers and employees with its “You’re in Good Hands®” promise and is proud to have been named a Best Employer in Canada for nine consecutive years. Job description:

The Enterprise P&C Actuary Consultant job is responsible for executing and/or managing actuarial projects in support of capital management and risk, utilizing accepted actuarial and statistical standards, methodologies, and sound actuarial judgment. This role works closely with Risk, Finance, and other key business partners to support ORSA, economic capital modeling, capital adequacy and stress testing, as well as other strategic risk and capital initiatives. The role will perform a range of complex and evolving actuarial and risk analyses, communicate key findings, and contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of actuarial frameworks and processes that support business and regulatory objectives.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Uses best practices to determine appropriate analytical approaches and performs moderate to highly complex actuarial and risk analysis, using actuarial, statistical and/or modeling techniques, including appropriate documentation and evaluation, to support enterprise risk and capital management, including economic capital, stress testing, Financial Condition Testing (FCT) and Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA).
  • Analyzes and interprets results, identifies key drivers and emerging risks, and develops recommendations and insights for actuarial leadership and key business partners to support informed decision-making.
  • Leverages understanding of the insurance business, products, markets, and regulatory capital and risk management requirements in the development of analyses, recommendations, and business decisions, while building expertise within enterprise risk and capital management.
  • Responsible for selecting, reviewing, using, and ensuring the quality of data used to perform actuarial and statistical analyses and determining appropriate tools and methodologies.
  • Communicates the appropriateness of actuarial and modeling techniques, key assumptions, results, and limitations to management and non-technical audiences to support business and risk management decisions.
  • Plans, implements, manages, and/or contributes to moderate to highly complex projects related to capital modeling, stress testing, risk assessment, and other enterprise actuarial initiatives using accepted project management standards. Work is primarily self-directed and may require judgment in addressing complex, evolving, or less-defined issues.
  • Provides thought and/or technical leadership, including contributions to process and methodology improvement, development, and innovation, and may serve as a subject matter expert within areas of responsibility.
  • May mentor and/or provide technical guidance to less experienced talent.

Education:

• Bachelors Degree in Actuarial Science or a relevant discipline

• ACAS/FCAS (Preferred)


Experience:

• 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities:

• This job does not have supervisory duties.

Job.JobTitle: SIU Field Investigator - St. Louis, MO - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Special Investigative Unit Consultant II is responsible for investigating and analyzing complex, multi-discipline coverage and claims that have been referred to the Special Investigative Unit (SIU) for potential fraud. The role typically handles a combination of complex attorney represented and unrepresented claims and moderate to complex losses, in which suspicious activity has been identified. The individual performs a thorough investigation including (1) conducting background searches, scene investigations, and clinic inspections; (2) taking recorded statements; (3) reviewing and analyzing medical notes, bills, and property damage; and (4) conducting witness interviews and social media searches. The individual conducts surveillance on property and/or creates scene reconstructions on some investigations and reviews whether fraud can be substantiated and supports a lawsuit.

We are seeking an experienced SIU Investigator to join our growing team! This role is responsible for conducting complex fraud investigations across multiple lines of business, including Auto, Homeowners, and Specialty Lines. This is a field-based position supporting a territory within approximately a three-hour radius of St Louis, MO. Prior investigative experience is required, with a strong preference for candidates who have a Special Investigations Unit (SIU) background and a proven track record of identifying, investigating, and resolving suspicious claims.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enters SIU claim data information into multiple SIU systems
  • Reviews investigations with fraud outcomes to validate whether denial is appropriate
  • Updates files with investigation outcome, and when no fraud or insufficient evidence is found, returns file to MCO for further handling and settlement
  • Conducts complex online data application searches, research, and evaluation
  • Conducts complex site inspections, including body shops, medical clinics, loss locations etc.
  • Conducts thorough investigations of complex that are potentially fraudulent to determine if payment is warranted, including scene investigations and surveillance as needed
  • Validates that the information provided and obtained through investigation is true and accurate and follows up on all possible leads
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process
  • Utilizes analytic tools or SIU field intelligence to identify complex claims for investigation and/or for support in the evidence of the fraud and damages
  • Researches and responds to complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Job Description

Finance and Investments Communications Business Partner
The Lead Communications Consultant plays a critical role in advancing the Finance and Investments organizations' strategic priorities through communications. This role partners closely with senior leaders to develop and execute integrated communications strategies that inform, engage and inspire employees while supporting executive visibility and enterprise objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Planning

  • Serve as a strategic communications business partner to Finance and Investments leaders, translating business priorities into clear communications strategies and advising on messaging, audiences, timing and channels.
  • Lead cross-functional communications planning and execution for Finance and Investments initiatives, organizing Communications partners and other stakeholders to establish objectives, roles, timelines, messaging and deliverables and drive programs from planning through execution.
  • Identify and develop proactive storytelling opportunities across Finance and Investments that bring business priorities to life, including business results, strategic initiatives, innovation, employee and culture stories and other key accomplishments.

Executive Communications

  • Develop executive communications materials for Finance and Investments leaders, including talking points, presentations, employee communications, briefing materials and other content that translates complex business topics into clear, compelling messages.
  • Prepare leaders for internal and external speaking engagements, developing key messages, briefing materials and presentations and providing hands-on speaker preparation to ensure leaders are well-positioned for each audience.
  • Advance executive visibility across internal and external channels, partnering with media relations, social media and other Communications teams to identify and execute opportunities that support leader and business priorities.

 

Internal Communications and Employee Engagement

  • Lead communications strategy, planning and execution for Finance and Investments town halls, leadership meetings and employee events.
  • Develop and manage internal communications channels and content strategies across Finance and Investments organizations to increase employee awareness, reinforce key messages and drive engagement with business priorities.
  • Partner with production teams and event support partners to deliver seamless communications experiences and effective event execution.

 

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in strategic communications, executive communications or corporate communications.
  • Proven ability to partner with senior leaders and provide communications counsel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex business topics into clear, concise and engaging communications.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence across functions and levels.

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Senior Claim Manager leads a Direct Claims team responsible for handling complex claims and latent injury exposures, including asbestos, pollution, PFAS, talc, and other long-tail matters. This role is responsible for strategic leadership, operational excellence, financial oversight, and team development to ensure high-quality claim outcomes, regulatory compliance, and alignment with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities 


Lead and develop a high-performing team of claim professionals handling complex environmental, mass tort, asbestos, PFAS, and other long-tail liability claims. 

  • Provide strategic direction on claim resolution, including coverage analysis, liability assessment, litigation management, reserving, reinsurance reporting, and settlement strategies for high-severity exposures. 
  • Drive superior claim outcomes through sound financial stewardship, innovative disposition strategies, and a focus on timely, effective claim resolution. 
  • Oversee litigation and dispute resolution activities, including management of outside counsel, experts, consultants, and vendor partners. 
  • Monitor claim performance, reserving accuracy, operational metrics, and emerging trends to identify opportunities for improved results and organizational effectiveness. 
  • Partner with Legal, Actuarial, Reinsurance, Finance, and senior leadership to address complex claims and business issues. 
  • Prepare and present claim strategies, exposure assessments, and operational updates to senior leadership. 
  • Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, continuous learning, and employee engagement through coaching, performance management, and talent development. 
  • Build technical capability and succession strength within the team through coaching, knowledge transfer, and development planning. 
  • Ensure compliance with claim handling standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies. 
  • Leverage data analytics, technology, and AI-enabled tools to enhance decision-making, operational efficiency, and claim outcomes. 
  • Identify emerging claim trends and communicate potential financial, operational, and reputational impacts to key stakeholders. 
  • Oversee third-party administrators and vendors to ensure contract compliance, service quality, and cost control. 
  • Occasional business travel may be required. 
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.  

Qualifications: 

Experience 

  • 10+ years of relevant claims, insurance coverage, or reinsurance experience. 
  • Proven leadership experience managing teams and direct reports. 

Technical & Functional Skills 

  • Advanced expertise in environmental and mass tort claims, investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and settlement. 
  • Strong knowledge of insurance, coverage interpretation, and case law. 
  • Deep understanding of claims processes, systems, and regulatory requirements. 
  • Ability to analyze complex data, financial forecasts, and operational performance metrics. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled technologies, with demonstrated adaptability to new systems and tools. 

Leadership Competencies 

  • Strong leadership and people management skills, including coaching, mentoring, and team development. 
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and diverse stakeholders. 
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex issues into actionable solutions. 
  • Proven ability to drive results, improve processes, and manage competing priorities. 

Work Environment & Technology 

  • Company-provided technology includes laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse. 
  • Remote employees receive monthly connectivity reimbursement. 
  • A dedicated, distraction-free workspace and reliable internet, with minimum speeds of 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload, are required for remote work. 

Skills

Claims Review, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Operational Performance, Performance Metrics, Process Improvements, Vendor Management

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:  

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention 
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals 
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth 
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales 
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives 
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition 
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations 

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more 
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays 
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone 
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture 
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program 
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Senior Counsel, Incident Management plays a critical role in providing real-time, business-focused legal guidance on incident response and cybersecurity matters.

Recognized internally as a subject matter expert, this individual brings advanced business acumen and specialized legal expertise to support complex cybersecurity and incident response matters across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead investigations and effectively collaborate with stakeholders in Law & Regulation, risk, security, technology, and more, ensuring an effective incident response across jurisdictions in compliance with applicable privacy, information security and cybersecurity laws and regulations
  • Maintain knowledge of privacy, information security and cybersecurity laws and regulations, with focus on data breach laws
  • Proactively monitor and assess applicability of privacy, information security and cybersecurity laws and regulations, and other legal authority
  • Conduct risk analyses on key issues, from a holistic perspective, recognizing overall impact to the enterprise; make strategic recommendations based on legal requirements and risk analyses
  • Advise business partners on legal subjects (including cybersecurity and incident response) and risk management
  • Drive strategy determination, action planning, and communication with business partners, business units, and other areas of Law & Regulation
  • Anticipate legal concerns and provide creative problem solving in a dynamic business environment
  • Escalate matters, as appropriate, to support legal and compliance risk identification and mitigation and company requirements
  • Exceptional ability to communicate verbally and in writing with a variety of audiences about complex technologies and legal requirements
  • This role may require minimal travel to Allstate locations in Arizona, Illinois, North Carolina, and Texas, based on business needs.

Education:

  • Juris Doctor (Required)

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Must be admitted, licensed to practice law, and in good standing with the bar of at least one U.S. state.

  • Minimum of 7 years of legal experience in a law firm or an in-house legal department of a mid- to large-sized company (Required)
  • Experience advising technology teams on legal and regulatory matters. (Required)
  • Extensive and demonstrated experience advising on data breach response (Required)

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job may have supervisory duties over individual contributors, contractors, consultants, and temps (as required)
