Job.JobTitle: Obvious Total Loss Adjuster (Job Location: CST, MST, PST)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

** This position supports the Central (CST), Mountain (MST) and Pacific (PST) Standard Time Regions

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Join Our Team as an Obvious Total Loss Adjuster – Where Your Expertise Drives Real Impact
As an Obvious Total Loss Adjuster, you will play a critical role in our claims handling process, focusing on determining the repairability or total loss of vehicles. Working remotely, you will spend the majority of your time managing total loss claims. Your responsibilities will involve reviewing claim details, preparing total loss valuations, assessing vehicle conditions, determining salvage valuations, and engaging in negotiation and settlement processes with our valued customers and/or claimants.
This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people’s lives during challenging moments, all while leveraging your analytical skills and industry knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 12 months or more of Auto Collision estimating in CCC One, Audatex, or Mitchell preferred
  • Previous experience in total loss adjustment or a related field is highly desirable
  • Proficiency in using estimating software and valuation tools for virtual assessments
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate moderate to complex vehicle damages effectively
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely
  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in a virtual work environment
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a commitment to delivering accurate and timely results

You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each auto claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate auto claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Work Location:

This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.  This Position is not available for Washington, California, Alaska, and Hawaii residents.  

When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB download speed and 5 MB upload speed.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

Work schedule:

Candidates are considered based on the time zone they live in. If you selected for this position you need to be willing to work one of the following schedules to be determined by business needs.

Candidates in CST, MST or PST preferred

Standard business hours 8:00 am - 4:30 pm local time

What Allstate will provide:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, and mouse.)
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. Job.JobTitle: Personal Injury Protection Adjuster - PST/MST/CST- Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Are you a strong communicator who enjoys solving problems, helping others, and making a meaningful impact every day? We're seeking a Personal Injury Protection Adjuster to join our team and support customers through the medical claims process following an auto accident.

This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for individuals with strong critical thinking, time management, and customer service skills who are looking to build a rewarding career in claims. Insurance experience is helpful but not required. We provide training and support to help you succeed.

In this role, you'll work directly with customers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders to review medical claims, determine coverage, evaluate bills, and ensure claims are handled fairly, accurately, and compassionately.

What You'll Do


As a Personal Injury Protection Adjuster, you will:


  • Guide customers through the medical claims process with empathy, professionalism, and care.
  • Investigate and evaluate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) and Medical Payments (Med Pay) claims.
  • Review medical bills, treatment records, wage loss documentation, mileage reimbursements, attendant care requests, and other related expenses.
  • Determine claim eligibility, coverage, and reasonableness of medical expenses.
  • Communicate claim decisions clearly and professionally to customers and other parties involved.
  • Maintain accurate claim documentation and detailed file notes.
  • Establish and manage claim reserves based on claim facts and treatment patterns.
  • Identify potential medical management opportunities and refer suspicious activity when appropriate.
  • Manage multiple claims simultaneously while meeting quality, service, and productivity expectations.
  • Utilize digital tools and technology to provide efficient and seamless customer experiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Personal Injury Protection (PIP)/MedPay claim handling experience.
  • 2 years of insurance claim handling/adjusting.
  • Complex liability claim handling.
  • Experience using Mitchell DecisionPoint.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.


Location: Candidates located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones are preferred. This position is not available to candidates in California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico.


Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8-hour shift scheduled between 7:00 a.m. and 6:30 p.m. Central Time.


When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A home office – a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Training:

  • The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:  

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits: 

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes: 
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement. 
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance. 
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role. 
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

This position involves working in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail and strong communication skills are essential. You’ll be responsible for handling a wide range of tasks that support enterprise operations, including data validation, customer interactions, and process documentation. You’ll collaborate with various teams and use multiple tools to ensure business needs are met efficiently and accurately.

As a Casualty Claims Associate III, you’ll be a key contributor in supporting internal and external customers and business partners through a variety of processing tasks. This role requires a high level of accuracy, adaptability, and the ability to work across multiple systems and communication channels. You’ll help ensure smooth operations by managing complex data, resolving inquiries, and identifying opportunities for process improvements.


In This Role, You Will

·         Identify and recommend process improvements; assist in maintaining standard operating procedures.

·         Handle complex or unique customer interactions with professionalism and care.

·         Validate, edit, and correct advanced data entries across systems.

·         Communicate effectively with internal teams, external partners, agents, and consumers.

·         Select appropriate tools and procedures from established options to resolve issues.

·         Provide service, information, and procedural guidance to customers and stakeholders.

·         Process data in alignment with internal policies and external business requirements.

·         Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM (Local Time)


You’re a Great Match for This Role If You Have

·         Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data handling.

·         Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

·         Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently.

·         A problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

·         Comfort navigating multiple systems and tools in a fast-paced environment.

·         A team-oriented attitude with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.


Other Things to Consider

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As an Unrepresented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with customers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of claims adjusting and bodily injury adjusting experience.
  • Previous experience in bodily injury claims handling or a related field preferred.
  • Colossus evaluation experience a plus.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Candidates for this role must reside in either the Eastern (EST) or Central (CST) time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, or Hawaii.


You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Sign-On Bonus Information


  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus. 
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Remote Home-Based Work:
This position is a remote home-based role.

  • Schedule: Mon-Fri | 8:00am-4:30pm or 9:00am-5:30pm EST


Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply. 

 

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education. reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. Job Description

We are seeking a Platform Consultant DBaaS Senior Expert to help design, evolve, and drive adoption of enterprise database platform capabilities. This role combines database architecture, cloud engineering, platform automation, and consulting expertise to deliver secure, scalable, and self-service database services for application teams. The ideal candidate will be passionate about simplifying database consumption through automation, reusable patterns, and platform engineering best practices.

Allstate is modernising its database ecosystem to provide secure, reliable, automated, and self-service database capabilities that accelerate delivery for Digital Product Teams. As application teams increasingly consume infrastructure through platform services, and Database as a Service (DBaaS) plays a critical role in simplifying database operations while improving reliability, security, and developer experience.

Key responsibilities:


Help Shape Database Platform Capabilities

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for database platform capabilities and automation.

Job.JobTitle: Lead Consultant, Penetration Testing - Adversarial Validation
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description


The team:


  • Our Adversarial Validation team is part of Allstate’s broader Exposure Management organization, focused on identifying, testing, and validating security vulnerabilities across enterprise applications and technology environments.
  • Our team is evolving beyond traditional penetration testing to take a more proactive approach to security. In addition to supporting critical application and compliance testing, we investigate newly disclosed vulnerabilities to understand their exploitability and potential business impact.
  • The team brings together penetration testing professionals with complementary technical expertise who collaborate closely with Exposure Intelligence, Exposure Response, and Threat Intelligence teams.

Overall Work Scope: Lead Consultant, Penetration Testing - Adversarial Validation


  • As a Lead Consultant within our Adversarial Validation team, you'll combine advanced penetration testing with real-time security exposure validation.
  • You'll work closely with security engineers, exposure management teams, and technology stakeholders, providing both hands-on technical expertise and clear guidance to leadership.
  • This is an opportunity to influence how we approach offensive security while continuing to develop your skills across emerging technologies.

What You'll Do


  • Lead complex, hands-on penetration testing across web applications, APIs, networks, and enterprise technologies.
  • Investigate emerging vulnerabilities, analyze publicly available exploit code, and validate whether identified exposures can be exploited in our environment.
  • Assess attack paths, security controls, and potential business impact to help prioritize remediation.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable risk insights for engineers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with exposure intelligence, exposure response, threat intelligence, and technology teams to investigate and address security risks.
  • Leverage penetration testing tools and automation capabilities to improve testing efficiency and validate security exposures.
  • Support security assessments of critical applications and environments, including those subject to regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to testing methodologies, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.

What You Bring


  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, offensive security, red teaming, or related adversarial security testing.
  • Strong practical experience conducting penetration tests, particularly across web applications, APIs, and network environments.
  • Experience investigating vulnerabilities, analyzing proof-of-concept exploit code, and validating real-world exploitability.
  • Ability to assess attack paths, evaluate security controls, and determine the technical and business impact of security exposures.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings and security risks to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Working knowledge of penetration testing methodologies, common vulnerabilities, and security frameworks such as OWASP and PTES.
  • Working knowledge of security tools such as Burp Suite Professional, Postman, or comparable testing technologies.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS or similar security compliance requirements and their implications for risk prioritization.

Nice to Have


  • Experience assessing cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Exposure to penetration testing of AI-enabled applications, generative AI, or large language model technologies.
  • Experience with mobile applications, SaaS platforms, or PaaS environments.
  • Experience leveraging automated security testing or adversarial validation tools.
  • Scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience with Active Directory, identity security, advanced network testing, or adversary simulation.
  • Offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GPEN, or equivalent demonstrated capabilities.

Skills

Adversary Simulation, Automation, Network Penetration Testing, Offensive Cyber Operations, Offensive Security (Inactive), Penetration Testing, Red Teaming, Security Testing, Threat Detection, Threat Management, Web Application Penetration Testing

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Training & Development Specialist, Human Resources & Training
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

Help Develop Talent, Drive Learning, and Make an Impact

Are you passionate about developing others, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and helping employees build skills that drive business success? We’re seeking a Learning & Development Consultant I to join our collaborative team and deliver impactful learning experiences across South and Southwest Florida.

In this role, you’ll work directly with employees, leaders, and cross-functional partners to deliver learning programs that strengthen employee performance, support professional growth, and build a culture of continuous learning. This is a field-based hybrid position with approximately 60% travel to locations throughout South and Southwest Florida and 40% virtual/work from home.

Why Join Our Team?

Our team is known for its strong culture, collaboration, and commitment to development. Team members support one another, share knowledge, and work together to create meaningful learning experiences.

Field-based trainers also receive:

  • Company vehicle
  • Company fuel/gas card
  • Company credit card for approved travel expenses
  • Daily meal per diem while traveling
  • Opportunity to work directly with employees and leaders across multiple locations

What You’ll Do

  • Facilitate engaging instructor-led training and learning programs aligned with business and enterprise strategies
  • Design and support learning experiences that develop meaningful, business-relevant skills
  • Build strong relationships with employees, business leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners
  • Coach and support learners throughout training programs and learning activities
  • Promote a skills-based learning culture focused on employee growth and development
  • Measure learning effectiveness and recommend improvements based on learner feedback and outcomes
  • Maintain learning content and training offerings to ensure they meet evolving business needs
  • Coordinate training logistics, including class setup, participant lists, materials, and other classroom needs
  • Participate in learning system audits and quality reviews to support accuracy and consistency

What You’ll Bring

  • Active license required
  • Experience delivering training, facilitating learning programs, or supporting employee development
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills
  • Excellent customer service and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to engage diverse audiences and create a positive learning environment
  • Ability to coach and support learners through training activities
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly throughout assigned locations

Preferred Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Learning & Development, training, facilitation, or a related area
  • Experience working with adult learners in a corporate environment
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) and learning technologies
  • Experience measuring learning effectiveness and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement

Important Location & Travel Requirements

This position supports the South and Southwest Florida territory. Candidates must be based in Florida and positioned to regularly travel throughout South and Southwest Florida.

  • Approximately 60% travel/on-site across South and Southwest Florida locations
  • Approximately 40% virtual/work from home
  • Regular travel within the assigned territory is an essential part of the role

What Success Looks Like

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy working directly with people, creating engaging learning experiences, coaching employees, and spending time in the field. You’ll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with employees and leaders while helping develop the skills that support individual and organizational success.

Join a team where collaboration, development, and employee growth are at the center of what we do.

Job.JobTitle: Good Hands Repair Network - Automotive Virtual Triage Total Loss Adjuster - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

This job is responsible for providing a superior level of customer service and attention to customers who have a vehicle that needs repaired. The individual virtually inspects damage to a vehicle (which may include automobiles, motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles and recreational vehicles), writes damage repair estimates, completes total loss valuations and negotiates moderately complex and occasionally complex settlements with repair facilities, tow yards, customers, and estimates repair times for rental/loss of use. The individual works independently, prioritizes the individual's own responsibilities, and manages the individual's own workload and is responsible for explaining coverage, estimates, claims, settlement, and rental processes to agents and/or customers.

Key Responsibilities:


The Customer Service Expert – You’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 


The Investigator – You’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty and applicable lines of business claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 


The Effective Communicator – You’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 


The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.


The Problem Solver – You’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 


The Recorder – You’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim. 


Work Location

Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available for Washington, California, Alaska, and Hawaii residents.


When you work from home full time, you’ll need: 

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up 
  • Appropriate work surface and seating  


What will Allstate provide:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse) 
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet

Preferred Experience

  • You have 18 months or more experience writing Auto collision estimates 
  • You have prior experience using an auto estimating program such as: CCC One / Mitchell / Audatex 

Functional Skills

  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes
  • Documents a claim file with notes, evaluations, and decision-making process.
  • May work the Triage Tool and partners with the Good Hands Repair Network for vehicles that may be potential total losses, and determines reparability and if repairs can be settled rapidly
  • Investigates moderately complex or occasionally complex files, reviews damage, take photos, and determines reparability or total loss
  • Prepares damage estimates or valuation for moderately complex or occasionally complex claims and locates parts   
  • Evaluates diminished value in a moderately complex or occasionally complex claim
  • Triage moderately complex and occasionally complex total loss claims
  • Initiates payments (QCP, Fast Mobile Epay, etc.) and pays appropriate parties
  • Negotiates and settles moderately complex and occasionally complex claims in accordance with business unit best practices
  • Responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex arbitrations contentions

Please note, you may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.


Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjuster’s license in multiple markets
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings: 

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching 
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement 
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement 
  • Wellness incentives
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities

To learn more about our benefits and programs visit AllstateGoodLife.com


Notes


The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. May be required to perform other related duties as assigned. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this job


This position is not available for residents of Washington, California, Alaska, and Hawaii.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Job Profile Summary
The Senior Manager, Data and Value-Added Services leads the strategy, prioritization, and delivery of solutions that strengthen Allstate’s relationships with dealerships and support profitable growth. The role brings together Allstate and dealership solutions, products, data, insights, and capabilities to identify dealer and customer needs, build and manage an integrated roadmap, and deliver differentiated solutions. This leader establishes a clear framework for deciding what to pursue, sequence, defer, or stop; communicates the rationale for those decisions; and influences cross-functional teams to secure the commitment required to deliver. The position balances strategic and technical judgment with persuasive business leadership, advancing practical solutions that can be tested, measured, and improved over time.

Job Description
This position develops and advances strategies, services, and tools that help Allstate and its dealership partners create greater value for customers. The role connects data and analytics with dealer relationships, finance and insurance products, property and casualty offerings, technology, and enterprise capabilities. It translates insights into a prioritized portfolio of practical solutions, aligns stakeholders around sequencing and trade-offs, and guides cross-functional work from concept through market testing. The leader uses customer and business feedback to refine solutions over time, balancing long-term capability development with the speed required to learn, improve dealer engagement, support customer acquisition, and drive profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the strategy for using Allstate and dealership capabilities to identify dealer, customer, product, and market opportunities.
  • Develops value-added services that combine data, insights, products, and Allstate capabilities to strengthen the dealer value proposition.
  • Translates dealership and customer insights into solutions that improve dealer engagement, customer value, and business growth.
  • Partners with marketing, analytics, technology, product, sales, and other business teams to connect information and capabilities across Allstate, build shared ownership of outcomes, and influence the prioritization of dealer initiatives within teams that manage competing enterprise commitments.
  • Establishes approaches for dealer segmentation and opportunity identification to tailor products, services, and relationship strategies to dealer needs.
  • Thrives in ambiguity and navigates across Allstate to rapidly bring differentiated dealer and customer solutions to market, using pragmatic judgment to define minimum viable capabilities, test assumptions, gather feedback, and iterate toward more complete solutions.
  • Identifies opportunities to combine finance and insurance products with property and casualty offerings to provide a more complete set of solutions through dealerships.
  • Builds business cases and roadmaps for new data-enabled services, tools, programs, and dealer solutions.

Job Description

Allstate is seeking an AI Security Engineer to help build and operate an always-on adversarial testing capability for AI-enabled and agentic systems.

In this role, you will integrate commercial, open-source, and Allstate-internal adversarial testing technologies into Allstate environments, connect them to AI-enabled applications, and build the automation, telemetry, and data capabilities needed to execute testing reliably at enterprise scale. You will work closely with engineers designing new adversarial techniques to turn successful strategies into repeatable capabilities that can continuously identify and measure AI system weaknesses.

This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role suited for engineers who enjoy integrating emerging technologies into complex enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities


  • Integrate commercial, open-source, and Allstate-built AI agentic evaluation and red-team technologies into Allstate environments using approved enterprise engineering and security patterns.
  • Connect testing systems to AI products through APIs, agent and tool protocols, voice interfaces, and other application-specific integration patterns.
  • Turn attack strategies into reliable, configuration-driven test capabilities that can be reused across applications and environments.
  • Develop APIs, microservices, orchestration components, and automated triggers supporting continuous and large-scale adversarial testing.
  • Build secure authentication, authorization, and credential-management patterns that allow automated testing to operate without manual intervention.
  • Capture and persist test evidence including requests, responses, conversation history, tool interactions, configuration, grading results, and other relevant telemetry.
  • Integrate test results with reporting, observability, compliance, and engineering workflows.
  • Build CI/CD, monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and operational practices for the adversarial testing platform.


Essential Skills

  • Professional software engineering experience building and operating enterprise applications, services, or platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java.
  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous workflows, or event-driven systems.
  • Experience integrating third-party, vendor, or open-source technologies into enterprise environments.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud, container, or enterprise PaaS technologies.
  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, configuration management, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization, service identities, secrets management, network controls, and secure application integration.
  • Experience building observable services using logs, metrics, tracing, alerts, and operational dashboards.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills across application, integration, deployment, and infrastructure boundaries.


Preferred Skills


  • Experience with AI/LLM evaluation, red-team, security testing, or quality-assurance frameworks.
  • Experience with tools such as Coval, Promptfoo, PyRIT, Garak, Inspect AI, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with agentic AI systems, including tool-calling agents, MCP, multi-agent systems, conversational agents, or voice agents.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge techniques, AI guardrails, or AI observability.
  • Familiarity with AI security risks such as prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure, excessive agency, memory poisoning, or insecure tool use.


The hiring manager has flexibility to hire at the Senior Consultant I to Lead Consultant level. The level will be determined by the selected applicant's skills and competencies.

Job.JobTitle: Specialty Operations Claims (Property & Casualty Reinsurance) Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Specialty Operations Claims Consultant handles and analyzes assumed reinsurance claims under excess of loss and facultative reinsurance contracts, including workers’ compensation and automobile claims and developing responsibility for mass tort, latent injury, and other long-tail casualty matters. The role evaluates claim facts, coverage, contract obligations, liability, damages, reserves, payments, and supporting documentation to help control exposure and support appropriate claim outcomes.

In this role, you will manage an assigned caseload with increasing independence, develop claim action plans, maintain well-documented files, and communicate with internal and external business partners. You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable Specialty Operations team where sound judgment, technical curiosity, ownership, and clear communication are valued.

Key Responsibilities

·    Handle and adjust assigned excess of loss and facultative assumed reinsurance claims with appropriate guidance, with the goal of evaluating and controlling exposure.

·    Analyze claim facts and financial information, including liability, damages, coverage positions, reserves, payments, allocation information, and supporting documentation.

·    Interpret and apply relevant provisions of reinsurance contracts, facultative certificates, underlying insurance policies, and available legal or industry guidance.

·    Establish and maintain appropriate reserves and process payments within assigned authority; prepare clear recommendations and obtain approval when matters exceed authority.

·    Develop and carry out claim action plans, including identification of coverage, exposure, documentation, financial, and timing issues requiring follow-up or escalation.

·    Maintain accurate and well-reasoned claim files, including timely diary activity, claim analyses, required reporting, and adherence to applicable procedures and service expectations.

·    Communicate professionally with management, cedents, brokers, internal business partners, and other external contacts; request additional information and explain claim positions as appropriate.

·    Support complex claim reviews and special projects through research, financial analysis, reporting, data validation, and collaboration with senior claim professionals.

·    Continue building technical expertise through training, feedback, review of claim outcomes, and awareness of relevant insurance, reinsurance, legal, and industry developments.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience

·    3+ years of relevant experience preferred.


Functional Skills

·    Working knowledge of reinsurance contracts, insurance policies, coverage principles, claim processes, procedures, and system applications.

·    Ability to evaluate claim information and identify relevant facts, exposure considerations, financial impacts, documentation needs, and issues requiring escalation.

·    Ability to manage an assigned caseload, prioritize competing deadlines, and maintain accurate, timely, and well-supported claim records.

·    Effective written and verbal communication skills, including clear claim analyses, recommendations, and correspondence.

·    Ability to collaborate effectively in virtual and in-person settings with team members, management, internal partners, cedents, brokers, and other external contacts.

·    Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and Copilot; aptitude for learning new technology and claims systems.

·    Analytical thinking, sound judgment, and appropriate independence, with willingness to seek guidance on complex matters or issues outside assigned authority.


Limited travel may be expected (approximately twice per year) to support team connection, training, or business needs.

Job Description

The Special Investigation Unit (SIU) Lead Investigator is responsible for analyzing highly complex fraud patterns and Allstate's exposure to fraudulent claims, looking for patterns of suspected fraud and helping to recommend appropriate cases for prosecution. The individual determines a course of action once a pattern has been identified and oversees investigations and litigation. This role will require prior experience in dealing with governmental agencies such as State and Federal Attorney Generals, District Attorneys, prosecutors, FBI, IRS or DOJ (Healthcare).

This position is not available to candidates that reside in California, Washington, Hawaii, Alaska or Puerto Rico.

• Will serve as a liaison to claims, SIU, MCU and various State and Federal Agencies.

• Analyzes legal bills to assess appropriateness of charges and detect duplicate billing.

• Interacts and exchanges information with claim personnel, investigators, management, fraud bureaus, law enforcement, and industry anti-fraud groups.

• Analyzes highly complex investigation data involving multiple claims and multiple entities participating in the fraudulent schemes.

• Documents a claim file with notes, evaluations, and decision-making process.

• Acts as a resource to management on highly complex analyses of claim fraud data and activity.

• Works with counsel and Corporate Lit Counsel on discovery and interrogatory responses.

• Directs and facilitates with litigation counsel consistent handling on the underlying claims along with the global case.

• Designated as the Corporate Representative 30 (b) (6) both as to the person with the most knowledge and responsible for articulating damage calculation to include but not limited to case specific policy, practices, and procedures

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.
This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today! 


As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique? 

  • Day 1 Benefits 
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • 0 – 2 years of experience 
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster Field Estimating - Phoenix, AZ
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Reside in Phoenix, AZ.

  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required qualification:

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

This job is responsible for investigating, processing, and settling claims in the first party property appraisal process.  This individual evaluates appraisal demands, works with internal and external vendors to complete the process, and applies coverages to the results.  

A day in the life of an Inside Appraisal Adjuster:

Job Description

The Team & What They Do:


  • The Measurement Science team sits at the center of high-impact decision support across the enterprise. This group is the go-to partner when the business needs to understand what truly drives outcomes.
  • Working within a specialized analytics pod and closely aligned with a broader “core” measurement team, you’ll collaborate with peers who combine deep statistical rigor with a consulting mindset. Together, the team evaluates campaigns, product changes, and strategic initiatives to ensure leaders can make decisions grounded in well-reasoned statistical evidence.
  • This is a high-visibility team that frequently engages with senior leadership to assess the effectiveness of major initiatives and quantify real business impact.
  • Unlike traditional data science roles focused on prediction, this role is about decision science—producing defensible, evidence-based insights that shape strategy.

Overall Work Scope:


  • As a Lead Data Scientist on the Measurement Science team you will have the opportunity to work on high value, high visibility projects across the entire enterprise. This role is tasked with providing clarity to problems with high degrees of uncertainty.
  • Your role will be responsible for the following: applying advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to evaluate business metrics, designing and analyzing business experiments, applying quasi-causal techniques, validating and evaluating key metrics, and engineering repeatable measurement methodologies and systems. This role will contribute to and manage projects of high complexity

Key Responsibilities:


  • Works collaboratively to improve the effectiveness of business decisions and business results through designing, building, and advising on appropriate measurement, experimental, or quasi-causal designs.
  • Provides leadership clear insights into the strengths and limitations of measurement approaches
  • Identifies and evaluates key performance metrics, including validation of proxies and leading indicators.
  • Contributes to the design, review and engineering of repeatable measurement methodologies and systems.
  • Identifies languages, tools, and methodologies that can bring efficiencies and rigor to the team.
  • Uses best practices to develop statistical and machine learning/AI techniques to enable rigorous data-driven decisions
  • Mentors and upskills junior data scientists

Required Qualifications:


  • A minimum of 3 years demonstrated experience applying causal inference methodologies (experimental design, propensity score matching/weighting, double ML, cluster randomization, doubly robust estimation)
  • Comfortable consulting with and educating non-technical business partners on a variety of measurement methods
  • Strong foundation in statistical inference including hypothesis testing, generalized linear modeling, variance reduction techniques (CUPED) and Bayesian inference
  • Experience in statistical and machine learning fundamentals, including model evaluation, feature engineering, and supervised/unsupervised learning principles
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis, data manipulation, and model development.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with dashboards or visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (version control, code review, testing frameworks).
  • Experience using CI/CD pipelines or modern development workflows for deploying data products, experiments, or analytics automation.
  • Experience with agentic coding tools and methodologies (i.e. Github copilot, Claude code, spec-kit, etc.)
  • Experience evaluating LLM and agentic systems
  • Proficiency in distributed compute systems (i.e. PySpark)

Artificial Intelligence Markup Language, Business Model Development, Causal Inference, Data Analytics, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), R Programming, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Models, Statistical Tools, Statistics

Job Description

The Inside Property Analyst II is responsible for investigating and confirming the facts of loss for homeowners claims. The role determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within authority.

This is an IN-OFFICE Hybrid Trainee role in the Allstate Denver, CO office


THIS IS AN IN OFFICE ROLE

8:00 –4:30 MST

Monday, Wednesday, Friday - In Office

Tuesday, Thursday- Remote

You will work in the office all 5 days for the first 6 months during training, then will move to the hybrid schedule.

Greenwood Village, CO


A day in the life of an inside Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Moderate Inside Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. The work schedule is in-office at our Denver location on Monday, Wednesday and Friday with remote work on Tuesday and Thursday. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

·        The Customer Service Expert – you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always. This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need

·        The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

·        The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

·        The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

·        The Problem Solver – you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

·        The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.


Schedule:

8:00 –4:30 MST

You will work in the office all 5 days for the first 6 months during training, then will move to the hybrid schedule.

·       1+ years of previous customer service experience required.

·        Previous industry experience is highly desired.

·        Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for virtual assessments is preferred.

·        Ability to assess property damages and accurately determine claim coverage.

·        Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

·        Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in a virtual work environment.

·        Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.


This role is Hybrid at the Allstate Denver Office.


You’re provided with comprehensive training:

·        The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

·        Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. Job Description

Think working in insurance can't be exciting, rewarding, and challenging? Think again.

Allstate extends beyond insurance to provide customers with protection across many aspects of their lives.

Team Overview

The ALLIE Product Execution team plays a critical role in advancing Allstate’s AI-enabled business strategy by connecting portfolio priorities, business objectives, technology, and execution. As part of ALLIE, Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem, the team develops and enables technology solutions that help translate strategic goals and complex business needs into actionable insights, products, and capabilities.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, data, analytics, finance, and business teams, we build scalable solutions that improve how portfolio decisions are made and executed. This includes leveraging AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices to create intelligent capabilities that improve visibility, identify risks and opportunities, support prioritization, and enable better business and customer outcomes.

Our team enables a high-performing, user-centric culture that empowers employees to deliver valuable customer outcomes. We leverage modern engineering practices including Agile development, test-driven development, continuous integration, and continuous delivery.

This role is open for consideration of Senior Consultant to Lead Consultant levels.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering leaders and product managers to deliver technology solutions that support business and customer needs.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable applications using Python and modern development practices.
  • Contribute to product backlogs by delivering features, resolving defects, and improving overall application quality.
  • Support the adoption of AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), vector database technologies, and related capabilities across products.
  • Participate in product discovery, technical design, and solution architecture discussions.
  • Contribute to Azure cloud-based solutions and help implement scalable, reliable, and secure architectures.
  • Support the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines, automation, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with architecture, platform, data science, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Promote documentation standards, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

Senior Consultant Requirements 

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience developing enterprise applications using Python and/or Java/Spring Boot, including backend development and REST API integration.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, microservices, API design, cloud services, and modern cloud-native architectures, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • 1+ year of experience working with AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or related machine learning solutions. (preferred)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices, source control systems, and modern software delivery methodologies.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Experience designing and scaling REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications, preferably in Microsoft Azure.
  • 1+ years of mentoring junior staff and managing external stakeholders.
  • Experience with modern DevOps, CI/CD, observability, site reliability, and production operations practices.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments and mentoring engineers on technical best practices.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

We’re excited to expand our team of Learning & Development Claims Trainers for the Allstate Claims University! As a Trainer, you'll facilitate engaging and effective sessions for Property or CAT claims classes. This is a virtual position with travel required, depending on business needs. The Trainer will support a mix of virtual and in-person training sessions. The ideal candidate should be flexible and open to a 10-days-on / 4-days-off schedule, as needed. Our training schedules mainly align to the Central Time zone.  We’re looking for candidates who have strong technical claims experience. The ideal candidate will have multiple years of experience with insurance field claims handling. If you're passionate about claims and training and want to make an impact, then apply today and help us grow our Allstate Claims University!


Key Responsibilities

    • Coaches and supports learners as they work through learning exercises.
    • Maintains catalog of offerings and recommends content to meet business unit and enterprise needs.
    • Coordinates the initial set-up of classes, which includes reviewing the class list and preparing materials for the class
    • Measures learning effectiveness and shares recommendations to help improve learner understanding; Provides support for learners as needed.
    • Designs and delivers learning offerings that are developed and aligned to business and enterprise strategy as part of an agile team; Ensures talent management practices are supported consistently within learning offerings.
    • Builds and maintains relationships with business partners, clients and cross-functional teams; Drive adoption of skills-based culture to empower and develop meaningful business-relevant skills through design and delivery of learning.
    • Participates in audit and quality reviews of learning systems.

Supervisory Responsibilities

    • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Functional Skills:

    • Training Program Creation and Design: Expertise in developing training programs specifically tailored for new Property and CAT (Catastrophe) claims employees.
    • Instructor-Led and Self-Paced Training: Experienced in delivering both instructor-led and self-paced training sessions ensuring knowledge retention and engagement.
    • Assessments and Feedback: Strong skills in utilizing assessments and feedback mechanisms to track and identify learning gaps.
    • Compliance and Industry Standards: Knowledgeable in incorporating legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into the training content, ensuring that new hires understand the critical regulatory frameworks surrounding Property and CAT claims management.
    • Collaboration with Leadership: Ability to work closely with Property and CAT leadership to ensure training objectives align with team and business goals. Experience in tailoring content to the specific needs of claims managers and other stakeholders.

Additional Job Description

Base compensation offered for this role is

  • Learning & Development Consultant I: $53,500 - $77,800
  • Learning & Development Consultant II: $56,000 - $82,500
  • Learning & Development Senior Consultant I: $62,100- $92,700
  • Learning & Development Senior Consultant II: $65,600 - $98,200

Annually and is based on experience and qualifications. Total compensation for this role is comprised of several factors, including the base compensation outlined above, plus incentive pay (i.e. commission, bonus, etc.) if applicable for the role.


Skills

Coaching, Facilitation, Homeowners Claims, Homeowners Insurance Claims, Learning and Development (L&D), Learning Effectiveness, Learning Facilitation, Learning Materials Development, Negotiation, Performance Management (PM), Training, Training and Development, Training Coordination, Training Instruction, Training Programs

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 65,600.00 - 110,075.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

When property damage happens, customers need someone who can bring clarity to an uncertain situation. As an Inside Property Claims Adjuster with National General, an Allstate company, you’ll own claims from investigation through resolution, gathering information, evaluating damages, reviewing coverage, and helping customers understand what comes next. You’ll use critical thinking, sound judgment, and virtual claims tools to make informed decisions without the routine travel of a field adjuster role. If you enjoy solving problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership of your decisions, you can build meaningful connections and make an impact with every claim.

National General is seeking an Inside Property Adjuster to join our Claims team. This position offers the flexibility of working primarily remotely while conducting occasional in-person inspections to assess homeowners' property claims.


Key Responsibilities

• For claims involving fraud or subrogation, partners with assigned reps from those areas to achieve best outcome

• Demonstrates intermediate understanding of insurance policies written by the company, the industry, and organizational relationships within the company and department

• Handles investigation regarding most aspects of homeowner first party claims (coverage, damages, subrogation) with the exercise of discretion and independence within increased level of authority

• Recognizes and identifies key components of residential construction and repair

• Identifies customer needs and works to meet those needs using appropriate customer service skills

• Demonstrates a basic understanding of systems and technology used within the company

• Learns how to determine subrogation or fraud potential and how to handle.

* This is a Hybrid position- if a claim is in your area, possible field travel if needed.


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.

Sign On Bonus:  

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 


 *Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.*


As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.


#LI-TR1

Business Acumen, Business Acumen, Case Management, Claims Administration, Claims Documentation, Claims Management System, Complex Claims, Customer Service, Homeowners Claims, Homeowners Insurance, Insurance Adjusting, Insurance Claim Handling, Insurance Claims, Insurance Underwriting, Loss Adjusting, Multitasking, Negotiation, Property Claims, Property Damage Claims, Property Insurance Claims, Residential Estimating, Residential Homes, Residential Property, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Task Management {+ 2 more}
