Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Denver, CO
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job! 

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims. 


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience: 

·        The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.  

·        The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.  

·        The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.  

·        The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations. 

·        The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.  

·        The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.   


Qualifications: 

·        2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired. 

·        Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired. 

·        Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating. 

·        Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements. 

·        Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service. 

·        Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively. 

·        Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work. 

·       This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents. 


Required Qualifications: 

·        Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.  

·        Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

·        Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements. 


You’re provided with comprehensive training: 

·        The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

·        Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

·        You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX. 


Notice of Licensing Requirement: 

·        As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire. 

·        If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed. 


Sign On Bonus:  

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 


*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.


Company Car: 

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work. 


Allstate Benefits: 

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes: 

·        Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement. 

·        Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance. 

·        Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role. 

·        Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. 


#LI-NJ1

Skills

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Multitasking, Negotiation, Time Management, Working Independently, Xactimate

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is $68,000 - $105,000 and is based on experience and qualifications,  location, and internal equity.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Senior Incident Handler leads the investigation and response to complex cybersecurity incidents across the enterprise; directs technical investigations, containment, eradication, and recovery activities; coordinates cross-functional response teams; and advises technical, business, and executive leadership on incident impact, risk, and actions required to contain threats and restore operations.

About the Role

We're rebuilding incident response from the ground up—and we want a proven responder to help lead the way. This is a chance to bring your hard-won expertise into a next-generation Security Operations program at Fortune 100 scale, where rapid response, automation, and AI-driven investigation are core to how we operate.

As our Senior Incident Handler, you'll be the technical anchor for our most significant security events—driving the response, raising the bar on how we work, and helping mature the team toward a formal, scalable incident command model we're building for the future.


If you've handled the incidents that make headlines (or quietly prevented them from becoming headlines), bring the instincts of a seasoned incident commander, and can move seamlessly from the server room to the boardroom, this is where your experience turns into real influence.

What You'll Own

  • Incident Handling & Response Leadership: Serve as the lead responder during critical incidents—owning the full lifecycle from detection through containment, eradication, and recovery. You'll help run the war room, coordinate responders, and make confident calls with incomplete information.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Unify analysts, infrastructure, application owners, legal, comms, and third-party partners into a single, fast-moving response. Relentless focus on reducing dwell time and mean-time-to-respond.
  • Executive Communication: Be a trusted voice during high-severity events—translating fast-moving technical realities into clear business impact for stakeholders up to the C-suite. You build calm and confidence when it matters most.
  • Deep Threat Investigation: Lead advanced investigations into malware, identity compromise, ransomware, and targeted attacks. Analyze logs, network, and forensic data to expose attacker tradecraft (lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration) and hunt down what others miss—leveraging EDR/XDR, SIEM, and cloud telemetry.
  • AI & Automation Leadership: Help modernize our SOC by putting cutting-edge automation and AI-assisted tooling to work—accelerating triage and enrichment without sacrificing human judgment.
  • Team Uplevel & Continuous Improvement: Raise the standard of how the team responds—sharpening detections, playbooks, and controls through meaningful after-action reviews, and helping shape the practices that will underpin our future incident command function.
  • Mentorship & Readiness: Coach L1/L2 analysts, share command-level tradecraft, and lead the tabletop exercises that keep the whole team sharp.

What You Bring 

  • Battle-tested IR experience: 5+ years in cybersecurity operations or incident response, with a track record of leading complex, enterprise-scale incidents end-to-end. Financial services or insurance experience is a plus—but great responders come from everywhere.
  • Command-level instincts: Demonstrated ability to act as an incident commander or technical lead in high-stakes moments—running major bridge calls and making decisive calls fast. You bring the judgment that helps a team operate like a mature command function.
  • Technical depth: Strong command of network security, EDR/XDR, log and forensic analysis, and threat hunting across on-prem and cloud. Comfortable with SIEM, forensics tooling, and scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell).
  • Communication range: Exceptional written and verbal skills; equally credible with engineers and executives.
  • Automation mindset: Enthusiasm for SOAR, ML-based tooling, and LLMs to elevate response workflows. 
  • Credentials: CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, OSCP or other certifications preferred.


Why This Role

You'll join at a pivotal moment—bringing your expertise to a team that's actively maturing, with the opportunity to help shape the incident command function we're building next. Job.JobTitle: Digital Product Manager – Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Product Manager, Technology / Insurtech, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

About Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms (ACO&P) is a net-new digital product organization within Cyber Operations, building the shared technology foundation for how modern cyber defense operates.

Our north star is an adaptive, engineering-led, AI-powered cyber operations platform that brings together high-fidelity security data, integrated tooling, AI, and automation to help defenders detect threats earlier, turn security telemetry into actionable intelligence, accelerate decision-making, and respond at machine speed.

Our mission is to connect the cyber operations lifecycle end to end, turning signals into trusted intelligence, intelligence into decisions, and decisions into protection. By reducing fragmentation and intelligently applying AI and automation, ACO&P enables cyber defenders to focus their expertise where human judgment matters most while building a cyber operations ecosystem that continuously adapts to an evolving threat landscape.

About the Role
As a Digital Product Manager in ACO&P, you will be a hands-on product owner for a defined area of the cyber operations portfolio. You will translate the needs of defenders, investigators, engineers, end users, and business partners into a clear roadmap and prioritized backlog, lead discovery, set iteration goals, and make the trade-offs that keep your team focused on the outcomes that matter most.

You will partner closely with engineering teams and with detection and response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, and platform teams to build on shared security data and integrations, connecting your product area to the broader ACO&P ecosystem rather than delivering isolated point solutions.

Open Roles
We are hiring Digital Product Managers for two distinct product areas. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each area.

Open Roles

We are hiring Digital Product Managers for three distinct product areas. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each area.


Key Responsibilities (All Roles)

  • Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for your product area, aligned to the ACO&P north star and the priorities of your partner teams.
  • Lead problem-first discovery and framing, translating defender, investigator, engineering, end-user, and business partner needs into validated problem statements, testable hypotheses, epics, and user stories.
  • Establish and track outcome-based KPIs that show measurable progress for your product area.
  • Partner with engineering and adjacent Cyber Operations teams to build on shared security data and integrations rather than isolated point solutions.
  • Support vendor evaluations, proofs of value, and build, buy, or retire decisions with clear acceptance criteria, usage models, and success measures.
  • Drive adoption and change management through documentation, communication, enablement, and feedback loops with users and stakeholders.
  • Design products with appropriate guardrails, including auditability and human oversight of AI-enabled and automated actions.

Required Qualifications (All Roles)

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in digital product management, platform product delivery, data product ownership, or enterprise tooling ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated success translating complex stakeholder needs into outcome-based roadmaps and prioritized backlogs.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Proven track record of defining strategy and using metrics to drive prioritization, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience operating in agile, product-centric delivery models.

Role Profiles and Preferred Qualifications


Preferred Qualifications (All Roles)

  • Familiarity with security operations and investigation workflows, including detection, threat hunting, incident response, digital forensics, and case management.
  • Experience with AI/ML-enabled products, workflow automation, or governance-by-design concepts such as auditability, access boundaries, policy enforcement, and safe automated actions.

Role 1: Digital Product Manager – Endpoint Security

Own the products that protect Allstate's endpoints, including endpoint detection and response, privilege management, and application control, moving from reactive, incident-driven changes to proactive, measurable risk reduction. You will work with a dedicated team of endpoint security engineers and report to the Lead Digital Product Manager – Endpoint & Data Defense.


Focus Areas

  • Endpoint coverage: ensure every endpoint is protected, with a clear, current view of where gaps remain and how they are being closed.
  • Prevention and controls: deploy protections and policy changes based on risk reduction, operational impact, and user experience, and scale block-by-default application control and least privilege with sustainable exception processes.
  • Alerting and containment: reduce alert noise, improve alert context, and enable fast, consistent device isolation.
  • Proactive defense: partner with threat intelligence, threat hunting, and purple teams to deploy protections ahead of emerging threats and vendor advisories.
  • AI-enabled operations: apply AI and automation to policy tuning, change deployment, and repetitive operational work.

Success is measured by endpoint coverage, prevention effectiveness, time to detect and contain, alert quality, deployment speed, and user experience.


Preferred Qualifications – Endpoint Security

  • Familiarity with endpoint security capabilities such as EDR, next-generation antivirus, endpoint privilege management, application control, or device control, using technologies like CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BeyondTrust, or similar.
  • Experience with large, heterogeneous endpoint environments, including Windows, macOS, Linux, virtual desktops, and cloud workloads.
  • Familiarity with threat-informed defense concepts such as MITRE ATT&CK and control validation.
  • Experience bringing product practices to infrastructure or operations teams, including iterative delivery and outcome-based change management.

Role 2: Digital Product Manager – Mission Control

Build Mission Control, a new product that gives Allstate's cyber defenders one unified operating experience, bringing intelligence, investigation context, and workflows from many separate security tools together in one place, with AI agents working alongside analysts. As an inaugural product role, you will partner with a dedicated engineering team to connect existing tools rather than replace them, and deliver early wins that move defenders faster from signal to decision to action.


Focus Areas

  • Unified operating view: give responders one central view of active incidents and investigations, relevant telemetry, and who is working on what, so context is not lost across tools and handoffs. 
  • Connected tools: integrate the SIEM, SOAR, case management, threat intelligence, endpoint, and ticketing tools defenders already use, along with the connections AI agents rely on, through a common, reusable integration layer.
  • Investigation and case workflows: streamline how alerts become cases and how investigations are coordinated across teams, cutting manual lookups and tool switching.
  • Decision support and AI agents: assemble evidence and recommend next steps with clear confidence information, laying the groundwork for governed, agent-assisted operations with humans accountable for high-impact decisions.
  • Adoption and trust: observe analysts' real workflows, earn their trust through transparency and audit trails, and retire old paths as the product proves its value.

Success is measured by fewer tool switches and manual lookups, less time spent assembling context, faster time to decide and act, clear visibility into investigation status, and analyst adoption and satisfaction.


Preferred Qualifications – Mission Control

  • Familiarity with security operations platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, XDR, and case management tools, using technologies like Microsoft Sentinel or similar.
  • Experience building analyst- or operator-facing workflow products, such as case management, incident management, or operations consoles, used by multiple teams.
  • Experience with integration and orchestration capabilities, such as APIs, event-driven workflows, or agent connectivity standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop AI or automation, including explainability, confidence signals, permissions, and audit trails.
  • Experience launching a new product from the ground up, including user research, prototyping, and early wins that drive adoption and build user trust.

Role 3: Digital Product Manager – WAF & Web Edge Protection

Own the products that protect Allstate's internet-facing web applications and APIs, including web application firewall (WAF), bot and API protection, and rapid virtual patching, across multiple providers, hosting platforms, and acquired businesses. Working with a dedicated team of WAF engineers, you will front the most exposed applications and APIs first, then build a reliable, measurable protection capability backed by deep in-house expertise. 


Focus Areas 

  • Exposure-led coverage: find the most exposed internet-facing applications and APIs and front them first, covering back-end services as well as front ends, with a clear, current view of protection status and remaining gaps. 
  • Protection and availability: partner with Digital Protection and application teams to balance aggressive tuning with legitimate traffic, move applications from alert-only to blocking mode with fast rollback, and track the availability and security indicators both sides rely on. 
  • Provider strategy and policy as code: lead use-case-based evaluations and proofs of value to select the right enterprise providers, consolidating where it improves outcomes while preserving resilience, and manage policy as code so one protection can be applied across every provider. 
  • Operations and rapid protection: shape a 24/7 support model with cyber operations, with clear runbooks and the ability to deploy emergency rules and virtual patches within hours of a newly exploited vulnerability. 
  • Reliability and AI-enabled operations: learn from outages and root cause analyses, feed WAF telemetry into shared security data, and apply AI and automation to tuning, onboarding, and repetitive operational work. 

Success is measured by coverage of the most exposed applications and APIs, blocking-mode adoption, time to deploy an emergency protection, availability impact from WAF changes, logging completeness, and the share of operations run by the in-house team.


Preferred Qualifications – WAF & Web Edge Protection

  • Familiarity with web application and API threats and protections, such as the OWASP Top 10, WAF, bot management, API security, and DDoS mitigation, using technologies like Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly, F5, or similar.
  • Familiarity with web delivery fundamentals, including DNS, TLS certificates, load balancers, reverse proxies, Kubernetes ingress, and content delivery networks.
  • Experience leading vendor evaluations, RFPs, or proofs of value for a security or infrastructure platform, using use-case-based criteria that weigh outcomes, resilience, and cost.
  • Experience with policy as code, infrastructure as code, or CI/CD pipelines for managing security controls at scale.
  • Experience standing up 24/7 operational support for a critical control, including on-call models, runbooks, service-level objectives, and building in-house expertise.

Supervisory Responsibilities

These roles do not have supervisory duties.

Skills

Job.JobTitle: Lead Digital Product Manager – Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Product Manager, Technology / Insurtech, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

About Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms (ACO&P) is a net-new digital product organization within Cyber Operations, building the shared technology foundation for how modern cyber defense operates.
Our north star is an adaptive, engineering-led, AI-powered cyber operations platform that brings together high-fidelity security data, integrated tooling, AI, and automation to help defenders detect threats earlier, turn security telemetry into actionable intelligence, accelerate decision-making, and respond at machine speed.

Our mission is to connect the cyber operations lifecycle end to end, turning signals into trusted intelligence, intelligence into decisions, and decisions into protection. By reducing fragmentation and intelligently applying AI and automation, ACO&P enables cyber defenders to focus their expertise where human judgment matters most while building a cyber operations ecosystem that continuously adapts to an evolving threat landscape.

About the Role
As a Lead Digital Product Manager in ACO&P, you will lead a portfolio of capabilities within the cyber operations ecosystem, shaping the product strategy for how those capabilities are delivered, measured, and continuously improved. As the portfolio evolves, you will identify, shape, and scale the capabilities that deliver the greatest value across Cyber Operations, balancing near-term needs with the long-term integrity, adoption, and outcomes of the platform.

You will lead and develop Digital Product Managers and partner closely with engineering leaders and Cyber Operations stakeholders to translate strategy into measurable outcomes, product roadmaps, and durable capabilities.

Open Roles
We are hiring Lead Digital Product Managers for three distinct portfolios. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each portfolio.

Key Responsibilities (All Roles)

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, outcomes, and roadmap for your portfolio, aligned to the ACO&P north star.
  • Lead, coach, and grow Digital Product Managers, building strong product practices in discovery, outcome definition, roadmapping, prioritization, and measurement.
  • Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs that connect your portfolio's performance, adoption, and user experience to Cyber Operations outcomes.
  • Translate complex Cyber Operations needs into a coherent product strategy, balancing immediate priorities with the foundational capabilities needed to unlock future value.
  • Drive connected capabilities that build on shared data, integrations, platform, workflow, and orchestration capabilities rather than isolated point solutions.
  • Define clear product boundaries, decision rights, and partnership models with adjacent teams across Cyber Operations, enterprise platforms, and engineering.
  • Advance AI and automation responsibly, establishing the product principles and guardrails needed for safe, auditable, and increasingly agentic cyber operations.
  • Guide build, buy, integrate, and retire decisions based on long-term value, user needs, resilience, interoperability, and portfolio integrity.
  • Stay close to defenders and the work, using continuous discovery, observation, product data, and feedback to understand friction, validate assumptions, and measure adoption and outcomes.
  • Communicate strategy, progress, evidence, and trade-offs to Cyber Operations leadership and stakeholders, resolving tensions between local needs and ecosystem-wide outcomes.

Required Qualifications (All Roles)

  • 8+ years of experience in digital product management, platform product leadership, or enterprise product delivery, with demonstrated experience leading, coaching, or influencing product teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading outcome-driven products, platforms, or portfolios in complex enterprise environments.
  • Track record of outcome-driven product management, including defining measurable outcomes, establishing baselines, using data to inform decisions, and prioritizing roadmaps against those outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder leadership with the ability to align engineering, platform, security, risk, and business partners around shared outcomes, priorities, and clear ownership boundaries.
  • Excellent strategic communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational topics clear and actionable for both executives and practitioners.

Role Profiles and Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications (All Roles)

  • Background in cybersecurity operations, such as SOC operations, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, or detection engineering.
  • Experience enabling AI and automation at scale, including agentic AI governance concepts such as guardrails, auditability, human oversight, and safe actions.

Role 1: Lead Digital Product Manager – Cyber Intelligence Platform

Lead the foundational platform that turns security telemetry into trusted, decision-ready intelligence and connects it to the tools and workflows defenders use every day, reducing fragmentation and accelerating the path from signal to decision to action.


Focus Areas

  • Trusted security data: make telemetry reliable, timely, observable, and enriched, with shared data standards that improve quality and interoperability across the ecosystem.
  • Connected operating experience: bring intelligence, tools, workflows, and AI together so defenders can investigate, decide, and respond with less friction.
  • Decision intelligence and trusted AI: turn security context into prioritized insights and safe automated actions, and enable AI agents to interact safely with security data and tools.
  • Extensible platform: drive reusable integrations, APIs, orchestration, and platform patterns that serve multiple Cyber Operations teams.
  • Success is measured by platform health, adoption, user experience, and operational effectiveness across Cyber Operations.

Preferred Qualifications – Cyber Intelligence Platform

  • Demonstrated success owning platform or data products used by multiple internal teams.
  • Experience with security data, observability, telemetry pipelines, or SIEM and analytics ecosystems, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Data Explorer, Cribl, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with KQL-style analytics, data normalization and schemas, and data quality and health concepts.
  • Experience building or leading internal developer or operator platforms, golden paths, APIs, orchestration, or workflow capabilities.
  • Experience with context enrichment, knowledge graphs, or decision-support products.

Role 2: Lead Digital Product Manager – Security Operations Missions

Lead the mission-focused capabilities that turn intelligence into protection, helping Cyber Operations discover threats earlier, investigate and respond faster, reduce exposure, and automate repetitive operational work.


Focus Areas

  • Threat discovery and intelligence: connect threat intelligence, hunting, detection, and security context to improve coverage, reduce noise, and focus on the highest-value threats.
  • Investigation and response: enable faster, more consistent investigation, containment, and response through connected workflows, decision support, and automation.
  • Exposure intelligence: combine vulnerability, threat, and business context to prioritize the exposures that matter most and measure risk reduction through remediation.
  • Scalable mission capabilities: work with frontline teams to turn workflows, decision logic, and response patterns into reusable, increasingly automated capabilities.
  • Success is measured by detection effectiveness, time to investigate and contain, exposure reduction, analyst effort, and automation effectiveness.


Preferred Qualifications – Security Operations Missions

  • Experience partnering closely with operational teams to translate frontline workflows and pain points into products that achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with security operations technologies and workflows, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, security analytics, and case management.
  • Familiarity with threat and exposure frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, threat-informed defense, and risk-based vulnerability prioritization.
  • Experience with insider threat or vulnerability and exposure management.
  • Experience building products that connect intelligence, operational workflows, and decision-making across multiple teams or systems.

Role 3: Lead Digital Product Manager – Endpoint & Data Defense

Lead the products that protect Allstate's endpoints and data across the enterprise and acquired businesses, moving from reactive, incident-driven control changes to proactive, threat-informed risk reduction while keeping friction low for end users.


Focus Areas

  • Endpoint coverage: protect every workstation, server, Mac, Linux, virtual desktop, and cloud workload, with clear visibility into gaps and compensating controls.
  • Prevention and hardening: advance EDR, privilege management, and application control that block malicious activity by default, deployed ahead of emerging threats with threat intelligence, hunting, and purple teams.
  • Data protection: evolve capabilities such as data loss prevention, encryption, removable media and data movement controls, and malware scanning of stored data.
  • Detection quality and containment: deliver high-fidelity telemetry, well-tuned policies, and reliable device isolation for detection, response, and threat hunting teams.
  • Portfolio rationalization: define clear scope with adjacent teams, retire overlapping tools, and break large policy and deployment changes into smaller, lower-risk increments.
  • Success is measured by coverage, prevention, detection, containment, risk reduction, and user experience.


Preferred Qualifications – Endpoint & Data Defense

  • Experience with endpoint security and data protection capabilities, such as EDR, endpoint privilege management, application control, DLP, encryption, or device control, using technologies like CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview, BeyondTrust, or similar.
  • Familiarity with large, heterogeneous endpoint environments and the trade-offs between protection and user experience.
  • Familiarity with threat-informed defense, MITRE ATT&CK, control validation, and purple team practices.
  • Experience with control governance and risk management, including coverage measurement, exception and risk-acceptance processes, and audit readiness.
  • Experience bringing multiple environments or acquired businesses onto common platforms, standards, and controls.

Supervisory Responsibilities

These roles lead, coach, and develop Digital Product Managers within their portfolio.

Skills

Cyber Defense, Cyber Operations, Cybersecurity Operations, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Influencing Others, Product Management, Product Organization, Product Ownership, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Product Vision, Security Analytics, Strategic Management, Systems Thinking

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 134,000.00 - 209,750.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Allstate’s sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from life’s uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy — no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $20 per hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $55,000–$82,510/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstate’s discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)

  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employee’s first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Allstate’s sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from life’s uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will: 

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment. 
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies. 
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy — no cold calling required. 
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience. 

Compensation & Benefits 

  • Base Pay: $20 per hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $55,000–$82,510/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
    • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstate’s discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including: 

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan 
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development 
  • Wellness programs  

Additional Benefits 

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on) 
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance 
  • Monthly internet reimbursement  
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate 

Why Join Allstate 

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you 
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company 
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates 
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience 
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customer’s needs 

Requirements 

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus) 
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred) 
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstate’s support 
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role. 
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies. 
  • High school diploma or GED required 
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet) 
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided) 
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends 
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching 
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills 
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts 
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance  
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously 

Essential Job Functions 

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement. 
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employee’s first 90 days of employment. 
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions. 
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs. 
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards. 
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers. 

This position is only available within the US, but not currently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents. 

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices. 

Reasonable Accommodation Statement 

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards. 

DS01

Customer Centricity, Customer Insights, Customer Sales, Digital Literacy, Inclusive Leadership, Learning Agility, Results-Oriented, Sales, Sales Operations, Strategic Selling

Target Total Compensation: $52,730–$76,480/year (Base Pay + Uncapped Performance-Based Incentives). Incentives are based on productivity and are not guaranteed. Payments are governed by the terms of the applicable sales bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstate’s discretion.
Base Pay: $18 per hour

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As an Assess Repair Adjuster you will be responsible for providing a superior level of customer service and attention to customers who have a vehicle that needs repaired. The individual virtually inspects damage to a vehicle (which may include automobiles, motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles and recreational vehicles), writes damage repair estimates, completes total loss valuations and negotiates moderately complex and occasionally complex settlements with repair facilities, tow yards, customers, and estimates repair times for rental/loss of use. The individual works independently, prioritizes the individual's own responsibilities, and manages the individual's own workload and is responsible for explaining coverage, estimates, claims, settlement, and rental processes to agents and/or customers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 18 months or more of Auto Collision estimating in CCC One, Audatex, or Mitchell
  • Previous experience in total loss adjustment or a related field is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in using estimating software and valuation tools for virtual assessments.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate moderate to complex vehicle damages effectively.
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in a virtual work environment.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a commitment to delivering accurate and timely results.

You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience.

  • The Customer Service Expert– you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each auto claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator– you’ll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator– you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator– You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver – you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder– you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Allstate Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our benefits: 

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan 
  • Ayco financial coaching 
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources 
  • Paid parental leave 
  • Adoption reimbursement 
  • Paid time off 
  • Tuition reimbursement 
  • Wellness incentives 
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities

Job.JobTitle: Investment Compliance Senior Consultant (Hybrid - Chicago, IL)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Compliance Senior Consultant assists the Investments Chief Compliance Office, Compliance Department, business unit and the senior leadership by designing, building, and overseeing a compliance program that ensures Allstate Investments and its two Investment Advisers comply with the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, state insurance laws relating to investments, and other requirements from Allstate's enterprise compliance program.

The Compliance Department protects Allstate Investments, its employees, and its clients through proactive investment compliance and risk management by ensuring that policies, procedures and practices are consistent with regulatory requirements. In addition, this role supports the business units by responding to semi complex day to day inquires and performs the semi complex day to day functions of the department.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partners with Investment Law, business areas and asset areas to draft, implement, and administer policies and procedures that incorporate regulatory requirements and operational controls.
  • Performs periodic risk assessments, reviews and tests to ensure successful implementation of policies and procedures through surveillance, monitoring, and examinations.
  • Prepares management and governance reports regarding compliance issues, investment limits and best execution.
  • Reports routine and semi complex compliance exceptions and materials to leadership and responds to in-depth questions.
  • Monitors client portfolios for compliance with Investment Policy and statutory investment limits, works to resolve routine and semi complex exceptions and administers compliance rules in the monitoring system.
  • Monitors regulatory developments and researches industry changes, trends, and best practices to recommend new or revised procedures as necessary.
  • Manages critical compliance related ad-hoc and special projects from inception to implementation.

Education and Experience

  • 4 year Bachelor’s Degree
  • 5 or more years of experience

Certifications, Licenses, Registrations

  • No Certification, License or Registration is required for the job.

Functional Skills

  • In depth knowledge of insurance statutes and securities regulations pertaining to investments and SEC registered investment advisers.
  • Ability to identify, document and mitigate potential compliance-related issues.
  • A high degree of discretion and confidentiality.
  • Team player with strong organizational, interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong work ethic, initiative, and a proactive approach.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Consistently demonstrate a positive mindset and behavior.

 Work Location

  • This role offers a hybrid work arrangement, with the designated office location in Chicago, IL (Riverpoint).

 Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Education & Experience (in lieu)

  • In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Analytical Thinking, Business Technology, Compliance, Critical Thinking, Investments, Problem Analysis, Problem Solving, Regulatory Compliance, Repointing, Risk Mitigation, SEC Compliance, SEC Regulations

Allstate Insurance Company has an opportunity for an experienced licensed Sales Leader to support the market in Michigan. The Sales Market Leader (SML) supports Allstate Exclusive Agents to consult about their business success. The SML supports the growth and success of the distribution channel and its new agency owners and/or existing exclusive agents. This is achieved through effective consultations, acquisition and retention process adoption, business planning and deployment/staffing strategies.  Influence’s behavior changes with the ability to coach/engage agency owners. 

Mobility preferred but not required.

  • Communicating Allstate messages to EAs, apply the message to the agency-specific business model, and assisting EAs and EFSs, as requested, to create an action plan to adjust operations accordingly

Job.JobTitle: Territory Sales Manager (Columbus, OH) - National General
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

• Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Household package coverages (based on state availability)

• Develops and maintains the assigned market’s new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level with large Independent Agents driving package product growth & coach new TSM’s

• Consults with IA’s by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position National General products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

• Delivers on the business unit’s annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on Household package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director.

• Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan, educating on package products to drive agency growth

• Collaborates with IAs to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

• Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

• Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and Underwriting trends filed and implemented in the market

• Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software


Candidates must reside in the greater Columbus, OH area.


Experience

• 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Consultative Selling, Relationship Building, Sales Management, Strategic Collaboration, Territory Management

Base Salary: $95,000 - $105,000 plus incentives based on performance

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Allstate’s sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from life’s uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Inside Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy — no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Pay: $20 per hour
    • Average Total Compensation: $55,000–$82,510/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
    • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstate’s discretion.
  • Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet stipend
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customer’s needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty license in your state of residence (preferred)

  • If Unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstate's support.

  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated any Allstate. This includes non-resident Producer licenses in all states required by this role.

  • If Hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments, and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance 
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.

  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employee’s first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within the US, but not currently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.


Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.
This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today! 


As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique? 

  • Day 1 Benefits 
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • 0 – 2 years of experience 
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company. 
  • #LI-RR3


Skills

Compensation

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour 
 
Total Compensation: 
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Travelers' Experience Design (XD) team creates solutions to ensure best-in-class experiences for our customers, agents, employees, and partners. This Lead Experience Designer will provide design expertise and leadership within the Management Liability Value Stream, contributing to experience vision and strategy while collaborating with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to deliver unified, inclusive, and valuable experiences for customers, agents, policyholders, and employees. You'll work across a mix of established platforms and newer, AI-powered tools and capabilities - helping both to modernize legacy systems with AI-driven enhancements and to shape net-new, AI-native experiences from the ground up. This work spans underwriting, broker, and policyholder-facing experiences, sometimes within the real constraints of existing systems, competing priorities, and multiple initiatives running in parallel. With guidance and strategic direction from Experience Design (XD) leadership, you will turn insights into actionable observations, define and implement service and product solutions across one or more channels, and develop your skills. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US.The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, this this role.

What Will You Do?

  • As the practice matures, XD is deliberately moving earlier into the process - from validating decisions after they're made to shaping strategy and priorities from the start. You'll be expected to help drive that shift.

  • Provide design expertise across initiatives, supporting product and journey vision and strategy, and contributing to organizational decision-making - earlier in the process, not just after direction is already set.
  • Lead the research and design of solutions for products and services by defining, creating, and improving models, concepts, and design elements (e.g., experience goals, journey maps, information architecture, scenarios, personas, interactions, content, visuals, etc.) guided by established design objectives, principles, and standards.
  • Plan and execute mixed-method user research and usability testing; lead synthesis and insights generation; analyze and communicate results and recommendations to stakeholders - and advocate for those findings to inform decisions before they're locked in.
  • Guide collaborative activities with end users, business, and technology partners, and outside partners, integrating a human-centered focus informed by research-based insights and design exploration.
  • Communicate design direction and rationale clearly; solicit and synthesize feedback; support prioritization across a fragmented, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Apply accessibility standards including WCAG and Travelers Digital Accessibility Policy, integrating inclusive design principles and demonstrating familiarity with accessibility testing tools such as Axe and screen readers.
  • Apply the Travelers Design System and Agile methodology, demonstrating design phases using the Human-Centered Design Double Diamond approach.
  • Leverage experience strategy and design to enhance business outcomes; identify missed opportunities and areas where experiences no longer align with goals, particularly where legacy constraints limit what's currently possible.
  • Contribute to the adoption of improved tools, methods, and processes within the XD practice.
  • Ensure all design work is aligned with brand guidelines and standards, maintaining a high bar for quality and consistency across projects.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects across different platforms and initiatives, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines in a fast-changing environment.
  • Stay current on industry trends and best practices in experience design, particularly in AI-powered product design, and apply them to advance the practice.
  • Participate in and contribute to Experience Design Community events, sharing knowledge across value streams and the broader enterprise.

  • Strong design thinking and ability to work across complex, multi-channel, multi-platform environments
