The Business Insights & Analytics Leadership Development Program (BI&ALDP) internship is built for analytically driven students who are serious about launching a career in data and analytics. This is not a passive, observational internship - you will do real work, solve real business problems, and be evaluated like a professional from day one.

Over 10 weeks, you and your cohort of peers will be embedded in Travelers' data and analytics community, gaining hands-on experience in one or more of our core analytics disciplines while building the technical and professional skills that define a successful career.

Technical training is delivered to you by current full-time BI&ALDP participants - those who were recently in your position - giving you an authentic, peer-informed perspective on what it takes to grow here.

Housing: The internship program is based in Hartford, CT and St. Paul, MN. Positions are available in our business units and corporate departments. Subsidized apartments are available for students who live beyond a commutable distance from Hartford, CT or St. Paul, MN.

Positions are available from June through early August.

What Will You Do?

  • Real project work aligned to active business needs across Travelers' analytics functions.
  • Technical training taught by full-time BI&ALDP participants.
  • Formal performance reviews that give you honest, structured feedback on your growth.
  • Leadership exposure through company-wide events including the Intern Symposium and community outreach initiatives, where you will interact with leaders and a cohort across the enterprise.
  • A collaborative capstone presentation where you and your fellow interns develop and present solutions to relevant business and analytics challenges.
  • Leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • At the close of the internship, top-performing interns are eligible to interview for a full-time offer to join the BI&ALDP - making these 10 weeks one of the most important career opportunities of your academic journey.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Cumulative GPA of 3.2 or greater preferred.
  • Obtained or pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science or Geography.
  • Exposure to ESRI ArcGIS Pro and other GIS mapping software and platforms.
  • Comfortable with using Python.
  • Experience with spatial statistics, including working knowledge of map projects and coordinate system variations.
  • Data warehouse and ETL understanding with Python, SQL, and/or Snowflake.

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, we're building the future of insurance - and Team Breeze is at the center of that work. This role puts you at the intersection of large language models (LLMs), cloud-native infrastructure, and real business impact. If you've shipped AI agent systems to production and want to do it again at scale, we'd like to talk.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead the design, configuration and development of complex, high-visibility AI applications on Team Breeze with a focus on LLM agents, retrieval pipelines and production reliability.
  • Design and implement agent orchestration flows using AWS Bedrock AgentCore and/or frameworks such as LangGraph, including tool calling, routing and prompt strategies for Claude models on Bedrock.
  • Own the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline end to end - from document ingestion (SharePoint/LivePublish to S3), processing and embedding in Databricks, and serving from a vector store via Python retrieval APIs (FastAPI/Haystack) - including evaluation steps that measure retrieval and answer quality before each release.
  • Architect and build services on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront/Lambda@Edge, Route 53, Secrets Manager/Vault and Bedrock application inference profiles to track and manage cost.
  • Develop and operate containerized retrieval and evaluation services on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), deployed with Helm and ArgoCD, including OpenTelemetry collector integration exporting traces to Dynatrace, S3 and Braintrust.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD using Terraform (Terraform Enterprise), GitHub Actions and TEP pipelines to deliver reliable, repeatable deployments.
  • Build and maintain the application layer across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 (Lambda xAPIs) and React 19/Vite for front-end UI experiences.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical, high-impact production issues, including debugging across AWS services, Kubernetes workloads, data pipelines and observability tooling.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to teammates, fostering strong engineering practices around design documentation, testing, evaluations, code reviews and operational readiness.
  • Continuously apply knowledge of current AI/LLM, cloud and observability trends to improve system design, developer productivity and business outcomes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • LLM and Agent Systems
    • Demonstrated experience shipping LLM/agent systems to production - not just demos or prototypes.
    • Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, prompt and routing design, RAG retrieval quality tuning, and defining evaluations to measure LLM and retrieval performance.
    • Experience with Strands, LangGraph or Bedrock AgentCore is a plus.
  • Cloud, Infrastructure and Operations
    • Strong AWS serverless and EKS experience; able to design and debug systems spanning Lambda, API Gateway and Kubernetes-based containers in production.
    • Practical experience authoring and maintaining Terraform, Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TEP).
    • Observability fluency: tracing with OpenTelemetry or Dynatrace, structured logging with correlation IDs, cost tracking and incident handling.
  • Full-Stack and Data Pipeline Ownership
    • Comfortable working across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 in the service layer and React 19/Vite on the front end.
    • Familiar with data and retrieval pipelines from ingestion through embedding to vector-store-backed APIs.
    • Consistent habit of writing tests, evaluations and data-quality checks.
  • Delivery
    • Advanced delivery skills, including the ability to determine software design strategy and methodology, use automated tests and informed feedback loops to ensure quality and production readiness, and monitor the health of work efforts and adjacent systems.
  • Domain Expertise
    • Demonstrated track record of developing business partnerships and influencing priorities by identifying solutions aligned with current business objectives; closely follows industry trends relevant to the domain and shares knowledge with coworkers.
  • Problem Solving
    • Strong problem solver who uses data and proofs of concept to find creative solutions, reflects on outcomes, measures impact and uses that information to optimize - including decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications.
  • Communication
    • Able to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives clearly and concisely, collaborate effectively regardless of role, and give and receive constructive feedback; an attentive and empathetic listener.
  • Leadership
    • Takes action even when there is no clear owner; inspires and motivates others and is effective at influencing team members.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 6 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Under moderate supervision, this position is responsible for partnering with claim professionals to assist customers. Responsibilities within the team include building customer relationships, completing financial transactions, updating and managing important business information, and handling numerous other duties and projects. This position does not manage others.

What Will You Do?

  • CLAIM OPERATIONAL SERVICE AND PARTNERSHIPS: Partners with claim professionals in multiple departments to assist with the timely resolution of claims, which may include: Properly documents claim files, including notes and diaries, Requests reports and records, and reviews medical bills, mail and wage statements. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office. This position services a territory in Binghamton, NY. You must either reside in or be willing to relocate at your own expense to assigned territory.

This position will support the Binghamton NY area/territory.

What Will You Do?

  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under limited supervision. Typically, will handle personal insurance claims with limited supervision and higher authority and begin to handle business insurance claims with direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, and third-party vendors.
  • Investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for property damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilize as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates, with guidance from management.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate with multiple constituents, i.e., contractors or insured's representatives with guidance.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Two years of property claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • One year of property or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is the Opportunity?

Under general supervision, manage Workers' Compensation claims with lost time to conclusion and negotiate settlements where appropriate to resolve claims. Coordinate medical and indemnity position of the claim with a Medical Case Manager. Independently handles assigned claims of low to moderate complexity where Wage loss and the expectation is a return to work to modified or full duty or obtain MMI with no RTW. There are no litigated issues or minor to moderate litigated issues. The claim may involve minor sprains/ minor to moderate surgery. The Injured worker is working modified duty and receiving ongoing medical treatment. The injured worker has returned to work, reached Maximum Medical Improvement (MMI) and is receiving PPD benefits. File will close as soon as the PPD is paid out. Independently handles all assigned claims up to and including most complex where Injured worker (IW) remains out of work and unlikely to return to position. Employer is unable to accommodate the restrictions. The claim involves moderate to complex litigation issues IW has returned to work, reached Maximum Medical Improvement (MMI), and has PPD. File litigated to dispute the permanency rating and/or causality. IW has been released to work with permanent restrictions and job is no longer available. IW is receiving Vocational Rehabilitation. Claims that have been reopened for additional medical treatment on more complex files. Injuries may involve one or multiple back, shoulder or knee surgeries, knee replacements, claims involving moderate to complex offsets, permanent restrictions and/or fatalities. Claims on which a settlement should be considered.

What Will You Do?

  • Conduct investigations, including, but not limited to assessing policy coverage, contacting insureds, injured workers, medical providers, and other parties in a timely manner to determine compensability.
  • Establish and update reserves to reflect claim exposure and document rationale. Identify and set actuarial reserves. Apply knowledge to determine causal relatedness of medical conditions.
  • Manage files with an emphasis on file quality (including timely contact and proper documentation and proactive resolution of outstanding issues). Achieve a positive end result by returning injured party to work and coordinating the appropriate medical treatment in collaboration with internal nurse resources where appropriate.
  • Develop strategies to manage losses involving issues of statutory benefit entitlement, medical diagnoses, Medicare Set Aside to achieve resolution through the best possible outcome. Work in collaboration with specialty resources (i.e. medical and legal) to proactively pursue claim resolution opportunities, (i.e. return to work, structured settlement, and discontinuation of benefits through litigation).
  • Develop strategies to manage losses involving issues of statutory benefit entitlement, medical diagnoses, Medicare Set Aside to achieve resolution through the best possible outcome
  • Collaborate with our internal nurse resources (Medical Case Manager) in order to integrate the delivery of medical services into the overall claim strategy.
  • Prepare necessary letters and state filings within statutory limits. Pursue all offset opportunities, including apportionment, contribution and subrogation.
  • Evaluate claims for potential fraud. Proactively manage inventory with documented plans of action to ensure timely and appropriate file closing or reassignment.
  • Proactively manage moderate to complex litigation to drive files to an optimal outcome, including resolution of benefits. Understand and apply Medicare Set Asides and allocations.
  • Negotiate settlement of claims within designated authority. May use structured settlement/annuity as appropriate for the jurisdiction. Apply deep technical expertise to assist in the resolution of highly complex claims. Mentor other Claim Professionals
  • Participate in Telephonic and/or onsite File Reviews. Respond to inquiries - verbal and written. Keep injured worker apprised of claim status

What Is the Opportunity?

The GenBI Insights Platform is one of the most strategically ambitious initiatives within EDDA - and it is already in motion. The target state conceptual architecture exists. Early implementation work is underway, and the platform's foundational direction has been set with intention. What comes next is where the real architectural work begins: proving out the architecture through implementation, refining it where reality pushes back on theory, and advancing the platform's capabilities into territory that remains genuinely complex.
The Lead Architect for this platform will report directly to the AVP of Data Products and Enablement and serve as the primary architectural authority for the GenBI Insights Platform - owning its reference architecture, driving its technical strategy, and ensuring that as the platform matures and expands, it does so on a foundation that is coherent, production-hardened, observable, and trustworthy. You will collaborate closely with Line of Business architecture and engineering teams across the enterprise, ensuring the platform's architecture remains aligned with - and additive to - the broader technology landscape it operates within.
This is a role for an architect who is as rigorous about production reliability and observability as they are energized by advancing a platform that is genuinely breaking new ground for the enterprise. The GenBI Insights Platform has a strong architectural foundation and genuine organizational momentum behind it. The work ahead - proving the architecture through implementation, hardening capabilities for production, and advancing the platform into agentic territory - is substantial, consequential, and technically rich. This is not a maintenance role or a steady-state assignment. It is the work of taking something with real potential and making sure the architecture is equal to it.
The foundation is set. The harder, more interesting work is what comes next.

What Will You Do?

  • Scope:
  • You will own the reference architecture for the GenBI Insights Platform as it moves from concept through implementation and into ongoing capability expansion - refining it as the platform encounters real-world complexity, extending it as new capabilities are brought into scope, making buy vs build decisions and maintaining its coherence as the technology landscape it depends on continues to evolve.
  • You will set the architectural standards the platform is built to and provide the technical direction that ensures every new component strengthens rather than complicates the overall design.
  • You will drive the architectural strategy for the platform's AI capabilities with a sustained focus on what it takes to move from early implementation to production-ready at enterprise scale.
  • You will collaborate actively with Line of Business architecture and engineering teams to ensure the platform's design accounts for varied data landscapes, integration patterns, and use case requirements across Travelers' business units.
  • You will engage with peer architects across EDDA's value streams, contributing the platform's perspective to cross-domain architectural decisions and incorporating theirs into the platform's continuing evolution.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Technical Expertise & Education:
  • Bachelor's degree in technology-related field or equivalent, with 8 to 10 years of architecture experience.
  • Advanced level architecture and recent hands-on strong engineering experience with modern technologies.
  • Successful execution of complex, large scale technology strategies.
  • You bring substantial architecture experience with genuine depth in AI, data, and knowledge architecture.
  • You have worked with enterprise context layers and you understand the tooling landscape, the structural trade-offs, and the downstream implications of the modeling decisions made at this layer
  • On the AI side, your experience is current and applied. You have worked with RAG-based architectures, vectorization approaches, and LLM evaluation frameworks in real delivery contexts, and you understand what separates a well-constructed AI capability from one that looks good in a demo and struggles in production. You know what observability, traceability, and hallucination mitigation require at the architectural level - not as concepts, but as design decisions with real implementation consequences.
  • Leadership & Influence:
  • Advanced leadership skills with the ability to leverage cross-functional networks to collaborate with architecture and engineering leaders on problem-solving, build company-wide credibility, prioritize critical architectural challenges, and strengthen the Architecture organization through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and creating development opportunities for team members.
  • Strategic & Business Acumen:
  • Extensive experience working in an agile operational model.
  • Advanced experience supporting transformational change. Able to adjust plans, priorities and strategies in response to changing circumstances.
  • Experience developing technology target states and roadmaps that align to short- and long-term business goals.
  • Insurance technology experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of value creation and business capability models.
  • Strong knowledge of the insurance industry.
  • Advanced experience identifying and analyzing current/future problems and opportunities, evaluating information to understand root causes, and exploring alternative solutions for effective decision-making.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with colleagues to achieve mutually responsible results.
  • Extensive experience exercising sound judgment, making decisions and committing to a position.
  • Advanced and effective verbal, written and listening communication skills.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 7 additional years of architecture/software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of technical leadership experience.

When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

  • Decide backlog priorities and sequencing for the producer management platform, including its AI assistant products.

AI products

Leadership and collaboration

What Is the Opportunity?

Manage Workers' Compensation claims with lost time to conclusion and negotiate settlements where appropriate to resolve claims. Coordinate medical and indemnity position of the claim with a Medical Case Manager. Independently handles assigned claims of low to moderate complexity where Wage loss and the expectation is a return to work to modified or full duty or obtain MMI with no RTW. There are no litigated issues or minor to moderate litigated issues. The claim may involve minor sprains/ minor to moderate surgery The injured worker is working modified duty and receiving ongoing medical treatment. The injured worker as returned to work, reached Maximum Medical Improvement (MMI) and is receiving PPD benefits. File will close as soon as the PPD is paid out. With close to moderate supervision, may handle claims of greater complexity where Injured worker (IW) remains out of work and unlikely to return to position. Employer is unable to accommodate the restrictions. The claim involves moderate to complex litigation issues IW has returned to work, reached Maximum Medical Improvement (MMI), and has PPD. File litigated to dispute the permanency rating and/or causality. IW has been released to work with permanent restrictions and there has been a change in the current position. IW is receiving Vocational Rehabilitation. Claims that have been reopened for additional medical treatment on more complex files. Injuries may involve one or multiple back, shoulder or knee surgeries, knee replacements, claims involving moderate to complex offsets, permanent restrictions and/or fatalities. Claims on which a settlement should be considered.

What Will You Do?

  • Conduct investigations, including, but not limited to assessing policy coverage, contacting insureds, injured workers, medical providers, and other parties in a timely manner to determine compensability
  • Establish and update reserves to reflect claim exposure and document rationale. Identify and set actuarial reserves. Apply knowledge to determine causal relatedness of medical conditions.
  • Manage files with an emphasis on file quality (including timely contact and proper documentation and proactive resolution of outstanding issues). Achieve a positive end result by returning injured party to work and coordinating the appropriate medical treatment.in collaboration with internal nurse resources where appropriate.

Travelers' accounting team serves as the steward of our financial information and controls to ensure compliance with all internal policies and external requirements. The team creates transparency about the health of the company by providing timely, accurate, and actionable information to all stakeholders.

As a Sr Accountant, you will be responsible for timely and accurate books and records for reporting to both internal and external parties while maintaining a strong control environment. What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Auto Damage, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage personal and business insurance damage claims involving various types of automobiles as well as heavy equipment, mobile equipment, and property damage. This role involves frequent customer interactions through telephone and written communications. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assess coverage to determine compensability.
  • Investigate by gathering information from policyholders, claimants, and witnesses.
  • Partner with resources, as needed, to obtain other evidence in order to properly handle the claim. Assess claims for potential fraud.
  • Establish appropriate claim reserves, determine the claim resolution amount, and issue accurate payments.
  • Develop and execute action plans for effective claim resolution.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status, including business customers.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new workflows, technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

As a Northland Transportation Liability Claim Representative you will be responsible for managing and investigating low to moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments within appropriate authority and oversight. In this fast-paced, detail-oriented and customer-focused role, you will work closely with customers, claimants, attorneys, and other parties to ensure claims are resolved accurately and efficiently while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and service. You may provide training and coaching to less experienced claim professionals.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles low to moderately complex personal and/or business insurance liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with policy terms and management guidance. Leverage internal resources, as appropriate.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, opposing counsel, third-party vendors, internal stakeholders, and other parties.
  • Negotiate with multiple constituents (e.g., claimants, attorneys, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • Handle low complexity litigation.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.

  • Two years of liability, bodily injury or comparable experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze situations, exercise sound judgement, make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Inside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for virtually inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working with our direct repair partners to address vehicle owner damages, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. For this role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes.

What Will You Do?

  • Review and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual inspections.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with Direct Repair partners, claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • May deploy to on-site inspections and have the ability to transport to meet with customers.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.

The role requires validating data, identifying trends and variances, and presenting findings clearly to BC business unit leads and Middle Market Finance partners. The successful candidate has strong Excel skills, adapts well to shifting priorities and looks for ways to streamline and automate reporting. Experience with reporting tools such as IPA (TM1) and ReportWorq is a plus, and the team will support the right candidate in building those skills. This role offers the chance to build strong relationships with business partners and grow toward more independent ownership of analysis.

What Will You Do?

  • Prepare, evaluate, and validate financial and operational reports.
  • Analyze and interpret trends and variances in business performance, while interacting with cross functional peers on a frequent basis.
  • Perform testing and validation of data and analyses when applicable.
  • Synthesize and present exhibits, results, observations, and recommendations to direct manager, team members and/or cross functional peers.
  • Support your financial and business partners in the creation of analyses to support business strategy.
  • Review competitor press releases, SEC filings, and industry trade press for helpful insights, linking key themes together.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or pursuing a Master's in Business Administration with a concentration in finance or accounting, or professional designations such as CPA, CMA or comparable advanced professional education.
  • Experience with Financial Analysis concepts and processes and accounting practices and principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with business partners.
  • Ability to analyze data to interpret trends and provide insights to management.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle shifting priorities.
  • Ability to foresee challenges and proactively look for ways to create more efficient processes for the business.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office (e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and Financial Reporting Software (e.g. TM1, Essbase, Hyperion, etc.).

What is a Must Have?

  • May manage Agile Product Owners.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Three years of experience articulating and translating business strategy, product vision, and analysis for a product.

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Personal Insurance (PI) business. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams.

  • Influence agency partners through effective communication and negotiation skills.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, such as Product and Underwriting to ensure alignment of sales strategies with business objectives.

  • Develop knowledge of competitor products and capabilities and local market trends.
  • Utilize advanced data and analytics for sales decisions and performance measurement, leveraging extensive knowledge of Travelers' systems and platforms to support the sales process.
  • Leverage AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (or willingness to pursue).
  • Strong knowledge of Travelers products and general Property & Casualty marketplace.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills to encourage agency partners to adopt Travelers products and services.
  • Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to define goals and priorities and meet these goals in a timely manner.
  • Exceptional organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities to meet sales goals and deadlines effectively.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What Is the Opportunity?

As a member of Enterprise AI Products & Emerging Tech, you'll be joining a strategic and collaborative team that is passionate about transforming our business and technology capabilities and paving the way for best-in-class technology, data and analytics.
Travelers is seeking a Senior Director, Applied AI to join Enterprise AI Products & Emerging Tech as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will lead and manage teams of AI-native engineers who deliver production AI solutions with and for Lines of Business. Individual will also plan and execute at a strategic level, lead and influence outcomes across multiple teams and business partners, lead the design, development and implementation of significantly complex, unscoped AI solutions that extend beyond the confines of a team, and establish AI-native engineering best practices and standards.

  • Lead teams of AI-native engineers and emerging leaders while role modeling Travelers' leadership behaviors.
  • Lead Applied AI engagements, from sustained strategic initiatives requiring deep discovery and architecture ownership to rapid field engagements embedded with Lines of Business that validate feasibility through working prototypes.
  • Partner with Line of Business leaders to identify, prioritize and shape high-value AI use cases, taking business problems directly to a scoped written intent with clear production intent, and align work with business and engineering priorities to realize meaningful impact.
  • Set direction for when to apply non-deterministic, AI-enabled design patterns versus traditional deterministic approaches, based on risk tolerance.
  • Establish AI-native engineering practices across teams, including spec and plan workflows, autonomy matched to risk, guardrails, evaluation before changes ship, and accountability standards so engineers own AI-assisted output as the accountable author.

  • Build AI-native capabilities across multiple teams, assess skill gaps, drive an AI learning strategy, and set the learning example for others.
  • Build collaborative relationships with key leaders and peers across the organization (i.e. Team Leaders, CoEs) to ensure the best use of overall resources, and present recommendations that influence executive decisions on AI investment and technology direction.
  • Develop a robust talent and leadership pipeline, providing technical leadership, mentorship, feedback and unique development opportunities to each team member.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • AI-Native Engineering - Experience establishing AI-native practices at an organizational level, including spec-and-plan workflows, context engineering, deterministic guardrails, evaluation suites that gate changes, living convention files and skills that encode policy, and parallel work streams sized to what one person can review.
  • Delivery - Advanced delivery skills including the ability to take AI solutions into production with evaluation, monitoring and human review, assess engineering strategies across an organization, and ensure the quality, production readiness and continued health of systems that meet nonfunctional requirements.
  • Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of applied AI and machine learning expertise, combining traditional ML with LLM-based approaches, consulting on business priorities, and thoughtfully and practically introducing concepts and technologies from the industry.
  • Problem Solving - Exceptional problem solver who leads architecture across multiple teams, balances deterministic and AI-mediated approaches based on risk, creates architecture robust against single points of failure in both systems and people, and looks ahead multiple quarters to turn areas of need into action.
  • Communication - Excellent communicator who explains AI capabilities, limits and risks in business terms to executive audiences, documents effectively so systems can be maintained or built upon, and gains consensus across disparate groups.
  • Leadership - Advanced leadership skills including coaching senior engineers and emerging leaders, building a leadership pipeline, and improving the entire engineering organization by teaching others and creating opportunities for others to develop.

  • Production experience leading the design and delivery of agentic workflows, LLM integrations, or AI-powered automations, including evaluation, monitoring and human review of AI outputs.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools as the accountable author, with complete ownership of outputs.
  • Applied machine learning experience including model selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation in production environments.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with Terraform, MongoDB or comparable NoSQL data stores, and Temporal or comparable workflow orchestration tools.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation methods, including designing evaluation datasets and measuring model performance in production.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, or RAG architectures.
  • Exposure to MCP server configurations or multi-agent frameworks.
  • Experience with ML observability, drift detection, observability tooling or distributed tracing in production environments.
  • Familiarity with zero-trust security principles or secure-by-design development practices in enterprise AI systems.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 7 additional years of software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of technical leadership experience.

Travelers Insurance is seeking a highly skilled and knowledgeable Sr Claim Counsel to join our Bond & Specialty Insurance team. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. As a Sr Claim Counsel, you will effectively manage all assigned BSI claims, typically of moderate to high severity and complexity with very limited guidance from management. Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. $47,700.00 - $78,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers fosters a culture of innovation, respect, and empowerment, bringing together different backgrounds and perspectives. We are dedicated to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We seek resourceful candidates with excellent communication skills to join our team and contribute to our goal of being the top choice for customers and a key partner for agents and brokers. Travelers is looking for an Associate Operations Account Specialist (AOAS) to learn and grow in a supportive environment. You will work towards achieving business goals and objectives while receiving comprehensive mentorship and training to help you develop your skills and reach your full potential.

What Will You Do?

  • Successfully complete applicable market new hire training and certification.
  • Learn to manage multi-state, multi-line accounts throughout their lifecycle, including rating/pricing, quoting, issuing policies, and handling related account activities.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with teammates, business partners and agents.
  • Learn standardized workflows and state compliance guidelines to understand business processes.
  • Analyze multiple sources of information to make sound decisions.
  • Develop critical thinking and decision-making skills to enhance business partner and customer confidence.
  • Execute service level commitments and deliver quality products in a timely manner.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Proficient in standard business software, such as Microsoft Office or equivalent.
  • Analytical thinking and judgment to analyze and compare information.
  • Time and desk management skills to organize and manage multiple priorities.
  • Effective verbal, written, and listening communication skills.
  • Ability to deliver service excellence to internal and external partners to ensure a positive experience.
  • Collaboration skills to work effectively in team situations.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Working knowledge of standard business software, such as Microsoft Office or equivalent.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$53,800.00 - $88,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Workers Compensation, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage workers compensation claims.

This program can typically last up to 12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until 12/3/2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assist in reviewing, investigating, and documenting Workers Compensation claims under close supervision.
  • Investigate, develop, and evaluate action plans for claim resolution. Assess coverage and determine if a claim is compensable under Workers Compensation including evaluating claims for potential fraud.
  • Participate in Telephonic and/or onsite File Reviews.
  • Learn how to determine coverage, compensability, and exposure based on policy terms and claim facts.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status which may include our business customers, injured employees, medical providers, and legal counsel.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Achieve a positive result by returning an injured party to work when appropriate. This may include coordinating medical treatment in collaboration with internal or external resources.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

The People Experience Center (PEC) Case Specialist provides responsive, personalized support to employees throughout their employment experience. As a PEC Case Specialist, you will serve as a subject matter expert in U.S. Leave of Absence administration, helping employees, managers, and business partners navigate complex and sensitive situations while driving operational excellence and process transformation. This role combines deep leave expertise, stakeholder partnership, and technology-enabled continuous improvement to enhance the employee experience.


What makes us different?

  • Opportunity to influence and modernize leave administration processes across the organization.
  • Partnership with Legal, Total Rewards, Payroll, People Partners, and external vendors.
  • Exposure to enterprise-wide initiatives, automation, and AI-powered transformation.
  • Ability to make a meaningful impact during sensitive employee life events.
  • Collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and employee experience.What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?
  • Manage complex U.S. Leave of Absence cases, including intermittent, extended, disability-related, and return-to-work situations.
  • Partner with employees, managers, Payroll, Legal, Total Rewards, People Partners, and Lincoln Financial to ensure accurate and timely case resolution.
  • Regularly provide live phone support to employees and leaders, in addition to chat, email and case work. Use empathy, sound judgment and clear communication to explain requirements, de-escalate concerns and drive issues through resolution. Candidates should be comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls involving complex, sensitive or escalated situations.
  • Identify potential compliance risks and situations that require guidance or escalation to Legal, Total Rewards or other subject-matter experts.
  • Apply knowledge of federal and state leave regulations, including FMLA and related programs.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation, AI adoption, and operational enhancements.
  • Maintain case documentation and leverage case management tools, Workday, and digital resources effectively.
  • Contribute to special projects, system enhancements, testing activities, and annual People Organization initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Minimum of 3 years of direct experience administering and supporting U.S. leave of absence programs, including complex, sensitive and escalated cases; overlapping leave entitlements; intermittent and extended absences and disability-related matters; and return-to-work scenarios.
  • Strong working knowledge of FMLA, ADA considerations, applicable state family and medical leave, paid leave and sick leave programs, and the interaction of leave administration with ERISA-governed benefit plans and HIPAA privacy requirements.
  • Experience managing complex, sensitive, and escalated employee situations.
  • Extensive knowledge of federal and state leave regulations and compliance considerations.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using HR systems such as Workday and case management tools.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to utilize AI, automation, and digital tools to improve efficiency and outcomes.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • HR certification such as PHR, SPHR, or GPHR.
  • Experience partnering with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of payroll processes and accommodations programs is highly desired.
  • Experience leading process improvement or transformation initiatives.

#LI-Remote

The Quality Engineer will support the overall Quality and Operations  Management  System by reviewing performance and deliverables of the organization. Working with all departments towards solutions and continuous improvement.  This position will also provide ongoing guidance, coaching, feedback, training, and development of in-house problem-solving programs and utilization of generally accepted Quality tools.

This is an onsite role at the Lewisville, TX DCC with a schedule of Monday-Friday, 8 am to 4:30 pm.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Validate process, system integration and testing methods (Gage R&R)

  • Create and review data analysis and trending reports

  • Process mapping/control points identification

  • Meeting with members of the production team to offer recommendations and share results from internal audits or open investigations

  • Analyzing, identifying, and implementing manufacturing and/or business process improvements which will improve capability and performance

  • Provide manufacturing and system/process validation support.

  • Experience in problem solving.

  • Provide training to all personnel on Quality tools

  • Map out Quality process flows and identify potential process and workflow improvements.

  • Lead CAPA/CI initiative utilizing Quality tools to facilitate root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions and process improvements

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale. 

  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent program metrics, tracking completion rates and percentages.

  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S./B.A.) in an Engineering discipline or a related field such as Quality, Operations/Business Management, Supply Chain, or a STEM discipline, plus 2 years of relevant/equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of two (2) years relevant/equivalent experience in use of Quality programs and tools.

  • Experience with 5S, Lean, and Six Sigma with the ability to apply the same in a practical, effective fashion, certification in above a plus.

  • Experience in process/testing/automation validation.

  •  Experience managing new product introduction.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Knowledge of ISO 9000 and/or QS 9000 standards

  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and be able to present in front of large groups.

  • Must have intermediate to excellent math skills;  statistical background a plus.

  • Must be detail-oriented.

  • Must have excellent time management skills.

  • Must have Strong PC skills (particularly Excel, spreadsheets,

  • databases, etc.) and familiarity.

  • Must have strong interpersonal skills, including effective oral communication skills.

  • Must have the ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Must have the ability to interact effectively and positively with all levels of company personnel as well as external personnel.

  • ·Must have the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and able handle multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Ability to identify potential process and workflow improvements

  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills in a teamwork setting

  • Exceptional knowledge and abilities with Microsoft Office to create spreadsheets, data graphing, statistics, presentations, effective procedures, flowcharting, and inspection standards

  • Multi-tasking ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

Environmental / Physical demands

This position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate standard office equipment such as a computer and phone.  Employees are occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry, and/or move up to 10 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to talk and hear. Required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls.  Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
