Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Operations Manager, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
As the Manufacturing Operations Supervisor you will be responsible for the employees in our facility, ensuring its effective operation by preparing work schedules, assigning tasks, coordinating the flow of work, and assigned projects, overseeing completion of work, and monitoring performance of your team. Attention to detail, demonstrated supervisory abilities and proficiency in manufacturing, distribution, inventory, and warehousing processes are crucial experience for this position.


This is an onsite role within our Mt Juliet TN facility with a schedule of Friday -Sunday, 5AM – 5:30PM


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff
  • Work with management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment, and innovation to achieve them
  • Develop and implement process improvements, and coordinate new model introductions
  • Act as liaison between teams, shifts, supervisors and departments, and partner with vendor / customer / client representatives
  • Accomplish supervisory and human resource objectives such as hiring, performing performance reviews and mentoring / coaching and disciplinary actions
  • Manage the team training matrix to ensure accuracy and within compliance based on the individual’s assigned area
  • Review Tableau reports to ensure that the team/dept is attaining the desired performance metrics
  • Drive engagement across area of responsibility and work with the team to foster a strong engage culture. Work with Mgr. to review the peakon score and create action plans within the tool
  • Meet production operational standards by implementing production, productivity and quality standards
  • Work with the site leadership to assist in resolving problems and identifying process improvements
  • Meet production financial standards by controlling and minimizing production expenses
  • Monitor production performance and ensure all daily shift production reports are completed on time
  • Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures while complying with legal regulations
  • Conduct periodic one on one meetings with associates to review performance and provide feedback/coaching.  These meetings need to be held at a minimum of once a month
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • HR Diploma or GED required
  • Minimum of 3-years of experience in a leadership role within a fast-pace, high-volume, manufacturing/repair environment
  • Strong knowledge and abilities with use of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Prior experience in a warehouse, shipping, receiving or related environment required
  • Ability to identify potential process and workflow improvements
  • Demonstrated experience with direct supervision and coaching of others
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to successfully interface with all levels of Company personnel as well as external personnel
  • High energy professional with the ability to establish and maintain effective business relationships with all suppliers and vendors
  • Strong interpersonal skills to deal effectively with problem solving, brainstorming sessions, strategy development and conflict resolution
  • Driven, goal-oriented, never confuses effort with results
  • Ability to multitask in a fast paced, dynamic assembly and logistics environment
  • May be required to work across multiple shifts

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Understanding of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Associate's degree and 3+ years of experience in supervising 15+ hourly associates in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?  

  • Position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate standard office equipment such as a computer and phone. 
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 20 pounds.
  • Occasional bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Pay Range:

$ 56.200,00 - $ 94.100,00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?  

  • Working knowledge of shop floor systems (CVision, Oracle, Unit Tracker, Great Plains, Ghost)

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Operations Manager, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
As the Manufacturing Operations Supervisor you will be responsible for the employees in our facility, ensuring its effective operation by preparing work schedules, assigning tasks, coordinating the flow of work, and assigned projects, overseeing completion of work, and monitoring performance of your team. Attention to detail, demonstrated supervisory abilities and proficiency in manufacturing, distribution, inventory, and warehousing processes are crucial experience for this position.


This is an onsite role within our Mt Juliet TN facility with a schedule of Monday - Thursday, 5AM – 3:30PM.


This job posting is part of our ongoing efforts to build a strong talent network for current and future opportunities. We invite you to apply, and qualified candidates will be contacted as roles become available.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff
  • Work with management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment, and innovation to achieve them
  • Develop and implement process improvements, and coordinate new model introductions
  • Act as liaison between teams, shifts, supervisors and departments, and partner with vendor / customer / client representatives
  • Accomplish supervisory and human resource objectives such as hiring, performing performance reviews and mentoring / coaching and disciplinary actions
  • Manage the team training matrix to ensure accuracy and within compliance based on the individual’s assigned area
  • Review Tableau reports to ensure that the team/dept is attaining the desired performance metrics
  • Drive engagement across area of responsibility and work with the team to foster a strong engage culture. Work with Mgr. to review the peakon score and create action plans within the tool
  • Meet production operational standards by implementing production, productivity and quality standards
  • Work with the site leadership to assist in resolving problems and identifying process improvements
  • Meet production financial standards by controlling and minimizing production expenses
  • Monitor production performance and ensure all daily shift production reports are completed on time
  • Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures while complying with legal regulations
  • Conduct periodic one on one meetings with associates to review performance and provide feedback/coaching.  These meetings need to be held at a minimum of once a month
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • HR Diploma or GED required
  • Minimum of 3-years of experience in a leadership role within a fast-pace, high-volume, manufacturing/repair environment
  • Strong knowledge and abilities with use of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Prior experience in a warehouse, shipping, receiving or related environment required
  • Ability to identify potential process and workflow improvements
  • Demonstrated experience with direct supervision and coaching of others
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to successfully interface with all levels of Company personnel as well as external personnel
  • High energy professional with the ability to establish and maintain effective business relationships with all suppliers and vendors
  • Strong interpersonal skills to deal effectively with problem solving, brainstorming sessions, strategy development and conflict resolution
  • Driven, goal-oriented, never confuses effort with results
  • Ability to multitask in a fast paced, dynamic assembly and logistics environment
  • May be required to work across multiple shifts

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Understanding of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Associate's degree and 3+ years of experience in supervising 15+ hourly associates in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?  

  • Position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate standard office equipment such as a computer and phone. 
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 20 pounds.
  • Occasional bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Pay Range:

$ 56.200,00 - $ 94.100,00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Why Join Assurant as a Regional Account Manager?


At Assurant, the Regional Account Manager plays a pivotal role in driving growth, innovation, and client success. This position goes beyond traditional account management, serving as a strategic advisor who strengthens client partnerships, and delivers solutions that help clients stay competitive in a rapidly evolving marketplace.


By analyzing industry trends, assessing client needs, and implementing tailored program enhancements, you'll directly influence business performance and customer outcomes. You'll collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to optimize program execution, uncover new opportunities, and integrate impactful solutions across sales channels.


Success in this role comes from leveraging data-driven insights and frontline feedback to continuously improve programs, enhance the customer experience, and drive measurable results. As a trusted voice to both clients and Assurant leadership, you'll help shape product and service strategies that maintain Assurant's competitive advantage.


If you're energized by building relationships, solving complex business challenges, and making a visible impact on growth and innovation, you'll find a rewarding career at Assurant where your expertise helps clients succeed and fuels the company's continued evolution.


This is a remote position; the ideal candidate will be based in Chicago, IL. The territory will be Illinois, Indiana, Michigan and Minnesota.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Responsible for driving performance for assigned programs for the assigned client through fostering and maintaining relationships with various levels of leadership.  
  • Conduct program training at corporate, division, region, district level or site location.  Conduct train-the-trainer programs for client staff.  
  • Circulate performance and compliance reports to ensure all related goals are being achieved.  
  • Consult with client management to establish and ultimately execute plans for achieving or exceeding program goals.  
  • Develop and enhance Assurant’s relationship with our client at management at various levels in the field to include, regional, district, and store level.
  • Communicate program results and plans for marketing efforts to client and Assurant management.  
  • Summarize activities for ROI purposes and be able to track the performance related to those activities.  
  • Serve as the primary contact between Assurant and client, as it relates to the assigned areas.
  • Assist in the execution of promotions and contests for associated programs.
  • Ensure travel budget adherence and control expenses.
  • Conduct competitive analysis regularly and prepare reports on the competitive environment, occasionally mystery shopping across related business segments.
  • Identify and assist in resolution of customer and client service quality process issues with the assigned Assurant Account Executive to ensure a positive root cause resolution.  

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in retail, wireless, customer-facing environments, with a strong understanding of sales, client service, and account development.
  • Proven presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and effectively engage leaders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience developing and executing strategies to improve business results.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and multimedia presentation tools.
  • Experience in managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines, and work independently with minimal supervision.

How much travel will be required?

  • Up to 75% travel.

#LI-Remote

Pay Range:

$82,200.00 - $137,200.00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.


Company Overview
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.


AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Overview of Position:

The Shared Services Operations Specialist handles the dispositioning of insurance claim checks on behalf of our financial institution clients, directly impacting the timeliness and accuracy of property damage claims . This role requires proven ability to manage deadlines and meet quality standards with accuracy and consistent attention to detail. It also requires the use of good judgment to solve problems and make business-appropriate decisions consistent with Assurant procedures and best practices.


The Shared Services Specialist has a direct impact on customer satisfaction and confidence through the timeliness and accuracy of their work and the quality provided. Our volume of work may increase on occasion, especially during natural disasters, and therefore there will be times when overtime may be required.


This role requires to go into the Springfield office: 1 Assurant Way, Springfield, OH 45505


How We’re Different

  • Your medical benefits begin on your first day
  • We provide tuition reimbursement available after 6 months
  • We deliver exceptional paid time off

What will be my duties and responsibilities?

  • Responsible for performing job requirements including processing insurance claim checks, maintenance, or research.
  • May perform monetary functional transactions such as posting deposits to client servicing system
  • Make appropriate updates to client database in order to meet regulatory obligation
  • Manage time to handle multiple demands and competing priorities
  • May work in multi-functional areas with multiple clients
  • Handle other duties and projects as requested on business needs
  • Maintain and update procedure knowledge on an on-going basis and attend workshops, seminars, and other training sessions as appropriate.

Department-Specific Duties

  • Job duties may vary based on Shared Services department of assignment.  Shared Services Specialist would be responsible for the primary duties listed above along with their specific duties by function.

What are the requirements needed for this position? 

  • High School diploma or GED
  • Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Basic knowledge of computers and proficiency with Microsoft office including Excel and PowerPoint
  • Good oral and written communication skills and professional etiquette

Preferred Qualifications/Experience

  • 1-year experience in insurance, banking, finance, mortgage servicing, or related experience

This role requires to go into the Springfield office: 1 Assurant Way, Springfield, OH 45505

Pay Range:

$16.23 - $25.16

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.


If there is no posting end date listed then this is a pipeline requisition, and we will continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis.

As the Shipping Supervisor you are responsible for the employees in our facility, ensuring effective operation by preparing work schedules, assigning tasks, coordinating the flow of work and assigned projects, overseeing completion of work, and monitoring the performance of your team. Attention to detail, demonstrated supervisory abilities and proficiency in manufacturing, distribution, inventory, and warehousing processes are crucial experience for this position.


This is an onsite role in our Mt. Juliet TN facility with a schedule of Monday - Friday, 7AM – 3:30PM


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff
  • Work with management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Develop and implement process improvements, and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partner with vendor / customer / client representatives
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Ensure proper labor utilization and develop staffing requirements
  • Conduct interviews for all nonexempt personnel and temporary employees
  • Review Tableau reports to ensure that the team/dept is attaining the desired performance metrics
  • Drive engagement across area of responsibility and work with the team to foster a strong engage culture
  • Work with manager to review the peakon score and create action plans within the tool
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Must have High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 3-years of experience in a leadership role within a fast-pace, high-volume, manufacturing/repair environment similar to Assurant, York, Lewisville or Tennessee facility
  • Strong knowledge and abilities with use of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Experience in a warehouse, shipping, receiving or related environment required
  • Ability to identify potential process and workflow improvements
  • Demonstrated experience with direct supervision and coaching of others
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Able to successfully interface with all levels of Company personnel as well as external personnel
  • High energy professional with the ability to establish and maintain effective business relationships with all suppliers and vendors
  • Strong interpersonal skills to deal effectively with problem solving, brainstorming sessions, strategy development and conflict resolution
  • Driven, goal-oriented, never confuses effort with results
  • Ability to multitask in a fast paced, dynamic assembly and logistics environment
  • May be required to work across multiple shifts

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Associates Degree and 3+ years of experience in supervising 15+ hourly associates in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • Understanding of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies

Pay Range:

$ 56.200,00 - $ 94.100,00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Join a hands-on maintenance team responsible for supporting facility operations, manufacturing readiness, and business growth. This role performs a wide range of facilities, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and preventative maintenance activities to ensure equipment, systems, and building infrastructure operate safely and efficiently.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Perform facility-wide repairs, installations, preventative maintenance, and general upkeep activities.
  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical systems including outlets, fixtures, switches, circuits, PLCs, and CNC equipment.
  • Repair and install plumbing systems including faucets, drains, toilets, and compressed air lines.
  • Work with copper, PVC/CPVC, and PEX piping systems.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance on conveyors, pallet jacks, compactors, automated equipment, motors, and pneumatic systems.
  • Complete carpentry projects including framing, drywall repair, door and window installation or adjustment.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues to minimize production downtime.
  • Analyze recurring equipment failures and recommend maintenance improvements.
  • Support general facility needs including painting, signage installation, janitorial support, and seasonal maintenance.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of three years of professional trade or military experience, with prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.
  • Hands-on experience in electrical, mechanical, and/or plumbing trades.
  • Ability to read and work from diagrams, sketches, manuals, and engineering specifications.
  • Knowledge of relay logic, ladder diagrams, motors, sensors, relays, drives, timers, solenoids, and related controls equipment.
  • Experience with PLC and CNC troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of electrical safety practices including Lock, Tag, Try (LTT), arc-flash prevention, and safe tool usage.
  • Experience performing preventative maintenance and equipment troubleshooting.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to assemble racks, carts, benches, and related equipment.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage schedules, and work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability to make sound decisions during equipment failures or emergency situations.
  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Successful completion of a criminal background check and motor vehicle record (MVR) review.
  • Ability to qualify for and maintain authorization to drive company-owned vehicles.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Knowledge of reliability-centered maintenance, root cause failure analysis (RCFA), or failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA).
  • Experience running power lines, wiring motors, panels, transformers, and industrial equipment.

Pay Range:

$27.08 - $45.22

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Job Description 


Customer Care Representative 


Location: Remote/Virtual | Job Type: Full-Time 


Schedule: Shifts may include evenings and weekends 


Compensation: Competitive pay + shift differentials for nights/weekends 


Why Join Us? 


At Assurant, our Customer Care Representatives are the voice of our organization and the first point of contact for our valued customers. We are deeply invested in your success and committed to providing a supportive, inclusive, and growth-oriented environment. 

What Sets Us Apart: 


  • Benefits from Day One – Medical, dental, vision, and more 
  • Paid Time Off – Including holidays 
  • Career Growth – Advancement opportunities and tuition reimbursement (up to $5,000/year after 6 months) 
  • Comprehensive Training – Paid virtual training to set you up for success 

What You’ll Do: 


  • Handle inbound customer calls and/or e-mails with empathy and professionalism 
  • Resolve issues, answer questions, and provide proactive solutions 
  • Document interactions and follow up as needed 
  • Participate in special projects and adapt to evolving priorities 
  • Deliver a WOW experience on every call—customers should hear your smile! 

Note: This role does not involve cold calling, sales, or contract upgrades. 

What We’re Looking For: 


  • Minimum Requirements: 
  • High school diploma or GED 
  • Customer service experience (call center, insurance, or banking preferred) 
  • Strong communication, listening, and problem-solving skills 
  • Ability to multitask using technology in a fast-paced environment 
  • Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps down / 6 Mbps up) 
  • Quiet, distraction-free home office setup 
  • Preferred Qualifications: 
  • 2+ years of customer service experience 
  • Prior remote work experience 

Work Environment: 

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week  
  • Shifts may vary and include weekends and holidays 
  • Must be available to work as late as 9 PM EST 
  • Periodic shift bids determine schedules based on business needs 
  • Highly collaborative, work closely with others 
  • Professional and visible on camera presence  

Ready to Make a Difference? 

If you're a great communicator, a natural problem solver, and passionate about delivering exceptional service, we’d love to hear from you! 

Pay Range:

$16.23 - $27.75

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.


If there is no posting end date listed then this is a pipeline requisition, and we will continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Policy Administration Specialist, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
This job is responsible for working with the Supervisors and assisting in training and developing the team, monitoring production performance, ensuring production and quality controls are met while adhering to the work instructions for the area of responsibility.  


This is an onsite role at our Irving, TX DCC, with a schedule of Monday through Thursday, 6:00 am to 4:30 pm.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?  

  • Working knowledge of shop floor systems (CVision, Oracle, Unit Tracker, Great Plains, Ghost)
  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings with Supervisor
  • Participate in internal and external customer or vendor meetings
  • Work with Supervisor to reallocate resources (people/supplies/products etc.) as needed to meet customer goals
  • Work with other departments as needed to ensure proper workflow is achieved
  • Point of contact for employees for handling escalation issues
  • Work with Engineering to identify and resolve process issues
  • Track and maintain daily attendance roster for Emergency Evacuation purposes
  • Participate with the 6S Audit team on monthly 6S audits
  • Work with supervisor to implement any changes or adjustments on production floor as a result from the audits
  • Perform on-the-job (OJT) refresher training and work station assessment
  • Monitor inventory levels (WIP Aging) for specific area of responsibility
  • Monitor KPI and SLA performance levels and escalate any issues/concerns to supervisor when needed

What are the requirements needed for this position?  

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 1+ years lead or supervisory experience in a manufacturing and/or warehouse environment 

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?  

  • Prior leadership experience in manufacturing, logistics, operations, or another applicable environment is preferred
  • Ability to collaborate with other departments with their area of responsibility
  • Training environment experience
  • Forklift certified if needed for area of responsibility
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of employees
  • Must be proficient and certified in the area that they are responsible for leading

Environmental/ physical demands

  • Occasional: Bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery.
  • This position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate.
  • standard office equipment such as a computer and bar scanner
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 40 pounds
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus
  • Must be able to talk and hear

 

Pay Range:

$17.34 - $27.75

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
Assurant is looking for strong sales professionals to join our dynamic team.  Come build a career as a licensed sales agent, with our team or grow your portfolio of work before you set out in new directions.  We are a fast-paced, energetic environment where you drive the results while having the opportunity to connect remotely and enjoy competitive monthly bonuses and working from the comforts of home.

You will serve as the point of contact in fulfilling the insurance needs of our clients by assisting them with their sales process via inbound calls.  

Work Schedule:

Our sales center is open from 8AM to 10PM ET on weekdays and 10AM to 5 PM ET on Saturdays. Individuals will have the ability to earn earlier shifts through our quarterly, performance-based shift bid process. Need flexibility to work any shift.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job? 

  • 90% Handle inbound calls for multiple products with no prospecting or cold calling
  • 10% outbound calls to follow up on existing quotes
  • Establish a good liaison with our client's customers while selling Renters Insurance products.
  • Adopt and develop strategies while meeting departmental monthly sales goals
  • Track and monitor personal results to meet monthly sales and key performance goals
  • Follow underwriting requirements and corporate policies while negotiating sales
  • Navigate a computerized data entry system, internet, and/or other relevant applications for tracking, information gathering, troubleshooting and transaction processing
  • Complete mandatory licensure continuing education and other training sessions as appropriate
  • Remain positioned and well informed of changes implemented that affect your work 
  • Our sales center is open from 8AM to 10PM ET on weekdays and 10AM to 5PM ET on Saturdays. Individuals will have the ability to earn earlier shifts through our quarterly, performance-based shift bid process.

What are the requirements needed for this position? 

  • High school diploma or GED
  • One (1) plus year of sales related experience
  • One (1) plus years of call center and/or insurance experience
  • Solid computer, grammar, and multi-tasking skills
  • Property & Casualty or Personal Lines insurance license or be willing to obtain one of these licenses within the first 30 days of employment.
  • Ability to become appointed/licensed as a non-resident agent in all applicable states.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have? 

  • Strong analytical, listening, problem-solving, and negotiating skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to excellence
  • Ability to prioritize tasks with shifting deadlines and work on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization internally and externally

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?  

  • General office demands  

#LI-Remote

Pay Range:

$16.23 - $25.16

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.


If there is no posting end date listed then this is a pipeline requisition, and we will continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.


Company Overview
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.


AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions? We’re looking for an Associate Technical Product Owner to join our dynamic Homeowners and Condo product team. In this role, you’ll work closely with the Agile Product Owner and be fully embedded in an Agile team, helping to deliver impactful solutions that align with business goals.


Applicants must be legally authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this opportunity.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?  

  • Partner with the Agile Product Owner to understand strategic objectives and help prioritize the product backlog, including compliance updates, business requirements, and project support.
  • Write clear, actionable user stories with both functional and technical detail; validate completed stories to ensure alignment with requirements.
  • Ensure scope and priority are understood by the Scrum team, and are aligned to the roadmaps as defined by business goals.
  • Act as the liaison alongside the Agile Product Owner between business stakeholders and the Agile development team, ensuring clarity and alignment.
  • Coordinate inter-team timelines and escalate issues to maintain project momentum.
  • Collaborate with the Agile team to define release dates and project scope.
  • Support production readiness and deployment activities to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Ensure that delivered work meets business needs by adhering to committed acceptance criteria.
  • Timely triage of incoming incidents/bugs/unplanned work for prioritization, in partnership with Scrum teams as needed to gather impact and root cause information.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 2+ years’ experience with Business Analysis.
  • 1 year of experience working in an Agile methodology environment.
  • Strong problem solving, critical thinking, organization, and collaboration skills.
  • Understanding of APIs and system integrations, and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?  

  • Agile certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Agile tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
  • Experience with sprint planning.

Pay Range:

$74,600.00 - $124,700.00

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Policy Administration Specialist, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
This job is responsible for working with the Supervisors and assisting in training and developing the team, monitoring production performance, ensuring production and quality controls are met while adhering to the work instructions for the area of responsibility.

This role is based at our Irving, TX location with a schedule of Monday-Thursday from 5:30 pm to 4:00 am


What will be my duties and responsibilities be in this job?

  • Working knowledge of shop floor systems (CVision, Oracle, Unit Tracker, Great Plains, Ghost)
  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings with Supervisor
  • Participate in internal and external customer or vendor meetings
  • Work with Supervisor to reallocate resources (people/supplies/products etc.) as needed to meet customer goals
  • Work with other departments as needed to ensure proper workflow is achieved
  • Point of contact for employees for handling escalation issues
  • Work with Engineering to identify and resolve process issues
  • Ability to collaborate with other departments with their area of responsibility
  • Track and maintain daily attendance roster for Emergency Evacuation purposes
  • Participate with the 6S Audit team on monthly 6S audits
  • Work with supervisor to implement any changes or adjustments on production floor as a result from the audits
  • Forklift certified if needed for area of responsibility
  • Perform on-the-job (OJT) refresher training and workstation assessment
  • Monitor inventory levels (WIP Aging) for specific area of responsibility
  • Monitor KPI and SLA performance levels and escalate any issues/concerns to supervisor when needed
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of employees
  • Must be proficient and certified in the area that they are responsible for leading
  • Compile and analyze data
  • Complete daily reports
  • Train and coach associates as needed

What are the requirements for this position?


  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 1+ years of lead or supervisory experience in a manufacturing and/or warehouse environment 

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Prior leadership experience in manufacturing, logistics, operations, or another applicable environment is preferred
  • Ability to collaborate with other departments within their area of responsibility
  • Training environment experience
  • Forklift certified if needed for area of responsibility
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of employees
  • Must be proficient and certified in the area that they are responsible for leading

Pay Range:

$17.34 - $27.75

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Operations Manager, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
The Repair Operations Manager leads device processing operations in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is accountable for production performance, quality standards, workforce development, and operational efficiency. You’ll oversee supervisors and technical teams to ensure production goals and customer SLAs are consistently met.

This is an onsite role in our Mt Juliet TN facility.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead and supervise supervisors and production staff to execute device processing in line with company standards and work instructions
  • Drive production performance, ensuring quality, throughput, and SLA targets are met
  • Monitor workflows, enforce quality controls, and implement reporting systems to track KPIs
  • Partner with leadership to set daily production plans, priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Optimize operations through line balancing, WIP reduction, and process improvements
  • Coach, train, and develop team members; foster a positive, high-performance culture
  • Implement and improve operational systems, procedures, and workforce planning
  • Maintain a safe, compliant, and efficient work environment

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 8+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, distribution, assembly, reverse logistics, or related operational environments
  • 5+ years of experience leading supervisors and managing frontline operations teams
  • Proven experience implementing Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze operational data and make informed, data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing an hourly workforce in a fast-paced production environment
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and employee development skills
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other business reporting tools
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering results in a dynamic environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field
  • Experience in wireless device repair, electronics manufacturing, OEM operations, or mobile device processing
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001, R2, or similar quality certifications
  • Familiarity with repair technologies, barcode scanning systems, and production tracking tools
  • 10+ years of operations or production leadership experience

#AssurantProudEB

Pay Range:

$74,600.00 - $124,700.00

We're looking for a skilled Senior Maintenance/Robotics Technician to support our Lewisville, TX manufacturing operation through preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of advanced production equipment. This role is ideal for a hands-on technician who enjoys solving complex mechanical and electrical challenges, working with automation and robotics, and helping drive equipment reliability and operational excellence.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on manufacturing and facility equipment
  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and automated systems to minimize downtime
  • Maintain and repair motors, conveyors, robots, vision systems, drives, control panels, and packaging equipment
  • Interpret blueprints, schematics, technical drawings, and equipment manuals to diagnose issues and complete repairs
  • Repair or replace components such as bearings, gears, belts, pumps, wiring, fuses, and motor controls
  • Perform basic fabrication, welding, and machining as needed to support equipment repairs
  • Utilize CMMS software to document maintenance activities, repairs, and parts usage
  • Partner with Operations to improve equipment performance and train operators on basic troubleshooting techniques
  • Follow all safety standards, including OSHA and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) requirements
  • Complete required technical and safety training to maintain certifications and expand technical capabilities

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical training or equivalent experience preferred
  • 3+ years of industrial, manufacturing, or multi-craft maintenance experience
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems
  • Experience maintaining and repairing automated manufacturing equipment
  • Ability to troubleshoot robots, conveyors, camera systems, polishing equipment, shrink-wrap systems, and related production equipment
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, electrical schematics, and technical documentation.
  • Experience using CMMS software for maintenance tracking and reporting
  • Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills with Maintenance, Operations, and Leadership teams
  • Willingness to work overtime, weekends, and off-shift hours when needed
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) certification and safely work in an industrial manufacturing environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience with KUKA robots
  • Working knowledge of Allen-Bradley, Siemens, and B&R PLCs
  • Experience supporting high-speed conveyors and drive systems
  • Knowledge of Cognex and Keyence vision systems
  • Experience with shrink-wrap and bagging equipment
  • Experience supporting buffing and polishing systems

#AssurantProudEB

Pay Range:

$23.66 - $39.06

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

The Manager of Quality Systems is a strategic leader responsible for building and scaling a high-performing Quality function that ensures operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and superior customer outcomes. This role drives quality planning, assurance, control, and continuous improvement initiatives across the Nashville facility, embedding best-in-class processes, governance, and accountability throughout the operation.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville, TX facility with a schedule of Monday -Friday: 8 am to 4:30 pm.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead the Quality Function: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing quality team, establishing clear roles, performance standards, and scalable workflows to meet evolving business needs

  • Own the QMS: Design, implement, and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring robust standards, processes, and controls are in place and consistently followed

  • Drive Cross-Functional Quality Excellence: Partner with site leadership and cross-functional teams to identify critical customer-facing processes and deploy quality assurance strategies that ensure SLA achievement and product integrity

  • Ensure Compliance & Standards Alignment: Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements and company quality standards; lead corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and continuous improvement efforts

  • Champion Continuous Improvement: Embed Lean/Six Sigma methodologies across the operation to drive defect reduction, efficiency gains, and measurable performance improvements

  • Lead Audits & Certifications: Partner with Compliance to support RIOS, R2, and emerging standards; serve as site lead for IMS and DPR initiatives

  • Turn Data into Action: Analyze quality metrics, trends, and monitoring results to inform business decisions, optimize production capabilities, and drive operational improvements

  • Reporting & Insights: Deliver clear, data-driven reporting for monthly and quarterly business reviews, including actionable recommendations and progress tracking

  • Own Quality Analytics & Documentation: Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of all quality records, reporting, and analysis

  • Resolve Quality Issues: Proactively identify risks, lead root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions to improve performance and customer satisfaction

Job.JobTitle: Principal Sourcing Manager - Enterprise & Supply Chain Services
Job.JobDescription:
The Principal Sourcing Manager serves as the on-site sourcing partner for the Nashville, TN or Dallas, TX Device Care Center, working closely with Operations, Engineering, Logistics, and GREF to support effective and efficient sourcing outcomes. This role helps translate enterprise sourcing strategies into practical, site-level execution by providing structure, insight, and commercial guidance. The individual will need to collaborate with stakeholders to enhance visibility, streamline supplier engagement, and strengthen continuity of supply, while supporting cost efficiency and operational agility. A key focus is on evolving sourcing practices in a way that balances speed, flexibility, and governance enabling teams to operate effectively while benefiting from scalable, transparent sourcing approaches.


What You'll Do

On-Site Sourcing Partnership & Vendor Support

  • Act as the primary on-site sourcing partner for the Nashville DCC.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and suppliers to support day-to-day needs and priorities.
  • Provide guidance on supplier considerations including capacity, performance, and risk.
  • Partner with teams to incorporate sourcing perspectives early in planning and decision-making.

End-to-End Sourcing Collaboration

  • Facilitate sourcing processes from requirements definition through implementation and transition to BAU.
  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Logistics, Facilities, Finance, Legal, and GREF to ensure aligned and seamless execution.
  • Support the implementation of contracts, catalogues, and purchasing frameworks that enable efficient and compliant buying.

Buying Practices & Enablement

  • Promote consistent and effective buying practices across the DCC.
  • Provide clarity, tools, and support to help teams make informed purchasing decisions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to simplify processes and encourage adoption of preferred sourcing channels.

Supplier Strategy & Value Realization

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to optimize the supplier landscape, improving resilience and operational simplicity.
  • Support delivery of cost efficiencies and productivity improvements aligned with enterprise priorities.
  • Balance immediate opportunities with longer-term enhancements to sourcing approaches.

Performance Insight & Continuous Improvement

  • Support supplier performance management and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Provide insights on spend, usage, and supplier trends to inform decision-making.
  • Act as a collaborative change partner, helping teams realize the benefits of structured sourcing while maintaining operational momentum.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required (MBA/Master’s a plus).
  • 8+ years’ experience in Strategic Sourcing / Procurement with end‑to‑end ownership (RFx through BAU).
  • Experience operating in fast‑paced operational, manufacturing, or logistics environments.
  • Strong capability across supplier performance management, continuity of supply, and vendor risk.
  • Proven delivery of cost optimization, supplier consolidation, and governed buying adoption. Solid commercial, financial, and contract acumen; able to influence cross‑functional stakeholders.


Why Assurant?  

  • People First – we prioritize employee well-being and development 
  • Empowerment – we enable our people to do their best work 
  • Benefits effective day one 
  • 401K Match – up to 6% dollar-for-dollar 

The Company 

Assurant, Inc. redefines the boundaries of protection — safeguarding and servicing connected devices, homes, automobiles, and commercial equipment in partnership with the world’s most successful brands. As a Fortune 500 company operating in 21 countries, Assurant leads the way in leveraging insights and technology to transform customer connections that build loyalty and drive value. With more than 325 million consumers protected worldwide, Assurant is behind the scenes helping brands deliver reliable, meaningful experiences customers can count on, so brands can shine and customers can have peace of mind. 

  

Global Impact 

Assurant is a purpose-driven company committed to advancing a connected, respected, and protected world. Through our focus on Connected Communities, Respected Resources, and a Protected Planet, we integrate sustainability into our long-term strategy in ways that support our business, strengthen operations, and help us deliver value for clients, customers, employees, and communities. 

  

Assurant Culture 

The Assurant Way defines how we show up for our clients, customers, communities, and one another — with Common Sense, Common Decency, Uncommon Thinking, and Uncommon Results. Recognized on Forbes’ list of the World’s Best Employers, named among Fortune’s America’s Most Innovative Companies, and consistently ranked as a “Best/Great Place to Work” in 14 countries, Assurant attracts talented people who are passionate about service, practical innovation, and delivering meaningful results. 

  

Benefits & Rewards 

Assurant is committed to providing a competitive rewards package that offers market-competitive benefits and resources designed to support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. 


Pay Range:

$103,800.00 - $173,300.00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Overview of Position


Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. In addition to enterprise related trade activities, this role actively supports the movement of mobile devices, device components, service parts, accessories, and related technologies across global markets while enabling efficient customer, carrier, OEM, repair, refurbishment, and logistics operations.


The Director serves as a strategic advisor to Connected Living leadership and business stakeholders, balancing compliance obligations with customer commitments, operational efficiency, and commercial objectives.


This role will also partner, coordinate, and align global trade compliance activities and strategies with the Director, Global Supply Chain Compliance.


What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?


Global Trade Compliance Leadership (45%)


  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Assurant's global trade compliance program.
  • Establish governance, policies, procedures, and internal controls covering import, export, sanctions, and customs compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
    • OFAC sanctions requirements
    • U.S. Customs regulations
    • International customs laws and regulations
    • Foreign trade regulations in countries where Assurant operates
  • Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on global trade risks and opportunities.
  • Identify and implement value-creation opportunities, including duty drawback, free trade agreements, foreign trade zones, tariff engineering, and other lawful duty mitigation strategies.

Import Compliance and Customs Management (20%)


  • Oversee global customs compliance for mobile devices, service parts, accessories, and technology.
  • Ensure accurate:
    • HTS classifications
    • Country-of-origin determinations
    • Customs valuation
    • Duty assessment
  • Manage customs brokers and trade service providers.
    • Identify and implement duty savings strategies and opportunities.
  • Support optimization of global supply chain costs and customs efficiency.

Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance (20%)


  • Oversee export classification activities for devices, components, software, and technology.
  • Ensure compliance with export controls.
  • Lead restricted-party screening and sanctions compliance programs.
  • Provide guidance regarding cross-border shipments, technology transfers, and international business transactions.
  • Manage export licensing requirements and government authorizations when required.
  • Drive global alignment for HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) determinations.
  • Maintain awareness of export-controlled technology, software, encryption, and restricted-access information requirements applicable to Assurant operations.
  • Assess and manage export control risks involving restricted destinations, restricted parties, military end users, military end uses, and controlled technologies, software, or technical data; develop procedures for end-use/end-user due diligence, escalation, licensing analysis, and transaction holds where required.

Risk Management and Compliance Governance (10%)


  • Conduct enterprise-wide trade compliance risk assessments.
  • Develop and maintain trade compliance controls and monitoring programs.
  • Lead internal audits and compliance reviews.
  • Establish compliance metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Investigate compliance incidents and manage corrective actions.
  • Lead government audits, inquiries, disclosures, and remediation activities.
  • Assists in remediating trade compliance issues as necessary, including but not limited to putting together project plans, connecting resources to find solutions, documenting resolutions, and documenting remediation plans.
  • Supports internal compliance audits and assists with managing external audits or inquiries from government agencies Maintains accurate data and recordkeeping to include collecting and retaining records in response to third-party inquiries relating to Assurant compliance practices and business activities.

Training and Culture (5%)


  • Develop and deliver trade compliance training and awareness programs.
  • Ensure employees understand their responsibilities related to international trade activities.
  • Maintain training records and support audit readiness.

Number of Direct Reports


  • 1-2 including a Compliance Analyst

Financial Responsibility


  • Signoff on responsible expenses, input on annual budget.

What are the requirements needed for this position?


Experience


  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance.
  • At least 5 years of leadership experience.
  • Experience supporting multinational import/export operations.
  • Experience managing customs and export compliance programs.
  • Experience supporting technology, telecommunications, consumer electronics, mobile device, repair/refurbishment, or logistics industries preferred.

 

 

Education & Certifications


  • Bachelors’ degree required, Master’s or JD preferred

Preferred Certifications


  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB)
  • Certified Export Specialist (CES)
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO)

Preferred Technical Expertise


  • EAR
  • OFAC sanctions compliance
  • Customs valuation
  • HTS classification
  • Country-of-origin analysis
  • Free Trade Agreements
  • Duty drawback
  • Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ)
  • Reverse logistics operations
  • Mobile device repair and refurbishment supply chains

Leadership Competencies

The candidate will be able to provide examples of successfully demonstrating the following leadership competencies:


  • Internal client-orientation with a constructive approach to resolution of issues.  A style which builds alliances within the organization.
  • Ability to establish credibility with business owners, including senior and executive leadership, and influence through professional communication, work product, etc.
  • Solutions-oriented, demonstrated growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships with clients, colleagues and stakeholders of various levels and areas throughout the organization.
  • Ability to lead change efforts through effective communication and persuasion.
  • Creative, resilient, and flexible style and approach to handling complex issues with high tolerance for ambiguity
  • Demonstrated leadership experience on leveraging data to drive actionable insights for risk or compliance programs
  • Clear written, visual and verbal communication skills, including ability to adjust messages dependent on audiences ranging from front-line employees to executive
  • Cultural competency and executive-level presence to work with the business and regional leadership teams around the world
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.  Ability to interpret rules and guidelines, and then conceptualize and implement into policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Excellent and demonstrated project management skills, and attention to detail in leading projects and activities in a global organization.  Ability to prioritize and simultaneously execute on multiple projects and ability to organize and analyze complex information and data
  • Sound and independent judgment, and demonstrated prudence and maturity
  • Commitment to driving a culture of ethics and integrity
  • Cultivate a high-performing trade compliance team through coaching, mentoring, accountability, and development of trade compliance professionals.

Skills


The candidate will be able to demonstrate proficiency in the following skills:


  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite with specific emphasis in Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment with several simultaneous deliverables
  • Program of project management skills

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?


  • Experience in mobile or technology industries
  • Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, etc
  • Supply chain and vendor risk management experience

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Operations to lead and optimize our end-to-end CPO operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, quality, profitability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across multiple functions, including demand planning, production and repair operations, new product introduction, customer implementations, service delivery, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader with experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, or refurbishment environments. This individual will leverage Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership to deliver scalable processes, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustained business growth.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with occasional travel (~10%).

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead all aspects of CPO operations, ensuring high levels of quality, service, productivity, and profitability
  • Develop and execute short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with business objectives
  • Establish policies, procedures, and performance standards that drive operational excellence and accountability
  • Oversee demand planning, operations planning and control, production processes, repair operations, parts reclamation, customer implementations, system support, and customer service functions
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles and best practices
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction
  • Partner with Product Development and Engineering teams to support new product introductions and operational readiness
  • Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, improve scalability, and enhance operational performance
  • Own operational financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and profitability analysis
  • Evaluate business opportunities and operational investments through financial modeling and data-driven analysis
  • Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to achieve business goals
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and lead high-performing teams
  • Establish performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development strategies
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Serve as the primary operational partner for internal stakeholders and external clients.
  • Resolve operational, product, system, and customer-related issues while maintaining strong client relationships
  • Collaborate across departments to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and operational improvements
  • Present recommendations, business cases, and operational updates to leadership teams and executive audiences
  • Support the development, launch, and operational integration of new products and services
  • Drive ongoing product profitability, compliance, and lifecycle performance
  • Partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that support business growth

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 6+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, refurbishment, or operations environments
  • Strong experience in demand planning, production planning, procurement, materials management, and new product introduction
  • Proven success leading process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies
  • Advanced analytical and financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance management
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, trend analysis, reporting, and data visualization
  • Experience with project management, resource planning, and systems implementation
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience using AI tools and automation technologies to improve business processes and operational efficiency
  • Background in technical, mechanical, electronics repair, refurbishment, or manufacturing environments
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher
  • Experience working within ISO and OSHA-regulated environments
  • Experience with Oracle ERP systems
  • Experience supporting wireless or consumer electronics products

As the Manufacturing Operations Supervisor you will be responsible for the employees in our facility, ensuring its effective operation by preparing work schedules, assigning tasks, coordinating the flow of work, and assigned projects, overseeing completion of work, and monitoring performance of your team. Attention to detail, demonstrated supervisory abilities and proficiency in manufacturing, distribution, inventory, and warehousing processes are crucial experience for this position.


This is an onsite role within our Lewisville TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Thursday, 6AM – 4:30PM.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff
  • Work with management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment, and innovation to achieve them
  • Develop and implement process improvements, and coordinate new model introductions
  • Act as liaison between teams, shifts, supervisors and departments, and partner with vendor / customer / client representatives
  • Accomplish supervisory and human resource objectives such as hiring, performing performance reviews and mentoring / coaching and disciplinary actions
  • Manage the team training matrix to ensure accuracy and within compliance based on the individual’s assigned area
  • Review Tableau reports to ensure that the team/dept is attaining the desired performance metrics
  • Drive engagement across area of responsibility and work with the team to foster a strong engage culture. Work with Mgr. to review the peakon score and create action plans within the tool
  • Meet production operational standards by implementing production, productivity and quality standards
  • Work with the site leadership to assist in resolving problems and identifying process improvements
  • Meet production financial standards by controlling and minimizing production expenses
  • Monitor production performance and ensure all daily shift production reports are completed on time
  • Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures while complying with legal regulations
  • Conduct periodic one on one meetings with associates to review performance and provide feedback/coaching.  These meetings need to be held at a minimum of once a month
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • HR Diploma or GED required
  • Minimum of 3-years of experience in a leadership role within a fast-pace, high-volume, manufacturing/repair environment
  • Strong knowledge and abilities with use of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Prior experience in a warehouse, shipping, receiving or related environment required
  • Ability to identify potential process and workflow improvements
  • Demonstrated experience with direct supervision and coaching of others
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to successfully interface with all levels of Company personnel as well as external personnel
  • High energy professional with the ability to establish and maintain effective business relationships with all suppliers and vendors
  • Strong interpersonal skills to deal effectively with problem solving, brainstorming sessions, strategy development and conflict resolution
  • Driven, goal-oriented, never confuses effort with results
  • Ability to multitask in a fast paced, dynamic assembly and logistics environment
  • May be required to work across multiple shifts

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Understanding of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Associate's degree and 3+ years of experience in supervising 15+ hourly associates in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?  

  • Position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate standard office equipment such as a computer and phone. 
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 20 pounds.
  • Occasional bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
