Overview of Position

The Sr IT Auditor II is responsible for the understanding and evaluation of the internal control and risk environment within Assurant, Inc. at the assigned business or enterprise functional and includes (but not limited to) the following objectives:

  • Lead audit teams and ensure that audit work performed is in compliance with established audit methodology while meeting all organizational and professional ethical standards.

  • Manage relationships with IT process owners to understand and influence improvements over management’s control environment.

  • Lead and participate in Internal Audit professional practice activities to improve the department’s ability to fulfill its charter.

What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?

The Sr IT Auditor II responsibilities include the following activities:

Lead Audit Projects (up to 70%)

The primary function of this role is to lead projects that identify risks, evaluate IT controls and report key findings for assigned business areas, and assess their impact to Assurant’s mission, strategy, and related business objectives. Specific tasks include but are not limited to the following:

  • Use knowledge of IT and general business to design, lead and execute risk-based IT audit programs for business process reviews, system implementations, and application reviews and other IT processes through all phases of the audit including planning, testing, and providing written reports of key findings. 

  • Provide IT support to other audit teams as assigned.

  • Assess opportunities to improve the internal control environment across the company.

  • Understand, recognize, and communicate key performance drivers, business trends, and emerging financial, technical and industry developments.

  • Identify and realize efficiencies through data analytics and automation in both the department and in the company.

  • Participate in Assurant’s annual risk assessment and audit planning.

  • Follow up on recommendations that help Assurant’s business leaders manage risk.

  • Follow professional standards and IAAS methodologies, policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure product quality.

  • Communicate effectively with all levels of management and staff through written reports and oral presentations.

  • Develop an understanding of Assurant Businesses and maintain awareness of significant industry, regulatory and business changes across the organization and their potential impact on the established control environment.

  • Pursue professional development opportunities and share lessons with colleagues.

SOX / MAR / External Auditor Assistance

The role may require the individual to support and/or coordinate SOX/MAR compliance or External Auditor Assistance activities through the execution of testing and communication to management.  Specific tasks include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Participate in the development, review and implementation of test documentation, control narratives, procedures, and control testing.

  • Execute business test strategy to ensure the activities are performed in accordance with the SOX/MAR plan.

  • Review documentation for quality, consistency, and relevance.

  • Participate in periodic scoping and account mapping of significant processes.

  • Work with and support external auditors as required.

  • Coordinate activities with External Auditors, Assurant Enterprise Risk, Compliance, and IT functions to align internal audit activities.

Build Relationships with Assurant Business Leaders/Managers (up to 10%)

The role may be required to develop the business relationships that enable IAAS to fulfill its charter and meet stakeholder expectations.  Specific tasks include (but not limited to) the following:

  • Develop and maintain relationships with control and process owners, business managers and subject matter experts as assigned.

  • Maintain awareness of significant industry, regulatory and business changes across assigned process and businesses and their potential impact to the established control environment.

  • Become a trusted, objective, and independent partner that is sought after to provide cost-effective, independent assurance and advice on the effectiveness of the company’s management of critical risks.

Lead Audit Teams (up to 10%)

This role may be required to lead small teams of direct reports including interns, staff auditors or external contractors with specific responsibilities including (but not limited to) the following:

  • Lead projects to successful outcomes ensuring that all supporting documentation is sufficient, adequate and meets professional standards to re-perform conclusions reached.

  • Oversee learning & development to ensure team has the skills and expertise necessary to complete assigned projects and grow as individuals.

  • Provide coaching, review, and constructive feedback on audit planning, testing, documentation, and reporting to ensure quality deliverables and support team development.

Lead Professional Practice Activities (up to 10%)

The role may require the individual to lead professional practice activities to support department development and help ensure that department processes, systems and methodologies effectively and efficiently enable the department to meet its chartered objectives. Specific tasks may include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Participate in initiatives, centers of excellence and other teams that enhance the quality, methodology and processes of the department.

  • Create and implement technology solutions that support the Risk-Based Audit and SOX/MAR methodologies aligned to the IIA IPPF.

  • Create and deliver learning interventions that support RBA and SOX/MAR methodologies aligned to the IIA IPPF.

  • Monitor and improve the adoption and use of systems used in the department to increase department performance.

  • Assist IAAS Leaders in talent management activities aligned with the IIA IPPF.

  • Manage Internal Audit Quality Assurance & Improvement Process activities aligned with the IIA IPPF.

  • Create and edit professional communications using a variety of mediums with information provided by department leaders for executive or high-profile audience.

  • Create, maintain, and communicate internal department policies and information using the department SharePoint sites.

  • Create, maintain, and report on department metrics through dashboards and reports that demonstrate best practices in data visualization and continuously monitor and report on department performance to department leaders.

The Senior Special Investigator protects the assets of the organization by avoiding the payment of fraudulent claims in accordance with the applicable law and policy provisions. SIU gathers facts of the loss without exposing the company to bad faith damages.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?


  • Conducts timely investigations of suspected fraudulent claims to ensure a prompt and accurate claims decision.
  • Conducts complex recorded interviews and investigations in an effort to validate a claim or identify persons or organizations that are involved in suspicious related activities.
  • Leads high exposure, high profile and sensitive work assignments, and special investigations involving complex specialized fraud referrals, (examples: organized provider rings, staged accidents, large losses of significant exposure and broad scale P&C schemes) across multiple entities or functions-Major Cases.
  • Applies advanced knowledge of P&C insurance industry products, services, and processes in investigating claims. This includes P&C insurance policy contracts and coverages and claims handling process and procedures.
  • Applies advanced knowledge of state laws and regulations pertaining to insurance fraud in investigating claims.
  • Processes large quantities of unstructured detailed information with high levels of accuracy by collecting evidence of potential fraud through field or remote interviews and thorough searches of investigative databases, internal resources, Internet resources, public records, and forensic tools, in order to validate the company’s exposure.
  • Maintains assigned claims files in confidential manner and ensures that all relevant facts pertaining to the files are documented in the appropriate claims handling system.
  • Initiates referrals to State Insurance Department, Fraud bureaus and NICB when a suspicious or fraudulent activity has been identified.
  • Initiates civil/criminal actions based on investigative outcomes.
  • Maintains investigative databases.
  • Assist all Assurant subsidiaries and accounts with investigations.
  • Conducts Fraud Training for new hires, clients and company staff as needed.
  • Assist SIU Manager with Claims Assignment as needed.
  • ·Requests, prepares, documents, and may conduct Examinations under Oath and/or sworn statements including those involving attorney representation.
  • Conducts thorough searches using investigative databases, internal resources, internet resources, and public records to locate parties and collect evidence to determine if potential fraud exists.
  • Obtains, evaluates and summarizes law enforcement reports, credit reports, medical documentation and affidavits in relation to loss including documentation from required parties in accordance to state and federal regulations.
  • Reviews and interprets medical records, reports, and billing in relation to injury loss investigations.
  • Testifies at depositions, hearings, and trials.
  • Develops and maintains a rapport with local information networks to include law enforcement, vendors, and industry experts.
  • Handles budgeting and directs outsourced investigations to vendor partners.
  • Acts as a resource to other Special Investigators. 

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 10+ years of P&C SIU/Fraud investigation experience or relevant fraud industry investigation experience, or at least 10 years prior law enforcement investigative experience/detective rank. 
  • Knowledge of Florida Property Fraud preferred. 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Criminal Justice or relevant work experience desired.
  • CFE/CIFI/FCLS designations a plus.
  • Field Investigation experience.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills, able to work well under deadlines in a changing environment and perform multiple tasks effectively and concurrently.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with both internal and external customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively independently and within a collaborative team-oriented environment using sound judgment in decision-making.
  • Excellent communication skills both oral and written skills with strong analytical skills.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word) and claims related software programs.
  • Must be a results-oriented, skilled investigator with experience taking complex statements from multiple parties to an event.
  • Ability to gather broad range of evidence and draw conclusions based on the objective details related to the applicability of fraud.
  • Proven ability to organize and prioritize workload, performing multiple tasks and devising solutions to problems.
  • Must be able to handle high volume of investigations and remain timely on status reports.
  • Ideal candidate will reside in Florida.

$64,900.00 - $108,200.00

The Materials Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products necessary for production and operational success within the depots. In addition to managing the entire lifecycle of materials, from procurement to distribution, ensuring that production processes run smoothly, maintains optimal inventory levels to prevent shortages or excess, which can disrupt production or tie up capital unnecessarily, and implement strategies to reduce costs while maintaining quality and supply continuity. This is accomplished through the development of lean processes and procedures that meet internal and external customer requirements and the effective leadership of Inventory Control resources through clear and precise communications of responsibilities and goals.


This is an onsite role in our Irving, TX facility with a schedule of Friday - Sunday from 6 AM to 6:30 PM.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Effective operation by working with the supervisors to complete customer priorities based on demand schedules, assigning tasks/projects as needed, coordinating the flow of work, oversee completion of work, monitor key performance metrics (KPI), managing labor efficiency across the area of responsibility, mentor/coach leaders and manage headcount
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff for the department
  • Establish, track, and analyze departmental reports/measurements and present findings as appropriate
  • Work with senior management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Identify process improvements for the department along with the design of KPIs and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Develop and utilize reporting to ensure SLAs are achieved
  • Manage cycle counts and inventory control processes to ensure inventory accuracy maintained
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partners with vendor/customer/client representatives while fostering true partner relationships that allow us to manage change and growth within the individual business
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Provides technical and operational support during the business development process and new customer acquisition
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Develop and establish document controls to ensure accuracy of inventory
  • Hires, develops, evaluates, and (when necessary) disciplines and discharges subordinates’ personnel or makes authoritative recommendations in such matters
  • Develops function-specific orientation and training programs for area personnel
  • Establishes standards for effective job performance and evaluates subordinates according to such standards

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in any business or related discipline
  • Minimum seven (7) years’ experience required in a logistics/distribution, fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment with at least five (5) years of data interpretation/analysis and logistics experience and 2 of inventory management experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience with at least five (5) years’ experience managing supervisory personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • APICS CPIM designation
  • Working knowledge and understanding of MRP/ERP systems, WIP & Planning, Preferred knowledge with Oracle
  • Experience with Microsoft Great Plains
  • Highly skilled inventory control leader with extensive strategic and tactical experience, results-oriented, high energy, high urgency, and embraces effective change
  • High level of customer interaction; frequent interruptions and re-prioritization of projects based upon customer needs, working under deadlines, creative thinking, working on multiple projects simultaneously, and ability making decisions based on various levels of information
  • Working knowledge of Visio
  • Ability to interact and understand IT issues related to business processes and systems changes
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing processing procedures
  • Experience in, manufacturing, automation, electronics, systems integration, life cycle modeling, new product introduction, process development and deployment, leveraging Lean/6 Sigma tools, project and resource planning, and systems implementation

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.  This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Summer 2027 Intern to support Assurant’s Global Onboarding program, incorporating analytics and insights to improve.


This internship offers an opportunity to contribute to strategic work that improves how new employees connect, learn, and succeed across the organization. The intern will partner with leaders and team members to analyze onboarding data and feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, support program design, and help strengthen the end-to-end experiences for key stakeholders.


The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience applying analytics, research, design thinking, and project management skills to real business challenges while contributing to an enterprise-wide onboarding program.


What You'll Do

The intern may support work in the following areas:


Global Onboarding

  • Assess onboarding experiences and identify opportunities to improve the employee journey.
  • Support the development of role-based and population-specific onboarding experiences.
  • Analyze onboarding feedback and operational metrics.
  • Help document employee journeys, personas, and process improvements.

Analytics & Insights

  • Compile and analyze onboarding feedback, experience, and operational data.
  • Create visualizations, dashboards, and reports that support onboarding decisions.
  • Translate quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Conduct research and benchmarking to identify onboarding trends and leading practices.
  • Explore opportunities to use technology and AI-enabled tools to improve onboarding efficiency, measurement, and reporting.

What We're Looking For


Education

Current undergraduate student graduating between December 2027 - May 2029


Preferred Majors

  • Human Resources Management
  • Industrial-Organizational Psychology
  • Organizational Leadership
  • Organizational Development
  • Business Administration
  • Management
  • Data Analytics
  • Analytics & Information Systems
  • Psychology
  • Sociology
  • Communications
  • Learning & Development
  • Public Policy

Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret data and identify meaningful insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organization.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, survey platforms, or analytics tools is a plus.
  • Curiosity, learning agility, and a desire to improve employee experiences.

What You'll Gain

  • Exposure to enterprise Global Onboarding and employee experience work.
  • Hands-on experience supporting an enterprise-wide People Organization program.
  • Opportunities to work with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using data and insights to improve employee experience and solve business problems.
  • Development of analytics, project management, communication, and consulting skills.
  • Ownership of a meaningful project culminating in a capstone presentation to leaders.

Remote Opportunity: Atlanta

Paid Internship: $20-22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027

Job Description

Customer Care Representative Located in Arizona and Nevada

Location: Remote | Job Type: Full-Time
Schedule: Shifts may include evenings and weekends
Compensation: Competitive pay + shift differentials for nights/weekends

Why Join Us?

At Assurant, our Customer Care Representatives are the voice of our organization and the first point of contact for our valued customers. We are deeply invested in your success and committed to providing a supportive, inclusive, and growth-oriented environment.

What Sets Us Apart:

  • Benefits from Day One – Medical, dental, vision, and more

  • Paid Time Off – Including holidays

  • Career Growth – Advancement opportunities and tuition reimbursement (up to $5,000/year after 6 months)

  • Comprehensive Training – Paid virtual training to set you up for success

What You’ll Do:

  • Handle inbound customer calls and/or e-mails with empathy and professionalism

  • Resolve issues, answer questions, and provide proactive solutions

  • Document interactions and follow up as needed

  • Participate in special projects and adapt to evolving priorities

  • Deliver a WOW experience on every call—customers should hear your smile!

Note: This role does not involve cold calling, sales, or contract upgrades.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Minimum Requirements:

    • High school diploma or GED

    • Customer service experience (call center, insurance, or banking preferred)

    • Strong communication, listening, and problem-solving skills

    • Ability to multitask using technology in a fast-paced environment

    • Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps down / 6 Mbps up)

    • Quiet, distraction-free home office setup

  • Preferred Qualifications:

    • 2+ years of customer service experience

    • Prior remote work experience

Work Environment:

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week

  • Shifts may vary and include weekends and holidays

  • Must be available to work as late as 9 PM EST

  • Periodic shift bids determine schedules based on business needs

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're a great communicator, a natural problem solver, and passionate about delivering exceptional service, we’d love to hear from you!

Job.JobTitle: Summer 2027 Intern: Employee Relations & People Partner Intern
Job.JobDescription:
The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. 


Are you curious about what drives employee engagement, workplace culture, and organizational success?

At Assurant, our greatest asset is our people and our culture is a distinct competitive advantage. This is more than a traditional HR internship. You'll contribute to projects that strengthen business outcomes through influencing culture, improving employee experiences, and proactively identifying and mitigating organizational risks. Along the way, you'll develop valuable skills in employee relations, workforce analytics, problem solving, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking.


At Assurant, we're transforming the way work gets done by harnessing innovative thinking, the power of AI, automation, and data-driven insights while leveraging the unique skills of our people to deliver the greatest value in the moments that matter most. 


As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on meaningful projects focused on driving our culture and continually improving the support and experiences of our employees and leaders
  • Gain exposure to Employee Relations and HR People Partner teams
  • Analyze employee feedback and workforce data to uncover insights
  • Collaborate with experienced HR professionals and business leaders
  • Help improve processes, resources, and experiences
  • Explore emerging HR technologies, digital enablement, and AI-powered solutions
  • Present recommendations and ideas that can influence real business outcomes

You'll leave with practical experience, professional connections, and a deeper understanding of how leading organizations create great employee experiences while delivering business results.


What You'll Do

Employee Experience & Workforce Insights

  • Analyze engagement survey results, employee feedback, and workforce trends to identify themes, root causes, and opportunities.
  • Help develop presentations, dashboards, reports, and executive-ready summaries that communicate insights and recommendations.
  • Summarize survey comments and feedback trends to support People Partner priorities and action planning.
  • Research employee experience and workplace trends to inform team initiatives.

Special Projects & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with People Partners and cross-functional stakeholders on strategic and operational priorities.
  • Gather stakeholder feedback and analyze findings to identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger employee experiences.
  • Conduct research and benchmarking, then translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Support presentations, communications, project materials, and leadership updates.
  • Bring a fresh perspective by challenging assumptions, identifying new ideas, and recommending innovative approaches.
  • Contribute to projects focused on employee relations, organizational effectiveness, digital enablement, employee experience, and continuous improvement.

Performance Management & Employee Relations Support

  • Support review of performance improvement and termination documentation for completeness, consistency, and alignment with company practices, while identifying items requiring additional People Partner review.
  • Help identify recurring documentation themes and opportunities to improve consistency and effectiveness.
  • Support maintenance of templates, resources, and job aids used by the People Partner team.
  • Summarize findings and insights related to performance management and employee relations activities to drive continual improvements.

Process Improvement & Digital Enablement

  • Support documentation and continuous improvement of People Partner processes, tools, and resources.
  • Assist with process mapping and identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce administrative effort, and improve efficiency.
  • Support development, testing, and implementation of tools, templates, and digital solutions that provide consistent guidance.
  • Help maintain centralized process documentation and knowledge resources.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organizational Development, or a related field. Graduating between December 2027 - May 2028
  • Demonstrated interest in HR, employee experience, or process improvement.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, or similar tools.
  • Strong curiosity, a proactive learning mindset, and a problem-solving approach.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to organize and simplify complex information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented, and people-centered approach.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with process mapping tools, such as Visio.
  • Exposure to HR processes, employee relations, or employment practices.
  • Interest in HR technology, automation, or AI-driven solutions.
  • Experience summarizing data and creating visual insights.

Remote Opportunity: Atlanta

Paid Internship: $20-22/hour

The Buyer negotiates the purchase of equipment, supplies and services within authorized limits.  The Buyer processes purchase requisitions and purchase orders using system software and leads customer focused special projects.  The Buyer must also be familiar with purchasing contract terms, RFP process and bid analysis.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process and manage purchase orders, requisitions, and receiving transactions in support of business operations.
  • Resolve purchase order, receipt, invoice, credit, and inventory discrepancies through coordination with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
  • Manage RMA processing and reconciliation activities within Oracle to ensure accurate order and inventory records.
  • Maintain and distribute open order, backorder, and operational reports to support inventory planning, business performance, and customer commitments.
  • Partner with Order Management, Customer Service, Accounts Payable, Logistics, and suppliers to resolve escalations and support daily operations.
  • Support inbound inventory transactions, device order processing, and fulfillment activities.
  • Execute expedited and standard purchase order requests in accordance with established service-level expectations.
  • Provide operational support during periods of increased demand, business-critical events, and emergency procurement situations, including limited after-hours support when required.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance procurement efficiency, inventory accuracy, reporting, and customer satisfaction.
  • Remote support process for PO’s to be created and placed over the weekend on an emergency basis
  • Staffed for normal weekly/monthly cyclicality (daily orders from DC90 and Apple into inventory)
  • Expedite PO placement within 1 hour 
  • Standard PO placement within 6 hours 
     

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor degree in Business or Finance
  • Minimum of 3 years buying and procurement related experience
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to reconcile purchase orders, receipts, invoices, credits, and inventory transactions.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Procurement, Operations, Customer Service, Accounts Payable, Order Management, Logistics, and external suppliers.
  • Experience investigating and resolving transactional discrepancies within ERP systems.
  • Ability to support critical business operations that may require urgent response and expedited procurement activities.

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to positively adjust to changing daily demands and work volumes required.
  • Effective verbal and written skills with mid to upper-level management required.
  • Above-average telephone and interpersonal skills required.
  • Above-average judgment, initiative, problem solving, collaboration and teamwork skills required.
  • Ability to conduct Request for Proposal (RFP) projects.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel.
  • Knowledge of purchasing terms, concepts, processes and procedures.
  • Oracle/MyBuy system experience

$49,300.00 - $81,300.00

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Operations Manager, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
As the Operations Supervisor you will be responsible for the employees in our facility, ensuring its effective operation by preparing work schedules, assigning tasks, coordinating the flow of work, and assigned projects, overseeing completion of work, and monitoring performance of your team. Attention to detail, demonstrated supervisory abilities and proficiency in manufacturing, distribution, inventory, and warehousing processes are crucial experience for this position.


This is an onsite role within our Lewisville TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Thursday, 12pm – 11pm


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff
  • Work with management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment, and innovation to achieve them
  • Drive process improvements and coordinate new product introductions
  • Act as liaison between teams, shifts, supervisors and departments, and partner with vendor / customer / client representatives
  • Accomplish supervisory and human resource objectives such as hiring, performing performance reviews and mentoring / coaching and disciplinary actions
  • Manage the team training matrix to ensure accuracy and within compliance based on the individual’s assigned area
  • Review Tableau reports to ensure that the team/dept is attaining the desired performance metrics
  • Drive engagement across area of responsibility and work with the team to foster a strong engage culture. Work with Mgr to review the peakon score and create action plans within the tool
  • Meet production operational standards by implementing production, productivity and quality standards
  • Work with the site leadership to assist in resolving problems and identifying process improvements
  • Meet production financial standards by controlling and minimizing production expenses
  • Monitor production performance and ensure all daily shift production reports are completed on time
  • Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures while complying with legal regulations
  • Conduct periodic one on one meetings with associates to review performance and provide feedback/coaching.  These meetings need to be held at a minimum of once a month
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • HR Diploma or GED required
  • Minimum of 3-years of experience in a leadership role within a fast-pace, high-volume, manufacturing/repair environment
  • Strong knowledge and abilities with use of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Prior experience in a warehouse, shipping, receiving or related environment required
  • Ability to identify potential process and workflow improvements
  • Demonstrated experience with direct supervision and coaching of others
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to successfully interface with all levels of Company personnel as well as external personnel
  • High energy professional with the ability to establish and maintain effective business relationships with all suppliers and vendors
  • Strong interpersonal skills to deal effectively with problem solving, brainstorming sessions, strategy development and conflict resolution
  • Driven, goal-oriented, never confuses effort with results
  • Ability to multitask in a fast paced, dynamic assembly and logistics environment
  • May be required to work across multiple shifts

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Understanding of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Associates Degree and 3+ years of experience in supervising 15+ hourly associates in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?  

  • Position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate standard office equipment such as a computer and phone. 
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 20 pounds.
  • Occasional bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Overview of Position

The Senior Compensation Analyst serves as a key analytical and consultative partner within Assurant’s Global Compensation team. This role transforms complex compensation and workforce data into meaningful insights and recommendations that support competitive, equitable, and financially responsible pay decisions.


Working with compensation leaders, People Business Partners, Finance, and business stakeholders, the Senior Compensation Analyst independently manages market pricing, job evaluation, annual compensation programs, data analysis, reporting, and complex stakeholder requests. The role applies compensation expertise, analytical judgment, and knowledge of internal practices and external market trends to identify risks, evaluate alternatives, and recommend practical solutions.


The Senior Compensation Analyst will also help advance the function’s future-state capabilities by identifying opportunities to improve compensation processes through automation, AI-enabled tools, enhanced reporting, and process augmentation.


What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?


  • Independently manage recurring compensation programs, processes, analyses, and complex stakeholder requests.
  • Conduct job evaluations, market pricing, benchmarking, and salary survey activities; interpret findings and develop well-supported recommendations.
  • Evaluate job responsibilities, organizational context, internal compensation relationships, and external market practices to assess role scope, level, and competitive positioning.
  • Analyze compensation trends, salary movement, incentive outcomes, pay equity, and other workforce compensation matters.
  • Build market-pricing analyses, financial and scenario models, dashboards, recurring and ad hoc reports, and executive-ready presentations.
  • Support the design, planning, testing, execution, and evaluation of annual compensation programs, including merit, promotion, salary-planning, and incentive processes.
  • Review compensation requests and transactions, identify exceptions and risks, and recommend solutions consistent with compensation philosophy, guidelines, and governance.
  • Translate complex compensation data and technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for People Business Partners, managers, and business leaders.
  • Perform data-quality reviews, audits, modeling, testing, and reconciliation; identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for corrective action.
  • Lead or contribute to compensation projects and continuous-improvement initiatives, including requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, implementation, and change support.
  • Identify opportunities to improve compensation workflows through automation, AI, digital tools, standardized reporting, and stronger quality controls.
  • Monitor external market trends, regulatory developments, and evolving compensation practices to inform program decisions.
  • Maintain accurate job descriptions, market matches, compensation records, analytical methodologies, and process documentation.
  • Share technical knowledge, tools, and effective practices with junior team members.

Location & Work Arrangement

  • This position is based in the United States and follows the work arrangement established for the selected location. The role collaborates regularly with stakeholders across functions and geographies. Occasional meetings outside standard local business hours may be required to support global stakeholders or annual compensation processes.

What are the requirements needed for this position?


  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive professional experience in Compensation, Total Rewards, Human Resources, Finance, data analytics, or a related field, including meaningful experience supporting compensation programs and analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with market pricing, job evaluation, salary surveys, compensation analysis, and annual compensation processes.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to augment processes, improve data analysis, or enhance stakeholder service.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including the ability to analyze, reconcile, model, and clearly present complex datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify trends and risks, evaluate alternatives, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Ability to translate technical compensation concepts and analytical findings into clear guidance for varied audiences.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work within established deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to handle sensitive employee and compensation information with discretion and confidentiality.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, geographies, and organizational levels.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?


  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Professional compensation certification or progress toward certification, such as Certified Compensation Professional, or CCP.
  • Experience supporting global compensation programs or working within a multinational organization.
  • Experience with Workday or another human resources information system and compensation-planning platform.
  • Experience with compensation surveys and market-data platforms, job architecture, salary structures, incentive plans, or pay-equity analysis.
  • Experience developing dashboards, data visualizations, automated reporting, or other technology-enabled compensation solutions.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with People Business Partners, business leaders, Finance, Legal, or other cross-functional stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

Join a collaborative Global Compensation team where you will have meaningful ownership of compensation analyses, programs, and stakeholder support. You will have the opportunity to deepen your technical expertise, influence compensation decisions, lead process improvements, and help shape the continued evolution of Assurant’s global Compensation and Total Rewards practices.


This role is well suited for a compensation professional who enjoys turning complex data into practical recommendations and wants to help advance the function through stronger analytics, automation, AI adoption, and technology-enabled solutions.

The Materials Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products necessary for production and operational success within the depots. In addition to managing the entire lifecycle of materials, from procurement to distribution, ensuring that production processes run smoothly, maintains optimal inventory levels to prevent shortages or excess, which can disrupt production or tie up capital unnecessarily, and implement strategies to reduce costs while maintaining quality and supply continuity. This is accomplished through the development of lean processes and procedures that meet internal and external customer requirements and the effective leadership of Inventory Control resources through clear and precise communications of responsibilities and goals.

This is an onsite role at our Irving, TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Thursday from 6 AM to 4:30 PM.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Effective operation by working with the supervisors to complete customer priorities based on demand schedules, assigning tasks/projects as needed, coordinating the flow of work, oversee completion of work, monitor key performance metrics (KPI), managing labor efficiency across the area of responsibility, mentor/coach leaders and manage headcount
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff for the department
  • Establish, track, and analyze departmental reports/measurements and present findings as appropriate
  • Work with senior management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Identify process improvements for the department along with the design of KPIs and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Develop and utilize reporting to ensure SLAs are achieved
  • Manage cycle counts and inventory control processes to ensure inventory accuracy maintained
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partners with vendor/customer/client representatives while fostering true partner relationships that allow us to manage change and growth within the individual business
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Provides technical and operational support during the business development process and new customer acquisition
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Develop and establish document controls to ensure accuracy of inventory
  • Hires, develops, evaluates, and (when necessary) disciplines and discharges subordinates’ personnel or makes authoritative recommendations in such matters
  • Develops function-specific orientation and training programs for area personnel
  • Establishes standards for effective job performance and evaluates subordinates according to such standards

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in any business or related discipline
  • Minimum seven (7) years’ experience required in a logistics/distribution, fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment with at least five (5) years of data interpretation/analysis and logistics experience and 2 of inventory management experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience with at least five (5) years’ experience managing supervisory personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • APICS CPIM designation
  • Working knowledge and understanding of MRP/ERP systems, WIP & Planning, Preferred knowledge with Oracle
  • Experience with Microsoft Great Plains
  • Highly skilled inventory control leader with extensive strategic and tactical experience, results-oriented, high energy, high urgency, and embraces effective change
  • High level of customer interaction; frequent interruptions and re-prioritization of projects based upon customer needs, working under deadlines, creative thinking, working on multiple projects simultaneously, and ability making decisions based on various levels of information
  • Working knowledge of Visio
  • Ability to interact and understand IT issues related to business processes and systems changes
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing processing procedures
  • Experience in, manufacturing, automation, electronics, systems integration, life cycle modeling, new product introduction, process development and deployment, leveraging Lean/6 Sigma tools, project and resource planning, and systems implementation

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.


Do you want to join a team that helps people protect the things that matter the most to them? Are you interested in discovering how to apply the skills you’re learning in school to solve real-world challenges? Are you looking for a well-rounded experience that enables and encourages continuous learning and participation in corporate social responsibility initiatives? 

 
Assurant is looking for summer 2027 Software Engineering Interns!  
 
The internship is designed for current students and soon to be college graduates to gain a well-rounded introduction to and experience in Information Technology.  The internship will focus on principles of Agile Application Development and will equip you with transferrable skills that can help you anywhere you go.  
 

The program is a paid internship consisting of one semester focused in software engineering, application development, code quality, and automation.  You will paired with technical and leadership mentors throughout the internship, giving you access to work on the things that you are the most passionate about. You will be engaged in immersive learning experiences, from Dojos to tech talks, with the opportunity to showcase your work with our leadership.  


We’ll provide learning opportunities to further your development with concepts to include: 

  • Plan, Develop, and Support applications in various languages and disciplines 
  • Collaborate with product owners, engineers, designers and business partners to ensure that development work will meet the needs and expectations of the business 
  • Research, solve for, and engage others as necessary to design solutions that will result in the desired business outcome  
  • Ability to work and think independently  
  • Work through and aid in production issues for applications supported by the department or functional area 
  • Prepare documentation on work produced to ensure a smooth handoff to other team members, as needed  

You bring your experience, knowledge & skills: 

  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
  • Project or Team Work 
  • Presentations & Tech challenges 
  • Creative problem solver 
  • Ability to demonstrate logical thinking 
  • Community Involvement: 
  • Clubs or troops 
  • Volunteering engagements 
  • Community support

  • AI usage with CoPilot, Claude, and/or Rovo building skills and agents 
  • Internal and External integrations for authentication and authorization utilizing webhooks and service accounts 
  • Observability tooling such as Datadog and Dynatrace 
  • Azure or AWS Cloud Hosting 
  • Azure DevOps or Jira Project Management tooling 
  • Development languages and frameworks such as .NET, React, Angular, Android, iOS, Oracle, and QA Automation 

Education: 

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Development, Information Systems or a related program at an accredited university. Interns will have at least one semester remaining following the summer internship.
  • You have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2029

Hybrid Opportunity: Miami, Atlanta or Chicago (team dependent)

We are seeking a strategic and results‑oriented leader to head our Automotive Line of Business. This role leads a complex, fast‑evolving portfolio within the vehicle industry and is accountable for driving performance, profitable growth, and product strategy. Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, deep market and network awareness, and the ability to translate industry trends into sustainable business results.

This is a high‑impact opportunity to shape the future of our automotive services while leading a growing business with significant revenue and profitability goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, and execute the AUTO LOB vision, growth strategy, product roadmap, operating plans, and financial plans.
  • Analyze vehicle market trends to forecast objectives and identify and size growth opportunities.
  • Own P&L accountability for the AUTO LOB, partnering with other countries, centers of excellence, and shared services to deliver results across local and enterprise targets.
  • Recommend and manage enterprise investments, operating expenses, and advertising and promotional spend for the LOB.
  • Provide direct oversight of AUTO business performance in Puerto Rico, including client results tracked through StoneEagle metrics.
  • Maintain accountability for the performance of all AUTO products.
  • Expand the business by identifying new opportunities through client engagement, channel partnerships, competitive analysis, and industry research.
  • Apply strong risk management expertise, monitoring trends and recommending changes as needed.
  • Build and develop a high‑performing team, strengthening people capabilities to deliver both short‑ and long‑term objectives.
  • Lead cross‑functional collaboration to scale the business.
  • Coordinate efforts at regional and corporate levels to ensure strategic alignment and effective product deployment.
  • Provide inspirational leadership to the AUTO team, fostering a culture of engagement, growth, accountability, and outperformance

​Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in general management, business development, and services support.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership, with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.
  • Strong capability to transfer business knowledge and best practices across teams, geographies, and functions.
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high‑performing leadership teams.
  • Track record of fostering a culture of engagement, growth, accountability, and outperformance.
  • Candidate must reside in or relocate to Puerto Rico.

Other requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, preferably with a concentration in Finance, Accounting, or Marketing.
  • 10+ years of experience within the automotive ecosystem, including one or more of the following: Automotive OEM, Captive Finance Company, Automotive Third‑Party Administrator, Automotive Retail, Auto Lending, or Insurance.
  • Proven general management and negotiation experience in multi‑country or regional environments.
  • Deep knowledge of the Puerto Rico automotive market, including key players, dynamics, and regulatory considerations.
  • Basic working knowledge of Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance.
  • Fully bilingual (English and Spanish).

Job Description

The Division Vice President (DVP) of Assurant Dealer Services leads the strategic and operational direction of a defined geographic business. This executive is responsible for achieving and exceeding revenue targets, growing market share, budget management, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts. The DVP oversees performance of the regional sales team, drives new business development, and builds strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job? 

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with Assurant Dealer Services (ADS) goals based on expertise within the channel, participants, markets, products and competitive landscape (traditional and disruptive).
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and cost management across the division, creating a roadmap for increased profitability and commercial excellence within their division.
  • Research and proposes innovative strategies for ADS sales strategic accounts growth for their division; monitor sales effectiveness in delivering points of difference to increase our position in value creation for AIZ and our partners.
  • Provides leadership in developing best practices for measuring and optimizing strategic activities to drive data-driven decision making and excellence in their division.
  • Proactively analyze segments of customer data to uncover insights and key takeaways that inform strategic planning, increase revenue and drives business value in their division.
  • Synthesize and present data on account performance, identify areas of potential income improvement, and implement strategies to cross-sell products in their division.
  • Ensures any service gaps are addressed quickly and effectively and in situations of conflict with the client, leads the management team(s) to resolution looking to accomplish a win-win situation.  Measures client satisfaction and uses findings to identify and address areas of opportunities as well as build upon success stories in their division.
  • Collaborates with risk management team related to current clients to mitigate regulatory risk and manage client compliance and oversight requirements in their division.
  • Lead, mentor, develop and performance manage regional sales managers and support staff. Build a high-performance, results-driven culture.
  • Monitor division sales performance/pipeline metrics and provide coaching.
  • Creating a roadmap for increased profitability and excellence within their division.

Team Leadership:


Direct reports

  • 8 Regional Managers

Number of direct and indirect reports

  • Approx. 20-35

 
What are the requirements needed for this position? 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing or related field.
  • A minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in retail automotive space with concentration in the F&I arena, with demonstrated experience showing progression and increasing scope of responsibility.
  • 15 or more years in the Automotive Insurance experience and/or training industry.
  • Proven track record of strategic goal setting and personnel oversight, development and managing large, complex accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of the automotive ecosystem—OEMs, tiered suppliers, dealers, or fleet/aftermarket services.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
  • Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Prepares and supports those affected by change; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns work with strategic goals.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve business goals that support the overall organization’s goals; Understands business strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have? 

  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.​

How much should I expect to travel? 

  • Up to 70% travel

Strong preference to candidates that reside or are open to relocation to the Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Los Angeles, or Chicago markets.


#LI-Remote


The Division Vice President, ADS is a commission-based position which is eligible for participation in a sales compensation plan and a biweekly non-recoverable draw. The non-recoverable draw represents a payroll advance against future earned commissions for a fixed period of time.  Because this role is fully commission based, the earning potential is from $250,000 to $340,000.

Job.JobTitle: Summer 2027 Intern: Assurant Claims Operations Intern
Job.JobDescription:
The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.  This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


Job Purpose 

The Claims Operations Intern will gain hands-on experience within residential property claims while learning how different teams contribute to the customer experience and claim lifecycle. Working alongside experienced Claims professionals, the intern will assist with operational activities, participate in cross-functional learning opportunities, and explore areas such as claim processing, quality, compliance, transformation, subrogation, training, and customer service.  


In addition to day-to-day business assignments, the intern will complete a summer project focused on a meaningful Claims opportunity or business challenge. The intern will gather information, analyze findings, develop recommendations, and present the project’s results to Claims team members and leaders. 


This position is designed for a student interested in insurance, business operations, risk management, customer experience, or a related field. 



What You Will Do 

  • Learn how residential property claims are reviewed, documented, processed, and resolved. 
  • Support operational activities involving claim documentation, reporting, workflow management, quality review, and process improvement. 
  • Work with Claims professionals across different business areas to understand their responsibilities and contributions to the claim lifecycle. 
  • Assist with research, data gathering, analysis, and documentation supporting current business priorities. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve a Claims process, workflow, technology, training approach, or customer experience. 
  • Complete a structured summer project with clear objectives, milestones, and measurable deliverables. 
  • Present project findings, insights, and recommendations to Claims colleagues and leaders. 
  • Participate in team meetings, professional-development activities, mentorship, and the enterprise internship learning program. 

What You Will Learn 

  • How Claims Operations supports customers and the broader business. 
  • How quality, compliance, customer service, technology, and operational processes influence claim outcomes. 
  • How different Claims teams collaborate to address business needs and improve the customer experience. 
  • How to research a business problem, analyze information, and develop practical recommendations. 
  • How to communicate findings and present ideas to business partners and leaders. 
  • How to work effectively in a professional, cross-functional environment. 

Basic Qualifications 

  • You are enrolled in a bachelor's degree program and will have at least one semester remaining following the summer internship. 
  • You have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028. 
  • You are available to participate in the full internship program from May 17, 2027 through August 7, 2027. 
  • You are proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. 
  • You possess effective written and verbal communication skills. 
  • You demonstrate strong attention to detail and organizational skills. 
  • You can manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines. 
  • You can work independently while collaborating effectively with a team. 
  • You can handle customer and company information with discretion and confidentiality. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in business administration, insurance, risk management, finance, communications, operations, or a related field. 
  • Interest in claims, insurance operations, customer experience, or process improvement. 
  • Previous customer service, administrative, office, or internship experience. 
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. 
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly. 
  • Comfort working in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. 
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, procedures, and business needs. 
  • Customer-focused mindset with an interest in helping others. 
  • Experience using Excel to organize, review, or analyze information. 

What Makes You a Good Fit 

  • Organized and detail-oriented. 
  • Curious and eager to learn. 
  • Customer-focused and empathetic. 
  • Dependable and accountable. 
  • Comfortable asking questions and receiving feedback. 
  • Proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions. 
  • Able to balance accuracy with productivity. 
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 

Internship Experience 

As a Claims Processing Operations Intern, you will receive: 

  • A structured onboarding experience. 
  • An assigned manager and opportunities for mentorship. 
  • Hands-on assignments that support real business needs. 
  • Exposure to experienced Claims and Operations professionals. 
  • Professional-development and networking opportunities. 
  • Ongoing coaching and performance feedback. 
  • A meaningful internship project with an opportunity to present your work.

Remote Opportunity

Paid Internship: $20-22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/6/2027

Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

We are seeking an Underwriting Intern to join our team!


The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. 


The Underwriting Intern will support the Underwriting team by assisting with risk analysis, portfolio management, reporting, and underwriting processes that help drive informed business decisions and profitable growth. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in insurance underwriting, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while developing foundational skills for a career in underwriting and risk management.


Underwriting Analysis & Development (80%)

  • Assist the Underwriting team with data collection, analysis, and reporting of key underwriting and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Support the review and evaluation of underwriting results, trends, risk characteristics, and financial performance.
  • Assist in the preparation of underwriting reports, presentations, and business insights for internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support underwriting strategies, pricing initiatives, and risk management decisions.
  • Help identify opportunities for process improvements and support the development of more efficient underwriting practices.
  • Utilize reporting and analytical tools to manage and interpret underwriting data in support of various projects.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, finance, product, and operations teams to support business objectives.

Project Management & Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Participate in team meetings and brainstorming sessions to support underwriting initiatives and business solutions.
  • Assist in documenting underwriting processes, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support special projects related to portfolio management, risk assessment, business analytics, and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to process mapping and workflow optimization efforts.

Learning & Development Opportunities

In this role, the intern will have the opportunity to gain experience, enhance skills, and develop competencies that prepare them for future underwriting and risk management roles, including:

  • Exposure to a corporate insurance and underwriting environment
  • Understanding of underwriting principles and risk evaluation
  • Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Advanced use of data analysis and reporting tools
  • Experience working with business performance metrics and portfolio analysis
  • Ability to develop business recommendations supported by data and research
  • Experience presenting findings and insights to stakeholders
  • Exposure to cross-functional collaboration and business decision-making

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years completed and currently enrolled in a 3rd or 4th year undergraduate program in Risk Management, Finance, Business Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master's degree candidates will also be considered.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and basic modeling.
  • Interest in insurance, underwriting, risk assessment, and business analytics.

Other Skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional demeanor and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound recommendations based on available information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience using data visualization or analytical tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar) is a plus.
  • Coursework in insurance, risk management, finance, statistics, or related disciplines preferred.

Remote Opportunity

End Date: 8/7/2027

Overview

The Global Finance Internship Program at Assurant is a 12-week immersive experience designed to provide hands-on exposure within Accounting, Business Finance, Tax, Investments, Internal Audit & Analytics, Vendor Management or Actuarial. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization. 


Interns will contribute to meaningful business initiatives, gain insight into enterprise financial operations, and develop professional capabilities through structured learning and mentorship.  This program concludes with a capstone presentation delivered to leadership. 


Interns will be placed into one of several functional teams based on interests, coursework, and business need. High-performing interns may be considered for future full-time opportunities within Assurant’s Finance organization.


What You’ll Do

Responsibilities vary by placement area, but interns can expect to perform one or more of the following tasks:

  • Support financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and reconciliation activities
  • Participate in month‑end financial close tasks and audit preparation
  • Analyze structured data and develop insights to support business decisions
  • Assist in building dashboards, financial models, and KPI reports
  • Conduct research, synthesize findings, and communicate recommendations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on ongoing projects and strategic initiatives
  • Present project outcomes and learnings during final capstone

Specialized Finance Tracks

  • Accounting: Gain exposure to corporate and international accounting operations, financial reporting (including SEC and statutory), controllership activities, audit support, and balance sheet reconciliation processes.
  • Finance: Support financial planning, forecasting, expense management, client profitability analysis, and financial modeling across domestic and international business units.
  • Vendor Management: Assist in global vendor risk oversight, regulatory research, and emerging risk analysis to support enterprise compliance and operational resilience.
  • Internal Audit & Analytics:  Contribute to risk-based audit activities and leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI) to enhance audit insights and financial transparency.
  • Tax: Support state and local tax compliance, research, and planning initiatives within a complex regulatory environment.
  • Investments: Assist with portfolio analytics, income forecasting, risk assessment, and strategic asset allocation activities within the enterprise investment function.
  • Actuarial: Support pricing, ratemaking, reserving, forecasting, and financial reporting activities that inform risk and profitability management.

Basic Qualifications

  • You are currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, Actuarial Science/Mathematics, or related field and will have at least on semester remaining following the summer internship
  • Expected graduation between December 2027 – June 2029
  • Basic Excel skills
  • Willingness to develop advanced Excel & Power BI skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical mindset with curiosity and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to organize and interpret structured data
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach
  • Interest in accounting, finance, risk, investments, or analytics

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Excel: pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning
  • Power BI: dashboards, KPIs (training provided)
  • SQL and/or other data tools (preferred for some tracks)
  • Understanding of performance metrics and financial statements
  • Automation/AI exposure
  • PowerPoint and executive-level presentation skills
  • Progress towards professional designations (CPA, CFA, ACAS, etc.)

Finance at Assurant

Finance at Assurant is about more than numbers—it’s about creating clarity and confidence in a complex world. Our teams operate across global markets and provide analytical insight and financial stewardship that empower the organization to invest smartly, innovate boldly, and deliver long‑term value. This internship will provide exposure to how finance helps strengthen and sustain our business globally.


Hybrid Opportunity: 2 days per week in office

Paid Internship: $25/hour

End Date: 8/7/2027

Job.JobDescription:
The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.  This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


The Data Support interns primary role is to support the department’s systems and staff by recommending and implementing system enhancements that promote efficiency, compliance, and growth. The position requires a well-rounded individual that supports operations staff and systems by maintaining and monitoring production applications, processes, and data.  Regularly analyzing, maintaining, and supporting system files, tables, and configurations used to drive the base functionality of corporate applications.  Contributes to support activities and project assignments of low to medium risk and complexity.  This includes activities such as requirement definition, research, analysis, coordination, testing, training, and documentation.  


PRODUCTION ANALYSIS AND SUPPORT: 


  • Provides general support for various business applications, databases, and integrations.
  • Analyze systems, processes, and data issues of low to medium complexity and provide options to for remediation to more experienced team members.
    • Enter low to medium complex routine user-maintained table changes and configurations.
    • Troubleshoot low complexity system issues with limited direction.
  • Ability to identify priority issues and determine which issues can be handled within the authority of an analyst and being able to discern those issues requiring direction from a higher authority.
  • Contributes to training efforts by writing documentation and manuals, preparing presentations, delivering training, and providing follow-up.

DATA ANALYSIS:

  • Ability to extract data from a variety of internal and external data sources.
  • Support both scheduled and ad hoc report requests.
  • Analyze data to deliver reporting and metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Document new and existing data sources, processes, tables, and fields.
  • Validate the integrity of the data shown in reports by performing regular data analysis.

REQUIREMENTS DEFINITION: 

  • Participate in analysis and definition of business and functional requirements, including client sessions and interviews.
  • Analyze requirements for new projects and processes.
  • Acts as the business and technical liaison during analysis, requirements definition, and design activities.

TESTING, DEBUGGING, TEST MANAGEMENT, QUALITY ASSURANCE:

  • Participates in definition of testing scope and scenarios, and estimates of effort, and duration on low to medium scale projects based on the business requirements.
  • Prepares test plans and scripts for low to medium scale projects.
    • Research, document, report, and communicate any defects with functionality, flow and/or program changes.
  • Performs user acceptance testing and deliver results for peer, team, and management review.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT: 

  • Display knowledge of project management principles and apply Company approved methodology.
  • Prioritize and coordinate activities of project team members for low impact projects.
  • Participate as a project team member for low to medium complex projects.
  • Identify project issues and communicate progress and obstacles to sponsors and/or management.
  • Handles multiple tasks and small projects, concurrently.
  • Participate in cost/benefit analysis.

IMPLEMENTATION: 

  • Coordinate production implementation efforts with User community and IT for low to medium complex support activities and project assignments.
  • Communicate implementation timelines and tasks.
  • Develop the User Documentation and Training material.
  • Train the trainers and/or impacted associates.
  • Post-implementation audits/reviews.

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT, RELATIONSHIP BUILDING, AND COMMUNICATIONS: 

  • Apply new knowledge rapidly.
  • Continuously seek opportunities for professional development.
  • Demonstrate quality, attentiveness, and attention to detail in all work activities.
  • Build relationships with internal and external customers and business partners.
  • Ability to manage stakeholder expectations using effective verbal and written communication skills.

 Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Risk/Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related field.
  • Requires experience extracting and analyzing data from a variety of sources such as Excel, delimited files, fixed width files, APIs, and SQL Server databases.
  • Requires skills of extracting and analyzing data using a variety of methods including SQL, Excel, and Power BI.

Other Requirements

  • Requires ability to continuously learn a variety of applications and skills.
  • Requires ability to process time sensitive data, make decisions and communicate actions.
  • Requires good organization, self-motivation skills, and manage multiple assignments and priorities.
  • Requires ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing to management, team members, business, and technology professionals.
  • Requires ability to adapt to a variety of project team roles, such as analyst, tester, documentation writer, or trainer.
