The Senior Buyer negotiates the purchase of complex equipment and strategic services within authorized limits, processes purchase requisitions and purchase orders using system software, looks for optimization, cost reduction, improved lead-times and product quality.  The Senior Buyer coaches and mentors any Associate Buyer and Buyer.  The Senior Buyer must have advanced knowledge of purchasing contract terms, RFP process, bid analysis and must be able to lead complex customer-focused special projects.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job? 

  • Purchase goods and services by utilizing the Procurement operation processes and technology across Assurant enterprise to meet the needs of the customers.
  • Review purchase requisitions for completeness and accuracy.
  • Develop, implement and follow established Procurement policies, procedures and organization structure.
  • Manage suppliers, internal costs, quality and delivery performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement on end-to-end aspects of the procurement process.
  • Maintain and promote sound relationships with suppliers and the business community.
  • Maintain positive relationships and communication with internal customers.
  • Demonstrate understanding of market trends and conditions for product changes.

What are the requirements needed for this position? 

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business or Finance
  • 5 years buying and procurement related experience
  • Ability to positively adjust to changing daily demands and work volumes required.
  • Effective verbal and written skills with mid to upper-level management required.
  • Above-average telephone and interpersonal skills required.
  • Above-average judgment, initiative, problem solving, collaboration and teamwork skills required.
  • Ability to conduct Request for Proposal (RFP) projects.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel.
  • Knowledge of purchasing terms, concepts, processes and procedures.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have? 

  • CPM certification

Why Assurant?  

  • People First – we prioritize employee well-being and development 
  • Empowerment – we enable our people to do their best work 
  • Benefits effective day one 
  • 401K Match – up to 6% dollar-for-dollar 

The Company 

Assurant, Inc. redefines the boundaries of protection — safeguarding and servicing connected devices, homes, automobiles, and commercial equipment in partnership with the world’s most successful brands. As a Fortune 500 company operating in 21 countries, Assurant leads the way in leveraging insights and technology to transform customer connections that build loyalty and drive value. With more than 325 million consumers protected worldwide, Assurant is behind the scenes helping brands deliver reliable, meaningful experiences customers can count on, so brands can shine and customers can have peace of mind. 

  

Global Impact 

Assurant is a purpose-driven company committed to advancing a connected, respected, and protected world. Through our focus on Connected Communities, Respected Resources, and a Protected Planet, we integrate sustainability into our long-term strategy in ways that support our business, strengthen operations, and help us deliver value for clients, customers, employees, and communities. 

  

Assurant Culture 

The Assurant Way defines how we show up for our clients, customers, communities, and one another — with Common Sense, Common Decency, Uncommon Thinking, and Uncommon Results. Recognized on Forbes’ list of the World’s Best Employers, named among Fortune’s America’s Most Innovative Companies, and consistently ranked as a “Best/Great Place to Work” in 14 countries, Assurant attracts talented people who are passionate about service, practical innovation, and delivering meaningful results. 

  

Benefits & Rewards 

Assurant is committed to providing a competitive rewards package that offers market-competitive benefits and resources designed to support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing.

The Senior Process Engineer is responsible for driving operational excellence across a high-volume, highly automated manufacturing facility. This role provides technical leadership for manufacturing processes, equipment optimization, new product introductions, and large-scale continuous improvement initiatives to achieve world-class safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.


The Senior Process Engineer leads cross-functional projects from concept through implementation, develops standardized manufacturing processes, and serves as a technical mentor to Process Engineers and Operations teams. This position partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Automation, Supply Chain, and customers to improve manufacturing capability while supporting production performance and business objectives.


This is an onsite role in our Mt. Juliet TN facility with a schedule of Monday - Friday, 8AM – 5PM.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?


Manufacturing Process Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and engineering support for all production operations.
  • Develop, optimize, and standardize manufacturing processes to improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
  • Design and maintain manufacturing work instructions, process documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Establish best practices that improve process consistency and manufacturing reliability.
  • Support new product introductions, equipment launches, and production transfers.

Project Management

  • Lead complex, cross-functional capital and operational improvement projects.
  • Develop project timelines, budgets, resource plans, launch curves, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Create project dashboards and tracking systems to ensure milestones, deliverables, and financial targets are achieved.
  • Coordinate activities between Engineering, Operations, Quality, Automation, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and external suppliers.
  • Present project status and business results to plant leadership.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and Value Stream Mapping initiatives throughout the facility.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing cost, improve throughput, eliminate waste, and increase equipment utilization.
  • Utilize data analytics to identify process bottlenecks and prioritize improvement opportunities.

Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving

  • Lead structured problem-solving activities utilizing:
    • DMAIC
    • 8D
    • 5 Why
    • Fishbone Analysis
    • FMEA
  • Investigate manufacturing failures, field returns, and customer complaints.
  • Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate recurring issues.
  • Support production during critical downtime events and major quality issues.

Data Analysis

  • Analyze manufacturing KPIs including:
    • Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
    • First Pass Yield (FPY)
    • Throughput
    • Cycle Time
    • Scrap
    • Rework
    • Labor Efficiency
    • Cost per Unit
    • Capacity Utilization
  • Utilize statistical analysis and manufacturing data to drive operational decisions.
  • Develop reports and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or similar analytical tools.

Cross Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Production, Maintenance, Automation, Quality, Materials, Supply Chain, Product Engineering, and Customers to achieve operational objectives.
  • Coordinate with suppliers on component issues and alternate material qualifications.
  • Support manufacturing readiness during new product launches.
  • Lead engineering reviews and communicate technical recommendations to leadership.

Coaching & Technical Leadership

  • Mentor Process Engineers
  • Coach manufacturing supervisors and production teams on Lean Manufacturing principles.
  • Provide technical guidance during equipment startups and process improvements.
  • Lead engineering knowledge-sharing and technical training sessions.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline
  • 3+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment
  • Experience leading large cross-functional manufacturing projects
  • Strong project management experience with budgets, schedules, and resource planning
  • Demonstrated experience in Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experience with highly automated manufacturing systems
  • Strong analytical and statistical problem-solving skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Project
  • Experience using AutoCAD for manufacturing layouts
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience in consumer electronics, wireless devices, or electronics refurbishment.
  • Experience in high-volume automated manufacturing facilities.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required; Black Belt preferred.
  • Knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC), Minitab, and process capability analysis.
  • Experience supporting robotics, vision systems, conveyors, and automated material handling.
  • Power BI or advanced manufacturing analytics experience.
  • Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and product launches

The Supply Chain Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products necessary for production and operational success within the depots. In addition to managing the entire lifecycle of materials, from procurement to distribution, ensuring that production processes run smoothly, maintains optimal inventory levels to prevent shortages or excess, which can disrupt production or tie up capital unnecessarily, and implement strategies to reduce costs while maintaining quality and supply continuity. This is accomplished through the development of lean processes and procedures that meet internal and external customer requirements and the effective leadership of Inventory Control resources through clear and precise communications of responsibilities and goals.

This is an onsite role in our Irving, TX facility. Multiple shifts and positions are available.

This job posting is part of our ongoing efforts to build a strong talent network for current and future opportunities. We invite you to apply, and qualified candidates will be contacted as roles become available.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Effective operation by working with the supervisors to complete customer priorities based on demand schedules, assigning tasks/projects as needed, coordinating the flow of work, oversee completion of work, monitor key performance metrics (KPI), managing labor efficiency across the area of responsibility, mentor/coach leaders and manage headcount
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff for the department
  • Establish, track, and analyze departmental reports/measurements and present findings as appropriate
  • Work with senior management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Identify process improvements for the department along with the design of KPIs and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Develop and utilize reporting to ensure SLAs are achieved
  • Manage cycle counts and inventory control processes to ensure inventory accuracy maintained
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partners with vendor/customer/client representatives while fostering true partner relationships that allow us to manage change and growth within the individual business
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Provides technical and operational support during the business development process and new customer acquisition
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Develop and establish document controls to ensure accuracy of inventory
  • Hires, develops, evaluates, and (when necessary) disciplines and discharges subordinates’ personnel or makes authoritative recommendations in such matters
  • Develops function-specific orientation and training programs for area personnel
  • Establishes standards for effective job performance and evaluates subordinates according to such standards

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in any business or related discipline
  • Minimum seven (7) years’ experience required in a logistics/distribution, fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment with at least five (5) years of data interpretation/analysis and logistics experience and 2 of inventory management experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience with at least five (5) years’ experience managing supervisory personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • APICS CPIM designation
  • Working knowledge and understanding of MRP/ERP systems, WIP & Planning, Preferred knowledge with Oracle
  • Experience with Microsoft Great Plains
  • Highly skilled inventory control leader with extensive strategic and tactical experience, results-oriented, high energy, high urgency, and embraces effective change
  • High level of customer interaction; frequent interruptions and re-prioritization of projects based upon customer needs, working under deadlines, creative thinking, working on multiple projects simultaneously, and ability making decisions based on various levels of information
  • Working knowledge of Visio
  • Ability to interact and understand IT issues related to business processes and systems changes
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing processing procedures

The VP, Client Supply Chain Solutions leads the development, execution, and expansion of the strategic account plan for the client, with specific responsibility for identifying, positioning, and selling Assurant's supply chain capabilities as a core value driver within the broader client relationship. This senior commercial leader serves as a trusted advisor, connecting client's business priorities with Assurant solutions across supply chain, device lifecycle, logistics, reverse logistics, repair, refurbishment, fulfillment, inventory management, and operational optimization.

This role is accountable for expanding the relationship beyond existing programs by shaping growth opportunities, influencing senior client stakeholders, and translating Assurant's operational capabilities into compelling commercial solutions. The successful candidate will improve client outcomes, support profitable revenue growth, and strengthen the long-term strategic partnership.

The VP will engage senior and mid-level client leaders across business, operations, supply chain, finance, product, and executive stakeholder groups, while leading direct and matrixed teams across Assurant.  This role will be based on site at our Irving, Texas location.   

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead the creation and execution of the strategic account plan for the client, with a focus on expanding revenue, strengthening executive engagement, and identifying new opportunities to position Assurant supply chain capabilities. 
  • Build and cultivate senior-level relationships across the client business, operations, supply chain, finance, product, and executive stakeholder groups to understand priorities, anticipate needs, and position Assurant as a strategic partner. 
  • Identify, develop, and advance commercial opportunities related to device lifecycle management, logistics, reverse logistics, repair, refurbishment, fulfillment, inventory management, operational efficiency, and related value-added services. 
  • Translate client business objectives and operational challenges into compelling solution opportunities, partnering with internal supply chain, operations, product, finance, legal, pricing, and implementation teams to develop client-ready proposals and business cases. 
  • Lead cross-functional selling efforts for new supply chain solutions, clearly articulating client value, financial impact, service performance, scalability, and alignment with the client’s strategic priorities. 
  • Guide direct and matrixed teams in the development of annual business plans, client business reviews, growth roadmaps, and executive-level presentations that demonstrate performance, highlight operational value, and advance mutual revenue goals. 
  • Develop, negotiate, and execute complex commercial agreements, renewals, expansions, and amendments that support Assurant growth objectives and the client’s evolving supply chain and customer experience needs. 
  • Partner with operational leaders to ensure sold solutions are executable, scalable, and aligned with contracted service expectations, while driving accountability for performance, service utilization, and client satisfaction. 
  • Lead the prioritization and coordination of client initiatives, including supply chain capability launches, operational enhancements, product or service expansions, and implementation of new client solutions. 
  • Anticipate and resolve client issues by engaging appropriate cross-functional leaders, driving operational process improvements, and ensuring supply chain performance supports the overall health and growth of the relationship. 
  • Monitor account financial performance, opportunity pipeline, margin considerations, contract economics, and mutual business outcomes to ensure growth opportunities are commercially sound and strategically aligned. 
  • Mentor account management leaders and cross-functional partners on strategic client engagement, executive communication, consultative selling, and positioning supply chain capabilities as part of an integrated client growth strategy. 

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • BS/BA degree; MBA preferred.
  • 15+ years of sales and/or marketing experience.
  • 15+ years of experience interacting with large, complex mobile industry clients and developing strategic relationships.
  • 7+ years of experience directly leading the work of others, including direct people leadership and supervision.
  • Demonstrated industry experience and deep knowledge of mobile supply chain, device lifecycle, logistics, reverse logistics, repair, refurbishment, fulfillment, inventory management, or related services.
  • Experience developing and executing long-term strategic plans spanning three or more years.
  • Experience managing complex commercial opportunities, account financial performance, pricing, margin considerations, contract economics, and revenue growth.

Core Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of complex deals and contracts, with advanced negotiation skills.
  • Advanced business and financial acumen, including the ability to build and evaluate compelling business cases.
  • Expert ability to cultivate strategic relationships and influence senior and C-suite leaders.
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including executive presentations and commercial pitches.
  • Ability to translate client needs and operational challenges into clear, scalable, and financially viable solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and disciplined management of multiple priorities, stakeholders, and initiatives.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong judgment balancing client advocacy, operational feasibility, commercial value, and long-term partnership objectives.

Communication & Leadership

  • Proven ability to serve as a trusted advisor to senior client and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence without authority and align direct and matrixed teams around shared priorities.
  • Confidence leading difficult conversations, resolving escalations, and presenting recommendations to executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor account management leaders and elevate consultative selling and executive engagement capabilities.

Analytical & Operational Skills

  • Ability to assess account performance, opportunity pipeline, financial trends, operational data, and client feedback to identify risks and growth opportunities.
  • Ability to connect service performance and operational capabilities with measurable client and financial outcomes.
  • Proficiency with business software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

As a Wireless Technician, you will inspect, refurbish, test, program, tune, troubleshoot and repair complex radio frequency electro-mechanical devices such as mobile phones.   You will work from complex schematics and diagrams, and utilize Multi-meters, Oscilloscopes, RF Signal Generators, Spectrum Analyzers and Communication Test Sets to troubleshoot faults to the component level. 

Additionally, you will work independently at your station but will also have the opportunity to work in a friendly, team-oriented environment.  This is a production environment with productivity requirements and quality standards.  If you enjoy working with your hands and want to work with the latest in wireless technology, this may be the perfect career opportunity for you!

This role is based at our Irving, TX location with a schedule of Monday - Thursday from 6am to 4:30pm

This job posting is part of our ongoing efforts to build a strong talent network for current and future opportunities. We invite you to apply, and qualified candidates will be contacted as roles become available.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job? 

  • Conduct root case failure analysis and troubleshooting on suspected defective equipment

  • Perform repetitive electromechanical assembly using hand and electric tools 

  • Must be able to perform component level and board repairs

  • Identify and report root cause deficiencies

  • Identify and report routine process deficiencies

  • Test, repair and program equipment

  • Perform soldering and de-soldering using handheld soldering equipment

  • Work with care and urgency in order to meet production goals

  • Participate in continuous improvement and team building activities

  • Refer to and follow Standard Operating Procedures to perform the job duties

  • Physically move material as needed

  • Perform other duties as assigned 

 What are the requirements needed for this position? 

  • High school diploma or GED

  • Two years skill-related experience such as working with components, testing requirements and/or assembly of small electronics

  • Demonstrated high-level proficiency with soldering and de-soldering

  • Basic computer skills and the ability to enter data on multiple screens

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment

  • Ability to interact effectively and positively with all levels of company personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have? 

  • Associates degree in electronics or technical degree in a related field

  • One year of previous experience working in a manufacturing environment

  • Knowledgeable in analog, digital and RF disciplines

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job? 

  • Must be able to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds

  • Must be able to work overtime and on Saturdays as needed

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus

  • Must be able to talk and hear

  • Required to use hands and fingers, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • The noise level in the work environment is low, and it is an Electro Static Discharge (ESD) safe area; wrist strap and smocks must be worn at all times

$ 19,08 - $ 30,53

A Day in the Life of a Customer Service Associate

As a valued member of a diverse and collaborative team, you play a key role in supporting our customers when they need us most.

  • You’re the first voice they hear, assisting with a wide range of situations, from auto and home claims to motorhome incidents and roadside assistance.
  • Working remotely, you’ll take inbound calls from the comfort of your home, with access to a variety of shift options.
    • Structured work environment, taking calls up to 7 hours of your day.
  • You guide customers through the claims process, setting clear expectations and helping them feel at ease.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail are essential, and you’ll be fully trained to document each interaction with care.
  • You’re part of a supportive team environment, where collaboration and encouragement are part of the daily routine, led by a dedicated supervisor.

Essential Job Functions

  • Responds to inbound telephone inquiries in a Claims Contact Center.
  • Initiates auto and homeowner claims by obtaining preliminary loss information from agents, insureds and third parties.
  • Provide customers with an explanation of the claim process.
  • May authorize services such as road side assistance and rental cars.
  • Responsible for efficient and accurate completion of customer inquiries regarding the status of existing claims.
  • Ensures all customer interactions are clearly and accurately documented in the claim file.
  • Maintains job knowledge through intermittent training/learning and incorporates new information into daily tasks.

Key Qualifications

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Proficient in both written and spoken English.
  • Assumes personal accountability for actions and outcomes.
  • Possesses flexability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Experience & Skill Requirements

  • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to navigate multiple systems, computer screens, and communication platforms simultaneously.
    • Ability to troubleshoot connectiviety issues, if needed. 
  • Typing speed of at least 30 WPM with 90% accuracy.
  • Customer service experience is highly preferred.
  • Remote contact center experience is a plus, but not required.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent High School diploma or equivalent required.

Physical Actions & Enviroment

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions.

  • Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift.
  • Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
  • Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance.
  • Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (e.g. others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction.
  • Visually verifies and reads information.
  • Visually locates material, resources and other objects.
  • Ability to operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift.
  • Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

We are seeking an experienced attorney with experience handling habitability, landlord-tenant, and HOA matters to join our Southern California staff counsel team! Our attorneys work from home and handle in-person appearances and trials as required. We offer developmental opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package including annual bonus potential up to 20% of the salary, generous 401k, auto allowance, PTO, medical/dental/vision, paid parental leave, and much more all without the stress of billable hours!   

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily moderate to high complexity and exposure and/or involve unique insurance defense issues. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates moderate to high complexity and exposure cases and/or cases involving unique legal or procedural issues and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement. This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Acts as the lead attorney at hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Develops strategies and arguments to thoroughly prepare for trial.
  • Utilizes knowledge of legal precedents to analyze the probable outcomes of a case. 
  • Identifies the strengths and weaknesses of approaches to a case.
  • Performs or ensures completion of any other tasks or duties necessary for the proper representation of clients.
  • Consults with Claims Executive team and renders legal strategy recommendations regarding the legal aspects of the handling of personal injury claims.
  • Provides guidance to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Interprets applicable industry laws, rulings and regulations.
  • Functionally supervises attorneys who are assisting in the handling of cases as development opportunities.
  • Provides guidance and mentorship with the autonomy to learn.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrollable outside environmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Seven years of litigation experience required. Insurance defense, personal injury, and/or jury trial experience required. First and second chair trial experience in bodily injury litigation strongly preferred. Multistate jurisdictional practice preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function and handle high case loads in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Effective leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to command the attention of an audience. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Possesses a genuine interest in the defense of Insurance regulations. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Handles conflict effectively with the ability to quickly interpret and respond to new information. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Excellent time management and priority setting skills. Articulate and responsive to colleagues. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

A dedicated workspace, free of noise and distractions is required. 

A Day in the Life of a BW Claims Customer Service Associate

As a valued member of a diverse and collaborative team, you play a key role in supporting our customers when they need us most.

  • You’re the first voice they hear, assisting with a wide range of situations, from auto and roadside assistance.
  • Working remotely, you’ll take inbound calls from the comfort of your home, with access to a variety of shift options.
    • Structured work environment, taking calls up to 7 hours of your day.
  • You guide customers through the claims process, setting clear expectations and helping them feel at ease.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail are essential, and you’ll be fully trained to document each interaction with care.
  • You’re part of a supportive team environment, where collaboration and encouragement are part of the daily routine, led by a dedicated supervisor.

Essential Job Functions

Responds to inbound telephone inquiries in a Claims Contact Center.

  • Initiates auto and homeowner claims by obtaining preliminary loss information from agents, insureds and third parties.
  • Provide customers with an explanation of the claim process.
  • May authorize services such as road side assistance and rental cars.
  • Responsible for efficient and accurate completion of customer inquiries regarding the status of existing claims.
  • Ensures all customer interactions are clearly and accurately documented in the claim file.
  • Maintains job knowledge through intermittent training/learning and incorporates new information into daily tasks.

Key Qualifications

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Proficient in both written and spoken English.
  • Assumes personal accountability for actions and outcomes.
  • Possesses flexability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Experience & Skills

  • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to navigate multiple systems, computer screens, and communication platforms simultaneously.
    • Ability to troubleshoot connectiviety issues, if needed. 
  • Typing speed of at least 30 WPM with 90% accuracy.
    • A Typing Assessment will be administered, if considered for the role. 
  • Customer service experience is highly preferred.
  • Remote contact center experience is a plus, but not required.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent High School diploma or equivalent required. 

Physical Actions & Environment

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions.

  • Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift.
  • Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily high complexity and exposure and/or involve unique insurance defense issues. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution. Assumes first and/or second chair responsibility for reassigned cases that are in the late stages of litigation.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates cases of high complexity and exposure, which may involve unique legal or procedural issues in all venues to full resolution through trial and/or settlement.
  • This includes but is not limited to: preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Acts as the lead attorney at hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Develops and utilizes strategies and arguments to thoroughly prepare for trial.
  • Utilizes knowledge of legal precedents to analyze the probable outcome of a case. 
  • Identifies the strengths and weaknesses of approaches to a case.
  • Performs or ensures completion of any other tasks or duties necessary for the proper representation of clients.
  • Assumes responsibility to act as first or second chair for cases that are in the late stages of litigation, including trials, when necessary.
  • Handles any matter assigned within their State of licensure and courts of admittance and may be required to seek admission and handle matters in other jurisdictions. 
  • Leads knowledge sharing of industry legal trends and developments.
  • Provides job-related guidance, mentoring, and training to other attorneys.
  • Consults with Claims Executive team and renders legal strategy recommendations regarding the legal aspects of the handling of personal injury claims.
  • Provides guidance to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Interprets applicable industry laws, rulings and regulation.
  • Functionally supervises attorneys who are assisting in the handling of cases as development opportunities.
  • Provides guidance and mentorship with the autonomy to learn.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment with exposure to uncontrolled outside environmental conditions as required by the exigencies of the issues or subject matter. High Exposure Attorneys are expected to handle any matter assigned within their State of licensure and Courts of Admittance, which may require travel by vehicle, train, or air with extended overnight and/or lengthier travel periods.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Experience handling matters that are high complexity and/or exposure, including first chair jury trial experience, and/or comparable court experience required. Multistate jurisdictional practice strongly preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Expansive knowledge of both procedural and substantive law. Superlative skills in all areas including, but not limited to, trial, public speaking and/or communication, case preparation, strategy, advocacy, negotiations, depositions, expert witnesses, damages, ana lysis/evaluation, reporting and client/customer service.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to command the attention of an audience. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Handles conflict effectively with the ability to quickly interpret and respond to new information. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Articulate and responsive to colleagues. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment. Other. Possesses expansive knowledge of procedural and substantive law and superlative skills in all areas of litigation, including but not limited to trials, public speaking and/or communication, case preparation, strategy, advocacy, negotiations, depositions, expert witnesses, case analysis/evaluation, reporting, and client/customer service.

Job Summary

  • Participates in training program to learn policies, practices, procedures, and strategies needed to become a Special Claims Representative.
  • Trains to handle more complex claims promptly, proactively, and with a sense of urgency.
  • Performs work under the guidance and supervision of a trainer.
  • Trainee is required to meet eligibility requirements and pass a certification exam at the end of training program.
  • Trainees who successfully complete this training program may be placed into a Special Claims Representative role of equivalent salary grade.

Essential Job Functions

  • In a supervised learning environment, trains to adjust more complex claims.
  • Learns skills such as conducting thorough investigations, establishing damages, determining liability, negotiating settlements, preparing of subrogration and/or arbitration, making claim payments, confirming policy coverage, and explaining claim determination to parties incident to the claim.
  • Works in electronic claim files to handle assigned claims within designated authority.

  • Reports theft, fraud, and arson losses as required by state and industry regulations.

The starting wage for this position is $26.01 per hour or higher. Additional compensation may be offered basedon relevant experience and transferable skills.

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Workplace: Field-based role in Arkansas 

Job Summary

  • This position manages an assigned territory of core Foremost Independent Agencies, including responsibilities to prospect and appoint new agencies with guidance, drive profitable premium growth, and achieve financial and operational goals. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company.
  • The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services, including a portfolio of moderately complex accounts, within an assigned territory. This role is at the forefront of building premium growth through relationships with agents to ensure market share is built successfully.
  • This position is an individual contributor who receives moderate guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts. The position is remote with required weekly field travel.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned territory driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets. With moderate guidance from management and field distribution partners, assists in leading, developing, and executing territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary.
  • With coaching, builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships in person with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework. Establishes position as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training, to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue. With moderate guidance, creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals.
  • Coordinates plans with field distribution partners, including strategic and tactical components, to align with business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support. With coaching, drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both ind ividual agency books and overall assigned territory. Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across territory.
  • Strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production/profitability data and analysis. Performs other duties as ass igned.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Education Requirements

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Position Highlights

  • Start Date: January 25, 2027
    • Candidates who currently hold an active adjuster license will be eligible for a later start date of February 8, 2027.
  • Paid Training: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Eastern for 8 weeks
  • Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Eastern
  • Starting Salary: $54,100 - $77,854 annually. Compensation is based on several factors, including experience, skills, job level, and geographic location.

Please review the schedule and location requirements carefully before applying. Candidates must be available to attend all required training sessions and meet the hybrid work location requirement.

Overview of the Role

A Bristol West Claims Medpip Representative conducts claims investigations, coverage confirmation, establishes appropriate medical necessity and payment of claims settlement. Using claims systems to accurately document files, they manage a diary and handle first party medical claims promptly, proactively and with a sense of urgency.

A Day in the Life of a Bristol West MedPip Representative

  • Evaluates Personal Injury Protection (PIP) and Med Pay claims for eligibility, medical necessity, and appropriateness of charges in accordance with state fee schedules.
  • Determines relatedness, causation, and appropriateness of treatment based on the compensable injury.
  • Provides reserve recommendations and makes payment approval to ensure activities are consistent with corporate policies.
  • Conducts detail bill reviews and process claims within designated authority levels.
  • Makes contacts with stakeholders to investigate and process claims.
  • Contacts may include multiple attempts to communicate with various parties and requires telephone conversations or other methods of communication to be a priority.
  • Parties involved could include policy holders, claimants, agents, witnesses, contractors, police and fire departments, state and county fraud and arson personnel, special investigators, attorneys, expert witnesses, members of the medical profession and other persons pertaining to the investigation and processing of claims.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Ability to obtain Adjuster License through Department of Insurance.  

Experience Requirements

  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic work environment.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude including the ability to maneuver multiple system platforms simultaneously.
  • Ability to mentor peers.

Job Summary

The Lead Pricing Actuary is a senior actuarial and business leader responsible for shaping pricing strategies that drive profitable growth, rate adequacy, and competitive performance across Personal and Commercial products and markets. This role leads the development of rate indications, pricing recommendations, and portfolio insights by integrating actuarial analysis, claims trends, reserving considerations, and market dynamics.

As a strategic partner to Product, Claims, Finance, Underwriting, and Reserving leaders, the Lead Pricing Actuary translates complex actuarial findings into actionable business recommendations that influence key enterprise decisions. The role provides leadership to a high-performing actuarial organization, develops talent, and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on matters impacting growth, profitability, and long-term business performance.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Lead pricing strategy for assigned Personal and Commercial Lines products and markets, ensuring alignment with profitability, growth, retention, and competitive objectives.
  • Establish rate level and rating plan recommendations using actuarial analysis, predictive modeling, business performance insights, and market intelligence.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and emerging trends to identify opportunities and recommend pricing actions that drive business results.
  • Provide actuarial leadership for financial planning, including rate activity, premium growth, loss trends, profitability targets, and other key business metrics.
  • Partner with Product, Underwriting, Finance, Claims, and Distribution leaders to influence strategic decisions and deliver actionable business insights.
  • Champion innovation through advanced analytics, predictive modeling, process improvement, and pricing automation.
  • Ensure the integrity of pricing data, models, tools, and governance processes while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and actuarial standards.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing actuarial organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and technical excellence.
  • Represent actuarial perspectives in business performance reviews and executive presentations, including exposure to senior leadership.

First Year Success Factors

Within the first 12 months, a successful candidate can expect to have achieved the following:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Bristol West's pricing processes, portfolio dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Build credibility with an already strong actuarial team and effectively leverage existing leadership talent.
  • Establish themselves as a trusted member of the Bristol West leadership team.
  • Strengthen collaboration across Product, Claims, Finance, and Reserving functions.
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen and executive presence by connecting actuarial insights to business outcomes.
  • Drive informed pricing decisions that balance profitability, growth, retention, and market competitiveness.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

Candidates would ideally reflect the following professional qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) designation required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of actuarial experience, including progressive responsibility in pricing, product management, or portfolio management.
  • Deep expertise in Personal Lines pricing, preferably within Personal Auto and broader Property & Casualty insurance.
  • Proven experience developing rate indications, pricing strategies, and profitability improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of loss trends, claims performance, reserving impacts, and rate adequacy analysis.
  • Experience leading actuarial teams and developing talent through coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
  • Ability to communicate complex actuarial concepts and analytical findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven track record influencing business strategy and driving decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Claims, Finance, Underwriting, and senior business leaders.
  • Strong knowledge of state rate filings, regulatory requirements, and actuarial standards of practice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Non-standard Personal Auto pricing experience.
  • Experience working within a large, multi-state insurance carrier.
  • Previous leadership responsibility for actuarial managers or other people leaders.
  • Experience presenting pricing recommendations and business performance results to executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling, pricing optimization, and advanced analytical techniques.
  • Experience balancing growth, retention, and profitability objectives within competitive insurance markets.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in SAS and SAS Macros.
  • Strong Excel modeling and analytical capabilities.
  • Experience utilizing Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Ability to leverage large datasets, predictive analytics, and visualization tools to support pricing decisions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

A Day in the Life of a Field Adjuster

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.
  • Earn additional hourly pay and overtime during deployment assignments.

If you have the following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

Previous property damage claims experience preferred but we are willing to train the right candidate!

Job Summary

  • This is for a person with expertise in product execution.  This role supports the rate setting process which is the most important driver of our business results.
  • The role leads large scale processes and drives process improvement.
  • You will be leading a team working on specific markets or countrywide efforts that is responsible for supporting profitable growth of the business; assignments are generally larger and more complex than Product Managers.
  • This position requires strong organizational and time management skills, working in a cross-collaborative environment and solving structured and unstructured business problems.
  • Performs work independently with limited guidance. May manage a team of Product Managers and Analysts.

Essential Job Functions

  • Demonstrates an expertise in the principles of product management, filing process, quoting platforms and systems, knowledge management, underwriting guidelines and defining data requirements in support of the profit and growth of the business.
  • Demonstrates understanding of how the rate order of calculation works.
  • Able to guide their team's ability to navigate the organization's processes (filing, IT programming/delivery/testing, compliance, underwriting, regulatory) to influence the timeline and sequencing of both rate and non-rate initiatives that drive and influence business results. Demonstrates ability to proactively guide team's management of complex rate and non-rate initiatives. 
  • Proactively works with key business partners to drive complex process improvements across the organization. Provides guidance to Product Managers and analysts on ways to optimize product changes, project implementation, and underwriting guideline updates. 
  • Provides guidance for scheduling and deployment of rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate projects, ensuring alignment across impacted states and teams. Owns scheduling and deployment of complex rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate initiatives, ensuring alignment across impacted states.
  • Provides direction and guidance for all stages of the rate execution, filing process, compliance and regulatory, rate and non-rate initiatives, and timeline and sequencing.
  • Regulatory expert for assigned market or product.
  • Influences key business partners and leadership on complex rate and non-rate timeline and sequencing.
  • Demonstrates expertise of competitor product structure, underwriting rules, systems and quoting platforms. Provides direction and guidance on competitor research into compliance and regulatory changes.
  • Develops training and onboarding plan and responsible for consistent development of team members related to key processes and progression. Responsible for leading the hiring and onboarding process of new team members.
  • Escalation owner for complex or high-impact product issues.
  • Review team recommendations and facilitate presentations with leaders and business partners regarding proposed product or underwriting rule changes.
  • Business owner of complex interactions and negotiation for proposed product or underwriting rule changes with departments of insurance and other regulatory entities.
  • Able to drive and coach team prioritization.
  • Able to leverage extensive network with key internal business partners.
  • Responsible for escalation resolution and leadership communication of complex structured and unstructured problems impacting the Product team. 

Physical Actions

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Bachelor's degree with focus in Business, or Research such as Economics, Business Administration, Marketing, Risk Management preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 13 years US property & casualty experience in product or underwriting preferred; or related experience preferred.
  • People leadership experience preferred.

Additional Qualification

  • Demonstrated analytical and research skills.
  • Possesses strong organizational skills with technical aptitude. 
  • Experience in Excel required. Effective interpersonal skills: has the ability to work in teams, embraces collaboration and networking.
  • Embraces continuous learning. Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Process improvement, lean thinking. Demonstrated mentorship and coaching skills.
  • Experience with AI and Automation Tools preferred

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

The starting wage for this position is $27.67hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills. 

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day, 
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Job Summary

This position manages a direct sales team to sell multi- line insurance products to prospective customers, primarily through inbound calls. The role leads day-to-day operations and holds team members accountable to the organizations objectives, initatives, and processes.

Essential Job Functions

  • Monitors teams daily, weekly, and monthly performance, including sales performance, customer experience, quality, efficiency, and compliance with established company and regulatory guidelines through active call listening, side-by-sides, and one-on-one coaching.
  • Recommends courses of action to address performance deficiencies.
  • Works with manager to create and implements sales and operational plans to constantly improve team performance and develop individual team members skillsets.
  • Accountable for ensuring team members meet individual and team performance goals.
  • Implements performance management, including corrective action, when applicable.
  • Informs leadership of team performance.
  • Manages daily operations of team, including all aspects of timecards (including work schedules, lunches, and breaks) and confirms appropriate system access.
  • Communicates company strategies related to products and philosophies to team members an ensures teams understanding.
  • Works with manager to investigates and resolves escalated customer issues in a timely manner.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Actions

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location.
  • The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation.
  • Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions.
  • Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift.
  • Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces.
  • Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance.
  • Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties.
  • Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift.
  • Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees.
  • Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information.
  • Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects.
  • Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace.
  • Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Property & Casualty insurance license required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum five years of sales and call center experience required, preferably in direct sales.
  • People leadership experience preferred.

Additional Qualification

  • Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents.
  • Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty.
  • Ability to inspire and develop staff.
  • Ability to coach others in selling techniques.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude.

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office.
