Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This position supports the growth of life insurance sales by leveraging data to make recommendations to agents that drive premium and profit objectives for an assigned territory. The role takes ownership of sales outcomes through proactive engagement and solution-driven approaches. The position develops and implements business plans to enhance agency productivity and profitability, deepen relationships, and promote life insurance products and the companys value proposition. The position collaborates with internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders to address complex or high-value challenges, implement life insurance sales initiatives, and achieve sales objectives. This position is an individual contributor and performs work independently while receiving minimal guidance and direction.

Essential Job Functions

Drives life insurance sales by consulting with agency owners to meet sales objectives across multiple product lines and on high-value and complex cases. Takes ownership of sales outcomes by managing both assisted and unassisted sales activities. Focuses on point-of-sale interactions to drive successful transactions and meet sales targets. Promotes life insurance products and company value proposition. Achieves activity targets and production goals by proactively engaging with district managers and agency owners to identify needs or opportunities and deliver tailored solutions, and continuously monitor outcomes. Follows up on implemented strategies to assess effectiveness and pivots as needed when results do not meet expectations. Develops and implements customized sales plans for assigned agency to drive sales growth and meet sales objectives, including quarterly and annual sales targets. Aligns agency-specific sales plans with broader business objectives and leverages adjacent revenue stream opportunities to drive life sales. Demonstrates strong knowledge of life insurance products and services to effectively compete in the marketplace. Independently provides recommendations on product illustrations, case designs, and sales focus. Acts as a liaison between internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders on complex underwriting, commissions, customer service, licensing, and other issues. Builds and maintains relationships with elite agents through targeted consultation, training, and education on products, services, marketing campaigns, technology, and advanced sales strategies. Supports agency growth by assisting with producer recruitment and development, optimizing performance and profitability, and delivering guidance virtually or in-person. Monitors agency performance through CRM systems and other tools. Tracks sales activities, analyzes data and identifies trends or patterns, and provides actionable insights to help agencies address performance gaps and improve sales results. Measures changes in agency performance resulting from the deployment of various tailored solutions. Mentors, trains, and coaches less experienced team members or lower level life sales consultants to develop their skills and improve performance. Provides ongoing support and feedback to support professional development and enhance team capabilities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Valid life insurance and FINRA 6, 63 licenses required. Other preferred designations include Financial Services Certified Professional (FSCP), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC).

Experience Requirements

Minimum seven years of experience in sales, account management, or agency operations, preferably within the insurance industry. Experience required in direct point of sale, life insurance wholesale, and sales leadership.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents. Demonstrated analytical skills. Possesses strong product knowledge. In-depth knowledge of life insurance products and services and in-depth understanding of company product offerings. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite. Strong proficiency in CRM and similar systems. Able to adapt quickly to new technology. Develops and delivers effective presentations. Possesses a high degree of initiative. Instills commitment to organizational goals. Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Workplace:Remote ( #LI-Remote ) - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policyholder homes. 

Candidates must reside in the greater Wayne County, MI area to be considered for this role. 

The starting wage for this position is $29.61/hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills.  

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… Then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day, 
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Job Summary

Farmers Insurance is seeking a Technology Auditor to support high‑quality technology audits as part of our transformation to a modern, risk‑focused Internal Audit function. This role is hands‑on and execution‑focused, with primary responsibility for technology control testing, evidence evaluation, and audit documentation across IT and cyber risk areas.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discussions with technology and business stakeholders to understand the objectives, processes, systems, data flows, key risks, and control environment associated with the area under review, and challenge assumptions where necessary.
  • Independently identify and assess technology risks, evaluate key controls, and help shape audit scope, testing strategies, and evidence requirements using a risk-based approach.
  • Execute technology audits across cybersecurity, identity and access management, applications, cloud, infrastructure, data, and emerging technology domains.
  • Perform stakeholder discussions, evaluate process and control design, and identify gaps, inconsistencies, or emerging risks by asking effective "why" and "how" questions.
  • Gather, evaluate, and challenge the completeness, reliability, and relevance of evidence obtained through interviews, system reports, configurations, logs, tickets, analytics, and other audit procedures.
  • Apply professional judgment and skepticism throughout the audit by assessing whether evidence supports management's assertions and investigating anomalies, exceptions, and conflicting information.
  • Own assigned audit areas from planning through reporting, proactively managing activities, stakeholder requests, dependencies, and timelines while escalating risks and blockers promptly.
  • Work in iterative audit cycles, continuously reassessing risks, adjusting testing approaches, and incorporating feedback as new information emerges.
  • Prepare high-quality workpapers that clearly document procedures performed, evidence reviewed, judgments applied, and conclusions reached in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and quality standards.
  • Identify, evaluate, and develop audit issues by determining root causes, assessing business and technology impacts, validating facts with stakeholders, and recommending practical corrective actions.
  • Clearly communicate risks, observations, and audit conclusions to stakeholders at various levels, translating technical issues into business-relevant risk implications.
  • Participate actively in audit team reviews, challenge sessions, showcases, and quality discussions, providing constructive challenge to strengthen audit outcomes.
  • Leverage approved analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve audit effectiveness, insight generation, and efficiency while maintaining accountability for audit conclusions.
  • Assess the design and effectiveness of remediation activities and validate that corrective actions appropriately address underlying risks and root causes.
  • Continuously expand expertise in technology, cybersecurity, emerging technologies, audit methodology, risk management, and industry practices through ongoing learning and professional development.

Essential Job Functions

  • Leads audit engagements with minimal supervision - on time and in a quality manner.
  • Preparation of reports and communication with the business.
  • Administrative duties supporting departmental activities, individual development plan, training, performance management, and general administration.
  • Participates in departmental special projects.

Physical Actions

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (example others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to continuously operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), CISA, or other comparable designation preferred.

Experience Requirements

Five or more years experience in Auditing at an external firm or financial services firm, or seven years experience with Farmers Insurance and/or one year as a Farmers Insurance Auditor. Detailed subject matter expertise of at least one area of the business or industry.

Special Skill Requirement

Strong analytical skills. Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong project management skills. Ability to effectively communicate with individuals in the business.

Job.JobDescription:
New Year - New Career! | Virtual Role in PST or MST | Uncapped Earnings + Career Growth

Are you a persuasive communicator who thrives in a fast-paced performance driven environment? Join our February 2027 class of Direct Sales Representatives and help customers protect what matters most. At Farmers, your ambition fuels your income and your future. In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer’s needs. You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential.

Uncapped Commissions

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success. 

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $38,025 - $67,500 based on your experience
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300 on top of the guaranteed base pay annually. 
  • Many of our top performers who consistently meet and exceed their goals earn up to an additional $75,000 on top of their annual base pay. 
  • 5% bilingual incentive.

If you're driven, competitive and ready to grow, this is the place to do it! 

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a sales environment 
  • Property and Casualty License (or the ability to obtain one)
  • Proven ability to meet quotas, metrics and goals 
  • A drive to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment
  • Desire for a long-term career within the insurance industry
  • Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems, and prioritize tasks
  • Direct sales skills, and the aptitude to influence customers and close the sale 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to adapt communication style to each phone call, and explain complex policy and coverage information in understandable terms 
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states

Here's what you'll accomplish as a member of our team...

  • Sell insurance products to inbound callers by gathering data from customers to generate quotes and ultimately bind the business; in some instances, make outbound calls
  • Provide exceptional customer service and build strong relationships, while educating customers regarding coverages and cost so that the customer can select the most appropriate option
  • Qualify customers as buyers of other products/services to create cross-sell and upselling opportunities
  • Navigate multiple computer systems while seamlessly interacting with the customer

You'll thrive here IF...

  • Self-motivated & goal-oriented – You set ambitious goals and chase them relentlessly.
  • Customer-focused – You build trust and tailor solutions with empathy.
  • Tech-savvy & adaptable – You navigate systems with ease and embrace change.
  • Coachable & curious – You welcome feedback and seek growth.
  • Accountable & reliable – You own your outcomes and show up ready.

  • Drives a culture of ownership, accountability, recognition, and continuous improvement through regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and development planning.

Experience Requirements

We are seeking an experienced trial attorney to join our Washington staff counsel team! Our attorneys work from home and handle in-person appearances and trials as required so we are open to candidates throughout Washington. We offer developmental opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package including annual bonus potential up to 20% of the salary, generous 401k, auto allowance, PTO, medical/dental/vision, paid parental leave, and much more all without the stress of billable hours!   

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily moderate to high complexity and exposure and/or involve unique insurance defense issues. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates moderate to high complexity and exposure cases and/or cases involving unique legal or procedural issues and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement. This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Acts as the lead attorney at hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Develops strategies and arguments to thoroughly prepare for trial. Utilizes knowledge of legal precedents to analyze the probable outcomes of a case.
  • Identifies the strengths and weaknesses of approaches to a case. Performs or ensures completion of any other tasks or duties necessary for the proper representation of clients.
  • Consults with Claims Executive team and renders legal strategy recommendations regarding the legal aspects of the handling of personal injury claims.
  • Provides guidance to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Interprets applicable industry laws, rulings and regulations.
  • Functionally supervises attorneys who are assisting in the handling of cases as development opportunities.
  • Provides guidance and mentorship with the autonomy to learn.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrollable outside environmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Seven years of litigation experience required. Insurance defense, personal injury, and/or jury trial experience required. First and second chair trial experience in bodily injury litigation strongly preferred. Multistate jurisdictional practice preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function and handle high case loads in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Effective leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to command the attention of an audience. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Possesses a genuine interest in the defense of Insurance regulations. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Handles conflict effectively with the ability to quickly interpret and respond to new information. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Excellent time management and priority setting skills. Articulate and responsive to colleagues. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.

  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

Our Internal Audit team is adding multiple Senior Business Auditors! We are open to more senior candidates as well. 

Job Summary

Are you an inquisitive individual with a passion for uncovering insights and driving improvements to positively impact an organization? Farmers Insurance is for Senior Business Internal Auditors to strengthen our assurance practices through the performance of quality audit work as part of our transformation to become a leading practice audit function. What You'll Do:

  • Lead: Lead audit engagements in accordance with Farmers Internal Audit Standards with minimal oversight.
  • Deliver: High quality audits that help Farmers deliver on its value proposition to its customers.
  • Contribute: Participate in the development of the Internal Audit Strategy and Plan, as well as the Audit Universe, by demonstrating a thorough understanding of the risks facing the company or business unit. Analyze controls and information gathered through audits, meetings, and other sources, and escalate relevant findings to Audit Management.
  • Collaborate: Establish strong working relationships with, and knowledge of, the business while partnering with IT Internal Audit in the performance of integrated audits
  • Communicate: Prepare executive ready reports and other written correspondence that effectively and efficiently communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Transform: Bring, and drive, transformational ideas that drive the Internal Audit function forward.
  • Facilitate Knowledge Sharing: Mentor peers and colleagues to support their professional development and enhance the overall capability of the team.
  • Cultivate Professional Development: Grow as a professional through various stretch and growth opportunities that will develop and hone skillsets needed for advancement.

Join our team to lead impactful audit engagements and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal audit processes.

Essential Job Functions

Leads audit engagements with minimal supervision - on time and in a quality manner. Preparation of reports and communication with the business. Administrative duties supporting departmental activities, individual development plan, training, performance management, and general administration. Participates in departmental special projects.

Physical Actions

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (example others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to continuously operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or other comparable designation preferred.

Experience Requirements

Five or more years experience in Auditing at an external firm or financial services firm, or seven years experience with Farmers Insurance and/or one year as a Farmers Insurance Auditor. Detailed subject matter expertise of at least one area of the business or industry.

The preferred candidate will possess:

  • Prior experience in insurance or financial services.
  • Demonstrated ability in advanced audit techniques including data analysis, data visualization, data mining, process mining, provide audit insights and critically think through complex problems.
  • Proficient in data analytics tools such as PowerBI, Excel, and SQL.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence methods within the audit process.
  • Skilled in tracing transactions to the general ledger.
  • Experience leading complex audit engagements.
  • Strong understanding of auditing principles, methodologies, and techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage and maintain professional relationships.

Special Skill Requirement

Strong analytical skills. Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong project management skills. Ability to effectively communicate with individuals in the business.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex to highly complex business initiatives. The role acts as a subject matter expert to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving guidance or direction for only the most complex scenarios. Mentors, trains, and coaches team members at all levels.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Partners with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex to highly complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Leads discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging comprehensive business knowledge and depth of expertise in solution engineering.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Anticipates and removes constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to lead technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.

Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Leads development and delivery of complex to highly complex solutions by ensuring technical implementation s align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and leads technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Oversees the maintenance of technical documentation for solutions to ensure effective knowledge sharing. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the achievement of team and project objectives. Acts as a subject matter expert to consult and advise on solution engineering across business units and the enterprise. Leads pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvements across solutions. Performs other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as a trusted AI partner and primary AI contact for both IT and Business organizations.
  • Translate business opportunities into a sequenced portfolio of AI initiatives, clearly defining target outcomes, required capabilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Partner across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, and governance teams to identify and remove barriers to execution, accelerate delivery from concept through production, and ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and reusable across the enterprise.
  • Drive adoption of the enterprise Spec-Driven Development (SDD) framework and AI-assisted engineering practices, achieving 90% adoption across targeted teams.
  • Drive measurable business and technology outcomes through faster delivery cycles, improved software quality, increased automation adoption, and successful deployment of AI capabilities that deliver enterprise value.
  • Lead multiple AI initiatives from concept through production readiness, partnering with engineering ensuring successful delivery while proactively removing obstacles and managing risks.
  • Establish reusable AI delivery assets, including implementation playbooks, patterns, templates, evaluation frameworks, governance controls, CI/CD standards, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Build a portfolio of AI success stories and reusable solutions that accelerate adoption across the enterprise.
  • Champion AI adoption across IT through hackathons, innovation challenges, monthly technology summits, workshops, and enablement programs.
  • Coach and enable engineers, architects, product owners, and technical teams on AI technologies, SDD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and AI-driven transformation across the IT organization.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 9 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams required.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Lead Solution Engineer is in support of AI COE / Forward Deployed Engineer in the AI and Automation Team.  
  • This role is targeting the IT / Systems AI FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) in support of Farmers IT Core SDLC Functions.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues of varying complexity.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Deep knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Farmers Group (Woodland Hills, CA) seeks a Solution Engineer to design, develop, and deliver scalable, enterprise-level technology solutions aligned with business objectives. Specific duties include: collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical designs; design end-to-end system architectures ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, scalability, performance, and security; lead solution design discussions across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and coordinate implementation across multiple teams; define and manage non-functional requirements including performance, reliability, and availability; identify dependencies, constraints, and risks across applications and platforms; design and implement CI/CD pipelines; guide teams in coding standards, architecture patterns, and design principles; evaluate and integrate Google Cloud Platform services including Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, and Cloud Storage; design and implement AI/ML solutions using Vertex AI, CCAI, Conversational AI, and Document AI; conduct technical feasibility analysis and proof-of-concepts; monitor solution delivery, perform root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions; participate in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, system demos, and retrospectives; collaborate with QA teams to validate test strategies; maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams and design specifications; mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing; research emerging technologies to enhance system capabilities. Position requires Specialization Certification covering GCP Machine Learning and Data Engineering. Position requires 10% travel within the U.S. Option to work remotely from anywhere in the U.S.

Position requires a Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a closely related field of study, plus 7 years of experience in the job offered, or as a Machine Learning AI Engineer, Computer Systems Analyst, Solution Lead, or similar experience in the IT software development position. Must have 7 years of experience with each of the following: working in software development, systems engineering, or solution engineering; designing and developing enterprise applications and distributed systems using Google Cloud Platform (GCP); implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in the cloud platforms; programming in object-oriented and scripting languages using Python; working with data modeling, data processing, and database technologies; working with AI/ML frameworks, model development, and applied analytics; working with system integration, APIs, and microservices architecture; performing technical design, system analysis, and solution architecture; and working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or SAFe. Must also have 1 year of experience mentoring junior developers. Must have Specialization Certification covering GCP Machine Learning and Data Engineering. Must be willing to travel 10% of the time within the U.S. Option to work remotely from anywhere in the U.S.

Full time position. Apply by submitting your resumes at Farmers.com/Careers, Job ID: 36266.

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

Job Summary

Serves as the analytics lead and thought partner for Enterprise Marketing. Leads a team of analysts with a curiosity and a passion for testing and learning. Provides vision and leadership to deliver actionable insights and enables data-driven decisions through data analytics and data science.

Essential Job Functions

  • Oversees the prioritization, design, and execution of marketing analytics and testing.
  • Lead and coordinate the full funnel learning agenda in collaboration with analytics counterpart.
  • Uses data and analytics to recommend ways to optimize campaign effectiveness and maximize profitable growth through actionable data-driven insights.
  • Facilitates discussions with stakeholders to ensure alignment of business requirements and prioritization.
  • Provides analytic thought partnership, data mine, and surface actionable insights to optimize Marketing activities.
  • Continually develops the Marketing Analytics team into strategic and valued thought partners of marketing, who are passionate about analyzing and optimizing marketing performance.
  • Fosters a sense of insatiable curiosity.
  • Coaches, mentors, and inspires the team to develop their skills to reach their full potential.
  • Applies advanced analytics and data science to marketing including develop and optimize methodologies to measure effectiveness of campaigns across multiple channels; optimize reach & frequency; employ multitouch attribution; media mix modeling; predictive modeling, and propensity-to-buy modeling.
  • Promotes a culture of continuous test-and-learn within marketing.
  • Facilitates the design, measurement, and reporting of all tests, leveraging A/B and multivariate methodologies, and focusing on incremental impact delivered by marketing activities.
  • Ensures results, learnings, and next steps are shared objectively and broadly.
  • Performs cost benefit analysis to help inform decisions.
  • Coordinates with the Data & Reporting and IT teams on any data integrity issues, and when selecting analytic tools and software.
  • Stays well-informed of industry trends and educates the team on topics such as MarTech, data governance and new techniques in data strategy and data science.
  • Communicates meaningful insights through compelling storytelling, data visualization, tailored and contextualized to the target audience.
  • Delivers presentations to senior leaders in a concise manner that supports decision making.
  • Establishes relationships and collaborates with partners around the enterprise such as Distribution, Product, and IT.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelors degree in related field required.

Experience Requirements

  • 10+ years of related experience required.
  • 3+ years leadership experience required.
  • P&C insurance experience preferred.

Additional Qualification

  • Possesses strong technical aptitude.
  • Ability to use advanced statistical/Machine Learning concepts including Regression, GLMs, Decision Trees, Ensemble Modeling, Clustering, SVM. Familiarity with at least one statistical/modeling package such as Python, R and/or SAS). Familiar with data management programming SQL.
  • Excellent organizational skills. Develops and delivers effective presentations.
  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
  • Strong written communication skills. 
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills.
  • Possesses a high degree of initiative.
  • Intellectually curious, impact-driven, persistent, and is confident with sharing opinions and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills.
  • The ability to present data analytics interpretation to key stakeholders and senior leadership in a non-technical way.

Job Summary

  • This position manages an assigned territory of core Foremost Independent Agencies, including responsibilities to prospect and appoint new agencies with guidance, drive profitable premium growth, and achieve financial and operational goals. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company. The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services, including a portfolio of moderately complex accounts, within an assigned territory. This role is at the forefront of building premium growth through relationships with agents to ensure market share is built successfully. This position is an individual contributor who receives moderate guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts. The position is remote with required weekly field travel.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned territory driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets. With moderate guidance from management and field distribution partners, assists in leading, developing, and executing territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary. With coaching, builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships in person with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework. Establishes position as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training, to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue. With moderate guidance, creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals. Coordinates plans with field distribution partners, including strategic and tactical components, to align with business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support. With coaching, drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both ind ividual agency books and overall assigned territory. Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across territory. Strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production/profitability data and analysis. Performs other duties as ass igned.

Physical Actions

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. CIC, CPCU, or insurance licenses preferred upon hire.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum three years of insurance sales and management work experience.
  • Experience achieving profitable premium growth and sales success.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Define KPIs, benchmarks, and key performance drivers.
  • Build dashboards that translate data into actionable insights.
  • Analyze the digital conversion funnel and identify friction and fallout.
  • Recommend changes to improve conversion and customer experience.
  • Monitor bounce rate, conversion, ROI, ROAS, and other digital metrics.
  • Leverage A/B testing to measure impact and guide optimization.
  • Turn digital analytics into prescriptive business recommendations.
  • Leads a team of business and data analysts.

  • Executes key change initiatives or process improvements on the Analytics team.

  • Develops employees on presentations to project sponsors or business leads.
  • Effectively delivers presentations to executive audiences.
  • Is accountable to business leaders for hours worked by the team.
  • Ensures quality products are delivered to internal customers through analysis techniques and quantitative skills.
  • This is accomplished through data extraction using SQL, business query interfaces, and analysis cubes as well as using descriptive statistics and their application to business problems.

First Year Success Factors

Job Summary

Ready to change how a Life Insurance business uses data to grow? As Director, Business Intelligence & Analytics, you will lead a team of two analysts and serve as the go-to data and analytics partner across our Life Insurance organization. You will transform how the business accesses and uses data, turning insights from distribution and sales, new business, and customer and agent experience into decisions that drive profitable growth.  

Your team will own a portfolio of field-facing and operational reports and dashboards, build statistical models, and provide the analytical horsepower behind high-visibility, cross-functional initiatives. You will influence data and analytics strategy, review and approve analytics initiatives, oversee the support and evolution of existing data products, and bring innovative ideas to business leadership, then lead them through to implementation. This is a highly visible role for a builder who wants to see their work move the needle. 

Essential Job Functions

In this role, you will lead the analytics engine behind our Life Insurance business. You will develop advanced, value-driven analytics solutions, from statistical models that sharpen our understanding of the application funnel, policy placement, and persistency to Power BI dashboards that give agents, field leaders, and operations teams the insights they need to act. You will own and continuously evolve a portfolio of field-facing and operational reports and dashboards so they keep pace with changing business needs.   
 
As a trusted partner to leaders across distribution and sales, customer and agent experience, and operations, you will identify the biggest opportunities to unlock business value, translate them into clear analytics requirements and business plans, and drive them to resolution.  You will apply a deep understanding of the data elements, structures, and standards common in financial services and Life Insurance, including cloud-based data storage and sharing, to balance regulatory and compliance requirements with business needs. You will consult on UAT, technical specifications, strategic planning, contract design, testing, and training, and independently lead highly complex projects with little to no guidance.   
 
As a people leader, you will supervise, coach, and manage the performance of two analysts, deliver regular feedback, and support their professional development, fostering a high-performance culture where excellence is standard and innovation is actively encouraged. You will craft strategic plans and turn them into action for your team and for partners across three or more business domains, communicating strategy in a way that resonates with audiences new to data and analytics and helping enable enterprise priorities. 

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree or equivalent required, preferably in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Actuarial Science, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.  Master's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or an MBA with a quantitative focus preferred. Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate or insurance industry designations (e.g., LOMA FLMI), are a plus.

Experience Requirements

7-10 years of related work experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data science required, including: 
  • Building and maintaining enterprise reporting and dashboards in Power BI (or a comparable BI tool) for business and front-line audiences, including data modeling and DAX 
  • Applying statistical and predictive modeling techniques (e.g., regression, segmentation, propensity or retention modeling) to solve business problems and influence decisions 
  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and experience working with data warehouses, data marts, and cloud-based data platforms across multiple source systems 
  • Partnering with senior business leaders to translate ambiguous questions into analytics requirements, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes 
  • Leading complex, cross-functional analytics initiatives with IT, data science, product, and vendor partners from concept through implementation 
  • Establishing data quality, governance, and reporting standards, and resolving data issues across systems 
  • Communicating insights and recommendations clearly to executive and non-technical audiences 
 
Preferred experience: 
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience, ideally in Life Insurance, with familiarity with new business, underwriting, policy administration, and distribution data 
  • Experience analyzing sales and distribution performance, application funnel and throughput, placement, persistency, or agent and customer experience metrics 
  • Experience in a people leader or management role, including coaching and developing analysts 
  • Experience supporting field-facing or agent-facing reporting in a distribution-driven organization 
  • Working knowledge of Python or R and of data privacy and regulatory considerations in insurance

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

Job.JobTitle: UNLICENSED Direct Sales Rep - Base Pay + Uncapped Incentive (Hybrid - Phoenix, AZ)
Job.JobDescription:
New Year - New Career! | Hybrid Role in Phoenix, AZ | Uncapped Earnings + Career Growth

Are you a persuasive communicator who thrives in a fast-paced performance driven environment? Join our January 2027 class of Direct Sales Representatives and help customers protect what matters most. At Farmers, your ambition fuels your income and your future. In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer’s needs. You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential.

Uncapped Commissions

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success. 

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $38,025 - $67,500 based on your experience
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300 on top of the guaranteed base pay annually. 
  • Many of our top performers who consistently meet and exceed their goals earn up to an additional $75,000 on top of their annual base pay. 
  • 5% bilingual incentive.

If you're driven, competitive and ready to grow, this is the place to do it! 

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a sales environment 
  • Property and Casualty License (or the ability to obtain one)
  • Proven ability to meet quotas, metrics and goals 
  • A drive to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment
  • Desire for a long-term career within the insurance industry
  • Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems, and prioritize tasks
  • Direct sales skills, and the aptitude to influence customers and close the sale 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to adapt communication style to each phone call, and explain complex policy and coverage information in understandable terms 
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states

Here's what you'll accomplish as a member of our team:

  • Sell insurance products to inbound callers by gathering data from customers to generate quotes and ultimately bind the business; in some instances, make outbound calls
  • Provide exceptional customer service and build strong relationships, while educating customers regarding coverages and cost so that the customer can select the most appropriate option
  • Qualify customers as buyers of other products/services to create cross-sell and upselling opportunities
  • Navigate multiple computer systems while seamlessly interacting with the customer

You'll thrive here if...

  • Self-motivated & goal-oriented – You set ambitious goals and chase them relentlessly.
  • Customer-focused – You build trust and tailor solutions with empathy.
  • Tech-savvy & adaptable – You navigate systems with ease and embrace change.
  • Coachable & curious – You welcome feedback and seek growth.

Location & Schedule

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Our California Workers' Compensation team is looking to add an attorney! This is a virtual position and we are open to candidates located anywhere in California who can make occasional in-person WCAB appearances as required. We offer developmental opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package including annual bonus potential up to 15% of the salary, generous 401k, auto allowance, PTO, medical/dental/vision, paid parental leave, and much more all without the stress of billable hours!

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of workers' compensation defense practice, handling cases that are primarily low in complexity and exposure. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates low complexity and exposure cases and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement.
  • This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Attends hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Proactively informs leadership of case handling opportunities and challenges encountered.
  • Consults with the Claims Department on the legal aspects of files.
  • Performs other tasks or duties to ensure efficient case management.
  • May handle second chair trials and handle trials in cases with minimal complexity and/or exposure.
  • May provide support to senior attorneys in cases of greater complexity and/or exposure and may receive developmental assignments of matters that are of moderate complexity and/or exposure.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrolled outside en vironmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Civil litigation and/or personal/bodily injury experience preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Excellent written communication skills. Effective negotiation skills. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

The Role at a Glance

The Lead Application Security Engineer is responsible for working with application development and infrastructure teams to ensure applications are designed, coded, and implemented securely. You will be responsible for Integrating security best practices and controls into all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 

You will drive the improvement of policies, standards, and other supporting documentation. This is a hands-on technical position that you will find yourself collaborating with multiple groups across the organization. Strong communication skills are needed to explain complex security to a wide variety of technical levels. Experience as a developer is helpful, but not required. 

What you'll be doing

  • Responsibility for the security of Lincoln Financial applications and services 
  • Conduct design review, code review, and dynamic analysis 
  • Evaluate the security posture of AI/ML systems, including LLM-integrated applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows 
  • Identify, communicate, and drive the resolution of vulnerabilities 
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for application development and infrastructure teams 
  • Communicate effectively with a wide variety of technical levels 
  • Perform security assessments of web and mobile applications 
  • Research and advocate for new security solutions and technologies 
  • Stay current on security trends, vulnerabilities, and testing methods 
  • Contribute to related policies, standards, and supporting documentation 

What we’re looking for

Must Haves:

  • Undergraduate degree or 4+ years of comparable work experience 
  • 5-7+ years of experience in Information Technology that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position
  • Extensive experience in web application security 
  • Strong knowledge of application security throughout the SDLC 
  • Experience with agile delivery practices 
  • Experience integrating security into DevOps practices. 
  • Experience conducting source code review preferred 
  • Experience using static application security testing tools such as Fortify, Checkmarx, Veracode, etc. 
  • Experience dynamic analysis with tools such as AppScan, Webinspect, BurpSuite, and OWASP ZAP, etc. 
  • Familiarity with related network infrastructure, such as firewalls, WAFs, and IPS 
  • Familiarity with common DMZ architectures 
  • Prior financial services experience preferred 
  • Agile Mindset; awareness/understanding of Agile methodologies  

Nice to Haves

  • OSCP, OSWE, ISC2 CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC GWAPT, GIAC GSSP-Java, GIAC GSSP-NET Preferred 

Application Deadline

Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, and the posting may be taken down early due to applicant volume.

The Role at a Glance

As a Lead Group Underwriter on the Specialty Health team, you will underwrite new and existing business for Lincoln's Supplemental Health (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity) products. You'll assess risk, develop pricing recommendations, and support profitable growth and customer retention through sound underwriting decisions.

This role offers the opportunity to work independently on more complex underwriting assignments while partnering with Sales, Account Management, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to drive business results. You'll build strong relationships, influence underwriting outcomes, contribute to process improvements, and continue to grow your technical and industry expertise.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite new business, renewals, and amendments for Supplemental Health products
  • Manage an assigned in-force book of business
  • Assess risk by evaluating group characteristics, demographics, participation, benefit design, claims experience, and other underwriting factors
  • Perform experience rating and collaborate with actuarial partners to evaluate pricing and risk
  • Apply underwriting guidelines, authority limits, and pricing methodologies to determine appropriate coverage terms and rates
  • Make underwriting decisions within assigned authority and recommend actions requiring additional review or approval
  • Prepare and communicate underwriting analyses, pricing recommendations, and renewal strategies to business partners
  • Support the RFP process, including responding to underwriting requirements and completing submissions through third-party platforms
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Pricing, Operations, and underwriting partners across product lines to develop coordinated customer solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners, support the development of underwriting expertise across the team, and serve as a trusted resource on underwriting strategies and risk assessment
  • Identify opportunities to improve underwriting processes, tools, and reporting capabilities

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of degree)
  • 5+ years of Supplemental Health underwriting experience
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

 

Nice-to-haves:

  • Expertise in experience rating and renewal underwriting

This position is perfect for someone inclined to leverage their IT Audit and technology expertise in an internal audit environment, while focusing on an in-depth review of IT systems, cybersecurity, and data integrity controls. As a Sr. IT Auditor, you will independently manage IT audits, perform advisory reviews, and support integrated audits in collaboration with the broader Internal Audit team. If you are passionate about driving improvements and ensuring robust IT governance, we want to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

  • Plan audit engagements, identify inherent risks and control objectives, perform risk assessments and identify IT-related risks and vulnerabilities based on business objectives, regulatory requirements, and emerging threats.
  • Conduct end-to-end audit engagements, perform detailed testing, facilitate meetings, and document and review the results of testing according to internal audit methodology.
  • Perform advisory reviews by assessing project governance, risks, controls, and implementation activities.
  • Support integrated audits in collaboration with the broader Internal Audit team by evaluating IT risks and controls relevant to the audit objectives.
  • Demonstrate expertise in IT disciplines (but not limited to): cybersecurity, hardware, networking, firewalls, servers, database management systems, operating systems, disaster recovery, cloud technologies, identity and access management, incident management, vulnerability management, risk assessment, IT governance, and system development.
  • Provide IT subject matter expertise, audit knowledge, and professional judgment to assess a broad range of business processes, risks, and control objectives.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports outlining findings, risk criteria, and recommendations for management, lead audit closing meetings, and ensure all audit documentation is finalized and conforms with department policies and standards.
  • Monitor and report on issue remediation, retesting, and closure status.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and stay informed about emerging IT and industry trends, including developments in AI, and share those insights with team members.
  • Manage co-source partner(s) and ensure they are adhering to LF IA methodology, review deliverables, and hold them accountable for budget and scope.
  • Partner with IT infrastructure, security, risk management, and other control groups within the company to establish strong working relationships while maintaining independence.
  • Collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Internal Audit, the department, and the broader organization while expanding knowledge of the insurance industry, products, and operations.
  • Perform duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, as well as company policies and procedures.

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:

  • Expertise in IT disciplines (but not limited to): cybersecurity, hardware, networking, cloud environments, firewalls, servers, database management systems, operating systems, disaster recovery, identity and access management, incident management, vulnerability management, risk assessment, IT governance, and system development
  • 4+ years of experience in IT audit and/or information technology that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position
  • Certifications/Licensures: CISA, CISSP and/or CIA
  • Knowledge of internal controls, business / information technology risk, regulatory and compliance frameworks (ITIL, NIST, COBIT, NY DFS, CCPA/CPRA, SEC, PCI DSS etc.), project management, and audit techniques
  • Demonstrates problem solving skills, root-cause analysis, and critical-thinking skills to assess complex IT environments and identify control gaps
  • Demonstrates relationship management skills and organizational skills and can independently manage engagements and prioritize workload
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • 4 Year / Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or another related IT field

Nice-to-haves:

  • Interest in emerging technologies, including AI, and how they may impact business risk.
  • Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
  • Experience in the insurance or financial services industry
  • Other related certifications (PMP, GSNA, CRISC, CCSP, CISM, etc.)
