The Lead Cloud Architect will work on the Enterprise Architecture Team focused on advancing Lincoln’s overall IT cloud and AI capabilities.  Initially the focus will be on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with the goal of transforming the organization toward a multi-cloud model.  In addition to Cloud Technologies, primarily AWS, this role will work closely with our AI teams to develop and implement Enterprise AI Solutions.  The architect, reporting to the Head of Cloud Architecture, will work in a team setting of AI and Cloud technical resources with a goal of building a foundation (technology and process) for enabling the organization to execute using a cloud-first approach.  

What you'll be doing

  • Partners with application development teams to drive product development for Cloud solutions and participates in proof of concept (POC) and implementation projects. 
  • Delivers patterns for AI and Cloud technical architectures and communicates successful cloud architectures to the enterprise. 
  • Contributes to and helps Maintain a catalog of cloud products and services and determines when a given service should be utilized. 
  • Collaborates with other IT teams and internal stakeholders to deliver best in class cloud solutions. 
  •  Maintains knowledge on current and emerging developments/trends, assesses the impact, and collaborates with senior management to incorporate new trends and developments in current and future strategies. 
  • Provides subject matter expertise to team members and applicable internal/external stakeholders on complex assignments/projects. 
  • Provides strategic direction to build and enhance the capability. 

What we’re looking for

Must Haves:

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's)
  • 5-7+ Years of experience in IT architecture including experience with cloud technology that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position 
  • Experience with Amazon Webservices (AgentCore, S3, ECS, etc.) and an understanding of the technical capabilities and limitations when designing solutions in the AWS 
  • Knowledge across multiple technical domains including compute, database, storage, security, network, configuration management, and application development (source code->deploy) 
  • In-depth knowledge of the architecture design process, including conceptual, logical, and physical designs. 
  • Experience in architecting complex systems which address key functional and non-functional requirements (Ex. - high availability within and across availability zones (AZs), disaster recovery (cross region), RTO, RPO, etc.) 
  • Thorough understanding of cloud computing: virtualization technologies, Infrastructure as a Service, Platform as a Service and Software as a Service Cloud delivery models and the current competitive landscape 
  • Thorough understanding of AI Techonlogies including Copilot, Claude, OpenAI and other AI providers as they evolve. 
  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts, practices, tools and continuous delivery pipelines: Git, Jenkins, Artifactory, XL Release/Deploy, etc. 
  • Experience in leading complex architectural change programs in a large enterprise 
  • Strong influencing, facilitation and collaboration skills 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to tailor communication effectively for a given audience including senior executives

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with additional cloud platforms such as GCP and Azure is a plus   
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (preferred) 
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (is a plus)

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

The Role at a Glance

The Actuarial Development Program (ADP) at Lincoln Financial is an industry-leading program that demonstrates Lincoln Financial’ s commitment to creating highly qualified business leaders.  As an ADP participant, you’ll be able to explore your unique interests while developing the essential actuarial, technical, management, communication, and leadership skills you need to succeed. The Actuarial Development Program includes a series of rotations, typically every 18-24 months. For each rotation, roles are available in different business areas including Life and Annuities, Retirement and Group Protection. Experience gained will enable participants to become well-rounded actuaries with knowledge that may include Product Development, Pricing, Valuation, Modeling, Risk Management, Asset Liability Management, Investments, Data Analytics, and Internal Audit.
 
ADP participants are expected to pass the Society of Actuaries’ exams at a prescribed pace. The program is designed to support you as you work towards your FSA and provide the training and resources necessary to become a well-rounded actuarial leader.
 
Additional Program Highlights:
•Highly competitive compensation package with salary increases and bonuses upon successful exam completion
•Social and training opportunities to enhance skills, network with ADP participants and build long-lasting industry relationships 
•Dedicated leaders and mentors to assist with career development
Work with actuarial and data science software and technologies including MG-ALFA, Axis, Prophet, Dataiku, R, and Tableau
•Generous study time allowances for each exam session
•Payment and/or reimbursement of actuarial exam fees, materials, review courses, and seminars taken during the program 

The Associate Actuary, Pricing Analytics & Reporting role will support the highly visible pricing execution reporting across Lincoln’s Group Protection product suite – Life/AD&D, LTD, STD, Leave, Dental, and Supplemental Health. This role will be responsible for producing critical metrics & forecasts that drive business decisions across pricing, underwriting, and sales/distribution. You will be an end-to-end owner of the reporting process including data transformation, pricing strategy implementation, and data visualization. 

What you'll be doing

•Data Transformation: Maintain data pipeline (i.e. Dataiku) that produces the team’s renewal and new business execution reports, proactively identifying and implementing improvements to accuracy, functionality, and business impact. 
•Renewal Execution Reporting/Forecasting: Produce reporting on key renewal metrics such as persistency, rate action, and profitability. Track & forecast metric development throughout operational year and influence intra-year strategy decisions. 
•New Business Execution Reporting/Forecasting: Produce reporting on new business sales & profitability relative to targets. Integrate region, segment, or product-specific strategies into target benchmarks. Act as a technical liaison to sales leadership.  
•Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely partner with leaders from pricing, underwriting, data engineering, sales, and account management to drive business decisions through accurate and relevant reporting. 
•Data Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that are used by a variety of stakeholders. Develop creative solutions to display insights in new and meaningful ways. 

What we’re looking for

•3-6+ years of actuarial experience
•Pursuing actuarial credentials (ASA designation preferred)
•Proficiency in SQL, experience with Dataiku & Oracle databases
•Experience with data visualization or other reporting tools (Ex: Tableau)
•Demonstrated ability to maintain data accuracy, cleanliness, and functionality
•Motivated and collaborative approach to the role
•4 Year/Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) (Minimum Required)

The Role at a Glance

This position supports Lincoln’s network operations team.  As a member of this team, this role be responsible for developing, automating, and maintaining network infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. The ideal candidate will have experience in both network administration as well as software development and automation skills. 

What you'll be doing

  • Supports delivery and administration of an enterprise network inclusive of routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, DNS appliances within both datacenter and campus architectures. 
  • Experience as a technical escalation resource for a front-line network support team. 
  • Experience with enterprise grade network solutions from vendors such as Cisco, F5, Infoblox, Palo Alto, Arista. 
  • Experience deploying and maintaining vendor management tools such as Cisco Catalyst Center, Palo Alto Panorama. 
  • Experience in utilizing and interpreting alerts and logs from telemetry tools such as SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, Nagios, NewRelic. 
  • Builds and evangelizes Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts throughout the network domain, being a subject matter expert (SME) for IaC principles as they exist within the network domain.
  • Partners with senior network engineers to develop (IaC) discipline within the network domain, focusing on identifying areas where IaC concepts can accelerate delivery, reliability, and security. 
  • Partners with senior network engineers in support of emerging IaC discipline to develop Github repositories, Ansible playbooks, and overall build and maintain a healthy CI/CD pipeline within compliance of Lincoln security policy. 
  • As IaC SME, will develop documentation and reference material, updating in accordance with Lincoln policy & standards guidelines, as well as technology changes dictate. 
  • Works with Lincoln’s managed service provider (MSP) to hand-off technologies and support documentation as applicable.   
  • Maintains knowledge on current and emerging developments/trends, assesses the impact, and collaborates with management to incorporate new trends and developments in current and future solutions. 
  • Champions and enhances organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and/or departmental/enterprise initiatives. 
  • Serves as a resource to team members and applicable internal/external stakeholders on more complex assignments/projects. 
  • Identifies and recommends process improvements that significantly reduce workloads or improve quality. 
  • Serves as a resource to administer and maintain security of devices within span of responsibility. 
  • Identifies potential solutions for their assigned area of Infrastructure responsibility by understanding increasingly complex business/technical problems and opportunities. 
  • Provides input and validates increasingly complex project plans, test plans and implementation plans including estimates on time frames, needed resources and budgets. 
  • Serves as an escalation point for more complex issue resolution. 
  • Communicates effectively with internal stakeholders and management. 
  • Analyzes more complex data to determine key requirements to store and access data and communicate that information to management. 
  • May require after hours to support maintenance windows, on-call rotations.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves:

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
  • 3 - 5+ Years of experience in IT system administration and/or IT infrastructure that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position.

Our contact center technology organization supports platforms for routing, workforce management, quality, fraud/authentication, CRM and digital channels (including Five9, Verint, Pindrop, AWS, click-to-chat and Sierra). The team has two directors, one for platforms and one for integration and application development, plus a federated architect who also serves as a lead developer. What you'll be doing

  • Lead our AI focus: track best practices and trends, assess capabilities, and recommend where to adopt them.
  • Find ways to use AI in the team's day-to-day work (documentation, analysis, reporting, routine requests) to free capacity for business deliverables.
  • Document current processes, break them into explicit tasks, and determine where AI agents can appropriately remove manual work.
  • Work directly with the business to identify use cases and build the case for savings and a better customer experience.
  • Provide analysis and support across the platforms, integration and development, and architecture teams.
  • Lead resource capacity planning, work in-take and chief-of-staff activities.

  • Working knowledge of contact center best practices and current trends, especially conversational and agentic AI.
  • Ability to document processes and decompose them into discrete tasks suitable for automation.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents, with sound judgment on where AI is and is not appropriate.
  • Strong communication skills with both business leaders and technical teams.
  • Experience building business cases and quantifying savings or customer experience impact.
  • 5+ Years of experience that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position.
  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with contact center, fraud/authentication, quality and analytics, cloud, or AI platforms, and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Experience in capacity planning or workforce management.
  • Prior chief-of-staff, business analyst, or program management experience.

The Role at a Glance

The Lead Software Engineer / Technical Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for an Agile delivery team responsible for building industry-leading capabilities while modernizing the technology landscape through cloud migration, DevOps, artificial intelligence and architectural advancement. This role guides solution design and application delivery from initial proposal and estimation through development, testing, deployment, and production support.

The position partners with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, federated architecture teams, Security, and other technology groups to deliver scalable, secure, cost-effective solutions. The role also champions engineering practices such as CI/CD, independent architecture, secure coding, automated testing, and a “you build it, you own it” operating model. 

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of AWS cloud-native and serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and Step Functions.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures supporting enterprise integrations.
  • Provide hands-on development using Java, Node.js, and Python, including code reviews, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Design and manage infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, including automated testing, security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Implement asynchronous processing, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and resilient integration patterns.
  • Collaborate with Security and Identity teams on OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS (mTLS), IAM, Secrets Manager, and secure API integrations.
  • Drive application observability and production troubleshooting using CloudWatch, Splunk, and New Relic.
  • Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimation, and implementation planning across distributed Agile teams.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications, reduce technical debt, improve system reliability, and optimize AWS costs.
  • Promote engineering excellence through secure coding, automated testing, peer reviews, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools.
  • Assess emerging technology trends and advise senior management on their potential impact, particularly in AWS, microservices, cloud architecture, and artificial intelligence.
  • Identify and lead process improvements that reduce defects, shorten code turnaround time, strengthen pipelines, improve cost and performance, and enhance application security.
  • Provide business and technical subject matter expertise to team members and internal and external stakeholders on complex assignments and initiatives.
  • Lead technical response and solution coordination for production issues; support resolution estimation, root-cause analysis, remediation, and service restoration.
  • Direct and enhance organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and/or departmental/enterprise initiatives within assigned area(s) of responsibility including but not limited to transition to AIDLC, enterprise cloud migration, etc. that support IT partners in delivering applications that increase adoption of self-service capabilities.

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications.
  • 2+ years of experience providing technical leadership to distributed Agile development teams.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless services, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Event Bridge, and SQS.
  • Proficiency in one or more backend technologies, including Java, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, preferably AWS CDK or CloudFormation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure deployment processes.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, OAuth 2.0, API authentication, and secure integration patterns.
  • Experience with application monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply generative AI responsibly within the software development lifecycle, including validating AI-generated outputs, protecting confidential information, following secure coding practices, and complying with enterprise AI governance and intellectual property requirements.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable generative AI tools to accelerate code development, technical analysis, documentation, testing, debugging, and modernization activities.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, security teams, and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical assignments, communicate architectural decisions, and collaborate effectively with business and technology stakeholders.

TECHNOLOGY EXPERIENCE

Cloud Platform & Serverless

  • AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, AWS Step Functions
  • Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, AWS IAM, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, Amazon VPC, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail

Programming Languages & Frameworks

  • Java, Node.js, Python
  • Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

  • AWS CDK, AWS CloudFormation
  • GitLab CI/CD, Git, automated deployment pipelines
  • Automated testing, code quality analysis, vulnerability scanning

Architecture & Integration

  • Serverless architecture, event-driven architecture, microservices
  • REST APIs, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems
  • OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS (mTLS), secure API integrations
  • Retry handling, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and fault tolerance

Monitoring & Observability

  • Amazon CloudWatch, Splunk, New Relic
  • Application logging, monitoring, performance analysis, production troubleshooting
  • Databases
  • DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, DB2, SQL

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI-assisted development tools
  • Responsible use of generative AI for development, code reviews, testing, documentation, and modernization

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on Payment Specialist, Long Term Disability, in our Payment Services team to join our Group Protection Shared Services Team supporting Workplace Solutions.

Background Details

The Group Protection Operations Team will help you grow your group benefits knowledge and establish strong partnerships (internally/externally) while working in this fast-paced environment. 

As a Payment Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting our claims organization by calculating and issuing short and/or long-term disability payments, using various excel calculation tools, knowledge of policy/contract provisions, benefit offset options, and work earnings.  This opportunity will provide the ability to grow within the group insurance industry while gaining new skills and building strong working relationships. If this sounds like a role for you, please read on!

What you'll be doing

•    You will establish increasingly complex payments in system, document claims accurately and comprehensively, and update/maintain payment tracking system with key dates and outcomes.
•    You will partner with internal and external areas to achieve financial accuracy and stability for our claimants, using contracts, state guidelines, and various other income earnings. In addition, you will communicate via email or by phone with employers, claims specialists, and/or claimants to gain financial data and other information needed to determine and calculate benefits.  
•    You will gather and review information needed for decisions from multiple sources, including claim case managers, claimants, vendors and customer contacts. 
•    You will work independently, in accordance with established procedures and guidelines, in a timely manner and meets deadlines appropriate around service level agreements and performance guarantees. In addition, you will make routine & non-routine decisions, applying limited but increasingly more discretion within role except for matters of significance which affect the business as a whole or a significant part of it, in accordance with established procedures & guidelines
•    You will apply expanded knowledge obtained from the role in increasingly more complex situations and continues to acquire more knowledge to apply in role.
•    You will establish follow-up tasks for claims examiners that require ongoing payment adjustments or oversight. In addition, you will identify and act upon claims with potential for benefit offset based on other income sources.
•    You will adhere to financial controls under Sarbanes-Oxley, corporate compliance, and GAAP.

What we’re looking for

Must-have experience (Required):


•    High School diploma or GED. 
•    2 - 3 Years of progressive experience in a financial services environment, such as payroll services, directly aligned to the specific responsibilities for this position (Required)
•    Ability to communicate effectively (verbal/written).
•    Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
•    Ability to work with others in a team environment.
•    Demonstrates excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and multi-task while maintaining strict attention to detail.

Nice-to have Experience (Preferred): 

 
·    Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment with the ability to adapt as needed. 
•    Ability to work in various excel documents with a high comfort level of mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, averages and/or variances.
·    Ability to articulate/alter provisions – comfortable with contract language.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial Group is seeking a Data Scientist to join our AI Product & Delivery organization, focused on the agentic AI systems powering our next generation of products. You will generate insights from data, build and validate models, design experiments, and measure the business value AI agents deliver — while establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks that keep agentic systems accurate, safe, and reliable in a regulated financial services environment. You will partner closely with product owners, engineers, and business stakeholders to turn analysis into decisions and evals into guardrails.

What you'll be doing

Insights & Analysis

  • Analyze usage, performance, and outcome data to surface actionable insights on how agentic AI features are used and where they fall short.
  • Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Modeling & Agentic AI Systems

  • Design, build, and validate models and agentic workflows with traditional ML, NLP, RAG, and supervised/unsupervised ML. 
  • Evaluate model and agent architecture choices, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and risk.
  • Collaborate with engineering to productionize models and agents and monitor them post-launch.

Experimentation

  • Design and run experiments — A/B tests, offline evaluations, holdouts — to test agent behavior, prompt or model changes, and feature variants.
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, and sample size or power requirements; ensure statistical rigor.
  • Interpret results and translate them into clear go/no-go recommendations.

Value Measurement

  • Define and track metrics that connect agentic AI features to business value — efficiency gains, cost savings, revenue, and customer or employee experience.
  • Build measurement frameworks that isolate AI-driven impact from other contributing factors.
  • Report on ROI and value realization to product and business leadership.

Evaluations

  • Design and maintain eval suites and benchmarks covering task success, reasoning quality, tool-use correctness, safety, and failure modes.
  • Partner with product owners on human-in-the-loop review processes and use eval findings to guide model and agent improvements.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 3–8 years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong use of AI Coding agents as a core part of how you work
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating ML models with traditional ML, NLP, RAG, and supervised/unsupervised ML.
  • Experience with agentic AI systems (LLM agents, tool use, multi-step reasoning) strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing and analyzing experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and standard ML/data science tooling.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Grade level: final grade level for this position will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building or evaluating LLM-based agents or multi-agent systems.
  • Familiarity with eval frameworks and observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, Ragas).
  • Experience with LLM APIs or enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI).
  • Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field.
  • Domain experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement planning, or employee benefits.

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through September 30, 2026, subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln’s Investment Strategy & Portfolio Management team is evolving its Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and asset liability modeling toolkit to better support enterprise risk appetite, capital, liquidity, and new business growth across U.S.A. and Bermuda entities.

The team partners with insurance businesses and the Investments team to design and maintain the enterprise SAA across legal entities, integrating new business pricing with in force optimization, and operating within U.S. and Bermuda regulatory regimes.  In this role, you will own the quantitative modeling and analytics that power strategic asset allocation, in-force optimization, and new business pricing support — drawing on ALM analytics as a key input, and building select ALM components as needed.  You will work as a close quantitative partner to investment strategy and portfolio management, bringing deep understanding of SAA and portfolio construction to develop models and dashboards, and ensuring our analytics incorporate regulatory requirements for NAIC and Bermuda Monetary Authority standards.  Your efforts will enable our investment strategies to be produced faster across regimes and improve our documentation and governance controls.

What you'll be doing

Build and own the SAA analytics platform
•Engineer reliable Python services and SQL backed data pipelines that ingest asset, liability, and market data; orchestrate runs; and expose results to strategy and risk partners (APIs, notebooks, dashboards).
•Productionize research prototypes into hardened components (configuration management, unit/integration tests, logging, lineage, and automated documentation) supporting enterprise wide SAA across U.S. and Bermuda entities.


Portfolio construction & optimization enablement
•Implement and scale optimization, scenario analysis, and stress testing tools used to construct SAA under capital, rating, liquidity, and ALM constraints; parameterize for both U.S. RBC and Bermuda BSCR frameworks.
•Integrate cash flow projections (e.g., BondEdge outputs) and reconcile them to portfolio views with auditable data controls.

Regulatory aware data modeling
•Model and map security master and position data to NAIC designations and statutory schedules and to BMA BSCR asset categories and SBA portfolios; embed validation checks aligned to reporting rules.

Partner across the enterprise
•Work across the Investments team to partner with insurance business units, ALM, Actuarial, Enterprise Risk Management, and Finance.

What we’re looking for

Quantitative & technical skills
•Fluent in multiple languages with depth in Python and SQL (required). You also bring working proficiency in other languages for legacy model integration.
•Hands on experience building scalable, object-oriented solutions/components for model enhancements/extensions across different products/assumptions. Enhancing existing core framework to scale model with change requests from product owners (annuities, life, group etc.) while maintaining code readability, documentation, and audit trail.
•Hands on data engineering: relational modeling, performance tuning, data integration (with tools like Bloomberg & Intex), orchestration, version control, testing frameworks, and observability.
•Quant/optimization toolkit experience (e.g., pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Pyomo/OR Tools) and time series/scenario modeling.
•Code testing/automation using CI/CD framework, Backtesting of strategy – creating backtesting data and summarizing model results and reporting Investment analytics by potentially leveraging Lincoln’s AI tools/suite of products.
•Experience in producing asset cashflows utilizing tools like Factset/Bloomberg/Intex is a plus.

Insurance investing & regulatory literacy
•Required:  Practical familiarity with NAIC investment regulations, statutory accounting and reporting (including RBC capital concepts and statutory investment schedules)
•Required:  Understanding of Bermuda Monetary Authority capital and reporting
•Required: Deep understanding of SAA optimization incorporating the matching of insurance product liability cash flows across multiple economic scenarios

Domain context
•Exposure to ALM and insurance balance sheet dynamics (duration/convexity, liquidity ladders, reinvestment, asset rating migration).
•Comfort integrating third party and internal data sources (e.g., pricing/spread inputs, cash flow engines) into reproducible SAA processes.
Ways of working
•Product mindset: ability to decompose ambiguous strategy problems into small, testable engineering increments with clear documentation.
•Excellent communication with non engineers; able to explain model assumptions, caveats, and results succinctly for decision makers.

Minimum qualifications
•Bachelor’s degree in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s degree, CFA, FRM or FSA preferred).
•10+ years of experience within the financial services or related industry; 5+ years of professional experience in quantitative investment strategy, strategic asset allocation, portfolio construction, or asset-liability management, with strong hands-on software/data engineering skills to build and productionize the underlying analytics.
•Demonstrated track record building production data/analytics platforms supporting portfolio construction or risk/ALM.

Applications for this position will be accepted through December 20th, 2026 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on an Excel/VBA Annuity Modeling Specialist to join our Retail Solutions organization in a hybrid work environment. We are open to candidates in the following key city locations: Charlotte (NC), Fort Wayne (IN), Greensboro (NC), Hartford (CT), Omaha (NE) and Radnor (PA). 

Background Details

As the Excel/VBA Annuity Modeling Specialist, you will contribute to the development of benchmark test tools for our annuity illustration, administration, and other product platforms. Working under general supervision and following established guidelines, you will apply working knowledge of Excel and VBA to build and maintain spreadsheet models that verify the accuracy of our systems. This position supports analysis for stakeholders across the Annuities group while delivering on routine assignments within its assigned area. The incumbent also serves as a resource for annuity product technical questions and supports other ad hoc annuity analytical initiatives as needed. 

What you'll be doing

  • You will support the development and implementation of Excel-based testing models for Variable, Fixed, Indexed, Immediate and Deferred Income Annuities to ensure the accuracy of our illustration system(s), digital platform(s), administration system(s), and any other supporting system(s), including but not limited to: adding new products to existing spreadsheet models, creating new spreadsheets for new products, and updating existing spreadsheets for product changes. 
  • You will work collaboratively with fellow team members to meet shared goals and deadlines. 
  • You will leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate spreadsheet modeling, testing, and analysis workflows. 
  • You will assist in debugging systems and help determine the sources of differences from the benchmark tool. 
  • You will respond to straightforward queries from distribution regarding product illustrations and projections. 
  • You will work with Operations and the Product Implementation team to support production-related calculation issues. 
  • You will maintain working knowledge of current developments and trends for assigned area(s) of responsibility. 
  • You will support and positively contribute to departmental and enterprise change management initiatives within assigned area(s) of responsibility. 
  • You will perform and deliver on routine assignments/projects while applying working knowledge of assigned area(s) of responsibility. 
  • You will serve as a resource for ad hoc annuity product analysis assignments as needed. 

What we’re looking for

  • 4 Year/Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in mathematics, computer science, or a similar technical field. 
  • 1–3+ Years of experience in Excel modeling that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position. 
  • Working knowledge of spreadsheets and programming experience with VBA. 
  • Experience using AI platforms (i.e., CoPilot, Claude). 
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills; detail-oriented, motivated, and eager to learn. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret both internal and external documents. 
  • Ability to apply mathematical concepts such as probability, statistics, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical solutions. 
  • Ability to solve challenging but noncomplex problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables where guidelines exist. 
  • Ability to collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Ability to evaluate trends in data or information. 
  • Understanding of annuity products and markets preferred, or a willingness to develop it. 
  • Ability to work with others in a collaborative team environment under general supervision. 
  • Demonstrated relationship management skills with internal clients (e.g., management, peers, and colleagues). 
  • Demonstrates strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and multi-task while maintaining attention to detail.

The Role at a Glance

The Vice President, Fixed Income will be a senior investment leader within Lincoln Financial’ s Investments organization, responsible for executing and advancing fixed income investment strategies that support the company’s insurance businesses, enterprise objectives, and long term financial performance. This role partners closely with the Head of Fixed Income and collaborates with actuarial, ALM, finance, risk, and business unit leadership to ensure strong alignment of assets and liabilities while delivering risk adjusted returns consistent with Lincoln’s risk appetite and regulatory frameworks.

This position plays a key role in portfolio construction, manager oversight, new money deployment, and in force portfolio optimization across Lincoln’s fixed income portfolios. The VP also supports new business pricing, strategic asset allocation initiatives, and transaction related analysis.

 Ideal Candidate

  • Structured credit depth: Deep technical expertise and a long, hands-on track record in structured credit (including asset-backed finance, rated note structures, and other securitized and private structured products), with strong command of structuring, collateral and cash flow analysis, and structural protections.
  • Investment acumen and enterprise perspective: Sound investment judgment with a broad understanding of asset classes beyond structured credit, able to work across actuarial, ALM, finance, risk, and business unit stakeholders and to contribute to larger projects and strategic initiatives while executing against the agreed fixed income strategy.
  • Highly driven owner of fixed income credit: Self-motivated and accountable for the credit function end to end, with clear functional ownership of (1) strategy execution and pipeline, (2) sourcing and underwriting, (3) manager and portfolio oversight, and (4) risk monitoring, governance, and reporting.

What you'll be doing

Fixed Income Strategy Execution & Portfolio Leadership

  • Execute fixed income strategies across insurance legal entities and business lines, consistent with enterprise risk, capital, and liquidity objectives.
  • Evaluate existing and new fixed income asset classes, asset managers, and strategies aligned with evolving business needs and regulatory requirements (including U.S. and Bermuda regimes).
  • Source, evaluate, and underwrite public and private fixed income opportunities across private placements, structured credit, asset-backed finance, rated note structures, infrastructure debt, with a focus on relative value, structural protections, and risk- and capital-adjusted returns.
  • Develop and manage investment pipeline, prioritizing opportunities based on relative value, capacity, and strategic fit.

Manager Oversight & Investment Sourcing

  • Oversee performance and risk of assigned external fixed income managers.
  • Support manager selection, onboarding, and review processes, including performance benchmarking and due diligence.
  • Partner with asset managers to evaluate co investment opportunities and support underwriting and execution.

Portfolio Optimization & Risk Management

  • Monitor portfolio performance, credit quality, liquidity, concentrations, and investment activity within assigned areas.
  • Contribute to quantitative modeling, stress testing, and scenario analysis used to inform portfolio allocation decisions.
  • Ensure adherence to governance standards, documentation requirements, and regulatory and accounting frameworks.

Cross Functional & Strategic Support

  • Partner closely with actuarial, ALM, finance, risk, treasury, and business unit stakeholders to support asset liability alignment.
  • Prepare analyses, materials, and recommendations for senior investment leadership and governance forums.
  • Communicate complex portfolio insights clearly to internal stakeholders.

What we’re looking for

  • Experienced fixed income investment professional with strong expertise in credit investing, and insurance balance sheet frameworks.
  • 12 + years of experience in insurance asset management, fixed income portfolio management, liability driven investing, or related fields.
  • Strong understanding of insurance balance sheets, asset–liability management, U.S. RBC and Bermuda regulatory frameworks, and GAAP/statutory accounting.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in highly cross functional environments and influence outcomes through analysis and collaboration.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and synthesize complex data sets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present investment insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, quantitative discipline, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • CFA preferred but not required.

The Role at a Glance

The Security Risk Assessment Analyst conducts information security risk assessments on external parties to ensure that the risks associated with those relationships fall within Lincoln’s acceptable risk tolerances. The Analyst independently owns assessments for vendors and services, including complex vendors and high-risk engagements, determines their information security risk profiles, and works with vendors and internal stakeholders to drive risk mitigation and remediation. The Analyst guides stakeholders on the risks associated with assessment findings and on adherence to applicable procedures, regulations, and/or laws. The Analyst also informally mentors Sr. Associates and shares knowledge with the team. 

What you'll be doing

Assessment and risk determination

  • Independently conducts security risk assessments of external parties, including complex vendors and high-risk engagements, by reviewing questionnaires, audit reports, control documentation, and supporting evidence.
  • Determines vendor risk profiles and evaluates control gaps using established methodologies, Lincoln policies, industry standards, business context, data sensitivity, and access.
  • Applies critical thinking and independent judgment to analyze information from multiple sources and develop clear findings, recommendations, and reporting.
  • Integrates business, technical, and risk information to provide actionable guidance.
  • Performs vendor risk management activities, leads portions of projects, and coordinates activities across stakeholders.

Mitigation, remediation, and escalation

  • Recommends mitigation strategies to reduce identified risk and clearly communicates expectations to vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Drives remediation by setting expectations, tracking progress, and following up until findings are closed, accepted, or escalated.
  • Independently resolves moderately complex issues and promptly escalates matters outside the role’s scope with clear recommendations.
  • Respectfully challenges risks, exceptions, and concerns using a fact-based, solution-oriented approach.

Communication and stakeholder engagement

  • Communicates security and risk concepts clearly and persuasively, adapting messages, reports, and presentations for technical, business, and leadership audiences.
  • Builds trusted relationships and influences stakeholders regarding risk implications, assessment outcomes, and remediation strategies.
  • Partners across business and risk functions to support assessments, remediation, and risk management efforts.
  • Reports engagement status to Information Security management, project managers, and stakeholders.

AI and emerging risk

  • Independently evaluates third-party AI solutions, including generative AI, using established policies, standards, and industry practices.
  • Advises stakeholders on AI risk and maintains knowledge of emerging AI technologies and security risks.

Metrics, reporting, and documentation

  • Maintains complete, accurate, and timely assessment documentation and communications in Lincoln’s GRC platform.
  • Analyzes assessment and remediation data to identify trends, reporting opportunities, and data-quality improvements.
  • Owns reporting for assigned vendors and workload, developing metrics, dashboards, reports, and presentations that communicate risk trends, remediation progress, and program performance.

Standards, improvement, and team contribution

  • Contributes to information security standards, policies, procedures, and related documentation.
  • Leads process improvements that enhance program efficiency, consistency, and quality.
  • Informally mentors Sr. Associates and shares expertise across the team.
  • Maintains knowledge of security issues, threats, technologies, and industry best practices and applies expertise to complex situations.
  • Contributes to departmental and enterprise initiatives, change efforts, and team objectives.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Information Security, Information Risk Management, or related field, or 4+ years of equivalent work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • 3–5 years of experience in IT Security or Information Risk Management directly aligned with the responsibilities of this role.
  • 1+ year of experience or demonstrated working knowledge of AI technologies, including generative AI, as applied to security or third-party risk.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, regulations, policies, audit reports, proposals, and standard operating procedures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for technical, business, and leadership audiences.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, including synthesizing information from multiple sources into clear conclusions.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, including the ability to build consensus and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Ability to successfully complete regulatory and job training requirements.

 

Nice to Have

  • CompTIA Security+ certification or higher preferred.

Requisition #: 76583

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to be seeking a highly motivated Nurse Disability Consultant to our clinical organization. This position will be responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and interpreting medical information available for disability claims.

Background Details

As a Nurse Disability Consultant, you will act as a clinical resource for Group Protection benefit specialists and claim professionals. You will evaluate medical information to clarify diagnoses, evaluate the severity of medical conditions, validate medical restrictions and limitations, and estimate duration of recovery. You will provide coaching and guidance to claims regarding medical management. If this sounds like a role for you, please read on!

What you'll be doing

  • You will maintain knowledge on current and emerging developments/trends, assess the impact, and collaborate with management to incorporate new trends and developments in current and future solutions.
  • You will evaluate medical information to clarify diagnoses, evaluate the severity of medical conditions, validating medical restrictions and limitations, and estimating duration of recovery.
  • You will clarify, interpret and/or evaluate medical information to assess appropriateness of current and ongoing restrictions / limitations and level of impairment
  • You will identify pertinent clinical facts and answers questions in collaboration with benefits specialists and physician consultants
  • You will act as a clinical resource to Group Protection claim professionals during claim meetings and as needed.
  • You will recommend specific medical information needed to evaluate ongoing levels of impairment and to facilitate optimal claim management.
  • You will make appropriate referrals to external clinical resources (i.e. IME, FCE, Peer Reviews).
  • You will discuss complex medical issues with health care providers as needed and documents outcomes of discussion.
  • You will coordinate and partner with Vocational Rehabilitation Coordinators (VRC) and others to support with return-to-work services.
  • You will effectively manage assigned caseload within department productivity goals.

What we’re looking for

Must-have experience (Required):

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) in Nursing.
  • Registered Nurse – Current, unrestricted license in the state where the position is located (upon hire certificates/licensures).
  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret both internal and external documents such as general media/publications, professional journals, technical procedures, governmental regulations, policies, proposals, and standard operating procedures.
  • Confident, comfortable communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrates clear, concise communication skills when interpreting medical information, documenting rationales for clinical opinions, clarifying restrictions/limitations, assisting with return to work and communicating with staff, mgmt. & other stakeholders

 

Nice-to have experience (Preferred):

  • Associates or bachelor’s degree in Nursing.
  • 3-5 years of nursing experience with preferred clinical nursing expertise in Emergency Room, Critical Care, Orthopedics, Coronary Care, or trauma.
  • Previous insurance industry experience preferred.
  • Experience and/or proficiency with Disability Management (STD/LTD), Workers Compensation, Utilization Review and/or nurse case management preferred skills

The Role at a Glance

The Actuarial Development Program (ADP) at Lincoln Financial Group is an industry-leading program that demonstrates Lincoln Financial’ s commitment to creating highly qualified business leaders.  As an ADP participant, you’ll be able to explore your unique interests while developing the essential actuarial, technical, management, communication, and leadership skills you need to succeed. The Actuarial Development Program includes a series of rotations, typically every 18-24 months. For each rotation, roles are available in different business areas including Life and Annuities, Retirement and Group Protection. Experience gained will enable participants to become well-rounded actuaries with knowledge that may include Product Development, Pricing, Valuation, Modeling, Risk Management, Asset Liability Management, Investments, Data Analytics, and Internal Audit.
 
ADP participants are expected to pass the Society of Actuaries’ exams at a prescribed pace. The program is designed to support you as you work towards your FSA and provide the training and resources necessary to become a well-rounded actuarial leader.
 
Additional Program Highlights:
•Highly competitive compensation package with salary increases and bonuses upon successful exam completion
•Social and training opportunities to enhance skills, network with ADP participants and build long-lasting industry relationships 
•Dedicated leaders and mentors to assist with career development
Work with actuarial and data science software and technologies including MG-ALFA, Axis, Prophet, Dataiku, R, and Tableau
•Generous study time allowances for each exam session
•Payment and/or reimbursement of actuarial exam fees, materials, review courses, and seminars taken during the program 

The primary purpose of the Associate Actuary, Annuity Pricing role is performing ad hoc pricing analysis for retail annuity products, including fixed, fixed indexed, registered index-linked, and variable annuity products.

What you'll be doing

•Pricing/Risk Analysis: Perform foundational and exploratory pricing analysis across Lincoln’s suite of retail annuity products (including registered index-linked annuities, fixed annuities, fixed indexed annuities, and variable annuities) using vendor software and internally developed software and tools.
•Special Projects: Participate in ad hoc initiatives related to product development, implementation, assumption setting, pricing modeling, corporate risk management initiatives such as ERM and capital management, and other strategic projects.
•Analytical/ Technical Support: Maintain existing tools/models and develop new tools or methodologies as needed to support new capabilities or improve accuracy and efficiency. 
•Pricing Documentation: Prepare documentation of processes, tools, assumptions, and/or key decisions made.
•Collaboration & Communication: Collaborate with business partners on various initiatives. Present results to team members, key stakeholders, and management.

What we’re looking for

•4 Year/Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) (Minimum Required)
•3-6+ years of actuarial experience
•ASA designation preferred
•Strong technical, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
•Capability to be productive in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and responsibilities.
•Motivated and collaborative with an optimistic outlook
•Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Application Deadline

The Role at a Glance

This Financial Planning & Analysis Specialist will perform and deliver on routine assignments and projects while leveraging and applying knowledge of FP&A principles to support Lincoln Financial Distributors (LFD). The individual will prepare, analyze, forecast, and report on financial information that helps business leaders make informed decisions regarding budgets, expenses, headcount planning, and business investments. This role partners with leaders across multiple business lines to provide financial insights, evaluate business performance, identify trends and variances, and support strategic and operational planning initiatives. The position also contributes to annual budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and ad hoc analyses that support business growth and profitability.

What you'll be doing

  • Prepare, analyze, and report on financial results and key business metrics for assigned LFD business areas.
  • Support the annual budget, forecast, and long-range planning processes, including expense, revenue, and headcount planning.
  • Perform budget-to-actual, forecast-to-actual, and variance analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Partner with business leaders to provide financial guidance and decision support related to operational initiatives, strategic investments, and resource planning.
  • Develop financial models and analyses to evaluate business opportunities, including new products, pricing strategies, sales growth initiatives, and workforce planning scenarios.
  • Support month-end and quarterly close activities, including preparing journal entries, completing account reconciliations, and reviewing financial performance.
  • Research expense activity, resolve variances, and support the preparation of financial statements and the LFD profit and loss statement.
  • Support LFD bonus programs, including revenue-sharing and firm/advisor programs, through accruals, analysis, and financial modeling.
  • Communicate financial insights, trends, and emerging issues to management and recommend actions where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with team members and cross-functional partners to improve financial processes, reporting capabilities, and decision-making tools.

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) (Minimum Required)
  • 1+ Years experience in financial planning & analysis
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret financial data and communicate insights effectively.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with business leaders and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar platforms) to support data analysis, process efficiency, financial insights, and business decision-making
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint with experience developing clear and concise presentations that communicate financial results, forecasts, strategic recommendations, and key business insights to stakeholders.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with PeopleSoft and financial planning and reporting tools such as SmartView, Hyperion, Essbase, and/or Anaplan.Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, and ad hoc business analysis.
  • Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, and ad hoc business analysis.
  • Experience presenting financial results and recommendations to business partners and leadership.

The Role at a Glance

As the COLI BOLI Insurance Consultant for Lincoln’s Executive Benefit’s Underwriting Team, you will analyze and deliver on COLI BOLI ICOLI cases.   The Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) Underwriter is responsible for evaluating mortality, financial, and insurable risk associated with corporate-sponsored life insurance programs. The role supports the issuance and management of COLI and BOLI cases by assessing underwriting evidence, applying carrier guidelines, and making risk-based decisions that support profitable growth while maintaining regulatory compliance. Responsibilities often include collaboration with sales, actuarial, legal, case management, and corporate clients

This is a developmental opportunity designed for someone who brings relevant experience and knowledge of the COLI, BOLI, or broader institutional life insurance marketplace and is interested in building deeper underwriting expertise. A traditional underwriting background is not required. Candidates may bring transferable experience from areas such as operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or other roles that provide meaningful exposure to COLI and BOLI programs.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) applications, including corporate and institutionally sponsored programs.
  • Underwrite Guaranteed Issue (GI) and Simplified Issue (SI) COLI cases in accordance with approved program designs, eligibility criteria, and carrier guidelines.
  • Evaluate and assess complex financial, and corporate risks for executives, key employees, and eligible participant populations.
  • Analyze corporate financial statements, program structures, and plan designs to ensure alignment with underwriting standards, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerance.
  • Apply knowledge of Qualified Purchaser and Accredited Investor definitions in support of program eligibility, structure, and regulatory compliance.
  • Determine face amounts, and policy terms using sound underwriting judgment
  • Review and approve pre-issue and post-issue underwriting transactions, including policy changes, face amount adjustments, and other in-force underwriting requests.
  • Collaborate with Sales, New Business, Legal, Compliance, Actuarial, and Operations to support case design and execution.
  • Identify underwriting trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of COLI regulations, underwriting philosophies, and market practices.

What we’re looking for

Must-Have’s

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience 
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to influence management/critical stakeholders
  • Analytical skills and close attention to detail is necessary
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a changing work environment

Nice-to Have’s

  • Experience working with corporate owned life insurance (COLI) and/or bank owned life insurance (BOLI) programs
  • Strong understanding of the institutional life insurance marketplace
  • Experience in underwriting, operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or a related area

Job.JobDescription:

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on a Lead Business Analyst to support the Producer Solutions Operations business as part of the Retail Solutions organization. This role will be hybrid and open to the Lincoln key cities with a preferred location of Fort Wayne (IN), Greensboro (NC), or Hartford (CT).

Background Details
As a Lead Business Analyst, you will serve as a trusted business partner and subject matter expert for the Producer Solutions Operations business, leading complex business analysis initiatives from discovery through implementation. You will leverage strong domain knowledge and business stewardship to understand stakeholder needs, challenge assumptions, evaluate options and recommend solutions that best support business objectives. Rather than simply translating requests into requirements, you will help stakeholders understand what is possible, identify alternative approaches and guide decisions toward the most effective business outcomes.

In this role, you will also bring a Product Owner mindset to the team, helping prioritize work based on business value, impact, dependencies and release commitments. You will partner across business and technology teams to develop requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinate and complete user acceptance testing (UAT), address issues and defects, and ensure work remains on track for scheduled releases. You will provide direction throughout the delivery lifecycle while balancing scope, quality, risk, timing and business priorities. If you enjoy connecting business strategy with execution, influencing decisions and helping teams deliver meaningful solutions, please read on!

What you'll be doing

  • You will serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, partnering with key stakeholders to understand complex business challenges, uncover root causes and identify needs and opportunities.
  • You will leverage strong domain knowledge and business stewardship to challenge assumptions, evaluate alternatives and recommend solutions, rather than simply executing against initial requests.
  • You will lead the development of complex business requirements, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You will help prioritize and sequence work based on business value, urgency, risk, dependencies, capacity and scheduled release commitments.
  • You will partner closely with business, technology and other stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure solutions remain aligned with intended business outcomes.
  • You will own and/or coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), including developing test scenarios and acceptance criteria, validating results and ensuring solutions meet defined business needs.
  • You will monitor progress toward scheduled releases, identifying risks, dependencies, issues or competing priorities that could impact scope, quality or delivery timelines and helping drive them to resolution.
  • You will assess complex issues and defects, determine business impact and recommend appropriate prioritization and resolution.
  • You will facilitate discussions and decision-making when competing requirements, priorities or stakeholder perspectives arise.
  • You will conduct complex research and analysis to support business decisions and present recommendations and findings to management, project leaders and key stakeholders.
  • You will identify opportunities to improve business processes, practices and solutions, and help lead change through analysis, design, testing and implementation.
  • You will provide leadership and mentorship to peers and junior team members by sharing knowledge, best practices and domain expertise.

What we’re looking for

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's)
  • 5+ Years of experience in business analysis that directly relates to the specific responsibilities of this role
  • Producer Solutions Operations knowledge and experience is preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and multitask while maintaining strict attention to detail
  • Ability to evaluate information and data trends, solve challenging but non-complex problems, apply sound judgment to draw conclusions and act effectively in situations with limited standardization
  • Effectively and responsibly uses AI tools in daily work, validates AI-generated outputs, and identifies opportunities to improve productivity, decision-making, and outcomes for themselves, colleagues, and the organization
  • Remains current in profession and industry trends
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Application Deadline

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial Group is building an AI Native Intelligence platform that turns enterprise data into a conversational, agentic layer the business can query directly — and that continuously finds patterns, trends, and anomalies in that data on its own. The platform's architecture spans an AWS-native ingestion and extraction pipeline, a governed semantic layer and business knowledge graph, and an intelligence layer that answers questions in plain language and surfaces what's changing, instead of relying on static reports someone has to remember to check.

We're looking for a Sr. Director, AI Native Analytics to be the hands-on builder of that conversational and analytical experience: the person who actually designs and ships the Bedrock agents, retrieval pipelines, pattern-detection logic, and natural-language-to-analytics capabilities that make the platform usable. This is an individual-contributor-heavy, deeply technical role — you'll spend most of your time in the architecture, the prompts, and the code, while partnering closely with the Senior Director on direction and with business stakeholders on what “useful” actually looks like.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and build the conversational AI experience end to end: Bedrock Agents (via AgentCore or MCP/API), retrieval-augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases / OpenSearch Serverless, natural-language-to-SQL over Athena, and relationship queries over a knowledge graph (Amazon Neptune / GraphRAG).
  • Build capabilities that continuously detect patterns, trends, and anomalies across enterprise data — surfacing what's notable proactively, rather than waiting for someone to know what question to ask.
  • Build and tune the AI extraction pipeline that turns raw unstructured data (documents, logs, notes, communications) into structured, query-ready facts — using Amazon Comprehend and/or LLM-based extraction via the Bedrock Converse API (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB for state).
  • Own prompt engineering and agent tool design: system instructions, tool/action-group definitions, structured-output schemas, and model selection/tiering to balance accuracy, latency, and cost.
  • Integrate the conversational layer with the platform's semantic layer and business ontology (KPI and metrics definitions, business rules glossary) so agent answers stay consistent with how the business already measures itself — never computing an ad hoc number that disagrees with a dashboard.
  • Build evaluation and quality processes for LLM-based systems: golden question sets, retrieval/accuracy scoring, hallucination and abstention testing, and regression checks before any change ships to users.
  • Implement guardrails in partnership with security/compliance: PII detection and redaction, Bedrock Guardrails configuration, access-controlled data zones, and audit logging for every AI-generated answer.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders across the enterprise to translate real questions into working conversational and pattern-detection features, and iterate quickly based on usage and accuracy feedback.
  • Mentor and provide technical direction to engineers contributing to the conversational AI workstream, and represent this workstream in architecture reviews led by the Senior Director.
  • Stay current with the fast-moving AWS AI landscape — Bedrock model and AgentCore updates, new retrieval and evaluation tooling — and bring concrete recommendations back to the team.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Analytics / Business Intelligence with at least 2+ years building production LLM-based Analytics systems (not just prototypes or proofs of concept).
  • Hands-on, production-level expertise with the AWS AI/data stack: Amazon Bedrock (Knowledge Bases, Agents/AgentCore), AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena; working experience with a vector store (OpenSearch Serverless or similar).
  • Strong, practical prompt-engineering and LLM application development skills: structured extraction, tool-calling/agentic patterns, retrieval design, and iterative evaluation against real questions.
  • Solid understanding of semantic layers, business ontologies, or metrics layers, and how to ground LLM outputs in governed, consistent business definitions rather than ad hoc computation.
  • Experience building or applying pattern-, trend-, or anomaly-detection techniques over enterprise data (statistical, ML-based, or LLM-assisted), and turning what's found into something a business user can act on.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js for building extraction pipelines, agent tools, and integration code.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and cloud analytics engines (Athena, Redshift, or similar), sufficient to design and validate natural-language-to-SQL experiences.
  • Clear communicator who can demo a working system to engineers and explain its behavior and limitations to non-technical business stakeholders with equal clarity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with GraphRAG or other knowledge-graph-grounded retrieval patterns, and with a graph database such as Amazon Neptune.
  • Experience with a semantic-layer/metrics-layer tool (e.g., Cube.dev) used to serve consistent metrics to both BI and AI consumers.
  • Experience with NLP/document-processing pipelines (e.g., Amazon Comprehend) for extracting structure from varied unstructured enterprise data.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, with a working understanding of PII handling and data privacy/compliance considerations.
  • Experience configuring LLM safety/evaluation tooling such as Bedrock Guardrails, or building your own evaluation harness for generative AI systems.
  • Familiarity with a range of enterprise data domains (financial, operational, customer, or workforce data) within a large organization.

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on an AVP, Product Development – Registered Indexed Linked Annuities (RILA) to support the Annuity business in a hybrid work environment. Preferred key cities include Hartford, Greensboro, Fort Wayne, Radnor.

Background Details

As the AVP, Product Development for RILA products, you will play a leadership role focused on shaping and executing the future of Lincoln's RILA product portfolio. This position is responsible for driving product opportunities and growth by identifying market opportunities, and developing differentiated solutions, for a rapidly evolving segment of the annuity marketplace.

Working across the organization and with external partners, you will leverage industry expertise, market insights, and strong relationships to influence product direction and enhance Lincoln's competitive position. Success in this role requires a deep understanding of RILA products, the broader annuity landscape, and emerging trends that impact customers, advisors, and the industry.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of developing and advancing RILA or similar insurance and investment products, along with the strategic vision to anticipate market needs and translate them into meaningful product solutions. This role is well-suited for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of market strategy, product innovation, and business growth. If this role is for you, please read on!

Please note: This is a product leadership role focused on product strategy and development, not a project management position.

What you'll be doing

  • You will lead the discovery, design, development, and delivery of RILA solutions that support business growth, market differentiation, and long-term product strategy.
  • You will identify emerging market opportunities, consumer needs, and industry trends to develop strategies that expand into new markets and diversify the product portfolio.
  • You will assist business leaders by influencing product priorities and future growth opportunities.
  • You will work alongside business partners to assess the annuity and adjacent markets to identify product concepts and evaluate their viability, competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.
  • You will collaborate with Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, Legal, State Filings, Operations, and Implementation teams to develop and bring product solutions from concept to market.
  • You will build and leverage relationships with external partners, industry organizations, and third-party providers to gather market insights, identify opportunities, and inform product innovation efforts.
  • You will play a key role in evaluating product performance, in-force management strategies, and market competitiveness to support portfolio optimization and business growth.
  • You will contribute to risk management and product governance processes by assessing potential impacts to product design, pricing strategies, business mix, and overall portfolio performance.
  • You will help define and execute short- and long-term product strategies by maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitor offerings, regulatory developments, and emerging industry trends.

What we’re looking for

  • 4 Year Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of experience of equivalent work experience
  • 10+ Years experience in a similar role in the insurance industry. (Required)
  • Strong presentation skills with demonstrated ability to influence at all levels of management through clear, informed and logical discussions/presentations.
  • Demonstrates ability to communicate knowledgeably and credibly with senior management and internal constituents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify, develop and implement process improvements.
  • Demonstrated strong relationship management skills with internal clients (e.g. senior management, peers and colleagues); proven ability to develop creative and collaborative approaches.
