Requisition #: 76592

The Role at a Glance

The Agentic Platform Engineer builds the shared cloud platform and engineering foundations that enable AIDA teams to deliver secure, scalable AI agents and agentic applications. This role focuses on the runtime, tooling, and guardrails that agents depend on: model access, tool and context integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, observability, and DevSecOps on AWS.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain shared platform services that support agent runtimes, LLM gateways, model routing, prompt/context management, and tool integration.
  • Standardize agentic delivery patterns including tool/function calling, MCP-style tool servers, retrieval pipelines, memory and state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Implement guardrails for agent safety: input/output filtering, prompt injection defenses, human-in-the-loop approval paths, sandboxed execution, and least-privilege agent identities.
  • Improve developer productivity through CI/CD, environment templates, agent scaffolding, SDKs, and platform automation.
  • Build observability and evaluation for agentic systems: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency, quality/eval harnesses, and regression testing of prompts and agent behavior.
  • Manage cost-aware model consumption, rate limits, caching, and secure secrets/access patterns across environments.
  • Partner with architecture, security, risk, and engineering leaders to apply AI controls, interoperability standards, and governance guardrails.
  • Document platform standards and help delivery teams adopt agentic patterns consistently.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, with hands-on work building or operating AI/LLM-based applications.
  • Strong experience with AWS, including services supporting AI workloads (Bedrock, SageMaker, containers, serverless).
  • Practical experience with agent frameworks and LLM tooling such as LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
  • Strong coding ability in Python; Java or NodeJS is a plus.
  • Experience enabling engineering teams through CI/CD, GitLab, observability, reusable services, and platform standards.
  • Experience with API infrastructure, containers, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, or similar).
  • Experience supporting production systems, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads.
  • Exposure to regulated enterprise environments, identity/access controls, AI risk frameworks, and audit logging.

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking a highly motivated Lead Cloud Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Engineering team, with a primary focus on AWS Control Tower, enterprise landing zone engineering, and the secure enablement of AWS services. This is an enterprise cloud platform engineering role, not an application development or application-focused DevOps position. The engineer will build, govern, automate, and operate the shared AWS foundation used by multiple application teams, including landing zones, account provisioning, platform controls, and approved cloud and AI services, including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

The successful candidate will possess hands-on ownership experience with a shared enterprise AWS platform, deep practical AWS Control Tower knowledge and implementation experience, a demonstrated ability to take AWS services from evaluation through production enablement, and working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Strong software development and automation skills applied to reusable platform capabilities, experience with AI and machine learning technologies, and excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential. This position does not include direct people management responsibilities but requires strong technical influence and collaboration across stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design, implementation, automation, and ongoing operation of AWS Control Tower and enterprise landing zones, including multi-account structures, organizational units, account provisioning and enrollment, baseline configurations, landing zone upgrades, and drift remediation.
  • Implement and maintain AWS Control Tower controls and account governance in partnership with security teams, integrating AWS Organizations, service control policies (SCPs), IAM Identity Center, AWS Config, and centralized logging.
  • Drive end-to-end AWS service enablement: assess use cases and dependencies, coordinate architecture and security reviews, define approved configurations and access patterns, build reusable Infrastructure as Code, validate controls, and deliver production-ready services with documented support ownership.
  • Develop and maintain cloud automation using Python and Infrastructure as Code to standardize account provisioning, landing zone configurations, service deployment, and ongoing platform lifecycle management.
  • Build and enhance GitLab CI/CD pipelines for shared platform infrastructure, account baselines, and reusable AWS service enablement patterns.
  • Evaluate, enable, and support AI and machine learning capabilities, with particular emphasis on enabling Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as a governed enterprise platform capability. Develop shared deployment patterns, access controls, observability, and support boundaries for Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, and Observability in partnership with AI, application, architecture, and security teams. The focus is enabling application teams to build and operate agents, not primarily developing application-specific agents.
  • Partner with architects, developers, security teams, and operations teams to deliver shared cloud platform capabilities and approved service patterns that application teams can consume.
  • Implement cloud best practices related to security, scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in the shared AWS platform, including account provisioning, governance controls, identity integrations, and service enablement; collaborate with application teams to distinguish platform issues from application-owned issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across cloud engineering processes and tooling.

Technical Skills

Cloud & Platform

  • AWS / AWS Control Tower
  • Landing Zone 
  • AWS Organizations, organizational units, SCPs, IAM Identity Center, AWS Config, & AWS CloudTrail
  • EC2
  • S3
  • VPC
  • IAM
  • Lambda
  • API Gateway
  • EKS
  • ECS/Fargate
  • RDS
  • CloudWatch
  • Splunk
  • SNOW

Development & Automation

  • Python
  • GitLab
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • AWS CDK
  • CloudFormation
  • REST APIs
  • Reusable service enablement modules, account baseline automation, & automated configuration validation

AI & Machine Learning

  • Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, and Observability
  • SageMaker
  • Generative AI
  • Prompt Engineering
  • AI/ML Workflows
  • Agent-Based Solutions

Enterprise Tools

  • ServiceNow
  • Jira
  • Confluence

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related roles, including demonstrated hands-on ownership and engineering of a shared, enterprise-wide AWS platform supporting multiple accounts and application teams. Experience must include platform-level configuration, governance, automation, lifecycle management, and operational support. Experience limited to developing, deploying, or supporting applications within an existing AWS environment does not meet this requirement.
  • Deep hands-on experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting AWS Control Tower in an enterprise multi-account environment; practical experience with landing zone lifecycle management, Account Factory, account enrollment, organizational units, controls, and drift remediation is required.
  • Demonstrated experience enabling AWS services for enterprise use, including technical evaluation, architecture and security review, automated deployment patterns, testing, documentation, and operational readiness—not solely deploying services for individual applications.
  • Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, including the purpose and integration considerations of Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, and Observability, and an understanding of platform responsibilities versus application-owned agent logic.
  • Strong Python development and automation skills.
  • Experience building and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with AI and Machine Learning technologies and platforms.
  • Strong understanding of AWS architecture, cloud networking, security, and multi-account governance, including AWS Organizations, SCPs, IAM Identity Center, least-privilege access, AWS Config, and AWS CloudTrail.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.

Nice-to-haves: 

  • Hands-on experience implementing or piloting Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, including secure tool/API connectivity, identity integration, deployment automation, and agent monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, or Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise cloud platforms, including AWS Control Tower adoption, landing zone migrations or upgrades, and automated account customization.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 products and collaboration platforms.
  • AWS certifications such as: AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, or AWS Machine Learning Specialty

Requisition #: 76584

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on a PPLI Client Experience Specialist to support the Retail Solutions business in a work from home environment.

Background Details
As a PPLI Client Experience Specialist, you will manage the end-to-end administration of the Private Placement Life Insurance (PPLI) policy life cycle, including new business and case management, forms management, policy issuance, policy delivery, post-issue transactions, incoming requests and inquiries, and the death claim process. Serving as a key point of contact for PPLI Sales, Underwriting, Product, specialty brokers, and other business partners, you will guide stakeholders through case requirements, status updates, and next steps while ensuring new business submissions are accurate, complete, and compliant.

In partnership with Underwriting and Product teams, you will support case approvals, policy issuance, IDF implementation, planning, and funding activities. You will also support operational functions across PPLI and Executive Benefits products (COLI, BOLI, and ICOLI) by processing premium payments, renewals, fund transfers, and related transactions. Additionally, you will maintain PPLI forms and coordinate regulatory updates with Compliance, Legal, and State Filing teams, resolve service and reporting issues, identify operational risks and process improvement opportunities, take the lead on defining workflows and maintaining procedures and reporting, and contribute to departmental initiatives that enhance efficiency, service delivery, and business outcomes.

This is a collaborative, fast-paced role where priorities can change quickly, and success depends on building strong relationships with sophisticated brokers and quickly learning complex life insurance products and investment options. If this sounds like a role for you, please read on!

What you'll be doing

  • You will own the end-to-end PPLI policy life cycle, from new business and case management and policy issuance through all post-issue transaction processing and incoming requests and inquiries, to the death claim process, while building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with sophisticated brokers, distribution partners, underwriters, and key internal stakeholders.
  • You will serve as a primary point of contact for PPLI Sales, Underwriting, Product, specialty brokers, and other partners, providing clear, proactive guidance on case requirements, status, and next steps.
  • You will review new business submissions for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established requirements and resolve routine discrepancies before advancing cases.
  • You will collaborate with Underwriting to support case approval and complete policy issuance activities within the new business platform. You will also coordinate with Product and other partners to support IDF implementation, planning, funding, and related case activities.
  • You will maintain PPLI forms and coordinate updates with Compliance, Legal, and State Filing to support timely and accurate regulatory submissions.
  • You will perform assigned PPLI post-issue and Executive Benefits operational activities, including premium payments, renewals, fund transfers, and related transactions.
  • You will research and resolve challenging but well-defined service, transaction, and reporting issues using established procedures, reports, and available resources, escalating exceptions as appropriate.
  • You will identify case-level risks, financial implications, process gaps, or service concerns and communicate findings and recommend next steps to appropriate partners.
  • You will lead process improvement by identifying efficiencies, defining workflows, maintaining and updating procedures, and producing reporting, while also contributing to team projects and supporting the implementation of departmental and enterprise changes.
  • You will stay flexible and collaborative in a fast-paced, changing environment, reprioritizing and pivoting quickly as case needs and business priorities shift.

What we’re looking for

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's)
  • 1+ Years of experience in a client-, broker-, or partner-facing role in a service, operations, or case management environment; life insurance new business/case management experience is a plus but not required
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with sophisticated brokers
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and multitask while maintaining strict attention to detail, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities change quickly
  • Ability to evaluate information and data trends, solve challenging but non-complex problems, apply sound judgment to draw conclusions and act effectively in situations with limited standardization.
  • Interest in process and continuous improvement, with the ability to define workflows, document procedures, and create reporting
  • Ability to learn complex life insurance products and related investment options quickly
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).  

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through November 30, 2026, subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

The Role at a Glance

The position is for a Lead Identity Infrastructure Engineer with experience designing, managing, securing, monitoring and supporting enterprise identity infrastructure, with primary emphasis on Active Directory, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Entra ID Application Registrations and related Domain Services technologies.

Responsibilities of this role include Active Directory architecture and lifecycle management; forest, domain and trust management; Certificate Services and Keyfactor integrations; operational monitoring and alerting; resilience, recovery and security hardening; and expert recommendations and guidance for Microsoft Entra ID application registrations and authentication strategies.

This role partners with Security, Enterprise Architecture, infrastructure teams and application owners to deliver compliant authentication and directory solutions. The role also supports, automation, high severity incident resolution, modern authentication patterns such as SAML and OAuth, and secure support for legacy authentication where required.

What you'll be doing

  • Serve as a technical expert for the architecture, engineering, administration and operational health of enterprise Active Directory and Domain Services.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and strategy recommendations for projects involving Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID application registrations, covering both legacy and modern authentication methods.
  • Demonstrate deep technical expertise in Public Key Infrastructure, including Keyfactor PKIaaS, certificate templates, enrollment services, certificate lifecycle processes and Keyfactor integrations.
  • Bring an AI agentic mindset to automation, continuous improvement and modernization opportunities that enhance the Domain Services service portfolio.
  • Design, manage and secure Active Directory forests, domains, trusts, sites and services, replication, DNS dependencies and domain controller lifecycle activities.
  • Build and improve monitoring, alerting, health checks and operational dashboards for Active Directory, authentication services and PKI using tools such as Splunk and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Contribute to Active Directory security hardening, identity threat detection and response, privileged access controls, disaster recovery planning and recovery exercises.
  • Lead troubleshooting and incident resolution for complex, high severity Active Directory, EntraID authentication and PKI incidents, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell Desired State Configuration (DSC) and GitLab for infrastructure configuration, source control, and automation.
  • Work closely with Security and Enterprise Architecture to design enterprise compliant, resilient and supportable identity solutions.
  • Develop and implement PowerShell based automation to improve security, consistency, monitoring and operational efficiency.
  • Partner and guide cross functional teams, application owners and Managed Service Providers to integrate and support authentication and directory services.
  • Provide advanced support for Microsoft Entra application registrations, enterprise applications, OAuth, OpenID Connect and SAML integrations as needed.
  • Create and maintain architecture, operational and recovery documentation and share knowledge with the team.
  • Build\Present engineered solutions to Architecture and Peer Review Boards.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience managing and supporting enterprise identity services, with deep hands-on experience in Active Directory, PKI, and Entra ID Application Registrations.
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory architecture, including forests, domains, trusts, organizational units, replication, sites and services, DNS dependencies and Group Policy.
  • Advanced experience with enterprise PKI, including Certificate Services, certificate templates, enrollment workflows, certificate lifecycle management and Keyfactor or comparable platforms.
  • Deep experience and understanding of Microsoft Entra ID Application Registrations, Enterprise Applications, EntraID Connect and Microsoft Graph APIs.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM, DNS, Windows Server, certificates and authentication related issues.
  • Expert knowledge of legacy and modern directory and authentication protocols, including LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM, SAML, OAuth and OpenID Connect.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
  • Proven experience with Active Directory security hardening, role based access control, privileged access, forest and domain trust management and secure administration practices.
  • In depth experience with Active Directory disaster recovery, recovery testing and operational resilience planning.
  • Experience designing and operating monitoring, alerting and health validation for directory, authentication and PKI services; Splunk search and dashboard experience is preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate with Agile teams and use Jira and Confluence to track engineering work and maintain technical documentation.
  • 4 Year/bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's)

The Role at a Glance

The Alternative Investment Sales Specialist Account Executive will develop, direct, implement, and maintain a business plan, to achieve sales and growth goals for alternative investments. They will partner closely with key stakeholders across field sales, investment, product management, and marketing in the distribution of alternative investment solutions to retail/HNW advisors and key centers of influence within the Western Region. This individual will leverage their alternative investments expertise and experience in executing critical educational and sales initiatives, aimed at driving adoption of Lincoln’s alternatives solutions among wealth management advisors.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop deep understanding of Lincoln Financial’s Alternatives platform and effectively represent individual solutions, to wealth management firms, advisors and clients, in partnership with Sales team. 
  • Provide subject matter expertise with Alternatives and collaborate with Sales team in organizing and executing fund roadshows and other field engagement routines, with prescribed follow-up activities to drive sales results.
  • Partner with investment, product and distribution teams, along with other key stakeholders, to promote and distribute a wide range of strategies and structures for retail/HNW advisors.
  • Support the development and rationalization of a variety of different types of Alternative Investment marketing collateral and branding initiatives (e.g., presentation decks, educational materials, thought leadership/thematic content).
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape and investor preferences to support product development and positioning in various educational forums, conferences, and other events.
  • Develops and maintains a more complex sales plan to increase sales revenue and market share within alternative investments.
  • Increases penetration in territory of by optimizing and growing relationships in partnership with existing field wholesale team to drive sales at targeted firms.
  • Cultivates, directs, and maintains client relationships within assigned territory’s firms.
  • Increases financial advisors’ awareness and drives adoption of Lincoln's alternative investments products and services within their assigned territory.
  • Partners with Lincoln’s wholesale team to Develop, direct, and execute a sales plan to increase/gain opportunities to introduce Lincoln’s private funds management and other resources to targeted advisors within their assigned territory.
  • Develops a comprehensive understanding of existing/targeted firms/advisors including targeted market segments, how they operate, and/or value proposition(s) and is known by them.
  • Works effectively to support growth of Lincoln's alternative investment offerings to maximize and capitalize on the opportunities to cross sell and penetrate new and existing financial advisors.
  • Conducts firm/advisor meetings to achieve sales targets. (e.g. due diligence meetings, one-on-one meetings, sponsorship and speaking opportunities).
  • Identifies and communicates any potential conflicts regarding Lincoln's alternative investments
  • Adhere to LFDs Culture of Compliance. Comply with LFDs policies and procedures.

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves

  • 3-5+ years experience in alternatives distribution that aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 63 License 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience 
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, identifying the appropriate resources and tools to drive solutions.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a changing work environment

Preferred 

  • MBA/CFA/CAIA
  • FINRA Series 24

The Role at a Glance

This role will provide research & due diligence across Lincoln’s manager-of-managers platform, with an emphasis on fixed income and international equity strategies. They will provide investment expertise and insight regarding the selection, oversight and placement of asset management solutions across Lincoln's product lines.

What you'll be doing

•Functions as a key resource in the selection and oversight of new and existing investment options offered in Lincoln variable life, variable annuity and retirement products.
•Oversees the screening and ongoing evaluation process for new and existing investment options.
•Presents research findings and performance results to internal stakeholders and potentially a broader group of constituents, such as the LVIP Board of Trustees.
•Collaborates with portfolio management teams to provide insight/analysis on the optimal use of multi-asset class investment options within broadly diversified portfolios.
•Conducts regular on-site due diligence visits with investment managers, usually alongside Portfolio Managers, in the selection and ongoing evaluation process to ensure that funds are managed in accordance with the stated investment policies.
•Recommends changes and/or actions, as appropriate, to further the objectives of investment committee(s) and Lincoln’s product lines.
•Provides competitive intelligence, including performing complex analysis and comparisons on an ongoing basis.
•Provides investment research subject matter expertise to various thought leadership research projects.
•Supports relationships with external consultants, asset allocation providers and research firms (e.g. Morningstar, eVestment, etc.).
•Provides consultative services to support sales efforts and training for investment products through regular interaction with sales teams, investment teams, and other internal clients.
•Leads the day-to-day usage of the core analytical tools, both internal and external (e.g. Morningstar), that are used by the Research and Portfolio Management teams.
•Designs and maintains analytics, risk reports, attribution, stress testing, etc. for managed funds in partnership with key internal stakeholders.
•Works closely with portfolio managers, external managers and analytic teams to understand investment portfolios, exposures and risks.
•Key contributor to risk management process across Lincoln's investment business including analyzing fund attribution & fund exposures, derivative exposures & risk, and potential impacts to the variable annuity hedge program, product pricing impacts.
•Contributes to the risk management process, including fund attribution and factor exposures, derivatives exposures and risks, and the potential impacts to Lincoln’s variable annuity hedge program.
•Participates in the relationship management of external asset/investment managers, including optimally leveraging their investment expertise, intellectual capital & best ideas while understanding Lincoln's overall mission & the feasibility of strategies

What we’re looking for

Must haves:


•4 Year/Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) (Minimum Required). 
•5+ Years of experience in manager/fund research & analysis in fixed income, global/international equities, or US equities. 
•Experience in mutual funds.
•Demonstrated expertise in fund industry research and analytical tools (Morningstar Direct, eVestment, or other similar tools).
•Expertise in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint with ability to illustrate complicated information succinctly in slides and charts for the benefit of senior management.
•Demonstrated strength in written and oral communication. Ability to communicate investment concepts to a variety of audiences.
•Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 
•Demonstrates excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and multi-task while maintaining strict attention to detail.
•Demonstrate strong relationship management skills with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. senior management, peers, and business lines).

Nice-to-haves:

•CFA or Progress towards CFA or other professional designations, or willingness to pursue professional designations.
•Familiarity with portfolio construction, asset allocation, modern portfolio theory, risk management and hedging.
•Strong knowledge of capital markets and industry trends.
•Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
•A demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and/or exceeding performance expectations. Work hard and strive for excellence.
•Familiar with AI tools (Copilot / Claude).

The Role at a Glance

The VP, Mergers & Acquisitions helps drive the organization's growth and long-term value creation through mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, reinsurance transactions, and other strategic transactions. Reporting to the Head of M&A, this leader supports the identification, assessment, structuring, execution, and integration of opportunities, ensuring each transaction is evaluated comprehensively for strategic alignment, financial impact, capital and risk considerations, and operational feasibility. With deep expertise in life and annuity reinsurance, this role serves as a trusted partner to senior leadership and to subject matter experts across actuarial, finance, legal, risk, tax, and operations translating complex transactions into executable, operationally sound outcomes that advance Lincoln's strategic priorities.

What you'll be doing

  • Contributes to the M&A function's strategy, goals, and operating approach, supporting alignment with Lincoln's enterprise business plans and strategic initiatives. 
  • Provides M&A thought leadership and technical expertise particularly in life and annuity reinsurance to drive improved financial and business results. 
  • Evaluates complex economic trends and market conditions affecting the financial services and insurance industry to inform short- and long-term M&A strategy. 
  • Supports the end-to-end evaluation of merger, acquisition, divestiture, and reinsurance opportunities, including analysis of the target's business strategy, financial profile, actuarial assumptions, capital implications, technology platform, and organizational fit to identify synergies and risks. 
  • Manages transaction project management across due diligence, financial and capital analysis, scoping, closing, integration, and ongoing transition planning. 
  • Executes deals and negotiates business and economic terms, partnering with legal counsel to finalize reinsurance agreements and related transaction documents. 
  • Evaluates reinsurance structures and counterparties, weighing strategic fit, economics, reserve and capital impacts, operational readiness, counterparty risk, and alignment with enterprise risk tolerances. 
  • Coordinates actuarial, finance, risk, tax, operations, and legal experts to translate transaction objectives into coordinated deal terms, reinsurance provisions, schedules, and supporting documentation. 
  • Leads operational integration by partnering across the enterprise to onboard transactions, operationalize new business and reinsurance arrangements, and transition deals from closing into integrated business operations or ongoing reinsurance administration. 
  • Advises senior leadership on strategic M&A opportunities and how they support enterprise objectives. 
  • Mentors and develops team members, providing guidance, visibility, and growth opportunities across direct and cross-functional reporting relationships. 

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves

  • 12+ Years experience in mergers and acquisitions or corporate development that directly aligns to the specific responsibilities of this position.
  • 5+ Years of senior management experience in a large complex organization including influencing senior management and critical stakeholder responsibility.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, enterprise wide initiatives involving multiple business and functional areas 
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and relationship management skills
  • Ability to adapt quickly, exercise sound judgment, and lead effectively in a changing and highly complex work environment

Nice To-Haves (Preferred)

  • CPA, FSA, or other advanced designations

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking an experienced Director of Customer Experience to lead and scale Customer Experience capabilities across Workplace Solutions. This leader will bring deep, hands-on CX expertise and a demonstrated track record of building mature, repeatable practices that embed customer-centered decision-making across an organization. In this role, you will set the CX strategy and operating model, strengthen governance and measurement, and create the tools, standards, and ways of working that enable teams across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to consistently improve the experience. You will champion the voice of the customer while connecting customer insights and experience improvements to measurable business outcomes, including growth, retention, efficiency, and differentiation.

This is not a role focused solely on journey mapping or Voice of Customer programs. We are looking for a proven CX leader who has helped an organization move from individual projects to an integrated, enterprise-scale CX capability. You will influence senior leaders, develop talent, build cross-functional commitment, and translate customer needs into clear priorities, investment decisions, and sustained change.

What you'll be doing

•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Experience professionals, setting clear expectations and building the strategic, analytical, and influencing capabilities needed to deliver meaningful impact.
•    Define and execute a scalable CX strategy and operating model, including governance, standards, roles, decision rights, prioritization, and cross-functional ways of working.
•    Build and mature the organization's CX capabilities by establishing repeatable methods, tools, training, and frameworks that enable teams to apply customer-centered practices consistently and independently.
•    Partner with senior leaders across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to embed customer needs into business strategy, transformation roadmaps, investment decisions, and solution design.
•    Establish an enterprise approach to journey management that identifies priority journeys, clarifies ownership, connects insights across touchpoints, and drives coordinated improvement over time.
•    Integrate Voice of Customer, research, behavioral and operational data, market intelligence, and employee insights to identify root causes, size opportunities, and inform strategic recommendations.
•    Translate complex customer and business challenges into actionable strategies, business cases, executive-level recommendations, and sequenced roadmaps.
•    Define and monitor a CX measurement framework that connects experience outcomes to business results such as growth, retention, utilization, digital adoption, cost, and operational performance.
•    Drive adoption and accountability through change leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, and capability-building across the organization.
•    Champion the thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies to improve customer outcomes, increase efficiency, and create competitive advantage.

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:
•    5+ years of progressive CX experience, including CX strategy, journey management, customer insights, experience measurement, service design, or related disciplines
•    Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or maturing a CX practice across a complex organization, including establishing operating models, governance, standards, tools, measurement, and cross-functional adoption
•    3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing high-performing teams and leading through influence in a matrixed environment
•    Experience translating customer insights and journey opportunities into enterprise priorities, funded roadmaps, measurable improvements, and business outcomes
•    Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and gain alignment across functions with competing priorities
•    Strong business acumen and the ability to connect CX investments to growth, retention, efficiency, risk reduction, and market differentiation
•    Demonstrated change leadership experience, including building organizational commitment, establishing accountability, and driving sustained adoption of new CX practices
•    Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree)

Nice-to-haves:
•    Recognized Customer Experience certification, such as CCXP, or comparable certification in human-centered design, service design, design thinking, or change management
•    Experience leading CX in financial services, insurance, employee benefits, retirement, or another regulated and complex service environment
•    Working knowledge of Group Benefits and/or Retirement Plans
•    Experience applying AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and operational outcomes

The Role at a Glance

The Financial Reporting Analyst role within the Fund Administration and Operations Team (FAO) assists with the coordination, preparation, and review of SEC financial data filings to ensure they are filed timely and accurately.  This requires a high level of coordination with many internal and external parties at various levels. 

What you'll be doing

•Research accounting guidance for newly developed products and company initiatives related to Lincoln Funds.
•Assure fund administration compliance with the Investment Company Act of 1940 as well as the Securities Acts of 1933 and 1934 and applicable Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
•Work closely with External Auditor in completing financials, formulating new/updating existing disclosures and as a point of escalation with sub-advisers and the Fund Accountant in obtaining audit evidence to ensure final opinions.
•Provide oversight and coordination of internal parties such as Legal, Compliance and Fund Management, including developing and distributing a financial reporting request list, which includes deadlines, and conducting meetings to ensure filings are completed timely and accurately.
•Assist with the preparation of and review of Fund Administration Board Materials.
•Assist with the review of fund expense budgets. 
•Assist with the compilation/review of fund prospectus fee tables.
•Maintain a working knowledge of strategic investment market activities and industry pronouncements and their impact on the Funds as well as Lincoln.
•Stay current with technological innovations, updating administration capabilities and capacity in a cost effective and efficient fashion.
•Participate in departmental or enterprise-wide complex projects assigned by providing stakeholders with actionable and valuable financial reporting information to enable decision-making that results in successful outcomes.
•Enhance organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and/or departmental/enterprise initiatives within assigned areas of responsibility.

What we’re looking for

•5+ Years of experience in Financial Reporting and/or Fund Accounting that aligns with the regulatory requirements of private closed-end funds required.
•Experience with AICPA Audit and Accounting guide, Reg S-X, N1-A and N-2 disclosure requirements preferred.
•Experience working with a third-party administrator and independent audit firms preferred.
•Experience with fund budget reviews. 
•Experience with prospectus fund fee tables.
•4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) (Minimum Required)
•CPA license is preferred
•Experience with Microsoft Co-Pilot or Claude is encouraged
•Demonstrated ability to identify, develop and implement process improvements.
•Demonstrated strong relationship management skills with internal clients (e.g. senior management, peers and colleagues); proven ability to develop creative and collaborative approaches.  
•Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative style.  
•Demonstrates strong project management leadership skills including, critical ability to coordinate and balance multiple projects in a time-sensitive environment, under pressure, and meeting deadlines. 
•Finds common ground and can gain collaboration among senior management, colleagues and peers; can influence outcomes without directing or commanding. 
•Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

The Role at a Glance

We’re looking for a driven and compassionate experienced Long-Term Disability (LTD) Claims Examiners to join our growing team in a 100% remote environment. In this role, you’ll make a meaningful impact—helping individuals navigate some of life’s most challenging moments while delivering fair, timely, and thoughtful claim decisions.

At Lincoln, you’ll partner with some of the most respected clients in the industry, contributing to solutions that set the standard for quality, innovation, and customer experience. You’ll thrive in a high-performance, collaborative environment where your expertise is valued, and your work truly matters. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced team environment, then please read on!

Why should you join our team?

  • Make a meaningful impact – Support individuals through life’s most critical moments by delivering thoughtful, fair, and timely claim decisions.
  • Join a high-performing, respected team – Be part of a collaborative environment known for best-in-class audit performance and operational excellence.
  • Grow your career with purpose – Develop your expertise in a supportive environment that values continuous learning, professional growth, and advancement.
  • Thrive in an innovative environment – Work within a dynamic team that embraces change, drives continuous improvement, and is shaping the future of claims.
 

What you'll be doing

  • You will independently manage a caseload of Long-Term Disability (LTD) claims from intake through resolution, partnering with claimants, employers, and medical professionals via phone and email to gather and assess information related to disability status and applicable state and federal benefits.
  • You will conduct initial and ongoing interviews with claimants to gather key information for claim evaluation, while reviewing medical documentation and partnering with clinical and vocational experts to support informed decisions.
  • You will deliver timely and ethical claim determinations, ensuring consistency with company guidelines and regulatory standards.
  • You will collaborate with case managers, nurse case managers, vocational specialists, and consulting physicians to support appropriate, ethical, and timely claim determinations.
  • You will review complex medical records and leverage a variety of tools and resources to determine appropriate claim durations and guide ongoing action planning throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • You will deliver exceptional customer service by proactively identifying needs and opportunities, while building strong relationships with claimants, employers, and internal partners.

What we’re looking for

Must-have experience (Required):

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking a Lead Actuary to join our Variable Annuity (VA) and Registered Index-Linked Annuity (RILA) Valuation team. In this role, you will produce monthly and quarterly valuations for Lincoln’s VA and RILA blocks while partnering with internal stakeholders to analyze results and gain insights. You will also provide support to various actuarial modernization and automation projects.

What you'll be doing

•Produce VA and RILA financial reporting results, including statutory reserve and capital under VM-21 and market risk benefits (MRBs) under GAAP LDTI.
•Develop expertise in modeling, automation, and visualization tools used in valuation processes.
•Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and regulatory standards.
•Build new tools and processes that provide deeper insight into VA and RILA valuations.
•Support existing automation efforts to increase efficiency, reduce the potential for error, and improve presentation of results.
•Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across Lincoln, including Accounting, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Market Risk Management (MRM), Model Development, Pricing, Audit, ERM, Investments, Capital Management, and the Qualified Actuary team.

What we’re looking for

•4-year/Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (minimum required)
•5-7+ years of actuarial experience with actuarial credentials (FSA or ASA with additional years of experience)
•Substantial knowledge of annuity products
•Experience with actuarial modeling software (e.g., GGY-AXIS) and data automation and visualization tools (e.g., Dataiku, Tableau)
•Strong execution and time management skills, with a record of producing high-quality work and meeting deadlines
•Self-starter with ability to work independently and demonstrated accountability

The Role at a Glance

As the STAT Financial Reporting Analyst you will play an important role in supporting the accuracy and integrity of the organization’s statutory financial reporting. You will analyze and prepare complex statutory financial statements, regulatory filings, and supporting schedules while applying your knowledge of statutory accounting principles and NAIC requirements. You will help prepare audited financial statements. You will also research technical accounting and regulatory matters, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and help ensure reporting requirements are met accurately and effectively.

What you'll be doing

  • Prepares and/or reviews more complex quarterly and annual Statutory NAIC financial statements, supporting schedules, and other regulatory filings. 
  • Reviews, analyzes, and reports on more complex statutory financial statements and supporting schedules in accordance with accounting and reporting calendars. 
  • Participates in the accounting close, including the preparation and review of more complex journal entries, account reconciliations, and statutory reporting adjustments. 
  • Conducts more complex financial analysis by legal entity in partnership with internal business team.
  • Identifies and researches more complex reporting issues arising from the application of statutory accounting principles, NAIC guidance, and other regulatory requirements, and assesses their applicability to assigned areas of responsibility. 
  • Provides more complex support with the coordination of MAR control and regulatory testing to comply with key controls developed for the group. 
  • Promotes and enhances organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and/or departmental/enterprise initiatives within assigned area(s) of responsibility.

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, or financial analysis that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities of this role, including statutory reporting experience 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Working knowledge of statutory accounting principles, NAIC reporting requirements, and insurance financial reporting 
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and close attention to detail, with the ability to research and communicate complex reporting matters 
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, the ability to work collaboratively, and the ability to adapt quickly while meeting reporting deadlines in a changing work environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • CPA or CPA Eligibility Certification

The Role at a Glance

As part of the AI PMO team, this position serves as the Program Manager is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional programs that deliver enterprise data platforms, data products, artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities, and the engineering foundations required to operate them securely, reliably, and at scale. 

The role translates strategic priorities and technical roadmaps into executable plans; coordinates delivery across the AI, Data and Analytics team (AIDA) ; and establishes the governance, transparency, and delivery discipline needed to manage scope, dependencies, resources, risks, and measurable outcomes from discovery through production adoption. Hands-on proficiency with Jira is essential.

What you'll be doing

Program Leadership

  • Leads the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex AI, data, and engineering programs, including data platforms, analytics products, AI/ML solutions, APIs, integrations, and cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Partners with engineering leaders, architects, product managers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to define program scope, priorities, success measures, and delivery approaches.
  • Translates product, architecture, and technology roadmaps into integrated program plans with clear milestones, dependencies, resource needs, and release targets.
  • Facilitates program operating rhythms, including planning sessions, dependency reviews, risk discussions, release readiness assessments, and executive updates.

Technical Program Management

  • Develops sufficient technical understanding to participate credibly in architecture and engineering discussions, identify risks, surface delivery gaps, and communicate tradeoffs.
  • Identifies, analyzes, and drives resolution of program risks, issues, and dependencies, including data quality, environment readiness, infrastructure, security, governance, and competing engineering priorities.
  • Coordinates delivery activities across software development, cybersecurity, architecture, privacy, data governance, AI governance, change management, and release management functions.
  • Drives release and production readiness across teams, including testing, deployment planning, adoption activities, support readiness, and post-implementation reviews.

Jira, Delivery Excellence & Communication

  • Uses Jira as the primary system of record for program execution, maintaining visibility into work, dependencies, releases, delivery progress, and program health.
  • Establishes delivery standards for backlog management, estimation, ownership, status reporting, dependency tracking, and release planning.
  • Produces clear communications and reporting for technical teams and senior leaders, including status updates, dashboards, roadmaps, risk summaries, and recommendations.
  • Improves program delivery practices by standardizing workflows, reporting, governance routines, and tools that increase transparency, quality, and execution speed.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's)
  • 5 – 7+ Years experience in Project/Program Management that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position 
  • Strong understanding of software development, engineering delivery, data platforms, analytics solutions, cloud technologies, or AI/ML implementations.
  • Experience using Jira for planning, execution, dependency management, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and drive alignment across technical and business teams.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills

The Role at a Glance

The Director, ServiceNow Platform provides operational leadership and direction for the organization's ServiceNow platform and related application support functions. This position is accountable for delivering on priorities, managing team performance, and ensuring results for the assigned area of responsibility. The Director leads the operational framework to support business objectives and digital transformation initiatives. This role collaborates with technology and business leaders to identify opportunities for platform optimization, automation, and service improvement while ensuring scalability, security, compliance, and operational performance. The Director leads a team of experienced technology professionals and/or first-level leaders and provides direction for complex implementation, application support, vendor management, and service delivery initiatives. 

What you'll be doing

  • Establishes and implements priorities, performance goals, and operating plans for the ServiceNow platform and application support function. 
  • Leads a team of experienced technology professionals and/or first-level leaders, with accountability for team performance, talent development, and results. 
  • Hires and retains talent and provides coaching, performance feedback, training, and stretch opportunities to build organizational capability. 
  • Performs project coordination and business analysis on key strategic initiatives; writes requirements for and coordinates with technical resources to deliver and test those requirements.
  • Leads agile ceremonies and identifies maturity opportunities around ways of working.
  • Executes the strategy, product roadmap, governance model, and standards for the ServiceNow platform and related application portfolio. 
  • Collaborates with technology and business leaders to identify, assess, and prioritize opportunities for digital transformation, automation, and enterprise service optimization. 
  • Directs the design, implementation, support, and optimization of ServiceNow capabilities, including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and other applicable modules. 
  • Ensures platform solutions meet complex business, technical, security, compliance, scalability, and operational requirements. 
  • Provides inputs regarding platform investments, architecture, vendor strategy, risk, and business outcomes. 
  • Directs the resolution of complex platform, application support, service delivery, and stakeholder escalation issues through completion. 
  • Evaluates risks related to time, cost, scope, quality, security, and delivery and ensures appropriate mitigation plans are developed and implemented. 
  • Provides inputs on the budget, licensing strategy, resource plan, vendor relationships, contracts, and expenses for the assigned area of responsibility. 
  • Establishes performance measures and monitors platform health, delivery outcomes, service performance, and progress toward established objectives and key results. 
  • Evaluates emerging ServiceNow capabilities, technologies, and industry practices and recommends opportunities to improve business value and operational efficiency. 
  • Leads cross-functional teams in the delivery of complex enterprise platform initiatives and transformation programs. 
  • Maintains knowledge of current and emerging trends, assesses their potential impact, and collaborates with management to incorporate relevant developments into current and future strategies. 

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves:

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 
  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture, enterprise platform management, application support, or technology leadership that directly aligns with the responsibilities of this position, including 3+ years of managerial, supervisory, and/or demonstrated leadership experience. 
  • Demonstrated experience with ServiceNow platform administration, development, architecture, implementation, support, and/or governance in a complex enterprise environment. 
  • Demonstrated experience executing technology strategies, architecture roadmaps, governance frameworks, and operating models. 
  • Experience leading ServiceNow implementations or optimization efforts involving ITSM, ITOM, Customer Service Management (CSM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), or other applicable modules. 
  • Experience managing technology vendors, licensing agreements, platform investments, budgets, contracts, and resource plans.
  • At least one ServiceNow Certification: Certified System Administrator, ServiceNow Certified Application Developer, or comparable ServiceNow certification.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or higher. 

 

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 
  • ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA). 
  • ITIL Managing Professional or Strategic Leader certification. 
  • Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) certification. 
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. 
  • Experience leading enterprise digital transformation, automation, or platform modernization initiatives within a large, complex organization. 
  • Experience establishing platform governance, operating models, and service management best practices at an enterprise scale.

The Role at a Glance

The VP, Legal Counsel M&A and Reinsurance will play a key role in advancing Lincoln’s strategic priorities by providing legal counsel across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, reinsurance transactions, and other strategic initiatives. This leader will guide transactions from structuring and due diligence through negotiation, execution, and integration, partnering closely with executive leadership, Finance, business leaders, and other key stakeholders. As a trusted advisor, they will help shape transaction strategy, navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations, mitigate risk, and deliver practical solutions that support business objectives.

This role is ideal for a highly experienced transactional attorney who brings strong business judgment, executive presence, and the ability to lead sophisticated negotiations while influencing decisions across the organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Responsible for all legal aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and reinsurance transactions, including structuring, negotiation, due diligence, and execution.
  • Provides strategic legal counsel to executive leadership and other stakeholders on transaction risks, regulatory and compliance implications, negotiation strategy, and complex deal structures.
  • Leads complex negotiations with external counterparties, regulators, and partners, representing the company in high-impact transactions.
  • Partners cross-functionally with Finance, business unit leaders, and other SME(s) in developing and executing legal strategy.
  • Proactively evaluates evolving regulatory and competitive landscapes, as well as developments and trends in applicable practice areas, and adapts legal advice accordingly.
  • Advises on integration and separation activities, ensuring legal risks are identified, mitigated, and managed effectively.
  • Develops and maintains key external relationships, including external counsel and trade/industry groups.
  • Provides legal counsel as needed on enterprise contracts involving the acquisition of goods and services, including software-as-a-service and outsourcing

What we’re looking for

Must-Haves

  • 12+ Years experience in M&A and strategic transactions, including 3+ years of law firm experience focused on insurance M&A and reinsurance.
  • J.D. from an American Bar Association approved law school
  • Demonstrated ability to support complex, enterprise-wide initiatives involving multiple business and functional areas
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and relationship management skills
  • Proximity or willingness to travel to Radnor, PA

Job.JobDescription:
Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Hartford, CT (Connecticut); Omaha, NE (Nebraska)

The Role at a Glance

The Actuarial Development Program (ADP) at Lincoln Financial is an industry-leading program that demonstrates Lincoln Financial’s commitment to creating highly qualified business leaders. As an ADP participant, you’ll be able to explore your unique interests while developing the essential actuarial, technical, management, communication, and leadership skills you need to succeed. The Actuarial Development Program includes a series of rotations, typically every 18-24 months. For each rotation, roles are available in different business areas including Life and Annuities, Retirement and Group Protection. Experience gained will enable participants to become well-rounded actuaries with knowledge that may include Product Development, Pricing, Reinsurance, Inforce Management, Valuation, Financial Projections, Risk Management, Financial Planning & Analysis, Financial Strategy & Management, Appointed Actuary, Experience Studies, Modeling and Data Analytics & Actuarial Transformation.


ADP participants are expected to pass the Society of Actuaries’ exams at a prescribed pace. The program is designed to support you as you work towards your FSA and provide the training and resources necessary to become a well-rounded actuarial leader.

Additional Program Highlights:

•Highly competitive compensation package with salary increases and bonuses upon successful exam completion
•Social and training opportunities to enhance skills, network with ADP participants and build long-lasting industry relationships
•Dedicated leaders and mentors to assist with career development
•Work with actuarial and data science software and technologies including MG-ALFA, Axis, Prophet, Dataiku, R, and Tableau
•Generous study time allowances for each exam session
•Payment and/or reimbursement of actuarial exam fees, materials, review courses, and seminars taken during the program


We’re excited to bring on an Senior Associate Actuarial Analyst, Assumption Governance, to own the review and documentation of assumption proposals, approvals, implementations and impacts. This role offers a unique view into the assumptions that drive profitability across Life business, and it is a strong fit for someone who enjoys diving into the details of model inputs, taking on ad hoc projects, and collaborating across teams. 

What you'll be doing

•Manage and maintain documentation of Life new business assumptions, including regular updates, version control, documentation of changes.
•Partner with the Pricing team to understand, review and refine model (MG-ALFA) input assumptions. 
•Coordinate assumption updates with cross-functional teams and confirm that the latest approved assumptions are reflected in the assumptions
•Develop tools and process improvements to make assumption maintenance and validation more efficient and controlled
•Support ad hoc data analysis and projects as priorities evolve

What we’re looking for

•Minimum of 4 actuarial exams passed
•1 to 4+ years of actuarial experience
•1 prior actuarial rotation
•Working knowledge of MG-ALFA
•Strong technical skills (Microsoft Office suite)
•Self-motivated with high level of integrity, strong problem-solving skills, and the capability of working independently
•Ability to quickly learn and apply new skills and information
•Collaborative, with the ability to build effective relationships across teams
•Strong written and verbal communication skills
•Experience with Tableau, SQL and Python is a plus

The Role at a Glance

We are creating a new AI/ML Ops pillar to own the reliability, safety, and cost-effectiveness of every model, pipeline, and agent we run in production. This is fundamentally an operations leadership role: someone who has built monitoring, escalation, and change management discipline from the ground up during a technology or business transformation, and who can apply that same rigor to AI/ML systems. This leader will build and run the function that closes the gap between "built" and "running well at scale." They will report to the Chief Data & AI Engineering Officer and sit alongside the leaders of AI/Data Infrastructure, Data Strategy & Governance, Data & Delivery Platform, AI/ML/Agentic Engineering, and AI Native Intelligence Platform.

What you'll be doing

Operating Foundation & Change Management

  • Define the operating model for how AI/ML systems move from build to production: intake, change approval, release governance.
  • Build change management processes for model, pipeline, and agent releases, including change advisory review, risk tiering, rollback authority, and communication protocols.
  • Establish a clear ownership and accountability model (RACI) across Engineering, Ops, and Governance for every production AI/ML asset. 

Monitoring, Observability & Notifications

  • Build monitoring for performance, drift, latency, quality, and safety across production AI/ML systems.
  • Design the notification and alerting architecture: what gets flagged, to whom, at what severity, with what SLA for acknowledgment.
  • Implement in-production evals and guardrails; enforce governance policy at runtime in partnership with Data Strategy & Governance.

Incident Response & Escalation Management

  • Define and own SLOs/SLAs for production models, pipelines, and agents.
  • Build on-call rotations, incident response, escalation tiers, and postmortem practice for AI/ML systems.
  • Own the detection and escalation path for misuse, abuse, or safety incidents.
  • Drive mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-recovery down as the estate scales.

Deployment & Lifecycle Governance

  • Partner with Platform Engineering to stand up CI/CD, versioning, and rollback for models, pipelines, and agents, partnering with Engineering on execution.
  • Establish safe rollout patterns (canary, shadow, staged) in partnership with Engineering.
  • Own the retirement and deprecation process for models and agents no longer in use.

Cost & Capacity

  • Own inference and compute cost visibility and optimization; build unit economics per model and agent.
  • Partner with AI/Data Infrastructure on capacity planning. Organization Building
  • Define the operating model, team structure, and hiring plan for the pillar.
  • Build the feedback loop that routes production failure modes and cost signals back to Engineering.
  • Establish the pillar's KPIs and report on them to the Chief Data & AI Engineering Officer and broader leadership.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven track record leading operations through a major transformation: building the operating model, monitoring and observability foundation, and escalation discipline for a function that didn't have one before, ideally in technology, platform, or shared-services operations.
  • Deep experience in change management: standing up change advisory processes, risk tiering, release governance, and rollback authority in a fast-moving technical environment.
  • Strong background in monitoring, observability, and notification and escalation design: knowing what to alert on, who gets paged, and how severity and ownership are defined.
  • Experience building incident response and postmortem practices, including on-call rotations and MTTD/MTTR reduction, in any production technology environment. AI/ML-specific experience is a strong plus, not a prerequisite.
  • Working knowledge of (or demonstrated ability to quickly learn) ML/LLM system failure modes: drift, degradation, hallucination, latency and cost blowups, and how to instrument against them.
  • Experience partnering with governance and risk functions to enforce policy in live systems.
  • Strong track record hiring, developing, and leading technical or operational teams, ideally from an early stage.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from scratch, not just running an existing playbook.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics (AIDA) organization is building the capabilities required for an AI-enabled business. Within AIDA, Data Strategy & Governance turns priority insurance and retirement use cases into governed, reusable data products and services. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI-native platform teams, with governance built into the product.

This role will build and operate the data and service components behind Lincoln's priority AI-ready data products. You will use Python and SQL to connect legacy sources, implement transformations and agent-facing interfaces, encode defined business rules, and make testing, lineage, and provenance part of the build. You will learn from senior engineers and business experts while taking increasing ownership of production work.                                                     

What you'll be doing

  • Build ingestion, transformation, and curated data models using SQL, Python, and approved AWS services.
  • Build and maintain FastAPI and Pydantic services and Model Context Protocol tools with clear schemas, validation, error handling, and documentation.
  • Turn source mappings and defined business rules into tested logic; work with business experts to clarify definitions and exceptions.
  • Write unit, integration, contract, reconciliation, and data-quality tests using pytest, mocks, and reusable fixtures.
  • Deploy through GitLab CI/CD or comparable pipelines; use logs, metrics, traces, and runbooks to support production workloads.
  • Capture metadata, lineage, provenance, and access requirements as part of the definition of done.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, plus typically 1 to 3 years of relevant experience or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Hands-on Python and SQL, with a solid grasp of joins, keys, data types, and foundational data modeling.
  • Working experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, and testable Python design.
  • Experience building or extending a Model Context Protocol server or a comparable agent-facing tool interface, plus working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, and a cloud data environment.
  • Ability to learn an unfamiliar business domain quickly, explain implementation choices clearly, and handle sensitive data with care. 

Nice to Haves

  • AWS Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, IAM, Lambda, ECS, or comparable services.
  • Dbt, Apache Airflow or Amazon MWAA, Spark, or comparable data-engineering technologies.
  • Document ingestion, classification, retrieval or RAG data preparation, or experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.

Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics (AIDA) organization is building the capabilities required for an AI-enabled business. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI-native platform teams, with governance built into the product.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you wil lead the end-to-end technical direction and delivery of complex AI-ready data products. You will connect priority business and AI use cases to the data capabilities beneath them, including shared meaning, rules, quality, lineage, secure access, and reusable services. You will also lead hands-on graph and GraphRAG delivery where relationships and unstructured knowledge matter, while choosing simpler relational, search, or rules-based patterns when they fit better.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead discovery with business and product owners, domain experts, stewards, source owners, and partner AIDA pillars to define the questions, actions, outcomes, product boundaries, and accountable owners.
  • Design the product's canonical and consumer models, ontology and semantic layer, business rules, contracts, interfaces, quality controls, metadata, lineage, provenance, and secure access.
  • Design and build graph models in Amazon Neptune or comparable technology, including entities, relationships, effective dates, rules, provenance, SPARQL queries, and performance tuning.
  • Implement GraphRAG and hybrid graph-vector retrieval, including ingestion, entity and relationship extraction, embeddings, graph enrichment, filtering, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
  • Design and build AWS source-to-product pipelines and agent-facing APIs or Model Context Protocol interfaces using fit-for-purpose lakehouse, orchestration, transformation, and infrastructure-as-code patterns.
  • Evaluate graph, relational, vector, search, and rules-based approaches against representative questions, expected evidence, answer quality, latency, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  • Lead a blended delivery pod through production readiness, code and design review, incident prevention, partner knowledge transfer, and reusable patterns that avoid unnecessary complexity and lock-in.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves:

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, plus typically 5 or more years of relevant experience with ownership of complex production data systems or products.
  • Substantial hands-on experience building and operating graph solutions with Amazon Neptune or comparable technology, including graph modeling, SPARQL, query analysis, and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on implementation of GraphRAG or comparable hybrid graph-vector retrieval, including ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
  • Advanced Python and SQL, plus strong AWS data-platform experience, orchestration, data modeling, distributed processing, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
  • Proven ability to translate a business capability into semantics, rules, contracts, controls, interfaces, and measurable evaluations, and to lead architecture decisions through influence while contributing hands-on.
  • Ownership of quality, lineage, privacy, access, observability, recovery, and production operations for sensitive or regulated data.

Nice to Haves:

  • Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, MLflow, or comparable production AI and retrieval services.
  • Model Context Protocol design, authorization propagation, agent evaluation and observability, ontologies, entity resolution, feature stores, or knowledge-graph governance.
  • Deep insurance or financial-services experience and technical leadership across employees, contractors, consultants, or managed-service teams.

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

The Role at a Glance

About AIDA Data Strategy and Governance
Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics (AIDA) organization is building the capabilities required for an AI-enabled business. Within AIDA, Data Strategy & Governance turns priority insurance and retirement use cases into governed, reusable data products and services. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI-native platform teams, with governance built into the product.

In this role, you will build and operate the data and service components behind Lincoln's priority AI-ready data products. You will use Python and SQL to connect legacy sources, implement transformations and agent-facing interfaces, encode defined business rules, and make testing, lineage, and provenance part of the build. You will learn from senior engineers and business experts while taking increasing ownership of production work.

What you'll be doing

  • Work with product owners, data owners, stewards, and business experts to define the decisions the product must support, its authoritative sources, common terms, rules, and ownership.
  • Design the product slice, including models, keys, effective-date logic, exceptions, data contracts, API and Model Context Protocol contracts, and versioning.
    Build and operate pipelines, dbt models, FastAPI and Pydantic services, and agent-facing tools using SQL, Python, orchestration, and approved AWS services.
  • Embed quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, privacy, and security into the product, with tests and evaluations that prove source-to-response correctness and traceability.
  • Own deployment and operation through CI/CD, observability, incident response, root-cause fixes, backfills, and recovery procedures.
  • Review code, coach Associate engineers, integrate partner contributions, and turn proven solutions into reusable team patterns.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, plus typically 3 to 5 years of relevant experience or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Production experience with Python, SQL, FastAPI, Pydantic, asynchronous programming, packaging, and automated testing.
  • Hands-on experience developing, deploying, and operating Model Context Protocol servers or comparable agent-facing tool interfaces. 
  • Experience with AWS data services, orchestration, dbt or comparable transformation tooling, CI/CD, Git-based review, and production troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to turn ambiguous business definitions and expert rules into durable models, contracts, controls, and tested logic, and to own a sensitive production capability with limited supervision.

Nice to Haves

  • AWS Lake Formation, Glue, Athena, IAM, Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, Airflow or MWAA, and infrastructure as code.
  • Semantic modeling, ontology, graph or vector data, hybrid retrieval, document ingestion, Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or agent evaluation. Insurance or financial-services workflows, or experience making contractor, consultant, or other-team deliverables supportable.

Application Deadline
