Job.JobTitle: Sr. Director, Internal Consulting, Op Model Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
We are seeking a Sr. Director of Internal Consulting to lead central initiatives for Aon. The role starts with building and carrying out a multi-year strategic overhaul of our Operating Model. Reporting to the leadership team of Aon Business Services (ABS), this role leads internal consulting and program management teams. It involves crafting, orchestrating, and scaling the transformation of the enterprise operating model at Aon. The goal is to improve how we deliver value to clients, colleagues, and other interested parties. This role will engage with senior leaders across Solution Lines, Regions, and Functions. It will also lead a cross‑functional group of internal advisors, project managers, and subject matter experts to deliver measurable performance outcomes. This role is open to a Virtual or Hybrid colleague based in Central or Eastern Time Zone. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Vision Partner with ABS leadership as well as business leaders, key collaborators, and cross-functional partners to advance the vision, objectives, and scope related to operating model transformation efforts Translate strategic priorities into a clear transformation roadmap with defined business outcomes, benchmarks, and value realization targets Apply structured consulting methodologies (e.g., problem framing, analytical reasoning, benchmarking, argument development) to advise recommendations Develop and validate arguments for operating model changes, including financial, operational, and qualitative benefits Operating Model Design & Alignment Lead the end‑to‑end diagnostic, build and transition of the target operating model across Aon’s Business Units, geographic areas, and departments Translate enterprise strategy into detailed organizational framework components, including capabilities, organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, governance models, and cross functional interaction patterns Be responsible for phased implementation, including pilots, scaling strategies, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with regional and solution line needs Build and maintain operating model blueprints, ensuring all components (capability models, interaction models, RACIs, team structures, decision rights, important metrics) integrate across the enterprise Stakeholder Engagement & Program Leadership Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives. Provide insight on opportunities, trade-offs, and risks related to the operating model. Ensure agreement and engagement in strategy and roadmap. Shape and deliver a compelling change narrative that articulates the “why,” “what,” and “how” of the transformation for different audiences Work closely with executive sponsors and the PMO to establish and maintain robust governance, decision‑making, and blocking issue mechanisms Partner with Change & Communications teams to define implications of design changes, highlight required behavior shifts, and identify points of resistance or adoption needs Facilitate executive and working‑level forums to align decisions, resolve conflicts, and maintain momentum People Leadership & Capability Building Recruit, develop, and mentor a high‑performing team members with capabilities in strategy, transformation, operations, change, and analytics Lead a team of internal consultants and business analysts to diagnose current‑state challenges, define solutions, and support implementation Build consulting capabilities within the broader organization by sharing methodologies, tools, and guidelines Promote a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement Bring together and embed lessons learned into subsequent waves of organizational build changes Skills and experience that will lead to success Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, or related field; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) strongly preferred Proven experience in management consulting, internal strategy/consulting or equivalent internal consulting function, including significant experience at the Director level or above Demonstrated experience leading sophisticated, multi‑workstream operating model or large‑scale transformation programs in a global, matrixed organization, including design, process transition and governance framework setup Experience working in or with professional services, insurance, or financial services environments is highly desirable Skills & Competencies Demonstrated ability to build and coach high‑performing, complementary teams and work effectively across cultures and geographies Ability to operate as a generalist across strategy development, organizational framework building, and execution support Ability to roll up the sleeves and problem solve Strong strategic and conceptual abilities; able to connect enterprise strategy to detailed building and implementation Expertise in building operating frameworks, process re‑engineering, and organizational development Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills, including experience engaging C‑suite and senior executives Outstanding ability to present complex topics clearly and build engaging narratives and materials Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities; comfortable with data, financial modeling, and performance metrics Growth mindset toward emerging technologies, with the ability to incorporate AI into daily work and support others in embracing new digital tools with confidence and ease. Proficiency in MS For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $225,000 to $275,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans in addition to base salary. The amount of any incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-CB1 #LI- Executive 2580694

Shape and deliver a compelling change narrative that articulates the “why,” “what,” and “how” of the transformation for different audiences Work closely with executive sponsors and the PMO to establish and maintain robust governance, decision‑making, and blocking issue mechanisms Partner with Change & Communications teams to define implications of design changes, highlight required behavior shifts, and identify points of resistance or adoption needs Facilitate executive and working‑level forums to align decisions, resolve conflicts, and maintain momentum People Leadership & Capability Building Recruit, develop, and mentor a high‑performing team members with capabilities in strategy, transformation, operations, change, and analytics Lead a team of internal consultants and business analysts to diagnose current‑state challenges, define solutions, and support implementation Build consulting capabilities within the broader organization by sharing methodologies, tools, and guidelines Promote a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement Bring together and embed lessons learned into subsequent waves of organizational build changes Skills and experience that will lead to success Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, or related field; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) strongly preferred Proven experience in management consulting, internal strategy/consulting or equivalent internal consulting function, including significant experience at the Director level or above Demonstrated experience leading sophisticated, multi‑workstream operating model or large‑scale transformation programs in a global, matrixed organization, including design, process transition and governance framework setup Experience working in or with professional services, insurance, or financial services environments is highly desirable Skills & Competencies Demonstrated ability to build and coach high‑performing, complementary teams and work effectively across cultures and geographies Ability to operate as a generalist across strategy development, organizational framework building, and execution support Ability to roll up the sleeves and problem solve Strong strategic and conceptual abilities; able to connect enterprise strategy to detailed building and implementation Expertise in building operating frameworks, process re‑engineering, and organizational development Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills, including experience engaging C‑suite and senior executives Outstanding ability to present complex topics clearly and build engaging narratives and materials Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities; comfortable with data, financial modeling, and performance metrics Growth mindset toward emerging technologies, with the ability to incorporate AI into daily work and support others in embracing new digital tools with confidence and ease. Proficiency in MS For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon Is Looking for a Senior Associate Consultant, Executive Compensation, Rewards Solutions Aon's Rewards Solutions, is the industry leader, providing advice and benchmarking to companies to address their toughest HR and rewards challenges: attracting, engaging and retaining talent! Our advisors provide industry-specific expertise, applying an analytical approach that integrates market data, trends and our experience in working with nearly 2,000 companies – from Global 1000 firms to start-ups – to balance the needs of executives, employees and shareholders! Their advice is customized to their client's outstanding situation to ensure rewards programs are not just driven - but can be a competitive advantage. We currently have an exciting career opportunity in our Executive Compensation Consulting practice in our Chicago, IL office. In this role, you are refining and applying your knowledge of compensation design and implementation practices to deliver high quality and effective client solutions. You will lead projects with minimum direction from more experienced consultants and/or serve as a team member for larger, more sophisticated client engagements. Additionally, you will be primarily delivering billable client work but will support selling efforts and be a part of proposal teams. This is a hybrid role where there is an expectation to be in the office a few days per week. Job Responsibilities: Serve as intermediary between Account Manager (Partners), junior staff resources (Analyst-Consultant) and Client Handle client projects from start to finish, translating client needs into analysis and design recommendations across topics such as executive compensation, board of director compensation, incentive plan design, equity guidelines Run projects within agreed upon timeline and within budget Review and be accountable for all methodology / analysis / output on each staffed project Provide regular mentorship and developmental feedback to junior staff Develop summary reports including findings and recommendations Interface and co-deliver presentations to client Assist in leading all aspects of key areas of firm research Assist in new business/firm development activities (e.g., speeches, white papers, etc.) You Bring Knowledge and Expertise Suggested Experience: 2+ years of compensation or related experience Executive compensation experience preferred Technology and/or Life Sciences proven experience preferred Skills: Strong quantitative background and skills Highly proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint Excellent written and verbal communication Ability to synthesize and communicate large amounts of data into key findings and identify related business issues Have an “eye for detail,” while not losing focus of the bigger picture Confidence to present and defend methodology / recommendations to C-level and Board of Directors audience Leadership experience in terms of mentoring or developing peers and/or junior team members Experience of working efficiently within teams (professionally or otherwise) Strong interpersonal and project management skills Ability to multi-task and handle multiple sophisticated projects in a fast-paced, loosely-structured, and time-sensitive environment Maturity to operate independently, yet maintain open communication with team members on changing landscape/priorities Track record of success regarding historical performance rating and/or utilization (billable hours / total hours) Required skills: Cross-Functional Work - Beginner; Data Analysis - Beginner; Market Research - Beginner; Meeting Facilitation - Beginner; Performance Analysis - Beginner; Regulatory Compliance - Beginner; Project Management - Beginner; Report Writing - Beginner Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably with a focus in Finance, Economics, Statistics or Mathematics. Job.JobTitle: Account Manager II, Commercial Risk - Florida
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Commercial Lines Account Manager, Customer Service / Account Support, Insurance Customer Service Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is Looking for an Account Manager II! Do you have experience in Commercial Risk? Are you an inquisitive, organized, meticulous individual who would like to apply their experience to our dynamic and engaging industry? If so, this may be the next step in your career! This is a hybrid role based out of our Tampa, Miami, or Jacksonville, FL office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like:   Partner with Account Executives on assigned book of business, manage day-to-day service processes and outputs, support a variety of strategic, client-facing initiatives, and run point on each client’s renewal cycle, ensuring a positive and productive client experience.   How this opportunity is different What makes this opportunity different is the combination of meaningful client impact and Aon’s collaborative culture. In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across geographies and solution lines, leveraging Aon’s tools and deep expertise to deliver great outcomes for clients—while benefiting from a supportive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, career development, and personal wellbeing.   Skills that will lead to success: Maintains effective and positive relationships with clients. Serves independently in a client-facing capacity on matters of moderate importance and complexity. Facilitates the timely and accurate flow of information between clients, and account team members, keeping all parties informed. Handles client open items lists and respond to client ad-hoc requests. Gathers and analyzes data and drafts assigned elements of stewardship reports and other convincing presentations tailored to the needs of the audience and the circumstances of the presentation. Actively supports and monitors the renewal process, engaging with account team members as necessary. May draft quote comparisons and is responsible for saving down binders, policies, and endorsements. Where applicable, serves as the primary point of contact with Aon Client Services (ACS), coordinating activities of the client service team and ACS to ensure that key processes assigned are performed efficiently and quality of client deliverables. Primary collaborator with Premium Accounting on client billing matters. Receives and handles routine and sophisticated coverage inquiries and endorsement requests. Serves as key client liaison for items such as certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals. Monitors and follows-up on invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections. Addresses and resolves problems. May provide guidance and mentoring to a less senior account specialist. Delegates work to support staff and ACS where applicable. Ensures tools are understood and used. Performs related duties as assigned. Education and Experience: 3+ years of insurance experience required (preferably in an Account Management role) Property & Casualty broker’s license strongly preferred, or to be obtained within 120 days of start date Strong verbal and written communication skills and analytical abilities Ability to work well under pressure with attention to detail Team oriented self-starter, with ability to organize, prioritize, monitor and control workflow deadlines and be flexible Proficient in Outlook, Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint (intermediate to expert user level preferred) High school diploma or equivalent required Associates degree preferred Experience supporting complex clients is preferred Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $70,000 - $84,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2590058

Job.JobTitle: Senior Vice President, Excess Casualty Broker
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Excess & Surplus Lines Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Broker
Job.JobDescription:
Senior Vice President, Excess Casualty Broker! The National Casualty Practice is a premier team of casualty brokerage professionals with extensive experience in representing buyers of primary and umbrella/excess liability. We are looking to add a broker to our Excess Casualty team! We are considering applicants in New York, NY and Dallas, TX. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Utilizing risk expertise and knowledge of industry and insurance marketplace, a VP reviews clients’ exposures and loss experience and develops solutions for clients’ needs. Serve as a trusted casualty advisor by evaluating client risks, analyzing loss experience, and developing renewal and placement strategies tailored to client needs. Lead the marketing process by preparing submissions, negotiating with carriers, evaluating quotes, and presenting coverage, pricing, and program recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Manage the placement lifecycle, including order-to-bind activities, policy reviews, program accuracy, and resolution of open items, subjectivities, and underwriting requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, carriers, underwriters, and Aon's National Casualty Practice to deliver exceptional service and market intelligence. Provide insights on market conditions, carrier appetites, pricing trends, and emerging coverage developments to support client decision-making. Collaborate with account executives, producers, and client teams to support client retention, new business opportunities, and the development of innovative risk solutions. Articulate the value of the broking function and participate in client discussions regarding strategy, program structure, and fee arrangements, as applicable. Mentor and support the development of brokers and other colleagues while ensuring compliance with Aon’s best practices. How this opportunity is different Our colleagues have access to industry-leading resources and expertise through data, research, and collaboration with subject matter experts. You will have the ability to ensure our clients are better informed and better advised, so they can make better decisions about their future. Skills and experience that will lead to success 15+ years of relevant insurance P&C business experience Demonstrated expertise of Casualty (Workers Compensation, Auto Liability, General Liability, Umbrella/Excess Liability, etc.) Strong understanding of casualty risks and carrier appetites. Broad relationships with the carriers that write casualty P&C business. Strong communication, presentation, and report-writing skills, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Co-Pilot. Education. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience. Property and Casualty Brokers License is required For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $173,500 to $235,000 annually. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. #LI-RW1 #LI-HYBRID 2587264

Early Careers Launch - Broking Commercial Risk Launch Your Career in Broking Aon is looking for soon-to-be graduates and recent graduates to join our Early Careers Launch Development Program as Brokers, with opportunities across Commercial Risk and Reinsurance. You do not need to be an insurance expert on day one. Through our Launch Program and on-the-job learning, you will learn how brokers help clients understand risk, navigate insurance and reinsurance markets, and make better decisions, that support resilience and growth. As a Broker, you will build the skills, confidence and market knowledge needed to translate complex risk exposures into structured insurance programs and serve as a credible intermediary between clients and insurers. Location: Dallas, Texas Houston, Texas Los Angeles, California Folsom, California Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What is Commercial Risk Commercial Risk Aon’s Commercial Risk team helps organizations around the world identify, understand, and manage the risks that could impact their people, assets, and performance. We partner with clients across industries to design and deliver innovative risk and insurance solutions - from property and casualty to cyber and specialty risks - using data, analytics, and deep market insight to help them make better decisions and protect their business. What You Will Do As a Broker, you will build hands-on broking experience while developing an understanding of how risk, markets, clients and strategy come together to create value for clients. Technology, including AI, Aon’s risk analyzers and global delivery teams increasingly support routine execution, allowing Brokers to focus earlier on commercial judgment, market strategy and client value. Analyze Risk and Build Market Insight Assess risk exposures using data, analytics and market intelligence while learning to validate results across coverage lines. Conduct market analysis to benchmark pricing, identify coverage gaps and support effective program recommendations. Support Market Strategy and Placements Help prepare market submissions, renewal materials, placement documentation and client deliverables. Engage insurers and underwriters to secure competitive pricing and terms, applying market knowledge where AI-suggested terms need tailoring. Build experience coordinating renewals, reviewing contracts and maintaining accurate documentation for smaller placements and account activity. Build Client Relationships and Advisory Skills Participate in client meetings, presentations and follow-up materials with growing confidence. Leverage technology, data analytics, and market insights to translate complex risk information into clear, actionable recommendations that help clients make informed business decisions. Build trust as a credible point of contact while developing client and market relationships. Coordinate Projects and Improve How Work Gets Done Support placement workflows across broking, account management, analytics, operations, specialist teams and global delivery partners. Review documents and client materials for accuracy, consistency and quality before they are used with markets or clients. Identify opportunities to improve broking processes and support efficient client delivery. Qualifications  College Seniors graduating between Spring 2026 to Spring 2027 with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 Please Note: For this role you must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. The Launch Development Program Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term broking and advisory career through: On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists. Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness. Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations. Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path. What Will Help You Succeed and Grow We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated and excited to learn. Through the Launch Program, you will continue developing the same skills and capabilities that support a successful broking and advisory career, including: An interest in business, risk, insurance, reinsurance, analytics, finance, economics, client service or global markets. A desire to pursue a career in Commercial Risk and/or Reinsurance - Broking. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders. Analytical and critical thinking, problem-solving ability and attention to detail. A collaborative mindset, alongside initiative, adaptability and a willingness to contribute as part of a team. Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Confidence using technology and a willingness to learn new tools, internal AI platforms and technology-enabled ways of working. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, clients and external partners. Initiative and a commitment to continuous learning, growth and professional development. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $63,000 to $77,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. #LI-MM3 #LI-KM1 #LI-SC3 #LI-KC3 #LI-CS6 #LI-HYBRID #RiskUS #LI-HYBRID #AonLaunchUS #CommercialRiskReinsuranceUS 2591131

Aon is looking for a Director, Catastrophe Management Analytics to join our Client Delivery team in Chicago, Bloomington, New York, or Boston! (This is a hybrid role, it is NOT virtual) As a senior member of the Catastrophe Management team, you will play an integral role in delivering catastrophe analytics, risk insights, and strategic consulting to Aon Reinsurance Solutions clients! You will work closely with clients, brokers, and analytics colleagues to translate catastrophe model results and other exposure and loss information into actionable insights that support reinsurance strategy and risk management decisions. You will also provide leadership across client teams, helping ensure high-quality analytical delivery while supporting the development of junior colleagues. Role Responsibilities: Lead catastrophe analytics and client delivery across reinsurance accounts, including exposure analysis, catastrophe modeling, portfolio analytics, and interpretation of model results. Partner with brokers and clients to translate analytical results into meaningful business insights supporting reinsurance strategy, portfolio management, risk selection, and other risk management decisions. Apply catastrophe model output and financial analyses to evaluate loss potential, reinsurance structures, catastrophe provisions, and allocation of catastrophe and reinsurance costs, as appropriate to individual client needs. Serve as a senior technical and analytical resource, providing guidance on catastrophe model assumptions, data quality, model results, uncertainty, and appropriate application of analytics. Manage client and broker relationships and oversee the timely, accurate, and effective delivery of catastrophe analytics across multiple accounts and projects. Lead analytical projects from planning through delivery, coordinating resources, establishing priorities, reviewing work, and communicating results to internal and external stakeholders. Mentor and develop analysts and other team members through technical guidance, coaching, review of analytical work, and constructive feedback. Contribute to the continued advancement of Catastrophe Management capabilities by identifying opportunities to improve analytical approaches, tools, workflows, and client deliverables. Skills and experience that will lead to success: 8+ years of relevant experience in catastrophe modeling, catastrophe risk analytics, reinsurance, insurance, or a closely related field. Strong understanding of catastrophe modeling concepts, exposure data, model assumptions and uncertainty, and the application of catastrophe analytics to insurance and reinsurance decision-making. Experience using leading catastrophe modeling platforms and interpreting model output, along with strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with analytical tools such as SQL, R, Python, or other data applications is a plus. Working knowledge of reinsurance structures and an understanding of how catastrophe analytics support reinsurance strategy and decision-making. Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical projects and delivering high-quality work across multiple client engagements or priorities. Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong client relationship, project management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across analytics, broking, and client teams. Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing analysts or other technical colleagues. BA/BS degree in a quantitative, analytical, scientific, actuarial, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Desired Skills (not required, but would help you stand out) Experience supporting global and/or complex commercial accounts with sophisticated catastrophe risk and analytics needs. Industry certifications such as ARe, CPCU, CCRMP, or CCRA are a plus, but not required. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $135,000 - $155,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. 2587658

Aon Human Capital is looking for a Consultant – Data Solutions As part of Aon’s Human Capital Rewards Solutions practice, you will help empower results for McLagan clients by delivering compensation benchmarking and consulting within the insurance industry. McLagan’s best-in-class data and advisory insights are the backbone to our industry-specific performance and advisory work! This position offers an opportunity to work with our dynamic team as a Consultant on the insurance team. Our clients include virtually every leading global financial services firm, including traditional and alternative asset managers, banks and brokers, advisory firms, insurers, and fin tech companies. Our business model is based on creating and expanding long-term partnerships with our clients. Many of our key client relationships extend back to McLagan’s inception in 1966. More information about Aon’s Human Capital Rewards Solutions is available at Talent and Rewards | Aon. This will be a hybrid role and the Consultant will be required to come to the office in Connecticut 2+ days/week. Job Overview: We currently have an immediate need for an experienced consultant to join our Financial Services Data Solutions Team. The Consultant will work across the firm’s performance & reward products to drive incremental sales, broaden relationships, manage & review data, execute on consulting engagements, and to innovate new products and solutions. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Colleagues at this level are expected to be or progress towards being a subject matter experts for their sector. With limited supervisions they understand and actively support the incremental improvements including data products timing & quality, processes, and other deliverables. Primary responsibilities include development of templates, management of timelines, independent execution of annual deliverables, and collaboration with senior data solutions management to integrate new insights into outputs. Under supervision, create high quality deliverables, including those that require synthesizing and interpreting of complex information beyond standard templates. Develop an understanding of key data product differentiators that drive revenue growth and opportunity. Successfully present analytics to deliver in-depth insights, conclusions and recommendations to clients. Capable of dispensing advice to mid and senior-level client HR professionals and answering questions which may be strategic in-nature. Understands the reward solutions business across multiple sectors and can articulate the value proposition of the business to peers at clients. Colleagues at this level can convey client segment trends to senior internal colleagues and can leverage that knowledge to influence product strategy. Independently partners with marketing to draft relevant sector content for purposes of outreach. Authors moderately complex proposals off the back of client conversations for data focused deliverables. Understands the competitive landscape of the sector and understands the segmentation in size and performance. Demonstrated ability to build tools to facilitate more efficient work processes and more quality insights from data products to meet desired objectives. Reviewed work completed by junior analysts and identified results that deviate from expectations or warrant further review. Skills and experience that will lead to success 4 - 8 of management consulting or human resources experience in the financial industry - insurance sector experience preferred. Highly numerate and analytical while having excellent client relationship management and communication skills. Excellent presentation skills including strong verbal and written communication. A knowledge of compensation is a strong plus. Other Key Experiences Includes: Experience leading projects and engagements. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to present effectively to senior management. Well organized and delivery-driven with good completion skills. Ability to work under pressure. Education: Bachelor’s Degree. Required skills: Report writing For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon Human Capital is looking for a Consultant – Data Solutions As part of Aon’s Human Capital Rewards Solutions practice, you will help empower results for McLagan clients by delivering compensation benchmarking and consulting within the insurance industry. McLagan’s best-in-class data and advisory insights are the backbone to our industry-specific performance and advisory work! This position offers an opportunity to work with our dynamic team as a Consultant on the insurance team. Our clients include virtually every leading global financial services firm, including traditional and alternative asset managers, banks and brokers, advisory firms, insurers, and fin tech companies. Our business model is based on creating and expanding long-term partnerships with our clients. Many of our key client relationships extend back to McLagan’s inception in 1966. More information about Aon’s Human Capital Rewards Solutions is available at Talent and Rewards | Aon. This will be a hybrid role and the Consultant will be required to come to the office in Connecticut 2+ days/week. Job Overview: We currently have an immediate need for an experienced consultant to join our Financial Services Data Solutions Team. The Consultant will work across the firm’s performance & reward products to drive incremental sales, broaden relationships, manage & review data, execute on consulting engagements, and to innovate new products and solutions. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Successfully present analytics to deliver in-depth insights, conclusions and recommendations to clients. Capable of dispensing advice to mid and senior-level client HR professionals and answering questions which may be strategic in-nature. Senior Claims Advocate - Financial Services Group As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Financial Services Group Legal and Claims Practice Group. This will be a hybrid role working from our New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Denver or Connecticut Aon office location. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Manage the claims process for Aon’s Financial Services Group’s (“FSG”) clients from start to finish Provide expert advice on reporting procedures and claims process Ensure timely and accurate reporting of claims Obtain and review coverage positions from insurers Establish and manage lines of communication between clients and insurance carriers Serve as the point person for the client on all FSG claims related matters Serve as the client’s advocate with the insurers Partner with clients to ensure that insurers are updated as necessary with respect to pending claims Obtain consent from insurers for retention of defense counsel and vendors Engage insurers in resolution of claims, such as seeking consent to settlement opportunities and ensuring payment of defense fees and expenses Assist clients and brokers on coverage issues for Directors and Officers Liability, Errors and Omissions, Employment Practices, Fiduciary, and Fidelity policies Maintain adequate documentation of claims related correspondence Work alongside Claims Attorneys to help clients resolve complex claims issues Contribute to data produced by the Legal and Claims Practice Group for the benefit of internal and external clients Any and all other responsibilities as deemed necessary by supervisor to achieve the purpose of the job How this opportunity is different Our approach to claims management is quite simple: through hard work, dedication, and creative thinking, we can help our clients achieve favorable claim resolutions. We are proud of the investment our firm has made in this valuable client resource and firmly believe Aon’s Legal and Claims Practice Group is a significant competitive advantage for our clients. Skills and experience that will lead to success Demonstrates a strong understanding of claims management process Possesses knowledge of Financial Lines market and insurer partners Analytical skills Attention to detail Customer and interpersonal skills Skilled in MS Office suite Has at least 5 years’ experience handling claims or commensurate legal or insurance experience Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of proven experience For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Senior Account Executive We are looking for a leader who is responsible for the overall strategy as well as the day-to-day, account management of Aon's relationships with assigned clients as their primary role. You will lead client service teams to identify and meet client needs and thereby retain and grow a profitable book of business. Through service, pricing, consultation, and reporting, you will promote the value Aon delivers to clients. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Retains and grows Aon's business, cultivating relationships with senior-most client decision-makers in the client organization as well as with day-to-day client contacts. Drives the renewal process, assembling the appropriate team to develop and implement the client-specific renewal strategy. Coordinates with Brokers in the development and delivery of renewal strategies. Facilitates critical relationships between clients, Aon and insurers. Ensures client service team understanding of client needs, service delivery methods, and the economic framework relevant to services delivered. Leads stewardship planning and delivery. Ensures overall account profitability with a value-based approach for the scope of service and costs associated with the Client Promise Plan. Arranges Aon compensation for services, whether fee or commission-based, accordingly. Educates clients in risk management, risk transfer, market issues and relevant trends including appropriate data and analytics. Marshals appropriate Aon resources to support clients in unusual circumstances such as large claims, etc. Involves others across geographic (including international), functional and business unit boundaries to define interdependent responses to opportunities to grow the business. Manages input to and follow-up on invoicing and receivables process for assigned clients, ensuring timely collections. Skills and experience that will lead to success Must have a minimum of 15 years of appropriate risk insurance experience coupled with project and account management experience on large accounts. Strong sales skills Organizational, interpersonal, and project management skills with an ability to multi-task and prioritize workload with attention to detail. Critical thinking skills with the ability to clearly express thoughts and concepts at various levels. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook Must have an active Property & Casualty license. Education: Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent years of industry experience. Compensation: The salary range for this position is $250,000 – $325,000 annually. This salary range is an estimate and the actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans. The amount of the incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. How we support our colleagues Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. Job.JobTitle: Regional Manager, Email Marketing and Automation - North America
Job.JobDescription:
The Regional Manager, Email Activation & Marketing Automation, North America, sits within the Global Digital Marketing team and is the strategic marketing automation partner and primary contact for email marketing and digital communications across the North America region. The role combines deep Eloqua expertise with stakeholder management, campaign consulting, governance and measurement, translating regional business needs into effective email, nurture and engagement strategies while applying global standards. It is not solely a coordination role: the manager provides expert recommendations, challenges briefs and directly supports advanced activation where complexity requires it. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Regional Stakeholder Partnership and Campaign Consulting Act as the primary email and automation contact for regional and solution line marketing teams, building trusted relationships with marketing leaders and campaign owners. Translate business objectives and briefs into clear email, nurture and engagement strategies, constructively challenging briefs unlikely to deliver the intended outcome. Advanced Email Activation and Campaign Leadership Lead the design and activation of complex, high-priority, multi-wave programs, including nurture, re-engagement and lifecycle journeys, with advanced segmentation, personalization and lead-scoring logic in Eloqua. Provide hands-on Eloqua activation where complexity or regional importance goes beyond standard delivery, ensuring campaigns are viable before build and escalating material risks. Campaign Governance, Quality and Standards Drive adoption of global email and marketing automation standards, templates, naming conventions, tracking and QA processes across the region. Apply governance across segmentation, consent, preference management, suppression, data use, accessibility and brand, with robust pre-launch validation for complex campaigns. Performance, Testing and Optimization Act as the regional subject matter expert on email and automated campaign performance, defining KPIs and championing systematic A/B and multivariate testing. Turn performance data into evidence-based recommendations, apply learnings to future campaigns, and connect email engagement to lead progression where data allows. Regional-to-GCC Operating Model Coordination Maintain a structured connection between regional stakeholders and the Global Capability Center (GCC) Digital Engagement and Email Marketing team, translating requirements into actionable briefs and coordinating intake, readiness and issue resolution. Surface capacity, timing and scope conflicts to regional and Global Digital leaders, and recommend improvements to roles, handoffs and processes that reduce duplication. Marketing Technology and Capability Building Contribute regional requirements to Eloqua and martech development, support user acceptance testing, and identify automation and AI-enabled efficiencies in line with privacy, risk and brand requirements. Champion email and automation excellence through guidance, workshops, playbooks and coaching of GCC colleagues on complex campaigns. Key Partnerships Global Head of Digital Marketing; North America Go-To-Market, marketing and solution line leaders; Global Capability Center Digital Marketing and Email Marketing teams; Lead CoE; Marketing Technology; Global Digital Performance and Insights; Data, Privacy, Risk and Compliance; Brand and Content. Skills and experience that will lead to success Advanced Oracle Eloqua experience in an enterprise environment, including Campaign Canvas, Program Builder, segmentation, forms, landing pages, custom data objects, lead scoring and dynamic content. Comparable platform experience may be considered alongside a strong grasp of Eloqua concepts. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex, multi-stage or multi-market email campaigns and nurture journeys. Strong understanding of audience data, tracking, consent, preference management, suppression and deliverability, with working knowledge of CRM integration, lead management and attribution. Strong stakeholder management, consulting and communication skills: translating business objectives into practical solutions, constructively challenging briefs, explaining technical concepts simply, and influencing senior stakeholders and matrixed teams without direct authority. Collaborative, proactive, pragmatic and accountable, comfortable in an evolving global operating model and in combining strategic consulting with hands-on expert activation. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital, technology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience; Oracle Eloqua or marketing automation certification. Significant experience in email marketing, digital communications, marketing automation or campaign operations within a global, regional or matrixed enterprise. Experience leading complex campaign workstreams or mentoring specialists; regulated, data-sensitive or professional-services experience is advantageous. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $100,000 - $115,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Chicago, Illinois. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-SP1 #LI-REMOTE 2590697

Champion email and automation excellence through guidance, workshops, playbooks and coaching of GCC colleagues on complex campaigns. Key Partnerships Global Head of Digital Marketing; North America Go-To-Market, marketing and solution line leaders; Global Capability Center Digital Marketing and Email Marketing teams; Lead CoE; Marketing Technology; Global Digital Performance and Insights; Data, Privacy, Risk and Compliance; Brand and Content. Skills and experience that will lead to success Advanced Oracle Eloqua experience in an enterprise environment, including Campaign Canvas, Program Builder, segmentation, forms, landing pages, custom data objects, lead scoring and dynamic content. Comparable platform experience may be considered alongside a strong grasp of Eloqua concepts. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex, multi-stage or multi-market email campaigns and nurture journeys. Strong understanding of audience data, tracking, consent, preference management, suppression and deliverability, with working knowledge of CRM integration, lead management and attribution. Strong stakeholder management, consulting and communication skills: translating business objectives into practical solutions, constructively challenging briefs, explaining technical concepts simply, and influencing senior stakeholders and matrixed teams without direct authority. Collaborative, proactive, pragmatic and accountable, comfortable in an evolving global operating model and in combining strategic consulting with hands-on expert activation. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital, technology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience; Oracle Eloqua or marketing automation certification. Significant experience in email marketing, digital communications, marketing automation or campaign operations within a global, regional or matrixed enterprise. Experience leading complex campaign workstreams or mentoring specialists; regulated, data-sensitive or professional-services experience is advantageous. Are you ready to lead complex risk strategy for organizations crafting the future of the commercial space economy? Do you thrive at the intersection of aerospace engineering, executive client leadership, and global specialty insurance? Join our Global Aon Space Practice and help clients make better decisions across the full mission lifecycle! This position offers a hybrid arrangement, allowing you to work from our Washington, DC office 2-3 days per week. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As Senior Vice President - Aon Space, you will function as a senior relationship executive and strategic risk counselor for a portfolio of complex space-sector clients. Reporting to the Global Space Practice Leader, you will manage client strategy, retention, profitable revenue growth, and coordinated delivery of insurance brokerage and risk advisory services. This senior client leadership and commercial role involves executive engagement, coverage invention, complex negotiations, technical risk analysis, claims support, and oversight of service delivery. Own the overall relationship and multiyear account strategy for satellite owners and operators, launch service providers, manufacturers, space infrastructure businesses, and emerging space ventures. Build positive relationships with executive leadership and collaborators across finance, treasury, legal, risk management, engineering, and mission operations. Lead insurance and risk financing strategies for applicable pre-launch, launch, commissioning, in-orbit, and third-party liability exposures, including renewal and placement strategy, program structure, limits, deductibles, and retentions. Contribute to defining loss criteria for satellite insurance policies with the Aon Space technical team and coordinate the review process of insurance requirements in launch agreements, satellite procurement contracts, financing arrangements, and other commercial agreements. Build internal risk assessment skills for the Aon Space team and offer engineering assistance to clients when required. Develop growth plans for assigned accounts and prospects; lead opportunity qualification, discovery, proposals, presentations, fee negotiations, pipeline forecasting, account budgets, and commercial planning. Lead multidisciplinary account teams across offices and time zones, establishing service commitments, renewal achievements, communication protocols, quality assurance, peer review, documentation, and critical issue practices. Coordinate claims advocacy and support compliance with licensing, sanctions, export-control, confidentiality, and information-handling requirements, without promising coverage or recovery. Contribute to practice strategy, service innovation, market relationships, and differentiated space-industry capabilities; represent the practice at relevant industry events and client forums. How this opportunity is different This position integrates executive client leadership, aerospace engineering skills, and commercial accountability within a niche of the global insurance market. You will support both established space firms and emerging ventures, build solutions across the mission lifecycle, and collaborate with Aon Space technical specialists, global specialty markets, claims advocates, legal and compliance partners, and broader firm capabilities. The role provides a chance to improve Aon’s U.S. engineering and risk analysis expertise while leading influential relationships in an evolving sector. Skills and experience that will lead to success Extensive knowledge of space insurance and the commercial space environment, covering satellite and launch risks, mission lifecycles, placement frameworks, and pertinent insurance markets; familiarity with both established companies and new ventures, including constellations, launch vehicles, and space infrastructure, is preferred. Demonstrated success retaining and growing significant client relationships, leading competitive pursuits, negotiating sophisticated insurance and service arrangements, and meeting revenue, retention, and profitability goals. Ability to advise executive collaborators and translate technical, contractual, financial, and engineering exposures into clear business decisions; strong policy wording, coverage analysis, claims coordination, and account economics experience. Proven leadership of cross-functional teams in a matrixed global organization, with excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, relationship-management, prioritization, and governance skills. Established connections within space insurers and international specialty markets, along with knowledge of alternative risk financing, structured placements, and intricate contractual risk allocation, are highly desirable. Relevant insurance broker licenses, or the capacity to acquire them within a mutually agreed timeframe, are mandatory. Education: Bachelor’s degree in aerospace or astronautical engineering, or equivalent experience, is required. Advanced study or professional experience in aerospace, engineering, finance, law, or a related field is preferred. A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required, or must be acquired within 90 days of hire if not already active Professional insurance or risk management designations such as CPCU, ARM, ACII, or equivalent are also preferred. Measures of success Retention and expansion of assigned client relationships, supported by detailed client feedback and executive engagement. Attainment of agreed new-business, organic revenue growth, and account profitability goals. Provision of engineering support to U.S. clients and improvement of internal risk analysis capabilities. Timely delivery of renewals, placements, and strategic account plans against agreed achievements. Quality of coverage advice, documentation, market execution, and coordination of significant claims matters. Effective cross-practice collaboration, development of team capability, and adherence to governance standards. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $163,200- $212,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-HYBRID #LI-CF1 2592250

Demonstrated ability to build tools to facilitate more efficient work processes and more quality insights from data products to meet desired objectives. Reviewed work completed by junior analysts and identified results that deviate from expectations or warrant further review. Highly numerate and analytical while having excellent client relationship management and communication skills. Excellent presentation skills including strong verbal and written communication. Job.JobTitle: M&A Due Diligence Consultant - Senior Vice President
Job.JobDescription:
Aon Is looking for a Risk & Insurance Due Diligence Senior Vice President in Aon’s M&A and Transaction Advisory Solutions practice in New York, New York. We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Senior Vice President within our Risk & Insurance Due Diligence team in New York. As part of an industry‑leading, global Transaction Advisory Services group, you will help empower results for our clients by leading the delivery of innovative and effective risk and insurance solutions for M&A transactions involving Private Equity and Corporate clients. In this senior role, you will oversee complex due diligence engagements, drive client relationships, and collaborate with colleagues across the NY region and globally within Commercial Risk Solutions. As a Senior Vice President, you will provide strategic guidance to the team, mentor junior colleagues, and report into the regional Transaction Advisory Services leader. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from a local New York, NY office (3 days in office per week). How this opportunity is different Work on sophisticated Property and Casualty due diligence projects within our M&A team. Aon has an inclusive culture, where you get to work with many different personality types while working with a lively team! There are opportunities for growth, as we are generating new opportunities throughout this division. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Job Responsibilities Lead due diligence projects of varying complexity. Communicate internally with brokers, coverage / exposure experts, producers, client service team and M&A team members and collaborate to develop findings and solutions. Communicate externally on daily basis as trusted advisor with private equity firms, target companies or their representatives. Execute and deliver accurate and professional due diligence reports to clients. Analyze and provide technical input on insurance coverage, claims history, insurance-related collateral, insurance-related financial expense, surety bonds and insurance sections of the draft purchase agreement. Identify transaction issues and work with clients’ other third-party advisors to develop resolution. Collaborate with producers to build and maintain relationships with ongoing clients and convert due diligence targets to ongoing clients. Communicate and capture the value that Aon brings even to the most challenging situations. Prepare spreadsheets and analyze data. Prepare proposals and make presentations to clients and prospects. Some travel required. Required Skills & Experience You Bring Knowledge and Expertise Property and Casualty insurance technical proficiency. Broad knowledge of specialty insurance including property, casualty, cyber, E&O, financial lines, environmental, group captives and others. Financial – basic understanding of financial statements, accounting. Project management – coordinate activities and information flow from a group of people within specified time frame. Strategic and analytical skills – attention to detail but able to draw conclusions. Strong communication skills (written and oral) – ability to communicate well and at the appropriate level with a wide range of people. Ability to perform under stress / tight time frames. Ability to develop relationships / build confidence of others (both internally and externally) based upon work performed. Ability to work on multiple projects at one time. Results oriented. Proficiency with Word, Excel, Power Point. Broker’s license 10+ years of insurance experience are highly preferred. Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), Organizational Structures, Project Management, Risk Analysis, Risk Management, Risk Management Strategies, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Accounting Standards, Business Cases, Strategy Development, Transaction Management, Client Relationship Management, Consulting, Data Analysis, Data Manipulation, Due Diligence, Management Consulting Preferred Experience CPCU a plus MBA, CPA or JD a plus Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in related field Pay Transparency The salary range for this position (for U.S. applicants) is $190,000- $260,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Benefits We Offer Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. #LI-Hybrid #LI-HL2 2583824
