Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for a Risk Consultant for our Property Consulting Group We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Property Risk Control Consultant. This position will support Aon’s Property Risk Consulting Group. To strengthen Aon’s construction risk engineering capability across the US, with a particular focus on digital infrastructure and data center projects, while also supporting broader construction-related opportunities across the region. This person should have HPR property engineering experience with knowledge of both NFPA and Factory Mutual standards as well as an understanding of property insurance policy terms and conditions. Applicant must be proficient in managing client, carrier, and insurance brokerage relationships. Excellent communication skills a must and should be able to effectively explain general property risk management concepts to prospective clients and internal business groups. The prospect will be expected to travel anywhere between 30-40% of the time primarily in the U.S. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Deliver construction risk engineering support across the project lifecycle, including early design / pre-construction, construction phase, energisation / commissioning and transition into operations. Conduct and lead project risk reviews, design reviews, construction site surveys, underwriting surveys, construction-phase risk assessments and loss estimate assignments. Identify critical construction-phase exposures, including fire, structural, delay-in-start-up, resilience and interface risks, and translate these into practical improvement recommendations. Support data centers and digital infrastructure projects by contributing to a consistent US delivery approach, common methodology and high-quality technical deliverables. Work closely with local country teams, broking colleagues, underwriters, clients and the wider US / global risk consulting community to support both local and cross-border assignments. Provide technical input into underwriting narratives, risk reports, loss estimates, risk improvement plans and client-facing recommendations. Help build and share construction risk engineering knowledge across US by supporting training initiatives, mentoring colleagues and contributing to standardized tools, templates and best-practice guidance. Support growth activity by helping country and regional leaders assess pipeline opportunities, resource needs and the technical feasibility of construction / digital infrastructure assignments. Skills and experience that will lead to success Strong background in construction risk engineering, project risk engineering, construction insurance engineering or a closely related technical engineering discipline. Experience with construction-phase risk reviews, design advisory / review work, site surveys, underwriting reports and technical risk recommendations. Ability to review and interpret engineering reports, drawings and interfaces between design disciplines, particularly where assignments require short turnaround times. Good understanding of data center / digital infrastructure risk drivers would be highly beneficial, including power supply, redundancy, cooling, commissioning, integrated systems testing and handover risks. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent years of industry experience and professional certifications. Fire protection certification preferred but not required. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $150,000 to $160,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-CC1 #LI-REMOTE 2584895

We’re seeking an Account Executive II to join our Construction & Infrastructure (C&I) in Chicago! This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside some of the most experienced and respected Insurance Professionals in the industry. Our team specializes in managing complex indemnity structures, handling high-volume transaction activity, and delivering sophisticated risk analysis for clients operating at the highest levels of the construction sector. This hybrid role (2–3 days onsite weekly) from a local Aon office. We are considering applicants in Chicago, Detroit, St Louis, Indianapolis and Minneapolis. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Collaborate with senior team members to develop coverage strategies and marketing initiatives for both renewals and prospective business opportunities. Respond promptly and accurately to client requests, inquiries, and service needs. Prepare and maintain up-to-date documentation for new business and renewals. Analyze client-specific risk exposures and coverage needs; develop and present tailored marketing proposals. Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with the underwriting community, particularly with key partner markets. Process and/or issue, as applicable, new policies, renewals, endorsements, additions, deletions, and cancellations. Review and proofread all documentation, ensure accurate signatures are obtained, and distribute materials as needed. Calculate premium adjustments and other related figures for insurance and provider documentation. Lead, monitor, and report on ongoing insurance or risk retention programs, ensuring they meet performance goals. Manage daily tasks and key assignments using appropriate technology tools and platforms. How this opportunity is different This isn’t a typical Account Executive role. At the core of our team is a deep bench of industry-leading expertise and a collaborative culture that empowers you to grow quickly and meaningfully. You’ll be working with high-performing professionals on some of the most complex and high-stakes surety programs in the market—programs that demand creativity, agility, and strategic thinking. You'll have the chance to lead, influence, and drive measurable impact while developing a long-term career path in a firm that values technical excellence, innovation, and leadership development. Skills and experience that will lead to success: 7+ years of relevant experience in Property & Casualty insurance, with a strong preference for expertise in Construction Surety Bonds. Proven ability to build strong rapport and collaborate effectively with high-level clients and stakeholders. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines, manage multiple tasks, and adapt quickly to shifting priorities. Exceptional attention to detail, with a commitment to reviewing work thoroughly and participating in peer reviews. Demonstrated ability to work independently and proactively, while also contributing positively to a collaborative team environment. Ability to prioritize tasks based on urgency and volume, while maintaining flexibility in a fast-paced setting. Solid mathematical and analytical reasoning skills to support risk analysis and premium calculations. Deep relationships with national and regional carriers active in the Surety and P&C markets. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to clients and team members. Strong digital literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and experience creating compelling client presentations. Commitment to maintaining compliance with all Aon policies and applicable regulatory requirements. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience. Must have the willingness to obtain an active Property and Casualty license within four months of hire (90 days) Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $123,000 to $220,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Chicago,IL. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with the underwriting community, particularly with key partner markets. Process and/or issue, as applicable, new policies, renewals, endorsements, additions, deletions, and cancellations. Review and proofread all documentation, ensure accurate signatures are obtained, and distribute materials as needed. Calculate premium adjustments and other related figures for insurance and provider documentation. Lead, monitor, and report on ongoing insurance or risk retention programs, ensuring they meet performance goals. Manage daily tasks and key assignments using appropriate technology tools and platforms. How this opportunity is different This isn’t a typical Account Executive role. At the core of our team is a deep bench of industry-leading expertise and a collaborative culture that empowers you to grow quickly and meaningfully. You’ll be working with high-performing professionals on some of the most complex and high-stakes surety programs in the market—programs that demand creativity, agility, and strategic thinking. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cybersecurity Analyst, Technology / Insurtech, Communications Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Specialist, Cybersecurity Communications to help strengthen cybersecurity awareness, engagement and behavior change across the firm. This role will partner closely with Global Cybersecurity Services (GCS) leaders to develop and execute internal communications and change management strategies that help colleagues make better decisions to protect Aon's systems, data and products. The role will report to the Head of Aon Business Services Communications on Aon's global Marketing & Communications team. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Partner with cybersecurity subject matter experts to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise and actionable communications. Lead planning and execution of cybersecurity awareness campaigns, including Cybersecurity Awareness Month, phishing awareness initiatives, training promotions and behavior change programs. Develop compelling colleague communications across a variety of channels, including email, intranet, Viva Engage, newsletters, presentations and leader communications. Participate in regular cybersecurity intelligence sharing meetings and forums, with the intent of driving both reactive and proactive cyber-driven communications across targeted Aon stakeholders. Drive business acumen knowledge across Aon’s global landscape, leveraging this to drive clear understanding across varying sets of stakeholders and audiences. Coordinate communications activities across stakeholder groups to ensure consistent messaging, audience alignment and effective execution. Support cybersecurity incident and crisis preparedness efforts by developing messaging templates and response materials that enable timely, coordinated communications. Contribute as a member of Aon's global communications team, partnering across functions and supporting enterprise priorities as business needs evolve. Maintain intranet materials, ensuring that materials are aligned with communication campaigns and follow relevant translation processes. Measure campaign effectiveness and communications performance, using engagement data and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with colleagues across Operations, Legal, Compliance and Marketing & Communications to support coordinated communication efforts. Job.JobDescription:
Are you ready to lead insurance solutions for Fortune 500 clients? Do you want to collaborate with industry experts and drive innovation in captive insurance management? Aon is actively seeking an experienced Insurance Officer to join our expanding team! This is a hybrid OR remote role. Strong preference for candidates who can work from our Burlington, VT office. This role will require Eastern Standard Time work hours. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. Job.JobTitle: Campaign Activation & Engagement Manager, M&A and Transaction Solutions (AMATS)
Job.JobDescription:
This is not a traditional campaign management role. You will be responsible for ensuring that agreed marketing priorities, multiformat campaigns and client engagement programs are activated effectively across the organization. Success requires someone who can think strategically, build structure from complexity, coordinate diverse stakeholders and create repeatable approaches that improve effectiveness and scale. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Campaign Activation Planning Translate campaign strategies into integrated activation plans and audience engagement programs. Build practical activation roadmaps covering channels, audiences, timing, content deployment and follow-up activities. Ensure events, content, social, digital and sales enablement activities operate as part of a coordinated campaign rather than standalone initiatives. Align activation plans with business priorities, growth objectives and target audiences. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and drive cost savings through greater standardization, reuse and scalability with global colleagues and external partnerships. Audience Engagement Programs Design engagement journeys that help move priority audiences from awareness through consideration and ongoing engagement. Develop activation approaches for key M&A and Transaction Solutions audiences including Private Equity firms, M&A Attorneys and other advisors and Strategic Corporates. . Recommend and deliver engagement tactics that strengthen relationships and increase participation in marketing initiatives. Partner with business stakeholders and sales enablement teams to improve audience progression and follow-through. Strategic Event and Client Engagement Activation Working with Global Marketing Leader, develop and deliver third-party sponsorship strategy and calendar. Serve as primary liaison with third-party agencies. Manage third-party sponsorship fulfillment, including collecting, creating, tracking and delivering upon sponsorship benefits including speaking opportunities, marketing materials, social media promotion (pre, during and post event), advertisements, client 1:1 meeting opportunities, etc. Develop and deliver integrated activation plans for strategic conferences, executive roundtables, sponsorships, webinars and flagship client engagement programs. Create pre-event, during-event and post-event engagement frameworks that maximize business value. Ensure thought leadership, executive participation, client outreach and follow-up activities are coordinated. Partner with business leadership, events and marketing teams to ensure programs support broader campaign objectives. Partner with Marketing Manager, Integrated Strategic & Growth Campaigns, Marketing Analyst & Enablement Coordinator and Aon Global Creative team to coordinate digital and printed materials for events. Conduct post-activation reviews and identify opportunities to improve future performance. Activation Frameworks and Playbooks Develop repeatable activation models that can be applied across multiple campaigns and regions. Create scalable playbooks, templates and engagement frameworks that improve consistency and effectiveness. Establish best practices for audience engagement, content utilization and campaign activation. Maintain an evolving library of activation approaches that can be reused across future programs. Cross-Functional Leadership Act as the bridge between campaign strategy owners and execution teams. Coordinate planning across communications, digital marketing, content, events, design, sales enablement and regional marketing teams. Facilitate activation planning sessions and maintain alignment across stakeholders. Identify and resolve delivery risks, dependencies and competing priorities. Build trusted relationships across a diverse global stakeholder group. Regional Enablement Support regional marketers with activation plans, engagement approaches and campaign toolkits. Enable consistent global execution while allowing flexibility for local market needs. Gather regional feedback and market insight to improve future programs. Share successful activation approaches and lessons learned across teams. Measurement and Optimization Define activation-level success measures aligned to broader campaign objectives. Evaluate engagement performance across campaigns, events and client programs. Identify opportunities to improve participation, effectiveness and commercial impact. Prepare actionable recommendations informed by campaign data, stakeholder feedback and market insight. Promote a culture of continuous improvement and learning. Skills and experience that will lead to success Required 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, client engagement, campaign activation, events marketing, account-based marketing or integrated communications. Experience executing multi-channel marketing campaigns across complex stakeholder environments. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple teams and priorities simultaneously. Strong project and program management capability. Experience developing activation plans, engagement programs and audience-focused marketing initiatives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong commercial awareness and business acumen. Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Ability to travel to proprietary and third-party events 6-10 times per year including occasional weekends. Preferred Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services, insurance, legal, advisory or technology sectors. Experience supporting executive engagement programs, thought leadership campaigns or client-facing events. Familiarity with campaign measurement, sales enablement and marketing analytics. Experience operating in a global matrix organization. Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Naturally curious and commercially minded. Comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure. Highly organized and execution-focused. Able to connect detailed delivery plans with broader business goals. Relationship-oriented and collaborative. Calm under pressure and able to manage competing priorities. Skilled at bringing people together around a common objective. Proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $85,000 - $100,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Chicago, Illinois. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-SP1 #LI-HYBRID 2590927

Establish best practices for audience engagement, content utilization and campaign activation. Maintain an evolving library of activation approaches that can be reused across future programs. Cross-Functional Leadership Act as the bridge between campaign strategy owners and execution teams. Coordinate planning across communications, digital marketing, content, events, design, sales enablement and regional marketing teams. Facilitate activation planning sessions and maintain alignment across stakeholders. Identify and resolve delivery risks, dependencies and competing priorities. Build trusted relationships across a diverse global stakeholder group. Regional Enablement Support regional marketers with activation plans, engagement approaches and campaign toolkits. Enable consistent global execution while allowing flexibility for local market needs. Gather regional feedback and market insight to improve future programs. Share successful activation approaches and lessons learned across teams. Measurement and Optimization Define activation-level success measures aligned to broader campaign objectives. Evaluate engagement performance across campaigns, events and client programs. Identify opportunities to improve participation, effectiveness and commercial impact. Prepare actionable recommendations informed by campaign data, stakeholder feedback and market insight. Promote a culture of continuous improvement and learning. Strong project and program management capability. Experience developing activation plans, engagement programs and audience-focused marketing initiatives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong commercial awareness and business acumen. Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Ability to travel to proprietary and third-party events 6-10 times per year including occasional weekends. Preferred Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services, insurance, legal, advisory or technology sectors. Experience supporting executive engagement programs, thought leadership campaigns or client-facing events. Familiarity with campaign measurement, sales enablement and marketing analytics. Comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure. Highly organized and execution-focused. Able to connect detailed delivery plans with broader business goals. Relationship-oriented and collaborative. Calm under pressure and able to manage competing priorities. Skilled at bringing people together around a common objective. Proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Director of Risk Management, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Director, Climate Risk Consulting This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our New York City office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Aon’s Climate Risk Advisory offers physical and transition risk diagnostics, consulting, and risk transfer solutions worldwide. The team includes more than 30 climate experts from various regions, solutions, and industries. It is deeply integrated within Aon’s core business, using over 100 modelers, 40 full-time scientists and engineers, and thousands of industry and regional specialists. The advisory team provides customized solutions and climate insights to help clients improve their decisions about climate and catastrophe-related risks. What the day will look like This role acts as a collaborator with regional practice leaders in Aon’s Climate Risk Advisory. It aims to promote excellence, coordination, efficiency, and effectiveness across client engagements and central initiatives. The individual will lead all aspects of project execution, manage several ongoing workstreams, and develop positive relationships with clients, account executives, producers, and the modelers, scientists, and consultants within the wider Aon team. As a trusted partner to practice leadership, the successful candidate will coordinate priorities, support communication, and address operational challenges. This will ensure consistent, high-quality delivery, engage colleagues and clients, and help expand the Climate Risk Advisory’s solution suite. Job Responsibilities: Business Development & Growth Collaborate with leadership to assist in long-term planning, business development, and efforts to expand the practice. Coordinate proposal development, client presentations, RFP responses, and opportunity pursuits. Maintain access to pipeline activity and support coordination across account teams, solution leaders, and technical experts. Assist in improving the Climate Risk Advisory value proposition and market positioning. Portfolio & Delivery Oversight Collaborate with clients, account teams, and technical experts to guarantee advisory solutions meet business objectives and produce measurable results. Coordinate Climate Risk Advisory engagements, making sure projects are prioritized and completed to a high standard. Maintain visibility across active engagements to identify capacity limits, delivery risks, and operational dependencies. Practice Leadership & Strategic Initiatives Function as a dependable ally to Climate Risk Advisory leadership, supporting the alignment of priorities, initiatives, and decision-making within the group. Join forces with leadership to build and broaden new advisory solutions, capabilities, and go-to-market initiatives. Drive alignment across regional teams, solution leaders, technical experts, and business partners to support consistent implementation and strategic growth. Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that support practice growth, innovation, and scalability. Organizational Excellence & Process Field Maintain tracking and reporting across client engagements, central initiatives, and team priorities. Establish guidelines, playbooks, templates, and governance frameworks that improve consistency across the practice. Ensure accountability and follow-through on key decisions, priorities, and action items. Team Leadership & Development Encourage cooperation and information exchange among regional teams, solution leaders, and technical experts. Support colleague development, mentoring, workforce planning, and prioritization across the practice. Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Skills and experience that will lead to success More than 12 years of experience in consulting, catastrophe/climate risk analytics, insurance, reinsurance, or a similar area. Bachelors Degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, CAT Modeling, a related field or equivalent years of industry experience Proven ability to guide complex client engagements and cross-functional project teams. Strong project and collaborator management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills, including experience working with clients, senior executives, and technical specialists. Demonstrated executive presence and ability to engage effectively with senior client and business leaders. Experience leading, mentoring, and developing colleagues within a consulting, analytics, or professional services environment. Strong understanding of climate risk, catastrophe modeling, risk analytics, and advisory methodologies. Experience assisting business growth efforts, including proposals, RFPs, and client pursuits. Existing connections within the insurance, reinsurance, or broking ecosystem preferred. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable business recommendations. Demonstrated ability to influence collaborators and drive outcomes across large, matrixed organizations. Experience assisting business operations, portfolio management, practice management, or comparable strategic leadership roles. Dedication to client service, integrity, and ethical business practices. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $175,000 to $200,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. #LI-AR1 #LI-HYBRID 2581207

Aon is looking for a Senior Property Placement Broker – Power & Renewable Energy Aon is hiring all over North America for talented Brokers! Are you looking to be a member of an industry-leading team? Do you want to deliver innovative and effective solutions to clients? If you said yes, then apply to join our Broker team today. The broker role involves developing and applying strategic risk management solutions for Power and Renewable Energy clients. This includes the design, marketing and service management of builder’s risk and operational property insurance programs. While we are open to all candidates, no matter where you are located, we are specifically focusing on Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, Houston, TX, or New York, NY Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As a senior broking leader, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the strategy, design, and marketing of traditional power and renewable energy builder’s risk programs and operational property programs, including single-carrier placements, shared and layered programs, and for global accounts. Facilitate the compilation and distribution of submission information in conjunction with appropriate external client contacts and internal Aon clients. Provide broking status and continuous support and service to clients during entire broking process and entire period of engagement by client (this is a continuous process). Development of client presentations including development of analytical data. Present terms to Clients in conjunction with Account Management Team. Negotiate assigned accounts and change endorsement directly with underwriters. Effective negotiation skills. Drive utilization of all available technology throughout broking process and client service process. Responsible along with balance of account service team for all aspects of client service for assigned book of business including, binding and invoicing, policy preparation and collection, review and transmittal in accordance with established service standards with support from Lead Brokers and Broker Specialists. Providing benchmarking and placement advice to clients and producing offices. Client relationship management (direct clients and/or producing offices). Assist in the production and/or delivery account RFP tenders. How this opportunity is different The broker will be instrumental in the analysis of client’s exposures to identify and mitigate risk as well as responsible for the coordination of the placement and day-to-day activities on accounts. The broker should have proven peer market relationships and emerging senior market relationships. Skills and experience that will lead to success 10-15+ years of relevant insurance P&C business experience. Validated knowledge of Property Insurance coverages. Some M&A experience is a plus including Due Diligence projects. Strong collaboration and communication skills. Outstanding Microsoft Suite and presentation skills. Ability to travel to support sales initiatives across the Middle Market practice. Education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent amount of relevant experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $120,400 - $200,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. 2587275

Job.JobDescription:
Are you a Technology Architect with deep experience architecting enterprise Sales and Marketing technology ecosystems? This could be a superb opportunity to explore! Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As the lead architect for Aon's Sales & Marketing technology portfolio, you will define and govern the technology architecture that powers client engagement, digital experiences, marketing efficiency, and commercial operations. Establish and maintain the target-state architecture and multi-year technology roadmap across Sales & Marketing platforms. Serve as the strategic architecture advisor to business and technology leaders, aligning technology investments with business objectives and enterprise standards. Lead architecture and solution design across CRM, Marketing Automation, Web, CDP, Analytics, Data, and artificial intelligence driven customer engagement platforms. Drive platform integration strategy, ensuring flawless data flow and customer journeys across the technology ecosystem. Partner with product, engineering, security, infrastructure, and data teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to find opportunities for innovation, modernization, and business value. Establish architecture governance, design standards, and best practices while reducing technical debt and improving platform sustainability. Lead technology assessments, vendor evaluations, and major transformation initiatives across the Sales & Marketing landscape. Mentor architects and engineering teams while encouraging architecture field and engineering excellence. Key Technology Domains The architecture portfolio will include: CRM Platforms (Salesforce, Oracle CX) Marketing Automation Platforms (Oracle Eloqua, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and related technologies) Customer Data Platforms (CDP) Aon.com and Digital Experience Platforms (Sitecore and related web technologies) Analytics, Reporting, and Customer Insights Data Integration and API Ecosystems AI-Powered Sales and Marketing Capabilities Lead Management and Customer Journey Technologies How this opportunity is different This role provides a unique opportunity to influence the future of Aon's sales and marketing technology ecosystem. You will work across business and technology teams to architect solutions that connect client data, digital experiences, marketing capabilities, and sales processes into a modern, integrated platform that enables growth and innovation. Success requires a balance of critical thinking, technical depth, business insight, and the ability to influence decisions across a complex global organization. Skills and experience that will lead to success 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or technology leadership roles. Deep experience architecting enterprise Sales & Marketing technology ecosystems. Strong knowledge of Salesforce and Oracle platforms, including CRM and marketing technologies. Experience with Sitecore, digital experience platforms, web architectures, and customer-facing applications. Expertise in Customer Data Platforms (CDP), customer data management, and personalization strategies. Strong knowledge of AI architecture and trends. Experience designing complex integrations across cloud platforms, SaaS applications, APIs, headless, composable and enterprise systems. Knowledge of modern architecture patterns including cloud-native, composable architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and API-first development. Experience leading large-scale technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives. Experience leading architecture reviews, governance forums, and long-term planning activities. Strong collaborator management and relationship-building skills. Ability to influence technology and business leaders without direct authority. Exceptional communication and presentation skills with executive audiences. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $170k to $180k annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program. #LI-KH1 2584682

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Resident Sales Director, Southern California Are you looking to drive growth across Aon’s various solution lines? Can you develop and lead a team to meet revenue goals? If you are looking to take the next step in your career, this is the role for you! Aon is in the business of better decisions As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As part of a leading team in the industry, you will provide creative and successful solutions within our sales group. This will help drive impactful outcomes for our clients. As a Resident Sales Director, you will report directly to the Southern California Market Leader and will have direct reports in the SouthWest offices. Drive growth: Achieve or exceed the quarterly and annual new business revenue goals set for the office. Lead all aspects of crafting and carrying out direct reports, personal and other revenue producing colleagues go to market plans and sales goals. Build and maintain a sales-focused culture across the state’s personnel. Support the execution of the National Sales and Marketing platform and initiatives. Mentor and develop, problem-solve and strategize with the office’s producers, Account Executives, and broking and solutions line leaders to build, develop and close specific revenue opportunities. Educate producers, Account Executives, and broking leaders on new products, approaches, services and solutions and Aon’s capabilities and thought leadership with training on the segment or client applicability and recommend dialoguing with clients and prospects. Work with the risk and health leader to ensure that the office’s clients and prospects receive regular written communication applicable to their business(es), exposures and needs. Build, tailor and/or implement email campaigns, mailings, seminars, webinars, seminars, roundtables, and Forums to drive revenue opportunities tailored to the office’s new business priorities and market area(s). Proactively and consistently communicate and meet with clients, prospects, insurers, and competitors to maintain a current knowledge of talent in the office’s market area(s). Maintain an accurate pipeline of new business results for confident revenue forecasting and helpful sales metric analysis. Supervise and assess ongoing new business results and related pipeline activity across the office’s personnel and promptly anticipate and address negative new business variances or trends and/or activity issues. Maintain a fair marketplace in terms of prospect allocation across the office and firm’s resources and follow protocols for pipeline documentation and production credit disputes. Recruit and present your recommendation and business plan for the best business development personnel (producers, Account Executives, and support personnel to enable others to produce more) for the market area’s needs. Onboard business developers with a clear understanding of their role and responsibilities and specified sales goals, and training on Aon Connect, Aon’s office, national and global resources, and systems. Identify and champion focus centers of influence in the accounting, legal, financial, and other segments of the business community in the office’s market areas for office-wide teamwork. Ensure that Aon has earned most of its large clients’ risk management and employee benefits, wallet or spend. Communicate innovative ways, best processes, market, and competitor trends nationally. How this opportunity is different You will help to build, develop, and grow your sales team. Skills and experience that will lead to success Minimum 10 years of Sales Leadership in the property and casualty and/or health/human capital industry. Validated teamwork skills to optimally lead new business teams in pursuit of target prospects. Strong negotiation skills. Outstanding oral presentation skills and ability to clearly articulate sophisticated messages in written form. Track record of personally initiating and closing sophisticated sales. Consistent achievement of assigned business goals. Active execution in the development and maintenance of a productive commercial and promotional culture. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with Sales and Risk and Insurance Management/Business related curriculum preferred For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $213,000 to $300,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in Aon’s annual incentive plans in addition to base salary. The amount of any incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-CB1 #LI-Executive 2580230

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
US Senior Account Representative This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our West Palm Beach, FL office Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Senior Account Representative Colleagues help clients understand, manage and transfer risk through innovative reinsurance solutions.  The role is immediately client-facing, offering exposure to high-level executives and decision-makers at clients and reinsurance providers. Senior Account Representatives work on multiple accounts as part of a larger broker team which requires strong communication and collaboration skills.  Candidates will develop comprehensive reinsurance market and industry knowledge while working on predominately Property-focused clients, with a focus on Florida, the Southeast, and Nationwide portfolios. Over time, colleagues will have increasing opportunities for domestic and international travel to client and reinsurer meetings and to take on expanded roles in developing strategic and innovative solutions for clients. Job Responsibilities Support broking teams in servicing reinsurance clients, including developing innovative solutions and strategic advice to address client needs Build out internal and external networks to assist in growth efforts Source new revenue opportunities Communicate with and participate in reinsurer meetings and discussions regarding client program placements Prepare formal reinsurance submission materials and executive-facing presentations Assist in the technical analysis of client information Collaborate with various supporting teams within Aon Reinsurance Solutions such as catastrophe modeling, actuarial and contract wording to bring the best of Aon to client Assist in logistical coordination of client meetings and trips Skills and experience that will lead to success Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Math, a related field or equivalent years of industry experience required 2+ years of client-facing experience in the Insurance/Reinsurance Industry required Proven analytical skills - prior analytical and problem-solving experience from academic and/or business environment Working knowledge of Microsoft products, with intermediate proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Access is a strong plus.  Ability to collaborate well with others and to interact with variety of audiences Strong organizational skills including the ability to manage multiple assignments, work well with minimal supervision and meet deadlines in a timely manner Open to travel for business within the Southeastern United States, up to 4 times per year How we support our colleagues Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $80,000 to $95,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. #LI-AR1 #LI-HYBRID 2591530

team quota as well as sales goal achievement Partner with other stakeholders within Health and Benefits, Elective Benefits and Enrollment Solutions practices including operations, product development, Job.JobDescription:
Aon Is Looking for A Manager of Claims Operations - Professional Liability The Manager of Claims Operations with Aon Business Services – Integrated Services and will support our Professional Liability & License Protection Claims function, leads the end-to-end management of professional liability, malpractice, regulatory, and licensing board claims. The role oversees claims administration, Escalation service team support, email customer service, legal coordination, quality, compliance, and team performance. This position serves as a subject matter expert and escalation point for insured professionals facing allegations, investigations, disciplinary actions, or civil liability matters, with a focus on protecting professional licenses, reputations, and financial interests. This position is for a hybrid schedule, in office and remote throughout the week in Fort Washington, PA ***Must have people management experience, preferred in the insurance industry*** At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Job Responsibilities: Direct the handling of professional liability and license protection claims from initial notification through resolution Manage Escalation service team support and email customer service, responding to inquiries, resolving issues, providing coverage guidance, and delivering exceptional service in a timely and professional manner Oversee matters involving licensing board complaints, administrative hearings, professional misconduct allegations, malpractice claims, and disciplinary actions Ensure timely claim investigations, coverage reviews, documentation, reserving, and resolution strategies Serve as the escalation point for high-exposure, sensitive, urgent, or complex claims Monitor claim inventory, aging, workloads, service levels, and closure activity Interact with key business stakeholders up to executive level Act as key liaison with carrier partner including complex claim resolution and audit administration Evaluate need for system improvements based on feedback from process owners and operations teams Work with advanced reporting and metrics, provide analysis and report out Required Experience: 5+ years of business experience preferably in the insurance industry Experience in Team Management, Project Management and Resource Planning Self-starter with operational improvement / mentality Has technical expertise to accomplish complex processes/tasks Experience analyzing complex issues and coming up with creative solutions Proficiency in Microsoft Suite Strong organizational skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent communication; both written and verbal Proactive Management Style and consistent follow-through Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment P&C License Preferred experience: Professional Liability Insurance Claims Handling Education: Bachelor's degree preferred or relevant validated experience For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Executive Benefits Analyst – Executive Life Join the Aon Executive benefits team and develop meaningful relationships with clients and plan participants through administration of their supplemental benefit program. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Bloomington, MN or Atlanta, GA offices. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: The Executive Benefits Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day administration of assigned executive benefit plans. This position requires understanding of coverage formulas, taxation, and carrier-specific practices, with direct client, participant and carrier interaction. The Analyst takes ownership of tactical aspects of implementation and renewal activities, manages and analyzes data files, and serves as a resource and informal mentor to more junior staff. This role also contributes to training efforts and supports client stewardship discussions. Key Job Responsibilities: Own day-to-day administration of executive life insurance and corporate owned life insurance plans, including status changes, enrollment, implementation, and renewal activities Recognize out of scope requests and seek appropriate guidance Audit and analyze census, policy, and plan data Drive accurate financial reporting and revenue recognition by updating revenue forecasts Run queries to extract, validate, and analyze data in support of plan administration and decision-making. Adjust queries as necessary Manage master enrollment files and email distribution lists Consistently track tasks and deadlines to ensure accuracy and avoid misses Prepare renewal files and related documentation, ensuring alignment between plan design, pricing, and administrative processes Interface directly with clients and carriers to support enrollments and renewals, ensuring accuracy and timely execution Address most participant inquiries independently Use strong written and verbal communication skills to create clear, professional client and internal communications, and support stewardship discussions Demonstrate a growing understanding of plan design, service strategies, and risk mitigation Offer ideas for process or plan improvements and participate in operational task forces Contribute to training efforts and serve as an informal mentor to junior staff, sharing technical expertise and best practices within the solution line How this opportunity is different: A competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization. The Analyst takes ownership of tactical aspects of implementation and renewal activities, manages and analyzes data files, and serves as a resource and informal mentor to more junior staff. This role also contributes to training efforts and supports client stewardship discussions. Key Job Responsibilities: Own day-to-day administration of executive life insurance and corporate owned life insurance plans, including status changes, enrollment, implementation, and renewal activities Recognize out of scope requests and seek appropriate guidance Audit and analyze census, policy, and plan data Drive accurate financial reporting and revenue recognition by updating revenue forecasts Run queries to extract, validate, and analyze data in support of plan administration and decision-making. Adjust queries as necessary Manage master enrollment files and email distribution lists Consistently track tasks and deadlines to ensure accuracy and avoid misses Prepare renewal files and related documentation, ensuring alignment between plan design, pricing, and administrative processes Interface directly with clients and carriers to support enrollments and renewals, ensuring accuracy and timely execution Address most participant inquiries independently Use strong written and verbal communication skills to create clear, professional client and internal communications, and support stewardship discussions Demonstrate a growing understanding of plan design, service strategies, and risk mitigation Offer ideas for process or plan improvements and participate in operational task forces Contribute to training efforts and serve as an informal mentor to junior staff, sharing technical expertise and best practices within the solution line How this opportunity is different: A competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Experience with relevant executive benefit programs and plan administration Customer service or client-facing experience Strong written and verbal communication skills High attention to detail and strong organizational skills Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) Ability to handle confidential information with discretion Analytical thinking and problem-solving capability Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to enhance work quality and efficiency Preferred Experience: Life insurance knowledge Benefits experience Customer Service knowledge and orientation Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience Pay Transparency: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $60,000 to $75,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. Aon is looking for an Office Operations & Administrative Specialist! Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the Day Will Look Like The Office Operations & Administrative Specialist is a full-time, office-based role within Aon United Administrative Operations organization responsible for delivering exceptional workplace experience for colleagues, clients, and visitors. This position combines administrative support, office operations, workplace services, and concierge-level assistance to ensure a seamless and productive environment. Serving as a visible and trusted on-site resource, the Office Operations & Administrative Specialist plays a critical role in supporting day-to-day business operations, enhancing workplace efficiency, and providing high-touch service to executives, colleagues, and guests. Working Model Full-time, five days per week in the office in our Miami, FL office. Position requires consistent on-site presence to support workplace operations and employee experience Role involves regular interaction with colleagues, leaders, clients, visitors, vendors, and workplace partners How this opportunity is different This role is ideal for a highly organized, service-oriented professional who enjoys working in a dynamic office environment, excels at creating positive experiences for others, and thrives in a role that blends administrative support, workplace operations, and concierge-level service. Administrative Support Provide proactive administrative support to assigned colleagues and business leaders, managing calendars, scheduling meetings, coordinating priorities, and responding to ad hoc requests with accuracy and professionalism. Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage expense reporting, reconciliation, and tracking to ensure timely and accurate processing. Organize virtual, in-person, and off-site meetings, including invitations, conference rooms, technology, materials, catering, agendas, meeting notes, decisions, and follow-up action items. Prepare, format, print, and distribute business documents, presentations, correspondence, reports, and other materials while maintaining a high level of quality, confidentiality, and attention to detail. What the day will look like Workplace & Location Services Operations: Coordinate meeting rooms, room setup, audiovisual technology, meeting materials, catering, and other office logistics to support seamless meetings and workplace activities. Support reception and visitor services, including registration, badging, greeting, escorting guests, and creating a professional and welcoming experience. Maintain workplace readiness by monitoring meeting rooms, common areas, amenities, office supplies, mail, packages, and occupancy needs. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve workplace issues promptly and support consistent, high-quality office experience. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Executive & On-Site Support Coordinate executive meetings, schedules, visits, and special requests, ensuring seamless logistics and a professional experience. Anticipate executive needs, prioritize urgent requests, and prepare meeting materials, presentations, and other support resources with discretion and accuracy. Support on-site meetings, office events, and employee or client-facing activities, including room setup, registration, signage, technology, materials, and catering. Provide a hospitality-focused experience by welcoming executives, clients, and visitors and supporting smooth day-of event execution. Partner with Marketing & Events and other stakeholders on larger events, including coordination, teardown, follow-up activities, and restoring workplace readiness. Organization & Execution Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and requests in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high service standards. Customer Service & Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, client-focused, and hospitality-oriented approach. Ability to build positive relationships and confidently interact with senior executives, clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders. Problem Solving & Ownership Proactive problem solver with strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to anticipate needs and identify effective solutions. Demonstrates accountability, ownership, adaptability, and flexibility when responding to changing business needs and priorities. Technology Proficiency Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience with expense management, travel booking, visitor management, scheduling platforms, and other workplace technology, with the ability to quickly learn new tools. Success Measures Deliver timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative and workplace support with strong responsiveness to requests, issues, and escalations. Ensure seamless coordination of meetings, executive/VIP visits, on-site events, and workplace logistics while maintaining a positive colleague, client, and visitor experience. Collaborate effectively across administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events to ensure clear handoffs and consistent service delivery. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $61,500 to $80,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-RW1 #LI-Office 2590917
