Job.JobTitle: Senior Casualty Claims Consultant - Virtual anywhere in US
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for a Senior Casualty Claims Consultant! We currently have a great career opportunity for a Casualty Claims Risk Consultant. It is the responsibility of the Casualty Claims Risk Consultant to deliver tactical, client specific, casualty claims services on assigned accounts in support of Aon’s core brokerage services. This position is for a workers’ compensation professional; however, experience with auto and general liability, is a plus. Work Style: Virtual work from Home. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. How this role is different The general role of our Casualty Claims Risk Consultant is to: Identify client exposures and provide customized casualty consulting services for clients to help them reduce their Total Cost of Risk. Ensuring the highest level of service from claims administrator(s) and carrier partners. Improve client claim outcomes by examining and analyzing key elements and related costs of their claims programs and build best practice-oriented approaches to claims cost containment. Introduce appropriate Aon resources and provide project management to ensure commitments are met and results are achieved. Establish project plans and budgets. May require limited involvement in business development opportunities as dictated by geographic needs. Skills and experience that will lead to success Demonstrated expertise in workers’ compensation claims management, with knowledge of casualty lines including auto and general liability, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client outcomes. Strong relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, advocate for clients, and collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, TPAs, Account Executives, and internal partners. Experience developing and executing strategic service plans, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality consulting services on time and in alignment with client objectives. Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate claims data, identify trends, conduct claim reviews, and recommend strategies that improve claim outcomes and reduce total cost of risk. Proven project management and process improvement capabilities, including managing multiple priorities, documenting action plans, applying best practices, and driving consistent service delivery. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, along with strong written and verbal communication skills and a commitment to continuous professional development. Minimum qualifications and requirements Proven performer with strong technical knowledge and work experience adjusting or managing workers compensation claims or possess multi-line claims experience with emphasis on casualty lines of coverage. Retain proficiency as an insurance professional while maintaining clear and effective communication, both in writing and verbally. Fluent in Microsoft office suite, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Minimum education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience Producer/Broker licensing may be required after hiring Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $126,735 to $140,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-RW1 #LI-REMOTE 2583908

Job.JobDescription:
Considering a job change? Take a look at Aon! Our Commercial Risk team in Ohio is looking for an Account Manager II. This hybrid opportunity can be based out of our Cleveland, Columbus, or Cincinnati office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like:    Partner with Account Executives on assigned book of business, manage day-to-day service processes and outputs, support a variety of strategic, client-facing initiatives, and run point on each client’s renewal cycle, ensuring a positive and productive client experience.     Skills that will lead to success:   Maintains effective and positive relationships with clients. Serves independently in a client-facing capacity on matters of moderate importance and complexity.  Facilitates the timely and accurate flow of information between clients and account team members, keeping all parties informed.  Handles client open items lists and respond to client ad-hoc requests.  Gathers and analyzes data and drafts assigned elements of stewardship reports and other convincing presentations tailored to the needs of the audience and the circumstances of the presentation.  Actively supports and monitors the renewal process, engaging with account team members as necessary. Makes draft quote comparisons and collaborates with Account Coordinators to oversee the saving of binders, policies, and endorsements.  Where applicable, serves as the primary point of contact with Aon Client Services (ACS), coordinating activities of the client service team and ACS to ensure that key processes assigned are performed efficiently and quality of client deliverables.  Primary collaborator with Premium Accounting on client billing matters.  Receives and handles routine and sophisticated coverage inquiries and endorsement requests.  Serves as key client liaison for items such as certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals.  Monitors invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections. Addresses and resolves problems.  May provide guidance and mentoring to a less senior account specialist. Delegates work to support staff and ACS where applicable.  Ensures tools are understood and used. Performs related duties as assigned.  Education and Experience:  3+ years of insurance experience required (preferably within Commercial Risk and in an Account Management role) Active Property & Casualty Insurance license required Ability to maintain effective and positive relationships with clients and colleagues Effective organization and time management skills Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing Effective presentation skills Ability to handle multiple, non-congruent tasks simultaneously Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $70,000 - $90,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2584719

SVP/VP – Network Evaluation Methodology & Discount Aon is seeking a Senior Vice President / Vice President to lead the strategy, design and continuous advancement of our network evaluation methodologies, models and analytics. This role will serve as the primary methodological architect for Network Analytics and as a key strategic partner to the Network Health Analytics Leader. This role will set the roadmap for Aon’s network evaluation framework, ensuring our analytics are rigorous, scalable and differentiated in the market. This role will work closely with actuarial, data science, engineering, clinical and consulting leaders to turn complex analytics into client‑ready solutions that support network, pricing and value‑based care strategies. This is a hybrid role with flexibility to work virtually and/or from an Aon office, with preference for Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, New York, or other major Aon locations. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Support the evolution and growth of network analytics capabilities by contributing to solution development, product enhancements, AI-enabled use case development, and analytics partnerships. Lead the design and maintenance of Aon’s core network evaluation methodology, including: Final sign-off on UDS data and methodology Evolution of next generation Total cost‑of‑care analyses Ongoing development of alternative and emerging health plan evaluation framework including but not limited to narrow/high-performing networks, ACOs, carveout centers of excellence, primary care-led arrangements, cost/quality steerage arrangements, and other value-based and/or emerging models Act as national point-of-contact with carriers for UDS data and discount methodology Develop and enhance analytic models and tools that support: Opportunity quantification, benchmarking and scenario testing for network strategies. Evaluation of financial proposals for traditional, alternative and emerging health plans and networks Incorporation of price‑transparency, provider quality, and other emerging data sources into Aon’s network evaluation capabilities. Partner with data engineering, data science and actuarial teams to: Translate methods into scalable data pipelines, algorithms and interactive tools. Define data requirements and quality rules for network analytics. Client-facing and external support: Advise on solution design for large/complex clients and strategic opportunities. Participate in client and prospect meetings to showcase explain analytic capabilities and methods. Showcase and present on analytics capabilities and market trends at both internal and external events. Participate in growth-related activities including development of consulting materials, sales materials, leading national trainings, training and organizing sales resources. Stay current on emerging trends and industry developments, propose new capabilities or suggestions to revamp existing capabilities to meet emerging client needs. Stay current on leading edge vendor and partner capabilities. Lead and develop a small team of network evaluation specialists: Review technical work product and ensure accuracy and clarity. Coach and mentor junior staff in methods, tools and best practices. Collaborate across Aon (Commercial Analytics, Actuarial, Innovation, Clinical, Aon Business Services) to ensure consistent use of network analytics in broader solutions and contribute to internal and external thought leadership. Skills and experience that will lead to success Minimum 8–10 years of experience in health care consulting, health plan, or related environment with significant responsibility for UDS / discount methodology, network measurement, provider contracting analytics, or value‑based care program evaluation. Hands‑on experience evaluating medical provider networks, including traditional and emerging health plans, ACOs/CINs, high‑performance and tiered networks, narrow networks, and value‑based arrangements. Demonstrated experience designing or governing analytic methodologies, models or products (e.g., pricing/underwriting, network evaluation, risk adjustment). Strong proficiency working with large health claims and encounter datasets; familiarity with provider quality data and coding standards (CPT, DRG, ICD‑10‑PCS). Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non‑technical audiences, including senior business and clinical leaders. Experience working with multi‑disciplinary teams (actuarial, data science, engineering, product, consulting) to build and scale analytic solutions. Working knowledge of regulatory and market trends affecting network analytics (e.g., price transparency, Affordable Care Act provisions). Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Proven ability to coach and develop junior technical talent. Working knowledge for Python + SQL Ability to travel approximately 10–20% of the time. Education Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Health Policy or related field required. Actuarial credentials (ASA/FSA) required. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is looking for a Customer Service Specialist II! As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Aon Affinity Healthcare Model Office in Fort Washington, PA. This is a hybrid position, working out of our Fort Washington, PA office twice a week. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the World. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. Aon is looking for a Private Client Account Executive. As part of an industry-leading team, responsible for the day-to-day account management and broking of complex personal insurance programs for affluent clients and families, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting our APRM group. This position is virtual role, based in California. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Manages an assigned book of high-net-worth personal insurance clients with personal insurance portfolios of varying size and complexity. May also include Group Excess Liability programs. Work to build, expand, and solidify relationships with existing clients and prospective clients. Leads appropriate resources to address the client/prospective client's risk needs, thereby retaining and growth a profitable book of business. Promotes the value that Aon delivers to clients through superior service, pricing, consultation, and reporting. Brokers and maintains required insurance policies and risk management solutions on behalf of clients. Conducts annual reviews for clients ahead of key renewal dates. Coordinates all client-related billing matters and maintains aged receivables reports. Works with Client Services team and assigned Coordinator to process changes and other client requests in a timely manner. Maintains awareness of all large and potentially complicated claim-related matters and assists in the negotiation of equitable claim settlements on behalf of clients. Engages internal and external resources as required in order to Empower Results on behalf of our clients. Achieves assigned annual revenue growth and retention metrics. Supports growth of book of business through rounding of accounts and through new business production. The time service standard: returning a phone call within 24 hours and responding to email by end of the day. Develops and maintains meaningful working relationships with insurers, clients, referral sources, and colleagues through regular contact and interaction. Maintains awareness of all insurance carrier partner products, services, and systems. Fully utilizes internal client management system to maintain policies, client correspondence, coordinate billing activities, and management client related tasks. Achieves assigned transparency, disclosure, and compliance goals and fosters innovative solutions to drive success for our clients. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Property and Casualty Broker's License required. 5-10 years of high net-worth personal insurance experience required. Appropriate insurance designations such as: CPCU, CIC,CPRM, CPRIA,AFIS or ARM completed or in process is preferred. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience. How we support our colleagues: In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $115,000 to $135,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Job.JobDescription:
Early Careers: Human Capital Mergers & Acquisitions – Associate Project Manager Interested in a career in Mergers & Acquisitions? If you enjoy building relationships with clients and colleagues, analyzing data, and driving innovation, apply today to join Aon’s Mergers & Acquisitions team! As part of an industry-leading team within our M&A and Transaction Solutions business group, you will help advise clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions. Location: St. Louis, MO Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Assist with leading and supporting M&A human capital due diligence engagements Work directly with private equity or corporate clients as well as their other outside advisors which include tax, legal and financial advisors. Coordinate with internal resources including health, retirement and talent teams, actuarial and financial experts, originators and other team members to develop diligence findings and solutions Assist with managing and executing client deliverables including an end-of-project report, interim email updates, and phone conversations Analyze employee demographics, health plan insurance coverage and claims history, retirement programs, executive compensation, worker classification, ERISA compliance, and the people-related matters of the draft purchase agreement and disclosures Work with and assist originators in establishing client relationships, developing new business opportunities, and converting due diligence targets to ongoing clients Assist with providing ongoing relationship management oversight to private equity clients Help prepare proposals and make presentations to clients How this opportunity is different Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term broking and advisory career through: On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists. Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness. Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations. Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path. Skills and experience that will lead to success We are looking for collaborators, critical thinkers, problem solvers, excellent teammates, effective communicators, relationship builders, and future leaders. We strive to recruit a diverse group of hardworking individuals who offer varying experiences, backgrounds, and strengths to ensure we can continue to offer the most innovative solutions. Additionally, we take into consideration the following: Ability to work on multiple projects at one time Project management – coordinate activities and information flow from a group of people within specified time frames Strategic and analytical skills – attention to detail while also being able to draw connections in order to provide overall conclusions Strong verbal and written communication skills – ability to communicate well and at the appropriate level with a wide range of colleagues Interest in learning about human capital solutions and how they apply to businesses of all sizes and industries Ability to perform under stress / tight time frames Ability to develop relationships / build confidence of others (both internally and externally) based upon work performed Financial – basic understanding of financial statements, reports, and accounting Results oriented Proficiency with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Preferred Experience Background in human resources, M&A, health and benefits analytics, or business administration and management Experience working in both office and virtual settings Education & Application Information Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally with a major in Business Administration, Business Management, or HR Management, though all majors are welcome. College Seniors graduating between Spring 2026 to Spring 2027 with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 Please Note: For this role you must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Job.JobTitle: Health Benefit Solutions Assistant Vice President
Job.JobDescription:
Are you intellectually curious with a passion to solve problems? Do you enjoy a flexible and collaborative, team-based environment where you are always learning and growing? If yes, Aon is the company for you! As part of a leading global professional services firm, you will empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting health and welfare benefits strategies. We are building our Health Solutions team with the best talent and will consider great candidates in Tampa or Miami, FL. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from a local office. What the day will look like As an Assistant Vice President, you are the Lead Consultant on the Health Solutions client team supporting the Account Executive and responsible for timely, accurate, and quality service of all client deliverables. In this position you will act as the primary day-to-day contact for clients and oversee the client team and project management. The Health Solutions Assistant Vice President will collaborate with the client Account Executive to facilitate execution of overall strategy plus special projects as needed. This position includes delegation of assignments to team members and peer review of their work, but also involves being actively involved in performing analysis, drafting client presentations, participating in client meetings, and identifying client needs for other services. Additionally, the Assistant Vice President will: Lead integrated efforts of internal Aon teams such as actuarial, audit, legal, and specialized broking teams Foster the overall relationship with the client’s vendor partners Maintain an understanding of healthcare market trends and innovation Leverage the right resources to resolve client issues Mentor, coach, and guide junior staff How this opportunity is different What makes Aon different are the people and the culture. Aon colleagues support each other across geographies and solution lines. Aon has the tools plus depth and breadth of experience to drive great outcomes for our clients, while providing the optimal environment for the career and personal growth of our colleagues. Skills and experience that will lead to success Ten plus years of experience in the group health and benefits industry with a strong working knowledge of benefits Excellent organizational and project management skills with strong attention to detail Ability to handle multiple projects at one time Strong analytical and presentation skills Advanced level of proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint and Excel) Project Management, Consulting, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Analysis, Health Care Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience Must have appropriate insurance license/life and health (can be fulfilled post-hire) Project management certification is a plus Pay Transparency The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $107,000 to $143,000.00 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Tampa, FL. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. Job.JobDescription:
We are looking to add a Risk Finance Leader to Aon! Are you passionate about helping organisations make better risk and capital decisions? Do you have the vision to build the future of risk financing across one of the world's leading professional services firms? Join Aon as Head of Risk Finance Consulting and play a pivotal role in defining and delivering our client-facing risk capital strategy across the region. Our global Risk Finance team helps large multinational organisations quantify, finance, and optimise their risk exposures to improve resilience, capital efficiency and business performance. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from any US Aon office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As Head of Risk Finance Consulting, you will set the strategic direction for Aon's risk finance proposition across the region. Combining client engagement, business growth, innovation, and leadership, you will help large multinational organisations better understand, quantify, and finance their risk exposures, connecting clients to specialist broking expertise to execute on complex and innovative deal structures. Key responsibilities include: Owning the Risk Financing strategy and growth agenda across the region. Partnering with colleagues across Commercial Risk Solutions, Industry Practices and Client Leadership teams to bring innovative risk financing solutions to clients. Supporting business development activity, including major client pursuits and tenders, by articulating the value and differentiation of Aon's risk financing capabilities. Driving the development and deployment of next-generation analytics tools and solutions, including Risk Financing Analytics (RFA). Providing thought leadership and delivering risk insights that help clients make better business decisions. Building, leading, mentoring and developing a team of highly skilled risk financing professionals. How this opportunity is different This is a opportunity to influence the future direction of Aon's risk capital capabilities across the region. You will work closely with senior leaders to shape strategy, drive innovation, and accelerate growth. You will collaborate with experts across risk consulting, broking, analytics, and industry practices, helping clients navigate some of the most significant and sophisticated risks facing organisations today. Combining strategic leadership, client engagement, innovation and commercial impact, this role offers outstanding visibility and the opportunity to build solutions that support some of the world's leading businesses. Skills and experience that will lead to success Significant experience in risk financing, analytics, capital modelling, or risk consulting gained within a consulting, insurance, reinsurance or related professional services environment. Demonstrated success leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams across multiple geographies. Strong partner management and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior executives, clients, and business leaders. Highly numerate with a degree in a quantitative field; a postgraduate qualification or relevant professional designation would be helpful. Education: Bachelor’s degree in or equivalent years of industry experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $285,000 to $325,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-CC1 #LI-HYBRID 2590408

Benefit Analyst As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Consumer Benefit Solutions group in Hammonton, New Jersey. As a Benefit Analyst you will report directly to the Sr. Director, Client Services or Director, Client Services. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Hammonton, New Jersey offices. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Consults with each assigned Client to provide guidance on what documentation Aon requires be provided for Aon to convert all Client benefit information into the Aon Plan Design Document (PDD), which functions as the documentation to support custom programming for each Client’s enrollment application. Analyzes clients benefits offerings/SPD’s to ensure eligibility rules and plan details are translated into both the PDD and into the Client training curriculum Develops the Aon Plan Design Document (PDD) for each client, utilizing extensive benefits knowledge and understanding of the client’s specific plans; primarily responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the PDD and communications screens for each assigned case Partners with the assigned Account Manager to manage the implementation major milestones, and interact with Client Human Resources/Benefits Department and Technology personnel to ascertain all employee benefit plan specifics. Steps in to manage Account Management tasks when they are on planned or unplanned PTO. Works closely with the Aon Technology division to build the enrollment application to ensure a successful enrollment experience for the Client. Interacts with internal implementation team members to help ensure a successful enrollment experience for each Client. Interacts with various insurance carriers to ascertain voluntary product specifics. Responsible for confirmation of all voluntary benefit offers, commission documentation and requested case set up documents. Completes Testing Criteria Documents for each case prior to the testing phase of each case for distribution amongst the team. Tests enrollment program for each case prior to enrollment starting. Leads all user testing initiatives, responsible for tracking all issues, ensuring resolution and the overall organization of the entire testing process. Performs the system demo with the client/broker prior to enrollment start date Builds Training curriculum and define training plan. Facilitates training with the Case Managers and/or Counselors before the start of each individual case. Sets priorities and manages work flow to ensure efficient, timely and accurate processing of transactions and other responsibilities. Maintain a cordial and effective relationship with clients, co-workers, carriers, vendors and other business contacts. Keeps informed regarding industry information, new product information, legislation, coverages and technology to continuously improve knowledge and performance. Interact with others effectively by utilizing good communication skills, cooperating purposefully and providing information and guidance, as needed, to achieve the business goals of the company How this opportunity is different A competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization. Skills and experience that will lead to success 1+ year Benefits plan administration background 1+ year customer service background Strong functional knowledge of Excel specific to creating, formatting and evaluating formulas and working within templates. Must be proficient in Excel, Word and other MS Office products along with Adobe products. Strong written, oral and interpersonal communication skills. Advanced problem solving and critical thinking skills. Ability to manage and negotiate multiple priorities and deadlines. Account Management - Experienced; Document Management - Experienced Preferred Experience Hold and maintain and Active Health and Life Insurance License Industry recognized benefits designations. Sharepoint knowledge Education: HS Diploma required. Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent years of industry experience. Pay Transparency: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $45,000 - $59,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon Is Looking for a Senior Associate Consultant, Executive Compensation, Rewards Solutions Aon's Rewards Solutions, is the industry leader, providing advice and benchmarking to companies to address their toughest HR and rewards challenges: attracting, engaging and retaining talent! Our advisors provide industry-specific expertise, applying an analytical approach that integrates market data, trends and our experience in working with nearly 2,000 companies – from Global 1000 firms to start-ups – to balance the needs of executives, employees and shareholders! Their advice is customized to their client's outstanding situation to ensure rewards programs are not just driven - but can be a competitive advantage. We currently have an exciting career opportunity in our Executive Compensation Consulting practice in our San Francisco, CA office. In this role, you are refining and applying your knowledge of compensation design and implementation practices to deliver high quality and effective client solutions. You will lead projects with minimum direction from more experienced consultants and/or serve as a team member for larger, more sophisticated client engagements. Additionally, you will be primarily delivering billable client work but will support selling efforts and be a part of proposal teams. Aon is looking for an Office Operations & Administrative Specialist! Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the Day Will Look Like The Office Operations & Administrative Specialist is a full-time, office-based role within Aon United Administrative Operations organization responsible for delivering exceptional workplace experience for colleagues, clients, and visitors. This position combines administrative support, office operations, workplace services, and concierge-level assistance to ensure a seamless and productive environment. Serving as a visible and trusted on-site resource, the Office Operations & Administrative Specialist plays a critical role in supporting day-to-day business operations, enhancing workplace efficiency, and providing high-touch service to executives, colleagues, and guests. Working Model Full-time, five days per week in the office in our Tampa, FL office. Position requires consistent on-site presence to support workplace operations and employee experience Role involves regular interaction with colleagues, leaders, clients, visitors, vendors, and workplace partners How this opportunity is different This role is ideal for a highly organized, service-oriented professional who enjoys working in a dynamic office environment, excels at creating positive experiences for others, and thrives in a role that blends administrative support, workplace operations, and concierge-level service. Administrative Support Provide proactive administrative support to assigned colleagues and business leaders, managing calendars, scheduling meetings, coordinating priorities, and responding to ad hoc requests with accuracy and professionalism. Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage expense reporting, reconciliation, and tracking to ensure timely and accurate processing. Organize virtual, in-person, and off-site meetings, including invitations, conference rooms, technology, materials, catering, agendas, meeting notes, decisions, and follow-up action items. Prepare, format, print, and distribute business documents, presentations, correspondence, reports, and other materials while maintaining a high level of quality, confidentiality, and attention to detail. What the day will look like Workplace & Location Services Operations: Coordinate meeting rooms, room setup, audiovisual technology, meeting materials, catering, and other office logistics to support seamless meetings and workplace activities. Support reception and visitor services, including registration, badging, greeting, escorting guests, and creating a professional and welcoming experience. Maintain workplace readiness by monitoring meeting rooms, common areas, amenities, office supplies, mail, packages, and occupancy needs. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve workplace issues promptly and support consistent, high-quality office experience. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Executive & On-Site Support Coordinate executive meetings, schedules, visits, and special requests, ensuring seamless logistics and a professional experience. Anticipate executive needs, prioritize urgent requests, and prepare meeting materials, presentations, and other support resources with discretion and accuracy. Support on-site meetings, office events, and employee or client-facing activities, including room setup, registration, signage, technology, materials, and catering. Provide a hospitality-focused experience by welcoming executives, clients, and visitors and supporting smooth day-of event execution. Partner with Marketing & Events and other stakeholders on larger events, including coordination, teardown, follow-up activities, and restoring workplace readiness. Organization & Execution Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and requests in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high service standards. Customer Service & Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, client-focused, and hospitality-oriented approach. Ability to build positive relationships and confidently interact with senior executives, clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders. Problem Solving & Ownership Proactive problem solver with strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to anticipate needs and identify effective solutions. Demonstrates accountability, ownership, adaptability, and flexibility when responding to changing business needs and priorities. Technology Proficiency Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience with expense management, travel booking, visitor management, scheduling platforms, and other workplace technology, with the ability to quickly learn new tools. Success Measures Deliver timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative and workplace support with strong responsiveness to requests, issues, and escalations. Ensure seamless coordination of meetings, executive/VIP visits, on-site events, and workplace logistics while maintaining a positive colleague, client, and visitor experience. Collaborate effectively across administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events to ensure clear handoffs and consistent service delivery. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for a Customer Service Specialist I As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions. This role has the flexibility to be based in Fort Washington, PA with a hybrid schedule (preferred) or 100% remote. Your impact as a Customer Service Specialist I Job Responsibilities: Handle inbound and outbound calls via 800 lines with multi-product portfolio- Professional Liability products. Respond to customer communications via email and written correspondence. Maintain service, quality and timeliness standards. Interact with other departments on various projects including new programs, products and technology. Support knowledge management transfer within the department through training, quality and intranet projects. Evaluate individual customers’ needs and propose additional insurance products based on personal and business needs. Maintains customer records by updating account or policy information and reconcile client payments against the policy administration system. Required Experience: Possess an active Property & Casualty Producer license is required. Candidates will not be considered if they do not have a P&C license. 1-3 years experience in customer service/call center/sales and service supporting multiple insurance products and/or financial services products. Experience with Professional Liability insurance for healthcare professionals. Demonstrated skills and abilities to be goal oriented and solve complex issues. Strong multi-tasker. Experience with CRM- Customer Relationship Management System preferred. Demonstrated ability in handling details and key follow up capability. Strong PC skills with solid knowledge based in Word, Excel and PowerPoint software. Ability to identify process efficiencies and handle daily activities in a thorough and accurate fashion. Ability to think critically and use sound judgment when serving clients. Demonstrated relationship-building skills evaluating individual insurance needs and offering appropriate products/solutions. Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant field, or equivalent work experience. How we support our colleagues: In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working! Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Director – Contracts - Reinsurance This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Chicago, IL or Bloomington, MN office Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Joining Aon's Reinsurance Solutions team, you will take charge of preparing, examining, and completing formal documentation that captures the terms and conditions related to treaty reinsurance arrangements. You will be motivated to continuously learn and stay current with industry expressions, conditions, trends, and regulatory changes. Role Responsibilities Support hiring, workforce planning, and talent development to ensure suitable staffing, technical knowledge, and capabilities within the department. Prepare complex reinsurance contracts and review the work of supporting Contract Drafters, ensuring technical quality, accuracy, and consistency. Manage and develop team of supporting Contract Drafters, offering technical mentorship, quality oversight, mentoring, feedback, and support for colleague development. Participate in client, reinsurer, and broker meetings, providing wording expertise in the development and interpretation of contract language. Apply deep understanding of reinsurance structures and intent to guide brokers and clients in developing and interpreting contract language covering complex coverage builds and potential loss scenarios. Partner with brokers during placement negotiations to join client discussions regarding wording provisions addressing emerging risks and specific client concerns. Support business growth and strengthen client advocacy through RFP participation, competitor wording reviews, and recommendations for coverage and contract improvements for new and existing clients. Maintain a solid grasp of evolving insurance, reinsurance, and risk management market conditions and keep brokers and clients updated on pertinent developments. Serve as a senior subject-matter expert on reinsurance contract wordings, offering mentorship and recommendations to brokers and clients. Manage departmental projects and initiatives passionate about improving contract processes, capabilities, consistency, and client service. Develop training materials and deliver internal technical training on reinsurance contract wording, market trends, and guidelines within the department. Contribute to the Annual Global Client Training Summit by presenting to clients and preparing materials on reinsurance contract wording trends, market developments, and possible coverage or contract improvements. Support multiline reinsurance business for Global and US clients. Skills and experience that will lead to success Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Legal Studies, Risk Management, a related field, or equivalent years of industry experience. A minimum of 8 years in insurance or reinsurance, working as a lawyer/attorney or contract/policy specialist, with preference for experience in reinsurance structures. Experience drafting and interpreting treaty wordings for domestic and global placements is preferred. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $130,000 to $190,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-AR1 #LI-HYBRID 2589278

Aon is looking for a Broker II, Healthcare Practice As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective risk transfer solutions as part of our National Health Care Practice Group. As a Broker II, you will report directly to senior leadership of the National Health Care Practice. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Instrumental in working closely with Healthcare Producers and Account Executives on new business opportunities and RFPs to help drive revenue growth for the Healthcare Practice Works closely with the Aon Mergers & Acquisitions team who have the PE relationships where these PE firms are targeting healthcare organizations for continued revenue growth opportunities Professional who develops and manages client relationships, account strategies and insurance and reinsurance marketing client programs. Acts as the primary negotiator in obtaining the most effective insurance programs to address client needs. Thorough analysis of current risk transfer programs to include coverage and cost analysis and a graphical representation of the program. Includes a thorough review of the client’s loss runs and creates a comprehensive, consolidated loss run to provide to the underwriters. Develop robust underwriting submissions to send to the underwriters Insurance and reinsurance program structure planning and design of alternatives based on client objectives. Provide benchmarking reports related to limits and programs. Sound knowledge of alternative risk financing and program design as it relates to Trusts, Captives and Risk Retention Groups; development of alternative risk financing projects and programs and their implementation. Prepare all marketplace re/insurance submissions, coordinate and conduct market meetings and negotiations as appropriate in coordination with Account Executive. Finalize all risk transfer quotes and complete a thorough comparison of program options as part of the client proposal presentation. Comparison to include changes in exposure, losses, coverage terms and conditions and cost of risk. Development and review of issued policy certificate and/or certificate language, including consulting around wording for captive policies. Represent Aon through periodic participation in speaking engagements aimed at business development; provide responses when requested for industry publications. Develop direct market relationships beyond routine placement activities through carrier meetings Serves as a source for information concerning market trends, pricing practices and other underwriting policies. Provides guidance and mentorship to more junior staff. Travel as appropriate for client and underwriting meetings (approx. 25%) Skills and experience that will lead to success Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Power Point; At least 10& years of placement / broking experience or comparable experience in the health care industry segment (i.e. underwriting, claims, etc.). Good working knowledge of the broking business. Superior written and communication skills to support conduct of business in a professional manner with external/internal clients and the marketplace. Strong team player who understands the roles and responsibilities of other Aon professionals, assumes responsibility for the timely delivery of a professional work product in accordance with assigned roles, and facilitates communication among team members. Job.JobTitle: Account Executive Practice Leader, Pacific Northwest
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for an Account Executive Practice Leader for our Commercial Risk team in the Pacific Northwest As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting Risk for our clients in the Pacific Northwest. Aon is in the business of better decisions As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like The Account Executive Practice Leader is primarily responsible for leading talent development and driving growth across the AE Local Practice. Accountable to the Market Leader to deliver retention and rollover goals for the office as well as new business from the Account Executive (AE) Local Practice. This responsibility may extend beyond direct AE reporting. By driving individual goal achievement, the AE Leader helps the office and Commercial Risk attain aggregate business goals. This role promotes the value Aon delivers to clients. Job Responsibilities: Support Account Executive’s effective alignment with the Aon Leadership Model. Educates Account Executives and Account Managers directly and by assisting with training plans in client management, risk management, insurer interface and Aon resources, processes and tools. The Account Executive Leader will help Account Executives marshal appropriate Aon resources to support retention and sales efforts and to assist clients. Teaming with Sales & Marketing and drives Account Executive efforts on new and penetration sales, including collaboration with originators. The Account Executive Leader raises AE awareness of and skills to introduce all of Aon’s products, services and specialty expertise. The Account Executive Practice Leader will work closely with the Pacific Northwest Market Leader, to lead critical client management efforts following established guidelines including Strategic Account Review, Fee Field and Client Return to Profitability Planning. Performs related duties as assigned. Skills and experience that will lead to success Typically, at least 7-10 years of appropriate insurance experience, coupled with managerial ability. Strong project and account management experience, and strong negotiation skills. In-depth proven understanding of the insurance business and the assigned clients’ needs as well as all major lines of business. Proficiency in PC office products such as Word, Excel. PowerPoint, and outlook is required. Evidence of ability to become proficient in the use of Aon specific software tools. Job.JobTitle: Account Manager II, Aon Natural Resources - Hybrid/Houston, TX
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Considering a job change? Take a look at Aon! Our Natural Resources team in Houston is seeking an Account Manager to support our clients in the dynamic Energy and Natural Resources sector. This is a hybrid role based out of our Houston, TX office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Our Energy & Natural Resources group helps organizations across oil & gas, power, renewables, mining, and other natural resource industries understand and manage their evolving risks. As part of the team, you’ll build relationships with clients, collaborate with experienced colleagues, and help deliver solutions that support their business goals. Why Join Aon’s Energy & Natural Resources Team? You’ll have the opportunity to work with leading organizations across the energy industry while building your expertise in a dynamic and evolving market. You’ll be part of a collaborative team where your ideas and contributions are valued, with opportunities to strengthen client relationships, expand your knowledge, and make an impact for clients and colleagues. What Your Day Will Look Like: Partner with Account Executives and Associate Account Executives to support clients across oil & gas, power, renewables, mining, and other natural resource industries. Coordinate client-facing and internal activities to provide responsive, high-quality service and keep client priorities moving forward. Collaborate with Brokers to support Commercial Risk business and help address clients’ insurance and risk management needs. Prepare client submissions and coordinate the timely and accurate exchange of information between clients and the account team. Respond to client requests and follow up on open items, helping clients navigate questions related to their operations and risk needs. Gather and analyze information for stewardship reports and presentations, providing meaningful insights that support client conversations. Play an active role in the renewal process by preparing quote comparisons and following up on binders, policies, and endorsements. Partner with Aon Client Services and Premium Accounting to support client billing needs and maintain accurate account information. Manage coverage inquiries and endorsement requests, including certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals. Monitor invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections while helping resolve client questions in a timely manner. Share your knowledge and experience with developing account specialists and support colleagues as they grow their insurance expertise. Skills That Will Lead to Success: Ability to build strong, collaborative relationships with clients and colleagues. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make insurance information understandable and relevant to a variety of audiences. Analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in understanding client needs, risk, and evolving industry trends. Education and Experience: 5+ years of insurance experience required; experience supporting energy, natural resources, or complex commercial accounts is a plus. Property & Casualty broker’s license preferred, or ability to obtain within 120 days of the start date. High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree preferred. Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $85,000 - $95,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2587544

Review, evaluate and approve insurance applications and related documents. Follow up with client or agent on pending information needed for a complete submission following the specific guidelines for the cash with application program. Prepare files for renewal solicitation. Verify accounts are still within the parameters of underwriting guidelines. Order loss runs and send non-renewals as needed. Assist in review and assignments of e-mails in unit shared e-mail boxes, including e-commerce websites (transaction confirmations). Meet minimum performance standards determined by Key Performance Indicators. Support a tier based phone support system answering calls from agents or insured’s as needed. Ability to work with frequent and multiple policy, procedure, and regulation changes. Proficiency at keying alpha and numeric information with accuracy and speed. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Customer Service experience including verbal/telephone skills. 1- 2 years Insurance industry experience preferred Strong organizational and interpersonal skills with attention to detail. Ability to work with frequent and multiple policy, procedure, and regulation changes. Proficiency at keying alpha and numeric information with accuracy and speed. Knowledge of basic equipment functions, such as how to create and maintain files, printing, copying, faxing, phone messaging and voicemail. Education: High School Diploma or Equivalent. College Degree preferred. How we support our colleagues: In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working! Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. We welcome applications from all and provide individuals with disabilities with reasonable adjustments to participate in the job application, interview process and to perform essential job functions once onboard.
