Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Do you have experience in Commercial Risk? Are you an inquisitive, organized, meticulous individual who would like to apply their experience to our dynamic and engaging industry? If so, this may be the next step in your career! The Account Manager II role is hybrid and based out of our Norwalk, CT office. Aon is in the business of better decisions.   At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.   As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.   What the day will look like:   Partner with Account Executives on assigned book of business, manage day-to-day service processes and outputs, support a variety of strategic, client-facing initiatives, and run point on each client’s renewal cycle, ensuring a positive and productive client experience.   How this opportunity is different What makes this opportunity different is the combination of meaningful client impact and Aon’s collaborative culture. In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across geographies and solution lines, leveraging Aon’s tools and deep expertise to deliver great outcomes for clients—while benefiting from a supportive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, career development, and personal wellbeing.   Skills that will lead to success: Maintains effective and positive relationships with clients. Serves independently in a client-facing capacity on matters of moderate importance and complexity. Facilitates the timely and accurate flow of information between clients, and account team members, keeping all parties informed. Handles client open items lists and respond to client ad-hoc requests. Gathers and analyzes data and drafts assigned elements of stewardship reports and other convincing presentations tailored to the needs of the audience and the circumstances of the presentation. Actively supports and monitors the renewal process, engaging with account team members as necessary. May draft quote comparisons and is responsible for saving down binders, policies, and endorsements. Where applicable, serves as the primary point of contact with Aon Client Services (ACS), coordinating activities of the client service team and ACS to ensure that key processes assigned are performed efficiently and quality of client deliverables. Primary collaborator with Premium Accounting on client billing matters. Receives and handles routine and sophisticated coverage inquiries and endorsement requests. Serves as key client liaison for items such as certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals. Monitors and follows-up on invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections. Addresses and resolves problems. May provide guidance and mentoring to a less senior account specialist. Delegates work to support staff and ACS where applicable. Ensures tools are understood and used. Performs related duties as assigned. Education and Experience: 3+ years of insurance experience required (preferably within Commercial Risk and in an Account Management role) Active Property & Casualty Insurance license required Ability to maintain effective and positive relationships with clients and colleagues Effective organization and time management skills Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing Effective presentation skills Ability to handle multiple, non-congruent tasks simultaneously Pay Transparency Laws   The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $75,000 - $93,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.   Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.   Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.  #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2587838

Job.JobTitle: Account Executive - Assistant Vice President - Private Equity
Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to be a member of an industry-leading team? Do you want to deliver innovative and effective solutions to clients? If yes, then our Private Equity Account Executive role is the one for you. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from any of our Florida offices (Jacksonville, Miami or Tampa). Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What The Day Will Look Like Responsible for overall total rewards strategy, benefits consulting, vendor management, client service, and growth-related activities for designated clients and prospects. This position will have frequent interactions with clients’ HR, Benefits and Finance executives regarding the delivery of benefits consulting services. Leads client service teams to identify and meet client needs and thereby retain and grow a profitable book of business. Through service, pricing, consultation and reporting, promotes the value Aon delivers to clients. Handles predominantly (i.e., 70%+) small and mid-market clients. Additionally, the Account Executive - Assistant Vice President will: Develop employee benefits strategies, lead sophisticated benefits consulting projects, manage vendors, develop client reports, lead external meetings and internal resource coordination. Maintain and grow long-term client relationships through excellent service Display an in-depth understanding of the Health and Benefits marketplace, as well as Aon’s Health Solutions capabilities Possess experience and expertise in benefit plan design, rate analysis, strategy, RFP development and response review, insurance carrier negotiations, stewardship report preparation, benchmark analysis, client financial analysis and reporting and carrier contract reviews Demonstrate excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal collaboration skills Form effective teams, share client background and goals, measure results, share ideas, identify process improvements, provide timely and regular coaching and feedback to team members Exhibit thought leadership—understand and be able to articulate ideas to clients Marshal appropriate Aon resources to support client needs Assist with client acquisitions and benefit integrations Arrange Aon compensation for services, whether fee or commission-based, and ensure overall account profitability Skills to be successful in the role 7+ years of Health and Benefits background and 5+ plus years of benefits consulting/brokerage experience Client facing experience at a consulting company, insurance company, or brokerage focused on benefits and health services Business development experience Broad business knowledge/perspective Team building skills Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools Working understanding of the Private Equity industry is preferred Data Management, Meeting Facilitation, Project Management, Risk Management, Solutions Design, Benefits Administration, Workforce Strategy, Consulting, Customer Engagement, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Analysis Education Bachelor’s degree or applicable experience or equivalent years of industry experience Life/Accident/Health insurance license (or ability to learn license after hire) Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $107,000 to $143,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Miami, FL. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. #LI-HL2 #LI-HYBRID #USA_IND 2581237

Health Analytics Advisory Leader Are you ready to shape how sophisticated health analytics advise executive decision-making? Join Aon and help bring our analytics capabilities together to deliver clearer insights and greater impact for clients! This role may be based in Atlanta, Chicago, New York, or near another Aon office. Proximity to an Aon location is preferred; however, strong candidates who require greater virtual flexibility may also be considered. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As Lead for our Health Analytics Advisory team, you will serve as the senior client advisor and advance our impact delivering, packaging and scaling leading analytics insights content across a growing range of analytic domains. Your role sits at the intersection of client advisory, analytics content strategy, financial measurement, and health economics. It also involves total-cost-of-care optimization and advancing Aon’s data-driven, AI-enabled client delivery model. You will be the trusted voice clients and consultants rely on to interpret sophisticated analytics across many domains. You will also connect our financial, predictive modeling, health economics, clinical, pharmacy, network, and care delivery analytics into one clear set of client content and solutions. You will: Advise clients and prospects on sophisticated, cross-domain analytics, translating financial, predictive, clinical, pharmacy, network, and cost-of-care analyses into actionable guidance for HR, Finance, and C-suite audiences. Lead sophisticated client engagements that bring together multiple Aon capabilities, including Cost Efficiency Measurement, Health Risk Analyzer, data warehouse and informatics content, Financial Experience Monitoring, and emerging analytics solutions. Develop unified client-facing analytics content that integrates different areas of expertise while balancing consultant-led, subject-matter expert-led, automated, and AI-enabled delivery. Partner with leaders across data platforms, clinical, and pharmacy analytics, actuarial and financial analytics, networks, care delivery, data science, AI enablement, analytics engineering, and Centers of Excellence. Develop measurement approaches that quantify the financial, utilization, engagement, and clinical impact of benefit programs, point solutions, and other interventions. Create data-driven thought leadership, including white papers, trend studies, market analyses, vendor category assessments, and regulatory impact analyses. Provide senior technical and methodological review across analytics domains, ensuring client content is consistent, accurate, and ready for delivery. Mentor colleagues and support special projects requiring alignment across clinical, actuarial, financial, and network analytics. How this opportunity is different You'll partner closely with analytics domain leaders, consultants, and client leaders to bring together repeatable, scalable analytics with deep-dive domain expertise — building a shared content capability that raises the quality, consistency, and client impact of everything Aon delivers. You'll shape how we progressively deliver insight across the full client spectrum: from early-stage prospects with limited available data, to established clients with rich, longitudinal data ecosystems — and across employer segments of every size. Success in this role depends on deep credibility in health and benefits analytics. It also requires a genuine passion for client advisory, positive relationship skills, and rigor to turn sophisticated analysis into scalable content. The right candidate will have a track record of advising clients directly on sophisticated analytics decisions including evaluating health carriers, vendors, and point solutions, and bridging technical domains to produce unified, scalable models and deliverables. Skills and experience that will lead to success Extensive experience with U.S. healthcare data, employer benefits, and insurance. Demonstrable experience as a client-facing analytics advisor, with excellent writing and presentation skills — able to guide senior partners (C-suite, HR, Finance) through sophisticated, multi-domain analytics with clarity and confidence. Demonstrated ability to work across various analytics fields by building consensus among actuaries, analytics leaders, and clinical/pharmacy experts. You also unify content across groups with different methods and priorities. Experience in measurement and validation of healthcare programs, including financial, utilization, engagement, clinical outcomes, and metrics related to return on investment. Experience serving large/complex Fortune 500 organizations as well as developing scaled solutions for smaller and mid-market self-insured groups. Experience with the broader vendor ecosystem serving the self-insured employer — Health Plans, PBMs, emerging point solutions, chronic condition management programs, and data warehouses/analytics platforms. Demonstrated experience with statistical measurement, causal inference, and data science/predictive modeling techniques, including work with large health claims datasets (HIPAA, de-identification, data cleaning, exploratory analysis). Solid understanding of medical and pharmacy claims reporting and billing — including ICD-10, CPT, DRG, ICD-10 PCS, National Drug Codes, and CMS codes — sufficient to engage credibly with clinical and pharmacy domain leaders. Ability to review technical work product across domains and mentor junior technical staff, including analysts, data scientists, statisticians, and actuaries. Well-developed project management and planning skills, particularly coordinating content and work across multiple partner groups. Advanced degree or bachelor's with equivalent certification in Health Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, Epidemiology, or a related field is required. Candidates with equivalent experience are encouraged to apply. Ability to travel 10–20% is needed. Experience with recent AI transformation projects is a plus. Project Management, Python (Programming Language), R Programming, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Models, Structured Query Language (SQL), Business Planning, Conflict Resolution, Organizational Leadership, Organizational Strategy, Performance Management (PM), Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Talent Management, Team Development, Team Management, Training and Development, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Analysis, Data Integration, Data Management, Data Mining, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Language Models, Machine Learning (ML), Predictive Modeling Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $250,000 to $300,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-LC1 #LI-Executive #LI-HYBRID 2585947

Job.JobDescription:
Property and Casualty Insurance Strategy Consulting – Senior Associate This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our New York City or Chicago offices Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Strategy Advisory group within the Strategy & Technology Group (STG) vertical in Chicago, Illinois. Aon STG Strategy Advisory provides consulting services to firms who operate across the insurance landscape, which include many of the most prestigious companies in the Global Property, Casualty, Insurtech, Digital Platforms, and Health and Benefit (re)insurance market. We help our clients to navigate a fast-changing market environment to drive profitable and sustainable growth and business results. We have privileged access to Aon’s proprietary data and its global network of (re)insurance industry experts to derive unique and compelling insights into the sources of competitive advantage in our industry. Most importantly we help our clients to turn insights into practical actions and into tangible outcomes. As a Strategy Consulting Senior Associate, you will be in a client-facing role working closely with Client Leaders, Project Managers, and Aon Leadership. Your role will involve leading project work streams to deliver business focused initiatives and strategic recommendations for our clients through understanding their objectives, addressing their challenges, developing an understanding of market conditions and issues, and defining strategies that drive growth opportunities and competitive market advantages. In this role, you will: Contribute to full lifecycle client engagements by leading strategic initiatives, managing project workstreams, and developing strategic recommendations Deliver project workstreams and outputs, managing project team members, and mentoring colleagues outside of specific projects Lead workstreams with clients to develop approaches, methodologies, and transition strategies that will guide them to the objective future state Lead market research efforts, quantitative and qualitative analyses, to synthesize strategic recommendations for clients Take a lead role on analysis, initial story building, production of reports, client solutioning and other client deliverables Lead the facilitation of interviews with clients and Aon colleagues Identify and communicate recommendations to clients Manage the client relationship alongside other STG colleagues Work in a collaborative environment with clients and colleagues Challenge the status quo and internal processes to identify opportunities to work more efficiently Lead by strong example and take on additional responsibility as required Work with senior management to develop proposals and create marketing and business development materials Support the operational needs of STG including internal initiatives such as recruiting, marketing, communications, etc. Skills and experience that will lead to success 3+ years of proven experience in strategy consulting, enterprise strategy, or the insurance/reinsurance industry (strongly preferred but not required) Prior experience at prominent Advisory Firms/ Strategy Consulting Firms is preferred Strong analytical abilities and a track record of academic success Project management skills Ability to communicate in a collaborative and client focused manner Ability to perform well under pressure, on multiple work streams, and with tight deadlines Strong attention to detail and critical eye in overseeing work of junior analysts Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to network and engage with all levels of stakeholders (both internal and external) Excellent oral and written communication skills Fluency in Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint and Excel) Experienced in data analytics tools is a plus Willing to travel up to 20% (typically much less) Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, a related field, or equivalent years of industry experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $80,000 to $110,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. #LI-AR1 #LI-HYBRID 2582524

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Risk Management / Loss Control, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
Senior Risk Consultant - Real Estate Work Style and Location This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of working from the office 2 to 3 days per week. The preferred locations are Chicago, IL, or Denver, CO. Remote candidates may be considered on a case-by-case basis. Regular travel, primarily within the United States, is required. Role Overview Join Aon in a highly consultative role supporting clients and prospects across our Real Estate & Hospitality practice. You will provide outsourced risk management and insurance advisory services, helping complex organizations understand their exposures, strengthen risk-management practices and make informed business and insurance decisions. This is not a broking or account-management position. The role focuses on business risk consulting, risk analysis and risk assessments, translating complex insurance and operational risks into practical recommendations and solutions. You will collaborate closely with the National Real Estate & Hospitality Leader and colleagues across Aon to support client engagements and practice-wide initiatives. What You'll Do Serve as a trusted consultant to real estate and hospitality clients, providing strategic risk management and business risk consulting across insurance, operational risk, risk financing and related business challenges. Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and risk analysis, using established auditing procedures to evaluate exposures, controls and insurance programs and recommend practical risk-mitigation strategies. Review contracts, lender requirements, property-management agreements and insurance policies to identify risk-management and regulatory compliance considerations. Evaluate property risk-control practices, including physical access controls where relevant. Advise clients on claims management, loss prevention, captive insurance and alternative risk solutions, including parametric insurance and structured risk solutions. Assess existing practices and support business process design improvements that strengthen efficiency and risk mitigation. Translate complex findings into clear, executive-ready reports and actionable recommendations, maintaining accurate client records, risk assessments and deliverables through effective report writing and document management. Lead multiple client engagements and practice initiatives using effective project management, balancing priorities, milestones and deliverables while working closely with the National Real Estate & Hospitality Leader and colleagues across Aon. Build trusted client relationships through strong customer relationship management (CRM) and clienteling practices, understanding evolving business needs and connecting clients with the right capabilities across Aon, including AGRC. Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success Extensive risk management and insurance experience supporting complex commercial real estate operations, with a strong understanding of industry risks, mitigation techniques and Property and Casualty insurance. Experience developing risk-mitigation strategies across claims management, property risk control and loss prevention, with knowledge of captive insurance, parametric insurance and other alternative risk solutions. Strong consulting and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex information, ask insightful questions and communicate practical recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders. Experience managing multiple client relationships, projects and priorities while building collaborative relationships with clients and internal partners. Strong written communication skills, including experience preparing client-facing or executive-level risk reports and interpreting contracts, lender requirements, property-management agreements and insurance policies. Education and Experience Bachelor's degree preferred; a professional qualification or designation in insurance or risk management is also desirable. 10+ years of relevant experience in commercial real estate risk management, insurance, brokerage, corporate risk management or a closely related environment. Strong technical insurance background, including experience working within or closely with a corporate Risk Management function. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $180,000 - $200,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. 2589000

Job.JobTitle: Account Executive/Broker, Commercial Risk - Canada Desk
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Account Executive, Insurance Sales, Insurance Broker
Job.JobDescription:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact with a diverse portfolio of clients? The Canada Desk in our Minneapolis office is seeking an Account Executive / Broker to join its team. In this role, you’ll combine your property and casualty expertise with strong client relationship skills to design innovative solutions, navigate complex risks, and deliver meaningful value to clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hybrid role based in Bloomington, MN, with an expectation of working three days per week in the office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like In this role, no two days will look exactly the same. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment supporting a diverse book of business across multiple industries and lines of coverage. Your day may include: Supporting day-to-day account needs, including certificates of insurance, endorsements, and coverage requests. Partnering with Account Executives, brokers, and other team members throughout the client lifecycle. Assisting with new business opportunities, renewals, and client-driven RFPs. Working across a variety of industries and coverage lines, giving you broad exposure and opportunities to expand your insurance knowledge. Coordinating with clients, underwriters, and internal partners to keep activities moving forward. Managing multiple priorities and adjusting quickly as new client needs and business opportunities arise. Contributing to a collaborative team where colleagues work together to deliver timely, high-quality client service. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, thrives in a fast-moving environment, and is comfortable balancing both broking and account management responsibilities. How this opportunity is different What makes this opportunity unique is the combination of strategic client leadership and hands-on P&C broking. You’ll support a diverse portfolio of industries, manage a significant book of business, and develop customized solutions for complex client needs while building strong relationships with key decision makers. Skills and experience that will lead to success 3+ years of commercial P&C insurance experience, preferably within a brokerage environment. Experience supporting the placement and management of property, liability, and workers’ compensation programs. Ability to manage medium to large, complex accounts across multiple industries. Knowledge of policy reviews, contracts, certificates, endorsements, and renewals. Strong ability to identify client needs and develop tailored insurance solutions. Proven client relationship skills with decision-makers, underwriters, and internal partners. Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience. A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required, or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $78,000-$85,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-HYBRID #LI-CF1 2588615

Our Commercial Risk team in Denver is looking for an Account Executive IV! We are looking for a leader who is responsible for the overall strategy as well as the day-to-day, account management of Aon's relationships with assigned clients as their primary role. You will lead client service teams to identify and meet client needs and thereby retain and grow a profitable book of business. Through service, pricing, consultation, and reporting, you will promote the value Aon delivers to clients. This is a hybrid role out of our office in Denver, CO. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Retains and grows Aon's business, cultivating relationships with senior-most client decision-makers in the client organization as well as with day-to-day client contacts. Drives the renewal process, assembling the appropriate team to develop and implement the client-specific renewal strategy. Coordinates with Brokers in the development and delivery of renewal strategies. Facilitates critical relationships between clients, Aon and insurers. Ensures client service team understanding of client needs, service delivery methods, and the economic framework relevant to services delivered. Leads stewardship planning and delivery. Ensures overall account profitability with a value-based approach for the scope of service and costs associated with the Client Promise Plan. Arranges Aon compensation for services, whether fee or commission-based, accordingly. Educates clients in risk management, risk transfer, market issues and relevant trends including appropriate data and analytics. Marshals appropriate Aon resources to support clients in unusual circumstances such as large claims, etc. Involves others across geographic (including international), functional and business unit boundaries to define interdependent responses to opportunities to grow the business. Manages input to and follow-up on invoicing and receivables process for assigned clients, ensuring timely collections. Skills and experience that will lead to success Must have a minimum of 15 years of appropriate risk insurance experience coupled with project and account management experience on large accounts. Strong sales skills Organizational, interpersonal, and project management skills with an ability to multi-task and prioritize workload with attention to detail. Critical thinking skills with the ability to clearly express thoughts and concepts at various levels. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook Must have an active Property & Casualty license. Education: Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent years of industry experience. Compensation: The salary range for this position is $205,000 – $285,000 annually. This salary range is an estimate and the actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans. The amount of the incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. How we support our colleagues Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. Job.JobTitle: Health and Benefits Solutions Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Are you intellectually curious with a passion to solve problems? Do you enjoy a flexible and collaborative, team-based environment where you are always learning and growing? If yes, Aon is the company for you! As part of a leading global professional services firm, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting health and welfare benefits strategies. We are building our Health Solutions team with the best talent and will consider great candidates in Atlanta, GA. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from a local office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like In this position, you will support the Account Executive as the Lead Consultant on the team taking ownership of and accountability for projects and deliverables. This position includes delegation of assignments to team members and peer review of their work, but also involves being actively involved in performing analysis, drafting client presentations, participating in client meetings, and identifying client needs for other services. This position will serve as the primary day-to-day vendor and/or client contact. Additionally, the Health Solutions Senior Consultant will: Coordinate with internal Subject Matter Experts including audit, legal, and specialized broking teams Facilitate communication with external stakeholders and vendor partners Lead project management and execution of client deliverables Manage client issues Provide guidance and mentorship to junior colleagues How this opportunity is different What makes Aon different are the people and the culture. Aon colleagues support each other, across geographies and solution lines. Aon has the tools plus depth and breadth of experience to drive great outcomes for our clients, while providing the optimal environment for the career and personal growth of our colleagues. Aon is looking for a Director - Compensation, Data Solutions - Norwalk, CT, New York Metro Area Aon is looking to welcome a data-driven consultant to support our Data Solutions team, focusing on clients in the financial services sector. This role is ideal for someone who excels in managing complex datasets, ensuring data quality, and translating insights into meaningful advisory support for compensation and organizational design. Strong candidates will be able to demonstrate a keen interest in rewards by working with compensation survey products and data, sharing stories of project managing client engagements, and building and championing strong client relationships. Preferred locations for the role include Norwalk CT / New York Metro Area. This role combines sales leadership, people management, executive client sponsorship, and thought leadership on Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) offerings and market dynamics. The SVP will also assist in education efforts for our health consultants to deliver coordinated, outstanding solutions.   Sales & Growth Leadership Partner with sales and health leadership on go‑to‑market plans, pipeline development, and RFP/finalist presentations. Support pharmacy project growth by delivering best in class consulting support, managing to scope requirements and building broader relationships Support Core Health sales efforts as part of a broader team of consultants where the SVP will present as a subject matter expert on pharmacy Client & Account Leadership Serve as executive sponsor on a portfolio of clients, including large and complex accounts. Build and sustain executive‑level relationships (HR, Finance, Procurement, Clinical, C‑suite). Lead all aspects of delivery quality and coordinate cross‑functional teams to provide integrated pharmacy solutions across core health and all Innovation and Integrated Solutions. Lead teams on building multi-year strategic roadmaps for clients rooted in market knowledge paired with an understanding of client benefits philosophy. Strategy & Offer Development Define and refine the strategic roadmap for pharmacy consulting, aligned with broader health and benefits strategy. Identify emerging trends (e.g., PBM models, specialty drugs, biosimilars, gene therapies, regulatory shifts) and translate them into differentiated offerings and frameworks. Partner with product, analytics, and operations to advance tools, methodologies, and partnerships. Thought Leadership & POV Development Lead creation of points of view on PBM offerings, contracting structures, clinical strategies, and market changes. Represent the firm through client forums, conferences, publications, and webinars. Convert sophisticated market dynamics into practical insights for clients and internal teams. People Leadership & Consultant Education Lead, develop, and mentor pharmacy consultants. Foster an inclusive, collaborative, high‑accountability culture. Support the build and deliver training, playbooks, and toolkits to educate health consultants on PBM offerings, contract levers, and market dynamics. Ensure pharmacy insights are embedded in comprehensive health and benefits strategies. Skills and experience that will lead to success Ten plus years of pharmacy consulting experience. Viewed as an industry leader with expertise in pharmacy benefits. Deep knowledge negotiating and running consulting engagements. Strong communication skills, both written and oral presentation skills. Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects and clients with dynamic and shifting timelines. Account Management, Market Research, Sales Performance, Customer Engagement, Customer Satisfaction, Advanced Product Knowledge   Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $200,000 to $250,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-LC1 #LI-Executive #LI-HYBRID

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Accountant, Accounting / Finance, Insurance Operations Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Aon Is Looking For an Accounting Operations Manager Aon Affinity is a leading provider of specialty insurance solutions and related products to a variety of professional, small & medium enterprise and consumer markets. We add value to your member, customer and affiliate relationships. This is a hybrid role with 2-3 days working from the Fort Washington, PA office. As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Accounting Operations Department within Aon Affinity. Job Responsibilities: Lead a portion of the accounting operations team (10-14 people) in processes related to fiduciary cash and payables including providing timely customer service to external customers and internal business partners Support variety of business units and associated systems in conducting daily accounting functions and the month end close processes Develop metrics to report on the status of work done by direct reports. Proactively address needs to maintain SLA’s for work and meet established deadlines including some state mandated timelines. Work with our Gen Pact team to further enhance their effectiveness and build cohesiveness between the onshore and offshore teams Team with the SVP of Accounting Operations to lead the redesign of Accounting Operations processes across multiple businesses and systems, translating accounting requirements into standardized processes, controlled workflows, data requirements and practical automation. Work with the project team in implementing the system and AI solutions delivered by our technology partners Collaborate with the other managers on the Accounting Operations staff to move the Processes to further standardization and implementation of AI solutions Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Strong accounting-operations experience including both cash and payables work Understanding of ledger implications of accounting operation function reconciliation foundation End-to-end process-mapping and redesign experience preferred Experience operating across multiple systems and business units desirable Strong control, auditability and documentation discipline Ability to lead internal and outsourced teams Executive-level communication and business-partnering skill Demonstrated project and change leadership Ability to quantify operational problems and develop business cases Cash-application or treasury-operations experience Experience implementing reconciliation, payables or cash-application solutions Practical understanding of AI-assisted finance processes Outsourcing governance experience, particularly with a provider such as Genpact Required Experience: 5- 7 years related experience Experience leading a team that delivers solid results Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or Mathematics preferred. How we support our colleagues: In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working! Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We welcome applications from all and provide individuals with disabilities with reasonable adjustments to participate in the job application, interview process and to perform essential job functions once onboard. If you would like to learn more about the reasonable accommodations we provide, email ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $95,000 to $110,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-AM4 2590903

The Strategic Client Leader position is a senior level role that serves as the primary business liaison for HR Solutions between Aon and its clients. While the role is multifaceted, in short, the Strategic Client Leader has overall accountability and responsibility for Aon’s relationship with the client. At a strategic level, the role is encouraged to develop an in-depth understanding of their client’s business. They should also understand the strategies senior management will deploy to drive desired business outcomes. That understanding is typically derived from meaningful discussions with C-suite contacts and their direct reports. Equipped with a clear strategic business purpose, the Client Leader works closely with the client and Aon subject matter experts. They explore and offer Aon’s thought leadership, innovation, and services to improve the client’s human capital strategy. This supports the client’s overall business strategy. At a functional level, this role serves as an integrator ensuring that the various Aon team members are client focused, providing consulting and operational insights based on the client situation and delivering a high-quality product and/or service consistent with the Aon Client Promise and continuous improvement principles. Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for an experienced Underwriter to join our growing Time Away & Life Solutions (TALS) Consulting Practice. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from one of our offices in the United States. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As a underwriter within the Time Away & Life Solutions (TALS) Consulting Practice, you will be leading large complex clients and presenting your analysis in a client-facing role. You will be responsible for training and development of the offshore COE team, and follow a formal peer review process, to drive the financial strategy for our clients. How this opportunity is different Our team focuses on National Account clients. With the evolving need for leave industry there is constant need for strategy development and cost modeling to ensure that clients remain compliant and competitive in the marketplace. This team is comprised of colleagues with different backgrounds and skillsets that collaborate with each other to deliver for our clients. Skills and experience that will lead to success The candidate should have financial technical skills with regards to disability, life insurance, FMLA and municipal/state regulated leaves, and voluntary benefits. Strong technical underwriting and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate risk and interpret complex benefit programs Ability to support project execution through effective planning, coordination, and timely delivery of assigned workstream components Solid organizational and project management skills to manage multiple priorities and deadlines Applies professional principles and sound business judgment to support the development and refinement of processes, procedures, and solutions Contributes to the adoption of best practices by consistently applying established processes, tools, and methodologies to support quality and efficiency Understanding of industry trends, data analysis, and evolving market dynamics impacting underwriting and benefit programs Project Management, Benefits Administration, Consulting, Data Analysis, Data Management, Meeting Facilitation Education 10+ years in underwriting Absence, Life & Disability Pay Transparency Laws: Salary range for the position The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $125,000 - $145,000.00 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Aon is looking for a Senior Staff Accountant in Plainview, NY !! This is a hybrid role working from our Plainview, NY office Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Perform monthly Travel revenue, premium and other financial reporting tasks to ensure all corporate deadlines are met. Ability to prepare various monthly journal entries including accrual and deferral entries. Ability to research and resolve bank reconciliation variances, including intricate differences resulting from a large volume of credit card transactions, chargebacks and fees. Prepare Foreign currency wire requests for claimants. Ability to review team’s work for errors and post to Accpac subledger accounting package. Prepare premium and profit-sharing remittances and carrier claims salvage payments including Subledger Ledger reconciliation. Ensure timely collection of client payments. Approve split allocations in Oracle database. Be key backup to team member tasks (including premium interface function). Subledger account analysis. Month end operational metrics and analysis. Client reporting as needed and analysis on file variances Assist with annual plan process and development of Travel revenue drivers Assist with research for Internal and Carrier Audits as needed. Other duties as assigned by manager. You Bring Knowledge and Expertise Required Experience: Strong proficiency with Excel (v lookups, pivot tables etc) Premium Accounting and experience with accounting software. Basic knowledge of GAAP Ability to work independently and as a team member. This position requires a self-starter and independent individual able to work in a deadline driven environment. Strong communication skills - will interface with all levels of management. Multitask oriented. Preferred Experience: Experience with Sage\AccPac, Workday and Cognos Finance preferred. Insurance experience a plus, not a requirement. Understanding of multicurrency accounting entries is a plus. Experience working with auditors is a plus At least 2-4 years of relevant work experience Proficient with MS Copilot Experience BA degree required – Accounting or Finance major For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is seeking an Enterprise Client Leader. The role is accountable for leading Aon’s relationship for its most strategic clients across geographies and solution lines. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Primary objectives of this role are to deliver retention and accelerated growth, bringing together and leading, through inclusion and trust, a client team of Aon colleagues to deliver one firm to Aon’s most strategic clients, and accessing and investing regular time with the most senior decision-makers, as well as all stakeholders, at our clients to gain an in-depth knowledge of their business priorities. The role reports to the Regional Head of Enterprise Clients and collaborates with Enterprise Client Leaders with the region, Industry leaders, Marketing, Growth Operations, and other regional leaders. Job Responsibilities: Drives business results for at least five enterprise clients, meeting new, retention, and rollover metrics by client across solution lines and geographies. Has a detailed understanding of global revenue and leads pipeline and investment globally. Builds, continuously updates, and aligns resources to execute against Client Value Creation Model. Delivers our Global Standards flawlessly, including bringing all key partners at Aon and the Client together for deep strategy and execution of our commitments and plans. This requires a regular presence with all partners in the client’s organization and updated Relationship mapping that is shared with client teams. Influences all levels of Aon to align appropriate internal resources and ensure excellent service from client delivery and shares strategy and planning with the Aon team through regular check ins, and 90 Day DAU Client Planning sessions. Aon IQ – through formal training and knowledge sharing in addition to participation In Client Planning across geographies and solution lines, maintains solid understanding of all Aon services and ensures that the client understands the full value delivered. Hold Risk, Health, Talent and Retirement badges. Role models partnership, collaboration, integrity, humility and respect to deliver the best of our firm to our clients. Aon is looking for an Office Operations & Administrative Specialist in our Pennsylvania office! Role Summary The Senior Administrative Assistant is a full-time, office-based role responsible for providing a combination of administrative support, workplace services, and on-site event assistance. This role serves as a visible and trusted on-site resource, helping colleagues, leaders, clients, and visitors navigate the office environment smoothly and professionally. The role is designed for an individual who is highly organized, service-oriented, proactive, and comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with hands-on workplace support. The Sr. Administrative Assistant plays an important role in creating a consistent, welcoming, and productive in-office experience. Working Model Full-time, five days per week in the office in our Pittsburgh, PA office. Requires regular interaction with colleagues, senior leaders, clients, visitors, vendors, Facilities, IT, Security, and other workplace partners. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Ideal Candidate Profile This role is ideal for a highly organized, service-oriented professional who enjoys being in the office, creating positive experiences for others, and serving as a dependable resource for administrative, workplace, VIP, and event-related needs. The successful candidate will be proactive, polished, flexible, and comfortable balancing hands-on support with strong coordination, judgment, and follow-through. How this opportunity is different Administrative Support Provide administrative support to assigned consumers and business leaders, including calendar management, scheduling, travel planning, and expense reporting. Prepare, print, distribute, and organize business documents, presentations, meeting materials, and other administrative resources. Coordinate virtual, in-person, and off-site meetings, including invitations, conference rooms, technology, materials, catering, and related logistics. Prepare agendas, capture notes, document decisions, and monitor action items when requested. Manage ad hoc requests with professionalism, accuracy, discretion, and a high level of responsiveness. What the day will look like Workplace and General Location Services: Serve as an on-site point of contact for office operations, workplace readiness, and general location services. Support meeting room reservations, room setup, equipment testing, audiovisual coordination, and meeting materials. Assist with reception and guest services, including greeting visitors, coordinating access, supporting front desk coverage, and responding to general inquiries. Coordinate workplace facilities needs, including office supplies, space coordination, mail and package handling, and escalation of workplace issues. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve office, technology, access, and safety-related needs promptly. Support food and catering deliveries, setup, and related office logistics. Provide high-touch, in-person support for executives, senior leaders, clients, and VIP visitors. Coordinate executive visits, special on-site arrangements, private meeting room setup, workspace readiness, and related logistics. Support day-of activities, including on-site agenda execution, stakeholder coordination, and smooth transitions between on-site commitments. Assist with executive onboarding needs, including workspace setup, technology coordination, and orientation to office resources. Manage VIP food, catering, preferred beverages, last-minute supplies, and other hospitality-related requests in alignment with service standards. On-Site Event Support: Support small, on-site office events, meetings, and employee or client-facing activities. Assist with room setup, registration, guest greeting, signage, meeting materials, catering coordination, and day-of execution. Help coordinate event teardown, follow-up items, and post-event workplace readiness. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Organization and execution: Strong ability to manage competing priorities, track details, follow through, and deliver accurate work in a fast-paced environment. Service mindset: Professional, hospitality-oriented approach with a focus on colleague, leader, client, and visitor experience. Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence interacting across all levels of the organization. Judgment and discretion: Ability to handle confidential information, sensitive requests, and senior leader interactions with professionalism. Problem solving: Proactive approach to anticipating needs, resolving issues, and escalating appropriately when needed. Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with administrative colleagues, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and other internal teams. Adaptability: Flexibility to respond to changing business needs, urgent requests, and evolving ways of working. Technology proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, along with comfort using travel, expense, visitor management, scheduling, and workplace technology tools. Success Measures Timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative support. Consistent workplace readiness and reliable location services support. Positive feedback from leaders, colleagues, clients, visitors, and workplace partners. Effective coordination of meetings, VIP visits, small on-site events, and day-of logistics. Strong responsiveness to issues, requests, and escalations. Clear handoffs and collaboration across AUAO, GCC administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events. Assist with reception and guest services, including greeting visitors, coordinating access, supporting front desk coverage, and responding to general inquiries. Coordinate workplace facilities needs, including office supplies, space coordination, mail and package handling, and escalation of workplace issues. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve office, technology, access, and safety-related needs promptly. Support food and catering deliveries, setup, and related office logistics. Provide high-touch, in-person support for executives, senior leaders, clients, and VIP visitors. Coordinate executive visits, special on-site arrangements, private meeting room setup, workspace readiness, and related logistics. Support day-of activities, including on-site agenda execution, stakeholder coordination, and smooth transitions between on-site commitments. Assist with executive onboarding needs, including workspace setup, technology coordination, and orientation to office resources. Manage VIP food, catering, preferred beverages, last-minute supplies, and other hospitality-related requests in alignment with service standards. On-Site Event Support: Support small, on-site office events, meetings, and employee or client-facing activities. Assist with room setup, registration, guest greeting, signage, meeting materials, catering coordination, and day-of execution. Help coordinate event teardown, follow-up items, and post-event workplace readiness. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Organization and execution: Strong ability to manage competing priorities, track details, follow through, and deliver accurate work in a fast-paced environment. Service mindset: Professional, hospitality-oriented approach with a focus on colleague, leader, client, and visitor experience. Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence interacting across all levels of the organization. Judgment and discretion: Ability to handle confidential information, sensitive requests, and senior leader interactions with professionalism. Problem solving: Proactive approach to anticipating needs, resolving issues, and escalating appropriately when needed. Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with administrative colleagues, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and other internal teams. Adaptability: Flexibility to respond to changing business needs, urgent requests, and evolving ways of working. Technology proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, along with comfort using travel, expense, visitor management, scheduling, and workplace technology tools. Success Measures Timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative support. Consistent workplace readiness and reliable location services support. Positive feedback from leaders, colleagues, clients, visitors, and workplace partners. Effective coordination of meetings, VIP visits, small on-site events, and day-of logistics. Strong responsiveness to issues, requests, and escalations. Clear handoffs and collaboration across AUAO, GCC administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events.
