Job.JobTitle: Aon Graduate Programme 2027 - Data Solutions (Wealth Solutions) - Glasgow
Job.JobDescription: Data Solutions (Wealth Solutions) - Glasgow: 2027 Graduate Programme Start Date: 1st September 2027 Application closing date: 7th December 2026 Please note, we may close earlier if we receive the quantity, quality & variety of applications required. Better Decisions Begin with You At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organisation, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Wealth Solutions: Data Solutions Right now, UK based companies have more invested in pension schemes than the rest of Europe combined. They are crafting and implementing large, complex projects that involve several collaborators and complex data sets. They aim to deliver efficient solutions for both employees and the company. As the market leaders in Wealth Solutions consulting, our Data Solutions Team (DST) are here to provide a fully integrated client service on data-driven strategic projects. They use their data management skills to help this new and growing specialist team design efficient processes to provide the best outcomes for Aon and for our clients. As an Aon graduate, you’ll work with some of the most creative and promising individuals in the industry. You will earn as you learn and build your career as a Data Solutions specialist. Join Aon as a Data Solutions graduate and discover how our growing team focus on working with large data sets to ensure strategic projects for our clients can be delivered efficiently. Work with specialists across data, consulting, project management and administration and learn about the vast array of projects we are designing and completing for our clients, and how your role will be vital to the success of these. Your role as a Data Solutions Graduate in Wealth Solutions: Retirement As a Data Solutions graduate, you’ll find that no two days in the office are the same. You’ll work supporting a range of teams with colleagues who provide advice and support to either the trustees managing the pension scheme, or the company that provides it. Our aim is for you to develop into an effective member of the Data Solutions Team and help shape how the team operates in the future. We’ll support you in building strong data analysis and problem-solving skills, including an understanding of data management, manipulation, rectification and benefit calculations. You’ll learn to use digital and AI-enabled tools thoughtfully, ask effective questions, refine outputs and apply your own judgement to test assumptions, identify anomalies and recognise when human expertise is needed. Throughout your career with Aon, you’ll continue to develop your commercial awareness, professionalism and ability to connect your work to positive client outcomes. What your day could look like: Process, clean and manipulate data using internal tools and efficient, well-controlled processes Analyse data sets to identify patterns, trends, anomalies and areas requiring further investigation Ask targeted questions, challenge assumptions and identify the root causes of data issues before recommending practical solutions Use digital productivity, analytics and AI-enabled tools to support your work, checking and refining outputs to ensure they are accurate, relevant and appropriate for the client Identify and rectify data issues so information is accurate, traceable and suitable for use in client projects Develop scalable solutions for large data sets and learn specialist benefit calculations Understand the complexities, nuances and caveats involved in gathering, handling and interpreting data Balance quality, budget and timescale considerations, taking ownership for dependable delivery and communicating priorities clearly Coordinate responses across colleagues and teams to keep client work joined up and focused on the right outcomes Take ownership for improving standard processes, sharing knowledge and adapting your approach as priorities and client needs change You’ll be given opportunities to work on a range of projects, gaining early exposure to clients to support your development. You’ll also can be involved in projects for one of our specialist teams, focusing in areas such as: Risk Settlement, advising clients on the best way to reduce risk through transferring it to a third party. Member Options, helping clients reduce risk and/or cost by offering pension scheme members the choice to reshape their benefits to better suit their individual circumstances. GMP equalisation, helping clients correct for previous benefit inequalities. Pensions Dashboard, ensuring pension savers can view all their pensions (from various employers) in one online place. Your Development As an Aon Graduate, you will be enrolled onto our Launch Programme when you join. This development programme is built around 2 core elements: Business learning. On the job learning and experiences enabling you to develop your knowledge and understanding of your team and solution line. Centralised learning. UK graduates complete in an Aon Induction, monthly webinars, business skills training and workshops; all designed to develop your knowledge of Aon, build your confidence and your network across our business. Your career beyond your Graduate programme Once you’ve completed the formal graduate programme, you’ll continue to receive lots of support at Aon. As well as continued technical and business skills training. To aid your professional development you’ll receive regular performance feedback, and work with your line manager towards promotions, which are considered twice a year, enabling you to progress from a Graduate Analyst to Associate Consultant, then Consultant and beyond. Next Steps If you are interested in this graduate programme and would like to apply, here is some useful information: Entry Requirements: You will need to have or be on track to achieve a 2:1 degree (or equivalent) in a numeric or data related subject. (Please note, this role is not suitable for Data Science graduates.) Excellent Microsoft Excel skills To ensure compliance with UK law, successful candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK throughout the duration of their time in role. What are we looking for? Motivation and ambition to pursue this career path, with the ability to explain why Data Solutions interests you and how you want to develop Clear and thoughtful communication, including asking focused questions, listening to different perspectives and making complex, data-led ideas easier to understand Sound judgement and problem-solving, with the curiosity to analyse information, challenge assumptions, test outputs and make well-reasoned decisions An interest in technology and new ways of working, including a willingness to learn how digital, analytical and AI-enabled tools can improve productivity and client delivery while recognising the importance of human oversight A client and results-focused appraoch, enabling you to connect your work to wider objectives, consider trade-offs and take accountability for high-quality outcomes A collaborative and dependable approach, building trust through consistent delivery, partnering effectively across teams and seeking and applying feedback A commitment to learning and inclusion, sharing knowledge, adapting to changing priorities and valuing different perspectives so others feel respected and able to contribute Initiative and forward thinking, anticipating what may be needed next, working independently when appropriate and communicating priorities clearly Locations This role is based in our Glasgow office. (If you prefer working out of our Birmingham office, please apply to the separate role for that location.) Aon UK Graduate Recruitment: What to Expect We know applying for your first graduate role can be exciting, and sometimes a little daunting. At Aon, we’re committed to making our recruitment process as transparent and supportive as possible. Here’s how our selection journey works, and what you can expect at each stage: Application Review We process applications on a rolling basis, moving candidates forward as they complete each stage. Every application is carefully reviewed by our team (not by AI). Due to the high volume of interest, this stage can take up to two weeks. Please note: We do not review CVs or cover letters at this point. Online Assessment We understand you want to put your best foot forward, so you’ll have 5 calendar days to complete the online assessment. If you need more time, just let us know as extensions are available. Video Interview Preparation matters, so you’ll have up to 10 days (240 hours) from receiving your invitation to record and submit your video interview. Rest assured: Every video interview is reviewed by a real member of our recruitment team, not an AI system. You’ll typically hear back from us within 2-3 weeks after submitting your interview, though times may vary depending on the number of applications. Assessment Centres Our assessment centres are held in person at the Aon office closest to the location you applied for. Please note: Due to the large number of applications, not every candidate who completes a video interview will be invited to an assessment centre. Assessment centres usually run from November to May. (With a pause over the Christmas holidays.) If selected, you’ll have 7-14 days’ notice to help you arrange any travel. We run a limited number of Assessment Centre so please make every effort to attend if invited. We reimburse reasonable travel costs (such as standard class train tickets). Flights and hotels are only covered if agreed in advance. At the assessment centre stage, your CV and cover letter will be shared with hiring managers. This helps them get a fuller picture of you as a candidate—but these documents are not used for initial screening. Aon's guidance of the use of AI during the selection process As an innovative global leader, we recognize and embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help job seekers be more efficient in their recruitment processes. In fact, Aon is in the business of developing and implementing innovative AI tools that support both colleagues and clients, which you’ll use as an Aon colleague if you join our team. AI can be a helpful tool for researching Aon, preparing for interviews or refining your CV, it should support, not replace, your own thinking, judgement, skills and experiences. Any application materials you submit should accurately reflect your achievements, capabilities and potential. We ask that you refrain from using AI when completing assessments or during live or pre-recorded interview processes, which will often include an in-person interview where the technology will not be available to you. Additionally, virtual or in-person interviews should not be recorded or transcribed. At Aon, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, fairness and transparency. We expect all candidates to embrace these principles in every interaction with us. Applying for more than one programme or role We ask candidates to submit one Early Carers application per recruitment cycle. We encourage you to explore our opportunities carefully and apply for the programme or role that best matches your skills, interests and career goals. This helps you focus on submitting your strongest application and ensures we can assess candidates fairly and efficiently. Job.JobTitle: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Strategic & Growth Campaigns
Job.JobDescription: At Aon, we help clients make better decisions. Within Aon's M&A and Transaction Solutions (AMATS) business, we advise organizations, investors, and transaction professionals as they navigate complex transactions and critical business decisions. AMATS is a market leading business with ambitious growth aspirations, and we are seeking an exceptional marketing professional who understands how marketing creates commercial value to help strengthen our market presence, deepen client relationships, create demand, and accelerate the next phase of our growth across key markets. Reporting to the Global Marketing Leader, AMATS, this role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with senior business leaders, subject matter experts, and marketing colleagues across the globe. The successful candidate will play a central role in advancing our thought leadership agenda, enhancing market visibility, creating demand, and delivering integrated marketing programs that support business priorities and contribute to continued business growth. Combining strategic thinking with hands on execution, you will help shape the AMATS marketing agenda, develop compelling content and thought leadership, lead integrated campaigns, engage senior stakeholders, and measure impact. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Strategic Marketing & Business Partnership Serve as a trusted marketing partner to the Global Marketing Leader, AMATS and business leadership team, helping translate growth priorities into impactful marketing strategies, campaigns and client engagement initiatives. Develop a strong understanding of the M&A, transaction risk and advisory marketplace, bringing forward ideas, opportunities and insights that support business growth and market differentiation. Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify emerging market themes, client challenges and commercial opportunities that can be translated into compelling marketing programs. Actively contribute to marketing planning discussions, recommending innovative approaches to elevate market visibility, strengthen client engagement and support strategic business objectives. Thought Leadership & Content Strategy Help shape and execute the AMATS thought leadership and content agenda, ensuring alignment with business priorities, growth opportunities and client needs. Collaborate with subject matter experts to transform complex technical expertise, transaction insights and market intelligence into compelling, client-centric content. Develop and manage a content roadmap spanning thought leadership, articles, reports, case studies, web content, social media, client communications, presentations and sales enablement materials. Ensure all content reflects a consistent voice, reinforces market positioning and clearly articulates Aon's differentiated value proposition Identify opportunities to elevate executive visibility through content, speaking opportunities, industry events and external engagement programs. Integrated Campaign Development & Execution Lead the development and activation of integrated marketing campaigns that support key growth priorities and commercial objectives. Translate business objectives into clear campaign briefs, audience strategies, messaging frameworks, content plans and activation roadmaps. Coordinate activity across content, digital, social, email, demand generation, events, webinars, media and sales enablement channels to maximize impact and audience engagement. Manage campaign execution from concept through launch, optimization and reporting, ensuring programs are delivered on time and to a high standard. Continually identify opportunities to strengthen campaign effectiveness through new channels, formats, technologies and audience engagement approaches. Client Engagement & Events Support the planning and activation of strategic events, industry conferences, executive roundtables, webinars and sponsorship opportunities aligned to business priorities. Develop content, messaging and engagement plans that maximize the commercial impact of client-facing activities. Collaborate with regional marketing and events teams to ensure consistent execution and measurement across key programs. Enterprise Collaboration & Aon United Partner closely with colleagues across Risk Capital, Human Capital, Enterprise Client Group, Industries and regional marketing teams to identify opportunities for integrated marketing activity and cross-solution storytelling Help position AMATS expertise within enterprise campaigns and strategic growth initiatives where appropriate. Build strong relationships across marketing centres of excellence, leveraging shared capabilities and best practices to enhance program effectiveness. Measurement, Insights & Optimization Define campaign objectives, KPIs and success measures for all major marketing initiatives. Partner with analytics and demand generation resources to evaluate campaign performance, audience engagement and business impact. Use data, stakeholder feedback and market insights to continuously optimize content, campaigns and client engagement activities. Prepare concise performance summaries and actionable recommendations for marketing and business leadership. How this opportunity is different This is an opportunity to make a significant contribution to a growing global business, work closely with executive leaders, and help shape the future marketing agenda of one of the industry's leading transaction solutions practices. The role offers a unique platform to influence strategy, enhance market reputation, elevate thought leadership, and demonstrate the impact that world class marketing can have on business performance. Skills and experience that will lead to success Experience 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing, content marketing, integrated campaign management, demand generation, strategic communications or a related field. Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns that drive measurable business outcomes. Experience supporting professional services, financial services, consulting, legal, insurance or other complex B2B organizations is desirable. Technical & Professional Skills Exceptional storytelling and content development capabilities, with the ability to simplify complex topics into compelling and client-relevant narratives. Strong strategic thinking and commercial acumen. Ability to connect business objectives, audience needs and market insights to create impactful marketing programs. Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience engaging with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts. Proficient in campaign measurement, performance reporting and marketing analytics Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, or a related discipline preferred. Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Naturally curious about markets, businesses and client challenges. Comfortable working with senior leaders and challenging conventional thinking constructively. A self-starter who takes ownership and follows through. Energized by ambiguity and comfortable creating structure where none exists. Equally comfortable developing strategy and executing the work required to bring it to life. Collaborative, humble and team-oriented. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. Known for getting things done while maintaining a positive and solutions-oriented mindset. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-SP1 #LI-HYBRID 2586063

This individual will be asked to carry out the following: Team members supporting day-to-day service initiatives for clients Develops and maintains strategy plans for portfolio of clients Broker, Negotiate, and evaluate the insurance markets to include self-funded, fully insured and level funding medical plans, dental, vision, life, disability and voluntary ancillary benefits to determine appropriateness of rates and rate components for client renewals. Develop client or prospect RFP responses and results in a presentation deliverable Work with the insurance markets to obtain client specific reports on all lines of coverage. Generates and produces client specific benefit analysis and reporting on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis. Seek and evaluate, new and emerging insurance programs or point solution options for clients and prospects Establish relationships with various insurance carrier representatives Assist team/ take the lead on client DD for M&A activity when the need arises Review and oversee compliance, contracts, SPD’s and employee communications to ensure alignment with client expectations and legal requirements Articulates data and sophisticated reports to clients. Develops sophisticated benefits design and renewal strategies and drive development of tools and solutions to manage complex client issues Schedules and conducts stewardship meetings, pre-renewal strategy and renewal meetings with key stakeholders Prepares open enrollment presentations and communications seeing the client open enrollment process through finality of effective date. Assists clients with EDI file feeds, payroll integration, HRIS/Benefit Administration system integration with markets. Operate independently and actively manage project plans May be responsible for the overall management of medium-sized projects Prioritizes work and takes ownership of tasks Strategic point of contact for client questions and deliverables Travel may be required Reporting to Health & Benefits Local Practice Leader How this opportunity is different This role offers the chance to be a true strategic partner to clients rather than a traditional “back-office” benefits technician. You will own a portfolio of clients end-to-end—from designing sophisticated benefit and funding strategies (self-funded, fully insured, level-funded, and ancillary) to leading RFPs, renewals, stewardship meetings, and open enrollment. You will work directly with clients’ key decision-makers, lead due diligence for M&A activity, and help integrate benefits with HRIS and payroll systems, giving you broad exposure across both strategy and execution. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to evaluate emerging point solutions, shape data-driven insights and reporting, and build deep carrier relationships, all while operating with a high degree of autonomy under the guidance of the Health & Benefits Local Practice Leader. We are seeking a strategic, outcome-oriented Senior Product Manager, Servicing to lead the vision, strategy, and evolution of our Servicing product domain. This is a virtual position, ideal candidate lives in Minnesota. This leader will be responsible for transforming how customers, distribution partners, and colleagues manage insurance relationships throughout the policy lifecycle. The role spans policy servicing, account management, and claims, with an emphasis on creating connected, intuitive, and scalable experiences across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and businesses. Operating in an evolving product organization, the ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and complexity. Strategies, priorities, and requirements will not always be clearly defined or handed to them. This individual must proactively identify opportunities, bring structure to uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and create the clarity and momentum needed to drive meaningful outcomes. This is a business-focused product leadership role requiring strong product management fundamentals, cross-functional influence, and the ability to connect customer needs, business capabilities, and technology investments. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Product Strategy & Domain Leadership Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Servicing domain, aligned with enterprise objectives and business priorities. Lead the evolution of capabilities across policy servicing, account management, and claims, including policy management, endorsements, renewals, and related servicing interactions. Identify opportunities to simplify complex insurance processes, increase self-service adoption, improve retention, and reduce operational costs. Establish a scalable approach to servicing that supports diverse insurance products, business models, distribution channels, and brands. Define meaningful product outcomes, success metrics, and investment priorities. Product Discovery & Delivery Translate business challenges, customer needs, and market opportunities into actionable product strategies and requirements. Lead discovery to understand current-state challenges, validate opportunities, and define future-state capabilities. Prioritize investments based on customer value, business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment. Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Experience, Intelligence, Operations, and business stakeholders to deliver cohesive solutions. Balance near-term business needs with long-term capability development, reducing fragmentation and unnecessary customization. Measure product performance and continuously refine priorities based on insights and results. Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration Lead, coach, and develop product managers and other product team members within the Servicing domain. Establish strong partnerships with business leaders across multiple insurance businesses to align priorities and drive adoption. Partner closely with other product domain leads, including Growth & Distribution, Payments, and Enterprise Capabilities, to align strategies, coordinate priorities, and deliver integrated capabilities and seamless end-to-end experiences. Navigate cross-domain dependencies, shared ownership, and competing priorities to drive alignment, resolve trade-offs, and ensure cohesive product outcomes. Collaborate with Experience to create consistent, intuitive customer, partner, and colleague journeys across digital and assisted channels. Demonstrate initiative and urgency in identifying opportunities, addressing challenges, and driving decisions forward. Communicate product direction, trade-offs, progress, and outcomes clearly to senior leadership. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Required: 7+ years of experience in product management, including ownership of complex digital products or business capabilities. Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps, and delivering measurable business outcomes. Experience leading product teams or providing leadership across multiple product initiatives. Strong understanding of product discovery, prioritization, requirements definition, and iterative delivery. Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable, customer-centered product capabilities. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity, independently establish direction, and drive progress without relying on predefined solutions or detailed instructions. Preferred: Experience in commercial property and casualty insurance, insurance distribution, or related financial services. Familiarity with insurance policy administration, endorsements, renewals, claims, or servicing operations. Experience supporting multiple business units, brands, or product lines through shared capabilities. Experience modernizing legacy processes and transitioning organizations toward product-led operating models. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience. Aon Risk Solutions, the global risk management business of Aon plc (NYSE: AON), is the worldwide leader in risk advice and insurance broking. Guided by the Aon Client Promise®, our teams help clients achieve profit, growth and continuity by delivering the best tailored and innovative risk solutions. This opportunity is viewed as a business partner & advisor who assist varying levels of business unit and corporate personnel in providing analysis, information and data to support achievement of business plans. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Do you have experience in Commercial Risk? Are you an inquisitive, organized, meticulous individual who would like to apply their experience to our dynamic and engaging industry? If so, this may be the next step in your career! This Account Manager II role is based out of our beautiful, New York City office, located in the Financial District. Aon is in the business of better decisions.   At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.   As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.   What the day will look like:   Partner with Account Executives on assigned book of business, manage day-to-day service processes and outputs, support a variety of strategic, client-facing initiatives, and run point on each client’s renewal cycle, ensuring a positive and productive client experience.   How this opportunity is different What makes this opportunity different is the combination of meaningful client impact and Aon’s collaborative culture. In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across geographies and solution lines, leveraging Aon’s tools and deep expertise to deliver great outcomes for clients—while benefiting from a supportive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, career development, and personal wellbeing.   Skills that will lead to success: Maintains effective and positive relationships with clients. Serves independently in a client-facing capacity on matters of moderate importance and complexity. Facilitates the timely and accurate flow of information between clients, and account team members, keeping all parties informed. Handles client open items lists and respond to client ad-hoc requests. Gathers and analyzes data and drafts assigned elements of stewardship reports and other convincing presentations tailored to the needs of the audience and the circumstances of the presentation. Actively supports and monitors the renewal process, engaging with account team members as necessary. May draft quote comparisons and is responsible for saving down binders, policies, and endorsements. Where applicable, serves as the primary point of contact with Aon Client Services (ACS), coordinating activities of the client service team and ACS to ensure that key processes assigned are performed efficiently and quality of client deliverables. Primary collaborator with Premium Accounting on client billing matters. Receives and handles routine and sophisticated coverage inquiries and endorsement requests. Serves as key client liaison for items such as certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals. Monitors and follows-up on invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections. Addresses and resolves problems. May provide guidance and mentoring to a less senior account specialist. Delegates work to support staff and ACS where applicable. Ensures tools are understood and used. Performs related duties as assigned. Education and Experience: 3+ years of insurance experience required (preferably within Commercial Risk and in an Account Management role) Active Property & Casualty Insurance license required Ability to maintain effective and positive relationships with clients and colleagues Effective organization and time management skills Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing Effective presentation skills Ability to handle multiple, non-congruent tasks simultaneously Pay Transparency Laws   The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $75,000 - $90,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.   Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.   Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.  #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2586841

Job.JobTitle: Senior Accountant - Captive and Insurance Management
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for a Senior Accountant - Captive and Insurance Management Aon’s Captive & Insurance Management team is an integral part of Aon’s global operations. Our 500 + captive insurance professionals manage over 1,000 captive insurance companies across 39 locations around the globe, representing more than 15% of the captive insurance market. Our clients span every sector and Industry and are primarily made up of Fortune 500 companies. This is a remote role or flexibility for a hybrid role if you are near our Honolulu, HI office. Aon is in the business of better decisions! At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Lead all aspects of the financial reporting for client accounts and serving as the primary contact for individuals from various departments, such as risk management, corporate controllership, tax, legal, etc. Drive communication & processes for client service teams to ensure quality and timeliness of financial reporting and regulatory filings. Mentor and develop accounting team members. Coordinate efforts with outside service providers, including actuaries, auditors, investment managers, brokers, claims adjusters, and outside counsel to proactively meet client needs. Communicate and implement business plan changes with State regulators. Prepare and present materials during client board meetings. How this opportunity is different As a Senior Accountant, you will lead client service teams with diverse skillsets and areas of knowledge: financial reporting, compliance, and insurance, while being supported and guided by leadership team members. You will have direct contact with client contacts within the corporate controllership, risk management, tax, legal and other departments, as well as auditors, actuaries, investment managers, etc. At Aon, you are provided the opportunity to drive your career development. Skills and experience that will lead to success Effective communicator, with strong interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and written. Accounting degree, CPA is a plus. Insurance Accounting experience welcomed. Organized and able to multi-task with ability to effectively prioritize tasks as needed. Consistent track record of increasing efficiency and improving methods and approaches. Proficiency working with Microsoft Office Suite. Demonstrated effectiveness in presentations to clients. Detail oriented and ability to understand and drive big picture recommendations. Contribute to a collaborative, innovative and forward-thinking office environment. Bachelor’s degree in business related major or equivalent years of industry experience is essential. How we support our colleagues In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. If you would like to learn more about the reasonable accommodations we provide, email ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Job.JobTitle: Insurance Strategy Consulting Director - Commercial Property and Casualty
Job.JobDescription:
Insurance Strategy Consulting Director - Commercial Property and Casualty This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work 3 days in our New York City Office and 2 days from home. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Strategy Advisory group within the Strategy & Technology Group (STG) vertical in New York. Aon STG Strategy Advisory provides consulting services to firms who operate across the insurance landscape, which include many of the most prestigious companies in the Global Property, Casualty, Insurtech, Digital Platforms, and Health and Benefit (re)insurance market. We help our clients to navigate a fast-changing market environment to drive profitable and sustainable growth and business results. We have privileged access to Aon’s proprietary data and its global network of (re)insurance industry experts to derive unique and compelling insights into the sources of competitive advantage in our industry. Most importantly we help our clients to turn insights into practical actions and into tangible outcomes. As a Strategy Consulting Director you will: Lead the full lifecycle of complex client engagements from ideation to project scope definition to project management, delivery and presentation to C-suite Manage the overall client relationship building credibility and trust Be responsible for project delivery and managing Associate, Senior Associate and Manager team members within the project team Be responsible for structuring a client project/problem into phases and questions, hypothesis testing, story building and deliverable production Lead problem solving sessions with internal/external clients to develop processes, methodologies, and transition strategies that will guide them to the objective future state Developing storyboard, framework for analysis, and formulating overarching narrative Lead the identification and communication of recommendations to clients Oversee the implementation and execution of strategic recommendations Developing and drafting client proposals, articulating STG’s value proposition Work towards selling client engagements through ongoing relationship, delivery of strategic initiatives and other business development activities Work in a collaborative environment with clients and colleagues Challenge the status quo and internal processes to identify opportunities to work more efficiently Lead by strong example, mentor, coach, and potentially line manage Associates and Senior Associates Support and lead additional function (talent, data, operations, etc) in support of STG’s growth including data management, operations, compliance, etc. How this opportunity is different As a Strategy Consulting Director, you will be in a client-facing role working directly with Client Leaders and Aon Leadership to develop strategies and solutions to help our clients turn insights into practical actions, and into tangible returns. Your role will involve leading consulting teams to deliver business focused initiatives and strategic recommendations for our clients through understanding their objectives, addressing their challenges, developing an understanding of market conditions and issues, and defining strategies that drive growth opportunities and competitive market advantages. In addition to Client delivery, you will be responsible for managing Client relationships and Aon network relationships, coaching, mentoring, and developing the staff, contribute to expanding STG’s market presence, and supporting the growth of our organization. Skills and experience that will lead to success 10+ years of work experience in corporate strategy or management consulting (prominent advisory firm experience is preferred) and experience in the P&C insurance industry Experience leading projects and managing teams of professionals to deliver quality and insightful work to Executive stakeholders Experienced in business storytelling and formulating strategic narratives Ability to develop robust and impactful Client & Executive presentations Excellent written and verbal communication skills Strong analytical abilities and a track record of business success Strong attention to detail and a critical eye in overseeing work of more junior team members Ability to perform well under pressure, on multiple work streams, and with tight deadlines Fluency in Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint and Excel) Willing to travel (typically less than 20%) Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent years of industry experience. MBA Preferred For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $180,000 to $230,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. #LI-AR1 #LI-HYBRID 2582517

Job.JobTitle: ECG Global Natural Resources Industry Leader
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is seeking an Enterprise Client Group Industry Leader for our Natural Resources Industry across our global Enterprise Client Group and individuals serving these clients. The Natural Resources Industry Leader will be responsible for taking industry insights, content and capability to Enterprise clients globally, providing feedback from clients on trends and themes in the industry—both current and emerging. This role will be responsible for the growth of revenue across the portfolio of Enterprise Clients as well as retention and accelerated growth of the Enterprise Portfolio as well their own clients within the industry. The role will support and coach Enterprise Client Leaders to grow relationships with Aon’s largest global clients within the industry. This role involves collaborating with the Industry work done in Region and Solution Line related to Natural Resources specialty. It ensures content, insights, and innovation are used to bring our best insights, content, and capability to our Enterprise Client Group. The Industry Leader will have responsibility and accountability to implement the Industry playbook and work in collaboration with other Industry Leaders, Regional Leadership, Sales Enablement, and Marketing. The Natural Resources Industry Leader will report directly into the Global ECG Industry Leader. This role ideally should be based in a major Aon office and will be in-office or with clients at least three days a week (hybrid). The Natural Resources Industry Leader will require distinct capabilities in following areas: Insights Deep understanding of industry-specific issues that are top of mind for senior executives Ability to connect these issues to Aon Solutions and offerings to customize products and services Support industry specific content creation working closely with the Natural Resources content, capability team and solution lines Bringing insights to relevant client events both hosted by Aon and where Aon is sponsor/participant Build two case studies per month for use in presentations, RFPs and use with monthly Steering Committee calls and ECL calls Relationships Leverage a broad senior relationship network to open doors with new buying centers at ECG clients Build deeper relationships with Enterprise Client Leaders to expand Aon’s relevance and buying centers across Natural Resources Enterprise clients Mentor ECLs in connecting relationship dots at clients and building trusted client relationships, including through AEC, ELT and relationship mapping Maintain own book of Natural Resources clients (2–3) Collaboration Identify trends and themes to build a multi-year industry strategy and execution plan focused on 3-4 growth plays Lead the Natural Resources Steering Committee, including solution line and regional representation Build a Natural Resources community, partnering with industry analysts, centers of excellence and Sales Enablement to build ECL & ACL skills around relationship, relevance and scalable revenue growth Support solution sprints that create value across Natural Resources ECG clients Participate in Global/Regional councils to discuss external events and help ECLs bring solutions/content to market Partner with Natural Resources Solution Line leaders to Aon is looking for a Managing Director, Catastrophe Management Analytics to join our Client Delivery team in Chicago, Bloomington, New York, or Boston! As a senior leader within the Catastrophe Management team, you will play an integral role in delivering catastrophe analytics, risk insights, and strategic consulting to Aon Reinsurance Solutions clients. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and brokers, providing strategic and analytical leadership across significant client relationships and helping translate complex catastrophe risk into actionable business and reinsurance strategies. You will also provide leadership across Catastrophe Management, developing colleagues, connecting clients with expertise and capabilities across Aon, and helping advance our analytical solutions, tools, and client delivery. Role Responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of catastrophe analytics across significant and/or complex client relationships, ensuring analytics are aligned with client objectives, reinsurance strategy, and broader risk management needs. Serve as a trusted analytics advisor and key member of client teams, building strong relationships with clients and brokers and providing perspective on complex catastrophe risk and analytical issues. Translate catastrophe modeling, exposure, portfolio, and financial analyses into strategic insights supporting reinsurance decisions, portfolio management, risk selection, and other client risk management objectives. Provide senior technical and analytical judgment on complex client challenges, including model assumptions and uncertainty, data quality, model interpretation, and appropriate application of catastrophe analytics. Develop a deep understanding of clients' businesses, risk profiles, and strategic priorities to identify needs and develop customized analytical approaches and solutions. Connect client needs with expertise, capabilities, products, and solutions across Aon, bringing together the appropriate resources to deliver integrated client solutions. Provide leadership across client teams, establishing priorities, maintaining high standards for analytical delivery, and anticipating and addressing resource and capability needs in partnership with Catastrophe Management leadership. Develop colleagues and future leaders through coaching, mentoring, technical and client guidance, and ongoing feedback. Lead or sponsor the advancement and adoption of analytical capabilities, technologies, tools, workflows, and products that improve client outcomes and organizational effectiveness. Provide leadership across Catastrophe Management through segment, client, capability, or subject matter leadership and contribute to broader organizational priorities. Skills and experience that will lead to success: 12+ years of relevant experience in catastrophe modeling, catastrophe risk analytics, reinsurance, insurance, or a closely related field. Deep understanding of catastrophe modeling concepts, exposure data, model assumptions and uncertainty, and the application of catastrophe analytics to insurance and reinsurance decision-making. Experience using leading catastrophe modeling platforms and interpreting model output, along with strong working knowledge of the tools used to deliver and communicate catastrophe analytics. Strong understanding of reinsurance structures and demonstrated ability to connect catastrophe analytics with reinsurance strategy and broader client risk management objectives. Demonstrated experience leading analytics for significant and/or complex client relationships and developing trusted relationships with senior client and broking stakeholders. Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts, implications, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated leadership across teams, accounts, or analytical initiatives, with the ability to influence outcomes and work effectively across organizational boundaries. Experience developing colleagues through mentoring, coaching, feedback, and leadership of multidisciplinary client teams. Experience contributing to broader analytical, capability, technology, or organizational initiatives beyond individual client assignments. BA/BS degree in a quantitative, analytical, scientific, actuarial, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Desired Skills (not required, but would help you stand out) Experience supporting global and/or complex commercial accounts with sophisticated catastrophe risk and analytics needs. Experience leading significant analytical capabilities, products, technology, or organizational initiatives. Industry certifications such as ARe, CPCU, CCRMP, or CCRA are a plus, but not required. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. Associate Director - Client Advocate - Reinsurance This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our New York City, Chicago or Atlanta office Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like The Associate Director (Client Advocate II) at Aon carries a wide-ranging set of responsibilities focused on reinsurance broking and client engagement. You will independently manage documentation, adhere to company regulations, and collaborate with internal teams on client plans. You will take initiative in interacting with clients and broker teams, analyze and assess claim details, and confirm accuracy in claims data. Account coordination, support for reinsurance placements, and serving as an intermediary among brokers, clients, and markets will be essential to your role. Additionally, you will prepare and review reinsurance submissions, spot and fix coding or invoice errors, and compose codes for clients and reinsurers. Leading and training fellow client advocates, defining team targets, and promoting communication and collaboration will also be part of your everyday responsibilities. Job responsibilities: Learn and retain knowledge of the reinsurance broking process without supervision. Receipt of submission from client. Request a quote from the reinsurer. Quote from reinsurer and to client. Firm order from client and to reinsurance market(s). Invoicing. Evidence of Cover document production. Acquire and implement understanding of Aon’s proprietary systems. Independently work with client services to answer queries. Collaborate with Internal Audit to prepare documentation and follow company compliance policies. Attend prescribed Aon My Learning courses. Actively connect and maintain communication with clients and broker teams. Review and analyze claim details, verify accuracy in claims data, and work with brokers on client concerns. Support pre and post reinsurance placements. Communicate clearly with clients and markets, serving as a bridge. Prepare and review reinsurance submissions using Aon’s proprietary systems. Identify and resolve coding or invoice inaccuracies with accounting. Work with the Business Entity Office (BEO) in crafting codes for clients and reinsurers. Train and lead other client advocates in compliance and established guidelines. Set and achieve realistic and stretch targets for the team. Strengthen relationships with cedents and reinsurers. Monitor and facilitate external and internal relationships. Encourage open communication and cooperation among different teams. Prepare and review performance management reports to ensure customer service standards are met. Skills and experience that will lead to success 10+ years of experience within the commercial insurance or reinsurance industry. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience in complex account management - responding to high volume transactional requests Exposure to loss run analysis and client insurance submissions Excellent interpersonal and communication skills both written, verbal and active listening. Strategic and analytical thinking, with problem-solving creativity. Accuracy, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail. Strong leadership and project management skills. Proven ability and experience in applying judgment, problem-solving, decision-making, and negotiation skills. Ability to mentor and develop team members. Understanding and communication of broader Aon initiatives, goals, and focus. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Job.JobDescription:
We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Broker III position reporting into the New York City office. This is a great opportunity to join the Construction Services Group to broker/consult on behalf of a diversified client base with insurance underwriters in the management/professional liability insurance discipline. This hybrid position involves working onsite 3 days each week. We welcome applications from candidates based in the Northeast & West coast regions. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Responsible for the day-to-day, account management and for broking. Build and deepen relationships with Aon colleagues worldwide to address the service needs and demands of global construction and design firms. Builds, expands, and solidifies relationships with existing clients at senior levels within the company. Negotiates with underwriters and /structures insurance programs on behalf of clients. Through service, consultation and reporting, promotes the value Aon delivers to clients. Ensures operational excellence, including adherence to service management requirements Pro-actively develops knowledge of sister Aon companies and seeks to identify and develop relevant cross sales opportunities and Aon tools. Enjoys developing new client relationships and building upon existing relationships. Works and collaborates with Aon leadership to achieve goals. Influences and has exposure to Aon leaders in multiple locations. How this opportunity is different Join Aon’s industry-leading Construction Services Group and work with sophisticated construction clients on complex management and professional liability programs. This role offers direct exposure to senior client leaders, top insurance markets, and national brokerage leadership—providing a unique opportunity to influence strategy, build lasting relationships, and advance your career within a global market leader. Skills and experience that will lead to success At least 10 years of placement experience or comparable experience in the construction industry segment Insurance licensing required - complete required training and exam necessary to obtain appropriate agent’s license(s) (may be obtained upon employment) and ongoing continuing education Advanced Degree or professional designation may be preferred, including CPCU, CPLU CIC or ARM Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Power Point Good working knowledge of the brokerage business Superior written and communication skills to support conduct of business in a professional manner with external/internal clients and the marketplace Strong team player who understands the roles and responsibilities of other Aon professionals, assumes responsibility for the timely delivery of a professional work product in accordance with assigned roles, and facilitates communication among team members Continually strives for perfection and professionalism in all communications and work products Continually strives for personal professional development Promotes a positive attitude in always trying to improve a program Adherence to Aon’s Business Code of Conduct Develop proficiency in use of in-house account management systems (Account Team Desktop, AMe, Bridge, GRIP) Bachelor’s degree in or equivalent years of industry experience. A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required, or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Considering a job change? Take a look at Aon! Our Affinity Insurance Services looking for an Account Manager II. This is a hybrid role based out of our Fort Washington, PA office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Position Summary Affinity Insurance Services, Inc. is seeking an experienced, self-directed Account Manager to oversee the administration of the Company Sponsored Program. This role requires demonstrated expertise in independently managing client relationships, annual renewals, agent enrollment, reporting, financial reconciliation, and cross-functional coordination. The ideal candidate will possess strong account management, analytical, project coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges, exercise sound judgment, and ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality program delivery with minimal direction. Key Responsibilities: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned Company Sponsored clients, building strong relationships and understanding client and agent needs. Manage annual renewal cycles, including project plans, timelines, deliverables, renewal forms, rates, client approvals, communications, and follow-up activity. Coordinate enrollment activities for new, renewal, and mid-term agents across online, mail, direct pay, and ledger deduction processes. Oversee roster management, including data validation, upload coordination, client review, agent additions/removals, payment method updates, coverage changes, and reconciliation against administrative systems. Partner with IT and operations teams on website updates, client portal enhancements, enrollment uploads, certificate issuance, service tickets, system troubleshooting, and process improvements. Coordinate cross-functional activities across customer service, finance, accounting, mailroom, marketing, compliance, IT, and carrier or broker partners to meet client and agent service expectations. Monitor customer service activity, call drivers, service trends, and critical issues to improve agent experience and ensure consistent, professional support. Prepare and distribute client reporting, including monthly rosters, weekly or bi-weekly enrollment updates, waiver reporting, cancellation/refund files, premium reconciliation, and ad hoc reports. Manage account and premium reconciliation, accounts receivable follow-up, fee tracking, invoicing support, and premium or surplus lines tax remittance coordination as applicable. Maintain current procedures, training materials, client reference documents, and process documentation to support operational consistency and knowledge transfer. Find opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, enhance digital adoption, strengthen controls, and improve the overall client and agent experience. Qualifications: Minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience in account management, insurance program administration, financial services, or a similar client-facing operational role. You must have demonstrated responsibility for managing complex processes and multiple collaborators. Active Property & Casualty brokers license highly preferred, or must be obtained within 6 months of hire Experience managing projects or recurring business cycles from planning through execution, including tracking deliverables, resolving obstacles, and meeting deadlines. Demonstrated ability to independently handle client accounts, operational workflows, and contending priorities with limited supervision. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for both internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders, complemented by strong client relationship management experience. Strong analytical skills, including experience reviewing complex data, identifying discrepancies, and driving issues through resolution. High attention to detail and ability to handle data, rosters, reconciliations, and operational documentation accurately. Ability to work collaboratively across operations, finance, IT, compliance, customer service, and client-facing teams. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. Customer-focused approach with practical judgment and accountability for results. Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $60,000 - $75,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2587113

Excess Casualty Broker, Senior Vice President The National Casualty Practice is a premier team of casualty brokerage professionals with extensive experience in representing buyers of primary and umbrella/excess liability. We are looking to add a senior broker to our Excess Casualty team! We are considering applicants in New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles. This is a hybrid role with at least three days a week in the office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Executing placements within required timeframes and servicing those placements including their renewals. Analyze and review insurance programs for clients to determine optimum program including structure, pricing, terms and conditions for both new and renewal business. Help with the development of new and innovative solutions for the National Casualty Practice Develop and maintain strong relationships with the carriers and underwriters. Mentor and help develop less experienced members of the team. Work as a team member and collaborate with other colleagues within the Aon team. Knowledge of Benchmarking and Loss Analysis. You’ll influence client outcomes, drive innovation through data and analytics, and shape the future of our business. As a senior broker, you’ll mentor top talent, build strong market relationships, and collaborate with leadership — all while helping to grow Aon’s casualty portfolio. Strong understanding of national casualty risks and carrier appetites. Broad relationships with the carriers that write national casualty P&C business. Strong collaboration and communication skills.
