Company Details

Berkley Medical Management Solutions (BMMS) provides a different kind of managed-care service for W.R. Berkley Corporation. We believe focusing on an injured worker’s successful and speedy return to work is good for people and good for Berkley’s insurance operating units. BMMS was first started in 2014 by reimagining the relationship between medical need and technology to deliver the best outcome for injured workers and Berkley’s operating units. Our goal was clear: combine solid clinical practices, proven return-to-work strategies and robust software into one system for seamless management of workers’ compensation cases.

To get it right, we started with a flexible technology platform that allowed for impressive customization without sacrificing the ability for expansion and continued innovation. We deploy integrated systems to give W.R. Berkley Companies recommendations and professional services for managing each individual case in an efficient and appropriate manner. The power of our technology takes medical bill-review services and clinical advisory services to a new level. Our unique marriage of technology, software platforms, data analytics and professional services ensures we provide Berkley’s operating units with reliable results, and reduced time and expenses associated with case management.

Responsibilities

As a Business Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in helping BMMS reach its goals by carrying-out the Business Analyst “Key Functions” outlined below. The Business Analyst is multi-faceted and acts as a liaison between business, operations, other business analysts, and IT resources internal to BMMS and external with BMMS’ vendors and Berkley sister companies.  The Business Analyst’s objective is to perform the business analysis function to help BMMS achieve strategic, project based, and department level success wherever a business analysis resource is deemed appropriate and is deployed, and help educate fellow team members on Active Listening, Balanced Approach, Boldness, Critical Thinking, Integrity, and Quality Decision Making.

  • Determine business analysis work that will be required during the planning phase of projects and process improvement efforts.
  • Elicit and document business requirements for projects, including core product build & enhancements and implementations; business process workflows, service management issues; &/or identified opportunities for improvement.  Requirements may include but are not limited to those that result in business and IT-based solutions including coding, configuration, EDI, reporting, process workflow, etc. These may impact BMMS only or BMMS’ vendors &/or Berkley sister company systems/programs.  Elicitation activities include leading large groups of diverse people within all levels of the organizations through detailed requirements gathering sessions.
  • Analyze business requirements to verify clarity and completeness with business owners; validate every requirement gathered belongs within the scope of project or assignment by comparing it to the stated business need & objective; confirm & document assumptions and constraints.
  • Analyze proposed solutions with the business owner and impacted IT &/or operational areas for clarity and completeness.  Solutions may include changes or enhancements to systems/programs &/or operational workflows and may have impacts only internal to BMMS, to BMMS’ vendors, &/or to Berkley sister companies.
  • Document high-level business requirements and/or detailed IT specifications using department-approved templates/formats (where applicable) to produce requirements artifacts that may include: Business Requirements Documents (“BRDs”), Policy & Procedure documents (“P&Ps”), IT Functional Specifications/User Stories, Report Specifications, Workflow Documents (Visios). 
  • Contribute to test design, planning, scenario-building, and validation.
  • For service management issues:  Identify root cause(s); lead resolution for specific issues; document issue, progress, and resolution clearly/completely in accordance with department standards; follow-up on root cause and lead root cause resolution with necessary business owner escalations & approvals.
  • Assist department in fulfilling goals and objectives by carrying-out other duties as assigned.
  • Mentor Associate Business Analysts.

Job.JobDescription:
Company Details

Company URL: https://www.berkleytechnologyservices.com/  

Berkley Technology Services (BTS) is the dynamic technology solution for W. R. Berkley Corporation, a Fortune 500 Commercial Lines Insurance Company. With key locations in Urbandale, IA and Wilmington, DE, BTS provides innovative and customer-focused IT solutions to the majority of WRBC’s 60+ operating units across the globe. BTS’s wide reach ensures that ideas and opinions are considered at every level of the organization to guarantee we find the best solutions possible.   

Driven by a commitment to collaboration, BTS acts as consultants to our customers and Operating Units by providing comprehensive solutions that not only address the challenge at hand but proactively plan for the “What’s Next” in our industry and beyond.   

With a culture centered on innovation and entrepreneurial spirit, BTS stands as a community of technology leaders with eyes toward the future -- leaders who truly care about growing not only their team members, but themselves, and take pride in their employees who shine. BTS offers endless ways to get involved and have the chance to grow your career into a wide range of roles you'd never known existed. Come join us as we push forward into the future of industry leading technological solutions.   

Berkley Technology Services: Right Team, Right Technology, Simple and Secure.  

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Engineer, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management serves as the technical engineering lead for VIPR (Vulnerability Incident Prevention & Remediation), the enterprise capability accountable for the patch and vulnerability remediation lifecycle across services, applications, platforms, and infrastructure. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management, this role leads the technical planning, orchestration, and execution of patch-related changes and partners with BTS technology teams, Cybersecurity, Service Management, Change Management, Application Support, and Operating Unit Technology organizations to ensure patches, vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings are remediated in a timely manner aligned with established service level agreements (SLAs).

The role is accountable for technical change orchestration and execution, AI-based vulnerability and patch analysis, exception review, and incident escalation. Success requires deep technical breadth across enterprise platforms, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate with and influence technical teams without direct authority.

Key functions include but are not limited to:

  • Technical Lead – Change Orchestration & Execution: Serve as the technical lead for patch-related change orchestration and execution across the enterprise. Build and sequence automated deployment plans, maintenance windows, dependencies, and rollback procedures; prepare and submit change records; and lead technical execution and bridge coordination during enterprise maintenance events. Coordinate remediation across products onto shared maintenance windows so that systems are touched once rather than repeatedly, reducing end-user disruption and change collisions.
  • AI-Based Vulnerability & Patch Analysis: Leverage AI-enabled tools, analytics, and automation to analyze vulnerability scan data, threat intelligence, and patch release information; correlate findings to assets and service owners; predict deployment risk and service impact; identify remediation trends, recurring failures, and root causes; and produce data-driven prioritization recommendations. Ensure AI-generated outputs are validated and used in alignment with BTS security, data, and responsible AI standards.
  • Exception Review & Risk Validation: Perform technical review of patch and vulnerability exception requests, validating business justification, compensating controls, residual risk, and remediation timelines. Provide technical recommendations to the Sr. Manager and Cybersecurity, track exceptions to expiration, and ensure exceptions are re-evaluated and closed in alignment with governance expectations.
  • Incident Escalation & Response: Act as the escalation point for patch-related incidents, failed deployments, and service degradation following maintenance activities. Triage issues, engage appropriate resolver groups, coordinate rollback or remediation actions, escalate critical issues to technology leadership, and participate in post-incident and problem management reviews to prevent recurrence.
  • Offshore Execution Pod Technical Direction: Provide day-to-day technical direction to the offshore execution pod, including remediation wave planning and handoffs, automated testing execution, ticket queue prioritization, evidence quality, and off-hours execution readiness; review pod work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Vulnerability Remediation Execution: Partner with teams to drive technical remediation of critical, high, medium, and low vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings across every device on the network within established SLAs.
  • Code Remediation Influence & Enablement: Partner with product owners to influence, prioritize, and drive code changes required to remediate vulnerabilities. Champion and leverage AI-based tools to facilitate code analysis, development of remediation recommendations, and validation of proposed fixes, working with product owners to drive implementation within established remediation SLAs.
  • Service Validation and Post-Patch Checkout: Lead tiered service health validation following remediation — from enterprise up/downs to basic and comprehensive automated validation — partnering with product owners and stakeholder teams who define what healthy looks like. Confirm operational readiness, capture remediation evidence, and implement new tests when disruption reveals gaps in coverage.
  • Automation and Tooling: Partner with SRE and DevOps team, Platform Engineering, and product owners to design, build, and enhance automated checkout and validation, remediation orchestration, deployment pipelines, and evidence collection using enterprise tools and scripting.
  • Reporting and Compliance Support: Review and analyze reporting prepared by the offshore execution pod on patch compliance, vulnerability aging, SLA adherence, deployment success rates, exception status, and incident trends, providing technical insight to support management and executive reporting.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Develop and maintain technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles; identify opportunities to improve patching reliability, reduce deployment risk, and increase automation coverage.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered.
  • 5+ years of technical experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, systems engineering, or infrastructure operations
  • Experience leading technical execution of enterprise change and maintenance activities across multiple platforms
  • Hands-on experience with patch and vulnerability tooling
  • Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation tools to operational or security data
  • Working knowledge of public cloud platforms and modern data, integration, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.

Core Skills/Competencies:

  • Patch Management Engineering (P) - plans, sequences, and executes enterprise patch deployments safely and consistently.
  • Vulnerability Management (P) - analyzes findings, prioritizes remediation, and drives SLA compliance.
  • Change Orchestration & Execution (P) - leads technical change planning, implementation, validation, and rollback across platforms.
  • AI and Data Analysis (P) - applies AI-based tools and analytics to vulnerability, patch, and operational data to inform prioritization and decisions.
  • Risk and Exception Analysis (P) - evaluates exposure, compensating controls, and residual risk to support exception decisions.
  • Incident Management (P) - triages, escalates, and coordinates resolution of patch-related incidents.
  • Automation and Scripting (N) - improves deployment reliability, reporting, and evidence collection.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms. The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees which for this role include: • Base Salary Range: $90,000 - $127,600 • Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Sponsorship Details

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

This role will: 

  • Lead the engineering, deployment, administration, and continuous enhancement of Microsoft Sentinel as the organization’s enterprise SIEM platform, including workspace architecture, RBAC, retention management, and ingestion cost optimization.• Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot security data ingestion pipelines and Sentinel connectors using Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, CEF/Syslog, APIs, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and custom integration patterns.• Validate and troubleshoot ingested data using KQL and other tools, resolving data quality, schema, parsing, normalization, latency, performance, and ingestion reliability issues.• Engineer and support log routing, filtering, parsing, and transformation through Cribl, including troubleshooting upstream ingestion issues and onboarding new data sources into Sentinel.• Establish scalable and supportable patterns for onboarding security telemetry from on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and third-party platforms, including automated monitoring and validation of ingestion pipelines.• Apply engineering best practices to Sentinel configurations and content, including source control, testing, peer review, CI/CD deployment, technical documentation, and lifecycle management.• Proactively identify routine, repeatable, and manual tasks across security engineering platforms and develop automations that reduce Manage Complex Claims:

Handling complex personal lines property claims for high-net-worth clients.

As a General Adjuster (Property Field Adjuster), you will be responsible for quality handling and resolution of property claims including complex, high exposure claims in a timely, professional manner with emphasis on providing quality service. We'll trust you to handle all manner and size of personal lines property claims - most often for high net worth customers.   

This role will require a colleague to travel to cover a territory within Texas therefore this person will need to reside in the Dallas Fort Worth area.

  • Internal mobility opportunities

  • Calm under pressure; you have excellent organizational and negotiation skills, integrity, and great follow-through on tasks

Responsibilities

The Chief Claims Officer (CCO) serves as the highest level of Claims leadership in the Operating Unit (OU) and is responsible for Claims strategy, operations, compliance, customer service, and overall management of loss costs.  The CCO serves as a member and key contributor on the OU’s Executive Committee and Senior Leadership Team (SLT), working above and beyond the Claims functional area as a co-leader of the OU in general.  The CCO is also responsible for all aspects of people management, engagement, and performance of the Claims staff.  The CCO leads innovation in both the Claims function and beyond.

  • Develops and communicates the vision, strategy and priorities of the Claims organization; including operational plans and controls to assure they are effectively executed.
  • Leads development and achievement of department goals including aligned performance objectives for all Claims staff. Assures effective metrics are in place, monitored, analyzed and reported regularly.
  • Assures sound case reserving practices and achieves favorable total claim outcomes, balancing loss costs, ALAE, and ULAE, with minimal claims leakage.
  • Leads Innovation ideation and experimentation to enhance the customer experience and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of claim operations.
  • Attains high levels of claims file quality through a robust, self-critical Quality Assurance program supplemented by a strong compliance model with effective controls and monitors.
  • Serves as the highest level of technical authority for claims pricing (reserve and settlement) and decision-making.
  • Directly manages the Claims Leadership Team comprised of Claims managers at various levels.
  • Assures optimal and high-performing relationships with other WRBC entities (RSS, BTS, BSS, BMMS, MEC, AMP, other Regional Segment companies, WRBC Corporate Claims) as well as all other BMAG functional areas.
  • Identifies and manages outsourced partnerships with law firms, independent adjusting firms, and other service providers; assures SLAs are in place and met, and services are priced appropriately.
  • Monitors emerging issues in Commercial claims, sharing knowledge across the organization and devising claims responses and mitigations to new and emerging risks.
  • Participates as an active member in industry trade groups, associations, and conferences.
  • In collaboration with the President and SLT, contributes significantly to the OU’s strategy, planning and execution of enterprise-wide imperatives.
  • Leads a PeopleFirst culture that attracts, develops, engages, and retains top talent.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of advanced multiline commercial claims leadership experience, preferably in the Chief Claims Officer role in a similar company or as a direct-reporting subordinate in a larger company.
  • Extensive multi-lines claims technical experience including Auto, Property, General Liability, Workers Compensation, and Umbrella claims.
  • Executive level skill and expertise in strategy, communications, and people management.
  • Executive level competency in the Berkley Innovation behaviors of Effective Collaboration, Courage, Managing Self, Resiliency, Challenging the Status Quo, Evidence-Based Decision Making, and Reflective Listening.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher required.
  • CPCU, CCP, AIC or other professional industry certifications preferred.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic enterprise thinking: Connects actuarial evidence to long-term competitive advantage, capital deployment, and operating priorities.

Commercial and underwriting acumen: Understands how product, appetite, distribution, claims, expense, and price interact to create sustainable returns.

Quality decision making: Balances rigor and speed; distinguishes what is known, uncertain, assumed, and actionable.

Influence and communication: Creates clarity, earns trust, constructively challenges, and turns analysis into commitment and action.

Technology and AI stewardship: Recognizes high-value use cases and establishes proportionate governance, controls, and human oversight.

Talent multiplication: Builds successors, broadens capabilities, and creates an environment where diverse perspectives improve decisions.

Execution and accountability: Sets priorities, simplifies work, assigns ownership, monitors outcomes, and closes the loop.

The IAM Automation Engineer designs, develops, and supports automation solutions that improve Identity and Access Management (IAM) operations, governance, compliance, and the security of both human and non-human identities. This role focuses on automating identity lifecycle processes, integrating IAM platforms with enterprise systems, and establishing governance for non-human identities such as service accounts, service principals, managed identities, APIs, bots, and machine credentials. The position also enables secure AI-assisted capabilities that increase operational efficiency while maintaining strong security controls, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness.

Cloud exposure management and platform ownership  Configure, administer, optimize, and troubleshoot cloud security and exposure management platforms such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud. Security automation and engineering Design and build reusable automation for cloud security operations using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, JSON/YAML, workflow orchestration, serverless services, and Infrastructure as Code. Responsibilities

As a High Value Home Risk Consultant, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to affluent homeowners, helping them protect their homes, families, and valuable assets from preventable loss. Through on-site and virtual risk assessments, the consultant identifies vulnerabilities and exposures, educates clients on emerging and common risks, and develops practical, customized loss prevention strategies.

By combining technical expertise with a consultative approach, the Risk Consultant helps clients understand their risks, evaluate mitigation options, and make informed decisions that enhance safety, resilience, and long-term asset protection. The role is focused not only on identifying exposures, but also on influencing action and supporting clients throughout their loss prevention journey.

You'll be an essential partner to Underwriting by validating property characteristics, assessing overall risk quality, establishing accurate replacement cost estimates, and escalating material underwriting concerns that may impact eligibility, pricing, or coverage decisions.

This is a fully remote/work-from-home position supporting accounts throughout New York City with heavy concentration in Manhattan, and serving the Brooklyn/Kings county area.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments for high-value homes to identify exposures that could lead to property damage, personal liability, or threats to client safety and security.

  • Evaluate risks associated with water damage, fire, electrical systems, severe weather, natural catastrophes, homes under construction, personal security, and other exposures common to affluent homeowners.

  • Deliver tailored loss prevention recommendations designed to reduce the likelihood and severity of loss while improving the resilience of the home and lifestyle.

  • Act as a trusted advisor by educating clients on risks, explaining mitigation options, and supporting informed decision-making.

  • Encourage and influence adoption of loss prevention measures through effective consultation, clear communication, and ongoing engagement with clients and brokers.

  • Maintain knowledge of emerging loss trends, technologies, and best practices to provide relevant and actionable risk management guidance.

  • Collaborate with brokers, clients, contractors, and service providers to facilitate the implementation of recommended risk mitigation solutions.

  • Validate and document property characteristics, construction features, protective systems, and occupancy information to support sound underwriting decisions.

  • Develop, validate, and maintain accurate replacement cost estimates to help ensure adequate insurance-to-value.

  • Identify, evaluate, and escalate material underwriting concerns, changes in risk profile, or coverage adequacy issues discovered during the assessment process.

  • Prepare clear and concise risk assessment reports that communicate exposures, recommendations, and underwriting considerations.

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What you'll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience in risk management, loss control, underwriting, claims, construction, appraising, or a related property risk discipline.

  • Strong ability to identify property loss exposures and provide effective loss prevention and risk mitigation recommendations.

  • Knowledge of residential construction, building systems, property valuation, and replacement cost methodologies.

  • Experience working with affluent clients and a solid understanding of personal insurance products and risk management principles.

  • Proficiency with e2Value or similar valuation platforms.

  • Exceptional communication, consulting, and relationship-management skills.

  • Customer-focused with the ability to influence action, build trust, and advocate for client needs.

  • Highly organized, accountable, and collaborative, with strong judgment and problem-solving skills.

What makes you stand out:

  • Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

Company Details

Berkley Medical Management Solutions (BMMS) provides a different kind of managed-care service for W.R. Berkley Corporation. We believe focusing on an injured worker’s successful and speedy return to work is good for people and good for Berkley’s insurance operating units. BMMS was first started in 2014 by reimagining the relationship between medical need and technology to deliver the best outcome for injured workers and Berkley’s operating units. Our goal was clear: combine solid clinical practices, proven return-to-work strategies and robust software into one system for seamless management of workers’ compensation cases.

To get it right, we started with a flexible technology platform that allowed for impressive customization without sacrificing the ability for expansion and continued innovation. We deploy integrated systems to give W.R. Berkley Companies recommendations and professional services for managing each individual case in an efficient and appropriate manner. The power of our technology takes medical bill-review services and clinical advisory services to a new level. Our unique marriage of technology, software platforms, data analytics and professional services ensures we provide Berkley’s operating units with reliable results, and reduced time and expenses associated with case management.

Responsibilities

As a Telephonic Nurse Case Manager, you will assess, plan, coordinate, monitor, evaluate and implement options and services to facilitate timely medical care and return to work outcomes of injured workers.

  • Coordinate and implement medical case management to facilitate case closure
  • Timely and comprehensive communication with with employers, adjusters and the injured workers.
  • Assess appropriate utilization of medical treatment and services available through contact with physicians and other specialist to ensure cost effective quality care
  • Review and analyze medical records and assess data to ensure appropriate case management process occurs while providing recommendations to achieve case progress and movement to closure
  • Responsible for assigned caseloads, which may vary in numbers, territory and/or by state jurisdiction
  • Acquire and maintain nursing licensure for all jurisdictions as business needs require
  • Coordinate services to include home services, durable medical equipment, IMEs, admissions, discharges, and vocational services when appropriate and evaluate cost effectiveness and quality of services
  • Document activities and case progress using appropriate methods and tools following best practices for quality improvement
  • Reviewing job analysis/job description with all providers to coordinate and implement disability case management. This includes coordinating job analysis with employer to facilitate return to work.
  • Engage and participate in special projects as assigned by case management leadership team
  • Occasionally attend on site meetings and professional programs
  • Foster a teamwork environment
  • Maintaining and updating evidence based medical guidelines (such as Official Disability Guidelines, MD Guidelines and all required state regulated guidelines) in reference to the injured worker treatment plan and work status.
  • Obtain and maintain applicable state certifications and/or licensures in the state where job duties are performed.
  • Obtain case management professional certification (CCM) within 2 years of hire date
  • Earn Continuing Education Units to maintain certifications and licensures

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in workers compensation insurance and medical case management preferred
  • Ability to work Pacific Standard Time business hours
  • California RN license greatly preferred 
  • Minimum of 4 years medical/surgical clinical experience required
  • Exhibit strong communication skills, professionalism, flexibility and adaptability
  • Possess working knowledge of medical and vocational resources available to the Workers’ Compensation industry
  • Demonstrate evidence of self-motivation and the ability to perform case management duties independently
  • Demonstrate evidence of computer and technology skills
  • Oral and written fluency in both Spanish and English a plus

Education 

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing and possess a current RN license.
  • *RN compact license preferred, CCM preferred, Bachelor of Nursing preferred*

The Underwriter/Sr. Underwriter will manage all related underwriting tasks for new and renewal accounts required in assigned regions to promote written premium growth and favorable loss ratio results.  The role will work closely with the TMs, AVPs, RVPs across assigned regions.  The role is expected to have increased involvement in the management, development and training of junior underwriting staff and increased responsibility for the business results of BMP. This role will also have significant influence as to the workflow and execution of a number of strategic initiatives.  This role may be responsible for managing a team of underwriters.

Duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for new & renewal accounts which focuses on underwriting and pricing risks in accordance with BMP’s business rules and personal underwriting authority. 
  • Ownership of the lifecycle of the submission including quoting, filing all relevant documents, binding, issuing and obtaining signed and executed applications. 
  • Support consistent underwriting best practices, in accordance with underwriting guidelines, to ensure rating, pricing, profitability, and structuring adequacy.
  • Responsible for assigning and managing the work of a team of underwriters.
  • Assist underwriters in executing on strategic initiatives. Provide support and develop solutions to their issues/concerns (system, guidelines, training, reports, new project request, product amendments).
  • Assist underwriters in collaborating with Territory Managers, AVPs and RVPs to target desirable accounts.
  • Identify the need for and manage special underwriting projects as needed.
  • Fully engage with agency personnel by providing superior customer service. 
  • In conjunction with TM’s, AVP’s and RVP’s will establish a workflow for renewals that will allow for “Insurance with Ease” for our agents. 
  • Work closely with the TM’s, AVPs and RVP’s to establish and implement a sales culture In collaboration with TM’s, AVP’s and RVP’s, creates the workflow that will establish the best user experience for the independent agent in the onboarding process. 
  • Ownership of the lifecycle of the submission including quoting, filing all relevant documents, binding, issuing and obtaining signed and executed applications. 
  • Manages the submission queue for all regions which requires a strong attention to detail.  Enters submissions in the system and accurately assigns them to the correct underwriter as well as filing documents accordingly. 
  • Establish strong relationships with agents in driving mutually beneficial results through agency planning, production and growth.
  • Monitor competitor’s offerings and emerging industry issues.
  • Embrace relevant technology and actively improves skillset through formal and informal learning.
  • Serves as a resource for new and innovative ideas to continually challenge the status quo.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum of 5-7 years of management liability underwriting or related experience at an insurance company or agency or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience contributing on a high performing marketing/ sales team in a high growth, fast paced environment.
  • Advanced product knowledge within the Management Liability suite of products (D&O, Cyber, EPL, Crime, Fiduciary, and MPL).
  • Empathy and understanding of the needs of our independent agents.  Will be an advocate for Berkley Management Protection customers and as such, will be passionate about their brand experience. 
  • An agile team player with strong written and verbal communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.

Lead Digital Transformation, Cloud Innovation & AI Strategy at Berkley One

Are you a hands-on technology leader who enjoys building modern digital experiences and solving complex business challenges?

Berkley One is looking for a Technology Lead, Digital Experience & Enterprise Services to drive the technology vision and delivery for our Digital Engagement, CRM, Customer Experience, and Enterprise Services platforms.   • West Hartford, CT
  • Morristown, NJ
  • Wilmington, DE
  • Chicago, IL

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience. 
  • 3+ years in a Technology Lead, Lead Engineer, Solution Architect, or similar leadership role. 
  • Proven success designing and delivering enterprise-scale software solutions. 
  • Strong ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong background with Java, Spring Boot, APIs, Microservices, React, and TypeScript.

What makes you stand out:

Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise actuarial, analytics, and portfolio intelligence agenda so that pricing, reserving, capital, reinsurance, planning, and growth decisions consistently improve risk-adjusted returns. The Chief Actuarial Officer translates complex risk into clear choices, builds trusted decision systems, and develops the next generation of actuarial and analytical leadership.

Reporting to the President, the Chief Actuarial Officer is a member of the executive leadership team and the senior actuarial voice for the operating unit. The role owns the integrity and strategic application of actuarial work across pricing, reserving, forecasting, portfolio management, capital and reinsurance support, regulatory matters, and data-enabled decision making. The leader partners closely with the President, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Underwriting Officer, Chief Claims Officer, distribution leaders, and corporate actuarial stakeholders.

Over the five-year horizon, success requires moving beyond production of actuarial indications and reports toward an integrated decision-intelligence model. The Chief Actuarial Officer will establish governed, explainable, repeatable analytics; accelerate feedback loops; identify emerging risk early; and enable leaders to act with confidence while preserving actuarial standards, sound judgment, and appropriate human oversight.

Enterprise Strategy and Executive Decision Support

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the President and executive team, connecting actuarial insight to operating strategy, growth priorities, geographic expansion, product appetite, expense management, and risk-adjusted return objectives.
  • Frame choices through scenarios, ranges, sensitivities, trade-offs, and leading indicators rather than relying only on point estimates or historical summaries.
  • Own the actuarial narrative for quarterly results, annual operating plans, reforecasts, and corporate reviews, with clear explanations of performance drivers and corrective actions.
  • Create a multi-year actuarial and analytics roadmap aligned with enterprise priorities, technology capabilities, talent needs, and governance expectations.

Pricing, Portfolio Steering, and Product Economics

  • Lead pricing adequacy, rate-level, trend, loss-cost, retention, mix, and new-business analyses across Small Commercial and Middle Market package products, Commercial Auto, Workers Compensation, Umbrella, and other assigned lines.
  • Build portfolio steering capabilities that connect indicated need, achieved rate, underwriting action, exposure change, retention, claims emergence, and profitability at actionable segment levels.
  • Partner with underwriting and distribution leadership to define profitable growth guardrails, market and segment priorities, and measurable action plans.
  • Provide actuarial leadership for product development, coverage changes, filings, and experimentation, including disciplined test design, monitoring, and post-implementation evaluation.
  • Advance risk segmentation and price optimization practices while protecting fairness, explainability, regulatory compliance, and sound underwriting judgment.

Reserving, Financial Insight, and Prospective Risk

  • Own the operating unit reserving process and recommendations, including methods, assumptions, diagnostics, documentation, peer review readiness, and communication of uncertainty.
  • Connect reserve analysis with claims operations, underwriting actions, social and economic inflation, legal environment changes, catastrophe activity, and shifts in exposure or mix.
  • Develop prospective views of loss emergence and profitability using actual-versus-expected diagnostics, early-warning indicators, scenario analysis, and stress testing.
  • Partner with Finance on premium, loss, expense, cash-flow, and earnings forecasts; annual planning; and explanations of material variances.
  • Maintain readiness for auditors, regulators, rating agencies, corporate actuarial reviews, and other authorized oversight.

Capital, Reinsurance, Catastrophe, and Emerging Risk

  • Provide actuarial insight for capital allocation, risk appetite, volatility, accumulation, and return-on-equity decisions at line, segment, product, and portfolio levels.
  • Partner on ceded reinsurance strategy, structure evaluation, renewal analytics, exposure data quality, and assessment of retained volatility.
  • Advance catastrophe and climate-related risk analysis appropriate to the portfolio, including geographic concentration, hazard change, model uncertainty, and mitigation opportunities.
  • Establish a repeatable emerging-risk process covering cyber, autonomous and connected technologies, supply-chain disruption, litigation and social inflation, economic regime shifts, and other material exposures.
  • Translate stress and scenario results into practical underwriting, claims, product, reinsurance, and growth recommendations.

Data, AI, Decision Systems, and Model Governance

  • Own the actuarial data and analytics strategy in partnership with technology, data, underwriting, claims, finance, compliance, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Create governed data products and a consistent source of truth for pricing, reserving, plan, actual-versus-expected, rate and retention, exposure, and portfolio performance reporting.
  • Sponsor responsible use of predictive analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and automation where they improve speed, quality, insight, or scalability.
  • Implement model inventory, ownership, validation, documentation, change control, performance monitoring, bias and fairness review, explainability, access controls, and human-judgment standards proportionate to model risk.
  • Ensure automated outputs are reproducible, auditable, secure, and appropriately reviewed before they influence material decisions.

Responsibilities

At Berkley Technology Services, we believe AI-assisted ways of working are becoming a foundational part of how excellent engineering work gets done - much like the way digital communication tools did a generation ago. We expect every member of our team to actively integrate AI tools into their daily work, not as a substitute for expertise, but as a natural extension of it. Candidates who bring genuine curiosity about AI, and a demonstrated habit of using it to work smarter, will find themselves at home here. 

The AI Automation Architect designs, builds, and maintains the automation and AI-enabled capabilities that make Berkley’s Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) function faster, more consistent, and more audit-ready. The role turns manual, repetitive compliance work — evidence collection, control testing support, exception handling, and reporting — into governed, automated workflows, freeing IT Compliance and operating-unit personnel to focus on judgment, risk decisions, and control ownership. 

Working within IT GRC and in close partnership with Information Security, Internal Audit, and the operating units, the engineer builds automations on the enterprise GRC platform (ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Archer), integrates control and evidence data across systems, and applies AI responsibly to accelerate compliance activities. Consistent with BTS’s “security-first” and “use AI to work smarter” principles, this position acts as a force multiplier for the compliance team rather than a replacement for it — accountability, oversight, and risk acceptance remain with people. 

  • Automation & AI Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain GRC automations and AI-enabled solutions that streamline compliance processes, ensuring each solution complies with security, privacy, and governance requirements. 
  • Control Evidence & Testing Support: Automate the collection, validation, and packaging of control evidence for SOX, NYDFS Part 500, and internal control assessments — reducing manual gathering and improving completeness and consistency. 
  • Exception & Workflow Automation: Build and improve exception intake, routing, reporting, and dashboards within ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Archer; support the migration of GRC processes onto the strategic platform. 
  • Integration & Data: Integrate control, risk, and evidence data across GRC, ITSM, identity, and security tooling via APIs and connectors to create reliable, reusable data pipelines and reporting. 
  • Applied AI: Apply AI responsibly to draft first-pass control narratives, summarize findings, map controls to frameworks (NIST CSF 2.0, NYDFS Part 500), and accelerate analysis — with human review retained for all decisions. 
  • Documentation: Create and maintain clear process and technical documentation for every automation, including run books, data lineage, and control mappings, so solutions remain auditable and supportable over time. 
  • Security First: Implement a security-first practice, embedding least-privilege access, logging, and change-control into every automation; ensure AI and automation use aligns with the company AI Policy and GRC governance. 
  • Business Partnership: Partner with IT Compliance analysts, Internal Audit, InfoSec, and OU compliance personnel to identify high-value automation opportunities, gather requirements, and drive adoption of delivered capabilities. 

Qualifications

  • Hands-on automation building. Demonstrated experience turning manual, fragmented processes into engineered, automated workflows — with concrete examples of automations built and shipped, not just advised on. 
  • Programming and scripting. Proficiency in Python and comfort building and consuming APIs / REST integrations to move and connect data across systems. 
  • Workflow and integration tooling. Practical experience with workflow-automation and orchestration tools, plus building reusable pipelines and integrations that others can consume. 
  • Applied AI judgment. Working experience with applied AI — agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM-assisted workflows — and sound judgment on when AI adds value versus when deterministic automation is the better choice. 
  • Data engineering fluency. Ability to structure, transform, and move data reliably across systems as the foundation for automation. 
  • Security-first mindset. Designs with security, oversight, and accountability in mind; keeps human judgment and review in the loop where it matters. 
  • Communication. Can explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership. 
  • Autonomy and influence. Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and influencing adoption across teams without direct authority. 
  •  
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context;approaches AI as a standard part of modern workflow rather than a specializedor optional capability

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves) 

  • Security domain exposure. Familiarity with one or more security domains — identity, cloud security, GRC, security operations, or AI security. 
  • Cloud and sandbox experience. Experience working in Azure and building or operating in lab / sandbox environments. 
  • Reusable patterns and standards. Track record of creating reusable automation patterns, reference designs, or standards that scale across multiple teams or business units. 
  • Coaching orientation. A force-multiplier, coaching-oriented style that raises the whole team’s leverage rather than centralizing all delivery on one person. 
  • Enterprise scale. Experience delivering solutions adopted broadly across a large or distributed organization. 

Education and Experience 

  • Education. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Experience. Several years of hands-on experience in software/automation engineering, data/integration engineering, or applied AI, including delivery of production-grade automation. 

Core Competencies 

Aligned to the WRB Competency Model and our Behavioral Interviewing focus areas (Innovation and Extreme Ownership): 

  • Innovation. Applies modern AI and automation pragmatically to solve real problems. 
  • Extreme ownership. Takes end-to-end accountability for what is built and how it performs. 
  • Collaboration. Works across boundaries in a non-territorial, shared-talent model. 
  • Judgment. Balances speed with responsible, secure, well-governed delivery.

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Data Scientist who is part deep technologist, part entrepreneur, and part strategic innovator. This is not a traditional analytics role, it is built for a builder. You will own the full lifecycle of high-impact AI/ML solutions, from whiteboard to production, writing substantial code and driving rigorous analysis that directly shapes enterprise decisions.

Sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning, software engineering, and business strategy, you will architect and ship production-grade AI systems across underwriting, claims, operations, and finance.

AI Engineering & Production ML Development

  • Own the code, not just the model: Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade ML and AI systems using Python, modern ML frameworks, and cloud-native tooling.
  • Build generative AI & LLM-powered solutions: Architect and implement RAG pipelines, fine-tuning workflows, agentic systems, and LLM evaluation harnesses.
  • Engineer scalable ML pipelines: Develop robust feature engineering, training, inference, and monitoring pipelines built for reliability and scale.
  • Ship end-to-end: Take models from prototype through CI/CD into monitored production environments, including automated retraining and drift detection.

Advanced Data Science & Analytical Rigor

  • Lead complex analytical investigations: Apply causal inference, Bayesian modeling, survival analysis, and simulation to solve high-stakes business problems.
  • Translate ambiguity to impact: Frame undefined problems with entrepreneurial clarity: define success metrics, scope solutions, and move from question to insight at speed.
  • Ensure reproducibility and rigor: Establish standards for experiment tracking, version control, and model validation aligned with enterprise governance requirements.

Architecture, Platforms & Technical Strategy

  • Shape the AI/ML platform: Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and cloud services (Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, etc.) that form the backbone of enterprise AI capability.
  • Establish reusable accelerators: Build and document shared libraries, templates, and design patterns that multiply team productivity across the data science community.
  • Drive MLOps excellence: Define and enforce best practices for model governance, monitoring, A/B testing, and lifecycle management in production.
  • Architect for the long term: Make principled trade-offs between build vs. buy, speed vs. rigor, and experimentation vs. standardization.

Entrepreneurial Innovation & Strategic Influence

  • Rapidly prototype and validate: Move from idea to working proof-of-concept in days, not months using experimentation to de-risk investment before scaling.
  • Influence enterprise standards: Shape the organization's model development, validation, and deployment standards as a principal-level technical authority.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Master's or PhD preferred

Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, data science, or AI engineering  not just analytics. Demonstrated track record of shipping ML models and AI systems to production, including ownership of monitoring and maintenance.
  • Experience leading complex, end-to-end data science projects from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement.
  • Proven ability to influence technical direction and strategy without direct management authority.
  • Minimum of 3 years of insurance experience. 

Technical Proficiency  (Must Be Hands-On)

  • Python (expert-level): NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent.
  • ML Engineering: Feature stores, model registries (MLflow), experiment tracking, CI/CD for ML, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

  • Cloud Platforms: Azure ML preferred; AWS SageMaker or GCP Vertex AI experience
  • Statistics & ML Foundations: Regression, classification, clustering, time-series, Bayesian methods, causal inference, and model interpretability (SHAP, LIME).
  • Software Engineering Practices: Git, code review, unit testing, design patterns you write code that others can maintain.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience in financial services, insurance, or other regulated industries with model risk management requirements.
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects
  • Experience building and operating real-time inference systems (low-latency APIs, streaming prediction pipelines).
  • Familiarity with model governance frameworks and regulatory requirements
  • Experience with agentic AI systems, multi-modal models, or domain-adapted LLMs in an enterprise context.
  • Background in agile/product-oriented analytics teams with sprint-based delivery.

Responsibilities

The Litigation Specialist’s job function includes efficiently and effectively handling advanced-level, primarily litigated, commercial first-property and/or third-party general liability losses in a “paperless” environment. An ability to communicate both verbally and in written form in a prompt, courteous and professional manner is essential.

This role can be based in our Scottsdale, AZ, West Chester, OH offices, or across various US locations.

Responsbilities include:

  • Review and set up new loss assignments in a timely manner in compliance with department guidelines and best practices.
  • Establish appropriate initial loss and expense reserves and continue to regularly evaluate the file for adequacy, accuracy and adherence to reserving guidelines.
  • Analyze and interpret policy language in conjunction with specific loss facts to reach appropriate coverage decisions.
  • Draft frequent and complex coverage correspondence, including reservation of rights and coverage disclaimers in compliance with various state statutes and regulations.
  • Compose a variety of other detailed correspondence to insureds, claimants, attorneys, agents and Regulatory agencies.
  • Proactively manage primarily litigated claim files from inception to closure, including identification and investigation of coverage, liability and damage issues, determination and efficient execution of an appropriate plan of action, and prompt, economical file resolution, in compliance with department guidelines and best practices.
  • Appropriately and clearly document all claim file activity, including current strategy, plan of action and exit plan in file notes.
  • Consistently demonstrate comprehensive coverage analysis, investigation, evaluation and negotiation skills at an advanced level.
  • Direct and control the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters.
  • Effectively present and discuss loss facts and issues in roundtable discussions to peers and members of management at all levels.
  • Compose and transmit in a regular and timely basis frequent Large Loss Reports and other detailed reporting documents as appropriate.
  • Manage and monitor file caseload through the use of various resources.
  • Obtain all required state adjuster licenses and maintain them as required via compliance with mandatory continuing education requirements.

Company Details

At Berkley Program Specialists, we are dedicated exclusively to program business and excel at partnering with program administrators who possess significant underwriting expertise for homogeneous, niche classes of business.

We enjoy the strength and stability that comes with being a Berkley Company and underwrite our programs through our member insurance companies, which are A+ (Superior), Financial Size Category XV, by A.M. Best.

Responsibilities

Berkley Program Specialists is seeking an experienced claims professional in Naperville, IL or Lexington, KY to join our Claims team with a focus on professional lines and management liability.  This role offers the opportunity to manage challenging and rewarding Directors & Officers (D&O) and Employment Practices Liability (EPLI) claims involving nonprofit organizations across the country. 

We are looking for a highly skilled claims professional who enjoys analyzing complex coverage issues, developing litigation strategies, collaborating with defense counsel, and delivering exceptional service to insureds and brokers. You'll have the autonomy to make meaningful claim decisions while working alongside a team of experienced professionals committed to technical excellence.

Manage Complex Claims

  • Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex nonprofit D&O and EPLI claims from first notice through resolution.
  • Evaluate liability, damages, coverage, and litigation exposure to develop effective resolution strategies.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate claim reserves.
  • Lead settlement negotiations and drive favorable claim outcomes. 

Apply Technical Expertise

  • Analyze claims-made policy coverage, including policy terms, exclusions, endorsements, reporting requirements, and prior acts provisions.
  • Draft clear and effective coverage position letters, reservation of rights letters, and coverage determinations.
  • Provide thoughtful analysis of emerging legal and claim trends impacting nonprofit organizations. 

Lead Litigation Strategy

  • Direct defense counsel on litigation and settlement strategy.
  • Monitor legal spend and case budgets.
  • Partner with attorneys and experts to achieve efficient and effective claim resolutions. 

Collaborate Across the Organization

  • Build strong relationships with insureds, brokers, underwriters, and business partners.
  • Serve as a trusted technical resource within the claims organization.
  • Mentor and support less experienced claim professionals. 

Deliver Outstanding Customer Service

  • Communicate complex claim and coverage issues clearly and confidently.
  • Provide responsive and professional service during challenging claim situations.
  • Help strengthen long-term relationships with insureds and distribution partners. 

Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure all claims activities comply with internal guidelines, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Maintain accurate and timely claim file documentation and reporting.
  • Participate in audits, peer reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • JD, CPCU, AIC, RPLU, or similar professional designation preferred.
  • Adjuster licensing required or ability to obtain required licenses within six months of hire. 

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience handling D&O, EPLI, management liability, professional liability, or related complex casualty claims.
  • Experience managing litigated claims and working directly with defense counsel.
  • Nonprofit management liability experience is preferred but not required. 

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of claims-made insurance policies and coverage analysis.
  • Knowledge of D&O, EPLI, fiduciary liability, and management liability exposures.
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills. 

Skills

  • Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience in managing others through tasks or projects. 

Key Competencies

  • Technical excellence and sound judgment
  • Customer-focused mindset
  • Strategic thinking and adaptability
  • Collaboration and relationship management
  • Accountability and ownership
  • Willingness to mentor junior claim professionals.

Responsibilities

The SIU Manager is responsible for assisting with leading our anti-fraud efforts to include both commercial and personal lines of business. This role is critical in safeguarding the integrity of our claims process, mitigating financial losses, and ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates.

The SIU Manager will be responsible for overseeing a team of investigators and support specialists, managing complex and high-exposure investigations, and assisting with investigative tools to support the enterprise anti-fraud efforts. This position requires a deep understanding of commercial and personal insurance operations, investigative techniques, and regulatory frameworks.

Key Functions/Duties of Position:

Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of SIU investigators and support specialists, ensuring high performance, professional development, and adherence to best practices.
  • Execute a strategic vision for fraud detection and prevention across all lines of business.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the SIU program.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to align SIU goals with broader organizational objectives.

Investigative Oversight

  • Oversee the intake, triage, and assignment of suspected fraudulent claims, ensuring timely and thorough investigations.
  • Direct the investigation of complex, high-value, or sensitive cases involving potential fraud, collusion, staged losses, or organized crime.
  • Ensure investigative activities are conducted in accordance with legal standards, company policies, and industry best practices.
  • Review and approve investigative reports, summaries, and referrals to law enforcement or regulatory bodies.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Manage and implement a comprehensive quality assurance program to evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of SIU investigations.
  • Conduct regular audits of investigative files to ensure adherence to internal protocols, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Provide feedback and coaching to investigators based on audit findings to drive continuous improvement.
  • Monitor trends in investigative performance and develop targeted training or process enhancements as needed.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting to state fraud bureaus, the NICB, and other regulatory entities.

Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable state and federal regulations, including mandatory fraud reporting requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all investigative activities in the case management system.
  • Prepare and submit regulatory reports, internal dashboards, and executive summaries as required to SIU Leadership.
  • Serve as a primary liaison with state fraud bureaus, the National Insurance Crime Bureau (NICB), and other external agencies.

Collaboration & Training

  • Partner with claims, underwriting, legal, and risk management teams to identify fraud trends and vulnerabilities.
  • Provide training and guidance to claims staff on fraud indicators, red flags, and referral procedures.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, fraud task forces, and professional associations.

Technology & Innovation

  • Leverage data analytics, predictive modeling, and fraud detection software to enhance investigative capabilities.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools and technologies to improve SIU efficiency and effectiveness.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

• Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in insurance fraud investigations, with minimum of 3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.• Extensive knowledge of commercial and personal insurance products and claims processes.• Completion of one or more of the following designations: Fraud Claims Law Specialist (FCLS), Certified Insurance Fraud Investigator (CIFI), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Associate in Claims (AIC).

Education Requirement

• Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Insurance, Business Administration, or a related field.

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Software Engineer to join our Sales & Marketing team. In this role, you will design, develop, support, and modernize software solutions that enable critical Sales and Marketing business processes. A primary focus of this position will be reviewing, refactoring, and enhancing existing C#/.NET code to improve maintainability, performance, scalability, and long-term supportability while reducing technical debt. 

This role will also be responsible for developing and supporting ETL processes, large-scale data movement initiatives, system integrations, and automation workflows utilizing SQL Server, Jenkins, and modern source control and CI/CD practices. The engineer will play a key role in application modernization efforts, including repository cleanup and migration to GitHub, while helping establish development standards and best practices across the team. 

Success in this position requires strong technical expertise, a problem-solving mindset, and close collaboration with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development team to deliver reliable, scalable, and business-focused solutions. The individual will also participate in application support and on-call rotations to help ensure the stability and availability of critical Sales & Marketing systems.

  • Review, refactor, and modernize existing C#/.NET code to improve code quality, maintainability, performance, and supportability. 
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications supporting Sales & Marketing initiatives. 
  • Define, document, and enforce development standards, design patterns, and coding best practices. 
  • Design and implement enterprise system integrations and interfaces. 
  • Design, develop, and support ETL processes for large-scale data movement between enterprise applications, CRM platforms, databases, and cloud services. 
  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases. 
  • Ensure data integrity, performance optimization, and secure data access. 
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, stakeholders, and end users to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
  • Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests or similar experiments to optimize features and user experience. 
  • Perform and coordinate quality assurance (QA) testing and job regression testing prior to and after production deployments. 
  • Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and Agile ceremonies to ensure timely and high-quality delivery. 
  • Support sprint execution by validating scope, estimating effort, and ensuring deliverables are production-ready. 
  • Deliver high-quality customer support with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability. 
  • Provide Tier 1 after-hours/on-call support by participating in application support and incident triage rotation. 
  • Quickly adapt to new technologies, tools, and platforms.  
  • Analyze and solve complex technical and business problems.  
  • Work effectively within a distributed and virtual team environment.  
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across Sales & Marketing technology platforms. 
  • Utilize Azure, Azure Service Bus, and Data Factory for cloud solutions. 
  • Utilize Microsoft Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools. 
  • Complete code reviews and pull request (PR) approvals for onshore and offshore resources on all changes prior to deployment. Ensure PRs adhere to established coding standards, security practices, documentation expectations, and deployment guidelines. Provide clear, constructive feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and long-term supportability. 

Qualifications

  • Strong technical background in C#/.NET, SQL Server, Python, and ETL/Data Integration, with experience developing applications, managing data solutions, and building data integration workflows.3+ years of software development experience 
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud computing platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.  
  • Experience participating in or leading code reviews and PR approval processes.  
  • Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  
  • Strong customer service mindset, sense of urgency, and accountability.  
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.  
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a distributed or offshore/onshore team model. 
  • Experience using Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket). 
  • Strong engineering judgment and attention to detail 
  • Ownership of code quality and production stability 
  • Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in related field or equivalent experience. 
  • Ability to influence development standards across teams 
  • Clear, respectful communication across global teams 
  • Customer-first orientation with a solution mindset 
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context;approaches AI as a standard part of modern workflow rather than a specializedor optional capability
  • Continuous improvement and modernization focus

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience with Jenkins for job scheduling, application deployment, automation, and data processing workflows. 
  • Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD practices. 
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power Pages, Dataverse).  
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM or Salesforce Development. 
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise CRM and marketing system interfaces. 
  • Experience working with Microsoft Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools. 
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 
  • Knowledge of or experience in the Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance industry.

Since 1974, Admiral Insurance Group has been supporting business innovation and market growth through our wholesale-dedicated excess and surplus (E&S) lines of commercial insurance.  We specialize in underwriting difficult-to-place moderate to high-risk commercial businesses that require creative solutions, outside of the box thinking, entrepreneurial spirit and astute business knowledge.  As a member of the W. Responsibilities

The Chief Claims Officer (CCO) is a critical member of the Senior Leadership Team, accountable for developing and executing the enterprise-wide claims strategy and driving exceptional performance across claims operations, customer service, compliance, litigation management, and overall loss cost leadership. This executive provides forward-looking strategic guidance, ensures disciplined operational execution, and builds a high-performing claims organization that advances the company’s financial strength, reputation, and long‑term growth. Central to the position is an Executive who will embrace and lead through a culture of collaboration and creativity.

Strategic Leadership & Enterprise Alignment

  • Lead the development, refinement, and execution of a comprehensive claims strategy aligned with enterprise objectives, partnering closely with the President and various departments leaders including Underwriting, Actuary, and Finance.
  • Evaluate existing strategies and operating models to identify opportunities for modernization, operational efficiency, and improved claim outcomes.
  • Serve as an advisor to the Senior Leadership Team on emerging loss trends, regulatory developments, market shifts, and strategic implications for the business.

Operational Excellence & Claims Performance

  • Ensure timely, fair, and consistent claims handling through disciplined adherence to internal claims best practices.
  • Oversee the establishment and maintenance of appropriate and timely claim reserves, reinforcing the importance of reserve accuracy in supporting rate adequacy and financial performance.
  • Lead the development and continuous enhancement of claims programs, performance metrics, operational frameworks, and compliance controls.
  • Champion the effective use of predictive analytics, technology, and automation to advance decision quality, improve operational efficiency, and reduce loss costs.
  • Drive cost containment strategies—including both ALAE and ULAE—in partnership with Finance and other business leaders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Collaborate across Underwriting, Actuarial, Finance, and other critical functions to ensure alignment on market intelligence, legal changes, loss trends, and strategic assumptions.

Responsibilities

At Berkley Technology Services, we believe AI-assisted ways of working are becoming a foundational part of how excellent engineering work gets done - much like the way digital communication tools did a generation ago. We expect every member of our team to actively integrate AI tools into their daily work, not as a substitute for expertise, but as a natural extension of it. Candidates who bring genuine curiosity about AI, and a demonstrated habit of using it to work smarter, will find themselves at home here. 

The Enterprise Architect partners with business and technology leaders to translate organizational strategy into enterprise capabilities, target-state architectures, transition roadmaps, and informed technology investment decisions. The role provides enterprise-wide direction for application and technology portfolios, including modernization, rationalization, lifecycle management, technical debt reduction, and responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies. 

Serving as a trusted advisor, the Enterprise Architect evaluates business value, cost, risk, architecture, data readiness, security, resilience, and organizational impact to recommend whether capabilities and technologies should be enhanced, consolidated, modernized, replaced, or retired. The role leads through influence, enables cross-domain decisions, and helps teams balance enterprise standards and reuse with the needs of individual operating companies.

Business and Technical Strategy 

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to understand strategic priorities, customer and employee needs, operating constraints, and growth opportunities. 
  • Translate business strategy into enterprise capabilities, target architectures, transition roadmaps, and sequenced investment choices. 
  • Frame recommendations, business cases, and solutions in terms of business value, cost, risk, speed, resilience, and organizational impact, not technical views alone. 
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, rationalize platforms, improve reuse, and strengthen enterprise leverage while respecting individual company needs. 
  • Maintain contact with vendors, industry peers, and professional associations to keep informed of existing and emerging industry trends, standards, and technologies. 

Architecture Direction and Portfolio Guidance 

  • Develop and maintain architecture principles, standards, guidelines, business capability models, and roadmaps that support enterprise priorities. 
  • Provide architecture guidance across initiatives and portfolios, identifying dependencies, redundancies, technical debt, and opportunities for reuse. 
  • Influence portfolio planning and technology lifecycle decisions through research, data-driven rationale, market trends, target architectures, and roadmaps. 

Solution Guidance and Governance 

  • Advise product, application, data, infrastructure, security, and engineering teams on solution direction and key design decisions. 
  • Lead or participate in architecture reviews with a pragmatic focus on business value, risk, standards alignment, technical debt, interoperability, scalability, and long-term sustainability. 
  • Create clear, decision-enabling architecture artifacts appropriate to their audience and the decisions being made. 
  • Escalate material risks and exceptions while helping teams identify viable paths forward. 

AI and Emerging Technology 

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to shape the enterprise approach to AI, including generative and agentic AI, by connecting use cases to business outcomes, data readiness, architecture, security, legal, compliance, and responsible use requirements. 
  • Guide teams in selecting fit-for-purpose AI patterns, platforms, models, tooling, and integration approaches, including build-versus-buy decisions. 
  • Assess AI and emerging technology opportunities through experiments and proofs-of-concept with clear hypotheses, guardrails, adoption considerations, and success metrics. 
  • Promote AI literacy among leaders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams by explaining capabilities, limitations, risks, and practical application patterns. 

Influence, Leadership, and Change 

  • Build trusted relationships across business and technology organizations and communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, and technical groups. 
  • Lead enterprise architecture initiatives and support adoption through stakeholder alignment, communication, ongoing support arrangements, and change management. 
  • Mentor architects and engineers, strengthen architecture practices, and contribute reusable knowledge to the technical community. 
  • Create clarity in ambiguous situations, facilitate decisions across competing priorities, and promote accountability for outcomes. 

Qualifications

Required 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technology, developing/engineering solutions and leading multiple cross-domain engineering initiatives. 
  • 6+ years of experience spanning multiple business and technology domains, with substantial depth in at least one architecture discipline and working experience across two or more additional disciplines. 
  • Proven ability to connect business strategy, capabilities, processes, technology, risk, and cost into coherent recommendations and transition roadmaps. 
  • Experience designing, developing, or modernizing technology capabilities supporting commercial insurance operations including translating business requirements into solution, application, integration, data, and/or platform decisions. 
  • Working knowledge of modern AI concepts and architectures, including generative AI, agentic systems, data and model dependencies, integration patterns, security, governance, and responsible AI. 
  • Working knowledge of public cloud platforms and modern data, integration, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices. 
  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, consulting, and decision-framing skills, including the ability to explain complex topics in concise business terms. 
  • Ability to lead through influence, navigate ambiguity, build alignment, and produce results across organizational boundaries. 
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context;approaches AI as a standard part of modern workflow rather than a specializedor optional capability
  • Strong analytical judgment, curiosity, customer focus, and commitment to collaboration and continuous learning. 

Preferred 

  • Experience as an Enterprise Architect or in a comparable enterprise-wide strategy or execution role. 
  • Experience applying AI to business or technology use cases and participating in AI governance, enablement, or platform decisions. 
  • Experience with product-oriented delivery, Agile methods, architecture repositories, capability-based planning, and technology portfolio management.
