Overview The AVP, Business Line Marketing & Growth is a senior marketing leader responsible for driving enterprise-wide growth initiatives across Wealthspire’s business lines and client segments, including private wealth and institutional audiences. This role serves as the primary marketing partner to Business Line Leaders, Sales, and Sales Enablement, while directly managing Marketing Managers and ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across the organization. Reporting to the SVP, Business Line Marketing, this individual combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating firm and business-line priorities into actionable marketing plans that deliver measurable results. This role requires strong people leadership, communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep understanding of how marketing performance supports business growth. Role Description The AVP, Business Line Marketing & Growth owns the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies that support Wealthspire’s growth objectives across all business lines. This role leads and prioritizes marketing efforts enterprise-wide, balancing long-term strategy with near-term execution in close partnership with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Business Line leadership. As a manager of marketing coordinators, this role is responsible for setting direction, establishing priorities, and ensuring alignment and accountability across Marketing Managers. While this position provides oversight and leadership, it is also expected to remain execution-capable, stepping in directly on high-impact initiatives, institutional opportunities, and strategic campaigns as needed. This individual brings a strong understanding of both institutional and private client marketing and acts as a connective leader across Wealthspire, helping unify offerings, messaging, and go-to-market execution across the firm. Key Responsibilities Enterprise & Business Line Leadership Serve as the senior marketing partner to Business Line Leaders, collaborating closely to translate business objectives into integrated marketing strategies. Partner with Sales and Sales Enablement to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals, pipeline development, and client acquisition strategies. Contribute to enterprise-level growth planning by helping prioritize initiatives, allocate marketing resources, and sequence execution in alignment with firm strategy. People Management & Team Leadership Directly manage and develop multiple Marketing Managers, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance oversight. Set priorities and standards across the marketing organization to ensure consistency, quality, and accountability. Act as an escalation point for complex initiatives, resource constraints, and cross-functional challenges. Strategy-to-Execution Ownership Lead the planning and execution of enterprise and business-line marketing initiatives, including lead generation programs, institutional campaigns, strategic partnerships, and integrated go-to-market efforts. Maintain the ability to execute directly on high-priority projects, ensuring momentum and excellence where senior involvement is required. Oversee the development of integrated marketing plans that span channels such as events, sponsorships, advertising, content, digital campaigns, and client communications. Institutional & Private Client Marketing Support marketing efforts across both institutional and private client segments, ensuring strategies and messaging are appropriately tailored while aligned under a cohesive firm narrative. Provide guidance on positioning, thought leadership, and campaign development to support institutional relationships and complex client needs. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the SVP and other leaders across Wealthspire to ensure marketing initiatives reflect a deep understanding of the firm’s services, capabilities, and operating model. Collaborate with corporate and centralized marketing teams to align brand standards, messaging frameworks, and campaign execution. Engage and manage external vendors and partners to support large-scale initiatives and events as needed. Performance, Metrics & Optimization Establish clear success metrics for enterprise and business-line marketing initiatives in collaboration with stakeholders. Review performance data and insights to optimize strategies, inform decision-making, and report results to senior leadership. Ensure Marketing Managers are tracking and reporting outcomes consistently across initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience supporting both institutional and private client audiences. Demonstrated success managing and developing people, preferably managing managers in a matrixed or enterprise environment. Strong strategic marketing background with the ability to translate complex business goals into actionable plans. Proven execution skills, with experience leading multiple, concurrent initiatives under tight timelines. Experience partnering closely with Sales and Sales Enablement teams. High level of comfort working cross-functionally and influencing senior stakeholders. Excellent communication, organizational, and prioritization skills. Financial services or professional services experience strongly preferred. Success in This Role Looks Like Business Line Leaders and Sales teams view marketing as a strategic growth partner. Marketing Managers are aligned, empowered, and executing consistently at a high level. Enterprise marketing initiatives are clearly prioritized, well-executed, and measurable. The firm presents a cohesive, differentiated marketing presence across private and institutional audiences. The SVP, Business Line Marketing can operate at a higher strategic level, confident in executional excellence beneath them. What We Offer: Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $100,000 – $120,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of the Role: We are seeking an Investment Analyst to join our Wealth Management team. This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical, intellectually curious professional who is passionate about investments and interested in building a long-term career focused on leading client portfolios. The Investment Analyst will interact directly with advisors and investment professionals to support portfolio analysis, investment research, client meeting preparation, and ongoing portfolio management activities. The role will initially focus on developing a strong understanding of our investment approach and supporting senior team members, with the opportunity to grow into a more client-facing position and participate directly in investment conversations with clients. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Conduct investigation and evaluation across a broad range of asset classes, investment strategies, funds, and managers. Assist with portfolio construction, asset allocation, rebalancing, and implementation activities. Supervise client portfolios, investment performance, allocations, and risk exposures. Analyze public and private investment opportunities and help translate research into actionable recommendations. Support investment due diligence and ongoing manager research. Research capital markets, economic developments, and investment trends that may impact client portfolios. Prepare investment analysis and recommendations for consultants and experienced investment professionals. Partner closely with advisors to prepare for client meetings from an investment perspective. Attend client meetings alongside advisors and senior portfolio management professionals. Gain investment-related action items from meetings and ensure timely follow-through. Prepare portfolio reports, investment materials, market commentary, and other information used in client discussions. Assist with client investment inquiries by researching questions and developing thoughtful responses. Build the knowledge and presentation skills necessary to gradually engage in direct financial discussions with clients. Develop an understanding of each client's objectives, risk tolerance, liquidity needs, tax considerations, and overall financial goals. Evaluate investment managers, funds, strategies, and other investment opportunities. Prepare portfolio recommendations, investment proposals, and due diligence materials. Synthesize complex investment information into clear insights for advisors, clients, and internal collaborators. Give research and analysis to broader investment discussions. Stay informed on financial markets, economic conditions, investment products, and industry developments. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities. Genuine interest in investments, capital markets, portfolio management, and wealth management. Understanding of fundamental investment concepts, including asset allocation, diversification, risk, and portfolio construction. Ability to interpret financial and investment data and communicate findings clearly. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent attention to detail and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead multiple priorities and work optimally in a collaborative environment. Strong interpersonal skills with a curiosity about developing client-facing capabilities. Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn from seasoned investment experts. High level of integrity, judgment, and discretion when working with sensitive client information. Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a similar area of study, with equivalent experience also accepted. 3-5 years of experience in wealth management, investment management, investment research, financial analysis, or a related field preferred. Experience conducting investment or securities research is a plus. Exposure to equities, fixed income, mutual funds, ETFs, alternative investments, or portfolio analytics is helpful. Interest in advancing professional credentials, including the Series 65, with a willingness to pursue additional certifications such as the Series 7 and 66, CFP, or CFA. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $100,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! JOB RESPONSIBILITIES · Lead and/or support other advisors in the management of client engagements. · Determine appropriate client allocations through analysis of investment objectives, risk tolerance, net worth, income, and investment experience, or other knowledge. · Execute investment and planning activities (e.g. rebalancing portfolios, money movements, required minimum distributions, tax loss harvesting, charitable planning, lending evaluation, education funding, etc.). · Actively service client accounts by performing and/or coordinating administrative tasks (e.g. tracking and monitoring account/asset transfers, preparing and presenting performance reports, processing transaction requests as directed, handling necessary paperwork for accounts, etc.). · Initiate and field client calls on various topics and miscellaneous requests (e.g. account-specific questions, general inquiries regarding portfolios, investment market discussions, planning items, money movements, etc.). · Assist with the development of client financial plans using financial planning software and present results and solutions to clients. · Monitor client investments, review performance and suggest changes to client portfolios as appropriate. · Prepare for and attend client meetings and manage and/or complete all meeting follow-up activities. · Create proposals for prospective clients. · Coordinate with clients’ attorneys, accountants, and other professionals, as needed. · Develop and maintain working knowledge of various financial planning concepts, such as gift, estate and income tax planning, insurance, credit solutions, education funding, charitable/philanthropic strategies, etc. · Pursue professional development opportunities to include additional licenses and/or designations, and actively participate in internal and external training sessions and networking events. · Deepen existing client relationships; seek client referrals. · Participate in community outreach, networking and marketing activities to drive new business opportunities. · Leverage local centers of influence to extend referral network. · Provide ongoing training and serve as a mentor to advisory staff. Ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple projects. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to effectively manage task lists. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Flexible team player who is highly adaptable to change and open to new ideas. Ability to think creatively. Reliable, follows through on commitments. Personal integrity and professional initiative. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM, portfolio management and financial planning software is a plus. Bachelor’s degree or higher preferably in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, law or related experience. Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: The Segment Leader has overall responsibility for the civic and governmental market segment and provides strategic direction, leadership and support to account management teams serving public-sector clients. The Segment Leader participates in the identification, development and execution of segment initiatives and client deliverables to ensure a competitive edge and support the business overall. The role brings a strong understanding of the distinct operating, procurement, compliance, budgeting and collaborator requirements of municipalities and government entities Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Collaborates with the Senior Leadership team to assess staffing needs, develop client deliverables and make decisions that best serve the Municipal and Government segment. Works with the Senior Leadership team to drive business results, including opportunities to increase revenue, build operational efficiencies and improve margin within the public-sector market. Ensures consistency across teams serving municipal and government clients with regard to accuracy, execution, timely delivery of scopes and conformity to NFP standards. Proactively leads account teams that deliver services in accordance with client scopes, public-sector requirements and established service expectations to maintain an excellent client experience and competitive position. Develops and manages relationships with key client stakeholders, carrier representatives and other partners supporting municipal and government entities. Participates in strategic client meetings, including stewardship and strategy discussions, and serves as an executive sponsor where appropriate across the segment. Monitors municipal and government market developments, including procurement practices, budget cycles, regulatory and compliance considerations, and translates relevant developments into client and team strategies. Provides strategic mentorship for requests for proposals, renewals, implementations and other public-sector client deliverables, as appropriate. Develops a team, including coaching and mentoring team members, appraising performance and addressing potential problems. Interviews candidates and assists in the hiring and onboarding process, as appropriate. Participates in training and assists in assessing employees for promotions. Performs other duties as assigned and typically exercises independent judgment on most matters; viewed as an authority in the area of responsibility. Ensures the organization's policies and procedures are adhered to. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Solid understanding in all areas of benefits brokerage and consulting, including benefits administration, compliance, benefits financing, industry trends, and carrier products and services. Ability to translate public-sector requirements and market developments into practical client strategies, service models and team priorities. Ability to work independently and anticipate business, client and team needs. Effective time management and decision-making skills. Diligent follow-up skills. Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications, including with elected officials, boards, administrators and other public-sector collaborators, as applicable. Education and/or Experience: BA/BS preferred with more than 10 years of proven experience. Experience leading account management for municipal, government or other public-sector clients strongly preferred. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $178,000 – $284,900. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #NFP 2588454

Maintains a project plan to ensure client deliverables are provided on time. Delegates work to more junior team members to ensure completion. Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers, companies and clients. Keep clients apprised of appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues Maintain relationships with carrier representatives in order to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients. Anticipate client needs and identify the strategies to solve them. Review request for proposals and insurance plan analyses, negotiate with carriers and recommend renewal actions. Oversee implementations of new business. Understand and articulate alternative funding strategies. Work with director to develop and execute client strategy plan and defined deliverables. Oversee open enrollment process for clients; Review employee presentations and communication materials. Conduct and present annual client compliance audits. Genuine understanding of client financial mechanics and projections. Keep clients apprised of appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues. Explain legislative guidelines including COBRA, HIPPA, ERISA, Section 125, and Health Care Reform to clients; Keep clients aware of updates on relevant Interpret plan rules to ensure compliance with Plan Documents and Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs). Review the work of the Account Managers on the team and provide informal mentorship to them. Ensure all client data is entered into CRM System (Salesforce) in a timely manner. May have direct supervisory responsibility of junior team members Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision making skills Diligent follow up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Education and/or Experience: BA/BS preferred Typically more than 8 years industry and product line experience. 8+ years of health and welfare consulting experience required. Facilitates transactions (i.e. credit card, ACH drafts, duplicate bill requests). Researches and follows through on a variety of information requests and assist with problem resolution. Looks beyond symptoms to identify causes of problems. Job.JobStreet: 3445 Peachtree Rd. NE, Two Live Oak
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Employee Benefits Consultant, Insurance Sales, Employee Benefits Account Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: The Account Manager is responsible for working with Account Executives to service client accounts. The position requires day to day client servicing for a specific set of clients and entails a great deal of verbal, electronic and other written communications. The Account Manager will handle the renewal and marketing process, and prepare materials for presentations and communications, in collaboration with their more senior team members. At this level, an Account Manager will lead open enrollment presentations and may take an active role in client meetings. Work is completed with a significant amount of independent discretion. While in this role, this person should be developing relationships with clients and carrier contacts and working proactively to optimally and efficiently deliver services to clients. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Develops and maintains strong relationships with clients, carriers, and vendors, serving as a key point of contact and taking an active role in client meetings, calls, and strategic discussions. Supports the marketing and renewal process by preparing and distributing RFPs, analyzing carrier proposals and plan designs, negotiating with carriers, reviewing contracts and source documents for accuracy, and recommending renewal strategies in partnership with Producers and senior team members. Prepares client deliverables including renewal presentations, benefit guides, employee communications, compliance audit materials, and other resources, ensuring all information remains accurate and up to date following enrollments or coverage changes. Provides ongoing client service support by responding to client requests, resolving product, vendor, or service-related issues, monitoring carrier performance, and recommending appropriate products and services to meet client needs. Assists with compliance and regulatory requirements, including ensuring timely completion of Form 5500 filings and keeping clients informed of relevant industry trends, state and federal regulations, and marketplace developments. Participates in key client initiatives such as new business implementations, open enrollment, non-discrimination testing, and other special projects, while collaborating with account management teams to deliver exceptional service. May provide informal leadership, guidance, and mentoring to less experienced team members based on experience and expertise, without direct supervisory responsibility. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, Health Care Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision making skills Diligent follow-up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Education and/or Experience: Associates degree (or equivalent experience), with BA/BS preferred More than 3 years’ client service and/or industry and product line experience Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2589606

Job.JobTitle: Client Service Associate, Executive Benefits Account Management
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Covala Group (part of NFP, an Aon company) is a proven enroller and administrator of voluntary, supplemental and individual disability benefits for large employers. Since 1993 we have connected employees of our clients to over $4.5 billion of income protection. We have also assisted Fortune 500 companies in the development and implementation of group life insurance, corporate owned life insurance, and long-term care programs. Our name, Covala, was inspired by the covalent bond, the strongest type of chemical bond there is. Covala embodies our dedication to forming powerful bonds with our clients and plan participants — connecting them to the benefits they need and the service they deserve. Position Summary: The Account Management position is an integral part of a ten-person team. The role is central within the organization and is responsible for managing relationships with corporate clients and overseeing internal operations among different functional groups.The individual in this position will participate in company-wide projects that involve collaboration across departments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone seeking to contribute meaningfully to a growing business and gain valuable experience. Success in this role requires a proactive and results-driven mindset, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Intellectual curiosity, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and professional integrity are also essential qualities. Schedule: This full-time, exempt position follows a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time. The role is open to a hybrid arrangement from our New York City office or a fully remote arrangement within the United States. Hybrid employees may work onsite up to three days per week during the first three months for training, with ongoing attendance based on business needs thereafter. Remote employees must maintain the established Eastern Time schedule, along with a private, confidential workspace and reliable high-speed internet. Position Responsibilities: Essential Functions: Interact daily with Benefit / Human Resource contacts at large corporate clients and top law firms providing administration and client service support for their individual disability insurance benefits. Coordinate annual enrollment and communication campaigns to executives of our corporate clients. Analyze census data from our corporate clients and determine eligible executive populations for enrollment campaigns. Handle inquiries from eligible executives about the disability insurance being offered through our enrollments. Team with our IT Group to develop reports for our corporate clients. Qualifications: The ideal candidate will demonstrate: Strong attention to detail with a high level of accountability and ownership. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, HR and Benefits contacts, executives, plan participants, and internal partners. Resourcefulness and sound judgment, including knowing when to engage others to resolve questions or issues. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative, fast-paced team. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with particular comfort reviewing and working with data in Excel. A professional, client-focused approach and the ability to adapt to changing priorities. Education/Experience: High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred. Life and Health Insurance License required. Able to obtain Long-Term Care (LTC) certification within three months of hire. 5-10 years of relevant experience in client service, account management, insurance, or employee benefits required. Executive benefits, individual disability insurance, and/or enrollment program experience preferred. What We Offer: We’re proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $61,500 – $80,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You… Better Together! NFP and Covala Group is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2586722

Posting Description Wealthspire Institutional brings together a network of affiliated firms that provides institutional advisory, wealth management, institutional advisory, and business management services to individuals, families, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Through its specialized subsidiaries and affiliates, clients can access wealth management, retirement plan consulting, nonprofit endowment and foundation advisory, business management, and family office services tailored to their evolving financial needs. Wealthspire invests in the people, technology, and resources that expand what the firm can do for clients, while preserving the personal relationships and accountability that are central to its client service approach. Inspiring Trust. Enriching Lives. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Position Summary The Defined Contribution Leader is responsible for guiding Wealthspire's National Defined Contribution administration practice. This role offers strategic direction, operational management, talent growth, exceptional service delivery, and financial responsibility for all DC plan administration activities throughout the organization. The leader will drive the integration of Defined Contribution administration teams into a consistent national service delivery model, in partnership with Platform Operations and other TPA leaders. The individual will lead teams coordinating retirement plans ranging from solo and safe harbor plans to highly customized and complex employer-sponsored retirement programs. The position also serves as a key member on the TPA leadership team who are responsible for accomplishing the organization's growth, technology, and operational excellence strategies. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Direct the national Defined Contribution practice and develop a consistent operating model across all offices. Develop and implement critical initiatives that boost service quality, scalability, profitability, and client happiness within the Defined Contribution practice. Partner with executive leadership to align departmental objectives with overall TPA business goals. Drive adoption of organizational values, accountability standards, and performance expectations. Support growth initiatives through operational preparedness, client retention, and business development partnership within the Defined Contribution practice. Operational Excellence Establish and maintain standardized service delivery processes across all DC administration teams. Drive adoption and continuous improvement of DC administration workflows in partnership with Platform Operations, bringing to bear Stax.AI and other enterprise technology platforms. Ensure uniform management of all DC plan types and service offerings. Monitor service quality, turnaround times, compliance standards, and client experience metrics. People Leadership Lead and develop a geographically dispersed team of managers, administrators, and specialists. Build clear career paths, succession plans, and professional development opportunities. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, trust, continuous learning, and transparency. Mentor leaders to effectively manage performance, employee engagement, and career growth. Financial & Business Management Maintain responsibility for departmental efficiency, resource utilization, and profitability. Find opportunities to improve operating leverage and service efficiency. Partner with Platform Operations and Finance to apply enterprise important metrics, dashboards, forecasting, and capacity models to manage the DC practice. Contribute to annual budgeting and long-term planning activities. Enterprise & Client Partnership Build positive relationships across Platform Operations, Defined Benefit, Advisory, Special Projects, Finance, and other functions to deliver a coordinated and consistent client experience. Support complex client needs and central initiatives by bringing together the appropriate expertise, resources, and operational capabilities across the organization. Partner with Business Development and key external relationships to strengthen client retention, support growth opportunities, and improve Wealthspire’s position in the retirement-plan marketplace. Qualifications Required Over 10 years of experience in managing retirement plans. 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and professional service teams. Deep expertise in qualified defined contribution plans, including 401(k), profit sharing, safe harbor, and cash balance/defined contribution combinations. Strong understanding of ERISA, IRC qualification requirements, compliance testing, plan operations, and fiduciary responsibilities. Demonstrated success leading operational transformation, process improvement, and organizational change. Experience managing workforce planning, service delivery, and operational performance metrics. Preferred ASPPA credentials (QKA, QPA, QKC, CPC, QKA, TGPC, etc.). Experience managing retirement plan administration operations across multiple offices or on a national scale. Experience with workflow platforms such as Stax.ai, PensionPro, ASC, or similar technologies. . What We Offer Wealthspire is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO and paid holidays, 401(k) with company match, and more. The base salary range for this position is $175,000-$200,000 and is eligible for an annual incentive bonus plan. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. 2591348

Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: Elevate your career as an Account Manager at NFP, where you'll be more than just a team member—you'll be a catalyst for exceptional client experiences. Immerse yourself in a role that blends technology with personalized service, ensuring each client feels uniquely valued. As a pivotal member of our account management team, you will have a meaningful role in nurturing client relationships. You will also ensure their happiness and strengthen their dedication to our brand. Within this position, you'll oversee a portfolio of clients, dealing with heightened complexity in areas such as compliance, finance, and marketing. You will assume control of daily interactions, becoming the primary point of contact for exceptional service. Your role goes beyond basic management; you will serve as the cornerstone of our commitment to delivering outstanding service, collaborating seamlessly with diverse operational teams. Be the difference, be the change, be part of our dynamic team. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Work with senior team members to prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. Learning to reviewing contracts, benefit plan summaries, and carrier source documents for accuracy under the direction of the Account Executive or Advisor. At this level, they will begin to learn more complex compliance and regulatory policy language. Creates and maintain client files in accordance with office procedures. May be responsible for keeping client policy records Takes the lead on answering questions from clients and/or insurance company personnel such as ID card request, claims or billing questions Begins to develop ongoing relationships with clients. Coordinates with Senior Account Manager, Account Executives or Advisors in doing so. Begins to develop relationships with carrier representatives to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients Learns vendor/carrier products and services from the more senior Account Manager or Account Executive. Begins to review and analyze requests for proposals and insurance plan analyses. Participates in negotiations with carriers and recommend renewal actions, under the direction of a senior team member. May assist Account Manager in drafting renewal presentations Assist with creating and updating benefits related guides, education resources for clients Learns how to conduct annual client compliance audits using NFP portal, assists more senior Account Managers in preparing document Attend to client requests including product or vendor service or performance challenges File form 5500 filing, reaching out for assistance as needed. Participates in client projects such as implementation of new business, open enrollment process, non-discrimination testing, etc. under the direction of more senior team members Create monthly, quarterly and annual reports for client review as needed Distribute monthly / quarterly newsletters and other briefings and content as appropriate Assist with creation of client corporate wellness programs and offerings Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision making skills Diligent follow up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Education and/or Experience: Associates degree (or equivalent), and BA/BS preferred More than 3 years’ client service and/or industry and product line experience Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Appropriately licensed or ability to obtain licensing if required What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $83,800 – $103,200. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: NFP. Summary: We are seeking a qualified professional for the position of Senior Investment Analyst. This role acts as a key member of the investment team, serving as an investment subject matter expert, primarily focused on investment analysis and communicating investment recommendations to clients. This salaried position includes an annual performance bonus based on regional revenue and retention goals. Senior Analysts are encouraged to pursue new business opportunities and may earn commissions, provided the appropriate licenses are held. Key Responsibilities: Conduct ongoing quantitative and qualitative analysis of investment managers and investment vehicles across multiple asset classes. Prepare clear, concise, and insightful written investment commentary for investment committee reports and client reviews. Prepare investment recommendations including fund additions, removals, watch status, and replacement recommendations based on established investment criteria and Investment Committee guidance. Present investment analysis and recommendations to clients’ investment committees. Respond to client questions regarding investment performance, manager philosophy, market conditions, and investment strategy. Participate in investment manager meetings, due diligence calls, and industry conferences. Coordinate regularly with fund company contacts to obtain due diligence information, discuss portfolio positioning, review organizational updates, and product enhancements. Evaluate target date fund providers and conduct suitability analysis for clients. Support Requests for Proposal (RFPs), finalist presentations, and new business opportunities by providing investment expertise. Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of the firm's investment research process and analytical tools. Required Experience/Characteristics: Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the retirement plan industry, with a specific focus on investment analysis (10+ years preferred). CFA achieved or in-progress preferred Proficient knowledge of asset allocation, portfolio construction, performance attribution, risk analysis, capital markets. Experience evaluating fund managers and experience with different investment vehicles (mutual funds, CITs, SMAs, etc). Exceptional presentation and communication skills. Strong commitment to client service, responsiveness, and ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and conducting meetings via MS Teams/Zoom. RPAG knowledge/background (preferred). What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Summary: Our Advisor Associates works directly with Advisors to assist with the wealth management and financial planning needs of clients. This position is responsible for providing support to Advisors including data gathering, case design, scenario building, financial plan development, financial plan application, and portfolio implementation. Responsibilities: Provide support to Advisors in all areas of financial planning. Initiate and field client calls on various items (e.g., strategy ideas, account specific questions, portfolio inquiries, etc.). Create proposals for prospective clients. Create and/or update financial plans for clients. Prepare materials for client meetings; work with other internal teams to ensure client meetings are prepared for thoroughly and accurately. Attend client meetings and manage/complete all meeting follow-up activities. Liaise with client’s attorneys and accountants as needed. Monitor portfolios and maintain portfolio target allocations. Rebalance portfolios as needed Assist with client data consolidation and maintenance as needed. Assist with special projects as required. Qualifications: 0-4 years of relevant experience. Completed or pursuing CFP®, CFA or JD. Bachelors’ degree or higher from an accredited university; major in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, or law preferred Continuously exhibits personal integrity and professional initiative. Reliable, follows through on commitments, self-starter when it comes to new challenges. Must be organized, detail-oriented and able to manage and prioritize tasks. Demonstrates a commitment to accuracy by delivering high quality work. Excellent written and verbal communication. Job.JobTitle: Senior Commercial Lines Account Executive, Construction
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Summary The Senior Account Executive interacts with clients on a day-to-day basis while building and maintaining relationships with both client and carrier representatives. This role supports a Construction-focused commercial insurance book of business, working with contractors, developers, and other construction-related clients to manage complex risk management and insurance needs. Responsibilities include preparing applications, specifications, and marketing strategies for new and renewal business, with some supervision and approval from the supervisor. This role may serve as the lead consultant and primary point of contact for assigned clients and may have revenue goals and/or client retention targets. Work Location This is a full-time position offering the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule, available from any of the following office locations: Albany, Amherst, Kingston, Rochester/Pittsford, Fishkill, NY, or Danbury, CT. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Negotiates terms, conditions, coverage limits, and pricing with carriers and wholesalers. Works with the Claims Department on relevant claims for assigned clients. Prepare client proposals, according to NFP standardization, from carrier quotes that reflect an accurate presentation of coverage terms, pricing, exposure basis, renewal comparisons, and marketing results. Highlight coverage gaps or differences to ensure clients understand any potential limitations in coverage. Responsible for obtaining and maintaining accurate exposure information, including payroll, sales, subcontractor costs, driver information, reporting forms, signed endorsements, and other data necessary to avoid E&O claims. Maintains a diary (follow-up system) to ensure policies, endorsements, certificates, and other information are received and processed in accordance with client requests. May supervise or direct the daily job activities of Coordinators and Account Managers. Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers and clients through regular contact and client visits. Keep clients apprised of industry trends, market conditions, and state and federal regulatory issues impacting the construction industry. Education and/or Experience Typically, more than 5 years of Commercial Lines experience. This must include recent tenure with a retail insurance brokerage or independent agency. Experience managing a book of middle-market accounts (estimated revenue minimum of 1 Million) is required. Experience servicing construction-related clients, including general contractors, trade contractors, developers, or other construction risks, is strongly preferred. In-depth knowledge of commercial insurance coverages, including General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, Umbrella/Excess Liability, Property, Builders Risk, Contractor's Equipment, and related construction exposures. Understanding of marketplace trends and best practices to meet clients' needs. Proven ability to prepare and analyze loss summaries to support renewals and client strategy. Strong negotiating skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel. Experience with EPIC preferred or other CRM required. BA/BS preferred. Certificates, Licenses, Registration P&C Insurance License required. CIC, CPCU, ARM, or other industry designation preferred. What We Offer NFP is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO and paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health and wellness programs, and more. Our people-first culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $77,200 -$110,000 The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #NFP 2587480

Posting Description Who We Are Lenox Advisors brings together sophisticated solutions in wealth management and insurance services to high-net-worth individuals and their families. As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon Company, we combine the culture of a boutique firm with the stability and backing of a large corporation to create an environment that's truly unique. NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We’re a recognized Elite Agency award winner and a leading property and casualty broker, benefits consultant, wealth manager, and retirement plan advisor. NFP provides solutions enabling client success through the expertise of over 8,000 global employees, investments in innovative technologies, and enduring relationships with highly rated insurers, vendors and financial institutions. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Position Summary & Overall Purpose Lenox Advisors is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Event Coordinator who is passionate about creating exceptional experiences and seeing complex events successfully come to life. This role combines independent ownership with a highly collaborative, team-focused environment. The ideal candidate is someone who can gather input from collaborators, conduct research and site visits, develop creative event concepts, and confidently present recommendations for feedback and approval. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced event professional who is ready to take the next step in their career and fully lead the planning and execution of impactful events that support business growth, client engagement, and organizational objectives. This hybrid role will be based in New York, NY and requires travel for events including to our Stamford office, as key leaders and event stakeholders are based in each office. The standard schedule is at least three days per week in the office, with willingness to support events on site outside of business hours. Key Responsibilities Event Planning & Execution Coordinate end-to-end planning of events including conferences training sessions, corporate meetings, and dinners. Develop timelines, run-of-show documents, and detailed logistical plans for each event Lead on-site execution including setup, vendor coordination, and issue resolution to ensure excellent delivery Vendor & Venue Management Source, evaluate, and manage relationships with venues and vendors (AV, catering, travel, etc.) Negotiate contracts in conjunction with manager and COO and ensure all services align with budget and event objectives Coordinate site visits and oversee logistics such as audiovisual needs and space planning in coordination with Lenox IT and the EA team. Registration & Attendee Management Manage event registration, RSVP tracking, and attendee communications together with the marketing team Prepare registration reports and maintain accurate participant data (e.g., tracking RSVPs and headcount for events) Coordinate event communications (invitations, registration follow ups, “Know Before You Go” emails, etc.) Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with executive leadership, executive assistants, event host, marketing, and external partners to align on event goals and messaging Serve as a central point of contact across internal teams and vendors Collaborate with marketing on event materials, branding, and communications Budget & Reporting Support event budget creation and track expenses to ensure cost efficiency Process invoices and vendor payments Deliver post-event reporting including attendance, feedback, and recommendations for improvement On-Site Operations Oversee onsite execution including registration, vendor coordination, and troubleshooting and coordinate with the event management vendor if one is hired Ensure all event elements run according to plan and meet Lenox quality standards Provide a high-touch, professional experience for advisors, clients, and partners Travel in the NYC & tri-state area required approximately 25% of the time Events will sometimes fall outside of normal business hours Qualifications 5+ years of experience in event coordination, preferably in corporate, financial services, or professional services environments Proven experience managing multiple events simultaneously with strong attention to detail Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills Experience working with executive leadership, senior stakeholders and external partners Proficiency with Microsoft Office and event management tools/platforms Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or related field preferred Key Competencies Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment Strong client-service mindset and professionalism Excellent interpersonal and communication skills High attention to detail and execution excellence Adaptability and ability to troubleshoot in real time What We Offer We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $80,000 - $95,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: Ready to jump into the heart of our vibrant account servicing team as a Senior Account Manager? Here’s your chance to become a superstar in a workplace that’s all about growth, collaboration, and, of course, a little fun along the way! Join our dynamic team as a Senior Account Manager and become a vital part of our collaborative culture that thrives on fostering professional growth opportunities for our employees. As a Senior Account Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in working closely with our Advisors and Account Executives to provide exceptional service to our valued clients. Job.JobTitle: Sr. Employee Benefits Account Manager - Remote
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Employee Benefits Account Manager, Customer Service / Account Support, Insurance Customer Service Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. The Sr. Account Manager supports the delivery of employee benefits solutions by partnering with clients, carriers, and internal teams. This role is responsible for managing renewals, analyzing benefit plans, preparing client presentations, coordinating compliance activities, and providing ongoing client support. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong relationship management, analytical, and communication skills while serving as a key contributor to client satisfaction and strategic benefits planning. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Works proactively to build rapport with carrier and client contacts; may take active role in meetings. Communicates directly with clients, carriers, and internal team members through phone, email, virtual meetings, and other remote collaboration tools, in collaboration with senior team members. Prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. First draft of renewal presentation. Takes the lead on reviewing contracts, benefit plan summaries, and carrier source documents for accuracy in collaboration with the Account Executive or Advisor. May serve as a mentor to more junior team members; assists with training more junior team members Develops and maintains ongoing relationships with clients through regular remote communication. Takes more of an active role in client meetings and calls, including virtual meetings as appropriate. May have direct contact with clients and relies on a growing knowledge of the details of various insurance coverages Continues relationships with carrier representatives to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients Work with advisors or more senior team members to identify the strategies to meet client needs Review & analyze request for proposals and insurance plan designs, negotiate with carriers and recommend renewal actions in drafts of presentations to be reviewed by Account Executives Assist with client renewals and marketing and client meeting presentations; responsible for first draft of presentations Update benefit guides, ensure client resources and communications are up to date following open enrollment or coverage change Prepare document and data for annual client compliance audits to be presented by Account Executive Attend to client requests including product or vendor service or performance challenges Ensure 5500 form is filed and completed in a timely manner Assembles updates for clients regarding appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues in conjunction with Account Executives or Advisors Learns about alternative funding strategies. General client service support in conjunction with the account management team Maintains consistent availability and responsiveness during business hours while working remotely, including timely participation in scheduled calls, virtual meetings, and team communications. Participate in client projects such as implementation of new business, open enrollment process, non-discrimination testing, etc. May provide informal leadership to more junior team members, based on experience, without official supervisory responsibility. Performs other duties as assigned and consistently makes independent judgments subject to general supervisor support. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision making skills Diligent follow up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, including strong self-management, proactive communication, and proficiency with virtual meeting and collaboration tools. Education and/or Experience: Associates degree (or equivalent), and BA/BS preferred More than 3 years’ client service and/or industry and product line experience Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required within six months. Physical Demand: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $52,700 – $65,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-RN1 #LI-REMOTE #NFP 2587263

Job.JobTitle: 2027 Wealth Management Intern - West Hartford, CT
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over $580B in assets under advisement, and more than 1,200 employees across 40+ offices, we deliver insights and solutions grounded in deep research, advanced technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Key responsibilities include: Assist with the development and preparation of client financial plans. Support portfolio construction, analysis, and client portfolio reviews. Reconcile and review financial data to ensure accuracy and completeness. Conduct investment and market research to support client needs and firm initiatives. Assist with the review and allocation of 529 college savings plans. Research client-specific questions and issues and present findings to team members. Collaborate with colleagues across the firm to gain exposure to different areas of the business. Develop and present clear, concise analysis and recommendations. Qualifications: Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance preferred, or an undergraduate/graduate degree program aligned with the CFP® certification. Demonstrated interest in financial planning and wealth management. Demonstrates integrity, professionalism, and initiative. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Highly organized and detail-oriented. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Collaborative and able to work effectively in a team environment. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list! We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences! The hourly range for this position is $20.00 – $22.00 per hour. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: This is a full-time, exempt, support position assisting the Account Team in the management of the existing Book of Business with emphasis in full retention responsibility. The primary function of this position is to provide quality service to clients and cross-sell/account-round within the existing book of business. The Account Manager (AM) will be the day-to-day liaison between the insurance company and designated middle-market accounts. You will lead and control relationships with clients in collaboration with Producers and/or Account Executives. Daily servicing of clients will include contract analysis, coverage and exposure analysis, endorsement activity, routine coverage and billing questions, problem-solving, renewal control, preparation of quotes/proposals, binding coverage, and claim reporting and follow-up. You will assist Producer(s) with the above functions as needed. You should have P&C experience and an active P&C license. Have knowledge and experience in select commercial insurance including, but not limited to, commercial auto, property, general liability, umbrella, inland marine, workers compensation, and flood. This is a full-time position, ideally working hybrid from either our Charlotte, NC office. We will consider a remote option for well-experienced Commercial Lines candidates able to work on an EST schedule. When working remotely, maintain a dedicated workspace to safeguard company equipment and communications. Make sure your internet is reliable and high-speed. Stay available and engaged online, and limit personal distractions throughout your work hours. Job Goals: Give the most prompt, accurate, and courteous service that customers have ever received…anywhere. Increase revenue by rounding out commercial lines accounts. Negotiate pricing and coverage terms in the client’s best interest. Develop relationships that lead to new business sales. Essential Core Duties and Responsibilities Build and maintain constructive and effective partnerships with clients by meeting and exceeding expectations. Provide consistent, accurate, timely, and pertinent communication to clients. Resolve/assist with any service issues/questions. Assist clients in making appropriate coverage changes, making each contact a marketing opportunity. Inform and educate clients about coverage, exclusions and exposures and document electronic files accordingly. Respond to clients’ needs by providing/producing binders, certificates, policies, auto id cards, evidence of insurance, and other related items accurately and on time. Monitor and review client satisfaction. Electronically document all communication with clients. As appropriate, market, negotiate, prepare and analyze alternative renewal options. Develop written, graphic, and electronic renewal materials as appropriate. Follow established agency procedures for effective utilization of the agency management system. Take advantage of personal and professional development opportunities such as continuing education, professional designations, and in-house training. Adhere to all state laws and regulations regarding insurance agents (licensing, continuing education, etc). Assist with or complete other tasks as advised by management/team. Job Specifications/Requirements: Property and casualty insurance license upon hire is required. At least 2 years of experience in commercial lines insurance, with an understanding of underwriting, coverage and rate analysis. In-depth knowledge of insurance coverages and an ability to communicate this knowledge clearly to clients and underwriters. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to prioritize and self-manage workload. Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel. EPIC experience is preferred, but will consider other agency management system experience. If not experienced with EPIC and seeking a remote role, on-site training may be required in one of our select East Coast offices. When working from home, you must maintain a private workspace to secure company equipment and correspondence; maintain high-speed internet, be present and responsive online and minimize personal interruptions during your work shift. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, ultimately, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $60,000 – $95,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Summary of Role: This is a full-time, exempt, support position assisting the Account Team in the management of the existing Book of Business with emphasis in full retention responsibility. The Account Manager (AM) will be the day-to-day liaison between the insurance company and designated middle-market accounts. You will lead and control relationships with clients in collaboration with Producers and/or Account Executives. Daily servicing of clients will include contract analysis, coverage and exposure analysis, endorsement activity, routine coverage and billing questions, problem-solving, renewal control, preparation of quotes/proposals, binding coverage, and claim reporting and follow-up. You will assist Producer(s) with the above functions as needed. You should have P&C experience and an active P&C license. Have knowledge and experience in select commercial insurance including, but not limited to, commercial auto, property, general liability, umbrella, inland marine, workers compensation, and flood. This is a full-time position, ideally working hybrid from either our Charlotte, NC office. We will consider a remote option for well-experienced Commercial Lines candidates able to work on an EST schedule. When working remotely, maintain a dedicated workspace to safeguard company equipment and communications. Make sure your internet is reliable and high-speed. Stay available and engaged online, and limit personal distractions throughout your work hours. Job Goals: Give the most prompt, accurate, and courteous service that customers have ever received…anywhere. Increase revenue by rounding out commercial lines accounts. Negotiate pricing and coverage terms in the client’s best interest. Develop relationships that lead to new business sales. Essential Core Duties and Responsibilities Build and maintain constructive and effective partnerships with clients by meeting and exceeding expectations. Provide consistent, accurate, timely, and pertinent communication to clients. Resolve/assist with any service issues/questions. Assist clients in making appropriate coverage changes, making each contact a marketing opportunity. Inform and educate clients about coverage, exclusions and exposures and document electronic files accordingly. Respond to clients’ needs by providing/producing binders, certificates, policies, auto id cards, evidence of insurance, and other related items accurately and on time. Monitor and review client satisfaction. Electronically document all communication with clients. As appropriate, market, negotiate, prepare and analyze alternative renewal options. Develop written, graphic, and electronic renewal materials as appropriate. Follow established agency procedures for effective utilization of the agency management system. Take advantage of personal and professional development opportunities such as continuing education, professional designations, and in-house training. Adhere to all state laws and regulations regarding insurance agents (licensing, continuing education, etc). Assist with or complete other tasks as advised by management/team. Job Specifications/Requirements: Property and casualty insurance license upon hire is required. At least 2 years of experience in commercial lines insurance, with an understanding of underwriting, coverage and rate analysis. In-depth knowledge of insurance coverages and an ability to communicate this knowledge clearly to clients and underwriters. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to prioritize and self-manage workload. Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel. EPIC experience is preferred, but will consider other agency management system experience. If not experienced with EPIC and seeking a remote role, on-site training may be required in one of our select East Coast offices. When working from home, you must maintain a private workspace to secure company equipment and correspondence; maintain high-speed internet, be present and responsive online and minimize personal interruptions during your work shift.
