Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire Advisors, founded in 1995, is a New York City-based, independent registered investment Advisory firm with more than 1,400 employees serving clients from 40+ offices. With a strong commitment to a fiduciary business model, the firm believes in connecting all aspects of a client's financial life to deliver thoughtful, collaborative strategies that focus on what is most important to each client. Wealthspire Advisors acts as a wealth manager, investment Advisor, consultant, and constant partner in helping clients achieve their aspirations. For more information on Wealthspire Advisors, please visit www.wealthspire.com. Summary: Wealthspire has a long and successful history of serving ultra-high net-worth multi-generational families. As a Senior Wealth Strategist, this role will join an experienced team in shaping Wealthspire’s approach to helping multi-generational families understand the challenges and opportunities of managing their wealth through financial, estate and tax planning. This role partners with colleagues across the organization, as well as outside advisors, in strategically advising UHNW clients with estate planning, tax planning and multi-generational planning. This role is also responsible for keeping up to date on estate and tax laws and regulations that may impact UHNW clients and proactively draft alerts and provide both internal and public-facing thought leadership on estate and tax issues. This role will report to the Director of Wealth Strategy. Responsibilities: Assist Advisors and clients in providing strategic wealth preservation guidance. Generate ideas regarding tax savings techniques and estate and business planning strategies to reduce income and estate tax as well as streamline business succession or liquidation planning. Meet with UHNW clients and their Advisors to discuss current estate plan, transfer tax implications, specific family circumstances and apply specific expertise to address strategic opportunities for planning. Help clients understand how different assets and sources of wealth should be used to maximize wealth for multiple generations and enhance their lives. Proactively manage prospect pipeline and existing clients to collaborate with Advisor teams on generating innovative ideas to serve clients and manage changes within the family or in the tax law. Review current estate plan and analyze opportunities to maximize wealth transfer for future generations. Collaborate with the clients’ attorneys, accountants, appraisers, or other trusted advisors to discuss and implement strategies and ensure a comprehensive financial, estate and income tax plan that addresses all the clients’ goals. Collaborate with clients’ accountant in preparation of gift tax returns to ensure proper reporting and track gift and GST exemption available for future planning. Propose special needs planning strategies to enhance a disabled family member’s life while maintaining eligibility for government services and benefits. Educate clients on potential asset protection strategies to protect family members from divorcing spouses or other creditors. Support UHNW clients and their families in handling estate administration upon death of family member, analyze opportunities for post-mortem planning and help families understand how assets are being inherited. Education Provide education internally and generate up to date intellectual capital in the form of articles, videos, podcasts, and presentations. Monitor updates in the law and draft timely alerts on estate and tax issues that may impact clients. Pursue external speaking opportunities to network with centers of influence and provide visibility to the community to promote the Wealthspire brand. Leadership Initiative-taking thought leader regarding estate and tax planning and active leader within the advisor team for clients. Function as a connector for the firm with centers of influence. Raise the profile of the firm through publishing and speaking externally. Work collaboratively with the Director of Wealth Strategy on strategy for building and growing the business. Qualifications: Law degree Minimum of six years of UHNW estate and wealth transfer planning experience in a law firm or a wealth management firm. Must be able to review and explain estate planning documents, as well as design complex estate plans. LLM in Tax a plus. Advisor to high-net-worth clients at a wealth management firm a plus. Specific expertise in philanthropy or business succession planning a plus. Ideal Candidate: Continuously exhibits personal integrity and professional initiative. Demonstrates a commitment to accuracy by delivering high quality work. Excellent written and verbal communication. Collaborative and able to work effectively with others. Flexible collaborator who is highly adaptable to change and open to innovative ideas. Entrepreneurial mindset. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, and more. The base salary range for this position is $275,000 – $335,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #wealthspire #LI-JS3 #Wealthspire . SVPWE015497

Moreover, at this level, you may find yourself directly supervising and mentoring team members, adding another layer of leadership to this exciting opportunity. Join us in this influential role where your expertise truly shines! Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Negotiates terms, conditions, coverage limits and pricing with carriers and wholesalers. Develop and maintain ongoing relationships with clients; Act as the subject matter expert on Health & Welfare Benefits and vendor/carrier products and services. Maintains a project plan to ensure client deliverables are provided on time. Delegates work to more junior team members to ensure completion. Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers, companies and clients. Keep clients apprised of appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues Maintain relationships with carrier representatives in order to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients. Anticipate client needs and identify the strategies to solve them. Review request for proposals and insurance plan analyses, negotiate with carriers and recommend renewal actions. Oversee implementations of new business. Understand and articulate alternative funding strategies. Work with director to develop and execute client strategy plan and defined deliverables. Oversee open enrollment process for clients; Review employee presentations and communication materials. Conduct and present annual client compliance audits. Genuine understanding of client financial mechanics and projections. Keep clients apprised of appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues. Explain legislative guidelines including COBRA, HIPPA, ERISA, Section 125, and Health Care Reform to clients; Keep clients aware of updates on relevant Interpret plan rules to ensure compliance with Plan Documents and Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs). Review the work of the Account Managers on the team and provide informal mentorship to them. Ensure all client data is entered into CRM System (Salesforce) in a timely manner. May have direct supervisory responsibility of junior team members Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision making skills Diligent follow up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Education and/or Experience: BA/BS preferred Typically more than 8 years industry and product line experience. 8+ years of health and welfare consulting experience required. Posting Description Who We Are: Financial Architects Partners (part of NFP, an Aon company) is a specialized life insurance firm that focuses on preserving generational wealth for super affluent clients and their families. We handle the complete process of analyzing, acquiring, and servicing high-end life insurance portfolios. Additionally, we provide support with advanced estate and insurance planning strategies. The portfolio administration department primarily manages portfolios, performs inforce analysis, and maintains client relationships. Our ongoing administration and dedication to quality set us apart in the market. We’re part of NFP, an Aon company, a multiple Best Places to Work award recipient in Business Insurance who has also received the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are a group of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We support companies and individuals worldwide in tackling their most critical risk, workforce, wealth management, and retirement challenges through tailored solutions and a people-first approach. Responsibilities: Take full responsibility for actively managing the Managing Director's business calendar, making sure their schedule aligns with client engagements, sales goals, relationship-building efforts, and company objectives. Arrange internal and external meetings with clients, prospects, advisors, referral partners, affiliates, carriers, and other business relationships. Anticipate scheduling conflicts, travel considerations, preparation requirements, and competing priorities. Collaborate with the Managing Director's sales and operational partners prior to arranging meetings that need their participation. Organize meeting agendas, materials, background information, logistics, and follow-up activities. Maintain access to the Managing Director's upcoming priorities and ensure the appropriate internal teams have sufficient notice of meetings, requests, and deliverables. Collaborate on scheduling matters with the Managing Director's external personal support teams when required, while keeping a clear focus on his business calendar and responsibilities. Sales Goal and Business Priority Coordination Help the Managing Director organize, monitor, and maintain access to their annual sales goals and related business priorities. Coordinate with Sales Operations and other designated partners to track progress against goals, priorities, opportunities, and commitments. Maintain organized records of key opportunities, relationships, meetings, and required follow-up activities. Assist in converting the Managing Director's priorities into distinct action items, assigned owners, deadlines, and subsequent steps. Support regular reviews of sales activity, pipeline priorities, relationship-development opportunities, and outstanding commitments. Detect absent details or pending follow-up tasks and collaborate with the relevant person or group to ensure progress continues. Provide the Managing Director with clear, organized information on priorities, deadlines, and upcoming decisions. Client and Advisor Experience Assistance Help provide a consistent, responsive, and highly coordinated experience for the Managing Director's clients, advisors, prospects, referral partners, and affiliates. Act as a professional and dependable liaison for the Managing Director's office. Anticipate meeting preparation, communication, scheduling, and follow-up needs. Ensure client and advisor commitments are recorded, shared, and directed to the relevant internal team. Partner with New Business, Design, Client Service, Underwriting, and other operational teams to aid in the timely completion of client-facing deliverables. Maintain awareness of significant client relationships, upcoming achievements, outstanding requests, and service needs. Assist the Managing Director in preserving consistent relationship engagement by making certain key interactions and follow-up commitments are not overlooked. Support meaningful client and advisor interactions, including meeting preparation, acknowledgments, event coordination, and other business-related relationship activities. Salesforce and Business Activity Management Maintain accurate and timely records of business activity in Salesforce. Document meetings, notes, activities, follow-up items, relationship information, and relevant opportunities. Record communications with clients, prospects, advisors, referral partners, affiliates, and other strategic relationships. Ensure operational teams have access to upcoming opportunities, client needs, deadlines, and deliverable requirements. Review records for absent or incomplete details and coordinate with the Managing Director and relevant team members to gather required updates. Follow FAP’s established Salesforce processes and data standards. Employ Salesforce as a system for organization and communication to facilitate coordination among sales and operational teams. Sales and Operations Coordination Act as the main liaison between the Managing Director and the firm’s operational teams. Facilitate clear communication among Sales, Sales Operations, New Business, Design, Client Service, Underwriting, and Operations teams. Ensure requests follow the correct firm procedures and are assigned to the suitable team. Provide operational teams with sufficient context, timing, and information to evaluate and prioritize requests. Coordinate follow-up activities resulting from client, prospect, advisor, and internal meetings. Track action items, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding decisions. Assist in making sure opportunities and client-facing requests advance effectively within the firm’s established workflows. Advance scheduling conflicts, competing priorities, or unresolved issues to the appropriate leader. Travel and Expense Coordination Coordinate business travel, including airfare, accommodations, transportation, meeting logistics, and itineraries. Maintain detailed travel schedules and communicate relevant information to internal and external collaborators. Coordinate with external support resources when business travel intersects with personal scheduling or logistical considerations. Prepare and submit business expense reports in accordance with firm policies. Track and reconcile business expenses accurately and promptly. Communication and Project Support Handle business-related correspondence and follow up on behalf of the Managing Director, as appropriate. Coordinate with firm leaders, operational teams, clients, advisors, prospects, and strategic partners. Maintain clear records of commitments, decisions, action items, and deadlines. Prepare organized summaries of upcoming meetings, priorities, and outstanding items. Support special projects and central initiatives related to the Managing Director’s clients, relationships, sales goals, and business responsibilities. Handle sensitive business information with discretion and sound judgment. Qualifications Required Experience 3-5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Sales Coordinator, or in a comparable business-support role. Experience providing support to a senior executive, sales leader, managing director, business owner, or other high-volume professional. Proven capability to handle intricate calendars, multiple priorities, travel arrangements, meetings, and executive follow-up. Experience coordinating across multiple departments, collaborators, and external relationships. Experience using a CRM or comparable business-management platform. Proficient in both written and spoken communication. Demonstrated discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information. Ability to learn business processes, industry terminology, and technology platforms. Preferred Experience Experience supporting a sales executive, business-development leader, financial, family office, professional, or client-focused business. Experience in financial services, insurance, wealth management, banking, consulting, or another professional-services environment. Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM. Experience using Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools to research client and prospect backgrounds. Experience supporting client relationship management, pipeline coordination, or sales activity tracking. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, ultimately, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $80,000 – $100,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Reconcile and review financial data to ensure accuracy and completeness. Conduct investment and market research to support client needs and firm initiatives. Assist with the review and allocation of 529 college savings plans. Research client-specific questions and issues and present findings to team members. Collaborate with colleagues across the firm to gain exposure to different areas of the business. Develop and present clear, concise analysis and recommendations. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary: The Senior Private Equity Broker is responsible for broking new and renewal business on behalf of private equity sponsors and their portfolio companies, leading all aspects of placements from initial market strategy through policy delivery. This role focuses on the largest and most complex placements and serves as a senior advisor to private equity sponsors across the full investment lifecycle, including pre-acquisition due diligence, transaction execution, post-close integration, and ongoing portfolio risk optimization. The role also carries leadership responsibility for mentoring team members and cultivating strong carrier, sponsor, and advisor relationships. This role has the potential to work anywhere in the U.S! Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Proactively coordinate and manage broking activities around renewals and transactions in accordance with NFP service standards Define and deliver go-to-market strategies for complex placements to achieve optimal client outcomes Lead negotiations with carriers, wholesalers, and specialty markets Carry out placements demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of client risk profiles Partner with account management teams to deliver complete, high-quality submissions and client proposals Develop creative solutions for difficult placement scenarios Partner with account team in presenting proposals and recommendations to clients and internal collaborators Oversee the review of binders and policies for accuracy and alignment with negotiated terms Mentor, support and develop brokers and account management team Maintain strong carrier and wholesale relationships Lead team in driving NFP’s broking strategies, including strategic carriers, panels, and preferred wholesaler utilization Demonstrate a strong understanding of a variety of P&C risk financing strategies Utilize data and analytics to provide insight and enhance client programs Private Equity & Transaction Responsibilities: Serve as senior insurance advisor to private equity sponsors and operating partners Lead and support insurance due diligence for acquisitions, including program reviews and gap identification Develop post-close insurance structures and integration strategies Support deal teams with pro formas and accelerated placement execution Advise on portfolio-wide insurance governance and benchmarking Collaborate with legal, tax, and transaction advisors Coverage Expertise: Demonstrate expertise across PE-relevant coverages including property, casualty, management liability (D&O, EPLI, fiduciary), cyber, environmental, executive risk, transactional liability, and complex excess structures, coordinating with specialty teams as appropriate. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Strong leadership and portfolio management skills Excellent communication and negotiation capabilities Deep understanding of private equity structures, deal cycles, and sponsor priorities Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to manage complex, fast-paced workloads. Education and/or Experience: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience Minimum seven (7) years of insurance experience, including private equity-backed clients or M&A transactions. Leadership experience preferred. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Proactively coordinate and manage broking activities around renewals and transactions in accordance with NFP service standards Define and deliver go-to-market strategies for complex placements to achieve optimal client outcomes Lead negotiations with carriers, wholesalers, and specialty markets Carry out placements demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of client risk profiles Partner with account management teams to deliver complete, high-quality submissions and client proposals Develop creative solutions for difficult placement scenarios Partner with account team in presenting proposals and recommendations to clients and internal collaborators Oversee the review of binders and policies for accuracy and alignment with negotiated terms Mentor, support and develop brokers and account management team Maintain strong carrier and wholesale relationships Lead team in driving NFP’s broking strategies, including strategic carriers, panels, and preferred wholesaler utilization Demonstrate a strong understanding of a variety of P&C risk financing strategies Utilize data and analytics to provide insight and enhance client programs Private Equity & Transaction Responsibilities: Serve as senior insurance advisor to private equity sponsors and operating partners Lead and support insurance due diligence for acquisitions, including program reviews and gap identification Develop post-close insurance structures and integration strategies Support deal teams with pro formas and accelerated placement execution Advise on portfolio-wide insurance governance and benchmarking Collaborate with legal, tax, and transaction advisors Coverage Expertise: Demonstrate expertise across PE-relevant coverages including property, casualty, management liability (D&O, EPLI, fiduciary), cyber, environmental, executive risk, transactional liability, and complex excess structures, coordinating with specialty teams as appropriate. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Strong leadership and portfolio management skills Excellent communication and negotiation capabilities Deep understanding of private equity structures, deal cycles, and sponsor priorities Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to manage complex, fast-paced workloads. Education and/or Experience: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience Minimum seven (7) years of insurance experience, including private equity-backed clients or M&A transactions. Leadership experience preferred. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Active P&C license required Advanced industry designation(s) (e.g. CPCU, CIC, ARM) preferred What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. highly confidential financial and employee data Support Finance Operations & User Experience · Enable period-end close, budget cycles, cost center and organizational changes, and global Finance transactions within Workday · Support mass data processing activities (EIB loads, chart of accounts restructures, large-scale updates) · Develop standard operating procedures, process flow Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Designing, implementing and managing all aspects of an employer sponsored benefits program. Developing and executing client strategic plan and defined deliverables Exploring strategic alternatives and providing strategic guidance while quantifying the financial implication and associated risk of options presented for consideration Negotiating terms, conditions, coverage limits and pricing with carriers and vendors Developing and maintaining ongoing relationships with clients; acting as the subject matter expert on Health & Welfare Benefits and vendor/carrier products and services Maintaining and executing a project plan to ensure client deliverables are provided on a timely basis. Delegating work to more junior team members as appropriate. Understanding and articulating alternative funding strategies, analyzing viability on a client specific basis Demonstrating a genuine understanding of the mechanics of client financials and related projections Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and carriers Keeping clients apprised of appropriate industry trends including all state and federal regulatory issues Explaining regulatory compliance and legislative guidelines including as related to COBRA, HIPAA, ERISA, Section 125, and Health Care Reform Interpreting plan rules to ensure compliance with Plan Documents and Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs) Anticipating client needs and identifying strategies to address them Overseeing the implementation of new business Overseeing open enrollment; developing and/or reviewing client presentations and communication materials May have direct supervisory responsibility of junior team members Review the work of junior team members and provide appropriate guidance and skill development Ensure all client data is entered into CRM System (Salesforce) in a timely manner. Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities: Comprehensive knowledge of carrier products and services, industry trends, benefits administration, regulatory compliance and HealthCare Reform Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective project management, time management and organizational skills Strong analytical and financial skills Excellent attention to detail and commitment to outstanding client service Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Education and/or Experience: A Bachelor’s Degree in Risk Management, Business, Finance or a related field preferred 5+ years health and welfare consulting experience Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required GBA or CEBS Certification a plus What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $95,300 – $130,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2588272

Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are on their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. Wealthspire Advisors is in search of a Wealth Advisor for its Beachwood, Ohio office. This position entails collaborating with other members of the team to serve the wealth management and financial planning needs of our high net-worth clients and their families. Responsibilities: Lead and/or support other advisors in the management of client engagements. Determine appropriate client allocations through analysis of investment objectives, risk tolerance, net worth, income, and investment experience, or other knowledge. Execute investment and planning activities (e.g., rebalancing portfolios, money movements, required minimum distributions, tax loss harvesting, charitable planning, lending evaluation, education funding, etc.). Monitor client investments, review performance, and suggest changes to client portfolios as appropriate. Actively service client accounts by performing and/or coordinating administrative tasks (e.g. tracking and monitoring account/asset transfers, preparing and presenting performance reports, processing transaction requests as directed, handling necessary paperwork for accounts, etc.). Initiate and field client calls on various topics and miscellaneous requests (e.g., account specific questions, general inquiries regarding portfolios, investment market discussions, planning items, money movements, etc.). Assist with the development of client financial plans using financial planning software and present results and solutions to clients. Prepare for and attend client meetings and manage and/or complete all meeting follow-up activities. Create proposals for prospective clients. Coordinate with clients’ attorneys, accountants, and other professionals as needed. Develop and maintain working knowledge of various financial planning concepts, such as gift, estate and income tax planning, insurance, credit solutions, education funding, charitable/philanthropic strategies, etc. Pursue professional development opportunities to include additional licenses and/or designations and actively participate in internal and external training sessions and networking events. Deepen existing client relationships; seek client referrals. Participate in community outreach, networking, and marketing activities to drive new business opportunities. Leverage local centers of influence to extend referral network. Provide ongoing training and serve as a mentor to advisory staff. Requirements: Minimum 10+ years of wealth management experience (other or additional experience will be considered). CFP other wealth management designation highly preferred. Ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple projects. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to effectively manage task lists. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Flexible team player who is highly adaptable to change and open to new ideas. Ability to think creatively. Reliable, follows through on commitments. Personal integrity and professional initiative. Previous supervisory experience managing teams is a plus. Strong problem-solving and influence/consensus-building skills. Strong communication and organizational skills. Ability to work through questions and concerns collaboratively. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM, portfolio management and financial planning software is a plus. Bachelor’s degree or higher preferably in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, law, or related experience. Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Wealthspire: Wealthspire is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment that values diversity as a fundamental asset. Research substantiates that diverse teams are not only more innovative but also make more informed decisions, leading to increased employee engagement and client satisfaction. Equal Opportunity: We are an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender, age, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Culture Add Over Culture Fit: Rather than seeking candidates who merely fit into our existing culture, we prioritize those who will add new dimensions to it. We welcome individuals who bring unique perspectives, experiences, and skills that enrich our team and client interactions. Inclusive Excellence: We believe that true excellence can only be achieved in an environment where every employee feels empowered and included. Our commitment to diversity extends beyond hiring practices to every facet of our business. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Do not hesitate to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification on the list. We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We are eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences. Wealthspire is a firm built on a straightforward idea: that clients deserve an advisor as motivated as they are to achieve their financial aspirations. With an independent business model that offers a fiduciary approach, with no proprietary products or sales incentives, and a deep bench of experts structured to collaborate around client needs, our team thrives on solving the complexities of our clients’ financial lives. What We Offer: Wealthspire is proud to offer a comprehensive rewards package that includes a competitive salary, paid time off and holidays, a 401(k) plan with company match, exclusive discount programs, and robust health and wellness benefits. Our culture is rooted in putting people first – nurturing lasting relationships with our employees and fostering a workplace where everyone feels supported and valued. The base salary range is $120,000 to $130,000, and the total compensation range is up to $260,000. #wealthspire #LI-JS3 #Wealthspire . VPWEA014096

Job.JobTitle: AVP, Affluent Personal Lines (Hybrid - Central NJ)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Summary: P&C Private Client Group (PCG/affluent lines) is a division of NFP Property & Casualty. We are a retail operation for affluent and wealthy individuals and families seeking personal lines products in the United States, parts of Europe, and Canada. Our headquarters are in New York City with offices across the country - specializing in insurance ranging from homeowners and auto to specialty lines, such as aircraft and watercraft The Assistant Vice President will have responsibility for multiple highly complex clients. In this role, you will manage new and existing clients, maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and carriers and be responsible for policy compliance and human resources functions. This is a full-time role with the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule of 1-2 days a week from our Berkeley Heights, NJ office and other days from home. Being in the office is highly preferred for fostering interaction, immediate feedback, and stronger team relationships, all of which are crucial for strategic alignment of this position. But we are open to considering an exceptionally qualified remote candidate. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Develop and maintain ongoing relationships with complex and large clients. Act as the subject matter expert on Property & Casualty and carrier products and services Maintains and manages solid relationships with clients and carrier sales representatives. Negotiate with carriers for the best possible result Work with internal and external centers of influence to develop relationships Work with the Senior Leadership team to develop regional client deliverables. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Position Overview: NFP Rx Solutions — the pharmacy benefit consulting arm of NFP — is one of the largest full-service pharmacy benefit consulting practices in the U.S. We deliver customized Rx solutions to self-funded employers, health plans, and coalition clients, combining contract negotiation, clinical expertise, and advanced analytics to meaningfully reduce pharmacy spend and improve member outcomes. The team is open to considering uniquely qualified pharmacy benefit candidates for a remote opportunity. Principal Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions: Develop and maintain effective working relationships as liaison between clients, internal teams, and external partners, such PBMs, brokers, and other third party staff. Understand each assigned client’s business model, organizational structure, business goals, pharmacy benefit intent, and forecasted changes. Proficient in the PBM marketplace, including carrier contacts, services, and underwriting requirements. Inform leadership of all important activities on client accounts. Present to clients and brokers market reprice analyses, contract terms, and rate dependencies. Research and respond to pharmacy benefit related questions within deadline requirements. Assist in the communication of employee benefits in client enrollment meetings and webinars with the appropriate PBM representation. Assist the client in resolving billing, claim, eligibility, COBRA, and other customer service problems. Partner with PBM teams to resolve problematic benefits issues. Management and execution of client benefit requests, benefit changes, program implementations, new groups, and terminations. Provide semi-annual detailed pharmacy benefit performance reports to clients showing client metrics in comparison to industry benchmarks along with recommendations for plan improvement. Develop robust client relationships to promote client satisfaction, client retention and additional revenue opportunities. Review pharmacy benefit utilization trends and outliers with client on a regular basis. Host clients in the VPS office and/or carrier facilities, as needed. Prepare and provide ad hoc reports as needed. Keep all information on book of business accurate and up to date in the CRM software. Monitor client billing and payments, and ensure that proper billing procedures are followed. Participate in seminars and classes for continuing education on industry skills and knowledge. Assist in the development and maintenance of department resources, job aids, training materials, etc. Present a positive image of self and of VPS, in and out of the office, to fellow employees, clients, providers, and the community. Participate in special projects as requested. Minimum Requirements for Education, Experience, and Certifications/Licenses: Prefer Bachelor’s degree. Associate’s degree or equivalent from two-year college, minimum requirement. Minimum three years of PBM related industry experience. Qualifications & Skills: Knowledge of the Employee Benefits industry, and PBM specifically Excellent research skills Ability to read, analyze and interpret industry policies and contract documents, as well as proposals and other documentation and correspondence Ability to respond efficiently and accurately to common inquiries or complaints from customers or carrier Ability to effectively present information to insured clients and their respective carriers Excellent oral and written communication skills and command of the English language Ability to apply basic mathematical concepts such as percentages, adding, subtracting, multiplying and division to required tasks High degree of initiative, diligence, attention to detail, critical thinking, organizational and decision making skills Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions Ability to function independently with minimal supervision Ability to prioritize multiple projects and meet objectives and deadlines established by supervisor and clients, often with short turnaround times Ability to maintain positive and beneficial relationships with department staff, numerous internal departments, external customers, agents, and subscribers Proficient in MS Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint Professional telephone skills and e-mail etiquette Ability to follow company confidentiality requirements as well as with HIPAA and other applicable government regulations Travel: Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, with occasional overnight trips. Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. It is not a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities and/or qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Job Summary The Senior Account Executive interacts with clients on a day-to-day basis while building and maintaining relationships with both client and carrier representatives.This role supports a diverse middle-market book of commercial business across a variety of industries, helping clients navigate complex risk management and insurance needs.Responsibilities include preparing applications, specifications, and marketing strategies for new and renewal business, with some supervision and approval from the supervisor. This role may serve as the lead consultant and primary point of contact for assigned clients and may have revenue goals and/or client retention targets. Work Location This is a full-time position offering the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule, available from any of the following office locations: Albany, Amherst, Kingston, Rochester/Pittsford, Fishkill, NY, or Danbury, CT. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Negotiates terms, conditions, coverage limits, and pricing with carriers and wholesalers. Works with the Claims Department on relevant claims for assigned clients. Prepare client proposals, according to NFP standardization, from carrier quotes that reflect an accurate presentation of coverage terms, pricing, exposure basis, renewal comparisons, and marketing results. Highlight coverage gaps or differences to ensure clients understand any potential limitations in coverage. Responsible for obtaining and maintaining accurate exposure information, including payroll, sales, subcontractor costs, driver information, reporting forms, signed endorsements, and other data necessary to avoid E&O claims. Maintains a diary (follow-up system) to ensure policies, endorsements, certificates, and other information are received and processed in accordance with client requests. May supervise or direct the daily job activities of Coordinators and Account Managers. Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers and clients through regular contact and client visits. Keep clients apprised of industry trends, market conditions, and state and federal regulatory issues impacting the construction industry. Education and/or Experience Typically, more than 5 years of Commercial Lines experience. This must include recent tenure with a retail insurance brokerage or independent agency. Experience managing a middle-market book of business with approximately $1 million or more in revenue, representing clients across a range of industries, is required. In-depth knowledge of commercial insurance coverages, including General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, Umbrella/Excess Liability, Property, and other relevant Commercial P&C coverages. Understanding of marketplace trends and best practices to meet clients' needs. Proven ability to prepare and analyze loss summaries to support renewals and client strategy. Strong negotiating skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel. Experience with EPIC preferred or other CRM required. BA/BS preferred. Certificates, Licenses, Registration P&C Insurance License required. CIC, CPCU, ARM, or other industry designation preferred. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Summary:We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Compensation Manager to lead the design, execution, and governance of our compensation programs. This role will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure competitive, equitable, and data-driven pay practices that support organizational growth and talent strategy. What You’ll Do Own Compensation Strategy & Program Design Partner with the CPO to define and evolve the company’s compensation philosophy and pay practices. Design, implement, and continuously refine compensation structures including base pay, incentive plans, bonus programs, and special pay arrangements. Develop and maintain salary structures, pay grades, and job architecture frameworks. Conduct market benchmarking and external salary survey analysis to ensure competitiveness and alignment with business strategy. Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Do you enjoy collaborating closely with the business rather than practicing law from the sidelines? As our Corporate Counsel (P&C), you'll support our evolving insurance businesses and work directly with the people making day-to-day decisions. The work ranges from high-volume contracts such as NDAs to more nuanced carrier, MGA/MGU and regulatory matters. You'll have room to take ownership, develop relationships and become a trusted legal resource for the businesses you support. This role is a strong fit for an attorney who understands how the P&C insurance business operates and can turn legal analysis into practical guidance. Experience working with insurance carriers, MGAs/MGUs, brokers or related insurance businesses is especially valuable. Prior business-side insurance experience is also welcome. What You'll Do Draft, review and negotiate carrier agreements, MGA/MGU and program administrator agreements, client service agreements, NDAs and other commercial contracts. Advise business teams on P&C insurance operations, regulatory matters, risk management and contract issues. Review carrier and client agreements, identify meaningful legal and business risks, and recommend practical solutions. Support MGA/MGU operations and carrier relationships as business needs and regulatory requirements evolve. Partner directly with business leaders to understand their objectives and provide timely, business-focused legal guidance. Handle routine agreements efficiently while knowing when an issue requires deeper analysis or escalation. Ask questions, gather information and collaborate across legal and business teams to resolve issues. Monitor relevant P&C insurance regulatory developments and help the business respond to changing requirements. Contribute to legal team initiatives and share knowledge with colleagues across the organization. Qualifications: Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. 5+ years of legal experience involving the property and casualty insurance industry. Experience working with an insurance carrier, MGA/MGU, insurance broker, regulatory agency or insurance-focused law practice. Experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements. Strong solid understanding of P&C insurance operations and the relationships among carriers, brokers and insurance intermediaries. Ability to identify legal and business risks and translate them into clear, practical recommendations. Ability to independently manage priorities, follow through on commitments and seek additional information when needed. Communication skills that build credibility with legal colleagues and business partners. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable: Carrier agreements or carrier relationship management MGA, MGU or program administrator operations Commercial Lines insurance Retail insurance brokerage P&C insurance regulatory matters Claims or related risk issues Business-side experience within the insurance industry Technology or AI tools used for legal research, drafting or workflow improvement What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $163,100 – $190,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-LL1 #LI-REMOTE 2589147

Posting Description About the Company: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services - empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first - our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Job Summary This internship offers hands-on experience in accounting and financial operations, including bookkeeping, accounts payable, reconciliations, financial reporting, and maintaining financial records using tools such as QuickBooks Online and Bill.com. It’s ideal for an Accounting student who is detail-oriented, organized, comfortable with Excel, and eager to gain practical accounting experience in a professional environment. Key responsibilities include: Support day-to-day bookkeeping and general accounting activities. Assist with the preparation of financial reports and cash flow analyses. Process accounts payable transactions accurately and timely using Bill.com. Assist with bank and credit card reconciliations and help resolve discrepancies. Enter, review, and maintain financial information in QuickBooks Online and other accounting systems. Maintain organized and accurate accounting records and supporting documentation. Provide support for special projects and administrative tasks, as assigned. Qualifications: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field; junior or senior standing is preferred. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to accuracy. Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel; familiarity with QuickBooks Online or Bill.com is a plus. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage time, prioritize assignments, and meet deadlines in a professional environment. Collaborative, dependable, and eager to learn with a positive, professional approach. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list. We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences! The hourly range for this position is $18.00 – $20.00 per hour. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #Wealthspire 2591563

Summary: Provide support to broking team members and contributes to strategic recommendations, problem solving, and solution development for prospects and clients. Develops a comprehensive understanding of prospect and client risk profiles and exposures, and acts to cultivate and increase insurance market interest leading to the development of effective risk financing and risk transfer solutions. Focuses on tailoring required coverage, terms and conditions, and developing the appropriate program. This is a full-time opportunity with standard hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET. To support hybrid or remote work, candidates must maintain a reliable, confidential, and interruption-free workspace and have a stable high-speed internet connection. In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for 25% commission on first year new business. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Participate in the analysis of clients’ or prospects’ existing programs and ensure requirements. Review current policies and formulate recommendations for customized risk solutions Negotiate with insurance carriers; drives financial and non-financial outcomes that support organic revenue development and retention. Seize upon opportunities to upsell and cross-sell, leading to greater client product density and expanded account margin Ensure placements are handled according to NFP’s service model standards and timelines Support the team in developing client/prospect diagnostics – working at the direction of the Broker or Senior Broker to complete a total program assessment, including total cost of risk, service results, and opportunities fo program improvement Assist in timely production of required documentation and follow-up, ensuring timely flow of materials Assist team members with proposal development for existing and prospective clients Respond to client queries and concerns to resolve issues promptly Attend client meetings with team; leading to refined and enhanced client communication and presentation skills Present to local account executives, participate in RFPs, occasional client meetings and conference calls Support the deployment of data and analytics to provide program insights for clients and the broking team Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and local NFP account teams Cultivate a thorough understanding of markets to better assist the broking team Execute on NFP’s broking strategies, including strategic carriers, panels, and preferred wholesaler utilization Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of the insurance marketplace, and the various lines, products and services offered by various insurers Ensure client, broking and brokerage data files are maintained in a complete, organized and timely fashion Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people Proven negotiation skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team Attention to detail, demonstrating reliability and accuracy Strong organizational skills with the ability to adjust to changing priorities Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative Microsoft Office Suite Experience with Epic (agency management system) a plus Education and/or Experience: High School Diploma or GED required Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred Certificates, Licenses, Registration: P&C License preferred What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $43,000 – $50,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. If local to Plymouth, MN this is will be a hybrid role. Considering fully remote as well, must be able to work PST, MST or CST hours. Essential duties and responsibilities: To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned as the need arises. Executive and Administrative Support Provide day-to-day support to the Wealth Management leadership team. Manage calendars, coordinate travel, coordinate meetings, and assist with scheduling across internal and external collaborators. Prepare, submit, reconcile, and track expense reports and supporting documentation. Organize and maintain electronic files, records, templates, contact lists, and reference materials. Prepare correspondence, presentations, reports, and other business materials. Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism. Meeting and Communication Coordination Coordinate leadership meetings, team meetings, advisor training sessions, business reviews, conferences, and special events. Prepare and distribute agendas, meeting materials, presentations, and follow-up communications. Record meeting notes, action items, decisions, and deadlines while keeping follow-up tracking updated. Coordinate event logistics, registrations, travel arrangements, meeting space requirements, and attendee communications. Operational Support Support day-to-day Wealth Management business operations and initiatives. Assist with advisor onboarding, transitions, offboarding activities, and related coordination efforts. Coordinate system access requests, user maintenance, and operational support activities. Maintain operational procedures, workflows, resource materials, and team documentation. Support vendor management, invoice coordination, purchasing requests, and related business processes. Project & Business Coordination Provide coordination support for projects, central initiatives, and business priorities. Monitor deliverables and deadlines and actively follow up on pending tasks and commitments. Gather, organize, and summarize information needed for leadership meetings, reporting, and business decisions. Communications & Reporting Support Assist with drafting, formatting, and distributing internal communications. Prepare presentations, leadership materials, reports, and business updates. Coordinate information and materials among advisors, leadership, and internal business partners. Support reporting initiatives, data gathering, metrics tracking, and recurring business reviews. Ensure communications and materials are accurate, professional, and delivered on schedule. Knowledge, skills, and/or abilities: Exceptional organizational and time management skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent follow-through and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work independently and make well-informed decisions. Professional demeanor and capability to collaborate effectively with advisors, leadership, vendors, and internal business partners. Strong customer-service attitude and collaborative approach. Advanced skills in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and associated business software. Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced and evolving business environment. Education and/or experience: Associate's or bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. 3-5 years of experience in executive support, administrative operations, business operations, project coordination, or a related role. Experience in Wealth Management, financial services, or another professional-services environment preferred. Experience supporting senior leaders, senior executives, or a leadership team preferred. What We Offer We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture emphasizes building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because our purpose is to support others. The base salary range for this position is $65,000-$80,000. The salary offered will depend on factors such as experience, credentials, education, certifications, required skill level, position scope, and geographic location. Each salary is determined individually. Additionally, this position may qualify for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2590077

Position Summary We are seeking a Plan Administrator with the technical expertise to support a variety of complex retirement plan administration projects. While this individual will have the knowledge and experience to provide full plan administration, their expertise will be leveraged by the Special Projects team to provide technical research, analysis, and guidance to internal and external stakeholders. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping clients and prospective clients navigate complex compliance challenges, resolve difficult plan issues, and protect the long-term health of their retirement plans. The ideal candidate combines deep ERISA and plan administration expertise with the relationship-building skills needed to guide clients confidently through an increasingly complex regulatory landscape. Key Responsibilities Plan Administration & Compliance Provide various technical compliance tasks for a multitude of clients including projects such as DB/DC/H&W 5500 preparation and corrective calculations Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements Calculate and allocate employer contributions Assist clients with corrections through the various governmental programs Reconcile payroll contributions and employee census to determine if prior activity aligns with prior instructions and determine current year plan eligibility Reconcile trust assets and contributions, interpreting trust financial statements to resolve discrepancies Interpret plan document provisions to ensure accurate, compliant administration Ensure clients adhere to government filing and regulatory requirements Government Filings & Regulatory Support Complete, review, and provide audit support for Forms 5500, 5330, 8955-SSA, 1099-R, and related schedules Review and validate work completed by other plan administrators and support staff to ensure accuracy prior to delivery Maintain and expand ERISA compliance and software knowledge in step with evolving regulations and our evolving technology platform capabilities Client & Relationship Management Develop effective working relationships with clients, internal teams, external advisors, recordkeepers, and auditors supporting shared client relationships Identify and present opportunities for new business development Analysis & Communication Review, analyze, and summarize plan data in clear, succinct written communication to support advisors, Consultants, and fellow Plan Administrators Serve as a technical resource for research and plan analysis projects for internal and external clients Professional Development Comply with continuing education requirements and pursue ongoing credentialing Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. High school diploma required. Experience 1-3 years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting. Credentialing (one or more preferred) ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA) NIPA: Accredited 401(k) Specialist (AKS), Accredited Pension Administrator (APA), and/or Accredited Pension Representative (APR) IRS Enrolled Retirement Plan Agent (ERPA) NAPA: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor (CPFA) and/or Qualified Plan Financial Consultant (QPFC) Technical Skills Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans. Core Competencies Communication – effective oral, written, and interpersonal skills; communicates clearly and interactively with team members and support staff Judgment & problem-solving – proven organizational and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on plan design and compliance matters Client service – demonstrated ability to deliver quality customer service while managing multiple tasks with a high degree of accuracy Ownership – a sense of urgency and commitment to timely, high-quality project completion, balanced with attention to detail and confidentiality Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset What We Offer: Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Position Summary We are seeking a Plan Administrator with the technical expertise to support a variety of complex retirement plan administration projects. While this individual will have the knowledge and experience to provide full plan administration, their expertise will be leveraged by the Special Projects team to provide technical research, analysis, and guidance to internal and external stakeholders. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping clients and prospective clients navigate complex compliance challenges, resolve difficult plan issues, and protect the long-term health of their retirement plans. The ideal candidate combines deep ERISA and plan administration expertise with the relationship-building skills needed to guide clients confidently through an increasingly complex regulatory landscape. Key Responsibilities Plan Administration & Compliance Provide various technical compliance tasks for a multitude of clients including projects such as DB/DC/H&W 5500 preparation and corrective calculations Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements Calculate and allocate employer contributions Assist clients with corrections through the various governmental programs Reconcile payroll contributions and employee census to determine if prior activity aligns with prior instructions and determine current year plan eligibility Reconcile trust assets and contributions, interpreting trust financial statements to resolve discrepancies Interpret plan document provisions to ensure accurate, compliant administration Ensure clients adhere to government filing and regulatory requirements Government Filings & Regulatory Support Complete, review, and provide audit support for Forms 5500, 5330, 8955-SSA, 1099-R, and related schedules Review and validate work completed by other plan administrators and support staff to ensure accuracy prior to delivery Maintain and expand ERISA compliance and software knowledge in step with evolving regulations and our evolving technology platform capabilities Client & Relationship Management Develop effective working relationships with clients, internal teams, external advisors, recordkeepers, and auditors supporting shared client relationships Identify and present opportunities for new business development Analysis & Communication Review, analyze, and summarize plan data in clear, succinct written communication to support advisors, Consultants, and fellow Plan Administrators Serve as a technical resource for research and plan analysis projects for internal and external clients Professional Development Comply with continuing education requirements and pursue ongoing credentialing Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. High school diploma required. Experience 1-3 years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting. Credentialing (one or more preferred) ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA) NIPA: Accredited 401(k) Specialist (AKS), Accredited Pension Administrator (APA), and/or Accredited Pension Representative (APR) IRS Enrolled Retirement Plan Agent (ERPA) NAPA: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor (CPFA) and/or Qualified Plan Financial Consultant (QPFC) Technical Skills Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans. Core Competencies Communication – effective oral, written, and interpersonal skills; communicates clearly and interactively with team members and support staff Judgment & problem-solving – proven organizational and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on plan design and compliance matters Client service – demonstrated ability to deliver quality customer service while managing multiple tasks with a high degree of accuracy Ownership – a sense of urgency and commitment to timely, high-quality project completion, balanced with attention to detail and confidentiality Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset What We Offer: Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more.
