Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: NFP.com. Summary of Role: This role serves as a key strategic partner between U.S. business teams and the Global Capability Center (GCC), helping drive alignment, visibility, and accountability across shared workstreams. The position will use data and strong cross-functional relationships to identify capacity needs, risks, and opportunities, resolve issues, and help ensure work continues moving effectively across teams and time zones. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Serve as the primary strategic partner between GCC leadership and U.S. business participants across supported workstreams. Build strong, positive relationships that promote clear communication, shared accountability, and alignment on priorities and expectations. Build insight into demand, workload, capacity, and resource needs across workstreams, and surface potential constraints or coverage gaps. Review and analyze GCC reports daily to identify priorities, risks, dependencies, and required handoffs; provide GCC with a daily prioritie's report at the start of its working day; and coordinate what GCC should advance while U.S. teams are offline and what U.S. teams must complete so GCC can continue progressing work and meeting field needs. Identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, risks, and trends that may affect service delivery, business outcomes, or partner experience. Use available data and collaborator input to develop actionable insights and support informed leadership decisions. Promote adoption of established processes, tools, workflows, and standards while identifying areas where additional clarity or reinforcement is needed. Coordinate cross-functional issues through resolution by clarifying ownership, tracking actions and dependencies, and maintaining follow-through until closure. Facilitate timely discussion and decision-making while GCC leaders and team members are online, reducing delays built by limited time-zone overlap. Partner with GCC and U.S. leaders to address systemic challenges and implement balanced improvements. Provide clear updates to leadership regarding capacity, risks, trends, unresolved issues, and progress against agreed actions. Support change initiatives that affect GCC and U.S. teams by helping partners understand expectations, impacts, and responsibilities. Maintain role clarity by partnering with, rather than assuming, the people-leadership and day-to-day execution responsibilities of GCC leaders. Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities: Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to establish trust across geographically dispersed teams. Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability without direct reporting authority. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to recognize patterns, identify root causes, and translate information into practical recommendations. Ability to assess workload, capacity, risks, dependencies, and competing priorities across multiple workstreams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for team members, managers, and senior leaders. Proven track record to navigate ambiguity, coordinate across functions, and move issues from identification through resolution. Strong organizational skills and disciplined follow-through on actions, commitments, and escalations. Ability to balance partnership and diplomacy with clear expectations and accountability. Commitment to process consistency, continuous improvement, and scalable ways of working. Education and/or Experience: Bachelor’s degree in business, management, organizational leadership, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience partnering with offshore, global, or Global Capability Center teams strongly preferred. Ability to work Eastern Time (ET) zone hours required. Experience using reporting, metrics, and trend analysis to support leadership decisions and improvement initiatives. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and resolving issues that span teams, functions, or geographic locations. Experience working in a matrixed environment and influencing leaders and stakeholders without direct authority. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Health and Life License Preferred What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $111,200 - $120,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2591281

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary The Senior Account Manager is responsible for managing an assigned book of business and providing exceptional service to clients. This role serves as a trusted day-to-day resource, building strong relationships with clients and carrier partners while ensuring account needs are handled accurately, efficiently, and proactively. In partnership with Account Executives and Advisors, the Senior Account Manager oversees renewals, marketing activities, client and carrier communication, and ongoing account servicing. The ideal candidate brings strong insurance knowledge, excellent organization and communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities while delivering a consistently high level of client service. This is a full-time opportunity with the flexibility to work hybrid from our Albany, NY or Fishkill, NY offices. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. EST. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Manage an assigned book of Personal Risk business and serve as a key day-to-day contact for clients. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and carrier partners through proactive, responsive communication. Manage the renewal and marketing process Review accounts, identify coverage needs, coordinate remarketing when appropriate, and support insurance recommendations. Communicate directly with clients and carriers regarding coverage, renewals, policy changes, and ongoing service needs. Participate in and, when appropriate, lead client meetings and account reviews. Maintain accurate client and policy records within the agency management system and ensure timely follow-through on outstanding items. Manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and priorities while collaborating with internal teams to deliver a high-quality client experience. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong knowledge of Personal Risk insurance products, coverage, renewals, and account management. Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and an assigned book of business. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proactive, client-focused approach. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Sound independent judgment with strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, documentation, and follow-through. Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and agency management systems; Applied Epic experience preferred. Flexible and adaptable to changing client needs, priorities, and technology. Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree preferred. More than five years of insurance industry and product-line experience. Experience independently managing renewals and an assigned book of business strongly preferred. Certificates, Licenses and Registrations New York Property & Casualty insurance license required. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $53,500 -$71,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: The Account Manager supports the day-to-day servicing and management of Employee Benefits client accounts, working alongside senior Account Managers and Consultants to maintain client relationships and deliver effective benefits solutions. Responsibilities include responding to client requests, coordinating open enrollment and implementation activities, supporting renewals and carrier negotiations, and assisting with benefits administration, compliance, and reporting. The role also involves preparing client presentations, reviewing insurance proposals, maintaining accurate documentation, and developing relationships with insurance carriers and vendors. Key Responsibilities: Works with more senior Account Managers and Consultants to service client accounts. Begins to develop ongoing relationships with clients. Coordinates with senior Account Managers and Consultants advisors in doing so. Attend to client requests including product or vendor service or performance challenges. Participates in client projects such as implementation of new business, open enrollment process, non-discrimination testing, etc. under the direction of more senior team members. Assist with the creation of client corporate wellness programs and offerings. Works with senior team members to prepare and send requests for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheet results as they come in. Begins to develop relationships with carrier representatives to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients. Learns vendor/carrier products and services from the more senior Account Managers or Consultants. Begins to review and analyze requests for proposals and insurance plan analyses. Participates in negotiations with carriers and recommend renewal actions, under the direction of a senior team member. May assist in drafting renewal presentations. Creates and maintains client files in accordance with office procedures. May be responsible for keeping client policy records. Learning to review contracts, benefit plan summaries, and carrier source documents for accuracy under the direction of the Consultant. At this level, they will begin to learn more complex compliance and regulatory policy language. Learns how to conduct annual client compliance audits using NFP portal, assists more senior Account Managers in preparing documents. May assist in facilitating 5500 filing. Assist with creating and updating benefits-related guides, education resources for clients. Begins to review and analyze requests for proposals and insurance plan analyses. Participates in negotiations with carriers and recommends renewal actions, under the direction of a senior team member. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision-making skills Diligent follow up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Education and/or Experience: 3+ years of experience in corporate benefits or a related field. Preferably a bachelor's degree. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $46,500 – $90,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2592188

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: Diversified Brokerage Services (part of NFP, an Aon company) is one of the largest brokerage general agencies in the United States specializing in life insurance, and we’re proud of our roots, starting as a family run business in 1968 and growing to where we are today. With over 50 years in the insurance industry, we’ve honed in on our strengths and perfected our processes, resulting in the best possible experience for the advisors we serve. We invite you to learn more about us and discover the “DBS Difference” for yourself! NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. NFP is an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers who help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. This position exists to provide DBS with a dedicated resource focused on acquiring and growing relationships with new individual brokers, producer groups and national accounts as well as growing relationships with existing brokers, producer groups and national accounts. This is an independent contributor role with no direct reports. The focus is on providing direction on production goals, account status, trends, and marketing initiatives. This will be accomplished by gaining and maintaining a deep understanding of the client organization’s wants, needs, and processes. We work with insurance agents, brokers, and financial advisors across the country to help them secure life insurance products for their clients who want to protect their families or their businesses. We take pride in the fact that we are directly responsible for insuring thousands of people nationwide as one of the leading distributors of life insurance in the nation. The Regional Sales Director will drive growth in an established, high-performing territory covering the Mid Atlantic. The ideal candidate will have a strong life insurance background and experience in wholesale and point-of-sale strategies. They will be supported by an experienced internal team and have the opportunity to contribute to one of the nation’s most established and successful brokerage agencies. This is a fully remote with travel opportunity that offers a competitive base salary of $75,000 + overrides, with top performers capable of earning $250,000+ annually. Travel within the assigned region is required approximately 40% of the time to engage with clients, attend industry events, and actively drive business expansion. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: This job description is not intended to be a complete and exhaustive statement of the requirements of the job. It is more representative of what is typical of this job. Implement key account strategies and processes with all accounts. Gold sheet, action plan, and strategic marketing plan Develop existing broker/account relationships and manage recruiting for new broker/accounts Regularly communicate the status of your accounts to the DBS team; keeping them informed of pertinent issues, especially during the onboarding process Continued development of industry, concept, carrier, and product knowledge Contribute to the overall success and profitability of the agency Meet or exceed acquired and assigned account production goals Implement key account strategies and processes with all accounts including Gold Sheet, action plan, and strategic marketing plan Regularly communicate the status of your accounts to the DBS team, keeping them informed of pertinent issues, especially during the onboarding process Continued development of industry, concept, carrier, and product knowledge Education and/or Experience: Past sales and relationship management experience in the life insurance industry required FINRA: Series 6 or 7, and 63 is required College degree or other higher education preferred Life and Health License Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Leadership, organizational skills, people skills, flexibility, team orientation, ability to travel, ability to manage a budget, good written and oral communication, ability to plan and prioritize Team Participation: Must work effectively in a diverse group of people as a team member Must have the ability to travel within assigned region approximately 40-50% (typically, same-day or short overnight trips and others as required) MS Office Suite and Salesforce (or similar CRM), Concur (or related expense management) required Able to quickly learn new business/communications systems and technologies Ability to communicate in a professional manner High focus on quality and customer satisfaction Flexible and able to react to change in a productive and positive manner Strong work ethic and ability to work with a sense of urgency Ensures that all DBS customers are provided service that is complete, accurate, prompt, confidential, and courteous What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $64,000 to $75,000 plus overrides, with top performers capable of earning $250,000+ annually. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-JS3 #LI-JS3 #NFP REGIO015287

Job.JobTitle: Commercial Lines, Account Manager (remote-PST, MT, CST)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Summary: The Commercial Lines Account Manager is responsible for working with Producers to service their client accounts. This is a generalist book of coverages with special emphasis on trucking and transportation clients. The position requires day-to-day client servicing for a specific set of clients and entails verbal, electronic and other written communications. The Account Manager will manage an assigned book of business, handling endorsements, binding policies, setting up financing, issuing certificates, billing, and responding to requests and questions from the insured and underwriters. You will also be involved in the renewal and marketing process, preparing proposals, obtaining signed applications, securing payment, and putting bind paperwork together. Work is completed with a significant amount of independent discretion. While in this role, you should be developing relationships with clients and carrier contacts and working proactively to efficiently and effectively respond to their needs. This is a full-time remote position working in either PST, MT or CST time zone. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Works proactively to develop relationships with carrier and client contacts and takes an active role in meetings. Bind and endorse policies, issue certificates, bill invoices, request payments, and have contact with all assigned clients verbally and by email regularly. Communicates directly with clients and carriers to obtain accurate information to market renewals. Prepare and send the request for renewal quotations to applicable insurance carriers and propose to insured. Duties also include quoting policy changes, facilitating financing, collecting additional premium and down payments and ensuring carrier payments are received. Responsible for updating and keeping client policy records in the agency management system. Answers incoming calls and emails, responding to client questions as needed. Follows up on suspense items and outstanding information. Other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Highly organized with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-confident to make sound independent decisions. Ability to successfully interact with diverse groups of people and function well both in a team environment and autonomously. Ability to handle situations in a calm, courteous and professional manner. Aim to deliver excellence in customer servicing and cultivate effective relationships. Intermediate level of experience in Microsoft Office products, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook Experience and adaptability with Copilot or similar AI tools. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks to meet deliverables. Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Sharp attention to detail, decision-making skills, and problem resolution Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities, deadlines and technology. When working from home, you must maintain a private workspace to secure company equipment and correspondence; maintain high-speed internet, be present and responsive online and minimize personal interruptions during your work shift. Education and/or Experience: Prior client service and/or industry and product line experience. Experience with transportation/trucking clients is ideal Property & Casualty Broker’s License required upon hire Bachelor’s degree preferred; High School Diploma or equivalent required. 3+ years of industry experience with a strong background in commercial insurance Prior retail brokerage experience required. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $60,000 - 75,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2590513

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary: The Associate Account Manager is responsible for working with Advisors/Client Executives and Account Executives to service client accounts. The position requires supporting them in the day to day account management for a specific set of clients and entails a great deal of verbal, electronic and other written communications. The Associate Account Manager will work with senior team members to manage the renewal and marketing process and prepare materials for presentations and communications. While in this role, this person will begin to learn to manage a book of business under senior team member direction and begin to develop relationships with clients and carrier contacts and work proactively to effectively and efficiently deliver services to clients. In this role, the Associate Account Manager is learning to manage the clients from start to finish, but requires a great deal of supervision and direction from more senior team members. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Begins to develop relationships; attend meetings and may contribute. Works with senior team members to prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. Begins to participate in reviewing proposals and carrier source documents for accuracy under the direction of the Account Executive or Advisor. Creates and maintains client files in accordance with office procedures. May be responsible for keeping client policy records in the agency management system. Assists on some billing questions from clients and insurance company personnel with assistance from Accounting Dept. when necessary. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Highly organized with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-confident to make sound independent decisions Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people and function well both in a team environment and autonomously. Ability to handle situations in a calm, courteous and professional manner Customer focused to establish and maintain effective relationships Intermediate level of experience in Microsoft Office products, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook Ability to prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines Must be able to read, analyze and reconcile financial reports Possess strong analytical and problem solving skills Sharp attention to detail, decision making skills, and problem resolution Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities, deadlines and technology. Education and/or Experience: Associates degree (or equivalent) and BA/BS preferred More than 3 years’ client service and/or industry and product line experience. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Appropriately licensed or ability to obtain licensing if required What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $48,000 to $80,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-JS3 #LI-HYBRID #LI-REMOTE #LI-LL1 #NFP ASSOC015483

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com Summary: The VP, Team Lead, Commercial Risk is a senior leader responsible for leading and developing an Account Management team while providing strategic oversight of a portfolio of high-value and complex Commercial Lines Property & Casualty clients. The role combines people leadership, client strategy, business growth, and operational excellence to drive strong client and business outcomes. The VP serves as a senior resource to Account Executives, Producers, clients, and internal leadership, providing strategic direction on complex accounts, strengthening client relationships, and identifying opportunities for retention and revenue growth. The role is also responsible for developing Account Executives to become increasingly strategic, proactive, and growth-oriented in managing client relationships. This role is ideal for an experienced people leader or a high-performing Senior Account Executive ready to take the next step in their career. It offers the opportunity to leverage deep client management expertise while expanding your impact through leadership, coaching, talent development, and team success. Work Schedule: This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Albany, NY, requiring an in-office presence three days per week to foster collaboration, professional development, and strong partnerships across teams. The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Leadership & Talent Development Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives, providing clear expectations, ongoing feedback, and development support. Establish accountability for client service, retention, relationship management, and execution across the team. Develop Account Executives to become increasingly strategic, consultative, proactive, and growth-oriented in their client relationships. Monitor team workload, capacity, account assignments, and resource needs to support effective client service and business growth. Partner with colleagues on career development, skill building, and succession planning to strengthen the Account Management talent pipeline. Provide technical and strategic guidance on complex accounts, coverage issues, renewal strategies, and challenging client situations. Foster collaboration across Account Management, Production, Broking, and other internal resources to deliver coordinated client solutions. Serve as a senior leader within the office and contribute to broader client strategy, growth priorities, service standards, and business initiatives. Client Strategy & Relationship Management Maintain strategic oversight of a portfolio of high-value and complex Commercial Lines Property & Casualty clients, with accountability for retention, relationship development, and growth. Develop and execute comprehensive client strategies addressing coverage objectives, risk considerations, service needs, renewal priorities, and long-term business goals. Serve as a senior escalation point and trusted advisor for complex, sensitive, or high-risk client matters. Lead or participate in strategic client meetings, including renewal, stewardship, relationship, and difficult client discussions. Build and maintain meaningful relationships with key client decision-makers and senior stakeholders. Provide senior-level guidance on coverage strategy, risk management, market conditions, and emerging trends. Ensure client teams deliver accurate, timely, consistent, and high-quality work aligned with client expectations. Growth & Business Development Drive retention and revenue growth by strengthening existing client relationships and identifying opportunities for new business, cross-sell, upsell, and account expansion. Partner closely with Producers to identify client needs and develop strategies that expand relationships and increase revenue opportunities. Support new business opportunities by contributing strategic and technical expertise to prospect strategy, market positioning, presentations, and client discussions. Build and leverage strong carrier relationships to support effective market strategies and competitive client solutions. Encourage Account Executives to recognize and develop growth opportunities within their client portfolios. Operational & Strategic Leadership Drive consistency and effectiveness in account management, renewal, marketing, and client service processes. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, client deliverables, team efficiency, and the overall client experience. Partner with office, regional, and national leadership on initiatives that strengthen Account Management practices and client service standards. Contribute subject matter expertise to the development and enhancement of tools, resources, standards, and best practices. Use business and client information to identify trends, risks, resource needs, and opportunities and translate those insights into appropriate action. PeopleFirst Leadership At NFP, our PeopleFirst approach is central to how we lead our teams and serve our clients. The VP is expected to foster an inclusive, respectful, collaborative, and accountable environment where colleagues feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed. As a people leader, the VP provides clear direction and expectations while maintaining a strong focus on coaching, development, engagement, and professional growth. The VP encourages open communication, recognizes and develops individual strengths, addresses performance concerns appropriately, and builds a team culture focused on shared accountability, collaboration, client excellence, and growth. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 10+ years of Commercial Lines Property & Casualty experience desired, including significant experience with complex or high-value accounts. Demonstrated leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, developing, and providing direction to Account Management professionals. Demonstrated ability to manage sophisticated client relationships while providing leadership and strategic guidance across a broader portfolio of business. Strong technical knowledge of Commercial Lines coverage, risk management, carrier markets, placement strategy, and account management practices. Proven ability to strengthen client relationships and identify opportunities for retention and revenue growth. Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with Producers, Account Executives, senior leadership, clients, carrier partners, and cross-functional teams. Strong business acumen with the ability to balance client needs, business objectives, growth opportunities, and team priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively to executive-level audiences. Advanced strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. Strong judgment and ability to navigate complex client, coverage, market, operational, and people-related situations. Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining responsiveness, attention to detail, and a sense of urgency. Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, accountability, and commitment to client service excellence. Proficiency in Microsoft Office products, including Word and Excel; experience with agency management systems, with EPIC preferred. Certificates, Licenses, Registration Property & Casualty Insurance License required. Professional insurance designation such as CIC, CISR, CPCU, CRM, or AAI preferred What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $150,000 – $200,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-JS3 #LI-JS3 #N AVP00015456

Job.JobTitle: Regional Sales Director, California & Hawaii (Life Ins. and Related Products)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: Diversified Brokerage Services (part of NFP, an Aon company) is one of the largest brokerage general agencies in the United States specializing in life insurance, and we’re proud of our roots, starting as a family run business in 1968 and growing to where we are today. With over 50 years in the insurance industry, we’ve honed in on our strengths and perfected our processes, resulting in the best possible experience for the advisors we serve. We invite you to learn more about us and discover the “DBS Difference” for yourself! We’re part of NFP, a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. NFP is an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers who help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. This position exists to provide DBS with a dedicated resource focused on acquiring and growing relationships with new individual brokers, producer groups and national accounts as well as growing relationships with existing brokers, producer groups and national accounts. This is an independent contributor role with no direct reports. The focus is on providing direction on production goals, account status, trends, and marketing initiatives. This will be accomplished by gaining and maintaining a deep understanding of the client organization’s wants, needs, and processes. We work with insurance agents, brokers, and financial advisors across the country to help them secure life insurance products for their clients who want to protect their families or their businesses. We take pride in the fact that we are directly responsible for insuring thousands of people nationwide as one of the leading distributors of life insurance in the nation. The Regional Sales Director will drive growth in an established, high-performing territory covering California (Orange County & Los Angeles) and Hawaii. The ideal candidate will have a strong life insurance background and experience in wholesale and point-of-sale strategies. They will be supported by an experienced internal team and have the opportunity to contribute to one of the nation’s most established and successful brokerage agencies. This is a fully remote with travel opportunity that offers a competitive base salary of $75,000 + overrides, with top performers capable of earning $250,000+ annually. Travel within the assigned region is required approximately 40% of the time to engage with clients, attend industry events, and actively drive business expansion. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: This job description is not intended to be a complete and exhaustive statement of the requirements of the job. It is more representative of what is typical of this job. Implement key account strategies and processes with all accounts. Gold sheet, action plan, and strategic marketing plan Develop existing broker/account relationships and manage recruiting for new broker/accounts Regularly communicate the status of your accounts to the DBS team; keeping them informed of pertinent issues, especially during the onboarding process Continued development of industry, concept, carrier, and product knowledge Contribute to the overall success and profitability of the agency Meet or exceed acquired and assigned account production goals Implement key account strategies and processes with all accounts including Gold Sheet, action plan, and strategic marketing plan Regularly communicate the status of your accounts to the DBS team, keeping them informed of pertinent issues, especially during the onboarding process Continued development of industry, concept, carrier, and product knowledge Education and/or Experience: Past sales and relationship management experience in the life insurance industry required FINRA: Series 6 or 7, or 63 is required College degree or other higher education preferred Life and Health License Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Leadership, organizational skills, people skills, flexibility, team orientation, ability to travel, ability to manage a budget, good written and oral communication, ability to plan and prioritize Team Participation: Must work effectively in a diverse group of people as a team member Must have the ability to travel within assigned region approximately 40-50% (typically, same-day or short overnight trips and others as required) MS Office Suite and Salesforce (or similar CRM), Concur (or related expense management) required Able to quickly learn new business/communications systems and technologies Ability to communicate in a professional manner High focus on quality and customer satisfaction Flexible and able to react to change in a productive and positive manner Strong work ethic and ability to work with a sense of urgency Ensures that all DBS customers are provided service that is complete, accurate, prompt, confidential, and courteous What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $64,000 to $75,000 plus overrides, with top performers capable of earning $250,000+ annually. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #NFP 2584757

Job.JobTitle: 2027 IT / Cybersecurity Engineer Intern - Chicago, IL
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description About the Company: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services - empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Internship Program Overview: Our 10-week Summer Internship Program provides an opportunity to learn about the practices that safeguard the firm’s systems, data, and technology infrastructure. The intern will collaborate with colleagues across Technology, Risk, and the business to learn how security best practices are applied, risks are mitigated, and business objectives are supported while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements. Location: Chicago, IL Key responsibilities include: Support the Cybersecurity team with monitoring systems and reviewing security alerts. Assist with identifying, documenting, and escalating potential security threats or vulnerabilities. Participate in incident response activities and help maintain accurate incident documentation. Support security assessments, testing, and remediation tracking. Assist with maintaining cybersecurity policies, procedures, and technical documentation. Collaborate with Technology, Risk, and business teams on cybersecurity initiatives. Conduct research on emerging threats, security trends, and industry best practices. Help promote cybersecurity awareness and support compliance with regulatory requirements. Complete additional cybersecurity projects and assignments throughout the internship. Lift and carry materials weighing up to 25 pounds, with reasonable accommodations available to support the performance of essential job functions. Qualifications: Preferably a rising senior pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field Strong interest in cybersecurity, technology risk, and information security. Excellent attention to detail Strong organizational and prioritization skills Problem solving skillset, paired with the ability to handle multiple projects at one time Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities. The summer internship experience provides interns with meaningful exposure to the financial services industry. Job.JobTitle: Personal Risk- Client Exec./Sales Advisor (Central Region remote)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Summary: This is a full-time role offering a hybrid schedule from one of our Central Region offices. Comprehensive experience with P&C markets in the region is required. Some travel within the region is expected. We will consider remote candidates who are experienced in the regional market and able to meet all deliverables and travel requirements. The Personal Risk Client Executive/Sales Advisor is P&C licensed and experienced in all facets of Personal Insurance, including proven sales skills. This New Business Department is a sales team whose primary role is to advise and deliver personal insurance products tailored to the specific needs of the prospective insured. In this role, you will be provided with leads from any/all non-solicited personal new business opportunities and or referrals presented to NFP. The expedited process of a Client Executive/Sales Advisor is conducted through a single-point-of-contact process, ensuring efficiency for the prospective insured while providing advice and creating an educated buying experience. Strong computer skills along with effective verbal, written and electronic communications are required. You should be able to perform within a team environment and build long-lasting relationships with agency partners, company leadership and staff. How this benefits you: You control the sale from start to finish, which means you control the client experience. You’re not dependent on a Producer to close or bind business. You stay focused on new business, not service work. You build deep carrier relationships, strengthening your placement expertise. You operate with autonomy, backed by a strong service infrastructure. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Understand various Carrier Appetites and Carrier Websites. Work closely with Carrier Underwriters to determine risk placement. Utilize agency management system, rating system and carrier websites to provide accurate, timely quotes. Complete policy correspondence delivery according to agency guidelines and procedures. Build and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, supervisors, and carrier representatives. Assist with special projects as assigned by management. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Experience in P&C Personal Lines client-facing sales, along with knowledge of coverage needs. Comprehensive experience with P&C markets, ideally in the Central Region. Demonstrated experience with related carriers such as Travelers, Safeco, Progressive, AutoOwners. Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs. Effective time management and decision-making skills. Strong leadership and diligent follow-through skills. Ability to negotiate and express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications. Proficiency in MS Office suite, CRM- EPIC preferred, MS Teams. Influential presentation and public speaking abilities. Self-confident to make sound independent decisions. Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people/personalities. Ability to travel, approx. 5% within the Central region Education and/or Experience: A bachelor’s degree preferred. HS Diploma or GED is required with additional learning/certifications More than 3 years of licensed Personal Lines related industry sales and service experience Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Property & Casualty Broker’s License required upon hire CPCU, CPRIA, CAPI or other P&C designation preferred What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $55,000 to $75,000. Compensation will also include 40% commission on new business. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #li-js3 #LI-JS3 How we support our colleagues In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. #linkedintag #NFP CLIEN015504

Posting Description Who We Are: Lenox Advisors is a premier MassMutual agency supporting a network of financial professionals who provide insurance, investment, and financial planning solutions to clients nationwide. As part of NFP, an Aon company, we offer the resources of a large organization while maintaining the culture and agility of a high-performing agency. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional advisor support, effective supervision, and operational excellence that drive business growth and client confidence. The Asset Management Associate (AMA) serves as the central contact for running operations and achieving goals within Lenox’s asset management division. Based on a team approach, AMAs’ daily duties include liaising with a variety of internal and external parties, and must maintain the highest level of organization and communication skills. Lenox Relationship Managers (Financial Advisors), Lenox Asset Management’s Sales Team (Asset Managers), and end-clients all rely on the AMA role to assist with new and existing business across led portfolios, fixed annuities and variable annuities. Essential Duties and Responsabilities: Assist new clients through the new relationship onboarding process. Understand what paperwork is needed for every new account by investment and account type when a new account request is made. Connect with clients, Relationship Managers, Asset Managers, Vendors, and MMLISI (broker-dealer) during the new account onboarding process. Acts as liaison between Asset Managers and other business partners and subsidiaries to ensure that high quality and comprehensive client service is provided to our clients in accordance with defined parameters. Client service includes client calls, transaction processing and the accurate recording in our proprietary CRM (Mosaic), inquiry response/research and account maintenance. Be able to quickly identify complex requests regarding investment accounts, contributions and distributions, policies and procedures, and promptly escalate to Lenox Asset Management Leadership when necessary. Lead all additional deposits and withdrawals from clients’ existing accounts through submission, tracking, and communicating with customers, relationship advisors, asset specialists, and vendors. Inclusive of expediting all wire transfers, distributions, withdrawals, ACAT’s, portfolio rebalancing, and redemption requests. Generate client proposals with the direction of Relationship Managers and/or Asset Managers. Cultivate a developing understanding of the various investment programs offered by Lenox and provide assistance in regularly updating internal marketing platforms (Lenox Intranet) with timely marketing materials. Directly support VP, Operations Manager in the completion of special projects as required. Develop relationships with Lenox vendors in order to facilitate the maintenance of clients’ accounts. Serve as an operational resource to Relationship Managers directly conducting Asset Management business without the assisted involvement of an Asset Manager. Develop expertise in advancing broker-dealer technology concerning the process of integrating new client accounts and reporting. AMAs are accountable for maintaining best-of-breed knowledge on system functionality within various teTechnology platforms. Current responsibilities include Lenox’s internally developed CRM tool (Mosaic), A360, ProGen, WealthScape, Envestnet, Tamarac, RightBridge, Broadridge and DST Vision. Become proficient in evolving custodian technology inclusive of Charles Schwab, Fidelity, National Financial Services (NFS), and more. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Experience: Solid understanding of equity and bond markets, trusts, and laws pertaining to security transfers. MOSAIC: Basic skills such as tasking and arrays. More sophisticated proficiencies involving Net Flow Reporting and Running the event process. Maintaining positive working relationships with client’s and Relationship Managers Learns systems & job procedures quickly and crafts a way to prioritize workload efficiently and optimally handle job responsibilities. Anticipates possible problems and develops contingency plans in advance and quickly identifies the central or underlying issues in a sophisticated situation. Proactive; Self-Starter with the ability to think on their feet. Views problems as opportunities to improve processes and make things better. Has a strong sense of urgency about solving problems and getting work done and genuinely cares about delivering a positive service experience Education and/or Experience: 1-3 years prior investment/client relationship/sales experience Familiar with sophisticated investment solutions specifically built for high net worth individuals and be proficient in the development of asset allocation strategies What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $70,000 – $85,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP and Lenox Advisors is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #NFP 2589556

Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services - empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,400 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first - our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. JOB DESCRIPTION Wealthspire Advisors is in search of a Wealth Advisor. This position entails collaborating with other members of the team to assist with the wealth management and financial planning needs of our high net-worth clients and their families. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and/or support other advisors in the management of client engagements. Determine appropriate client allocations through analysis of investment objectives, risk tolerance, net worth, income, and investment experience, or other knowledge. Execute investment and planning activities (e.g. rebalancing portfolios, money movements, required minimum distributions, tax loss harvesting, charitable planning, lending evaluation, education funding, etc.). Actively service client accounts by performing and/or coordinating administrative tasks (e.g. tracking and monitoring account/asset transfers, preparing and presenting performance reports, processing transaction requests as directed, handling necessary paperwork for accounts, etc.). Initiate and field client calls on various topics and miscellaneous requests (e.g. account specific questions, general inquiries regarding portfolios, investment market discussions, planning items, money movements, etc.). Assist with the development of client financial plans using financial planning software and present results and solutions to clients. Monitor client investments, review performance, and suggest changes to client portfolios as appropriate. Prepare for and attend client meetings and manage and/or complete all meeting follow-up activities. Create proposals for prospective clients. Coordinate with clients’ attorneys, accountants, and other professionals as needed. Develop and maintain working knowledge of various financial planning concepts, such as gift, estate and income tax planning, insurance, credit solutions, education funding, charitable/philanthropic strategies, etc. Pursue professional development opportunities to include additional licenses and/or designations, and actively participate in internal and external training sessions and networking events. REQUIREMENTS Minimum 5 years of wealth management experience (other or additional experience will be considered). CFP designation required. Ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple projects. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to effectively manage task lists. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Flexible team player who is highly adaptable to change and open to new ideas. Ability to think creatively. Reliable, follows through on commitments. Personal integrity and professional initiative. Previous supervisory experience managing teams is a plus. Strong problem-solving and influence/consensus-building skills. Strong communication and organizational skills. Ability to work through questions and concerns collaboratively Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM, portfolio management and financial planning software is a plus. Bachelor’s degree or higher preferably in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, law or related experience. REQUIRED: Strategic Consulting - Expert; Client Relationship Management - Advanced; Customer Relationship Management (CRM) - Expert; Market Research - Advanced; Meeting Facilitation - Advanced; Portfolio Management - Advanced; Project Management - Advanced; Quality of Service (QoS) - Advanced OPTIONAL: Sales - Expert; Business Development - Intermediate; Financial Services - Experienced; Investment Management - Experienced; Investments - Experienced; Process Improvements - Advanced; Risk Management - Experienced What We Offer: Wealthspire is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, and more. The base salary range for this position is $126,000 –$154,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #Wealthspire 2589493

Posting Description Wealthspire Institutional brings together a network of affiliated firms that provides institutional advisory, wealth management, institutional advisory, and business management services to individuals, families, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Through its specialized subsidiaries and affiliates, clients can access wealth management, retirement plan consulting, nonprofit endowment and foundation advisory, business management, and family office services tailored to their evolving financial needs. Wealthspire invests in the people, technology, and resources that expand what the firm can do for clients, while preserving the personal relationships and accountability that are central to its client service approach. Inspiring Trust. Enriching Lives. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Role Overview: The RFP (Request for Proposal) Team Analyst plays a key role in supporting the business development and client acquisition processes by creating compelling, accurate, and timely responses to RFPs and RFIs (Request for Information). This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while collaborating with subject matter experts and sales teams. The role will also require skills to present reports to clients in a committee meeting. Key Responsibilities: RFP Analysis: Prepare, edit, and deliver high-quality RFP and RFI benchmarking reports for clients in the 401(k) plan industry. Project Management: Manage the end-to-end RFP process, ensuring deadlines are met and deliverables are accurate and client-focused. Collaboration: Work closely with Plan Advisors, sales teams, and subject matter experts to gather necessary information. Quality Assurance: Review and proofread RFPs to ensure clarity, accuracy, and compliance with client requirements. Market Research: Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and regulatory changes in the retirement plan industry. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the RFP process. Qualifications: Experience: 2-4 years of experience working in the retirement industry. Preferred experience working on an RFP team analyzing pricing, service platforms and other relevant information. Skills: Strong editing, and proofreading abilities. Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Experience with RFP software tools is a plus Proficient mathematical skills. Knowledge: Familiarity with 401(k) plans, retirement plan services, and industry terminology is preferred. Key Competencies: Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyze complex information and present it clearly. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines effectively. Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Why Join Us: Professional Growth: Opportunities for career development and industry-specific training. Collaborative Environment: Work with a team of dedicated professionals who value teamwork and innovation. Impactful Work: Contribute to the growth and success of the firm by supporting client acquisition efforts. Benefits: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and work-life balance support. Wealthspire is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, and more. The base salary range for this position is $58,500–$71,500. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. #Wealthspire 2589993

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary: The Associate Account Manager (AAM) is a developmental role designed to build the foundational skills, technical & process knowledge, and client-facing service experience required to progress into an Account Manager position. Working under the guidance of Account Managers and Account Executives, the Associate Account Manager supports account servicing activities through coordination, documentation, follow-up and quality review or work completed across Shared Services, including the National Center of Excellence and the Global Capability Center. The AAM will also be expected to conduct relationship-building and strategic advisory responsibilities under the supervision and guidance of an Account Manager. This is a full-time position offering the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule, available from any of the following office locations: NY: Albany, Amherst, Kingston, Rochester, Pittsford or Fishkill or our office in Danbury, Connecticut. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Supports Account Managers and Account Executives in the execution of day-to-day client service activities, while building knowledge of client needs, policy administration, renewal processes, and service workflows Assists in the preparation and coordination of client materials, coordinating with Shared Services to facilitate the completion of transactional work Reviews work for accuracy, completeness, and client readiness before delivery, escalating questions or issues to Account Managers as appropriate Maintains client documentation in accordance with internal standards and systems Participates in client and internal meeting as appropriate to build understanding of account management and client servicing Develops basic understanding of the triage frameworks for complexity and / or urgency, and develops understanding of the Shared Services (GCCs and National COEs) delivery model Establish foundational knowledge of building and maintaining relationships with clients and carriers Completes training and development activities aligned to progression into an Account Manager role Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Strong interest in pursuing a career in Commercial Lines Insurance Account Management Ability to build relationships with clients, carriers, and internal partners. Analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to review and interpret policy documents, carrier correspondence, and insurance-related financial information. Strong customer service mindset and commitment to delivering exceptional client experiences. Ability to learn and effectively utilize Applied EPIC and other agency management systems Education and/or Experience: Associate’s degree or equivalent required; BA/BS preferred. 1-3 years of client service experience within the insurance industry or a related field preferred; exposure to commercial insurance products, policy administration, or account servicing is highly desirable. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Property & Casualty License preferred or able to obtain within 60 days What We Offer: NFP is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO and paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health and wellness programs, and more. Our people-first culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $55,000 – $70,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #NFP 2588345

We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. We’re looking for a Vice President, Surety to join our team. This role is responsible for strategic relationship management, retention of clients and production of new opportunities when presented. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Demonstrate a broad understanding of surety products and coverages. Supervise and manage the New York State Surety market for NFP preferably operating out of the Albany office. Responsible for managing the overall relationship with assigned surety clients including developing and engaging multiple relationships throughout and within the client organization. Posting Description Who We Are: We are a newly independent wealth management firm, with approximately $500 million in revenue, recently carved out from a larger parent company and acquired by a leading private equity sponsor. With a strong foundation of client relationships, acquisitions, and growth potential, we are in the process of standing up new systems, processes, and controls to support our next phase of expansion. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the tax infrastructure of a high-growth platform from the ground up. Summary: Wealthspire Advisors is in search of a Wealth Advisor . This position entails collaborating with other members of the team to serve the wealth management and financial planning needs of our high net-worth clients and their families. Responsibilities Lead and/or support other advisors in the management of client engagements. Determine appropriate client allocations through analysis of investment objectives, risk tolerance, net worth, income, and investment experience, or other knowledge. Execute investment and planning activities (e.g., rebalancing portfolios, money movements, required minimum distributions, tax loss harvesting, charitable planning, lending evaluation, education funding, etc.). Monitor client investments, review performance, and suggest changes to client portfolios as appropriate. Actively service client accounts by performing and/or coordinating administrative tasks (e.g. tracking and monitoring account/asset transfers, preparing and presenting performance reports, processing transaction requests as directed, handling necessary paperwork for accounts, etc.). Initiate and field client calls on various topics and miscellaneous requests (e.g., account specific questions, general inquiries regarding portfolios, investment market discussions, planning items, money movements, etc.). Assist with the development of client financial plans using financial planning software and present results and solutions to clients. Prepare for and attend client meetings and manage and/or complete all meeting follow-up activities. Create proposals for prospective clients. Coordinate with clients’ attorneys, accountants, and other professionals as needed. Develop and maintain working knowledge of various financial planning concepts, such as gift, estate and income tax planning, insurance, credit solutions, education funding, charitable/philanthropic strategies, etc. Pursue professional development opportunities to include additional licenses and/or designations and actively participate in internal and external training sessions and networking events. Deepen existing client relationships; seek client referrals. Participate in community outreach, networking, and marketing activities to drive new business opportunities. Leverage local centers of influence to extend referral network. Provide ongoing training and serve as a mentor to advisory staff. Requirements Minimum 10+ years of wealth management experience (other or additional experience will be considered). CFP other wealth management designation highly preferred. Ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple projects. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to effectively manage task lists. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Flexible team player who is highly adaptable to change and open to new ideas. Ability to think creatively. Reliable, follows through on commitments. Personal integrity and professional initiative. Previous supervisory experience managing teams is a plus. Strong problem-solving and influence/consensus-building skills. Strong communication and organizational skills. Ability to work through questions and concerns collaboratively. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM, portfolio management and financial planning software is a plus. Bachelor’s degree or higher preferably in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, law, or related experience. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, and more. The base salary range for this position is $204,400 – $347,500. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #Wealthspire . 2584321
