Job.JobTitle: Private Client Group, Account Manager (MN - hybrid)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: P&C Private Client Group (PCG/affluent lines) is a division of NFP Property & Casualty. We are a retail operation for affluent and wealthy individuals and families seeking personal lines products in the United States, parts of Europe, and Canada. Our headquarters are in New York City with offices across the country - specializing in insurance ranging from homeowners and auto to specialty lines, such as aircraft and watercraft. The Account Manager is responsible for working with Advisors/Client Executives and Account Executives to service client accounts. The position requires day-to-day client servicing for a specific set of clients and entails a great deal of verbal, electronic and other written communications. You will manage the renewal and marketing process and prepare materials for presentations and communications, partnering with more senior team members. Work is completed with a significant amount of independent discretion. While in this role, you will be developing relationships with clients and carrier contacts and working proactively to effectively and efficiently deliver services to clients. In addition to managing your own clients, you may also continue to support the Account Management Team as assigned. We offer the flexibility of a hybrid schedule in our Minneapolis, MN office. Working in the office is essential for fostering collaboration and career connections. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Works proactively to build relationships with carrier and client contacts; takes an active role in meetings. Prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. Prepare the first draft of the renewal presentation. Takes the lead on reviewing proposals and carrier source documents for accuracy in collaboration with the Account Executive or Advisor/Client Executive. Begins to communicate directly with clients and carriers, with approval from the Account Executive or Advisor/Client Executive. Creates and maintains client documents in accordance with office procedures. Keep client policy records in the agency management system. Utilize agency management system, rating system, and carrier websites. The first line of answering billing questions from clients and insurance company personnel. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Highly organized with excellent verbal and written communication skills Self-confident to make sound independent decisions Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people and function well both in a team environment and autonomously Ability to handle situations in a calm, courteous and professional manner Customer focused to establish and maintain effective relationships Intermediate level of experience in Microsoft Office products, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook Ability to prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines Must be able to read, analyze and reconcile financial reports Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills Sharp attention to detail, decision-making skills, and problem resolution Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities, deadlines and technology Education and/or Experience: Ideally 3-5 years of Personal Lines client service experience. Must include experience with an insurance brokerage or agency Demonstrated experience in relevant lines of coverage and running a book of business Demonstrated experience with related carriers such as Travelers, Safeco, Progressive, AutoOwners Fluency with EPIC or similar agency management system Associate's Degree (or equivalent) or BA/BS preferred. HS Diploma or equivalent with additional education/training required Certificates, Licenses, Registration: P&C Insurance License is required upon hire What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $60,000 – $80,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #NFP 2589295

Job.JobTitle: 2027 IT / AI Engineer Intern - Chicago, IL
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description About the Company: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services - empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first - our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Internship Program Overview: Our 10-week Summer Internship Program provides hands-on experience with modern software engineering, offering exposure to both development and infrastructure. As an intern, you will work alongside the engineering team on meaningful projects and gain insight into how code moves from concept to production in a secure, reliable, and repeatable way. You will contribute to development activities while building practical skills in scalable engineering practices that support efficient delivery and operational reliability. This opportunity is designed to help you develop production-relevant experience and a strong understanding of how business priorities are transformed into secure, sustainable technology solutions. Location: Chicago, IL Key responsibilities include: Support the design, development, testing, and implementation of software and AI-enabled solutions under the guidance of experienced engineers. Contribute to meaningful projects that address business needs and improve operational efficiency. Assist with writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting code while following established development standards and best practices. Participate in data preparation, model testing, and the evaluation of AI tools or solutions, as applicable. Support the integration and deployment of applications across development and production environments. Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams to understand requirements and deliver practical technology solutions. Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including project updates, testing results, and process guides. Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing opportunities throughout the internship. Lift and carry materials weighing up to 25 pounds, with reasonable accommodations available to support the performance of essential job functions. Qualifications: Preferably a rising senior pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Strong interest in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies. Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript. Basic understanding of software development concepts, data structures, algorithms, APIs, databases, or cloud technologies. Exposure to AI, machine learning, automation, or data analysis through coursework, academic projects, or prior experience is preferred. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with close attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a team environment. Ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to handle confidential or sensitive information with professionalism and discretion. Prior internship or project experience is a plus but not required. The summer internship experience provides interns with meaningful exposure to the financial services industry. Interns will gain experience in IT/AI function, while building valuable skills for a successful career. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list! We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences! The hourly range for this position is $20.00 – $22.00 per hour. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #Wealthspire 2590532

Posting Description Who We Are NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Covala Group (part of NFP, an Aon company) is a proven enroller and administrator of voluntary, supplemental and individual disability benefits for large employers. Since 1993 we have connected employees of our clients to over $4.5 billion of income protection. We have also assisted Fortune 500 companies in the development and implementation of group life insurance, corporate owned life insurance, and long-term care programs. Our name, Covala, was inspired by the covalent bond, the strongest type of chemical bond there is. Covala embodies our dedication to forming powerful bonds with our clients and plan participants — connecting them to the benefits they need and the service they deserve. Position Summary: Covala Group is seeking a VP, Technical Product Manager to own the technology product roadmap for our Individual Disability Income (IDI) and Long-Term Care (LTC) capabilities. This role bridges business, operations, carriers and technology, translating complex insurance rules into clear, prioritized product outcomes while moving the portfolio toward scalable, reusable platforms. This is a full-time opportunity open to a hybrid work arrangement from either our New York City or Austin, TX office. Essential Functions: Own and prioritize the IDI and LTC technology roadmap, supported by business cases and measurable outcomes. Lead discovery and write requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that account for carrier, client, plan and jurisdiction differences. Guide product decisions across the full policy lifecycle, from enrollment and underwriting through servicing, billing and reporting. Partner with UX/design and engineering to deliver intuitive digital enrollment experiences. Define file-based and API carrier integration requirements and establish repeatable integration approaches. Define data, migration and reporting requirements, including Power BI reporting for clients, operations and leadership. Manage the product backlog and releases, surfacing dependencies and risks early. Communicate priorities, trade-offs and progress to executive, business and technical stakeholders. Required Skills & Qualifications: 6+ years in technical product management, product ownership or a related role, owning complex enterprise products from discovery through production. Experience with AWS to Azure application migration, PHP application modernization, C#/.NET development and the SDLC using Azure DevOps. Experience managing roadmaps and backlogs while working directly with engineering, architecture, QA, UX/design and data teams. Strong understanding of APIs, system and file-based integrations, data mappings, relational data and data-intensive reporting products. Preferred Qualifications Experience modernizing legacy applications onto strategic enterprise platforms, including configurable multi-client or multi-carrier platforms. Experience with Microsoft Power BI or comparable reporting platforms. Knowledge of the insurance industry, particularly IDI and LTC products. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $165,000 – $190,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2591921

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. This role serves as a key management leader for the Construction & Infrastructure Claims Team, supporting overall team direction, operational consistency, and high-level execution across client accounts and complex claims matters. The position operates as a senior bridge between executive claims leadership and the Claims Leadership Executives and subject matter experts, helping manage team priorities, elevate service standards, and drive strategic coordination across construction-related lines of coverage. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the North American C&I Claims Leader, provide day-to-day leadership support and operational direction for the C&I Claims Team. Directly manage, train, and mentor the Construction Claims Account Executive and Subject Matter Expert Claims Analysts across all construction-related lines of coverage to strengthen technical expertise, ensure consistent service delivery, and enhance overall team performance. Serving as a technical resource to C&I Team Members and other internal stakeholders on claims-related issues, processes, and escalation matters. Provide strategic oversight of complex construction claims portfolios to ensure alignment with client objectives, risk tolerance, service expectations, and overall program performance. Supervise and support the execution of claims management strategies involving general liability, workers’ compensation, commercial auto, builders’ risk, professional liability, pollution, wrap-up, property, inland marine, surety, cyber, and subcontract default insurance exposures. Lead coverage advocacy on complex and disputed claims by directing policy analysis, challenging adverse carrier positions, coordinating supporting facts and arguments, and advancing strategies designed to maximize available coverage and claim outcomes for clients. Serve as a senior escalation point for significant, high-exposure, and complex claims matters, guiding internal teams on coverage strategy, exposure management, reserve concerns, litigation posture, and resolution planning. Coordinate with clients, producers, account management teams, carriers, TPAs, defense counsel, consultants, and other claim vendors to ensure consistent, efficient, and outcome-focused claims management across assigned accounts. Oversee large loss monitoring and significant reserve change reporting, helping determine when elevated review, client communication, or strategic intervention is necessary. Participate in and support structured claim reviews, stewardship meetings, and high-exposure roundtables focused on litigation strategy, reserve accuracy, risk mitigation, and matters with nuclear verdict potential. Review and delivery of stewardship reports, loss trend analyses, dashboards, and management reporting that provide visibility into claim performance, emerging risks, and service outcomes. Leverage data analytics and benchmarking to identify loss trends, measure program performance, and recommend strategies to reduce claim frequency, severity, and total cost of risk. Evaluate and strengthen claims reporting protocols, onboarding processes, account service plans, and client claims profiles to improve consistency, responsiveness, and execution across the team. Participate in acquisition, onboarding, renewal, and client stewardship meetings to present claims capabilities, support retention and growth efforts, and reinforce the value of the claims platform. Mentor, develop, and provide management support to team members, helping establish accountability, elevate technical performance, and promote consistent client service standards. Communicate proactively with executive leadership regarding significant claim developments, client concerns, operational challenges, staffing needs, and opportunities for continuous improvement. Maintain current knowledge of construction claim trends, coverage developments, jurisdictional issues, and market conditions affecting construction risk and claims management. Participate in special projects and provide support on broader team initiatives or cross-functional assignments as needed. Represent the organization at client meetings, industry events, and professional forums to strengthen relationships, support business development, and remain informed on relevant market developments. What We’re Looking For: Exceptional interpersonal skills capable of interacting with private equity and C-suite clients to cultivate strong relationships through effective communication and trust. Elite project management, communication, and presentation skills. Manages time effectively through excellent organization, time-management, and multi-tasking skills. Entrepreneurial attitude with a natural ability to take ownership of the overall success of client relationships. Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and results. Naturally anticipates and analyzes problems and information to proactively solve problems through critical thinking, team networking, and sound business decisions. Dedication to working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment with a commitment to operating with respect and integrity. Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Preferred qualifications: 15+ years of progressively responsible experience in construction claims or complex commercial casualty, including leadership responsibility. Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams, communicate with senior stakeholders, and manage complex client and carrier relationships. Extensive experience in construction claims, casualty claims, or complex commercial claims management, with progressive leadership responsibility. Deep working knowledge of construction-related insurance programs, coverage interpretation, claims advocacy, reserving, litigation management, and risk transfer concepts. Deep expertise in Commercial General Liability (CGL) construction claims, including catastrophic bodily injury, property damage, and completed operations. Extensive experience with OCIP/CCIP wrap‑up programs and large, complex construction placements, including multi‑line, multi‑jurisdictional programs. Broad knowledge of all major construction insurance lines (GL, excess/umbrella, WC, auto, builders risk, property, inland marine, professional, pollution, wrap‑up, surety, subcontract default, cyber as applicable). Extensive litigation management experience, including oversight of high‑severity and nuclear‑verdict‑potential claims, and collaboration with senior defense counsel. Proven track record managing and developing teams (Account Executives, SMEs, Claim Specialists) with responsibility for performance, quality, and growth. Advanced understanding and application of financial, actuarial, and reserving concepts, including portfolio‑level impact, loss triangles, and trend analysis. Demonstrated ability to evaluate claims and strategies using cost‑benefit and total cost of risk perspectives. Advanced analytical skills with experience leveraging data analytics and benchmarking to drive strategy, resource allocation, and continuous improvement. Strong strategic and operational leadership skills, including the ability to design and implement claims management protocols, governance, and best practices. Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive‑level presentation skills, with the ability to influence internal leadership, clients, and carrier partners. Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex claim facts, legal issues, and coverage considerations and clearly articulate analyses in internal reports and high‑stakes presentations. Experience leading cross‑functional initiatives and special projects across regions, practices, or product lines. Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams and accounts, while maintaining a long‑term, proactive view of business goals and client objectives. Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, drive decisions with incomplete information, and bring structure to complex operational and claim challenges. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort with dashboards, reporting tools, and other business technologies. Strong change‑management skills and a track record of adapting to and leading through evolving market, legal, and organizational environments. Bachelor’s degree required; JD preferred, particularly for roles involving complex coverage analysis, contract interpretation, and litigation management. Professional insurance designations, such as CPCU, AIC, ARM, and/or CRIS are advantageous. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $110,000 to $167,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-BW1 #LI-JS3 #LI-JS3 #NFP VPCLA015332

Summary of Job As the Senior Data Analyst at NFP, you will support Implementation Leads throughout the data conversion lifecycle, including the extraction, transformation, mapping, validation, and migration of data from legacy agency management systems to NFP's standard operating platforms. This role works closely with agencies, project teams, conversion vendors, and development resources to ensure converted data is accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with implementation achievements. Responsibilities Gather and examine data from source systems available in multiple formats. Convert this data into uniform conversion templates using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Alteryx, and other Microsoft data and analytics tools. Work directly with customers to facilitate data-related meetings, communicate requirements, track decisions, and supervise data cleanup activities through completion. Collaborate with agency partners, Implementation Leads, and Project Leads to map data from source systems to destination platforms and resolve mapping questions or data discrepancies. Prepare, analyze, and format carrier, employee, and other configuration-related data for agency review, mapping decisions, and setup within the destination agency management system. Carry out detailed validation and reconciliation of converted data through reports, queries, and conversion tools to uncover data discrepancies, conversion issues, and extra cleanup requirements. Lead data review sessions with internal teams and agency collaborators to support data quality and ensure conversion activities are completed within established timelines. Develop a strong understanding of data flows across systems, including data, documents, transactions, and messages, to support accurate conversion and issue analysis. Track conversion issues and defects through resolution, ensuring corrections are completed and subsequently validated. Identify scenarios requiring custom conversion logic or scripting, document business and data requirements, and validate the resulting converted data. Serve as a liaison with conversion vendors to communicate requirements, address conversion questions, assess impacts, and support issue resolution. Collaborate with development and technical teams to find opportunities for new or enhanced conversion tools, automation, and processes. Monitor conversion achievements, dependencies, and work progress to ensure alignment with the overall implementation project plan. Identify data quality risks, anomalies, and trends, and recommend appropriate cleanup or remediation actions. Maintain clear records of mapping decisions, validation outcomes, conversion challenges, and other essential data conversion tasks. Participate in on-site agency events during key phases of the implementation process, as required. Requirements Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Over 5 years of experience in data analysis, data transformation, data conversion, or related roles using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Alteryx, database tools, or comparable technologies. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables, VBA and data analysis techniques. Demonstrated experience analyzing large or complex datasets and identifying data quality issues, discrepancies, and patterns. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to understand source and destination data structures and translate business requirements into mapping and conversion requirements. Proven ability to prioritize multiple tasks, meet critical deadlines, and drive assigned work to completion with limited oversight. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and business priorities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead customer-facing meetings and clearly convey technical or data-related concepts to various audiences. Strong interpersonal and collaboration abilities with the capacity to work effectively across business, technical, vendor, and customer groups. High degree of personal and business integrity, accountability, initiative, and professionalism. Ability to travel ~ 10%. Ability to support occasional after-hours or weekend activities during critical conversion and implementation events. Preferred Requirements Experience within the insurance, brokerage, or agency management industry. Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server. Experience working with Microsoft Fabric, Dataflows Gen2, or comparable Microsoft data technologies. Experience with Alteryx or comparable data preparation and transformation tools. Familiarity with agency management or insurance operating systems. Experience converting or migrating data from one enterprise system to another. Experience in data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation. Experience supporting large-scale system implementations, migrations, or enterprise transformation initiatives. Experience building or employing automation to streamline data preparation, conversion, validation, and reconciliation processes. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $90,000– $120,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Surety Account Manager, Processor Team Lead Summary The Surety Account Manager is responsible for managing client relationships, overseeing surety account service activities, and providing leadership and direction to the Surety Processing team. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients, carriers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the accurate and timely issuance, renewal, and servicing of surety bonds. The Surety Account Manager drives operational excellence through workflow management, quality control, staff development, and process improvement while delivering exceptional client service and maintaining strong carrier relationships. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, surety carriers, producers, and internal business partners. Participate in client meetings and provide consultative support regarding bond programs, renewals, and service needs. Lead the review of surety proposals, bond documentation, renewal information, and carrier source documents for accuracy and completeness. Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Surety Processing team, including workflow distribution, prioritization, and quality assurance. Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to surety processors to support performance, productivity, and professional development. Monitor departmental service standards and ensure timely completion of bond issuance, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements. Manage and maintain client records, bond schedules, policy information, and supporting documentation within agency management systems and carrier portals. Review and approve bond requests, renewal processing, invoices, finance agreements, and related surety transactions. Coordinate the issuance of new and renewal bonds, including bid, performance, payment, maintenance, and miscellaneous bonds. Track bond renewals and ensure all required documentation and billing information is processed accurately and within established service timelines. Address client service issues, billing inquiries, and bond-related concerns while collaborating with carriers and internal departments as needed. Assist with process development, workflow enhancements, and operational efficiency initiatives to improve overall team performance. Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Support special projects and departmental initiatives as assigned. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong knowledge of surety bonds, bond administration processes, and surety industry practices. Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong client relationship management and customer service skills. Ability to make sound independent decisions and exercise professional judgment. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, producers, and internal teams. Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, and Outlook. Experience working with agency management systems and carrier platforms preferred. Ability to adapt to changing priorities, processes, and technology. Education and Experience Associate's degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor's degree preferred. 3+ years of insurance industry experience, including surety account management, surety operations, or related client service experience. Previous leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience preferred. Experience managing bond issuance, renewals, and surety servicing activities preferred. Certificates, Licenses, and Registration Property & Casualty Insurance License required or obtainable within 30 days of hire. Surety-specific industry designations or advanced insurance certifications are a plus. What we Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $75,000.00 – $85,000.00. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-NG1 2587820

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. The Client Service Associate plays a meaningful role in delivering a high level of service to clients within a specialized life and disability insurance practice. Working closely with a collaborative team, this individual will support clients with policy service needs, maintain accurate client and policy records, coordinate communications, and help ensure requests are handled accurately and efficiently from start to finish. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, personable professional who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and providing thoughtful client support. Prior life or disability insurance experience is not required; candidates with experience in professional office, financial services, insurance, accounting, legal, or other client-facing environments who are eager to learn a specialized business are encouraged to apply! Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Prepare Monthly Birthday List and send Birthday Communications weekly Manage client engagement touchpoints, including the preparation of monthly birthday lists and the distribution of personalized weekly birthday communications. Review and manage Lapse Reports Monitor and analyze lapse reports to ensure timely follow-up and resolution. Close new policies in accordance with established procedures Finalize new and increase policies in accordance with established procedures to ensure internal records are accurate Initiate Death and Disability Claims Initiate and support the processing of death and disability claims in accordance with company guidelines. Prepare annual Term Expiry reports and manage the communications Generate and manage annual term policy expiration reports, including preparation and distribution of related communications. Download Standard’s correspondence using Files Anywhere Retrieve and organize incoming correspondence from external systems (e.g., Files Anywhere) for internal processing. Additional Responsibilities are Back-Up to the CSR: Creates and maintain client files in accordance with office procedures Will be first line of answering questions from clients and insurance company personnel Take a proactive lead on conserving the existing block of disability and life insurance by notifying clients of overdue insurance premiums Process policy service requests: address changes, beneficiary changes, premium mode changes, etc. Follow up with carriers to ensure accuracy and completeness Ensure data accuracy in company records by routinely updating client and carrier information in our CMS and maintain electronic client files Complete policy summaries and annual reviews Perform administrative duties including scanning and accurately filing materials in the client files including but not limited to: answering phones, mail distribution Verifies that documentation (policies and endorsements) and information requested are accurate Perform policy reviews and the process for completing coverage in the CMS Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Proficiency in Microsoft office applications Good written and verbal communication skills Self-confidence to make sound independent decisions Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people Team player, adaptive to mentoring and continual learning Possess good analytical and problem-solving skills Attention to details May be required to work overtime as necessary Education and/or Experience: High School graduate or equivalent, College graduate preferred Minimum 1 year of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life & Health License to be earned Physical Demand: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $46,500 – $52,500. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Posting Description Who We Are Lenox Advisors is a premier MassMutual agency supporting a network of financial professionals who provide insurance, investment, and financial planning solutions to clients nationwide. As part of NFP, an Aon company, we offer the resources of a large organization while maintaining the culture and agility of a high-performing agency. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional advisor support, effective supervision, and operational excellence that drive business growth and client confidence. The Vice President, Controller leads the organization's accounting function and is accountable for accurate financial reporting, effective controls, and disciplined accounting operations. Reporting to the CFO, this leader oversees the financial close, financial and management reporting, balance sheet oversight, audit coordination, accounting policy, and internal controls. The VP, Controller works across Executive Leadership, Planning & Analysis, Finance Operations, Data & Analytics, MassMutual, and NFP/Aon Corporate Finance to strengthen reporting, solve complex accounting issues, and support informed business decisions. Interested in shaping how a growing organization approaches accounting, reporting, and financial operations? This role offers the opportunity to lead the controllership function while driving improvements in reporting, processes, controls, and scalability. Job Accountabilities / What You’ll Do Lead accounting, financial reporting, and monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities across a complex, multi-entity organization. Own the integrity of the general ledger, reconciliations, accounting policies, balance sheet substantiation, intercompany accounting, and related controls. Deliver financial statements and management reporting that clearly communicate business performance, financial results, trends, and risks. Analyze financial results and translate key drivers, trends, and issues into useful insights for leadership. Partner with NFP/Aon Corporate Accounting, Compliance, Internal Audit, and external auditors on reporting, audit, accounting, and control matters. Advise business leaders on accounting and reporting considerations related to business decisions and transactions. Develop accounting professionals and create an environment that supports accountability, collaboration, and continued growth. Support mergers and acquisitions through accounting diligence, reporting integration, and post-acquisition accounting activities. Lead initiatives that simplify processes, improve reporting capabilities, strengthen controls, and enable the accounting function to scale with the organization. Experience 12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, audit, or corporate finance. Big Four public accounting experience required. Public-company or public-company reporting experience required. Experience leading financial close and reporting for a complex, multi-entity organization. Experience addressing complex accounting matters and applying U.S. GAAP to business transactions. Experience partnering directly with corporate accounting, auditors, compliance teams, and senior leadership. Experience leading accounting teams and cross-functional finance initiatives. Skills / Abilities Knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, internal controls, and financial statement preparation and analysis. Ability to interpret financial results and communicate relevant insights to business and finance leaders. Ability to lead initiatives and work effectively across functions and organizational levels. Effective written, verbal, and presentation skills. Proficiency with Excel, financial systems, reporting platforms, and business intelligence tools. Project management and stakeholder management capabilities. Education Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required. CPA, Chartered Accountant (CA), or equivalent professional accounting designation required. MBA or other advanced finance designation preferred. What We Offer We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $135,600 – $210,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP and Lenox Advisors is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2589435

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, has been recognized several times as one of the Best Places to Work in Business Insurance. We are a group of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We assist companies and individuals worldwide in tackling their most important risk, workforce, wealth management, and retirement challenges with tailored solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. About the Role Are you passionate about guiding organizations through complicated risk management situations? As a Captive Insurance Consultant & Analyst within NFP’s Risk and Insurance Strategy Collective, you will develop, implement, and manage forward-thinking captive insurance and alternative risk financing solutions alongside skilled professionals. This position offers extensive exposure to different industries, including but not limited to, construction, healthcare, manufacturing, private equity, professional services, and transportation. . Key Responsibilities Perform captive insurance feasibility assessments and alternative risk financing evaluations. Develop financial models, pro forma projections, and scenario analyses. Analyze underwriting, claims, and exposure data to support client recommendations. Prepare client reports, board materials, business plans, and regulatory submissions. Coordinate with brokers, actuaries, auditors, attorneys, regulators, reinsurers, and fronting carriers. Assist with captive formations, licensing applications, and implementation projects. Support ongoing captive management, governance, compliance, and long-term planning activities. Participate in client meetings, board meetings, and business development opportunities. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Risk Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Business, or a related field. 2-7 years of experience in insurance, captive insurance, consulting, accounting, actuarial services, underwriting, or risk management. Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving capabilities. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Excellent communication, presentation, and client-facing skills. Interest in captive insurance, alternative risk funding, and strategic consulting. Preferred Qualifications Experience with captive insurance programs, actuarial analyses, or financial forecasting. Professional designations such as ACI, ARM, CPCU, CPA, or actuarial credentials. Experience preparing executive-level reports and presentations. This position offers an outstanding opportunity to develop a career in a fast-growing part of the insurance industry. You will work directly with senior leaders, clients, regulators, and industry partners on complex and impactful risk financing solutions. Join us and help invent the future of risk management! What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture centers on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees since our mission is to be there for others. Job.JobTitle: Senior Consultant, Vitality & Wellbeing Solutions (Hybrid, CST/PST)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary: This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping employers develop healthier, more engaged, and resilient workforces while serving as a trusted strategic advisor. The role offers the chance to shape and influence the continued growth of a national consulting practice within NFP, an Aon company, collaborating with experienced teams across benefits, analytics, communications, compliance, and vendor management to address complex client challenges. In addition, you will contribute to the development of scalable tools, thought leadership, and consulting best practices that enhance client outcomes and strengthen the overall consulting experience. Key Responsibilities: Lead strategic wellbeing consulting engagements for mid-size and large employer clients, including discovery, planning, recommendations, and ongoing advisory support. Design integrated wellbeing strategies that align health, emotional wellbeing, financial wellbeing, caregiving, culture, communications, vendor solutions, and benefits priorities. Translate client needs, workforce insights, market trends, vendor capabilities, and program results into clear guidance for HR, benefits, finance, leadership, and account team partners. Guide vendor strategy by supporting evaluations, RFPs, implementation planning, performance conversations, and ongoing accountability for client value. Use qualitative and quantitative information to identify priorities, shape recommendations, evaluate progress, and tell a clear story about program impact. Lead client projects and consulting deliverables with strong organization, ownership, follow-through, and readiness for client-facing interactions. Collaborate with account teams, practice leaders, and internal subject matter experts to strengthen client relationships, support retention, and contribute to growth opportunities. Develop and refine scalable resources, frameworks, presentations, and client-facing tools that support consistent national practice delivery. Mentor colleagues, share expertise, and help raise the quality, consistency, and strategic depth of consulting work across the team. Required Experience and Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced education, certifications, or professional credentials in wellbeing, benefits, HR, public health, or a related field are a plus. Life and Health license strongly preferred, or willingness to obtain within first three months. Core Competencies Minimum 5+ years of related experience with health and benefits and/or wellbeing required. Minimum 3+ years of employer wellbeing consulting experience required. Demonstrated experience in employer wellbeing, health and benefits, health transformation, employee engagement, or a related consulting/advisory environment. Experience supporting complex employer clients and advising internal or external stakeholders on program strategy, engagement, communications, vendor solutions, or measurement. Strong working knowledge of the employer wellbeing marketplace, including emerging trends, vendor solutions, point solutions, engagement strategies, and integration with benefits priorities. Comfort interpreting data, trends, client context, and partner feedback to develop thoughtful recommendations and practical next steps. Strategic consulting judgment and ability to design practical, client-centered solutions. Executive-ready communication skills, including strong writing, facilitation, and presentation presence. Ability to influence through credibility, preparation, business context, and subject matter expertise. Project leadership, organization, accountability, and comfort handling multiple priorities in a changing environment. Strong listening, adaptability, emotional intelligence, and relationship management skills. Market curiosity, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of work from concept through completion. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and AI, especially PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create polished client-facing materials. Travel and Work Environment: Hybrid role with periodic access to the Chicago office for collaboration, planning, and team connection. Ability and willingness to travel periodically (25% of the time) for client meetings, internal collaboration, and practice priorities. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $90,000 – $115,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-HYBRID #LI-LL1 #NFP 2584670

Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Legal & Compliance Intern Wealth Management Company – Private Equity Backed Carve-Out About the Company: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first - our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. Fiducient Advisors provides tailored and personalized investment consulting services to clients such as retirement plan sponsors, endowments and foundations, private clients, and financial institutions. We operate with over 200 professionals nationwide, supporting our distinct purpose of helping clients prosper. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Internship Description: Our 10-week Summer Intern Program is designed to provide students with a challenging and meaningful experience supporting the Legal & Compliance team. The position involves day-to-day responsibilities and a variety of projects that will allow interns to enhance their industry knowledge. Depending on location, the role is in-person for up to three days a week and remote for the remainder. Location: Chicago, IL or Aliso Viejo, CA Key Responsibilities Include: Investment adviser regulatory compliance support Assist the Compliance Officer with administering the Firm’s Code of Ethics in support of the firm’s fiduciary duty of care and loyalty. Assist with firm risk mitigation, including the revision of Firm policies and procedures and Firm marketing reviews Support the Compliance Officer in conducting compliance testing of the firm’s policies and procedures Perform other compliance and legal duties as required by Compliance Officer and Chief Compliance Officer/Associate General Counsel Collaborate across divisions and stakeholders to be seen as a trusted problem solver and adviser Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: 2L Class, 2L Eve/PT, 3L Class, 3L Eve/PT, L.L.M. Student or Major in Finance, Economics, or other related discipline Strong interest in regulatory Compliance / Legal activities in the financial services industry Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy, organizational skills, and time management Knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office products such as Word, PowerPoint and Excel Ability to achieve objectives within project timeline Excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience and interest in execution (doing) and strategy (building) Logical judgment and ability to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously Ability to work independently as well as with others in an energetic small team environment The summer internship experience provides interns with meaningful exposure to the financial services industry. Interns will gain experience in Marketing function, while building valuable skills for a successful career. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list. We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences. The hourly range for this position is $20.00 – $27.00 per hour. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #Wealthspire 2592140

Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. The Total Rewards Analyst provides technical support to clients and prospects for compensation and total rewards engagements. This position creates, develops, researches, and produces communication, data analysis and reports for external clients. The Analyst works independently and in a team environment to review, analyze, and provide recommendations on the compensation plan design and program administration. Ideally, we are looking to hire someone who can work out of one of our offices on a hybrid basis preferably in CST or EST time zones. I am accountable for these key areas: Benchmark and evaluate client roles and plan design aspects for market competitiveness using a variety of data sources. Prepare compensation observations, analyses, and recommendations for client and prospects. Assist with client project management. Create client communication and deliverables to support the practice. Strive to be a pacesetter in the compensation and total rewards space to keep our clients informed of innovative ideas and best practices. Responsibilities Benchmark and evaluate client roles and plan design aspects for market competitiveness using a variety of data sources. Analyze jobs for client projects using provided job descriptions and specified data scope criteria. Fully understand each individual survey database and technology to effectively complete compensation and total rewards projects that meet client deadlines. Gather additional data as needed from publicly available sources, such as 990 compensation data, salary ordinances, job boards, etc. Participate in client review meetings to gather and document feedback and adjust accordingly. 2. Prepare compensation observations, analysis, and recommendations for clients and prospects. Aggregate data from multiples systems to create summary reports and observations. Create pay structures using benchmark data and client objectives as a guide. Complete employee analysis reports, comparing employees to the new pay structures. Develop key client deliverables, including, but not limited to project kick-off decks, summary reports and presentations, compensation philosophies, administrative guidebooks, training presentations, FLSA classification recommendations, communication updates, etc. 3. Assist with client project management. Organize client job descriptions and data for ease of use and efficiency. Develop project plans and timelines for client engagements. Work with internal team members to schedule client meetings to stay on track with key milestones. Update the practice project tracker regularly. Attend and contribute to team meetings to stay aligned on priorities and deadlines. 4. Create and update deliverables and resources to support the practice. Review and recommend documents such as benchmark slot lists for compensation projects. Update documents when new data is available, such as the total rewards benchmarks, updated salary survey sources, internal templates, practice onboarding guide for clients, etc. Complete annual salary budget, total rewards, and other human resource-focused surveys and summarize data in a meaningful, clear, and useful format to update internal team members and clients. 5. Strive to be a pacesetter in the compensation and total rewards space to keep our clients informed of innovative ideas and best practices. Investigate new legislation and regulations that relate to our area of expertise. Research industry trends using publicly available sources such as surveys, publications, industry association websites and webinars, and specialized sources such as industry deliverables and white papers. Goals and Measures of Success Work is completed with an elevated level of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail. Once fully proficient in the role, few revisions should be needed to the work by more experience team members or project leads. Clients are confident in the expertise, recommendations, and knowledge of delivered work. Trust between client and Analyst is build through regular and proactive communication. Project and client deadlines are met or exceeded. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, human resources, business, or another related field required. Minimum of one year of experience in compensation, data analysis, benefits, human resources, or another related field required. Desire to obtain advanced certifications, such as the Certified Compensation Professional (CCP), Society of Human Resource Management Certified Professional (SHRM-CP), or other related certification preferred. Experience in a consulting environment preferred. Essential Functions and Skills Strong analytic and proficient Excel skills, with the ability to analysis, interpret and draw conclusions from data. Develops strong working relationships and trust with clients. Completes work with meticulous detail and accuracy, ensuring a high level of quality. Organizes and maintains systems and processes that support the projects and teams. Responds in a calm and effective manner to a variety of demands, projects, timelines, and working styles. Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal, and presentation capabilities. Dedicated team player but is also able to work effectively individually. Promotes cooperation and commitment within the team to achieve goals and deliverables. Proactive in identifying what needs to be done and acting before being asked. Strong work ethics with the flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to work under tight deadlines or changing clients needs. Demonstrates all NFP core values What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $65,000 – $80,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #LI-LL1 #LI-HYBRID 2588853

Job.JobTitle: Commercial Risk VP, Team Lead (NY or Boston hybrid)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Summary The VP Team Leader, Commercial Risk is a strategic leader who manages a portfolio of high-value and complex Commercial Lines Property & Casualty clients while leading and mentoring a group of Account Executives. The role drives retention and revenue growth by strengthening client relationships and identifying new business, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities. This role supports our Northeast territory. We offer a hybrid opportunity from our NYC, Long Island or Boston offices. Working in the office is essential for fostering collaboration and leadership. We will consider remote options for experienced candidates, ideally in the NE for the ability and feasibility to occasionally travel to client meetings or our designated offices if required. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Serve as a strategic leader within the office, helping shape client strategy, growth priorities, collaboration, and service excellence. Lead and mentor a group of Account Executives while managing an assigned book of complex, high-value clients. Develop Account Executives to become more strategic, growth-oriented, and proactive in managing client relationships. Drive revenue growth across the book by establishing relationships with producers, existing and prospective clients and identifying new business, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities. Lead account strategy, renewals, marketing, and complex client discussions in partnership with producers and account teams. Serve as a senior escalation point and trusted advisor for complex, sensitive, or high-risk client matters. Drive client retention and expansion through proactive relationship management, strong execution, and consistent service delivery. Find opportunities to improve account workflows, client results, and the overall client experience. PeopleFirst Leadership The VP models NFP’s PeopleFirst values by fostering an inclusive, respectful, and accountable environment. The role provides clear direction, coaching, and development support while encouraging collaboration, open communication, and professional growth. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 10+ years of Commercial Lines experience desired, including experience with complex or high-value accounts. Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor Account Executives while managing a complex book of business. Strong knowledge of Property & Casualty coverage, risk management, carrier markets, and account strategy. Proven ability to strengthen client relationships and identify revenue-growth opportunities. Excellent communication, critical thinking, problem-solving, and relationship-management skills. Ability to manage competing priorities with sound judgment, attention to detail, and urgency. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel; EPIC experience preferred. Certificates, Licenses, Registration Property & Casualty Insurance License required. Professional insurance designation such as CIC, CISR, CPCU, CRM, or AAI preferred. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $200,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Job.CustomJobTypeName: Surety Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Customer Service Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Account Manager, Surety Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary: The Account Manager is responsible for working with Client Executives and other Account Managers to service client accounts. The position requires day-to-day client servicing for a specific set of clients and entails a great deal of verbal, electronic and other written communications. You will manage the day-to-day handling of each accounts needs, which include file maintenance, issuance of surety bonds, including, bid, performance & payment, maintenance, transactional and renewal, and prepare materials for presentations and communications, in collaboration with their more senior team members. Work is completed with a significant amount of independent discretion, but is collaborative in nature with other team members. While in this role, you will be developing relationships with clients and carrier contacts and working proactively to effectively and efficiently deliver services to clients. In addition to managing your own clients, you may also continue to support the Account Management Team as assigned. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Works proactively to develop relationships with carrier and client contacts. Prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable surety carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. Takes the lead on reviewing carrier source documents for accuracy in collaboration with the Client Executive. Begins to communicate directly with clients and carriers, with approval from the Client Executive. Creates and maintains client files in accordance with office procedures. Will be responsible for keeping client policy records in the agency management system. May be the first line of answering billing questions from clients and insurance company personnel with assistance from the Accounting Dept. when necessary. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Highly organized with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-confident to make sound independent decisions. Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people and function well both in a team environment and autonomously. Ability to handle situations in a calm, courteous and professional manner. Customer-focused to establish and maintain effective relationships. Intermediate level of experience in Microsoft Office products, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines. Sharp attention to detail, decision-making skills, and problem resolution. Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities, deadlines and technology. Office Operations and Facilities Maintain the professional appearance and organization of office common areas, conference rooms, and kitchens. Manage office supplies, snacks, beverages, and meal orders for offices throughout the region. Support the RingCentral phone system, office equipment, and general operational needs. Assist with office moves, setups, and facilities-related projects. Ability to work collaboratively, take initiative, and manage competing priorities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM systems and SharePoint is a plus. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Job.JobTitle: Regional Vice President, Benefits Compliance (Eastern Region)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job summary: Under the general direction of the Regional Vice President (RVP), Group Leader, the RVP, Benefits Compliance, Atlantic Region will join a team of other compliance attorneys and specialists dedicated to providing exemplary benefits compliance support services. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing guidance to our employee benefit consultants and their clients on compliance with a broad range of laws applicable to health and welfare plans, including ERISA, PPACA, COBRA, HIPAA, Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act, Transparency in Coverage and No Surprises Acts, Internal Revenue Code (including Section 125), FSAs, HRAs, HSAs, FMLA and other state and federal laws. This role requires understanding relevant laws and explaining benefits compliance inquiries in language accessible to laypeople. The individual must communicate clearly with benefits brokers, consultants, and employer clients. Responsibilities include reviewing employee benefits compliance checklists, assisting with seminars and webinars, and offering internal training to employee benefit consultants and their clients across the Atlantic Region as assigned by market segment. Physical proximity to the East Coast preferred. Essential duties and responsibilities Perform compliance checklist reviews for key and national account clients, including pre-checklist review and detailed follow-up in coordination with account management teams. Respond to benefits compliance questions in a timely manner, often within 24 hours. Stay abreast of the changing legislative and regulatory landscape, to include statutory legislation and regulation impacting the Region. Attend internal Benefits Compliance Team meetings regularly. Attend internal regional and office-specific meetings (Team Lead, office-specific, etc.) regularly. Own or co-own regional compliance initiatives in conjunction with regional sales and account management leaders, including regular regional decisions, education, and webinar training. Communicate and educate account teams (and clients, as relevant) on compliance initiatives and resources, including Compliance Toolkits, Publications, and NFP Connect. Conduct or support benefits compliance seminars and webinars. Contribute to the overall mission of the Benefits Compliance Department including other duties as assigned by the team and/or the Regional Leads. Knowledge, skills, and/or abilities Must have knowledge of laws and regulations governing health and welfare plans. Must have clear communication skills and ability to explain compliance in easy to understand and accessible language to internal and external stakeholders. Must be a self-motivated worker with strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines Must have excellent presentation skills Must have a strong sense of business ethics and integrity Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality in regard to work performed and access to information/data Must maintain a professional and positive attitude SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None required, but there is opportunity for mentoring and cross-training with team members nationally. Education and/or experience: Brokerage/consultant account management experience preferred. Law degree not required, but attorneys will be considered. Prior experience with federal or state governmental regulatory body a plus. CEBS designation (or equivalent industry experience) a plus. Minimum 4 years of experience in employee benefits and/or compliance. Physical proximity to the Region preferred to support light travel to clients and offices. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $120,000.00 – $165,000.00. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer #LI-LL1 #LI-REMOTE #NFP 2584314
