Job.JobDescription:
Senior Insurance Loss Control Consultant

Job Description
At Alexander & Schmidt, a Senior Insurance Loss Control Consultant performs inspections and prepares in-depth reports for insurance underwriting purposes. Insurance companies use the reports to properly insure a commercial building, or business operations, for a new policy or renewal of a current policy.
Required Skills
  • MUST HAVE 10+ years’ experience with a major carrier or working as an independent contractor providing commercial insurance loss control services.
  • Extensive understanding of commercial property and casualty lines.
    • Property assessments will potentially include the necessity to determine adequacy of sprinkler systems based on occupancy, commodities and racking systems.
    • Inland Marine coverages will include builders risk, contractor’s equipment, motor truck cargo, WLL and MOLL and other specialty coverage’s.
    • Commercial General Liability will include Premises, Operations, Products and Completed Operations.
    • Workers Compensation assessments for regulatory compliance and workplace safety.
    • Loss analysis involving identification of trends, root cause and appropriate corrective action.
    • Specialty fields such as Environmental and Professional Liability
  • Risk Improvement services including training, consulting, hazard analysis and regulatory assessments will also be conducted.
  • Solid communication skills—including exceptional writing ability, organizational skills, and computer skills
  • Excellent Time management skills
  • Professional certifications CSP, OHST, ALCM and/or ARM are preferred, but not required.
  • Uploading completed reports, photos and diagrams through a special website or complete reports on web based systems
  • Travel within a reasonable territory, 60 mile radius
This work will be challenging and covers everything from contractors to real estate to retail to warehouse and distribution to manufacturing.
High-quality, accurate loss control surveys guide the underwriter in the selection of profitable business, and assist the insured in controlling losses through the demonstrated value of the loss control services provided.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Senior Insurance Loss Control Consultant

Job Description
At Alexander & Schmidt, a Senior Insurance Loss Control Consultant performs inspections and prepares in-depth reports for insurance underwriting purposes. Insurance companies use the reports to properly insure a commercial building, or business operations, for a new policy or renewal of a current policy.
Required Skills
  • MUST HAVE 10+ years’ experience with a major carrier or working as an independent contractor providing commercial insurance loss control services.
  • Extensive understanding of commercial property and casualty lines.
    • Property assessments will potentially include the necessity to determine adequacy of sprinkler systems based on occupancy, commodities and racking systems.
    • Inland Marine coverages will include builders risk, contractor’s equipment, motor truck cargo, WLL and MOLL and other specialty coverage’s.
    • Commercial General Liability will include Premises, Operations, Products and Completed Operations.
    • Workers Compensation assessments for regulatory compliance and workplace safety.
    • Loss analysis involving identification of trends, root cause and appropriate corrective action.
    • Specialty fields such as Environmental and Professional Liability
  • Risk Improvement services including training, consulting, hazard analysis and regulatory assessments will also be conducted.
  • Solid communication skills—including exceptional writing ability, organizational skills, and computer skills
  • Excellent Time management skills
  • Professional certifications CSP, OHST, ALCM and/or ARM are preferred, but not required.
  • Uploading completed reports, photos and diagrams through a special website or complete reports on web based systems
  • Travel within a reasonable territory, 60 mile radius
This work will be challenging and covers everything from contractors to real estate to retail to warehouse and distribution to manufacturing.
High-quality, accurate loss control surveys guide the underwriter in the selection of profitable business, and assist the insured in controlling losses through the demonstrated value of the loss control services provided.

The Data & Analytics Platforms Team (DAP) develops and runs central platforms and data products, which enable the Allianz Operating Entities (OEs) to generate value from data & analytics at scale. The major offering is the Allianz Data Platform (ADP) - a PaaS offering -, which comprises necessary capabilities to store, transfer and analyze data, as well as running data & analytics products. In addition, ADP also serves capabilities for ML (ops) and GenAI / Agentic AI use cases. 

The Data Architect (hands on) will be responsible to shape the future ADP data offering (evaluate, design and implement technical platform capabilities), spanning data storage, data modeling, data integration, and analytics enablement. Moreover, they will advice local implementation teams how to best apply platform capabilities for effective / efficient local application built / use case implementation. 

The candidate should bring a deep understanding of data architecture (data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance), market leading data platform solutions (e.g. Databricks) and modern data engineering technologies. 

What you do (Hands on Data architect)

Data Platform Strategy: 

  • Lead the migration of data workloads and data stores from on-premises infrastructure to MS Azure Cloud, ensuring alignment with Allianz's cloud strategy.
  • Design, build, and test data architectures in an enterprise setup to ensure efficient transfer and storage of large amounts of data, maintaining information accuracy and security during data transfers.
  • Stay updated with developments in data management, data platforms, and data engineering, providing guidance to cross-functional teams on data access and data integration, especially during major transfers, updates, or changes.

Architecture Design: 

  • Develop and oversee data architecture designs that meet business requirements and strategic objectives. Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and cost-effective.
  • Act as a thought leader and expert on data modeling, data integration, and Data Platform capabilities, advising customers and internal teams on the latest technology and valuable implementation strategies within Allianz.
  • Leverage data and analytics capabilities to create high-performing data services within the existing landscape, troubleshooting and solving technical issues with creativity and prior knowledge.

Stakeholder Engagement: 

  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, area architects, and business requirement teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and strategic goals.

Technical Leadership: 

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior architects and technical teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the Data architect subject-matter expert for the entire department, offering strategic insights and leadership.

Documentation and Compliance: 

  • Ensure thorough documentation of architecture designs and processes, maintaining compliance with Allianz standards and policies.
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards and best practices in all processes, fostering innovation and efficiency in data management.

Value Proposition: 

  • Drive initiatives that enhance the value proposition of Allianz's data solutions, focusing on expanding service capabilities and integrating new functionalities.
  • Vet data platform providers and third-party services to ensure high-quality offerings for storage, compute, and data processing, while creating standard operating procedures and policy documentation for data transfer and storage.

  

What you bring (Hands on Data architect) 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 8-10 years experience required with five years’ experience as a Data Architect or similar role.
  • Deep understanding of data architecture concepts, data modeling techniques, and data platform frameworks, with proficiency in designing and implementing data solutions that align with business objectives using popular platforms like Azure, and AWS .
  • Knowledge of data platform engineering, data warehousing, and data lake / lakehouse design, with experience using major cloud computing services such as Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Ability to design scalable and robust enterprise architectures that integrate data pipelines and data technologies into existing systems, identifying integration points and ensuring interoperability with other enterprise applications, databases, and services.
  • Strong data migration and data management skills, emphasizing data privacy and security, along with excellent problem-solving capabilities in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate with cross-functional departments and teams.
  • Relevant industry certifications, such as Databricks, Microsoft Azure, or AWS, are highly desirable; proficiency in English is required.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture and innovation strategies.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata management

 Preferred business domain:

  • Business knowledge of Life insurance domain

What we offer

  • We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working
  • We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes health insurance, company bonus scheme, 401(K) with company match, company paid holidays, paid time off, paid volunteer days, tuition reimbursement, paid parental leave, an employee shares program and employee discounts From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
  • The annualized base pay range for this role is $110,000 - 150,000. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, and the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the ATA total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, ATA also offers eligibility for an incentive-based annual bonus.

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.

We are looking for an experienced Principal Data Engineer to work hands-on on the re-engineering of an existing enterprise data platform built on Azure Synapse Analytics. The role requires strong technical depth to audit, understand, and validate a complex end-to-end data architecture spanning source ingestion through to consumption — and to help deliver the migration of validated workloads to Databricks. This is hands on  role and demands the ability to reverse-engineer existing implementations, assess their correctness, and build to an agreed migration strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the technical assessment and re-engineering of an existing enterprise data platform, spanning all layers from source ingestion through to data consumption
  • Reverse-engineer, document, and validate existing pipeline logic, data models, transformation frameworks, and data governance controls
  • Identify gaps, defects, and technical debt across the platform and remediate where implementations are incorrect or sub-optimal
  • Ensure correctness of data processing patterns including change data capture, slowly changing dimensions, deduplication, and business reconciliation
  • Implement target-state designs aligned to modern lakehouse principles, ensuring feature parity and business logic fidelity during transitions
  • Support platform evolution initiatives, including parallel-run phases where multiple implementations operate simultaneously, validating output consistency before cutover
  • Execute migration of existing workloads to modern data platforms, preserving existing governance and control framework semantics
  • Re-implement ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines on target platforms, maintaining audit, quality, and reconciliation standards
  • Collaborate with business, data governance, and architecture stakeholders to validate embedded business rules and data quality requirements
  • Mentor less experienced engineers, review code and designs, and support decommission planning for legacy components

Core Technical Skills

  • Azure Synapse & Data Platform Mandatory hands-on expertise with:
  • Azure Synapse Analytics (Pipelines, Spark Pool, Dedicated SQL Pool)
  • Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2)
  • Delta Lake on Azure (Synapse Lakehouse patterns)
  • Oracle Golden Gate Replication for real-time source integration
  • Azure Analysis Services and Power BI consumption layer patterns
  • Deep understanding of medallion architecture: Raw / Harmonized / Conformed / Consumption layers
  • Strong knowledge of SCD Type 0/1/2, CDC patterns, soft/hard delete, and retroactive change processing
  • Experience with Synapse SQL Pool — stored procedures, control tables, and data quality validation patterns
  • Experience with audit, balance, and control frameworks — parameterized, modular pipeline governance at enterprise scale
  • Familiarity with config-driven and automation-first pipeline patterns (YAML, PySpark, SQL-driven generation from mapping documents)

Databricks & Lakehouse

  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks (Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog preferred)
  • Strong Apache Spark skills (PySpark / Spark SQL)
  • Experience migrating workloads from legacy data warehouse or Synapse environments to a Databricks Lakehouse
  • Ability to re-implement governance and control frameworks natively in Databricks (audit logging, reconciliation, DQ checks)
  • Experience with Delta Lake features: MERGE, CDC, time travel, schema enforcement

Data Engineering & Development

  • Strong Python and SQL programming skills
  • Experience with ETL/ELT at scale: denormalization, surrogate keys, directory tables, curated data models
  • Experience integrating complex data sources: Oracle DB, SQL Server, Azure SQL DB, file systems, Salesforce, APIs
  • Strong data modelling skills: relational, dimensional, and lakehouse-oriented

DevOps & Automation

  • CI/CD pipelines for data engineering (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or ARM)
  • Containerization (Docker)
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks for data pipelines (unit testing, reconciliation-based validation)

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog for data governance and lineage
  • Familiarity with Azure Purview for data cataloguing and governance
  • Exposure to real-time and streaming pipelines (Event Hub / Kafka / Kinesis)
  • Experience with GenAI or ML platform integration (MLOps, feature engineering pipelines)
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Dynatrace)
  • Exposure to BI tools (Power BI, Tableau)

Experience & Profile

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, including platform migration or re-engineering work
  • Proven track record working on existing, complex enterprise data platforms — not just building from scratch
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise data governance patterns: audit trails, reconciliation, data quality controls, SCD versioning
  • Strong analytical mindset: ability to read existing implementations, identify intent versus defect, and make sound re-engineering decisions
  • Primarily hands-on, while comfortable contributing to technical design discussions
  • Strong communication skills — able to engage business, governance, and engineering stakeholders with clarity
  • Experience working in regulated or enterprise-scale environments (financial services a plus)

What we offer

  • We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working
  • We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes health insurance, company bonus scheme, 401(K) with company match, company paid holidays, paid time off, paid volunteer days, tuition reimbursement, paid parental leave, an employee shares program and employee discounts From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.

The Senior Manager of Digital Integration & Platform is a hands-on engineering leader responsible for the foundation that all five digital domains depend on. This role owns the API layer, microservices platform, event streaming infrastructure, cloud-native architecture, and the integrations that connect AllianzLife.com to financial product systems, downstream platforms, and third-party services.

This is a platform-first role in the truest sense and the team this manager leads enables every other domain to ship faster, more reliably, and with greater consistency. They are accountable for building and maintaining the Integration & Platform services defined in the Future Digital Reference Architecture: Java/Spring Boot microservices, AWS API Gateway, Kafka event streaming (EBS), MongoDB per-service data schemas, Ping authentication, Vault secrets management, and a cloud-native CI/CD pipeline on AWS ECS/EKS.

This role reports to the Head of Digital & Ops Modernization and partners closely with the Senior Director of Web Modernization, domain engineering managers, and enterprise architects. It is a cross-team enabler; reliability, API governance, and platform quality here directly determine the velocity of every team above it.

What you do

API development & governance

  • Own the full API layer for AllianzLife.com including design, development, versioning, deprecation, and contract governance across all domains
  • Build and maintain the AWS API Gateway configuration including WAF rules, rate limiting, routing, and security policies
  • Establish and enforce API standards used by all five engineering domains: REST conventions, error handling, versioning strategy, and documentation requirements
  • Own the API catalog and developer documentation so internal teams can self-serve integrations without reliance on tribal knowledge
  • Implement and maintain authentication (SSO, JWT, OAuth) across all platform entry points
  • Manage Vault for secrets management, certificate rotation, and secure credential distribution across services

Microservices & integration platform

  • Lead the engineering and ongoing operations of the Java/Spring Boot microservices that power AllianzLife.com’s core capabilities and build Account Service, Money Out Service, Claims Service, and Service Requests
  • Own MongoDB per-service schema design and data governance and ensuring schemas are right-sized, versioned, and maintained independently per service
  • Build and maintain Salesforce CRM integrations and all third-party API integrations that connect digital capabilities to back-office systems
  • Own middleware orchestration and data transformation patterns across the integration layer
  • Define and maintain integration contracts between the platform layer and all downstream systems: RSP, ID3, EODS, IHUB, and Producer Pro

Event-driven architecture & Kafka streaming

  • Own the EBS Kafka event streaming bus that underpins real-time integration across AllianzLife.com and downstream systems
  • Design and maintain event schemas, topic governance, consumer group management, and producer patterns
  • Ensure event-driven flows are reliable, monitored, and recoverable including dead-letter queues, retry strategies, and incident playbooks
  • Drive adoption of event-driven patterns across domain teams to reduce synchronous coupling and improve platform resilience

Cloud-native infrastructure & DevOps

  • Own the cloud-native platform on AWS  including ECS/EKS container orchestration, networking, IAM, and service mesh configuration
  • Lead infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and AWS CDK  all infrastructure is version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and automated
  • Own the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline including branch strategy, PR gates, build and test automation, and deployment to AWS ECS/EKS
  • Drive legacy system decommissioning with a sequenced, risk-managed migration plan that minimizes disruption to downstream consumers
  • Establish and maintain platform SLAs for availability, latency, and deployment frequency tracked through Dynatrace observability

Observability & platform reliability

  • Own Dynatrace as the full-stack observability platform — APM, distributed traces, log aggregation, RUM, SLO dashboards, and alerting
  • Define and enforce SLO targets for all platform services — ensuring the team is measuring what matters, not just what’s easy
  • Own on-call rotation and incident response for platform-layer issues — building a culture of blameless post-mortems and continuous improvement
  • Ensure platform health metrics are visible to all domain teams as a shared signal for release readiness

AI-augmented engineering

  • Embed AI-augmented development practices into the team’s engineering workflow: AI code review and generation, automated test coverage, and intelligent PR analysis
  • Partner with the Architecture domain to evaluate and adopt emerging AI-first tooling (Anthropic Claude Code and equivalent) that improves platform engineering velocity
  • Champion the AI-first operating model within the Integration & Platform domain as a foundational practice, not an optional add-on

Engineering leadership & culture

  • Lead a full-stack platform engineering team — hiring, developing, and retaining engineers with deep expertise in Java, AWS, event-driven architecture, and API platform engineering
  • Actively participate in technical decisions — conduct code reviews on microservices, infrastructure-as-code, and API contracts; shape architectural choices with the team
  • Establish a strong platform engineering culture: code review discipline, tech debt budget per sprint, shared definition of done, and zero-tolerance for unmonitored production incidents
  • Own the Integration & Platform team’s slice of the single prioritized backlog — ensuring stories are ready, sequenced, and clearly prioritized against platform stability and new capability work
  • Use DORA metrics — deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and MTTR — as active coaching tools, not reporting artifacts

What you bring

Required

  • 8–10 years of experience in platform, integration, or backend engineering, with at least 3–4 years leading and managing engineering teams
  • Demonstrated engineering background in Java/Spring Boot microservices — must be able to conduct meaningful code reviews, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and engage credibly on implementation details
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud-native services including API Gateway, ECS/EKS, IAM, CloudWatch, and networking — not just familiarity, but production ownership
  • Experience building and operating event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms
  • Experience with API gateway management, REST API design standards, and OAuth2/JWT authentication patterns in production environments
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or AWS CDK — all infrastructure version-controlled and peer-reviewed
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD tooling — building pipelines that deploy to containerized cloud environments

This is a high-visibility role embedded within a globally distributed EA community. The person will operate with significant autonomy, represent the Americas area in global architecture governance bodies, and act as a trusted technical advisor to both engineering and business leadership.

  • Drive architectural evolution of existing platforms - reducing technical debt and improving product health

  Architecture governance

  • Chair or co-chair the Americas Area Design Authority (ADA), facilitating architecture decision-making at area level
  • Represent the Americas area in global EA bodies, contributing to enterprise-wide standards, patterns, and architectural decisions
  • Review and sign off on significant architectural changes, ensuring compliance with H4 guardrails and enterprise standards
  • Coordinate with Lead Architects in adjacent areas and functional domains (data, security, cloud, integration)
  • Review projects and gain alignment for the Challenge room sessions

  • Ensure security architecture principles are followed in the design and implementation of services across the area
  • Consult product teams on secure-by-design patterns and facilitate security architecture reviews
  • Collaborate with the EA Security domain to embed controls appropriate for the Americas regulatory environment

  Strategic enablement

  • Participate in quarterly business reviews and planning cycles, providing architectural input to product roadmaps and investment decisions
  • Assess technology competencies within area teams and identify coaching and enablement needs
  • Contribute to the EA community of practice - sharing knowledge, validating patterns, and developing architectural standards

What you bring

  Experience

  • 8+ years in IT architecture roles, with at least 3 years at area or enterprise level
  • Proven track record managing architecture across complex, multi-team product areas in large-scale organizations
  • Background in insurance, financial services, or regulated industries is a strong plus 
  • Familiarity with agile operating models (SAFe, Spotify-model or equivalent)

  • Broad architectural knowledge across application, integration, infrastructure, and data domains
  • Hands-on understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and modern application patterns (microservices, event-driven, API-first)

  • Experience facilitating design authorities or architecture review forums

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Call Center Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
At Allianz Life, we are driven by our mission – we secure your future – and by our common goal of caring for tomorrow. We care for our employees by promoting an inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to grow and be rewarded for their success. We care for our customers by creating new products that help them protect their families and pursue their retirement goals. We care for our community by giving time, resources, and donations. And we care for the future by supporting sustainability, protecting the local environment, and promoting societal equity.

You will work exclusively Monday-Friday, no evenings and no weekends! 

Any employee who lives within a 50 mile radius of our offices in Golden Valley, MN will be required to come into the office at least 3 days a week.

You will provide prompt and accurate responses to telephone inquiries from both Customers and Financial Professionals. You will be trained on our products in a structured and active inbound contact-center environment. You will answer inquiries on product features, understanding product performance and educating callers on the self-service features of our website, and taking and keying trade instructions provided on calls. The Customer Service Representative will work with the Contact Center Management team to exceed published benchmarks related to soft skills, accuracy, call handle time and attendance. You are prepared to put the caller's needs first by prioritizing solving problems, de-escalating situations where warranted, and help guide a first call resolution. You will report into a Contact Center Supervisor.

What you do:

  • Answer incoming calls from Customers or Financial Professionals who need assistance on our procedures
  • Build relationships by listening, paraphrasing, and problem solving
  • Provide clear information
  • Manage a diverse clientele
  • Emphasis on attendance and punctuality
  • Support basic Allianz Website registration and navigation
  • Research required information using available resources
  • Follow up with Customers or Financial Professionals
  • Respond to callers, explaining possible solutions, and ensuring that client's feel supported and valued
  • Utilization of artificial intelligence tools and resources (e.g. generative AI).

What you bring:

  • High School Diploma or GED required

  • Aim to exceed standard call center metrics while providing excellent customer service

  • Computer proficiency skills

  • Process, focused on customer relationships

  • Work shift-times between 7am-6pm

  • For 100% remote and hybrid: Appropriate internet speed in order to be effective at home of 50 mbps or higher of download speed

  • You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require immigration sponsorship for visa status now or in the future (e.g. H1-B, L-1, TN, etc). If you are currently on CPT/OPT, you are ineligible due to the need for future immigration sponsorship.

Range $43,000 - $47,000

Actual base salary may vary based upon factors such as relevant experience, qualifications, internal equity of peers, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual incentive program. 

What we offer:

At Allianz Life, we’re proud to provide a benefits package that supports the True Balance of our employees and their families. We offer: a choice of comprehensive medical, dental and vision plan options, flexible spending and health savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, student loan retirement program, generous annual paid leave, an outstanding 401(k) company match, and life insurance. Plus, our employees enjoy an award-winning campus with an array of discounted amenities, including an onsite health center, child development center, fitness facility, convenience store and two cafeterias. Our employees and leaders take an active role in shaping our culture through our Employee Resource Groups, whose activities and advocacy contribute to an environment that welcomes, includes and celebrates diversity. Our generous benefits, campus amenities and inclusive, engaged culture are among the many reasons we’re routinely recognized as a top workplace employer.

Job.JobTitle: Auditor, Internal Audit - Asset Management covering PIMCO and Allianz Global Investors
Job.JobDescription:
JOB PURPOSE/ROLE

The mission of the Internal Audit department is to provide AllianzAM entities with independent, risk oriented and objective review and consulting services to help improve business operations. The US Internal Audit team is based in New York City and Newport Beach and is part of the Global Internal Audit team with additional presence in Munich, Frankfurt, and Hong Kong. As a member of the US Internal Audit team, you will support and perform audits in various locations throughout the United States and also contribute to audit activities carried out by the Internal Audit teams in Europe and Asia. The position will focus on supporting operational and financial risk-based audits as well as contributing to data analytical, statistical and data management routines to support the review of business processes.

What you will do

 

As a member to the Internal Audit team, you will:

 

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with business area stakeholders to provide audit support and contribute internal controls expertise.
  • Support and conduct business and integrated audits as well as selected consulting activities designed to assess and improve operations within the Asset Management business.
  • Support various aspects of audit engagements, including audit planning, fieldwork preparation and escalation of potential weaknesses and risks to the Audit Lead.
  • Contribute to audit work programs and conduct audit fieldwork, including documenting processes and procedures, performing testing, reviewing and analysing documentation, and identifying process and control issues.
  • Draft clear and concise audit findings, reflect on deficiencies identified during audit fieldwork and contribute practical recommendations to mitigate risk.
  • Support the annual audit risk assessment for selected areas within the operational entities and contribute input for the subsequent year’s annual audit plan.
  • Perform follow-up activities to evaluate the sufficiency and timeliness of management responses and corrective action taken in response to audit recommendations.
  • Implement computer-assisted audit techniques (CAATs) to support audit engagements.
  • Build data analytic procedures to efficiently test complete populations and support the implementation of data visualization tools to understand the significance of data by placing it in a visual context and detect patterns, trends and correlations.
  • Share data analytics best practices both horizontally and vertically throughout the organization and its various locations.
  • Implement data visualization tools to understand the significance of data by placing it in a visual context and detect patterns, trends and correlations.
  • Contribute ideas that strengthen internal audit practices and other risk/control efforts.
  • Travel up to 15% per annum is expected.

 

 

What you bring

  • Approx. 3–5 years of professional experience in internal/external audit, risk management, compliance, consulting or equivalent finance-related functions, ideally with exposure to asset management or corporate governance topics
  • Good understanding of products in the field.
  • Good analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Very good communications and presentation skills as well as strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to challenge.
  • Ability to work well within a matrix organization while being a consensus builder and team player.
  • Cultural skills and sensitivities necessary to work effectively in a global organization.
  • Good organizational and time management skills with the ability to work on multiple assignments with varying deadlines.
  • Strong IT skills / Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills
  • Willingness to travel

Education and/or Certifications

  • University degree in economics, finance, mathematics or equivalent
  • Ideally master’s degree
  • Audit certification (CA, CPA, CFA, CIA, CISA) will be an advantage

What we offer

 

  • Flexible working from home (hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
  • Investments for the future: Access to pension/ savings plans/ Allianz products
  • Shared success: Company share purchasing plan
  • Support for what matters: Mental health and wellbeing programs
  • Investments in your career: Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
  • Investments in your skills: Comprehensive learning and development offerings, including certifications and professional qualifications
  • … and so much more!

The base salary range for this position is 90,000 - 120,000 USD.

Additional Information

 

If you think you have what it takes to fill this attractive position in our dynamic organization, then please submit your cover letter and CV. We look forward to hearing from you! If you have any questions, please contact AllianzAM-HR-DE@allianzam.com.

  • Collaborating with colleagues across the Americas and internationally in order to fully leverage surety capabilities and existing customer base.

The Partnership Success Manager serves as the single accountable owner of assigned partnerships supporting our growing Home & Digital Services business, including insurance and assistance solutions across automotive, mobile device, home warranty, and related programs. Serving as partner expert and internal advocate, this role maintains a holistic view of the partner and their business and acts as the central point of contact for business reviews, audits, contractual obligations, performance monitoring, reporting, program implementations, issue resolution, and ongoing partner communication.

Acting as the program’s liaison between the partner and other internal teams, the Partnership Success Manager supports program enhancements and process improvements, and helps ensure operational, financial, contractual, and partner priorities remain on track. The role also supports retention and profitable growth by identifying opportunities to strengthen and expand existing programs.

Way of Working: This position follows a hybrid way of working, with in-office days on Tuesdays and Thursdays at our office in Richmond, VA. 

What you will do

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner and internal advocate for assigned partners, developing a broad understanding of the program and coordinating across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Lead partner governance activities, including business reviews, operational meetings, audits, contractual compliance, service-level monitoring, roadmap discussions, and renewal planning.
  • Coordinate day-to-day program activities across key functions including Finance, Legal, Underwriting, Operations, Sales, Technology, and other stakeholders to keep priorities and deliverables on track.
  • Analyze partner and program data, identify trends or issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations and data-driven business cases.
  • Proactively identify, track, and resolve operational, financial, technical, and partner issues, serving as the primary point of contact for escalations and driving issues through resolution.
  • Lead and coordinate partner initiatives, implementations, program enhancements, and process improvements, ensuring effective execution across stakeholders.
  • Monitor program performance, contractual obligations, reporting, invoicing requirements, and other key deliverables to support effective partner and business management.
  • Prepare and deliver business reviews, strategic presentations, and partner communications, effectively influencing stakeholders and navigating complex or challenging conversations.
  • Support account retention and profitable growth by identifying opportunities to strengthen the partnership, improve operating effectiveness, and enhance existing programs.
  • Develop and maintain program documentation, controls, CRM records, and operating procedures to support consistent execution and business continuity.
  • Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data analytics, and cloud‑based tools, using insights responsibly and in alignment with our standards for data governance, security, and ethical use.

What you will bring 

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–7 years of experience in account management, partnership management, program management, partner governance, or a related field.
  • Experience managing complex partner or client relationships across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with Excel proficiency and the ability to interpret and organize data to support business decisions.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive issues through resolution.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills, including the ability to navigate challenging conversations and influence without direct authority.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce and working in fast-paced, matrixed environments.
  • Fluency in English.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing MGA/TPA relationships or working within Mobility, automotive, warranty, insurance, or related programs is preferred.

Job Purpose

The Claims System Superuser & Operations Specialist serves as the primary Compass Claims System Superuser for the Americas region. This role supports system users, manages system defects and enhancement requests, conducts testing activities, supports releases, and drives continuous system improvements to promote optimal system performance and user experience.

Acting as a liaison between business users and technology teams, the position translates operational requirements into system solutions. The role also supports Claims and Collections reporting, KPI tracking, Group reporting requirements, project coordination, and related process improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Claims System Superuser

  • Serve as the primary Compass Claims System Superuser for the Americas region.
  • Provide end-user support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for Compass Claims users.
  • Investigate system issues, document findings, and support root-cause analysis.
  • Create, manage, revise, and track system defects, enhancement requests, and change requests in Jira.
  • Coordinate with Technology, ROC, and Group stakeholders to support timely resolution of system issues and implementation of system improvements.
  • Coordinate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, execution, evidence collection, results documentation, and validation.
  • Support system releases, upgrades, enhancements, and implementation activities.
  • Monitor system functionality and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, data integrity, and user experience.
  • Translate business needs into clear system requirements, defects, enhancement requests, and workflow improvements.
  • Create, revise, implement, and continuously improve system-related processes, procedures, workflows, controls, job aids, and user guides.
  • Conduct system training for new and existing users, including training related to new functionality, releases, and process changes.
  • Develop and maintain system training materials and knowledge resources.
  • Support system governance activities, user access reviews, audit requirements, and control validation.
  • Maintain current knowledge of Claims workflows, business requirements, and system capabilities.

Reporting, KPI Tracking & Group Reporting

  • Prepare, validate, and distribute Claims operational reporting.
  • Complete recurring Group reporting requirements and submissions.
  • Track and monitor Claims and Collections KPIs and related performance measures.
  • Analyze results to identify trends, exceptions, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain reporting methodologies, calculation documentation, and reporting controls.
  • Support reporting enhancements, dashboards, and reporting automation initiatives.
  • Perform validation and reconciliation activities to support accurate and consistent reporting.

Project Coordination & Continuous Improvement

  • Support Claims system initiatives, implementations, and operational improvement projects.
  • Coordinate project tasks, timelines, testing activities, dependencies, action items, risks, and status updates.
  • Gather and document business requirements and functional needs.
  • Support automation, workflow enhancement, and system-related process improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain project documentation, testing evidence, implementation records, and action logs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, operational efficiency, and the user experience.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Insurance, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Credit Insurance, Commercial Claims, Claims Operations, Business Systems Support, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting enterprise business applications, workflow systems, or case management platforms.
  • Experience with system testing, defect management, production support, and release activities.
  • Experience using Jira or a similar tool to document and track defects, enhancements, and project activities.
  • Experience creating and executing UAT plans and documenting results.
  • Experience creating and improving system-related processes, procedures, job aids, user guides, and training materials.
  • Experience preparing operational reports, KPI reporting, or management reporting.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, process improvements, or operational projects preferred.

Business Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of Claims processes, workflows, and operational requirements.
  • Knowledge of Credit Insurance products and Claims operations preferred.
  • Understanding of business process design, workflow management, automation, and operational controls.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical system solutions and process improvements.
  • Working knowledge of reporting methodologies, KPI tracking, and data validation practices.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, documentation, and follow-up skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to conduct training and communicate system concepts in clear business language.
  • Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technology teams.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational effectiveness and user experience.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to work effectively across functions and organizational levels.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and collaborative approach.

Let’s care for tomorrow.  

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow  

At Allianz Commercial (AzC), we are the global leader for insuring corporate and specialty risks in the Allianz Group.  Whether it’s aircraft, satellites, the world’s biggest ships and tallest building, cyber-attacks, or climate change impacts, AzC has the major risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.

We are seeking a property risk engineer consultant to support our West zone. Candidates must have a strong background performing site surveys and desktop work in the following: manufacturing, global (reverse flow), auto, construction, office buildings, HPR accounts, natural catastrophe exposures, supply chain, and fire protection. This role is remote, but candidates must physically reside in California (Central or Southern region), Arizona, or Nevada to support site survey/field work clients in these zones.

Your Team  

Allianz Commercial specializes in property insurance for middle-market and large companies, providing comprehensive coverage for complex and challenging risks. Through our global network, we offer tailored all-risks property and business interruption insurance.

Our Allianz Risk Consulting (ARC) team is made up of experienced engineers from a wide range of technical and scientific disciplines. The team provides a flexible range of risk consulting services, from natural hazards, fire safety, and human and organizational risk factors to in-depth analysis of industry operations, and financial exposures, across all industry sectors and risks. We also focus on delivering bespoke training plans to help our clients to optimize risk management procedures in the long term.

 

The Impact You Will Have  

Reporting to the Senior ARC Zone Team Leader, Responsible for providing loss control expertise, support and assistance to AzC and its customers, to assist Allianz underwriting in risk selection and retention. Provide ongoing co-ordination and monitoring of the loss control activity / servicing of assigned accounts & loss control survey work to assist with servicing of assigned accounts. Develop and maintain professional working relationships with Underwriting, Market Management, Communications, Claims, clients and brokers.  Maintain and enhance technical skills and expertise in respective field to support the business.

 

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:  

  • Independently support large corporate clients or clients with complex business occupancies and structures. Complete on-site field engineering survey assessments and plan reviews for underwriting and insureds, evaluating and summarizing exposures and controls. Complete account level overviews, desk top reviews and risk assessments to support zone and regional underwriting efforts, providing guidance and professional advice to clients and underwriting from both a location-level and a holistic, program-wide perspective.  Experience in a variety of occupancies, including both manufacturing and soft sectors, is necessary.
  • Survey large client operations in all business segments - obtain appropriate data, identify hazards, discuss findings with appropriate parties, and generate comprehensive risk engineering reports, recommendations, etc.  Work with underwriting, the client and broker to develop appropriate value-added solutions through tailored loss control programs and services, including development of scope and cost of risk consulting services. Conduct client stewardship meetings, promote and technically support ARC services and solutions, and foster client interaction with the objective of enhancing client resilience by mitigating property loss potentials.  Work with claims post loss as required.
  • Generate appropriate, technically accurate work product (Account Engineering annual account summaries, Prospect desktop reviews, risk engineering survey reports, recommendations, confirmation letters, etc.) as a result of account engineering, survey and service activities. Conduct all work in accordance with Account Service Instructions / Global Standard Operating Procedure requirements and reporting deadlines in accordance with departmental performance objectives.  Ensure appropriate data entry and quality in accordance with GSOP and management requirements.
  • This position requires good time management, organization and communication skills with both internal and external customers. The successful candidate must be able to balance field survey and prospect/account review and coordination workload demands, as well as regular meetings and interactions with clients and underwriting.  Daily workflow may require communication with third party service providers, clients, brokers, insured risk management department personnel, underwriting, peers, etc. Good, proactive communication skills, along with appropriate follow-up activities with relevant parties, are needed to maintain smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Assist Allianz Commercial and clients with respect to ongoing or specific projects. Support with relevant expertise additional ARC Services and be able to articulate and adapt these as potential solutions to client concerns especially in enhancing operational resilience.  Participate in Segment Expert Teams and other ARC initiatives, as well as ARC Global (inter-regional), cross-LoB and/or cross-functional projects as warranted.  Assist with training and presentations within ARC Corporate Property, other LoB's and in support of other functions (e.g. underwriting) as requested.

What You’ll Bring to the Role –  

  • Minimum 7 years’ strong engineering/technical expertise in Property Risk Engineering and Earthquake risks, as well as strong familiarity with a variety of occupancies and the associated hazards. Loss prevention engineering experience in an HPR type insurance environment relevant to the LoB (Property).
  • Bachelor's degree in Fire Protection Engineering or other Engineering type discipline. Or Bachelor's degree in another related discipline will be considered in conjunction with extensive technical expertise in the Property/HPR insurance industry.
  • Good knowledge and professional experience in various business sectors/occupancies, related to hazards and controls with focus on Earthquake related risks. Experience or background in managing/coordinating large global corporate property accounts within various occupancy sectors.
  • Experience in field and desktop evaluation and assessment of earthquake risks, including development of loss estimates and risk engineering solutions.
  • Experience in specialty industries (semi-conductor, chemical/pharmaceutical, etc.), exposures (BI/BCP/Supply Chain, emerging risks), or other lines of business is a plus.
  • Strong familiarity with Fire Protection guidelines, such as NFPA or FM Global.  Commitment to maintaining knowledge of developments and new technologies in field.
  • Ability to understand and apply technical loss control concepts to a variety of property risks and promote various ARC services as potential solutions for customer concerns.
  • Good knowledge of the MS365 environment, AI tools, data analytics and visualization techniques as well as NATCAT modeling principles.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work effectively in both home office and team environments.
  • Proactive change agent, adapting with ease and promoting among peers the adoption of new technologies, processes and working methods.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel throughout the US, with the potential for some Canada or international travel. 
  • The ability to utilize AI tools to support day-today tasks, improve efficiency, and contribute to data-driven decision-making is valuable. A willingness to learn and explore how AI can enhance your role and the broader organization is expected.

External applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship.

Let’s care for tomorrow. 

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow

At Allianz Commercial (AzC), we are the global leader for insuring corporate and specialty risks in the Allianz Group.  Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.  

We are looking for an Executive Underwriter Natural Resources & Construction - LatAm based in Miami.

The Impact You Will Have

The Executive Underwriter Natural Resources & Construction – LatAm will have deep expertise in Natural Resources and Construction (NR&C) risks, strong relationships with key brokers and clients in Miami and throughout the regional market, and the ability to leverage emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence solutions and underwriting agents, to enhance decision-making, efficiency, and operational excellence. You will act as a mentor, referral underwriter, and champion of underwriting governance through 4-eyes reviews and self-audit processes.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:

  • Participating in the development and execution of the regional Underwriting strategy for NR&C, including working closely with Distribution, Claims and other product lines to achieve key marketing strategies, including cross-selling.
  • Navigating evolving regulatory, geopolitical, environmental, and climate-related exposures in Latam.
  • Monitoring Natural Catastrophe Accumulation, ensuring an understanding of catastrophe modeling and interpretation of scenarios.
  • Serving as a senior technical referral point for complex underwriting decisions.
  • Underwriting new and renewal accounts within delegated authority to meet top and bottom line targets.
  • Applying advanced underwriting judgment to pricing, coverage structure, contract analysis, and capacity deployment.
  • Driving portfolio profitability through disciplined risk selection, accumulation management, and proactive portfolio steering.
  • Developing and maintaining strategic relationships with key brokers, clients, and risk managers across Miami and the broader Latin American market.
  • Positioning Allianz Commercial as a preferred market for NR&C risks.
  • Conducting regular broker visits, client meetings, stewardship reviews, and market-facing activities.
  • Collaborating closely with Distribution to support business development, retention, and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Representing Allianz Commercial at industry conferences, broker events, and technical forums.
  • Promoting underwriting excellence through consistent application of underwriting guidelines, authority levels, and risk appetite frameworks.
  • Leading and participating in structured peer reviews of complex accounts and large exposures.
  • Implement and maintain self-audit disciplines to ensure underwriting quality, documentation standards, and regulatory compliance.
  • Identify underwriting trends, lessons learned, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Champion the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence tools and digital underwriting capabilities, including driving automation opportunities that improve underwriting efficiency, consistency, and data quality.
  • Developing and leveraging AI-powered agents to support technical analysis, exposure assessment, policy reviews, portfolio monitoring, data extraction, and procedural compliance.
  • Partnering with the CTO team to identify use cases that enhance underwriting effectiveness and decision support.
  • Coaching and mentoring underwriters and associate underwriters on technical underwriting, broker management, and portfolio management.
  • Sharing market intelligence, technical expertise, and best practices across teams and regions.
  • Supporting training initiatives and contributing to underwriting capability development.
  • Driving a culture of accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 7+ years of proven expertise in underwriting profitable NR&C business, including demonstrated success managing complex accounts;
  • In depth understanding of regional/local MR&C insurance markets and competitor landscape;
  • Established broker network and strong market reputation within Miami and the regional marketplace;
  • Ability to assess risk inherent exposures and natural hazards relevant to NR&C;
  • Experience managing underwriting books, including analyzing trends and scenario plans from which portfolio strategies can be developed and implemented;
  • Analyzing current performance against various benchmarks with a view to ensure adequate progress and satisfactory performance, applying the knowledge of how the market operates and functions, the business needs and customer needs;
  • Ability to analyze highly complex data, from multiple sources, in detail, identifying and resolving issues before they transpire;
  • Experience utilizing advanced analytics, digital underwriting tools, or AI-enabled solution, including the ability to utilize AI tools to support day-to-day tasks, improve efficiency and contribute to data-driven decision making;
  • Ability to express ideas and messages clearly, both written and verbally;
  • Ability to build and foster relationships internally across the organization and externally with our broker partners;
  • Ability to speak Spanish and/or Portuguese required; and
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Petroleum, Mining, or related discipline).

External applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship.

The annualized base pay range for this role is $175,000 - $191,000. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

You will help lead the development, pricing, and strategic direction of Indexed Universal Life (IUL) products. Acts as one of our experts on IUL mechanics, index crediting structures, and actuarial modeling, ensuring products are competitive, sustainable, and aligned with business strategy. You will report to a credentialed senior leader on the Product Development team.

What you do:

  • Design and refine IUL products, including index crediting strategies, cap/participation structures, multipliers, fixed account design, riders, and survivorship variations.
  • Build, enhance, and validate pricing models using advanced actuarial techniques, ensuring accurate representation of product behavior.
  • Set and maintain assumptions for mortality, persistency, expenses, funding patterns, rider use, and index crediting performance.
  • You will develop pricing strategies that balance regulatory expectations, risk management considerations, and competitive market needs.
  • Incorporate requirements related to Standard Nonforfeiture Law (SNFL), Sections 7702 and AG 49 into product and pricing models, ensuring compliant and sustainable design parameters.
  • Conduct sensitivity testing, scenario modeling, and profitability analysis to evaluate product levers and support product positioning.
  • Collaborate with Investments to assess the feasibility and sustainability of index strategies, including option‑budget and hedging considerations.
  • Collaborate with Underwriting and Reinsurers to assess effectiveness and impacts of our underwriting practices
  • Monitor IUL market trends to guide product mix strategy, identify innovation opportunities, and ensure products stay competitive.
  • Partner with Product, Distribution, and Marketing to align product designs with customer needs and sales strategies.
  • Mentor actuarial staff on modeling, pricing frameworks, and IUL concepts..
  • Utilization of artificial intelligence tools and resources (e.g. generative AI)

What you bring:

  • 8+ years actuarial experience with background in life product development, including IUL.
  • Four-year degree required in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Engineering, or related field
  • Fellowship in the Society of Actuaries (FSA).
  • Expertise with actuarial modeling platforms and pricing methodologies.
  • Ability to translate technical modeling insights into clear product strategy recommendations.
  • Experience applying SNFL, 7702, and AG 49 requirements within product design, modeling, and pricing frameworks.
  • Experience with underwriting program analysis and assessing impacts to mortality trends
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively, ensuring long‑term project success across cross‑functional teams.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allianz Life, we are guided by our mission – we secure your future – and by our common goal of caring for tomorrow. What you do:

As an Analyst or Senior Analyst on the ALM team, you will be a key contributor supporting the management and analysis of the company’s assets and liabilities. Your role involves assisting with monthly regulatory analyses and quarterly ALM model runs, managing governance controls related to these key processes and helping to automate workflows. You will support strategic business initiatives by leveraging regulatory reporting activities in forward-looking ALM analyses that inform risk management and portfolio decisions.

This position offers an opportunity to deepen your knowledge of life insurance liability products, asset modeling, and portfolio management implications. You will own key “run” ALM processes becoming the expert in production as well as process maintenance and take steps towards process improvement. Your contributions will help the team shift toward more efficient, scalable, and integrated workflows to free capacity for deeper strategic insight.

ALLIANZ REINSURANCE OF AMERICA, INC.

AZRA is a specialty niche reinsurer, domiciled in California and licensed as an admitted insurer in 36 states (including District of Columbia), and is a qualified, accredited, or approved reinsurer in fifteen states. AZRA is a property casualty reinsurer which writes both prospective and legacy reinsurance. AZRA has specific expertise in run-off management of U.S. legacy insurance liabilities. AZRA has approximately 150 employees located nationwide with the majority working on a remote basis. AZRA is rated “AA-“ by Standard & Poor’s. As of December 31, 2025, AZRA had total admitted assets of USD $3.6 billion and policyholders’ surplus of $265 million.

  • Manage new loss assignments, reassignments and proper reserve setting.
  • Be able to perform coverage analysis, responsibilities to defend, tasks to indemnity, and choice of law.
  • Be able to identify issues that need to be resolved, what methods to use, including a focus on risk transfer and resolutions which create a best outcome.
  • Familiar with drafting of complex coverage letters, which include reservation of rights, disclaimers and responses to "push back" letters.
  • Develop legal strategy with counsel and manage GL/Excess litigation consistent with litigation guidelines. This includes both, Coverage Counsel and Defense Counsel.

  • Ideal candidate will have minimum of 5-10 years GL/Excess Claims experience a plus, will consider someone with demonstrated increasing responsibility in GL.
  • Technical background desired with an emphasis on coverage issue identification and policy interpretation.
  • Caseload primarily includes child abuse/sexual assault matters.
  • In-depth knowledge of liability policy language and coverage interpretation.
  • Work experience in a regulated environment and ability to ensure compliance with company procedures.
  • College degree.

Range $100,000 - $150,600

Job.JobDescription:
At Allianz Life, we are driven by our mission – we secure your future – and by our common goal of caring for tomorrow. What You Do:

Within the Model Risk Management Team (MRM) of the Corporate Risk Management Department (CRM), the Model Risk Analyst Manager/Associate Actuary is accountable for conducting independent validations of actuarial and capital models used for financial and regulatory reporting.

Operating under minimal oversight, the Model Risk Analyst Manager/Associate Actuary executes model validation activities in accordance with the approved validation plan, partnering with impacted departments (including Actuarial, Finance, Investments and other areas) and following Allianz Life and Allianz Group guidelines, as appropriate.

The Model Risk Analyst Manager/Associate Actuary ensures adherence to the model governance framework, monitors progress against validation plans, and addresses changes to promote sound model risk management practices.

The responsibilities of the role encompass three core areas: Model Validation, Model Governance, and Stakeholder Management.

1. Model Validation

  • Perform independent validations of actuarial and capital models, including new model validations, periodic revalidations, model change reviews, and ad hoc validation assignments:
    • Review model inputs, assumptions, and expert judgments.
    • Review model methodology and assess its mathematical, statistical, financial, and actuarial soundness.
    • Review model implementation and code to ensure alignment with the approved methodology.
    • Review model documentation to ensure completeness, transparency, and usability.
    • Review model outputs, controls, and reporting processes.
    • Design and perform validation testing, including back-testing, sensitivity testing, benchmarking, and code review procedures.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of model design, methodology, inputs, outputs, assumptions, limitations, and intended use.
  • Identify potential issues arising from validation activities, document findings, and align with model owners and team leadership on appropriate remediation plans and timelines based on risk and materiality.
  • Track remediation activities and collaborate with model owners to ensure identified findings are addressed in a timely manner.

2. Model Governance

  • Support the continuous improvement of model governance and model change management processes across various models and provide best-practice guidance to stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Maintain and enhance templates, standards, and documentation used by model validators.
  • Support the maintenance of the model inventory, including validation status, materiality, criticality, and other relevant model attributes, ensuring that all governance activities are appropriately documented.
  • Support the maintenance of the model findings inventory and monitor remediation progress.
  • Collaborate with model owners to understand proposed model changes and assess their impact on model validation requirements, model risk tiering, and validation plans.

3. Stakeholder Interaction

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across the organization.
  • Remain informed of model developments, assumption updates, methodology changes, and new tools through regular interaction with model owners and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Communicate validation conclusions, findings, and recommendations effectively to model owners, management, and other governance stakeholders.
  • Provide effective challenge and independent oversight while maintaining constructive relationships with model owners and business partners.

What You Bring :

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Financial Engineering, Physics or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in actuarial modeling, actuarial model validation, or a related actuarial function within the life insurance industry.
  • Hands-on experience with statutory reporting, statutory valuation and reserving methodologies, including models supporting CARVM, VM-20, VM-21, and other U.S. statutory reserve requirements.
  • Experience with Risk-Based Capital (RBC) modeling, reporting, and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of actuarial model governance frameworks, model risk management principles, and model validation practices.
  • Experience with actuarial modeling platforms and programming languages commonly used in the industry (e.g., RAFM, Python, R, SQL, VBA).
  • Demonstrated ability to independently assess model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, data quality, and model performance.
  • Ability to effectively challenge model owners and resolve technical, actuarial, and methodological disagreements through fact-based analysis and professional judgment, while building consensus on appropriate solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills, with the ability to effectively challenge model owners and communicate findings to senior management.
  • Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) or Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) designation preferred, but not required.

We are looking for an Aviation Senior Claims Specialist  (m/f/d), to be based in our, Alpharetta, GA or O’Fallon, MO locations.

Your Team

You will be working with a small but diverse team of claims professionals of various experience levels and backgrounds, in a collegial and supportive atmosphere that values individual strengths and encourages professional development and participation in industry leadership.

The Impact You Will Have

As an Aviation Senior Claims Specialist, you will proactively investigate, evaluate, and negotiate the resolution of assigned aviation hull claims and third party aircraft property damageon domestic matters. You’ll work in accordance with established best practices and within granted autonomy limits, developing and maintaining relationships with brokers, clients, and internal business partners. You’ll provide efficient claims handling within the team and collaborate with third-party service providers to achieve economical results and deliver high-quality service to all stakeholders.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigation & Reserving:
    • Investigating and adjusting claims that involve first party aviation hull losses and third party aircraft property damage on domestic matters;
    • Evaluating and addressing aviation hull coverage issues and determine appropriate reserving levels; and
    • Selecting and directing independent external service providers (e.g. Lawyers, Independent Adjusters, Experts).
  • Settlement:
    • Negotiate and resolve first party aviation hull and third party aviation property damage claims ensuring cost effective, service orientated solutions; and
    • Ensure claims are settled in accordance with settlement guidelines.
  • Referrals & Compliance:
    • Ensure claims are handled within authority limits and in line with company procedures.
    • Refer cases outside authority level, preparing referral documentation as needed.
    • Support claims management procedures for new business accounts.
  • Market Management:
    • Support acquisition of new business and retention of existing business.
    • Liaise with underwriters on market management initiatives.
    • Attend industry functions.
  • Relationship Management:
    • Represent the company externally and develop relationships with brokers, clients, and stakeholders.
    • Drive involvement of functional areas in claims handling (e.g., Underwriting, Operations).
    • Report and present complex loss and claims information internally and externally.
  • Claims Processing & Administration:
    • Maintain accurate claims records within claims administration systems.
    • Produce management information reports and identify loss trends.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 5 – 7 years - Detailed understanding of aviation hull claims handling process
  • 5 – 7 years - Proven track record in handling first party hull and third party liability aviation hull claims and damage issues.
  • Product and Coverages: Detailed understanding of aviation hull claims products, wordings, terms and conditions and coverages
  • Solid knowledge of aviation hull claim handling from notification to settlement and recovery.
  • Knowledge of reserving principles and practices.
  • Negotiation skills for resolution with claimants and/or lawyers.
  • Established relationships with brokers and strong presence in the local market (minimum 5+ years).
  • In-depth understanding of regional/local insurance markets and competitor landscape (minimum 5+ years).
  • Analytical skills to analyze non-complex data from multiple sources and resolve issues proactively.
  • Experience in applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to improve business processes and decision-making is highly beneficial.
  • Negotiation and conflict management skills, especially in contentious situations.
  • Bachelors Degree.
  • Insurance Industry Designations Preferred (Not required).
  • Pilot's license and/or Airframe & Powerplant Ratings preferred.
  • Proficiency in office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Fluent English skills, any other languages advantageous.

We are hiring a Portfolio Manager, Private Equity to be based in New York, to focus on our private equity efforts.

About our Private Equity Team:

With more than EUR 28 billion AuM in private equity, including primary fund commitments, co-investments and secondaries, Allianz Global Investors is one of the world’s leading institutional private equity investors. With offices in New York, Munich and Singapore, we partner with some of the world’s leading private equity funds.

Private Equity Responsibilities

  • Participate in sourcing and diligence efforts across primary, co-investment, and secondary opportunities, including diligence strategy, conducting analyses, and forming independent investment views.
  • Involved in investment decision-making, presenting recommendations to the Investment Committee (IC) and discussions, including addressing complex questions and articulating risk/return considerations.
  • Develop and execute portfolio construction strategy, including asset allocation, pacing, diversification, and manager selection aligned with overall investment objectives.
  • Maintain and expand senior relationships with fund managers, sponsors, and key market participants to enhance proprietary deal flow, market intelligence, and co-investment opportunities.
  • Oversee in-depth due diligence processes, including financial, operational, and qualitative assessments, ensuring rigor and consistency across investments.
  • Provide mentorship to junior investment professionals, ensuring high-quality analysis, professional development, and effective execution of investment processes.
  • Collaborate with global teams (Munich, Singapore, and other regions) and other asset classes (Private Credit) to align on investment strategy, share insights, and coordinate global investment activities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders (legal, tax, risk, ESG, etc.) to structure, execute, and monitor investments, ensuring alignment with firm policies and best practices.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives, including new product development, platform expansion, and exploration of emerging private equity strategies or geographies. This can include developing and executing the secondary activities and third party offering.
  • Utilization of artificial intelligence tools and resources (e.g. generative AI)

What you bring:

  • Typically 7–10+ years in private equity, fund-of-funds investing, investment banking, or a related field with demonstrated progression of responsibility.
  • Proven track record in leading investments across primaries, secondaries, and/or co-investments, including responsibility for investment decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in financial analysis and valuation, with the ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information into clear investment judgments.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability a plus, including influencing senior stakeholders, and driving outcomes in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience leading Investment Committee discussions and engaging with senior external partners.
  • Established network within the private equity ecosystem, including GPs, intermediaries, and advisors.
