Platform Architecture & Engineering

  • Design and implement Databricks architecture: workspace topology, Unity Catalog metastore design, cluster policies, compute pools, Delta Lake optimization (Z-ordering, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM scheduling, liquid clustering), and job orchestration strategy (Workflows, multi-task jobs, Delta Live Tables)
  • Architect Azure data landing zones: subscription/resource group hierarchy, hub-spoke networking, private endpoints, VNet integration for Databricks (VNet injection/secure cluster connectivity), ADLS Gen2 hierarchical namespace design, and Azure Data Factory/Synapse pipeline orchestration
  • Design Snowflake account-level architecture: multi-cluster warehouse strategy, resource monitor hierarchies, query performance tuning, data sharing/clean rooms, Snowpipe/Streams/Tasks for ingestion, and cost attribution models across business units
  • Define reference architectures and golden patterns for new data platform use cases; act as technical authority in architecture review boards

Access Management & Security Engineering

  • Design fine-grained authorization models: Unity Catalog row/column-level security and dynamic views, Snowflake RBAC hierarchies with functional/access roles separation, Azure RBAC + PIM for just-in-time privileged access
  • Engineer identity federation across platforms: Entra ID SCIM provisioning into Databricks/Snowflake, OAuth/SAML SSO, service principal and managed identity lifecycle management, secrets management (Azure Key Vault, Databricks secret scopes)
  • Lead security hardening: private connectivity (Private Link/Service Endpoints), network security group design, customer-managed encryption keys (CMK), audit log pipeline design (Unity Catalog audit logs, Snowflake ACCOUNT_USAGE, Azure Activity Logs) feeding into SIEM

At Allianz Commercial (AzC), we are the global leader for insuring corporate and specialty risks in the Allianz Group.  Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.  

We are looking for a Regulatory Filing Actuary, based in Alpharetta, Chicago or New York 

Your Team  

The Technical Pricing Certification team is part of the Global Pricing team at Allianz Commercial.  

The team is responsible for defining and delivering on Allianz Commercial’s strategic vision to be a technically excellent pricing team, with building a robust rate filing framework forming a key pillar. 

The Impact You Will Have  

As a Regulatory Filing Actuary, you will use your actuarial experience, knowledge of external market forces, and awareness of industry trends, to assist management with developing business strategies and with solving complex business problems.  You will be responsible for consulting with line of business experts to develop rates, rules, rating plans, actuarial support, and regulatory filing strategies for new and existing commercial products. You will complete required actuarial memoranda and exhibits for insurance department rate filings, respond to insurance department inquiries and objections to achieve successful outcomes and assist with the preparation of regulatory data call submissions. 

Some of your specific responsibilities could include: 

  • Keeping abreast of leading market practices and driving innovation. 

  • Promoting close collaboration and interaction with the various business areas (Group, UW, MM, CFO, etc.) to foster mutual understanding of how business developments impact actuarial drivers in the financials. 

  • Managing and driving forward own area of responsibility or project. 

  • Developing global actuarial pricing approaches and processes to rate filings, as well as enhancing actuarial models and analyses for rate filing purposes. 

  • Preparing and performing Actuarial rate filing analysis for assigned business area, including documentation, communication and explanation of results 

  • Peer reviewing work from other team members, as well as mentoring and providing guidance to junior team members. 

 What You’ll Bring to the Role 

  • Bachelor’s Degree (ideally Master’s) preferably in Mathematics, Statistics or other appropriate discipline or qualified by experience in related discipline; 

  • Accredited member of the Casualty Actuarial Society in good standing or are in progress toward accreditation; 

  • 3 years of actuarial pricing experience in the US, including at least 3 years of experience with standard commercial lines rate filings in states with complex actuarial and regulatory requirements; 

  • Excellent project management skills, including ability to maintain progress on multiple projects; 

  • Extensive computer skills (e.g., MS Office including VBA and relevant expert systems such as Matlab, R, SQL, Java, etc.); 

  • Ability to identify patterns and root causes in complex (e.g., ambiguous, from various sources) data and processes to rapidly distill key issues and provide insight in various situations, anticipating and resolving issues before they transpire; 

  • Ability to identify and initiate appropriate actions to remediate issues that can be abstract / ambiguous and follow through on their remediation. Ability to anticipate and resolve issues before they transpire; 

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with an ability to understand and convey information clearly and effectively with respect to the audience/level of management; 

  • Experience in applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to improve business processes and decision-making is highly beneficial. 

  • Ability to persuade and motivate others without direct authority. 

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship. 
 

The annualized base pay range for this role is $130,000 – $170,000. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

  • Manage the organization's most complex, strategic, or high-impact partner relationships.
  • Develop and maintain strong business relationships with partners, senior stakeholders, and cross functional leaders.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives and projects from planning through implementation and successful delivery for both internal and external partners.

  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Strong relationship-building and account management skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Allianz Partners does not accept unsolicited CV’s or approaches from agencies. We only work with partners on our approved supplier lists, under contract. Any unsolicited submission will not be considered.

Job.JobTitle: Complex Claims Analyst - Financial Lines - EPL
Job.JobDescription:
Let’s care for tomorrow. 

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow 

Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.   

We are looking for a Complex Claims Analyst – Financial Lines - EPL.  This role can be based in the Alpharetta, GA or Chicago, IL, offices.  We are also open to qualified remote candidates, who are not within a reasonable commuting distance of an Allianz Commercial North America office. 

Your Team  

You will be working with a small but diverse team of claims professionals of various experience levels and backgrounds, in a collegial and supportive atmosphere that values individual strengths and encourages professional development and participation in industry leadership. 

The Impact You Will Have  

The Complex Claims Analyst, will proactively investigate, evaluate, and negotiate resolution of assigned primary and excess EPL claims, in accordance with established best practices and assure claims are handled within granted autonomy limits.  The Complex Claims Analyst will also develop and maintain relationships with customers and brokers as well as internal business partners.   

Some of your specific responsibilities will include:                                          

  • Investigation  of Claims - Investigate claims that involve complex liability issues on primary and excess EPL claims, requiring qualified legal analysis. 

  • Evaluating and Reserving of Claims -  evaluating liability and analyzing damages; determining  appropriate reserving levels; and selecting and directing independent external service providers (e.g. Lawyers, Independent Adjusters, Experts). 

  • Analyzing Coverage – analyzing coverage to determine if there are coverage issues; communicating coverage positions to insureds and brokers.  

  • Settlement - Negotiating and resolving complex EPL claims ensuring cost effective, service orientated solutions. 

  • Ensuring claims are settled in accordance with settlement guidelines. 

  • Referrals and Compliance - Ensuring all claims handled within authority limits, and in line with AzC Claims complex procedures and claims handling guidelines. 

  • Referring cases outside of authority level, preparing referral documentation and materials as appropriate; and 

  • Supporting the establishment of claims management procedures on new business accounts in association with clients, brokers and loss adjusters. 

  • Market Management - Proactively supporting acquisition of new business and retention of existing business.

Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.

Bring your environmental claims expertise to complex risks that matter.

At Allianz Commercial, claims is more than resolving losses. It’s about bringing technical expertise, sound judgment, and strong relationships together to help our clients navigate challenging situations.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Environmental Claims Specialist to join our team in Chicago, IL; Alpharetta, GA; or O’Fallon, MO. If you have deep liability claims experience, a strong understanding of Environmental insurance products and coverage, and enjoy working through complex legal and claims issues, this could be an exciting opportunity to take the next step in your career.

Your Team

You’ll join a small, diverse team of claims professionals with a variety of experience levels and backgrounds. Our collegial and supportive environment values individual strengths, encourages professional development, and provides opportunities to participate in industry leadership.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Environmental Claims Specialist, you will proactively investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve assigned claims in accordance with established best practices and within granted authority levels.

You’ll combine technical claims expertise with strong relationship management, working closely with customers, brokers, internal business partners, and third-party service providers to achieve economical outcomes while delivering high-quality service.

Some of your specific responsibilities will include:

Investigation & Reserving

  • Investigate domestic and multinational claims involving complex legal issues.
  • Evaluate and address coverage issues and establish appropriate reserve levels.
  • Select and direct external service providers, including attorneys, independent adjusters, and experts.

Claims Resolution

  • Negotiate and resolve claims with a focus on cost-effective, service-oriented solutions.
  • Ensure claims are settled in accordance with established settlement guidelines.

Claims Processing & Administration

  • Maintain accurate and timely claims records for designated accounts within Allianz Commercial claims administration systems.
  • Produce management information reports, including major claims movement reporting, and proactively identify loss trends.

Referrals & Compliance

  • Manage claims within granted authority limits and in accordance with established claims procedures and guidelines.
  • Refer matters outside designated authority levels and prepare appropriate referral documentation and supporting materials.
  • Support the development of claims management procedures for new business accounts in collaboration with clients, brokers, and loss adjusters.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers, clients, third-party adjusters, and other key stakeholders.
  • Partner across Claims, Underwriting, Operations, and other functional areas to support effective claims handling.
  • Clearly communicate and present complex and contentious claims and loss information to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Positively represent Allianz Commercial in the marketplace.

Market Engagement

  • Support the acquisition of new business and retention of existing business.
  • Partner proactively with underwriters on market-management initiatives.
  • Represent Allianz Commercial at relevant industry functions.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

You’re an experienced claims professional who combines strong technical knowledge with sound judgment, curiosity, and an ability to build trusted relationships.

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring:

  • 7–10 years of claims experience, with a proven track record handling liability claims involving coverage and damage issues.
  • Expert knowledge of Environmental insurance products and portfolios, including coverage and its application throughout the claims adjustment process.
  • Established relationships with brokers at the peer-group level and a strong presence within the local market.
  • In-depth understanding of regional and local insurance markets and the competitive landscape.
  • Detailed understanding of relevant legal and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience operating effectively within a complex, global matrix organization.
  • The ability to use AI tools to support day-to-day activities, improve efficiency, and contribute to data-driven decision-making.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.

What’s in It for You?

This is an opportunity to bring your claims expertise to a specialized area where technical knowledge, judgment, and relationship management all make a difference.

At Allianz Commercial, you’ll have the opportunity to work with experienced claims professionals, collaborate across disciplines, engage with the insurance marketplace, and continue developing your expertise while handling challenging domestic and multinational claims.

Compensation

The annualized base pay range for this role is $117,217–$197,722. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. Actual salary may be above this range and will be determined based on several factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, as well as the candidate’s skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

Base pay is one component of the Allianz Commercial total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

Ready to Bring Your Environmental Claims Expertise to Allianz Commercial?

If you’re an experienced claims professional who enjoys navigating complex issues, building strong partnerships, and delivering thoughtful claims solutions, we want to hear from you.

The "Innovation Partner" position is integral to empowering Allianz's innovation teams by providing expert guidance and support throughout their innovation journey. This role focuses on making the lives of innovation teams easier by offering tailored coaching, addressing impediments, and facilitating smooth progress in innovation sprints. The Innovation Partner is committed to collecting and aggregating learnings from these sprints to identify insights and opportunities for systemic improvements. By proactively suggesting changes, the Innovation Partner enables faster and more effective innovation processes. Embracing innovation methodologies and fostering a culture of experimentation and learning are essential, as they drive the continuous evolution of ideas and solutions.

What you do:

  • Provide innovation methodology and coaching to teams, ensuring they have the tools and guidance needed to succeed in innovation sprints.
  • Take full ownership of the Innovation Council, AzT's internal innovation process modelled after venture capital practices. This involves screening ideas, preparing promising concepts for presentation to the Coucil, and providing coaching to teams that receive seed funding from the Council.
  • Accompany teams throughout their innovation journey, simplifying their path by resolving obstacles and ensuring smooth progress. This may also involve integrating team members from outside the Allianz Group, such as those from startups.
  • Collect and aggregate learnings from innovation sprints to identify patterns, insights, and areas for improvement.
  • Make proactive suggestions on systemic changes to enable innovation to happen faster and better within the organization.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and learning, encouraging teams to experiment and innovate.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and integration of innovation efforts across the organization.
  • Communicate insights and recommendations to senior leadership and other stakeholders to drive strategic decision-making

What you bring:

  • Demonstrated experience in coaching, innovation management, or a similar role, with expertise in methodologies such as Human-Centered Design, Open Innovation, and Lean Startup.

Job.JobDescription:
Let’s care for tomorrow. 

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow 

Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.   

We are looking for a Claims Manager – Excess and Surplus (m/f/d), based in our Alpharetta, GA or Chicago, IL locations. 

Are you an experienced commercial claims leader with deep expertise in Excess & Surplus liability? This is an opportunity to lead a team of skilled claims professionals, guide the resolution of complex losses, and build strong partnerships with brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders. 

As the Claims Manager, Excess Liability, you will lead a team responsible for unsupported umbrella and excess claims involving liability, automobile, product, and Alternative Risk Transfer coverages. You will combine technical claims leadership with team development, operational oversight, and relationship management in a complex global organization.  

What You’ll Do 

Lead and develop a high-performing claims team 

  • Lead and manage Claims Specialists handling complex umbrella and excess liability losses. 

  • Establish clear team direction, priorities, and performance goals. 

  • Delegate work effectively and provide technical guidance on claim referrals. 

  • Coach, train, and mentor team members, including less-experienced claims professionals. 

  • Manage the team’s cost-center budget within established plans.  

Oversee complex claim investigation and resolution 

  • Guide claims through the full lifecycle, from initial notification and coverage determination through settlement and recovery. 

  • Evaluate loss exposures and establish appropriate reserves. 

  • Select and direct independent service providers, including loss adjusters. 

  • Review contentious, high-value, and complex claims with management and internal stakeholders to gain additional perspectives and support effective decisions. 

  • Negotiate claim resolutions with claimants, attorneys, and other involved parties. https://allianzmsnam-my.sharepoint.com/personal/sonya_daies_agcs_allianz_com/_layouts/15/Doc.aspx?sourcedoc={C0A7FDB4-F4DD-4A45-9EEF-A0A920B8107B}&file=Excess Claims Manager.docx prework for posting.docx&action=default&mobileredirect=true 

Promote strong claims governance 

  • Ensure claims are handled within established authority levels and in accordance with applicable claims standards, procedures, and guidelines. 

  • Prepare clear and comprehensive referral documentation for claims that exceed delegated authority. 

  • Maintain accurate claim records within designated claims administration systems. 

  • Support claims-management procedures for new business accounts in collaboration with clients, brokers, and loss adjusters. 

  • Conduct audits of external service providers when appropriate. 

Deliver meaningful business insights 

  • Oversee the timely preparation of management information reports, including monthly reporting on significant claim movements. 

  • Identify and communicate emerging loss trends. 

  • Apply strong analytical judgment to information from multiple sources and translate findings into appropriate conclusions and actions.  

Build influential market relationships 

  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with brokers, clients, third-party adjusters, and other key stakeholders. 

  • Support the acquisition of new business and retention of existing accounts, including participation in client and broker negotiations. 

  • Represent the organization positively in the external market. 

  • Collaborate across Claims, Underwriting, Operations, market-management functions, and other internal areas to support effective claim outcomes.  

What You’ll Bring 

  • Bachelor’s degree. 

  • Strong commercial Excess & Surplus industry knowledge. 

  • Solid understanding of the claims-handling process, from notification through settlement and recovery. 

  • Three to five years of people-management experience, including leading claims professionals within a complex, global matrix organization. 

  • Strong knowledge of reserving principles and practices, along with a robust understanding of reinsurance and coinsurance. 

  • Understanding of relevant insurance products, policy wordings, terms, conditions, and coverages. 

  • Knowledge of the legal and regulatory frameworks affecting commercial claims. 

  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate effectively with claimants, attorneys, brokers, clients, and other stakeholders. 

  • Strong communication, presentation, relationship-building, quality-management, and analytical capabilities.  

  • Experience in applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to improve business processes and decision-making is highly beneficial. 

Why This Opportunity Stands Out 

This role offers the opportunity to: 

  • Lead and develop a specialized commercial claims team. 

  • Influence the handling of significant and technically complex losses. 

  • Partner closely with underwriting, operations, brokers, clients, and external service providers. 

  • Contribute to business retention, market relationships, and continuous improvement. 

  • Bring together technical expertise, sound judgment, and people leadership in a visible management position.  

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you are a collaborative claims leader who can confidently navigate complex Excess & Surplus losses, develop talented professionals, and build trusted market relationships, we invite you to explore this opportunity in Alpharetta, GA or Chicago, IL.  

The annualized base pay range for this role is $125,417 - $189,483. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package.  As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

We are seeking an enthusiastic Inside Sales Associate to join our Travel Sales team. In this role, you will engage with customers who are actively seeking travel insurance solutions, helping them understand their coverage options and select the protection that best fits their travel plans. Through consultative selling and exceptional customer service, you will play a key role in delivering a worry-free travel experience for our customers.

At Allianz Partners, we recognize that our strength lies in the people we hire. If you're passionate about sales, customer service, and helping customers travel with confidence, we'd love to hear from you.

What you will do:

  • Respond to inbound customer inquiries via phone and email with professionalism and empathy.
  • Identify customer needs and provide optimal or alternative product solutions to meet those needs.

  • Responsible for in-depth knowledge of products and services offered, learning about products and staying up to date on new product or policy changes.

We are looking for an Executive Underwriter for our Property Underwriting Team. This will be a hybrid role based in Chicago, IL. 

Your Team 

Allianz Commercial (AzC) specializes in corporate property insurance for the most complex and challenging risk exposures in more than 200 countries and territories. With a focus on larger international risk portfolios, we offer tailor-made 'All Risks' property damage and business interruption insurance through our Allianz Commercial Property network. 

Our experience speaks for itself, insuring the majority of Allianz Commercial Property Fortune 500 companies, managing over 1000 Allianz Commercial property insurance programs, and fielding an underwriting team averaging over 20 years' experience, backed up by a worldwide team of risk consultants and claims specialists. 

When it comes to underwriting insurance products for well-known famous sports venues, sports/entertainment facilities, major airlines, retail/wholesale companies, banks and manufacturers, we do it all! 

The Impact You Will Have 

As an Executive Underwriter, you will play a central role in shaping the profitability and growth of our regional underwriting portfolio. You will be a trusted leader within the team, guiding and developing senior underwriters while managing some of our most complex and high-profile accounts. Your expertise will directly influence how we assess risk, build lasting broker and client relationships, and drive strategic decisions that keep our business competitive and forward-looking. This is an opportunity to bring your deep market knowledge and underwriting judgment to a role where your contributions truly matter. 

Some of your responsibilities could include: 

Underwriting Strategy & Leadership 

  • Contribute to the development and execution of the regional underwriting strategy for your Line of Business 

  • Train, develop, and coach experienced staff, including Senior Underwriters 

  • Manage complex referrals from underwriters and spoke offices, re-underwriting complex business as appropriate 

  • Delegate work effectively across the team 

Underwriting Profitable Business 

  • Underwrite new and renewal accounts to meet top and bottom line targets 

  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with producers while proactively managing capacity 

  • Evaluate Natural Catastrophe Accumulation exposures, including catastrophe modeling and scenario interpretation 

  • Underwrite International Insurance Programs for relevant Lines of Business 

Relationship Management 

  • Positively represent Allianz Commercial in the external market 

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Market Management, Risk Consulting, Claims, and Operations 

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key producers, clients, and stakeholders such as risk managers 

Policy Documentation & Administration 

  • Ensure accurate and timely policy documentation is issued to or by producers 

  • Maintain complete and organized files for each risk and transaction 

  • Support the completion of policy administration and credit control processes 

Market Management 

  • Proactively support the acquisition of new business and retention of existing accounts, including client and producer negotiations 

  • Collaborate closely with Market Management on strategic initiatives 

Supporting Key Business Initiatives 

  • Participate in and contribute to key projects across the organization 

  • Serve as a referral point and mentor for Associate Underwriters and Underwriters 

  • Engage in cross-regional activities as needed 

What You'll Bring to the Role 

  • 7 to 10+ years of underwriting experience with a proven track record of underwriting profitable business in your Line of Business; similar property industry experience (e.g., broker or risk management) will also be considered 

  • Deep knowledge of your Line of Business products, portfolio dynamics, and the regional/local insurance market and competitive landscape 

  • Established broker and market relationships at the peer group level, with a strong reputation in the local market 

  • Strong risk assessment skills, including the ability to evaluate inherent exposures and natural hazards relevant to your Line of Business 

  • Portfolio management expertise, with the ability to analyze trends, develop scenario plans, and implement portfolio strategies 

  • Pricing and performance analysis skills, with experience benchmarking and evaluating portfolio performance 

  • Excellent analytical abilities, including comfort working with highly complex data from multiple sources 

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly express ideas in writing and verbally, and to deliver compelling, audience-winning presentations 

  • Influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to persuade and motivate others without executive authority 

  • Proficiency in standard office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) 

  • Experience in applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to improve business processes and decision-making is highly beneficial. 

  • Bachelor's degree preferred in Economics, Finance, Insurance Management, or Business Administration 

The annualized base pay range for this role is $129,741 - $196,017. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package.  As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

We are looking for Liability Zone Leader – West based in the Western Region

Your Team:
The North American Liability team offers a wide range of liability insurance solutions. These include National Accounts Excess, Multinational, Reverse Flow, Environmental Liability and some Primary General Liability in the United States and Canada.

The Impact You Will Have:
Reporting to the Head of National Accounts, Liability, the Liability Zone Leader – West will:

  • Lead a team of underwriters/team leads to underwrite profitable new and renewal business to meet Liability targets regionally and/or globally;
  • Lead team in negotiating participation, pricing and terms and conditions for large/critical clients;
  • Take ownership of large/critical accounts/clients and will have ultimate responsibility for accounts within the team;
  • Lead and manage a team, including training and development and act as the referral point for other underwriters; and
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with brokers and clients.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:

  • Managing a team of underwriters, including delegating tasks to team in order to achieve overall results, managing/supervising portfolio and acting as point of referral and managing cost center budget within plan.
  • Contributing to the development and execution of the regional underwriting strategy for Liability.
  • Managing referrals from underwriters and spokes and re-underwriting complex business as appropriate.
  • Responsibility  for zonal performance within National Accounts sub-Lob and acting as a "champion" for any matters relating to the sub-LoB.
  • Underwriting oversight on large/critical new and renewal accounts to meet top and bottom line targets (regional and/or global), including negotiating participation, pricing and terms and conditions with brokers, as well as proactively managing capacity.
  • Underwriting and evaluating Natural Catastrophe Accumulation, ensuring an understanding of catastrophe modelling and interpretation of scenarios for Liability, as well as underwriting International Insurance Programs for Liability.
  • Overseeing underwriting in line with Liability governance framework (e.g., underwriting authorities, global MSU, Underwriting Guidelines, and Rules and Principles).
  • Ensuring contract certainty is achieved on all accounts at time of inception.
  • Ensuring utilization of global/regional pricing tools.
  • Ensuring placing and binding of FAC Reinsurance prior to policy inception.
  • Ensuring adherence to reinsurance treaty terms/conditions.
  • Proactively supporting acquisition of new business and retention of existing business (including client and producer negotiations where necessary) and liaising with Distribution on market management initiatives.
  • Positively representing Allianz Commercial externally to the market.
  • Proactively driving involvement of functional areas in Underwriting process, including Distribution, ARC, Claims, and Operations.
  • Developing and maintaining strong relationships with key producers and clients and other relevant stakeholders (e.g., risk managers).

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in underwriting profitable Liability business, including specialized expert understanding of sub-LoB products and portfolio;
  • Recognized, well-established long term relationship building with brokers at peer group level and within the local market;
  • Specialized understanding of regional/local Liability insurance markets and competitor landscape, including global elements;
  • Understanding of legal and regulatory framework;
  • Ability to assess risk inherent exposures and natural hazards relevant to Liability;
  • Ability to analyze current performance against benchmarks applying how the market operates and functions, the business needs and customer needs;
  • Experience designing, developing and implementing consistent, robust wordings;
  • Robust understanding of policy administration life cycle, information collection, policy issuance, premium bookings, credit control, and cancellation;
  • Ability to analyze highly complex data, from multiple sources, in detail, identifying and resolving issues before they transpire;
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, with an ability to influence others;
  • Experience with MS Office tools;
  • Significant experience in leadership and development of direct teams, including coaching, mentoring and developing team members and performance assessment;
  • Ability to persuade and motivate others to act, without executive authority;
  • A deep knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights to shape strategic decisions and drive innovation across the organization; and
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Economics, Finance, Insurance Management or Business Administration.

Our Actuarial Reserving team is currently looking for a Senior Actuarial Expert based in any of the following location: Chicago, Toronto, OR London.  This is a hybrid role.

Your Team
Allianz Commercial employs the brightest, most passionate people in the insurance industry.  We’d love for you to join our growing team!  We invest in our people through training and professional development while supporting you along the way—all so you can meet your career goals. To us, the most important measure of our success is yours.  The CFO actuarial reserving team is a key unit in the broader CFO function and strategic contributor to the long-term success of Allianz Commercial.  We are an experienced, diverse and hardworking team and we look forward to welcoming you onboard.

The Impact You Will Have
You will join the Actuarial Reserving team as an experienced professional, ensuring robust reserves are held by doing both independent actuarial analysis and actively collaborating with various stakeholders.  You will derive forward- looking loss ratio views to inform business steering and quarterly closing.  You will be comfortable and confident working with colleagues around the globe and presenting up to C-Suite level.  Regular stakeholders will include:  underwriting, claims and pricing teams – working together to understand trends, business mix movement and market development and ESG topics.

As a Senior Actuarial Expert, you will ensure that best in class actuarial methods and techniques are adopted and implemented.  Using your experience, you will address new and previously unknown challenges such as inflation impact on reserves.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:
•    Ensure that adequate loss reserves are estimated for your line(s) of business on IFRS 17 basis.
•    Support the Actuarial Function team in derivation of a normalized loss ratio, and where relevant validate selected and booked NLR via annual reserve reviews.
•    Support the reserving team in monthly closings and contribute to the presentation for the Loss Reserve Committee. 
•    Drive innovation and efficiency in all our processes, particularly to improve the quality in forecasts, achieving a high predictability.
•    Peer review work from other team members and provide training and guidance to junior colleagues.                                        

What You’ll Bring to the Role
•    Minimum 8 years business experience in the P&C industry, preferably spanning multiple actuarial areas with a focus in Reserving
•    ACAS
•    Job specific knowledge with regard to market dynamics, standard concepts and approaches, regulations/compliance standards, reporting requirements (e.g., reinsurance and underwriting knowledge, reserving techniques, data flows, etc.)
•    Finance and Insurance know-how (ideally P&C) as well as a healthy curiosity to understand complexities inherent in an insurance group (consolidation processes, legal vs management view) allowing for cross-departmental thinking and acting
•    Ability to identify patterns and root causes in complex (e.g. ambiguous, from various sources) data and processes to rapidly distil key issues and provide insight in various situations
•    Basic balance sheet understanding on IFRS 4 and IFRS 17 bases, and experience of closing and reporting related topics
•    High level of analytical ability, capable of clearly communicating results and findings in a clear and concise manner
•    Proficiency in R/Alteryx/Tableau/Python is a plus
•    Experience in applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to improve business processes and decision-making is preferred

Job.JobTitle: Portfolio Steering and CAT Risk Analyst - Marine
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Risk Manager, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
If you are a current AzC employee and wish to refer a candidate for this role, please click here for instructions and eligibility criteria   

Cluster:  Senior Associate

  

Let’s care for tomorrow.  

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow  

At Allianz Commercial (AzC), we are the global leader for insuring corporate and specialty risks in the Allianz Group.  Whether it’s aircraft, satellites, the world’s biggest ships and tallest building, cyber-attacks, or climate change impacts, AzC has the major risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.

We are seeking a Portfolio Steering and CAT Risk Analyst for our Marine line of business. The specific nature of Marine risks, including static and non-static exposures (modelled and non-modelled exposures) requires management within a consistent global framework. Rapidly evolving exposures, risk mitigation approaches, tools, processes, and research demand continuous adaptation and up-to-date expertise. Detailed business monitoring and portfolio steering activities require sustained involvement and analytical focus.

This role is vital to understanding exposure hotspots, market changes that affect a portfolio, and related trends/changes within the competitor landscape. The current and future initiatives must be achieved. This role will work a hybrid schedule and can be based in one of our following offices: New York, Chicago, Alpharetta, O’Fallon, or Toronto.

Your Team  

Allianz Commercial (AzC) is one of the largest marine insurers in the world. Our unparalleled depth and breadth of capabilities sets us apart in the industry and provides an unmatched level of expertise. Our comprehensive portfolio of customizable products means we can meet a wide range of coverage needs by providing innovative solutions. Our appetite for challenging projects knows no bounds, offering our clients a wide range of options.

Our team combines portfolio steering expertise with advanced catastrophe risk analytics to drive informed decision-making across our Marine line of business. We are responsible for strategic portfolio monitoring, natural catastrophe and terrorism portfolio modelling, accumulation management, data quality oversight, and reinsurance-related analytics. Using cutting-edge tools such as Foundry and industry-leading CAT modelling platforms, we collaborate closely with underwriters, actuaries, and reinsurance teams to ensure our Marine portfolio remains resilient, profitable, and well-positioned for growth. Our strength lies in combining years of technical experience with market-leading financial expertise. This enables us to underwrite the largest and most challenging projects, providing our clients with unparalleled protection and peace of mind.

The Impact You Will Have  

Reporting to the Global Product Leader - Cargo, this position will identify and quantify global Marine NatCat accumulation risks, including modelled and non‑modelled exposures across all relevant Sub Lines, to support effective risk mitigation and underwriting controls. Apply catastrophe modelling expertise to meet team objectives and guide others. Collaborate closely with Product Leaders, the CUO Technical Office, and Regional Marine Underwriting to enhance NatCat underwriting strategy and controls. Maintain underwriting tools that enable assessment of individual risk exposures, portfolio impacts, and capacity steering, including risk visualization, while ensuring alignment with authority frameworks. Partner with NatCat Management and CFO Risk Management to ensure consistency with overall accumulation strategy, accurate reporting of Marine values, and appropriate reflection of risks in pricing and model development.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:  

  • Develop Nat Cat Underwriting tools and reports specific for Marine both to enable portfolio steering and to support the Underwriting process. Run Catastrophe loss modelling reports and prepare regular and ad-hoc data extracts and reports for the monitoring of AzC Marine global loss potential - including portfolio analyses, CAT limit monitoring (AzC Group and AzC internal limits), supporting global business steering and providing input to ensure adequate Reinsurance protection. Cooperate closely with the Product Leaders, Technical Office and Regional Underwriting specialists. Support the definition of the risk appetite and capacity steering.
  • Serve as business owner for IT and data initiatives, leading end‑to‑end scoping, prioritization, and delivery of reporting and transformation projects—ensuring solutions such as Power BI dashboards directly support Marine underwriting and portfolio steering strategy while advancing the data platform landscape
  • Provide on the spot consultancy and translate or explain CAT Modeling results and reports to Marine Underwriters; Communication and explanation of portfolio impact. Evaluate and make recommendations to ensure Marine specific requirements and exposures are most appropriately reflected and cater for the special nature of Marine. Training & education of the Marine Underwriting community with minimal guidance.
  • Collaboration with the Marine community and other relevant functions (Actuarial, Risk Management, Reinsurance, Nat Cat Capacity Steering Desk - NCCSD, ARC, Claims, etc.) to support business steering and portfolio management and Data Quality improvements with minimal guidance.
  • Maintain Marine Portfolio Steering and NatCat underwriting tools, providing ongoing support to the underwriting community
  • Drive innovation and change through managing the evaluation process relating to modelling upgrades as well as developing and enhancing Marine specific tools. All upgrade and change activities include technical and portfolio impact analyses and complete documentations.

 

 

What You’ll Bring to the Role –  

  • Minimum 5 years’ professional insurance and/or reinsurance experience and a minimum 3 years’ understanding of underwriting practice for Marine business on a global basis.
    • Ideal candidate will be well versed in multiple inland marine and cargo products such as: construction, transportation, miscellaneous coverages, and property (i.e., builder’s risk, contractor’s equipment, motortruck cargo, physical damage, mono line property for small to medium risks, and scheduled property floaters), international transit, stock through-put, project cargo (including delay in start-up) and tailored coverages.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferably in Insurance and Risk Management, Geosciences, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Practical experience and familiarity with multiple vendor tools
  • Project Management experience: Ability to manage projects (milestone and task planning, managing resources, project controlling, monitoring, and reporting, moderation techniques) and to develop solutions while considering complex stakeholder structures and requirements.
  • Experience using Catastrophe Modeling Software (RMS, AIR, EQECAT) and GIS (Geographical Information Systems) applications.
  • Strong computer skills, particularly Excel & VBA (knowledge in database applications is an advantage).
  • Multi-task profile with focus on effective use of own resources and handling of competing priorities under tight deadlines
  • Professional communication, technical depth and ability to communicate with required levels / functions internally and externally in a global environment.
  • Ability to deliver results, develop talent and performance and drive innovation and change
  • Lead oneself and others in-line with agreed organizational strategic orientation
  • The ability to utilize AI tools to support day-today tasks, improve efficiency, and contribute to data-driven decision-making is valuable. A willingness to learn and explore how AI can enhance your role and the broader organization is expected.

External applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship.

The annualized base pay range for this role is $101,364 to $153,200. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by several factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials, and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Complex Claims Analyst - Management Liability - Private and Public D&O
Job.JobDescription:
Let’s care for tomorrow. 

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow 

Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses.   

We are looking for a Senior Complex Claims Analyst – Management Liability - Private D&O and Public D&O.  This role will be based in our Alpharetta, GA or New York, NY office. 

Your Team 

Join a talented and diverse team of claims professionals who bring a wide range of experience, perspectives, and expertise. You'll work in a collaborative and supportive environment that values individual strengths, encourages continuous learning, and provides opportunities for professional growth and industry leadership. 

The Impact You Will Have 

As a Senior Complex Claims Analyst, you will play a critical role in managing and resolving complex primary and excess Private D&O and Public D&O claims. You will proactively investigate, evaluate, and negotiate claim resolutions while ensuring compliance with established best practices and authority guidelines. In this highly visible role, you'll also cultivate strong relationships with brokers, clients, and internal business partners, helping to deliver exceptional service and strengthen Allianz Commercial's reputation in the marketplace. 

Some of your specific responsibilities will include: 

  • Complex Claims Management – Investigate, evaluate, and manage complex primary and excess Private D&O and Public D&O claims, including those involving significant liability and coverage considerations. 

  • Coverage Analysis & Reserving – Assess coverage positions, determine appropriate reserve levels, and engage and oversee external service providers such as defense counsel, independent adjusters, and subject matter experts. 

  • Strategic Resolution & Settlement – Negotiate and resolve complex claims with a focus on achieving timely, cost-effective, and customer-focused outcomes. 

  • Advanced Negotiation – Collaborate effectively with claimants, attorneys, brokers, and other stakeholders to reach successful claim resolutions. 

  • Claims Excellence – Ensure claims are handled and settled in accordance with company guidelines, best practices, and regulatory requirements. 

  • Compliance & Authority Management – Maintain adherence to Allianz Commercial's claims procedures, authority limits, and governance standards, escalating matters as appropriate. 

  • Relationship Management – Serve as a trusted partner to clients, brokers, and key stakeholders while positively representing Allianz Commercial in the market. 

What You'll Bring to the Role 

  • 5–7 years of claims handling experience, including a demonstrated track record managing liability claims with increasing complexity. 

  • Established relationships with brokers and a strong professional presence within the insurance marketplace. 

  • Deep understanding of liability insurance products, policy coverage, and claim adjustment practices. 

  • Strong knowledge of regional insurance markets, industry trends, and the competitive landscape. 

  • Experience in applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to improve business processes and decision-making is highly beneficial. 

  • Communication & Presentation Skills – Ability to clearly and confidently communicate complex issues, both verbally and in writing, while effectively promoting Allianz Commercial's claims capabilities. 

  • Technical Expertise – Detailed knowledge of Public D&O and Private D&O products, policy wordings, terms and conditions, and coverage applications. 

  • Claims Management Knowledge – Comprehensive understanding of the claims lifecycle, from initial notification through settlement and recovery. 

  • Writing Excellence – Strong written communication skills with the ability to prepare clear, concise, and impactful correspondence and coverage analyses. 

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree preferred. 

The annualized base pay range for this role is $130,870 – $227,965.  The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by several factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package.  As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

At Allianz Asset Management we act with integrity, take ownership and responsibility and care for employee wellbeing. Would you like to be a part of the financial and governance holding for Allianz Group‘s asset management business? Then, join us as an IT Audit Manager and become a valued member of our IT Internal Audit team based in Newport Beach / New York, United States.

The IT Audit Manager, reporting to the Head of IT Audit, is a highly experienced senior specialist role with in-depth auditing experience in Digitalization and IT.

What you will do

  • Responsibility for risk-based planning of the annual audit plan and the risk assessments, and successful execution of the audit plan and ad-hoc engagements.
  • Build-up and maintain relationships with the auditees and become a recognized partner to the business also on senior stakeholder level.
  • Plan, lead, manage and supervise complex large-scale, cross regional and cross-functional audit assignments, supervise audit projects (IT and integrated audits), define risk-based audit areas (both IT and business), audit infrastructure and network, processes, and control systems, business transactions, as well as workflows with very limited supervision.
  • Determine deficiencies and vulnerabilities to be remedied, analyze audit results, proposals for solutions, lead closing meetings and performing audit follow-up activities, including assessing the sufficiency and timeliness of remediation actions.
  • Collaborate on departmental and inter-organizational projects.
  • Ensure compliance with the audit policies and the respective standards (independence, integrity, confidentiality, truth and fairness, security, economy, system conformity).
  • Support and review auditor’s work (audit preparation, interviews, tests, evidence gathering, report writing and validation preparation).
  • Be a center of Excellence for IT Infrastructure & Network Management, Information Security, Cyber Security, and Public Cloud, but also IT General Controls, integrated audits, business application controls, system development methodologies, Business Continuity Management, and IT best practices.
  • Mentoring and coaching of less experienced staff on complex topics. Plan and implement technical training and information sharing (team/peer).
  • Driving consistent enhancement of methodology and practices of the audit function.

 

 

 

What you bring

 

  • Minimum 9 years professional experience in internal/external IT audit, or as IT consultant or equivalent.
  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree (or comprehensive experience) in Information Technologies, Business Informatics or equivalent.
  • Professional certification e.g.  CISA, CISSP, or in COBIT, ITIL is an advantage.
  • Broad IT skills on IT infrastructure and information & cyber security (e.g. operating systems, databases, networks, public cloud, security related tools), and ideally also on web technology, IT governance, general IT controls, programming and software deployment.
  • Broad understanding of regulatory requirements, especially DORA regulation with the aspects of ICT Risk Management, Digital Resilience, Incident Management and Third-Party Risk Management.
  • Driving data analytics literacy globally based on broad experience in data analytics, including data cleansing and preparation, data analysis, data visualization, statistical data mining, or data science, as well as driving usage on Artificial Intelligence from an Internal Audit perspective.
  • Working knowledge of core Office applications, especially Excel and PowerBI.
  • Knowledge of any data analytics tools (e.g. Python, TeamMate Analytics, Idea) is considered an advantage.
  • Experience in Asset Management or financial services, including financial industry products and services, securities processing, and related information systems.
  • Experience in handling diverse personalities, intercultural differences and managing challenging situations. Team spirit, personal initiative and intercultural sensitivity is necessary to interact in a global work environment.
  • Fluent English (verbal and written); German language skills are an advantage.
  • Compliance with audit policies and respective standards (independence, integrity, confidentiality, truth and fairness, security, economy, system conformity).
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% per annum.

What we offer

 

  • New ways of working (hybrid model/ flexible working hours/cross-border remote work) 
  • Access to pension/ savings plans/ Allianz products
  • Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
  • Company share purchasing plan 
  • Mental health and wellbeing programs 
  • Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
  • Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group 
  • Self-guided learning & development
  • … and so much more! 

The base salary range for this position is 130,000 -160,000 USD.

Allianz Asset Management rewards its employees based on a total compensation approach which includes base salary and discretionary variable compensation. Base Salary is the fixed component of compensation that is determined by factors such as core job responsibilities, relevant experience, internal level, and market factors. The discretionary variable compensation considers individual, business division as well as company performance on a long- term sustainable basis.

About Allianz Asset Management

 

Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurance and financial service providers, a global player employing almost 160,000 people who conduct business in more than 70 countries. 

 

Within Allianz Group, Allianz Asset Management GmbH (AllianzAM) is the financial and governance holding company for the asset management business of Allianz Group, with approx. EUR 2,448 bn of assets under management and over 6,500 employees worldwide. AllianzAM comprises two separate investment management companies: Allianz Global Investors and PIMCO. AllianzAM has created a business structure that enables it to meet the demands of stakeholders and empowers its investment managers to focus on achieving strong and consistent results.

As an Actuarial Pricing Analyst at Allianz Partners, you will analyze company risk related to insurance products, price new products, and perform in-depth analyses of historical business performance to accurately forecast future liability and set appropriate rate levels.

 

As a key member of our five-person actuarial team, you'll help drive pricing strategy for a $2.5B travel insurance portfolio while influencing product innovation, performing predictive modeling, and contributing to strategic business decision-making. You'll have the freedom to bring new ideas forward, leverage emerging technologies including AI, work directly with senior leadership, and build the skills needed to grow into future leadership opportunities.

 

Way of Working: This position follows a hybrid way of working Monday through Friday to include 2 in-office days on Tuesdays and Thursdays at our location in Richmond, Virginia.

 

 

What you will do

  • Apply a variety of actuarial concepts, practices, and procedures, in accordance with relevant Actuarial Standards of Practice as promulgated by the Actuarial Standards Board and recognized actuarial organizations.
  • Collect, analyze and interpret historical data.
  • Utilize detailed knowledge of benefits, certificates and adjudication process to evaluate potential impact of benefit plan experience data.
  • Meet actuarial reporting needs: manage the completion and delivery of internal and external reports and serve as a consultant and guide others within the division on deliverables and independently manage projects through completion.
  • Plan and implement innovative insurance, management and client solutions
  • Design rate filings to support benefit and product needs in compliance with state regulatory requirements.
  • Independently respond to regulatory requests related to rate filings and market conduct examinations.
  • Develop customized pricing models, as needed.
  • Enhance and develop tools and models as necessary to support changes in the business.
  • Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data analytics, and cloud‑based tools, using insights responsibly and in alignment with our standards for data governance, security, and ethical use.

 

What you will bring 

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Finance, Economics or related field or equivalent combination of education, training and relevant work experience.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years related pricing actuarial experience in the insurance industry.
  • Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in actuarial techniques, R or Python coding and predictive modeling.
  • Associate, Casualty Actuarial Society designation preferred.
  • Experience or demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives.
  • Cross functional collaboration skills with strong business acumen.

At this time, Allianz Partners will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration-related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, or another type of work authorization)

 

What we offer

 

Annualized base pay range is $96,300 – $142,000 USD

Actual base pay may vary based upon factors such as relevant experience, qualifications, internal equity of peers, and geographic location. Employees may also qualify for performance-based bonuses, merit increases, and other incentives based on individual and company performance. Job.JobTitle: Regional Head of Sales, Travel Partnerships, North America
Job.JobDescription:
As Regional Head, Travel Partnerships – North America, you will be the senior commercial leader responsible for defining and executing the sales and partnerships strategy supporting all lines of business within the Travel segment. You will drive revenue growth and expansion across a portfolio of travel suppliers and distribution partners, including airlines, online travel agencies (OTAs), hotels, event ticketing partners, and other digital channels distributing embedded and ancillary insurance products.

This high-impact leadership role oversees the Business Development function and Travel Segment Key Account Management team and serves as a member of the North America Senior Leadership Team. You will shape growth strategy, strengthen key partnerships, and influence business decisions across the organization. This is a unique opportunity to bring an eCommerce-driven mindset to a global leader in travel insurance and assistance and help drive the next phase of digital partnership growth.

Way of Working

Hybrid based in Richmond, Virginia Monday – Friday with 2 in-office days (Tuesday and Thursday)

Approximately 25% travel, primarily within North America, to engage partners and stakeholders

What You Will Do

 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to the sales organization supporting the Travel Segment across North America, ensuring alignment with company objectives and Line of Business strategy.

  • Define and execute a regional travel partnerships strategy focused on priority supplier segments (airlines, hotels and lodging, eCommerce travel platforms, event ticketing partners).

  • Partner closely with the Travel Line of Business and Partnership Success Teams to ensure sales plays, value propositions, and solutions align with market dynamics and partner needs.

  • Lead the Business Development function for the Travel Segment, ensuring a structured, scalable approach to identifying, qualifying, and pursuing new partnership opportunities that support regional growth objectives.

  • Provide executive oversight of the Travel Segment Key Account Management team, managing and expanding strategic partner relationships across all eCommerce channels and ensuring strong governance across the full partner lifecycle.

  • Serve as executive sponsor for key strategic partners, fostering long-term, senior-level relationships and driving joint value creation and commercial success.

  • Establish revenue objectives, forecasts, and performance metrics for Travel Segment partnerships within North America, monitoring pipeline health, partner performance, and market trends using data-driven insights and adjusting strategy as needed.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop senior leaders within Sales, Business Development, and Key Account Management, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture focused on strategic partnerships and long-term value creation.
  • Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data analytics, and cloud‑based tools, using insights responsibly and in alignment with our standards for data governance, security, and ethical use.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in sales, partnerships, or business development, with proven success in complex, partnership-driven environments.
  • Experience within the Insurance or Insurtech industry, preferably in travel, specialty, or embedded insurance.
  • Strong understanding of insurance distribution models, including B2B2C, embedded insurance, affinity partnerships, and digital channels.
  • Experience selling or partnering with insurance solutions in regulated environments, balancing growth with compliance and risk considerations.
  • Strong understanding of the travel and eCommerce ecosystem, including supplier and platform dynamics (e.g., airlines, OTAs, hotels, and event ticketing partners).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead in a matrixed environment and influence senior stakeholders, aligning priorities across Sales, Partnership Success, and Lines of Business.
  • Hands-on, results-oriented leadership style with the ability to lead experienced teams, drive results through others, and engage in operational details when needed.

What we offer

 

United States:  Annualized base pay range is $134,000 - $197,000 USD

Actual base pay may vary based upon factors such as relevant experience, qualifications, internal equity of peers, and geographic location. Employees may also qualify for performance-based bonuses, merit increases, and other incentives based on individual and company performance. The availability and amount of these additional compensation elements are determined by company policy and may vary.

The Data Science team at Allianz Life sits within the Data & Analytics Center of Excellence and is responsible for developing machine learning, automation, NLP, generative AI and other data science solutions across the company. The team supports all areas of the business including operations, sales/distribution, marketing/growth, HR and compliance.

The 2027 Graduate Data Science Summer Internship position will provide an opportunity to tackle challenging and meaningful real world business problems using cutting edge data science techniques and solutions. You will be working directly with business stakeholders and technical teams on highly visible and highly impactful projects. A successful candidate will have a strong technical background in data science and statistics as well as strong communications skills and a willingness to work in a collaborative environment.

What you do:

  • Design and build appropriate data science solutions and/or statistical analyses that will address important business needs
  • Query and prepare relevant data for models and analysis, including performing exploratory data analysis and handling outliers
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and data scientists to understand business problems and develop appropriate solution, including iterating through proof-of-concept solutions
  • Implement high quality code and participate in regular code reviews with data scientists
  • Balance working independently and collaborating with other team members on a variety of projects
  • Identify new opportunities for analytical solutions
  • Present results and recommendations to department and senior leadership

  • Working toward a graduate or doctorate degree in statistics, data science, math, computer science or a related quantitative field
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods (e.g. hypothesis testing), machine learning concepts, and data visualization techniques
  • Experience working with databases, including relational databases using SQL
  • Ability to summarize, explore, visualize, and manipulate large data sets
  • Ability to deal with the ambiguity of early-stage scoping and evaluation of new opportunities and the flexibility to change direction as additional information becomes available
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Curiosity to learn, including an interest in learning about the life insurance and annuities industry

  • Conducts risk assessments during projects and manages reports on residual risks; provides ad-hoc security consultancy on projects, both local and group initiatives
  • Encourages and nurtures effective working relationships across IT, promoting the one team approach both across departments within IT (onshore and offshore) as well as engaging positively with the Business Community in pursuance of total business solutions
  • Ensures that management and staff are made aware of Information Security Policies and Processes relevant to their general working environment and, where necessary, their specific job roles
  • Ensures that management and staff are made aware of and understand the information security risks and associated mitigating controls that have been put in place to address them

 

PCI DSS Compliance

  • Manages and maintains the organization's PCI DSS compliance program, ensuring adherence to the current PCI DSS standard (v4.0.1)
  • Coordinates and leads the annual PCI DSS Self-Assessment Questionnaire (SAQ) process or Report on Compliance (ROC) activities
  • Defines, documents, and maintains the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) scope, including network segmentation validation
  • Liaises with Qualified Security Assessors (QSAs) during external assessments and manages remediation of any findings
  • Maintains and updates PCI DSS policies, procedures, and evidence documentation throughout the compliance cycle
  • Conducts quarterly internal vulnerability scans and coordinates with Approved Scanning Vendors (ASVs) for external scans
  • Monitors and ensures compliance with PCI DSS requirements across all 12 requirement domains
  • Manages the PCI DSS compensating controls documentation and ensures controls remain valid and effective
  • Coordinates penetration testing activities in alignment with PCI DSS requirements
  • Tracks and reports on PCI compliance status to senior leadership and relevant governance committees
  • Manages relationships with payment brands, acquiring banks, and third-party service providers regarding PCI compliance obligations
  • Ensures new projects, systems, and vendors that interact with cardholder data are assessed for PCI DSS impact
  • Leads incident response activities related to potential cardholder data breaches in coordination with the broader security team

 

 

 

What you will bring 

 

 

  • Solid understanding of information security control and governance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT)
  • Minimum 3–5 years of direct PCI DSS compliance experience, including assessment coordination and evidence management
  • Previous experience of conducting onsite information security audits
  • Experience working with payment processors, acquiring banks, or card brands
  • Significant information security experience in a regulated environment
  • Experience managing third-party service provider compliance and conducting due diligence reviews

 

 

 

What we offer

 

Our employees play an integral part in our success as a business. We appreciate that each of our employees are unique and have unique needs, ambitions and we enjoy being a part of their journey.


We are there to empower and encourage you with your personal and professional development ensuring that you take control by offering a large variety of courses and targeted development programs. All that in a global environment where international mobility and career progression are encouraged. Caring for your health and wellbeing is key priority for us. This is why we build Work Well programs to providing you with peace of mind and give the flexibility in planning and arranging for a better work-life balance.

 

 

At Allianz we use some AI-assisted technology as part of our recruitment process to help match candidates to roles based on skills, experience, job title, and location. AI supports our recruiters by enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of candidate assessments and job recommendations, while all applications are reviewed by our recruitment team and final hiring decisions are made by humans.

 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

  • In the US (USD): $76,300 – $111,970
  • In Canada (CAD): $66,400 – $97,350

Actual base salary may vary based upon factors such as relevant experience, qualifications, internal equity of peers, and geographic location. Employees may also qualify for performance based bonuses, merit increases, and other incentives based on individual and company performance.
