Job.JobTitle: Head of National Accounts - Liability US
Job.JobDescription:
Let’s care for tomorrow.

Your ambitions.  Your dreams.  Your tomorrow

At Allianz Commercial (AzC), we are the global leader for insuring corporate and specialty risks in the Allianz Group.  Whether it’s aircraft, international business or offshore wind parks, Allianz Commercial has an extensive range of risks covered when it comes to protecting businesses. 

We are looking for an Head of National Accounts - Liability US based in New York or Chicago

Your Team:
The National Accounts Liability team offers a wide range of liability insurance solutions. These include Excess, Umbrella, some Primary GL, and Multinational.

The Impact You Will Have:
Reporting to the Regional Head of Liability – Noth America, the Head of National Accounts – Liability US will:

  • Lead a team of Zone Leaders, Team Leads and Underwriters within the National Accounts line of business to underwrite profitable new and renewal business, meeting Liability targets regionally and/or globally;
  • Have management oversight of large/critical accounts/clients and will have ultimate responsibility for accounts within the National Accounts portfolio;
  • Lead and manage a senior team, including training and development and act as the referral point for other underwriters; and
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with brokers and clients.

Some of your specific responsibilities could include:

  • Managing a team of Zone Leaders, Team Leads and underwriters, including delegate tasks to team in order to achieve overall results, managing/supervising team client accounts and acting as point of referral and managing cost center budget within plan.
  • Developing and executing the  underwriting strategy for National Accounts, Liability.
  • Managing referrals from underwriters and re-underwriting complex business as appropriate.
  • Responsibility for particular sub-LoB or area within regional team and acting as a "champion" for any matters relating to the sub-LoB.
  • Overseeing large/critical new and renewal accounts to meet top and bottom line targets (regional and/or global), including negotiating participation, pricing and terms and conditions with brokers, as well as proactively managing capacity.
  • Underwriting and evaluating Natural Catastrophe Accumulation, ensuring an understanding of catastrophe modelling and interpretation of scenarios for Liability, as well as underwriting International Insurance Programs for Liability.
  • Underwriting in line with Liability governance framework (e.g., underwriting authorities, global MSU, Underwriting Guidelines, and Rules and Principles).
  • Ensuring contract certainty is achieved on all accounts at time of inception.
  • Ensuring utilization of global/regional pricing tools.
  • Ensuring placing and binding of FAC Reinsurance prior to policy inception.
  • Overseeing adherence to reinsurance treaty.
  • Participating in reinsurance treaty processes related to the National Accounts portfolio.
  • Proactively supporting acquisition of new business and retention of existing business (including client and producer negotiations where necessary) and liaising with Distribution on market management initiatives.
  • Positively representing Allianz Commercial externally to the market.
  • Proactively driving involvement of functional areas in Underwriting process, including Distribution, ARC, Claims, and Operations.
  • Developing and maintaining strong relationships with key producers and clients and other relevant stakeholders (e.g., risk managers).

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • A minimum of 11 years of experience in underwriting profitable Liability business, including specialized expert understanding of sub-LoB products and portfolio;
  • Recognized, well-established long term relationship building with brokers at peer group level and within the local market;
  • Specialized understanding of regional/local Liability insurance markets and competitor landscape, including global elements;
  • Understanding of legal and regulatory framework;
  • Ability to assess risk inherent exposures and natural hazards relevant to Liability;
  • Ability to analyze current performance against benchmarks applying how the market operates and functions, the business needs and customer needs;
  • Experience designing, developing and implementing consistent, robust wordings;
  • Robust understanding of policy administration life cycle, information collection, policy issuance, premium bookings, credit control, and cancellation;
  • Ability to analyze highly complex data, from multiple sources, in detail, identifying and resolving issues before they transpire;
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, with an ability to influence others;
  • Experience with MS Office tools;
  • Significant experience in leadership and development of direct teams, including coaching, mentoring and developing team members and performance assessment;
  • Ability to persuade and motivate others to act, without executive authority;
  • Ability to utilize AI tools to support day-to-day tasks, improve efficiency and contribute to data-driven decision making; and
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Economics, Finance, Insurance Management or Business Administration.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship.

The annualized base pay range for this role is $180,000 - $280,000. The annual base salary range represents a nationwide market range. The actual salary for this position may be above and will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate. The base pay is just one component of the AzC total compensation package. As part of our comprehensive compensation and highly rated benefits programs, employees are also eligible for annual performance-based cash incentive awards.

Reporting Line: US Head of Commercial Underwriting

Under the direction of the US Head of Commercial Underwriting, this position will manage a pipeline of new business submissions in order to achieve Allianz Trade profitability and growth objectives. This position will analyze and provide policy structure and premium rates for new business applications, cultivate relationships with direct sales force agents and broker partners, provide the highest quality of customer service, and assess commercial underwriting risk.

Key Responsibilities and Duties
  • Structure and price new business policies to drive profitability and growth
  • Have a deep understanding and be compliant with Group Commercial Rules.
  • High level of interaction with Risk Underwriting to maximize approvals for a pipeline of new business applications.
  • Manage customer and broker relationships with our Direct Sales Force team
  • Provide highest levels of customer service to internal and external customers by promptly addressing inquiries, providing accurate information, and offering tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of prospective customers.
  • Quote/negotiate new business transactions in accordance with Allianz Trade pricing and Commercial Underwriting guidelines
  • Support management of new business pipeline with Direct Sales Force team
  • Be a principal driver of revenue, growth and profitability
  • Lead and/or contribute to special projects as needed
  • Act as a mentor for more junior team members
  • Work independently on projects assigned on an as needed basis

Required Qualifications and Skills
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business, economics, finance or related discipline
  • Previous trade credit commercial underwriting experience preferred
  • 4 plus years of financial services or underwriting experience
  • Effectively interact with our Direct Sales Force and other departments within Allianz Trade
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Successfully manage multiple priorities

Under minimal supervision, you will work on all phases of the audit process including consultative projects. You will provide consultative guidance to the department demonstrating technical proficiency in one or more domain(s) as assigned. You will perform complex assignments within the context of audit engagements including the following: identify and evaluate risk, develop audit programs, execute complex audit program steps, identify and communicate issues, provide recommendations for improvements in efficiency and effectiveness, and provide written and oral feedback relative to the engagement.  Work with Management in developing action plans to ensure identified risks are effectively mitigated.

What you do:

  • Review business processes and Draft audit programs to effectively test the design and operational effectiveness of the system of internal controls.
  • Perform complex audit activities, as assigned.
  • Identify and communicate issues and provide recommendations for improvements of the internal control environment.
  • Collaborate with management on the development of action plans to ensure risks are mitigated appropriately and follow-up to completion.
  • Serve as key contact between the business and internal audit and develop executive presence.
  • Act as business technical advisor to audit team members.
  • Utilization of artificial intelligence tools and resources (e.g. generative AI).

What you bring:

  • 6 or more years experience required: Professional experience working in a corporate setting; Minimum 2-3 years of Audit or insurance industry related experience required.
  • Four-year degree required or equivalent work experience
  • You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes holders of H-1B, H4, L-1, L-2, TN, OPT, CPT, and other nonimmigrant visas.

Job posting range: $82,000 - $124,000

In addition to those factors, we will also consider internal equity of our current employees. Please keep in mind that the range provided is the full base salary range for the role. Hiring at or near the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. This role is also eligible for a variable compensation program. The actual variable compensation earned is driven by assigned territory and individual sales performance.

What we offer:

At Allianz Life, we’re proud to provide a benefits package that supports the True Balance of our employees and their families. We offer: a choice of comprehensive medical, dental and vision plan options, flexible spending and health savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, student loan retirement program, generous annual paid leave, an outstanding 401(k) company match, and life insurance. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Risk Manager, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
At Allianz Life, we are driven by our mission – we secure your future – and by our common goal of caring for tomorrow. We care for our employees by promoting an inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to grow and be rewarded for their success. We care for our customers by creating new products that help them protect their families and pursue their retirement goals. We care for our community by giving time, resources, and donations. And we care for the future by supporting sustainability, protecting the local environment, and promoting societal equity.

What you do:

As a Senior Operations Control Consultant, you will assess control needs, recommend controls, perform monitoring controls and testing, monitor control performance, and provide risk management expertise and consulting related to the Policyholder Tax Operations function. The Policyholder Tax Operations team performs tax administration and support for annuity and life insurance products. Under limited supervision, the Senior Operations Control Consultant is responsible for collaborating with business leaders, key stakeholders, and business unit control consultants to develop, enhance and implement processes and controls to identify, assess, and improve the risk environment within Policyholder Tax Operations. The resource will collaborate with second and third lines of defense (legal and compliance) to align on scalable risk management solutions. The role may partner with more senior consultants on complex and/or large-scale initiatives.

  • Develop and maintain the COO risk management framework supporting Policyholder Tax Operations (e.g., policies, procedures, standards, and tools).
  • Partner with the Policyholder Tax Operations team to provide day-to-day consultation on risk management practices and control effectiveness. Coordinate with business unit control consultants and personnel on execution of risk and control activities related to Policyholder Tax processes, risks and controls.
  • Manage ongoing reporting and analysis in support of the risk management framework. Lead reviews and discussions with business leaders regarding findings, trends, and areas for risk and control improvement.
  • Document and manage standard operating procedures (SOPs) for control monitoring.
  • Assess operations processes and solutions and recommend business improvement opportunities aligned with trends identified in areas of compliance, controls and risk management. Present recommendations to partners, including senior leadership.
  • Develop and deliver risk and controls related training; provide coaching and mentoring to business unit control consultants and other personnel as needed.
  • Provide consultative support to assist with gap closure and key risk projects.
  • Utilization of artificial intelligence tools and resources (e.g. generative AI).

What you bring:

  • 4 or more years’ experience required: Operations, Insurance/Financial services experience and/or relevant technical experience; strong analytical skills; knowledge of basic project management practices and risk management methodology.
  • Four year degree or equivalent work experience required
  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes holders of H-1B, H4, L-1, L-2, TN, OPT, CPT, and other nonimmigrant visas.

Base Salary Range: $80,000 - $115,000

Actual base salary may vary based upon factors such as relevant experience, qualifications, internal equity of peers, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual incentive program. 

What we offer:

At Allianz Life, we’re proud to provide a benefits package that supports the True Balance of our employees and their families. We offer a choice of comprehensive medical and dental plan options, a generous time off plan and an outstanding 401(k) company match. Plus, our employees enjoy an award-winning campus with an array of discounted amenities, including an onsite health center, child development center, fitness facility, convenience store and two cafeterias. Our employees and leaders take an active role in shaping our culture through our Employee Resource Groups, whose activities and advocacy contribute to an environment that welcomes, includes and celebrates diversity. Our generous benefits, campus amenities and inclusive, engaged culture are among the many reasons we’re routinely recognized as a top workplace employer.
